dbe skrun gsal bshad/'dzam gling yang steng du chags pa'i rang re'i bod mi rigs 'di nyid la lo rgyus ring zhing mi rigs kyi thun min gyi khyad chos ldan pa'i rig gnas gzhan dring mi 'jog pa zhig yod gshis/ deng sang 'dzam gling du bod rig pa zhes bod kyi srid 'byor rig gsum gtso bor gyur pa'i bod spyi tshogs kyi khyab khongs so sor zhib 'jug bgyi ba'i rig lam gsar ba 'di gsar dar byung ste/ rgyal khab dang sa khul mang po zhig gis zhib 'jug las khungs ched btsugs kyis do snang chen po byas dang byed bzhin yod pa spyi dang / sgos su rang rgyal du nye ba'i lo 'ga' nas bod rig pa'i zhib 'jug gi las ka dbyar mtsho bzhin du rgyas pa'i dgos mkho'i ched dang / lhag par rgyal nang du spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi dpal yon gsum 'dzugs spel gyi rba rlabs 'phyur bzhin yod pa'ang mi'i shes rig la rag las stabs/ mi rigs so so'i rtsa ba'i rig gnas phul byung rnams nyams pa sor chud dang ma nyams gong 'phel gtong ba'i dgos mkho bcas la dmigs te/ 'di ga dpe skrun khang gis rgyal khab rim pa'i tshan rig zhib 'jug gi rnam grangs gtso gras su tshud pa'i bod yig gi 〈bka' 'gyur 〉 dang 〈bstan 'gyur 〉 dpe bsdur ma par skrun 'grem spel byas dang byed mur yod pa ma zad/ da dung bod kyi mkhas dbang snga rabs pa dag gis mdzad pa'i gsung 'bum thams cad legs sgrig bya rgyu'i 'char gzhi ltar/ bod yig gi gna' dpe'i dpe dkon dpe tshogs du ma par du bskrun dang skrun bzhin yod la/ da lam rgya che'i klog pa po rnams kyi spyan ras dgyes pa'i dga' ston du 'bul bya ni 〈rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum 〉〉 zhes pa ste/ 'di ni dus rabs bcu bdun pa'i skabs su byon pa'i tā la'i bla ma sku phreng lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtshos mdzad pa'i gsung chos rnams phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs (pod 1 28yod pa )pa yin la/ yongs grags su rgyal dbang lnga pa zhes pa khong ni tā la'i bla ma sku phreng thams cad las brtsams chos ches mang zhing / bod kyi chos srid rig gnas thad la mdzad pa ha cang rgya chen po gnang yod pa'i thun min skyes mchog cig yin/1

bgrang bya gnyis kyi sngon du 'di ga dpe skrun khang nas ser gtsug dpe rnying 'tshol bsdu phyogs sgrig khang dang zhib gros byas mthar srol rgyun rig gnas srung skyob dang / bod rig pa'i dpyad yig myur skyob dang cha tshang du gtong ba'i dmigs yul ngos 'dzin gcig gyur thog 〈gangs can khyad nor 〉zhes pa'i dpe tshogs chen po mnyam 'brel gyis par skrun zhu rgyu'i gros mthun byung ba las/ gsung 'bum 'di nyid par du bskrun pa ni mnyam las kyi grub 'bras thog ma yin zhing / mu mthud las gzhi rgya bskyed yong ba'i rmang gzhi yang tshugs pa yin/gsung 'bum 'di nyid kyi ma phyi bsdu rub dang / glog klad du 'jug pa/ zhu dag bcas ser gtsug nang bstan dpe rnying 'tshol bsdu phyogs sgrig khang nas mdzad cing / sgrig rim dang dpe sgrigazhu dag skabs kyi gsal bshad zhu dgos pa rnams bsdu sgrig gsal bshad du bkod yod pa ltar lags pas bskyar zlos gsal bshad byas med/gsung 'bum 'di nyid kyi nang du/ lo rgyus rnam thar skor dang / gsan yig 'don chog sgrub thabs/ dbu phar 'dul mdzod sogs kyi 'grel bshad/ rten bzhugs dkar chag rtsis dkar nagagasol mchod/ chab shog bca' yig rdzogs chen khrid skor/ snyan ngag gi 'grel pa sogs nang don sna mang phun sum tshogs pa yod pas/ skabs de'i bod sa gnas kyi lo rgyus dang / mdo sngags rig gnas kyi skor la slob gnyer dang zhib 'jug byed mkhan rnams la rin thang gzhal du med pa'i dpyad gzhi'i nor sgrom zhig red/ 'di ltar dpe sgrig gi las ga'i brgyud rim cha tshang ba byas te par du bton mod/ nga tsho'i shes yon gyi chu tshad zhan pa dang mi sna nyung zhing las ka mang drag pas zhu dag dang dpe sgrig thad la chad lhag nor 'byug yod nges pas mkhyen ldan rnams kyis legs spel nyes 'gog gi dgongs 'char thad gar stsol gnang mkhyen zhu rgyu dang / rting mar gsung 'bum 'di bzhin legs sgrig byed pa'i bya ba la phyogs gang thad nas rgyab skyor gnang mkhan gzhung sger kun la snying thag pa nas thugs rje che zhus//krung ka'i bod rig pa dpe sgrun khang nas/spyi lo 2009lo'i zla 8par/2

gleng gzhi/rab dkar gangs ri'i phreng bas yongs su bskor zhing 'dzam gling go la chen po'i spyi gtsug tu chags pa'i mtho sgang bod ces grags pa'i sa yi thig ler/ pha sprel rgan dang / ma brag srin gnyis nas mched pa'i bod mi'i thog ma byung ba nas bzung / skye bo kun gyis rang rang gi rnam dpyod 'dra min gyi rtsal la brten nas rig pa'i gnas ci rigs gsar gtod dang / 'phel rgyas btang zhing gtong mus mchis/ lhag par dus rabs bdun pa'i skabs su sa gsum na snyan pa'i grags pa yongs su khyab pa'i chos kyi rgyal po srong btsan sgam po zhes bya ba'i skyes mchog gang gi mkhyen brtse nus pa'i byed las nyag gcig gi mthu las/ bod kyi sa chen po'i khyon kun la khyab par nus shing / 'jig rten dang /'jig rten las 'das pa'i chos kyi gnas lugs mtha' dag ji bzhin ston par nus pa/ ches ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba'i bod kyi yi ge 'di bzhin thog mar srol gtod mdzad la/ skye rgu'i phan bde'i gzhi rtsa nang chos bod du bsgyur mgo brtsams pa dang / dus rabs brgyad pa'i nang chos rgyal khri srong lde btsan gyis bsam yas su sad mi bdun gyis thog drangs rab byung gi sde dang / sgra bsgyur slob grwa thog mar btsugs nas blo rig bkra ba'i lo tsā ba du ma gso skyong gnang ste/ nye 'brel rgyal khab khag nas nang rig pa gtso bor gyur pa'i rigs gzhung snying bcud sna tshogs ljongs 'dir dar spel mdzad de/ shes rig mdzod brgya'i sgo 'phar yangs por phyes pa nas bzung / dus rabs rim pa'i nang yul /bams 'dir 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum la mnga' brnyes pa'i mkhas grub gnyis ldan gyi skyes chen dam pa ji snyed byon pa rnams kyis snga phyir bod yig tu bsgyur cing gtan la phab pa dang / gsar rtsom mdzad pa'i bstan bcos thams cad 'u cag lta bus tshe gang ngal ba bsten nas bgrangs kyang bgrang bar dka' bas/ bod yul gyi gsung rab glegs bam thams cad gzhi gcig tu brtsigs na ri rgyal lhun po'i dpangs la'ang skyengs pa ster nus so zhes smras kyang 'ud du mi che/ de /lta bu'i rtsa che'i rigs gzhung

rmongs pa'i nad brgya 'joms pa'i sman mchog bdud rtsi lta bu de dag gi ro bcud gangs can pa'i lus sems su shog bu snum tshos bzhin du sims pa nas bzung / skye bo phal pa dag gi blang dor 'byed pa'i shes rab kyi tshad kyang ches mthon por son te sgo gsum dge bcu'i las la brtson pa dang / byams dang snying rjes rgyud dul zhing / ya rabs dang gshis bzang gi mdzes sdug rang chas su ldan pa'i mi rigs khyad 'phags can zhig tu yar rgyas byung ba'i 'bras bur/ deng gi dus su'ang 'dzam gling yongs su gnas pa'i srid 'byor rig gsum spyi dang / yang sgos tshan rig rtser son gyi yul gru dag gi mi sna grags can rnams kyang yul 'di dang 'di nyid kyi rig gnas la blo kha phyogs sa dang / zhib 'jug bya yul zhig tu gyur don yang de'i phyir lags/'on kyang sems can spyi mthun gyi bsod nams nyams dmas su song ba'i nyer len las/ lo bcu'i god chags kyi khrod du stong gsum nor gyis bkang ste yon du phul na yang blu thabs bral ba'i gangs ljongs kyi khyad noX te/ gsung rab par shing dang bcas pa phal mo che me lha dang chu lha'i zhal du phul zin dag ni bskyar gso bya rgyu'i nus mthu rang cag su la'ang med la/ dus ngan de lta bu'i khrod nas stes dbang gis da lta sa steng du lhag lus gsung rab dag kyang phal che ba dpe rgyun dkon rigs sha stag tu gyur stabs deng skabs rig gnas dngos rdzas kyi lam lugs gzhir bzung bdag srung byed dgos rkyen/ rigs gzhung don gnyer ba'i spyan lam du bstar ma thub pas gsung rab kyi dgos pa ji bzhin ma grub cing / de bas nyen tshabs che ba ni 'byung bzhi sogs kyi gnod pas sa steng du rtsa brlag mi gtong ba'i nges pa med gshis/ 'di kun bdag srung gnad 'khel bya rgyu de gzhan la 'gel thabs med pa'i rang cag kho na'i 'gan 'khri nyid du nges so/ /der brten se ra theg chen gling dang lha ldan gtsug lag khang mnyam 'brel gyis ser gtsug nang bstan dpe rnying 'tshol bsdu phyogs sgrig khang zhes pa'i tshan pa zhig ched du btsugs nas da bar bgrang bya gsum lhag tsam gyi ring la phyogs gnyis nas thun mong du ma thebs sgor sa ya gsum lhag 2

tsam btang ste dpe dkon myur skyob dang / deng skabs slob gnyer ba'i nyer mkho'i ched du gangs can khyad nor zhes pa'i dpe tshogs gsar du bsgrigs te da phan pod phreng nyis brgyar nye ba par skrun zin pa dang / dgon sde dang / spyi tshogs kyi dpe mdzod khang brgya la nye bar cha tshang gnyis re rin med 'bul lam zhus pa phud/ de byings ma gnas tsam gyi thog nas spus 'tshong zhus te/ rgyal bstan la sri zhu dang ris med ser skya thos bsam can rnams kyi thugs 'dun skong thabs zhu mus su mchis/'das pa'i lo zla'i nang nga tsho'i las gzhi la gong rim 'brel yod tshan pa khag gi dbu khrid nas gzigs skyong bla na med pa gnang ba dang / mkhyen dpyod mkha' ltar yangs shing / lhag bsam dung ltar dkar ba'i skyes chen du mas nga tsho'i las gar gdeng 'jog tshad med dang / ma nor lam ston/ ma dpe mkho 'don gnang ba sogs kyis mtshon/ nga tshor phyar ba gru 'degs kyis lhad med rgyab skyor rogs ram gnang bar rjes su yi rangs dang / snying dbus nas thugs rje che zhes zhu ba dang chabs ciga'abyung 'gyur yang ser gtsug nas dge lugs gsung 'bum gtso bor gyur pa'i ris med gsung rab dpe rgyun dkon rigs dang / zhib 'jug tshan pa khag dang / slob grwa khag la nye bar mkho ba'i rig gzhung dag kyang rim pas par skrun zhu rgyu'i 'dun pa snying bcangs su yod pa lags na/ lhag bsam rnam dpyod can gyi ris med ser skya kun nas ma dpe mkho 'don dang / nga tsho'i las gar rtsa che'i lam ston bka' slob mu mthud lhug stsol yod pa mkhyen zhes zhu'o/ /ser ra khuganang bstan dpe rnying 'tshol bas phyogs ga khang nas/spyi lo 2009lo'i zla ba 6pa'i tshes 7la/

bsdi/sgrig gab55 nga pond/7gong sa lnga pa chen po mchog ni spyir sku tshe hril po chos srid gnyis kyis mtshon sku gsung thugs kyi gsang gsum mdzad pa bsam gyis mi khyab pas dus 'da' bar mdzad pa dang/ yang sgos mdzad pa'i mchog gsung gi mdzad pa ste/ dam pa gang gis rjes 'jug skal ldan rnams kyi bsod nams kyi bgo skal du bzhag pa'i yid bzhin nor bu las kyang lhag pa'i rtsa chen gsung 'bum dag ni/gang nyid sku 'tsho bzhugs skabs nas lha rtse dga' ldan phun tshogs gling du cha tshang par shing du brkos yod rung / rig gnas gsar brje'i skabs rtsa thor du song nas da lta gsung 'bum cha tshang gcig kyang btsal rnyed dka' bar gyur stabs/ snga phyir don gnyer lhag bsam can gyi tshogs pa dang mi sger mi nyung ba zhig la/ phyogs bsgrigs dang dpe skrun zhu 'dun yod kyang / ma dpe btsal 'tshol dang mi sna'i cha rkyen sogs rgyu rkyen sna tshogs la brten nas/ da bar sus kyang dpe skrun ma thub par rim 'gyangs su lus 'dug par brten/'di ga ser gtsug nang bstan dpe rnying 'tshol bsdu phyogs sgrig khang nas spyi lo 2005nas bzung snga phyir 'bras spungs dgon dang /pho brang po tā la/bod ljongs dpe mdzod khang sogs rig dngos tshan pa khag dang / de bzhin mi sger sogs nas ma dpe g.yar po zhus pa bzhin 'brel yod khag nas gang ci'i mthun 'gyur gang legs stsal ba brgyud dge lugs gsung 'bum gtso gnad du byas pa'i ris med kyi gsung 'bum pod stong phrag brgal ba zer bris su dpar ba dang / gzhan yang dpe dkon dang nyer mkho'i rigs dpe deb nyis brgyar nye ba nang khul par skrun byas zin pa dang /de'i khongs nas rgyal dbang lnga pa chen po'i gsung 'bum pod nyer lnga dang / sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtshos mdzad pa'i du kū la'i gos bzang gi 'phros pod gsum bcas khyon pod nyer brgyad bzhugs pa/gangs can khyad nor dpe tshogs kyi pod 'phreng 171nas 198bar bsgrigs te rgya che'i gzigs pa 4

po'i spyan lam du phul ba yin/gsung 'bum 'di nyid kyi ma phyi ni pho brang po tā lar bzhugs pa'i rgyal dbang mchog gi gsung 'bum rmang gzhir bzung thog yi ge mi gsal ba dang dogs gnas can rnams se ra theg chen gling gi rgyal ba'i gzims chung bde ba can du bzhugs pa'i gsung 'bum dang / lha ldan gtsug lag khang gi dpe mdzod khang du bzhugs pa'i gsung 'bum 'phrul par ma/ de bzhin dwags po mnga' ris grwa tshang gi gsung 'bum 'phrul par ma sogs ma dpe khag bzhi tsam la zhib bsdur zhus pa yin/glegs bam dang chos tshan gyi go rim ni/ deb 1nas 4bar pod rtags (kan 6) (gnakhong ) ste rgyal dbang mchog gi don gyi rnam thar gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun pod bzhi dang / deb ldanas 7bar pod rtags 6༄ 6) (ja) ste thun mong phyi'i rnam thar du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam pod gsum/ deb 8nas 10bar sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtshos mdzad pa'i du kū la'i gos bzang gi 'phros pod gsum ste pod rtags la (ji she (ja3) (ja4)bkod yod/ deb 11pa la pod rtags 6) stergyal dbang sku 'phreng gsum pa dang bzhi pa/ dpon slob paṇa chen blo bzang chos rgyan/ mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan/ khri chen dkon mchog chos 'phel/ 'khon ston dpal 'byor lhun grub/ byang pa rig 'dzin chen po'i rnam thar bcas chos tshan bdun/ deb 12pa la pod rtags 6)ste zur chen chos dbyings rang grol/ nyang ston khra tshang pa/ tshar chen blo gsal rgya mtsho/ khyab bdag dbang phyug rab brtan/ rin chen bsod nams mchog grub kyi rnam thar bcas chos tshan lnga/ deb 13pa la bod rtags (tha)ste bla ma mchod pa'i cho ga zung 'jug sgrub pa'i shing rta sogs chos tshan drug cu re gsum/ deb 14pa la pod rtags9)ste dam can chos srung rgya mtsho'i mngon rtogs mchod 'bul bskang bshags bstod tshogs sogs chos tshan bcu bdun/ deb 15pa la pod rtags rton)ste lam rim 'jam dpal zhal lung sogs chos tshan bcu/ deb 16pa la pod rtags (pa)ste phar phyin blo bzang dgongs rgyan gdong lnga'i dbang po'i sgra dbyangs/ deb 17pa la pod rtags (pha)ste 'dul ba'i 5

las chog rnam rgyal gser mdog dang / chos mngon rin chen 'dren pa'i shing rta sogs chos tshan gsum/ deb 18pa la pod rtags (pe)ste bstod tsho gos dngos grub rgya mtsho sogs chos tshan bcu gcig deb 19nas 21bar pod rtags (5) (mi 64ste sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhengs rin po che'i mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag dang tham phud deb khrims yig 'go rgyangs sde bzhi'i sgo 'phar phye ba'i skal bzang pod gsum/ deb 22pa la pod rtags (dza)ste rgyal rabs deb ther dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i glu dbyangs sogs chos tshan bzhi/ deb 23pa la pod rtags (wa)ste snyan 'grel dbyangs can dgyes glu sogs chos tshan gsum/ deb 24pa la pod rtags (zha)ste smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam gnyis/deb 25pa gsung nang ma (ka)ste bka' brgyad bde gshegs 'dus pa'i las byang khrag 'thung gad rgyangs sogs chos tshan nyer drug deb 26pa gsung nang ma (ba)ste tshe bdag gi yig char rnam par dpyad pa'i yi ge ri thang mtshams kyi nad brgya 'joms pa'i sman gcig sogs chos tshan zhe gsum/ deb 27pa gsung nang ma rtog)ste rdzogs chen 'khrid yig rig 'dzin zhal lung sogs chos tshan nyer drug deb 28pa gsung nang ma (ri)ste le'u bdun pa'i brgyud 'debs sogs chos tshan nga lnga bcas te pho brang po tā la'i gsung 'bum dkar chag gi go rim ltar bsgrigs pa yin/dmigs bsal zhu bya zhig la khong gi gsung las gsang ba rgya can bris ma pod gnyis bzhugs pa ha cang bka' gnyan pa dang / gsang ba khyab bsgrags mi rung ba'i bka' srol ltar 'dir yang par skrun zhus med pa thugs nges zhu rgyu ma zad/ ma dpe'i nang du mchod brjod sogs kyi skabs su lañdza mang tsam byung yang da lta glog klad du lañdza'i yi ge med pas 'jog thub med pa bcas kyang thugs la nges par 'tshal zhu/lhag par du rnam dpyod dang ldan pa rnams kyis slad phyin ma phyir dpe sdur ba dang / 'tshol bde ba'i ched ma dpe'i shog grangs dang nyin srib kyi bsdus rtags (2na) (2ba ) 'di'i nang bkod yod/6

zhu dag byed skabs/ thog ma'i zhu dag dang / bskyar zhus/ yang zhus/ zhus chen bcas zhu dag gi rim pa bzhi lhag brgyud cing / tshig phrad dang / lhag bcas/ rgyan sdud gsum gyi phrad dang yig nor mngon gsal can re zung dag bcos byas pa phud/ skabs de'i yi ge'i 'bri srol/ deng skabs dang mi 'dra ba dper na/'bri la 'dri dang / tsong kha pa la btsong kha pa/ mtshams la 'tshams/ mthun la 'thun/mtsho la 'tsho/ rmad la smad/ byung la 'byung / rang rkya la rang skya/ grwa la ga klong la slong / rig 'dzin la rigs 'dzin/ rig gnas la rigs gnas/ rigs pa la rig pa/ gcod la spyod/ rdzong brda la rdzong sta/ rdzong bda' sogs kyang ma dpe sor bzhag byas yod/spyir na tshig don gnyis thad nas zhus dag pher nges su rloms kyang / nged rnams rtsom sgrig gi bya bar las dang po ba yin pa dang / shes rig nor gyis dbul bas phyogs gang thad nas mi lding ba'i cha sogs skyon dang nor zhabrul mi nyung ba zhig 'byung nges pas rgya che'i mkhyen ldan rnam pas thad gar ram/yig thog zhal par bcas gang rung gi thog nas nyes 'gog legs spel gyi dgongs 'char lhug stsol gnang rogs zhes dran skul zhu rgyu ma zad/ lhag par nged tsho'i las don thad lhag bsam rnam dag gis rgyab skyor gnang mkhan dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang dang / pho brang po tā la'i rig dngos do dam khang gis gtsos tshan pa khag dang / mi sger bcas nas gang ci'i thad slob ston dang mthun rkyen gyi rgyab skyor tshad med gnang bar snying dbus nas thugs rje che zhes lan brgyar zhu'o/ /ser gtsug nang bstan dpe rnying 'tsho thabasdu phyogs ga khang nas/bod sa glang lo'i sa ga zla ba'i tshes 15la/7

mdzad pa po'i rnam thar mdor bsdus/ji skad du/ 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud las/ dus mthar 'jig rten nyams pa na/ /sdom brtson rgyal po'i tshul gyis ni/ /'byung bar 'gyur ba the tshom med/ /dper na ma khol zhes bya dang / /me tog cesabyar rnam par grags/ /zhes dang / gzhan yang bka' gdams glegs bam/ rat+na'i spyi lung / rdo rje gling pa'i gter lung / bka' thang sde lnga sogs bka' gter mang po nas 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs kyi sprul par lan cig min par gsungs pa'i rgyal dbang lnga pa chen po mtshan yongs rdzogs la thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho 'jigs med go cha thub bstan lang tsho'i sde'am/byis pa'i mtshan bdud 'dul rdo rje dang / snyan ngag gi mtshan tshangs sras bzhad pa'i rdo rje/ gsang mtshan sngags smyon zil gnon bzhad pa rtsal dang / za hor gyi sngags mkhan che mchog 'dus pa rtsal/rnal 'byor pa gang shar rang grol/ de bzhin 'jam dbyangs dga' ba'i bshes gnyen nam za hor gyi ban+de zhes yongs su grags pa ste/ gang gi sprul gzhi 'phags mchog spyan/ras gzigs kyi che ba'i yon tan dang / sprul brgyud na rim gyi rnam par byon tshul sogs ni sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtshos mdzad pa'i du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gsum pa'i 'phros bzhi pa sogs chos 'byung lo rgyus deb ther khag las shes par bya zhing / rigs ni dpal ldan zhi ba 'tsho dang / jo bo rje dpal ldan a ti sha sku 'khrungs pa'i rgyud za hor gyi rigs las chad pa/ dpal phag mo gru pa'i blon po'i gdung rgyud du yab bdud 'dul rab brtan dang / yum kun dga' lha mdzes gnyis kyi sras su bod rab byung bcu pa'i me sprul te spyi lo 1617lor lho kha 'phyongs rgyas 'phying dbar stag rtser sku 'byungs shing / sku na chung ngu'i dus nas dam pa'i rang mdangs lhag par gsal zhing byis pa phal pa'i spyod tshul las 'das pa'i khyad yon mnga'/ dgung lo gsum thog dpon slob paṇa chen rin po che blo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan dang /gling smad zhabs drung khri chen dkon mchog chos 'phel gnyis nas rwa sgreng gi jo bo 'jam dpal rdo rje 8

dang / lha sa'i jo bo shākya mu ne'i sku drung du zan ril brtag pa mdzad pa dang / chos skyong khag gi bka' lung rnams gcig mthun byung ba ltar paṇa chen blo bzang chos rgyan dang / chos rje sbyin pa dar rgyas sogs nas gtsang pa rgyal por snyan zhus bka' 'khrol bzhin rgyal ba sku 'phreng bzhi pa sku1na tan rgya mtsho'i yang srid du ngos 'dzin zhus te mi ring bar dga' ldan pho brang du gdan drangs/ dgung lo dgu par paṇa chen rin po ches mkhan po dang / khri chen dkon mchog chos 'phel gyis las slob mdzad de dge tshul gyi bslab sdom bzhes te ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho 'jigs med go cha thub bstan lang tsho'i sde zhes mtshan gsol ba dang / de nas rim bzhin khri chen dkon mchog chos 'phel/ khyab bdag dbang phyug rab brtan/ zur chen chos dbyings rang grol/ zha lu mkhan chen rdo rje 'chang rin chen bsod nams mchog grub/ 'khon ston dpal 'byor lhun grub/ nyang ston khra tshang pa chen po blo mchog rgya mtsho/ smon 'gro 'jam dbyangs dbang rgyal rdo rje sogs la bsam sbyor gnyis kyis tshul bzhin du bsten nas gzhung chen bka' pod lnga dang / gsang sngags gsar rnying gi chos skor/ sgra snyan sman rtsis dang bcas pa rig gnas skor yongs su rdzogs pa la gsan bsam mthar phyin pa mdzad/ de nas dgung lo nyer gnyis pa sa pho stag gi lor lha ldan jo shāka yid bzhin nor bu'i drung du dpon slob paṇa chen blo bzang chos rgyan gyis mkhan po dang gsang ston/ khri chen dkon mchog chos 'phel gyis las slob/ byes pa rtsed thang pa byams pa smon lam gyis grib tshod pa mdzad de dge 'dun grangs tshang ba'i dbus su bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa bzhes/ dgung lo nyer drug par dga' ldan pho brang gi srid dbang yongs rdzogs bzhes te thog ma'i sde srid du phyag mdzod bsod nams chos 'phel bsko gzhag mdzad/dgung lo nyer dgu par pho brang po tā la'i pho brang rnying pa rgya bskyed thog pho brang dkar po gsar bzhengs mdzad cing / pho brang dkar po grub rjes dga' ldan pho brang gi chos srid kyi byed sgo gal chen khag der spel ba gnang / dgung lo so gsum pa la gso rig 'gro phan gling gsar du btsugs/ dgung lo so drug thog gong ma shun tsis gdan zhus ltar pe cin du phebs/ dgung lo nga bzhi'i thog ra sa dang bsam 9

yas kyi gtsug lag khang bcas la nyams gso gnang ba/ gzhan yang rje 'dis dgon sde gsar 'debs mdzad pa dang / dgon sde khag tu lha khang dang rten mchod gsar bzhengs/ chos gnyis mchod rgyun sbyor 'jags mdzad pa/ ris med gsung rab pod khrir nye bar dkar chag gsar bsgrigs/bsgrub bya khri phrag mang por dge tshul slong gi sdom pa bstsal ba dang / de bzhin dpe rgyun dkon rigs par 'debs byed rgyu khyab brdal gtong ched/ 'bras spungs dga' ldan pho brang gi par khang dang / pho brang po tā la'i ltag sgo'i rgyab kyi par khang bcas gsar du 'dzugs gnang mdzad pa sogs chos srid kyi mdzad pa spyi dang / lhag par rgyal dbang mchog gi don gyi rnam thar gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun/ phyi'i rnam thar du kū la'i gos bzang gis gtsos pa'i rnam thar/ gzhung chen khag gi 'grel pa dbu ma la theg chen rgya mtshor 'jug pa'i gru rdzings dang / mdzod la chos mngon rin chen 'dren pa'i shing rta/ 'dul bar las chog rnam rgyal gser mdog rgyal rabs la deb ther rdzogs ldan gzhen nu'i dga' ston dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i glu dbyangs/ smin byed kyi 'khrid yig rnam gnyis te lam rim 'jam dpal zhal lung dang / rdzogs chen 'khrid yig rig 'dzin zhal lung / de bzhin rtsis skar nag tshe bdag dris lan/dkar chag zhal gdams/ snyan mgur/ snyan dar zhal yig chab re/ga brtan bzhugs/ lam yigabasko 'ja'/ grwa tshang 'don cha/ dam can chos srung gi sgrub skor/ bsnyen yig sogs pod nyer lnga dang /gsang ba'i gras rtsa gsum lha dang mngon sum mjal zhing bgros pa la sogs pa'i rgya can nyer bzhi'i bu yig bka' rtsom gras pod gnyis bcas/ legs par bshad pa pod nyi shu rtsa bdun brtsams par gnang ste bstan 'gro'i phan bde rgya cher spel gnang mdzad nas mthar dgung grangs re drug ste rab byung bcu gcig pa'i chu khyi ste 1682lor dgongs pa gzhan don du gshegs pa bcas dam pa gang gi rnam par thar pa mdor mtshon tsam du bkod pa las zhib phra rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang sogs mdzad rnam gzhan mang du bzhugs pa las mkhyen par zhu'o/ /ser gtsug nang bstan dpe rnying 'tshol ba phyog sgrig khang nas//(/

dkar chagabaka' brgyad bde gshegs 'dus pa'i las byang khrag 'thung rol ba'i gad brgyangs/ (1)gter kha gong ma'i drag po bde 'dus kyi bsnyen yig me rlung zhakhrug pa'i tsha ngar (30)bka' brgyad gsang rdzogs kyi las byang lhan thabs dgongs pa kun 'byung / (37)zhi khro bka' brgyad gsang ba yongs rdzogs sgrub chen gyi reg zig zhagi la bral mthong bas re skong / (57)nyang lugs drag po bde gshegs 'dus pa'i rgyun khyer rigs 'dzin brgyud pa'i zhal lung / (70)gsang rdzogs sgrub chen dang sman sgrub kyi zin bris gaṅgā'i chu rgyun/ (73)bka' brgyad gsang ba yongs rdzogs kyi las byang klag chog dgos pa kun tshang / (78)bka' brgyad gsang ba yongs rdzogs kyi dbang bskur dus sgrub 'bum dang dbang 'bum bsdebs nas chu babs su bkod pa yongs 'du'i 'khri shing / (117)bka' brgyad bde 'dus kyi dbang dang / khro rol gyi zin bris kun bzang dgongs pa'i rol mtsho (245)bka' brgyad yongs rdzogs kyi las gzhung gi byang bu/ 4255)bka' brgyad yongs rdzogs kyi zhi ba'i sbyin sreg rigs 'dzin kun+da'i 'dod 'jo/ (269)bka' brgyad gsang rdzogs kyi bris thang 'dri ba'i gsal byed gsang gsum mi zad rgyan 'khor/ (283)

sangs rgyas thams cad dang mnyam par sbyor ba dpal yang dag zla gam dgu pa'i 'phrin las kyi rim pa rgyud don snang byed/ (291)sangs rgyas thams cad dang mnyam par sbyor ba dpal yang dag zla gam dgu pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga hūṃ mdzad zhal lung / 4341)byang gter thugs sgrub 'bring po'i 'phrin las rin cen 'phreng ba zhes bya ba/ (431)thugs sgrub drag po rtsal gyi las byang dngos grub yongs 'du'i gter mdzod/ (454)thugs sgrub kyi las byang nor bu'i cod pan zhes bya ba/ (467)rigs 'dzin gdung sgrub kyi 'phrin las klag chog mthong ba don ldan du bkod pa/ (480)drang srong dri med zhi khro'i rig gtad kyi chog sgrigs thugs thigs snying bum g.yas 'khyil ces bya ba/ (506)gzhung chen bder gshegs 'dus pa'i snying po'i don kun tshang bar bsdus pa'i thugs sgrub thog mda'i tsha dbal/ (513)'chi bdag bzlog byed kyi gyer gzhung 'chi bdag g.yul las rgyal ba'i ru mtshon zhes bya nga/ (519)zhing skyong seng ge'i gdong pa can gyi las byang gnam lcags spu gri/ (531)lha mchog 'bar ba rtsal gyi 'phrin las brgya phrag nyid ngos 'dzin pa'i snang gsal/ 4536)lha chen rdo rje 'bar ba rtsal gyi srog gtad kyi rjes gnang mu thi la'i 'phreng ba/ (570)rdo rje 'bar ba rtsal gyi bsnyen sgrub bkang mdos kyi lag len dran pa'i gsol 'debs/ (576)rdo rje 'bar ba rtsal gyi rten mdos bkang mdos zlog mdos kyi rim pa rgya 'bag mig gi rnam 'iXspyol/ (583)2

༄༅༅//bka' brgyad bde gshegs 'dus pa'i las byang khrag 'thung rol ba'i gad brgyangs bzhugs/༄7//na ma shan+ta: kroṅgā nī de wa sa mādza su tsa grwa ya/chos sku gdod nas 'du ma byas pa kunas yongasadag rig rtsal gdangs//'gag med rnam dag mkha' dbyings ngos su zhi khro'i dkyil 'khor longasaspyod rdzogs//gang 'dul sprul pa'i sgyu 'phrul gar mkhan bde bshegs kun 'dus bka' brgyad lha//spro dang sdud mdzad rigs brgya'i khyab bdag pad+ma thod phreng gto gyi skyabs//che mchog bdud rtsi'i bka' babs gnyags ban rje//gdul dka'i 'gro la rjes chags gshes gnyen tshul//zur chen chos dbyings rang grol thams cad mkhyen//rtsa ba'i bla ma snying dbus pad mtshor bzhugs//bag yod zhig por mtshar 'dzin phag rgod khyu/ /rigs mthun rmongs pa'i nags su rgyu min par//chos kyi rgyal po mnga' bdag nyang ral gter//thos bsam sgom pa bsod nams zong gi bsgrubs//sgrub chen skabs kyi dus bzhin gyer ba dang /khro bo rol pa sogs la nyer mkho ba//las byang gter byung dgongs don ma 'chugs par//tshig nyung don rgyas blo gsal mgul pa'i rgyan/kho bo'i blo gros phra yang brgyud ldan gyi//gsung 'phros cung zad zin phyir 'dri ba la//'bar ma sde dpon sum cu gter 2na ) srung sogs//dam can rgya mtsho dgyes mgur gnang ba stsol//las byang 'bring po'i don bsdusasbyor dngos rjes//sbyor ba skyabs sems tshogs bsag rdor bzlas dang //mtshams gcod brda sgo brda phyag bshags dam bca'//dbab brlab rim pa'i dang po skyabs 'gro ni//bdag dang nam mkha'i mtha' mnyam sems can rnams//deng nas kun bzang rang ngo ma 'phrod bar//rgyal ba dgongs rgyud rigs 'dzin brda brgyud dang //gang zag snyan brgyud smon lam dbang bskur brgyud//gtad rgya lung

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (25)bstan las 'phro gter gyi brgyud/ khog ser tshig gi brgyud pa la sogs pa'i/ /dngos dang brgyud pa'i bla ma ma lus pa/ /byin rlabs rtsa bar nges pas skyabs su mchi/ /zhi ba bzhi bcu gshin rje dbang chen dang / /yang dag che mchog phur pa mngon rdzogs rgyal/ /dregs 'dul stobs ldan yi dam zhi khro'i tshogs/ /dngos grub rtsa bar nges nas skyabs su mchi/ /gnas gsum dpa' bo mkha' 'gro ma lus dang / /'bar ma chen mo dregs pa'i sde dpon sogs/ /chos stong gter bdag dam can rgya mtsho rnams/ /bar chad sel bar nges nas skyabs su mchi/ /mdor na bskyab (2ba)bya skyab byed ma lus pa/ /rang byung rang shar rig pa'i rang rtsal te/ /gnas lugs rang ngo shes pa'i ngang nyid nas/ /dkon mchog rtsa ba gsum la skyabs su mchi/ /gnyis pa gzhan don byang chub sems bskyed pa/ /ye nas chos sku rang rig kun du bzang / /rang ngo ma 'phrod 'khor 'phyan 'gro ba rnams/ /rkang lkoms rgyal bu rgyal sar 'don pa ltar/ /rang ngo sprod phyir byang chub sems bskyed do/ /gsum pa bsod nams tshogs chen spel ba ni/ /rang nyid dpal chen zhal gcig phyag gnyis par/ /gsal ba'i thugs ga'i hūṃ las 'od 'phros pas/ /bla ma sgrub ldebargyad kyi lha tsho gos rnams/ /'dir gshegs nyi zla pad+ma'i gdan la bzhugs/ /rdo rje slob dpon sangs rgyas dpal/ /dus gsum zhugs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mchog gsum ston pa'i zhing gyur la/ /gnyis med yid kyi skyabs su mchi/ /dngos 'byor yid kyis rnam sprul ba'i/ /dag pa'i mchod pa bzhes su gsol/ /dngos grub chu bo gcod pa'i bgegs/ /nyes byas ma lus bshags par gyi/ /phyogs bcu 'khor gsum dag pa'i chos/ /ma chags spyod la rjes yi rang / /dag pa'i mtha' bzhi dri ma med/ /rdzogs pa'i byang chub sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs dbang phyug sems can la/ /dag pa gsum gyi lus 'bul lo/ /tshe rabs bgrangs pa'i las rnam kun/ /bsdus te byang chub chen por bsngo/ /sems can bde dang ldan gyur cig /sdug bsngal kun dang bral bar shog /bde ba rtag tu mi'abral zhing / /chos kun mnyam nyid rtogs par shog /bzhi pa sgrib sbyong rdor sems sgom bzlas ni/ /rang nyid tha mal gnas pa'i spyi bo sa /pad zla'i gdan la hūṃ dkar las byung ba'i/ /rdo rje sems —2

bka' brgyad bde gshegs 'dus pa'i las byang khrag 'thung rol ba'i gad brgyangs/ nang ma 6)dpa' yum dang mnyam sbyor ba/ /rdo rje dril 'dzin rin wo rus pa'i rgyan/ /(3na skor zab longasaspyod rdzogs sku'i cha lus mdzes/ /thugs gar zla steng hūṃ dkar yig brgyas bskor/ /de las bdud rtsi mu tig phreng lta bu/ /sbyor mtshams nas babs spyi gtsug lam brgyud de/ /rkang mthil 'og nas 'thon na sngon bsags kyi/ /sdig lhung nad gdon nyes tshogis ma lus pa/ /dud sol khu ba rnag khrag srog chags kyi/ /rnam pa kun bkrus dwangs shel lta bur gyur/ /he ru ga'i yi ge brgya pa ci nus bzlas pa'i mthar/ /mgon po bdag gi sdig sgrib ma lus pa/ /dag pa thugs rje bskul ba'i gdung shugs kyis/ / yab yum 'od zhu spyi gtsug nas thim pa'i/ /dbyer med ngo bo gcig tu samādhi/ /lnga pa mtshams gtsod sngon 'gror nga rgyal bzung/ /bka' bsgo dngos bstan gsum gyi dang po ni/ /su bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las pad+ma nyi zla'i steng rang semasa3 yig mthing nag yongs gyur las/ /zhe sdang rdo rje zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ /g.yas dkar g.yon dmar rtsa zhal sku mdog nag /g.yas gsum rdo rje lcagasakyu zhags pa dang / /g.yon gsum thod khrag lcags sgrog dril bu 'dzin/ /dur khrod mas brgyad rus pa sbrul gyi brgyan/ khro gtum 'jigs rung bzod dka'i drag shul can/ /zhabs bzhi g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang tshul gyis sung / /ye shes me dpung 'bar ba'i klong na bzhugs/ /gnyis pa bgegasagator gtong zhing bka' bgo ba/ /snri nyon cig bgegs dang log 'dren tshogs/ /nga yi bka' lasa'ada' ma byed/ /rdo rje gsang ba'i bka' las ni/ /sdig can gang zhig 'da' byed pa/ /stobs chen khro bo chen po yi/ /klad pa tshal pa brgya ru khos/ /de bas rang rang gnas su dengs/ /hūṃ/ bzhi'i (3bsngags dang hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ bi shwa badz+ra kro dha dz+wa la maṇ+ḍal phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa ha la ha la ha la hūṃ zhes zla zhing rol mo dang a brab kyi tsha rngam bya/ gsum par phyi nang gsang las dang po ni/ /rgyasapar sgrub chen gzhung bzhin 'byer bde ba/ /rang gi thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od 'phros pas/ /rgyal chen sde bzhi btsun mo sras blon sogs/ /grangs med 'khor tshogs mtha' dag 'dir byon nas/ /dgyesapa'i gdan la brten par bzhugs su gsol/ /ā+oṃ dhi ṭa ra ma bi ru rte ka /bi ru pa k+ṣa/ /be+e shra wa ṇa sa—3—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho gsung tsom/ ()pa ri wā ra a: nas shasta'i bar gyis mchod gong gi sngags gsham du/i rda bha lin+ta kha kha khā hi khā hi btags pa lan gsum gyis phul/bdag sogs 'phrin las rnam bzhi bsgrub pa la//phyi yi bar chad nang du mi gtong zhing//nang gi dngos grub phyi ru mi mung ba'i//srung ba ma sgos kyi phrin las mdzad du gsol//gnyis par lnga las dang po lta stangs mtshams//hūṃ/bdag nyid las kyi he ru gaḥ//rngam brjid khros ba rab bsgom te//spyan mig g.yas g.yon nyi zlar bskyed//rdo rje'i 'gros kyi rab bskor zhing /khro bo'i sdang mig rab tu blta//'gying bag tshul du rab tu brjid//zhal nas/ phaḍa 'brug sgra sgrog/spyan las 'phros pa'i 'od zer gyis//bar ho bgegs dpung sreg par byed//ā+oṃ gu rla tsan+d+ra dz+wa la dz+wa la hūṃ phaḍa//gnyis pa srung ba 'khor lo'i mtshams gcod ni/hūṃ/bdag nyid dpal gyi thugs ka nas/khro rgyal ṭak+ki rā dza 'phros//dmar skya zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa//g.yas g.yon tho ba lcags kyu thogs//'phros pa phyogs bcur rab 'phros bas//chos stong bcu po bkug nas ni//phyogs bstokun tu gdan du 4na po ting //pho mo gan rgyal kha bub bsnol//hūṃ bzhi'i sngags mthar//ā+oṃ in+d+ra ya/asna ye/ya mā ya/ni ri s+t+ya/0ru ṇa ya/wa ya we//ku be rwa ya/sī sha nā ya/su rla tsan+d+ra pra ti ༷ tir baṃ dzaḥ/ baX ho3/bdag nyid dpal gyi thugs ka nas//phyogs skyong bcu yi gdan steng du//'bar ba'i hūṃ brgya 'phros ba las//sa 'dus khro bo bcu ru gyur//hūṃ kur rnam rgyal dbyug sngon rgyal//gshin rje mi g.yo rta 'grin rgyal//'dod rgyal bdud rtsi khams gsum rgyal//stobs po che rnams rim bzhin bsgom//kun kyang zhal gsum phyag drug pa//sku mdog khro tshul mtsho ni cha 'dzin//dur khrod masakyis rab tu brgyan//snu smad lcags phur zur gsum 'bar//phyogs skyong bcu yi snying gar btab//me dpung 'bar ba'i klong dkyil nas//sprul pa yang sprul grangs las 'das//bar chad bgegasadapung ma lus pa//rdul phran bawo du brlag par bya//ā+oṃ badz+ra kro dha hūṃ ka ra hūṃ bar ho yang po gha ga gha dzo hūṃ phaṭa//ā+oṃ badz+ra kro dha bi dza ye mir go 'byung po ha na ha na hūṃ phaṭa//ā+oṃ badz+ra kro dha ni la daṇ+ḍa3 bar ho khrung po da ha da ha hūṃ phaḍa//ā+oṃ brda kro dha ya mān+ta ka hūṃ//bar ho khrung po pa tsa pa tsa

bka' brgyad bde gshegs 'dus pa'i las byang khrag 'thung rol ba'i gad brgyangs/ nang ma 6)hūṃ phaṭa//oṃ badz+ra kro dha ārla a tsa lam hūṃ//bar chad 'byung po ban+ta ban+ta /phaṭa//ma badz+ra kro dha ha ya sgyi wa hūṃ phaṭa/bar chad 'byung po hu lu hu lu hūṃ phaṭa/oṃ badz+ra kro dha a pa ra tsit+ta hūṃ/bar ho 'byung po tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha hūṃ phaṭa/ā+oṃ badz+ra kro dha a khra ta kuṇ+ḍali hūṃ/bar go khrung po spyo snyo hūṃ phaṭa/ā+oṃ badz+ra krodha tri lo kya bi dza ye hūṃ/bar ho 'byung po ༷ nga hūṃ phaṭa/ā+oṃ badz+ra krodha mahā ba la hūṃ/4ba bar ho 'byung po h+pho ṭa h+pho ṭa hūṃ phaṭa/gsum pa sreg par byed pa me yi mtshams//hūṃ/bdag nyid dpal gyi thugs ka nas//ye shes lnga yi me 'bar bas//stong gsum phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten kun//bskalapa'i me dpung wo po bzhi//'ur 'ur chem d+ku rab tu 'bar//rdo rje'i tsha tsha zhugs su 'phro//srid pa gsum yang sreg byed na//bar gcod bdud rnams smos ci dgos//ā+oṃ badz+ra tha la raṃ raṃ ga me raṃ raṃ dz+wa la raṃ raṃ//bzhi pa mtshon cha 'chol ba'i mtshams gtsod pa//hūṃ/thugs las chu hūṃ phaṭa e dza:/sprosapa'i rdo rje 'bor lo dang //phur bu tho ba ral grir gyur//steng yang byu cha'i bla bre la//mardzo cha'i thog dang ser chen 'bebs//'og kyang mtshon cha'i sa gzhi la//mtshon cha'i 'phro 'du me ltar 'bar//phyogs mtshams mtshon mas gtams pa la/ /mtshon cha'i tsha tsha skar ltar 'phro/ /mtshon cha rnam lngas mtshams bcad pas//bar gcod bdud dpung brlag par bya//oṃ badz+ra tsa kra ki lwa ya mu sgo ra a ko ṭa ya wa hūṃ phaṭa//lnga pa khro bo rol pa'i mtshams gcod ni/hūṃ/mi bzad khro gas rngam pa'i tshogs/khro bo'i sprul pas nam mkha' gang /khro mo'i sprul pas sa gzhi gang //bar snang khro chung sprul pas khyab//pho nya las byed du mar bcas//phyogs bcu kun tu rab tu gtams//ā+oṃ lo ka sarba mahā krodha ya mān+ta ka paṅgān+ta spo ta ga me krodha ma ma ru lu sarba du / hūṃ phaṭa//gong gi gsum pa gsang ba'i mtshams gcod ni/hūṃ/ma bcos thig le klong yangs nas//'khor 'das chos rnams ma lus pa//sems nyid bde chen dag pa'i klong//de ltar gsal bar rab rtog nas//bgegs zhes bya ba'i ming yang med//mtshamasaldan〉kyi dkyil 'khor lhun gyis grub//sam ya a/drug pa ye shes brda yi sgo dbye ba/hūṃ/snang srid 'khor 'das gdod ma nas//rnam dag lhun grub rgyal ba'i zhing//ma rtogs gnyis 'dzin sgrib g.yogs

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()sgo//rang rig brda yis dbye bar bya//dzo pra we sha ya phaṭa/bdun pa ye shes brda phyag 'tshal ba ni/hūṃ/khams gsum ye nas rang byung ba'i//bde gshegs rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor nyid//brda dang gar gyis la nas kyang //gnyis su med par phyag bgyi'o//a la la lho a ti pā lho pra tā〉 sngo brgyad pa sdig lhung nyes tshogis gzhags pa ni/hūṃ/bla ma rig 'dzin rgyal ba zhi khro dang //phyi nang ḍa glo dam can 'am lus pa//rang snang dag pa'i dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams//rig 'dzin sgrub mchog bdag la dgongs su gsol//rnal 'byor bdag cag ma rig dbang gyur nas//theg mchog gsang ba'i lta spyod du ma rnams//gzhung bzhin ma rtogs dang du ma blang pas //nyams chag 'gal 'khrul gyur ba ci mchos pa//sems nyid gnas lugasang nga du gnyis med kyang //kun rdzob sgyu ma tsam gyi rol pa las//rang snang 'gyod pa'i sems kyis mthol lo bshags//mthol bshags bzod pa dam pa zhes nas kyang //sgrib med tshangs pa'i dngos grub stsol ba dang //sku lnga ye shes lnga yi 'bras bu mchog/'bad rtsol med par dus 'dir 'grub par mdzod//dgu pa srog phyir mi gtong dam bca' ni//lho khamasagasum sems can ma lus pa//ye nas sangs rgyas yin mod kyang //log rtogs dbang gi 'khor bar 'khyams//snying rje'i yul du gyur pa rnams//sangs rgyas5bsal 'god bya'i phyir//sgrub pa bka' brgyad lha tsho gos rnams//sngon nas bdag gi yi dam lha//da lta bdag dang gnyis su med/khrog gi phyir yang mi spong zhing //rtse gcig yid kyis bsgrub par bya//a la la sngos ma ya bho dhi tsit+ta aḥbacu pa bdag rten rdzas la byin dbab pa/hūṃ/dus gsum bde gshegs rgyal ba rnams//chos sku skye ba med pa las//gzugs sku 'gro ba'i don mdzad phyir//gnyis med dbyings nas sku bzhengs la//rnal 'byor rig 'dzin sgrub pa po//dngos grub ma lus thob bya'i phyir//lha dang rig 'dzin srung ma'i tshogs//sprul pa 'khor dang bcas pa rnams//mkha' la sprin ltar gtibs nas kyang //dngos grub ma lus char ltar phob//dbang chog ma lus bdag la bskur//sku yi gar stabs glog ltar 'byug/gsung gi nga ro 'brug ltar sgrogs//thugs kyi brtse ༷sa bdag la dgongs//dkyil 'khor 'di la byin

bka' brgyad bde gshegs 'dus pa'i las byang khrag 'thung rol ba'i gad brgyangs/ nang ma 6)phob la/ /sgrub mchog bdag la dbang zhig bskur/ /sgrub rdzas 'di la byin phob la/ /gzhal yas 'di la brtan par bzhugs/ /mthu dang rtsal gyi nus pa thon/ /rtags dang mtshan ma bstan du gsol/ /thugs dam gnyen po'i dus la bab/ /sam ya a we sha ya hūṃ hūṃ/ /bcu gcig sman raka mchod gtor brlab pa la/ /nang gses bdun las dang po phyi mchod ni/ mchod pa'i rdzas kyi ma dag skyon rnamasakun/ /thugs ka'i hūṃ las2byung me yi bsregs/ /yaṃ las rlung gis gtor zhing khaṃ yig gi /chus bkrus mi dmigs stong pa'i ngang nyid las/ /a las bhan+ta 'bar ba'i snod rnams su/ /hūṃ las chu gnyis nyer spyod rol mo bcas/ /dbang po'i yul du zag med bde ster ba/ /nam mkha' (6na) mdzod kyi sgo 'phar phye bar gyur/ /ā+oṃ badz+ra a: nas shabha'i bar brjod/ gnyis pa bdud rtsi sman phud brlab pa ni/ yaṃ raṃ kai las rlud me thod skam gyi/ /skyed bu'i steng du ma las thod pa'i nang / /gser 'khor rtsibs brgyad steng du nyi ma la/ /sto ta ku da ha na las sha lnga dang/ /bi nu ma ra shu las bdud rtsi lnga/ /dbyangs gsal gyisamatshan zla dkyil kha gcod kyi/ /lte bar sna tsho gos rdo rje'i khong seng du/ /'bru gsum gyis mtshan rlung gi me sbar te/ /rdzas 'khol rlangs pa zla phyed rdo rjer 'phog /'od los zhi khro rab mas thugs rgyud bskul/ /slar bkug dam tshig bdud rtsi la 'dus pas/ /ā+oṃ āḥ& swāhā las phyag mtshan lnga/ /de yisayu ba byas pa'i dril bcas gyur/ /hūṃ badz+ra lha ka /lha dhā tī shwa rī/ ā+oṃ dzi na dzi ka / lī de ṣa ra ti/ swā rat+na lha ka /rmā mo ha ra ti/ ā+oṃ a ro li ka /'a ra ga ra ti/ hā pra dzñā lha ka /two badz+ra ra ti/ brjod pas rigs lnga yab yum mnyam sbyor gyur/ ā+oṃ āḥlha sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta hūṃ gyi ṭha/ zhes pa'i sgras bskul yab yum snyom zhugs pa'i/ /bde ba'i 'od kyis sras bcas sangs rgyas mchod/ /'od zhu zhal du zhugs pa'i byang chub sems/ /sku yi dbyibs brgyud mkha' gsang nas babs pa/ /dam tshig rdzas dang dbyer med bdud rtsir 'khyil/ /mtheb srin sbyar bas rdo rje'i lte ba sa /hrī'i las byung rta mgrin yab yum gyi/ /gtsug nas bdud rtsi kun bos sbyor mtshams nas/ /babs pa'i thod pa'i nang kun bdud rtsi yis/ /gang bas mu tig phreng ba lta bur gyur/ /bdud rtsi'i sngags bdun brjod rjes rak+ta ni/ /oṃ pad+ma bha wa maṇ+ḍal —7

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (25): / brjod pas yum gyi mkha' dbyings gru gsum nang / /ma (6ba thas nyi dkyil steng du ra yig las/ /rak+ta'i mtsho 'byug lpa ra ṇa phaṭa kyis/ /chags pa'i 'od 'phros saṃ ha ra ṇa hūṃ/ /gdug can tshur 'dus hūṃ 〉badz+ra phaṭa/ /yab kyi gsang gnas rdo rje'i tho ba yis/ /brdungs bas nye zhe mongs bag chags ma lusapa/ /sbyangs nas zhing gi lhu dum rab 'phyo zhing / /zegs ma'i tsho gos las 'dod yon lha mo ni / /mkha' la sprin phung lta bur gtibs par gyur/ /ā+oṃ aḥ& ma hā rak+ta dz+wa lamaṇ+ḍal hūṃ lha'i/ /lan bdun brjod rjes gtor ma bas pa ni/ /thod par sto spyad ha na las sha /bi nu ma ra shu las bdud rtsi lnga/ /steng du rigs lnga yab yum sa bon mtshan/ /de las 'od los rlung gi me sbar bas/ /bdud rtsi kholabasam dag kun sbyang te/ /zag med ro brgya ldan pa'i phung bor gyur/ /oṃ āḥ/ ma hā bha lin+ta te dz+wa bha lin+ta bha la bha te gu pho sa ma ya hūṃ gyi'o/ sngags ni bdun bzlas dza gad brlab pa ni/ dza gad bum pa gzhal yas 'od kyi nang / /smu las mā ma ki sngon bum 'dzin bas/ /stong gsum 'byung lnga'i bcud rnams ma lus pa/ /bsdus nas dza gad nyid la thim par gyur/ /ā+oṃ mā ma ki ri ki ri tiṣ+ṭha dzñā na me swāhā/'dzab ni bzlas rjes zla gam brlab pa ni/ hūṃ hūṃ gnyis las thabs shes nyi zla zung / /mnyam par sbyar bas bde stong ye shes kyi/ /byang sems bdud rtsi ches cher 'phel ba yi/ /zag med dga' bzhi rgyasapa'i nus ldan gyur/ /ā+oṃ bo dhi tsit+ta mahā su kha sngo 'dzab bzlas ma lcag tu tshe zan brlab pa ni/ : lasatshe bum rin chen gzhal yas khang / /'dab brgyad lte bar phyi las tshe dpag med/ /dmar po mnyam gzhag steng na tshe bum 'dzin/ /ba po shis lha mo brgyad kyis yongs bskor ba/ /badz+ra sa mā dzaḥyis spyan drangs nas/ /dzaḥnā baṃ sngos gnyis su med (7na)par gyur/ /thugs ka'i saḥlas 'od los 'khor 'das kyi/ /tshe bcud kun bsdus bum nang bskyil bar gyur /ā+oṃ ā yu dzñā na tshe sne hūṃ/ /gnyis pa dngosagazhir ting 'dzin rnam pa gsum/ /gzhal yas gdan lha dbang bskur spyan drangs bzhugs/ /phyag mchod bstod pa 'dzab ste bcu gsum gyi/ /dang po de bzhin nyid kyi ting 'dzin ni/ /hūṃ/ rnam dag byang chub sems kyi rang bzhin ni/ /gdod nas ma skyes ye brdal gting mtha' med/ /mi gnas mi dmigs—8—

bka' brgyad bde gshegs 'dug pa'i las byang khrag 'thung rol ba'i gad brgyangs/ nang ma 6)spros pa med pa'i ngang / /brjod med bsam 'das mnyam nyid dbyings su rdzogs/ /ā+oṃ ma hā shā n+ya tā dzñā na badz+ra swa bha wa byu ko3nya/ gnyis pa kun tu snang ba'i ting 'dzin ni/ /thams bcad snying po byang chub sems nyid las/ /gzung 'dzin mtshan ma rdul tsam mi dmigs kyang / /rtsod med dbyings las 'gag pa med pa'i phyir/ /sgyu ma'i phyag rgya bye brag cir yang gsal/ /āḥdharmā bhā tu su bhā wa āt+pa ko3nya/gsum pa dbyer med rgyu yi kho 'dzin ni/ /chos nyid thams bcad dbyings su sangs rgyas shing / /skye med bde chen ngang du ro gcig kyang / /skye ba'i cho 'phrul 'bar ba'i byin rlabs kyis/ /rang rig ye shes chos sku mngon du shar/ /hūṃ badz+ra tsit+ta hūṃ/ hūṃ las re yaṃ khaṃ 'phros snod bas sbyangs/ /dngas ma'i hūṃ yig rdo rje rtse lngar gyur/ /de las rgyu yi khrag 'thung ye shes sems/ /mthing gsal rang snang yum bcas mkha' la gsal/ /bzhi pa rten gyi ga 'kha yas khang bskyed pa/ /nam mkhar gnas pa'i khrag 'thung thugs ka nas/ /e yaṃ raṃ / kai raṃ chad pa las/ /e ā kā sha maṇ+ḍal/ /waṃ wā yu maṇ+ḍal/ raṃ rak+ta maṇ+ḍal/ / ti ra maṇ+ḍal/ ko ni ri ti maṇ+ḍal/ raṃ dz+wa la(7ba〉ṇ+ḍal/ lpa ra ṇa phaṭa/ /ha ra ṇa hūṃ/e las nam mkha' mthing nag 'byam klas dbyings/ /tha las rlud dkyil ljang nag rgya gram g.yo/ /de steng raṃ las khrag mtsho dmar zlum 'khrug /lha las zhing chen sa gzhi gru bzhir brdal/ /ke las rusapa'i ri rab bang rim bzhi/ /raṃ las bskal pa'i me chen 'bar ba'i klong / / baṃ las 'dab stong pad+ma'i ge sar la/ /hūṃ las sna tsho gos rdo rje sra zhing brtan/ /de steng mkha' la sne yig lnga ldan babs/ /sne bi shwa bi shu d+dha rat+na bha lha dzñā na tsakra maṇ+ḍal rje/ /sde yig yongs gyur rin chen gzhal med khang / khru bzhi sgo bzhi shel gser rā ga dang / /margad be+eḍūrla yi rang bzhin can/ /rdo rje nor bu'i rtsig steng rin po che'i/ /pha gu ser po de steng mu tig gi /dra ba dra phyed shar bu mda' yab mdzes/ khang brtsegs phyur bur rdo rje nor bu'i tog /sna tsho gis rin chen 'od 'phro ming gi gzhir/ /'dod snam dmar por gzung ma bcu drug 'khod/ /sgo bzhir ka ba bzhis bteg to ra ṇa/ /bang rim brgyad ldan chos 'khor ri dwagasagadugs/ /ngo mtshar kun tu bzang po'i rgyan bkod pa'i/ /gzhal med khang nang rdo rje'i gdung bzhi —9

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (25)yis/ /mig mang ris bres so so'i nang khongs su/ /dur khrod rol pa'i gzhal med khang pa dgu/ /rim gsum thod pa'i rtsig par khra zhag 'bab/ sha chen 'dod snam pha gur thod pas dkrigs/ /rkang lag shar bu sgal tshigs mda' yab can/ khyu rlon rus pa'i dra phyed thod tshal 'phyang / / mi ro'i rgyal mtshan 'phan gdugs tsistu'i tog /lha klu'i ka gdung gza' skar dral phyam byas/ /zhing lpags thog phub nya sbrul za ra tshags/ /rab 'jigs pho brang kun nang mthing nag e/ /rtsibs bzhi mu (8na)phyud gru chad khyams dang bcas/ /kun gyi phyi rol dur khrod chen po brgyad/ /mchod rten shing me sprin chu grub pa brgyad/ /lha klu phyogs skyong ma mo zhing skyong dang / sha za ro langs gsar rnying bam ro'i tshal/ /de mthar gzhom med rdo rje'i srung ba'i gur/ /mi phyed rab 'bar phreng ba 'khrigs pas bskor/ /lnga pa pho brang sosor gdan bskyed pa/ ru dra kro dhī ti ra baṃ/ baṃ pad+ma maṇ+ḍal/ ma su rla maṇ+ḍal/ a tsan+d+ra maṇ+ḍal/ pho brang lte bar be+eḍūr rang bzhin brag /'gro drug sna tsho gos pad+ma'i ge sar la/ /rab 'bar nyi ma dkar gsal zla ba'i dkyil/ /dbang po tshangs pa dbang phyug khyab 'jug dang / /nye dbang gzhon nu :nga gi tshogasabadag dang / /mtha' yas 'jog po dung skyong stobs kyi rgyu/ /pad+ma pad chen nor rgyas rig ldan klu/ /bsnol mar brdzis steng seng ge stag zig dom/ /glang chen ma he chu srin sprul gyi khrir/ /gser 'khor bcu gnyis rtsibs ldan lte ba sa /ma hā de wa u ma de lir bcas/ /phyogs mtshams brgyad por pad+ma nyi zla'i steng / khar du drag po lho phyogs ma he nub/ /chu bdag byang du lha chen mer ma mo/ /bden bral dar zab rlung du dregs pa dang / /dbang ldan dgra bgegs kun kyang chung mar bcas/ /pho rnams kha sbub mo rnams gan rgyal bsnon/ /drug pa brten pa lha tsho gis bskyed pa ni/ /nam mkhar gnas pa'i rgyu yi he ru da:/ /yab yum dkyil 'khor dbus kyi gdan la 'khod/ /snyom par zhugs pa'i dga' bsa'aphags pa mchod/ /sems can don byas tshur 'dus sku la 'dus/ /bde chen byang sems ngo bor gyur pa las/ /dbyings phyug ma yis stong pa'i sgras bskul te/ /stong pa (4shin tu yod med rnal 'byor mthus/ /nam mkha' bzhin las dam tshig nye bar gnas/ /bde gshegs bde bar gshegs mdzad — 10—

bka' brgyad bde gshegs 'dus pa'i las byang khrag 'thung rol ba'i gad brgyangs/ nang ma 6)dgongs su gsol/ /he ru gaḥdapal khyod bdag skal ba bzang / /bskul ba'i rkyen gyis thig le mthing nag hūṃ/ /yongs gyur rdo rje rtse lnga hūṃ gis mas/ /snya ra ṇa phaṭa brjod pa'i 'od zer 'phros/ srus yosargyal mchod sems can don kun byas/ //ha ra ṇa hūṃ gis tshur la bsdus/ /de nyid yongs gyur bdag nyid khro rgyal kun/ /yongs 'dus dpal chen che mchog he ru gaḥ/ /mthing nag dbu dgu phyag ni bco brgyad gdengs/ /rtsa gzhal g.yas dkar g.yon dmar dbus thing nag /bar ma g.yas dkar g.yon ljang dbus zhal sngo/ /steng zhal dbus gnag g.yas dkar g.yon pa dmar/ /zhal dgur dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum ldan/ /zhal gdangs mche gtsigs glog ltar 'byugs pa/ ljags/ /rdo rje'i gad rgyangs khro gnyer bsdus pa yi/ shangs bug rnams nas dus mtha'i rlung chen 'tshub/ /rdzi ma smin ma sma rar me chen 'bar/ /dbu skra kham nag nam mkha'i sprin ltar gtibs/ /sku che yan lag ragasashing 'gyur bag ldan/ /bco brgyad phyag gi dang pos rdo rje dang / /dung khra bzung nas shes rab yum la 'byud/ /lhag ma g.yas rnams rim bzhin kha ṭ+wāṃ ka /cang te 'khor lo rin chen pad+ma dang / /ral gri dgra sta zhags pa g.yon rnams kyis/ /zhing dbyug thong gzhol nyi zla ri rab dang / khrag mtsho me rlung rlung nag 'tshub ma bsnams/ /zhabs brgyad g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang dor stabs kyis/ /lha chen pho mo'i mgo dang nu ma brdzis/ /thod skam dbu rgyan skam rlon rnying pa yi/ /thod pa rgyu mar rgyus (9na)pa'i do shal 'phyang / /zhing glang stod g.yogs stag sham rus pa'i rgyan/ khrag gi thig le zhag gi sor risadang / /thal chen tshom bu sprul lnga'i gdu bu can/ /rdo rje'i khyung shog la sogs dpal gyi chas/ /bcu ldan sgeg cing dpa' ba mi sdug pa/ /rgod cing drag shul 'jigs rung snying rje dang / /rngam zhi gar dgu rol pas bzhugs pa'i pang / /gnam zhal dbyings phyug sngon mo zhal gcig ma/ /phyag gnyis kha/ thod khrag 'dzin pas 'byud/ khro mo'i chas kun ma lus yongs rdzogs shing / /g.yas brkyang g.yon bskum yab kyi sku la 'khril/ /stong nyid snying rje dbyer med zung 'jug pa/ /yab yum gnyis ka nyi ma 'bum phrag gi /gzi 'bar bskal pa'i me dpung dbus na bzhugs/ /yab kyi gsang gnas/ las rtse lnga pa'i/ /rdo — 1/ —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()rje'i dbyibs can zla bar ā+oṃ gyis mtshan//yum gyi mkha' gsang paṃ las 'dab brgyad kyi//pad+ma'i ze'u 'brur nyi mar ༷ gyi mtshan//yab kyis sam sngo yi brdas bskul ba//yum gyis sam ya ra lan btab par//yab kyis rā ga ya lha'i brda sbyar ba//yum gyis rā ga ya mi'i brda yis bskul//a la lasngodzaḥ/ baṃ hoḥbo dhi tsit+ta lpa ra ṇa phaṭa/oṃ āḥ//brjod pas lcags kyu'i phyag rgyas dpung nas bzung //zhags pa'i phyag rgyas phan tshun stod smad 'byud//lcags sgrog phyag rgyas dbang po'i sgo gnyis spras//dril bu'i phyag rgyas rdo rje pad+ma ra zhugs//byang sems lan gcig babs pa'i yum gyi mkhar//gzhal yas khang gyur gnyis pas gdan gting zhing //gsum pas sa bon hūṃ yig sprod par gyur//rdo rje pad+ma bde ba rgyas mdzad nas//yab yum gnyis med sbyor 9ba thas dgyes par tshim//bdud rtsi byang chub sems kyi sprin spros pas//stong gsum khro bo'i tsho gos kyi dkyil 'khor spro//hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ zhes snyom par zhugs pa yi//byang sems/ gi rang bzhin khro bo'i tshogs//steng 'og phyogs mtshams spros pasadregs pa can//sdodang bcas pa tshar bcad dbang du bsdus//thams cad dpal dgu'i dkyil 'khor lha tsho gos su//bkod nas tshun 'dus snyom 'jug bdeb che//zhu ba 'bar ba'i hūṃ yig brgyad du gyur//hūṃ/'jig rten stong khams gang ba'i khrag 'thung rnams//rang la bsdu ba'i sbyor bas kun bsdus te//dbyings su thim nas yig 'bru phyag mtshan dgu/khro bor gyur te phyogs 'tshams kun tu 'khod//hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ/dbus phyogs mar mthing nag tshe dbyings su//tshe mchog yab yum mkha' las phyir sprod nas//rtsibs bzhin rigs bzhin khyams la khro bo bcu//sgo bzhir mthar byed mu ran ce spyang brgyad//ā+oṃ badz+ra gro sgo mahā shrī he ru daḥ/ phaṭa/hūṃ/shar phyogs dkyil 'khor dbus su ru dra'i steng //yang dag mthing nag g.yas dkar g.yon dmar zhal//phyag drug rdo rje kha ṭ+wāṃ rnge'u chung g.yas//dril bu bhan dmar rgyu zhags g.yon na bsnams//kro ti shwa rī kha ṭ+wāṃ thod 'dzin 'byud//rtsibs bzhir rigs bzhi khyams la go ri sogs//ma mo bcu drug sgo bzhin gdong can bzhi//mu ran dbang phyug nyi shu rtsa brgyad 'khod//ā+oṃ ru lu ru lu hūṃ bh+yo hūṃ/hūṃ/lho phyogs dkyil 'khor dbus su chu glang steng //

bka' brgyad bde gshegs 'dus pa'i las byang khrag 'thung rol ba'i gad brgyangs/ nang ma 9)gshin rje ser nag g.yas dkar g.yon dmar zhal/ /phyag drug be con ral gri dgra sta g.yas/ /bhan dmar sdigs 'dzub mdung thung g.yon na bsnams/ /be+e ta dgra sta bhan dmar (10na stob pas stid/ /ral gcig rtsegasum thod 'dzin g.yas su 'khod/ /rtsibs bzhin gshed bzhi khyams la 'a mi bdag ni/ /bcu gnyis sgo bzhir gdong can mu ran la/ /ging bdud rtsis pa bshan pa la sogs 'bod/ /ā+oṃ a kro te ka ya man+ta ka ha na ma bha ྅ hūṃ phaṭa/ hūṃ/ nub phyogs dkyil 'khor dbus su klu chen steng / /rta mgrin dmar nag g.yas dkar g.yon sngo zhal/ /phyag drug rdo rje kha ṭ+wāṃ sprul zhags g.yas/ khril bu dung dmar lcags sgrog g.yon na bsnams/ /pad+ma zil gnon kha ṭ+wāṃ thod 'dzin 'byud/ /g.yas g.yon phra men byi la pu shud gdong / /rtsibs bzhir rigs bzhin khyams la zil gnon brgyad/ /sgo bzhi las bzhi mu ran kham rgya drug /dmus long khyi sbyang pho nya 'brug bzhin bcas/ /ā+o hrīḥpaṅgān+ta kri ta badz+ra krodha ha ya lha wa nyu lu hu lu hūṃ phaṭa/ hūṃ/ byang phyogs dkyil 'khor dbus su lha chen steng / /phur pa ljang nag g.yasadakar g.yon dmar zhal/ /phyag drug g.yas gnyis rtsedagu rtse lnga dang / /g.yon gnyis me dpung kha ṭ+wāṃ mtha' gnyis kyis/ /phur bu bsgril 'debs rdo rje'i gzhog pa gdengs/ /'khor lo rgyas 'debs kha ṭ+wāṃ thod 'dzin 'byud/ /rtsibs bsnyo sras bzhi khyams la khro bo bcu/ /yab yum za gsod sgo bzhin sgo srung bzhi/ khu ran phur srung dam can bcu drug 'khod/ /ā+oṃ badz+ra kyi li gī la ya sarba bi snyan baṃ hūṃ phaṭa/hūṃ/ shar lho'i dkyil 'khor dbus su ma mo'i steng / /bla med khrag 'thung mthing nag dkar dmar zhal/ /phyag drug rdo rje khyung chen sprul zhags g.yas/ /bhan dmar zhing dbyugs thod pa'i ga'u g.yon/ /mu kha mthing nag zhal lnga dkar ser (10ba'i mar/ /ljang gu mthing ga phyag drug rdo rje dang / /gri zhags bum pa g.yas 'dzin dril bu dang / /bhan dmar g.yang gzhis yab 'byud zhabs brgyad bgrad/ /rtsibasabazhir ma lnga 'khyams la rje mo ni/ /bcu gnyis sman mo nga brgyad sgo bzhi sa /srid bzhi mu ran ro kha ma sogs 'khod/ /ā+oṃ gu tho dzñā na shrī he ru ga:gu tho dzñā na kro dhī shwa rī ri ma ma yo gi ni ru lu ru lu hūṃ bh+yo hūṃ 2/ hūṃ/ lho nub dkyil 'khor dbus na seng ge'i khrir/ /gsang ba'i bdag po rig 'dzin rdo rje chos/ /—13

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()dkar gsal phyag gnyis rdo rje dril bu 'dzin//dbu skra thor tshugs gi wo cod pan ༅//〉ldir smad g.yogs rus pa'i rgyan drug gal//rnal 'byor ma mo rang 'dra'i mas ldan 'byud//rtsibs bzhin rigasabazhi khyams la rigs 'dzin brgyad//sgo bzhir slob dbon mu ran mkha' 'gros bskor//ā+oṃ badz+ra mahā gu ru sarba sirnyi hūṃ phaṭa/hūṃ/nub byang dkyil 'khor dbus su dregs pa'i steng //dregs 'dul mthing nag g.yas ser g.yon smug zhal//phyag drug rdo rje lha brgyad mgo bo g.yas//bhan dmar klu brgyad mgo bo g.yon na bsnams/khams gsum spyi 'dul kha ṭ+wāṃ thod 'dzin 'byud//rtsibs bzhi khyams sgor sdod pon sum cu dang //mu ran snang srid dregs pa'i tshogs kun 'bor //ā+oṃ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa sa rba du ṭ+wāṃ hūṃ phaṭa/hūṃ/ byang shar dkyil 'khor dbus su dgra bgegs steng / /stobs ldan nag po zhal gsum mig sman mdog phyag drug rdo rje lha brgyad tsit+ta g.yas//bhan dmar klu brgyad tsit+ta g.yon na bsnams//'byung lnga'i bdag mo mthing nag phag gnyis kyis//gzugs khams mkhar 'degs 'dod khamasasagazhir gnon//rtsibs bzhi khyams sgor sdod pon 11na yotsha brgyad dang /khu ran lha srin sdebargyad tshogs rnams 'khor//ā+oṃ badz+ra sarba du ṭ+wāṃ hūṃ phaṭa/rigs 'dzin ma gtogs dpal chen khrag 'thung kun//dbu gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi mi bzad gzugs//gar dgu'i rnam rol zhal gdangs mche ba gtsigs//dmar zlum spyan ldog smin ma ag tshom 'bar//zhing chen glang lpags stod g.yogasastag sham 'phyang //tshar gsum thod phreng sprul brgyad phyag rgya drug/rak+ta zhag dang thal chen mtshan mas spras//dpal chen mas rdzogs yum rnams khro chags tshul//rngam brjid rgyan ldan rang rang yab dang sbyor//gtso 'khor thugs kar rang 'dra'i ye shes sems//de nang nyi steng rdo rje lte bar hūṃ//so so'i sngags 'phreng 'bar bas g.yas su 'khor//dkyil 'khor phyi khyams shar sogs phyogs bzhi rtswa/zhi rgyas dbang drag ma mo drug drug dang //sgo bzhi sgo skyong kun kyang phyogs kyi mdog/'jigs gzugasadur khrod chas ldan rang rtags 'dzin//phyi yi mu khyu/ mkha' 'gro sum cu gnyis//ging chen bco brgyad

bka' brgyad bde gshegs 'dus pa'i las byang khrag 'thung rol ba'i gad brgyangs/ nang ma (ka)liṅga drug cu dang / /'bar ma ma brgyad sa bdag sum cu gnyis/ /ma bdun sring bzhi pho nya drug cu bzhi/mkha' 'gro dregs byed phyogs skyong rgyal chen sogs/ /dpal gyis pho nya bsam gyi mi khyab pa/ /nyi dkyil las ni 'od zer ji bzhin du/ /rab 'byams nam mkha'i khams kun gang bar gyur/ /oṃ badz+ra ya k+ṣa sa ma ya hūṃ phaṭa/ /bdun pa byin rlabs dbang bskur rim pa ni/hūṃ/ bdag nyid dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ khro bo'i rgyal po ye nas yin pa'i phyir/ /sku dang gsung dang thugs su byin brlab cing / /ye shes rnam pa lnga yi dbang bskur ro/ /(11ba〉〉 sarba ta thā ga ta mahā kā ya badz+ra su bhā wa āt+pa ko3sni/ /de bzhin du wā ka dang tsit+ta yang sbyar/ /spyi bor zla ba mgrin par pad+ma dang / /snying gar nyi steng ā+oṃ dkar āḥdamar hūṃ/ /mthing ga las los 'od kyisabade gshegs kyi/ khri spyad bskul rdo rje gsum gyi lha tshogs rnams/ /nam mkha'i khams kun gang ba spyan drangs nas/ /yi ge gsum la thim pa yongs gyur pas/ /rnam snang snang mtha' mi bskyod longs spyod rdzogs/ /rang rtags phyag mtshan 'dzin pa'i sku ru gyur/ /oṃ mahā shā n+ya tā dzñā na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+pa ko3nya/ /de bzhin du shā n+ya tā'i tshab tu ā+oṃ dar sha dang mahā dang phra tu bek+ṣa ṇa dang kṛ kyi a nu ṣ+ṭha rnams 'byin 'jug byed/ /rigs lnga rjes chags kyis zhu ye shes lnga'i/ /chu yi dbang bskur nyon mongs lnga dag nas/ /phung po sangs rgyas lnga ru gnas gyur te/ /dbang rtags rgyal ba rigs lngas dbang bskur gyur/ /brgyad pa ye shes lha tshogs spyan drang ba/hūṃ/ thugs ga'i hūṃ las 'od zer lcags kyu ltar/ /los pas ye dag rig rtsal 'og min nas/ /sgrub sde brgyas kyi dkyil 'khor lha tshogs kun/ /thog med badz+ra sa mā ya dza:dza:hūṃ/ 'og min chos dbyings dbus mtha' med pa nas/ /bde gshegs zhi ba'i lha tsho gos dbyingasanas bzhengs/ /chos kyi dbyings nas 'gro don sku sprul pa/ /yab yum 'khor bcas gnas 'dir shegs su gsol/ /'og min cho medabyings dbus phyogs pho brang nas/ /che mchog yon tan lha tshogs ྾/ /chos dbyings ྾/ /yab yum ྾/ /'og min chos dbyings phyogs mtshams ra/ /sgrub pa bka' — 15

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ smyonabargyad lha tsho gis sko//chos kyi ྾//yab yum za//rab mas phyogs bcu'i zhing khams rgya mtsho nas//bka' sdod pho nya'i lha tsho gos snga//12na〉la kyi ྾//yab yums//ā+oṃ shrī badz+ra kro dha he ru gaḥs pa ri wā ra e a ra li hri hri dzaḥ/ baṃ hoḥdagu pa lha tsho gos bzhugs su gsol ba ni/hūṃ/pho brang dgu'i klong 'bar ba'i e dbyings su//lha brgyad klu brgyad byol song gtso bo brgyad//ru po gshin rje chu bdag lha wo po//ma mo dar zab dregs pa dgra gegs gdan//ma chags pad+ma thabs shes nyi zla la//dpal chen gtso dgu'i lha tshogasabazhugs su gsol//sam ya āḥzhe sha ya ti sta lhan//bstob dkyil 'khor lha la phyag tshal ba/hūṃ/chos skur skye med nga/byings las ma g.yos kyang //thugs rjes gzugs skur rgyu ma'i sku bzhengs pa//zhi khro rab 'byams dkyil 'khor 'khor le'i gtso//dpal chen bka' brgyad lha la phyag 'tshal lo a ti pu 〉prati ts+tsha ho bcu tsog mchod pa'i sman phung dngos grub blang //phyi ma rdzo phyag rgya dam rdzas 'dod yon lha//bdud rtsi rak+ta sbyor sgrol gnyis med las//dang po myong grol bdud rtsi'i sman ma rdzo ni//hūṃ/rang byung gdod nas rnam par dag pa ste//rtsa brgyad yan lag stong las sbyar ba'i sman//rigs lnga dam tshig rnam pa lnga yi dngos//ye shes lnga rdzogs grub pa'i rdzas chen po//nyon mongs gdung ba sel ba'i bdud rtsi 'di//rtsa ba gsum gyi lha tshogs rnams la 'bul//thugs rje brtser dgongs dbang dang dngos grub stsol//sarba pañtsa a skṛ ta kha raṃ ji hi//kun tu bzang po che mchog he ru daḥ//rdo rje cho sodang las kyi dbang mo che//rigs 'dzin rnams brgyad pad+ma thod phreng la//sman mar 'bul lo mthu dbang dngos grub stsol//sarba pañtsa a :snga/rje 'bangs dgu dang gter ston mnga' 12ba ) bdag nyang /thugs sras 'gro ba'i mgon po sku mched gnyis//rdzogs chen mched gnyis de wa pa tri la//sman mchod 'bul ྾/sarba ྾/chos kyi rin chen sum ldan yab sras dang //'jam dbyangs rin wo zur skru chos kyi rje//pha la shri shākya bshes gawo la//sman mchod 'bul lo ྾//sarba ྾/rgyal sras chos rje rgyud 'dzin legs pa ༷pal//'jam dbyangs rgyal mawo paṇa chen pad+ma

bka' brgyad bde gshegs 'dus pa'i la byang khrag 'grung rol ba'i gad brgyangs/ nang ma 6)dbang //legs ldan rdo rje gnam lcags tsher la//sman mchod 'bul los//sarba pañtsa mo//bkushis rgya mtsho du ma rang grol rje//de dbon ngag gi dbang bo yel shes grub//zur wo kun mkhyen chosadabyings rang grol la//sman mchod 'bul lo ྾//sarba ྾/gnam lcags me 'bar man kho bosathob pa ltar bris pa yin gyis/de man 'bri gung dang rdo rje brag sogs sel med kyi brgyud pa mi dbar khyis ma chod pa zhig btsal nas dbri bsnan bya'o//che mi choge yang dag gshin rje pad+ma dbang //phur pa rbod gtong rigs 'dzin dregs 'dul dang //drag sngags dpal chen bka' brgyad gtso 'khor la//sman mchod ྾//sarba ྾//nag po chen po yab yum bga' sdod brgyad//gnas gsum mkha' 'gro dam can gter bdag dang //gnas bdag gter bdag dkar phyogs skyong rnams la//sman mchod 'bul lo ྾//sarba ྾//gnyis pa bdud rtsi'i dngos grub blang ba ni/hūṃ/don dam thig le bde ba chen po las//mtshudas pa med pa bhan+ta'i snod nang du//ye shesalnga rdzogs bdud rtsi rin wo gter//dngos po med las dngos grub blang bar bya//kā ya sirnyi ā+oṃ/wā ka sirnyi āḥtsit+ta sirnyi hūṃ//gsum pa phyi yi mchod pa'i rim pa ni// hūṃ/13na skongs bsil rnyog med yid 'ong mar yon sbreng //dag byed zhabs bsil dri ldan gaṅgā'i rgyun//thang skyes chu skyes rnam bkra'i me tog tshal//lhan cig skyes dang yongs sbyar bdug pa'i sprin//mar me nyi mor byed pa'i gzugs gsar pa//dri chab dam pa mchog bskyed rol mtshor spel//zhal zas lha yi bdud rtsi ro brgya'i bcud//rol rma snyan 'a rjebs yan lag rgya mtsho'i sgra//ngo mtshar mchod pa'i sprin phung bsam yas pas//ram 'byams nam mkha'i khyon rnams bkang ste 'bul//ā+oṃ shrī badz+ra he ru ka sa pa ri wā ra a: nas shastaḥdzaḥsngo//dzaskru'i gser 'khor yid bzhi nor bu mchog/yid 'ong btsun mo blo ldan khyim bdag ste//stobs ldan glang po cang shes rta yi mchog/phasargol mthar byed dmag dpon rin chen bdun//mdzes sdug gzugs dang snyan brjid rol mo'i sgra//dri zhim ngad ldang bcud ldan bdud rtsi'i zas//'a/ma gar+sā rig bya bkra shis gas rdzas sogs//

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (25)srid zhi'i 'byor tshogs nam mkha' mdzod du 'bul/ /ā+oṃ shrī badz+ra he ru gaḥs pa ri wā ra sa sta mahā rat+na pañtsa kā ma gu ṇa pā dzaḥho:/ bzhi pa phyag rgya gar gyi mchod pa ni/ /hūṃ/ khrag 'thung rgyal po gar la dgyes/ /sku mdog zhal ni rnam par 'gyur/ /sku yi gar stabs glog 'khyug pa'i/ /phyag rgya gar gyi mchod pa 'bul/ /ma hā mu dra pā dza:ho/ lnga pa dam rdzas rgyu yi mchod pa ni/ hūṃ/ gdug pa can rnams tshar bcad pa'i/ /dbang po'i me tog phreng bar spel/ /tshil chen gsur gyi dud pa'i sprin/ /mi bzad mun pa lta bur 'tshub/ /zhun mar mchog gi sgron me ni/ /dusamatha'i zhugs kyi phung por 'bar/ khrag mkhris (13ba)dri dang yongs sbyar ba'i/ /lha 'phreng rab 'khrug byug pa'i mtsho/ sha khrag rus pa don snying tshogs/ /lhun por spungs pa'i zhal zas mchoge /thod lnga rkang gi gling bu dang / /rab 'jigs sgra dbyangs rgya mtshor bcas/ /dur khrod mchog gis mchode sprin 'di/ /gshin rje'i 'dun sa bzhin du 'bul/ /oṃ shrī badz+ra he ru ga:sa pa ri lha ra mahā shā shā na pu ni sgru 2di2lha ba li bye shasta pā dzaḥhoḥ/ /drug pa 'dod yon lha mo'i mchod pa ni/ hūṃ/ rdo rje sgeg mo gzugs mdzes ma/ /'phreng ba ma ni rgyan 'phreng 'dzin/ /glu ma glu len pi waṃ brdung / /gar ma mdzes pa'i gar bsgyur ma/ /bdug pa ma ni spos sprin spro/ /me tog ma ni me rtag 'thor/ /mar me ma ni snang gsal 'dzin/ /dri ma dri mchog byug pa 'bul/ /brgyad ka gzugs mdzes lta na sdug /yid 'ong gar bsgyur glu len ma/ /'chi med bu mo lta bu yis/ /phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten bkang ste 'bul/ /oṃ badz+ra lu phye hūṃ/ de bzhin/ mā le tre/ gī ti sgyi/nirti āḥ/ pu 〉 hūṃ/ ci/ a lo ke khyu/ gharnye āḥ/ bdun pa dza gad dpa' bo'i mchod pa ni/ hūṃ/ rgyu gnyis rkyen sbyar bdud rtsi 'di/ /dug lnga sman bsgyur ye shes rdzas/ /dza gad dpa' bo'i phud kyi mchog /dpal chen dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul/ /mahā pañtsa a mri ta khā hi/ brgyad pa bha ling gtor ma'i mchod pa ni/ dam rdzas ra byung ga kho wo po/ /chos nyid skye med klong nas sprul/ /'dod yon rnams lngasarab tu spras/ /dpal chen dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul/ /mahā bha lidha khā hi/ dgu pa dmar chen ra skyi — 18—

bka' brgyad bde gshegs 'dug pa'i las byang khrag 'thung rol ba'i gad brgyangs/ nang ma zhanam rdzo pa ni/sto mongs rtsa ba 'khor ba'i khrag/khams gsum 'khor ba stongs bya'i phyir//dung wo snod du 14na po mar chen bskyil//dpal chen dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul/mahā rak+ta khā hi/bstob bde ོ sbyor ba'i ma rdzo pa ni//sgyul ba'i ma rdzo wo mkho sbyor bas//thabs dang shes rab gnyis su med//gnyis med sbyor ba bde ba'i mchog/dpal wo dkyil lor lha la 'bul//bho dhi tsit+ta mahā su kha a nu ra ga ya mi//bcu gcig log 'dren bsgral mchod ni//yang dag rtog ba'i mtshon bya yis//ma rtogs sems can dbyings su bsgral//sgrol ba las kyi mchod pa che//dpal chen dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul//sarba sha gu mā ra ya rbad/bcu gnyis spros bral mchod ba ni//gdod nas rang rig lha ru dag/mchod bya mchod byed mchod yul kun//mi dmigs spros pa phyag rgya che//dpal r+ṣa dkyil 'khor lha la tsol//sto dh+wa tu ma hā mu dra byu dzaḥhoḥ//bcu gnyis dkyil 'khor lha tsho gos la bstod pa/hūṃ/bde gshegs sku lnga yon to rdzogasapa'i lha//'gro drug dug lnga'i bag chags rgyud sbyong zhing //mas dang dpe byad 'bar ba'i skur snang ba//bde gshegs zhi ba'i lha la phyag 'tshal bstod//bde gshegs yon tan ma lus rdzogs pa'i lha//'gro drug kun gzhi'i bag chags mo//chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes mo//che mchog yon tan lha la mo//bde gshegs thugs kyi yon tan rdzogs pa'i lha//'gro drug sems kyi bag chags mo//me long lta bur//yang dag thugs kyi lha yis//bde gshegs sku yis//'gro drug lus kyas//mnyam pa nyid kyis//'jam dpal sku yis//bde gshegs gsung gi mo//'gro drug ngag gis//so sor rtog pa'i za//pad+ma 14ba ) gsung gir//bde gshegs 'phrin las za//'gro drug sgo lnga'i mo//bya ba grub pa'i za//phur pa wen las za//bde gshegs rbod gtong yon to rdzogs pa'i lha//'gro drug sgrol mdzad yum gyi bha ga'i klong //ma dang sring mo'i tshul du skur ston pa//ma mo rbod gtong ྾//bde gshegs phyag rgya'i ra//'gro drug sems can kun gyi don la dgongs//phyag rgya chen po'i ༄ wa du྾//rigs 'dzin slob dpon za//bde gshegasaXka' yi bstan pa gsung ba'i phyir//nga wo chos

rgyal dbang lnga pa pag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (25)kyi dbyings las ma g.yos kyang / /gzugs sku dregs pa'i tshul dum/ /'jig rten mchod bstod kho/ /bde gshegs bstan pa'i dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i phyir/ /chos kyi dbyings las sgyu ma'i skur bzhengasanas/ /sngags bdag dregs pa'i tshul du skur ston pa/ /dmod pa drag sngags mo/ /bde gshegs spyan sngar khas blangs dam bcas bzhin/ /zhi rgyas dbang drag 'phrin las rnam pa bzhis/ /tshar gcod rjesa'adzin mthu stobs rtsal mnga' ba'i/ /dpal gyi bka' sdod 'khor dang bcas la bstod/ /bcu gsum bsnyen sgrub 'dzab 'das rim pa ni/ /bdag nyid dpal chen tsi ta rin po che/ /mchong smug gur khang phub pa lta bu'i nang / /pad+ma nyi zla'i steng na rang 'dra ba'i/ /ye shes sems pa mtshon gang thugs ka sa /nyi zlar rdo rje sngon po nas 'bras tsam/ /lte bar nyi ma yungs tso tsam gyi steng / /hūṃ yig sbu shad mtha' skor sngags kyi bskor/ /klog tshul gyis bzlas g.yas su 'khor ba las/ /'od lnga'i zer 'phros ba spu'i bu'i ga'i mthar/ /hūṃ yig gis khyab de las khro bo'i tshogs/ /mtshon gang tsam gyis bar mtshamasamed par gtibs/ /slar yang 'od lnga 'phros pas snod bcud (15na thun/ /rten dang brten par bsgyur zhing rang sngags sgras/ /phyi nang lha tsho gis kyis khyab zhal nas kyang / /'brug sgra ltar sgrog 'od kyis bde gshegs rnams/ khyud bskul dbang dang dngos grub byin rlabs bsdus/ /sems can la phogs sdig sgrib rab sbyangs nas/ /zhi dang khro bo'i go 'phang dag la bkod/ /slar yang 'od zer dkar ljang dmar po dang / /mthing nag tsha zhing rtsub par dpag med phros/ /bdag dang rgyu sbyor dmigs yul bcas pa yi/ /nad gdon sgrib sbyangs tshe dang bsod nams rgyas/ /dgra bgegs tshar bcad 'phrin las rnam bzhi kun/ /bsgrub pa'i dmigs pa dang bcas 'dzab bzla ba/ ā+oṃ bo dhi tsit+ta mahā su kha dzñā na rdzo tu āḥ/ā+oṃ badz+ra kro dha mahā shri he ru gaḥ/ phaṭa/ ā+oṃ ru lu ru lu hūṃ bh+yo hūṃ phaṭa/ /ā+oṃ a kro te ka ya mān+ta ka ha na ma tha bha ñdza hūṃ phaṭa/ ā+oṃ 〉pa dhan+ta spo ta badz+ra kro dha ha ya ghi wa hūṃ phaṭa/ ā+oṃ badz+raki li ki la yā sarba bhi snan baṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ ā+oṃ gu ya dzñā na shri he ru da: gu ya dzñā na kro dhi shwa ri sku ma ma yo gi ni ru lu ru lu hūṃ bh+yo hūṃ phaṭa/ ā+oṃ badz+ra mahā gu ru sarba sirnyi hūṃ phaṭa/ ā+oṃ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa sarba du ṣi hūṃ phaṭa/ hūṃ badz+ra sarba du ṣ+ṭṛ hūṃ phaṭa/ ā+oṃ badz+ra sarba —20

bka' brgyad bde gshegs 'dus pa'i las byang khrag 'thung rol ba'i gad brgyangs/ nang ma 9)yak+ṣa sam ya hūṃ phaṭa/ā+oṃ badz+ra ma hā kro dha pad+ma kro dhi shwa ri badz+ra gī li ki wā ya mahā yak+ṣa kā la rū pa ga rma raṃ raṃ dz+wa la raṃ hūṃ phaṭa/stong tshig gi mchod pa ni/hūṃ/ye shes lha tsho gis spyan 'dren gshegs//phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa 'bul//sku gsung thugs yon 'phrin las bstod//bag med 'gal 'khrul nyams chags bshags//mahā a khra ta ba smra ta rak+ta khā hi//thig le'i rnal 'byor snying ga'i 'khor lo las//sngags 'phreng phyir 'phros yab kyi zhal nas 'thon//yum gyi zhal zhugs dbyibs brgyud pad+ma nas//nor bu'i lam brgyud 15ba ) ma gal me ltar 'khor ba'i//ngang las bzlas pas bde stong dbyer med kyi//rtogs pa'i bogs 'byin bla na med pa'o//rtsa ba'i gsum pa mjug la brlab drang mchod/ /bshags bsgral lhag ma bskul chad bstan ma bro//dngos grub mchod bstod bshags gshegs rgyun spyod srung //smon lam shis brjod stso bdun dang po ni/hūṃ/rdo rje lta bu'i ye shes kyis//chos kun sgyu mar rig pa las//rig pa'i ye shes re yaṃ khaṃ//raṃ las me 'bar dngos 'dzin bsregs//yaṃ las rlud g.yos bag chags gang /khaṃ las chu byung gnyis 'dzin bkrus//raṃ yaṃ khaṃ skyo ra ṇa phaṭa//slar yang sa ā+oṃ āḥ/ myi//'phros pas ra ldan ka pā lar//zlo gyis 'dod yon rdzogasu sbyar//ā+oṃ gyis dposa'adzin dri ma sbyangs//ā be+e sa nam mkha' gang bar spel//hūṃ gyis gang mos de ltar bsgyur//gyi yisazag med bdud rtsir zhu//phun tshogs 'dod yon longs spyod tshogs//bde gshegs rigs lnga'i dam tshig rdzas//rgya wo gto zab lhun sdug pa//ngo mtshar mchod sprin wo por gyur//ā+oṃ āḥ& ha ho sgyiganyis pa tsho gis kyi zhing du spyan drang ba/hūṃ/chos dbyings 'gyur med 'og min kho khams nas//bde gshegs zhi khro bka' brgyad lha tsho gos rnams//ye shes tshogos la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol//'dod pa'i yon to lnga yi tshogs mchode 'bul//tsho gos kyi mchod pa dam pa bzhes nas kyang //tshe dang dbang gi dngos grub stsal du gsol//badz+ra sa ma ya dzaḥdzaḥ& baṃ ho/gsum pa longs spyod tshogasamachod ni/bla med mchog gi ma rdzo pa dam pa 'di//ye shes lnga yi 'od zer rnam par 'phro//'dod pa'i yon tan lnga yis rab brgyan te//thugs dam bzhin 16na7sa ci bder bzhes su gsol/oṃ gha na

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (25)tsakra pañtsa kā ma gu ṇa pra twe ts+tsha swāhā/ bzhi pa nyes pa'i tsho gis rnams rab bshags pa/ /bdag cag ma rig lus dang ngag sems kyis/ /bag med spyod pas dam las 'das gyur te/ /dkyil 'khor lha tshogasathugs dang ci 'gal ba/ /'dod yon tshogs kyi mchod pas bskang zhing bshags/ /yig brgya bzla/ lnga pa nya bo bsgral zhing stob pa ni/ e las gnam lcags 'bar ba'i khang sgrom nang / /: dang tri lasaganod byed dgra bgegs rnams/ /yan lag lcags sgrog gis bcings nyam thag pa/ /mngon gsum lta bur gsal ba nyid du gyur/ /na mas brgyud bla ma sgrub sde brgyad kyi lha/ khyad par sde dpon sum stolas byed tshogs/ /ting 'dzin sngags dang phyag brgya'i nus mthu yis/ /dgra bgegs thams cad khug cig gzugs la phob/ /ā+oṃ badz+ra kro dha mahā shrī he ru rkaḥ/ phaṭa/ dgra bgegs shrī tre badz+ra gu ru sha dza:/zhes lcags kyu'i phyag rgyas dgug /badz+ra pā sha lho rme rtags pa'i phyag rgyas gzhug /badz+ra spo tra baṃ/ lcagasasgrog gi phyag rgyas bcings/ badz+ra a we shā ya a aḥ dril bu'i phyag rgyas dbab/ de bzhin yang dag gi sngags dang / dgra bgegs skṛ tri sarba a pa na ya hūṃ phaṭa/ dbab pa'i phyag rgyas mthudang rdo 'phrul phyogs/ /'jam dpal rtsa sngags dang 'byed pa'i phyag rgyas/ dgra bgegs: tri ha san hri dha ya hūṃ phaṭa/ ces pas lha dang dbye/ rta mgrin gyi rtsa sngags dang dbab pa'i phyag rgyas/ dgra bgegs: tri sarba a we shā ya a we shā ya hūṃ phaṭa/ phur pa'i rtsa sngags dang / bcing pa'i phyag rgyas/ dgra bgegs: tri tri tri ha na hūṃ phaṭa/ ma mo'i rtsa sngags dang (16ba)brgyal zhing zhabrug pa'i phyag rgyas/ dgra bgegs: tri dz+wa la pa ya dz+wa la pa ya hūṃ phaṭa/ ces dran med smyos su bcug pa/ drag pa'i rtsa sngags dang brdung ba'i phyag rgyas/ dgra bgegs: tri ta tha ya ta tha ya hūṃ phaṭa/ phur bus rdul du brlag pa'o/ /de nas dreg sngags phur pas nya bo bsgral te/ dmod pa drag sngags kyi rtsa sngags dang phyag rgyas ston pa'i tshul gyis/dgra bgegs bri na ya bī na ya hūṃ phaṭa/ phung po sha khrag tu dgas la stob pa ni/ dgra bgegs gdug pa bsgral ba'i sha khrag rus/ /dug gsum dbyings su sbyang ba mchod pa'i sprin/ /zag med bdud rtsir sbar nas 'bul lags na/ /rngam pa'i stabs kyis dgyes par bzhes su gsol/ /rma sa rak+ta ki ni ri ti a —22

bka' brgyad bde gshegs sa pa'i las byang khrag 'thung rol ba'i gad brgyangs/ nang ma 6)mṛ ta pā byu hi/ drug ba tsho gis kyi lhag ma btang ba ni/ hūṃ/ dang po phud kyis mi mchod du/ /dpal chen lha tsho gis phud kyi bdag /bar du sprin ltar migati ba tu/ /dge ba'i bshes gnyen gnyan gyi bka'/ /tha ma gcig tu mi bsre sa /ma tshogs dbang phyug lhag ma'i gnas/ /lhag ma kha chus mig gdab tu/khyed dang deng gnyis dam tshig gcig /ye nas 'du 'bral med don du/ /'dus la las rnams kun byos shig /hūṃ/ bde gshegs zhi khro dpal chen dgu'i/ /bka' nyan rol pa'i pho nya lhag sdud rnams/ /sngags tshig bshug pa'i sgra yis mtsho ni nas kyang / /ma lus 'khor dang bcas te gshegs su gsol/ /snyo wo g.yar mo'i brda yis ma zhi nas kyang / /ma lus 'khor dang cas zo/ /glu gar phyag rgya rol mos mtsho ni nas kyang / /ma lus za/ /dmar chen khrag dang bdud rtsis mtshone nas kyang / /ma lus ma/ /mkha' 'gro ging lang dbang phyug ma/ /ma bdun sring bzhi 'bar ma brgyad/ /pho nya la (17na〉sogs lhag sdud tshogs/ /dpal gyi pham phabs 'di gsol la/ /sngon tshe dpal gyi bka' lung bzhin/ /bcol ba'i 'phrin las sgrub par mdzod/ /ā+oṃ usnroṣ+ṭha ba smra ta bhak+ṣa gi swāhā/ bdun pa ni khro'i lha tsho gos bskul ba ni/ hūṃ/ mi mngon dbyings na bzhugs pa rgyal ba zhi khro'i tshogs/ /bzhedas shig bzhengs shig chosakyi dbyings nas bzhengs/ /bskul lo bskul lo sems can don la bskul/ /mdzod cig mdzod cig drag po'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /chos sku zhi ba'i ngang las ma g.yos kyang / /gzugs sku 'jigs pa'i cha lugs rdzogs mdzad pa/ /phyogs bcu dus gsum bde gshegs zhi khro dang / /sgrub pa bka' brgyad lha tsho gos thugs dam can/ /mi mngon dbyings nas 'dir gshegs thugs dam bskul/ khrag po'i 'phrin las mdzad pa'i dus la bab/ /thugs dam thugs rjes dgra bgegs myur du sgrol/ /brgyad pa sngon gyi chad mtho sgrag pa ni/ bh+yo/ sngon tshe 'das dus bskal pa'i dang po la/ / 'og min gsang ba mchog gi dkyil 'khor du/ /kun tu bzang po che mchog he ru gas/ /bde gshegs sgrub pa bka' brgyad bshad pa'i tshe/ /rigs lnga yab yum sems dpa' lcam dral gyis/ /so so'i sku gsung thugs su bstan nasakyang / /ji ltar khas blangs dam bcas ji bzhin du/ /mchod gtor bzhes la 'phrin las sgrub par —23

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()mdzod//de 'og bar gyi bskal pa'i dbus ma la//mi mngon rig pa 'dzin pa'i gnas mchogo tu//rigs 'dzin gtso bo rdo rje chos ga gyi/khyud kyi tshig don bsdub mdzad pa'i tshe//gsang sngags bka' yi srung ma'i tshogs rnams kyis//so so'i sku gsung thugs su mo//ji ltar khas blangs za/17bsgo cho de gtor bzhes྾//de 'og bar gyi bskal pa'i tha ma la//lha gnas gsum du drags pa'i gnas ma ga tu//rig pa 'dzin pa rigs 'dzin mchog rnams kyis//gsang sngags rgyud sde yi ger bkod pa'i tshe//gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i bka' srung gis//so so'i sku gsung thugs su za/ji ltar ra/mchod gtor〉/de rjes rtsod pa'i dus la sleb pa'i tshe//dur khrod ro gling bsil ba'i tshal wo du//mkha' 'gro r+ṣa mo las kyi dbang mo che//gsang sngags rgyud sde gter du sbas pa'i tshe//bka' yi srung ma lha srin sdebargyad kyis//so so'i gnas nas rdzu la mo//ji ltar ma/mar gtor྾/de rjes snyigasama'i dus la babs pa'i tshe//mchod rten r+pā po bde byed legs tshal du/grub pa brnyes pa'i slob dpon brgyad rnams kyis//dgung 'dun dgongs pa mdzad nas gzigs pa'i tshe//dregs pa can gyisagato sgrom ba 'a nas kyang //so so'i sku gsung ྾//ji ltar〉/mgo gtor྾/de rjes gdul bya dus la bab pa'i tshe//bod yul kha ba ༅ gyi yul ljongs su//slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas byon pa'i tshe//bod kyi lha srin gdug pa tso rnams kyis//rang rang mthu rtsal che bar bska nas kyang //so so'i྾//ji ltar〉//ma rdzogator྾//de ltar bsgrub pa'i rnal 'byor bdag cag gis//mkha' 'gro dam can 'i 'du ba gnas mchog 'dir/ /tshe 'dir sangs rgyas sku gsung bsgrubs pa'i tshe/ /bka' srung dam tso rgya mtsho sa rnams kyis//so so'i྾//ji ltar ri/ /mar ga sto bzhes྾/ /dgu pa bska ma ba lcoganyis skyong ba ni/hūṃ/sa dang bka' yi lis bcas smi/khrag las de ba nam mkha'i sku//gshegs tshur gshegs skyong ma rnams/ /1ni 'dir spyon dam skong tshon las mdzod//bstan ma brgya gnyis 'khor dang tsos/a cag sngon gyi yal gam tso//slob dpon pad+ma thod phreng dang //slob ma glang wo dpal seng gis//mon kha sna ring /nga gsum du//snyo r+pā bsgral ba'i gdan steng

bka' brgyad bde gshegs 'dus pa'i las byang khrag 'khrung rol ba'i gad brgyangs/ nang ma 9)du/ /rnal 'byor gral la bzhag nas ni/ /thar pa thob pa'i mtshan yang btags/ /sgrub pa po la phan gdags phyir/ /bran gyi tshul du khas blangs na/ /dam las ma 'da' da tshur spyon/ /bka' yi gtor ma 'di long la/ /bcol ba'i 'phrin las sgrub par mdzod/ /bcu pa dam sri mnan cing rta bro brdung / /hūṃ/ya ma 'i bya ba dam sri khyod/ /mnan no ri rab 'og tu mnan/ /bskyur ro rgya mtsho'i gting du skyur/ /bsreg go me dpung klong du sregs/ /bskyon no 'khor lo'i rtsibs la bskyon/ /gtad do 'chi bdag lag tu gto/ /byang chub sems ni ma skyes bar/ /nam yang btang bar mi bya'o/ /ā+oṃ lo hūṃ le sa bha ya nan/ hūṃ/dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i ma rig sems/ /phung khams skye mched bcas pa la/ /bde gshegs 'dusapa'i bro brdungs pas/ khro bo khro mo sprin ltar gtibs/ khro chung tsho gis ni skar ltar 'khrug /bro ni bar chad med pa'i bro/ /glu ni 'du 'bral med pa'i glu/ /tshig ni snying bo 'dzab tu bzla/ /dgra rnams thal bar brlag pa'i bro/ /bgegs rnams phye mar 'thag pa'i bro/ khyud drug gnas nas 'dren ba'i bro/ /rigs drug g.yang sa gcod pa'i bro/ /'jigs pa'i bdud bzhi 'joms pa'i bro/ /gsang ba'i dgra gsum gsod pa'i bro/ /bro ni skye ba med par brdung / /glu ni 'gag pa med par len/ /tshig ni snying bo 'dzab tu bzla/ /dgra bgegs dug lnga dbyings(14)su dag /rdzogs pa chen po'i klong du thim/ /stsogacig mchog thun dngos grub len pa ni/ /hūṃ/ dur khrod gsang ba mchog gi dkyil 'khor nas/ /dpal chen che mchog sgrub pa bka' brgyad lha/ /pho nya bka' sdod 'khor dang bcas pa rnams/ /thugs dam dbang gis bdag la dgongasasu gsol/ /bdag cag gsang ba'i sgor zhugs dam tshig can/ /bsnyen sgrub mthar phyin sgrub pa'i zhag grangs rdzogs/ /dang ba'i shugs kyis thugs dam rgyud bskul na/ /dpal chen he ru /yi go 'phang mchog /dka' ba med par tshe 'dir grub pa dang / /'phrin las rnam bzhis ris med 'gro ba rnams/ /phan bde'i lam la 'god pa'i dngos grub stsol/ /sarba sirnyi pha la ho/ bgraganyis gtang rag mchod bstod rim pa ni/ hūṃ/ mchod yon me rtag bdug spos snang gsal dri/ /zhal zas sgra snyan la sogs—25

rgyal dbang lnga gang ga dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()mchod pa'i sprin//dngos su 'byor dang yid kyis rnam sprul nas//phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod sprin rgya mtshos mchod//ā+oṃ shrī badz+ra he ru gaḥs pa ri wā ra / nas sha sna pā dzaḥhoḥhūṃ/bde gshegs thams cad mnyam nyid thugs kyi ngang //chos sku skye med ngang las ma g.yosakyang //thabs la mkhas pas so sor skur ston pa//sgrub pa bka' brgyad lha la phyag 'tshal bstod//bcu gsum ma rig nyes tshogos bshags pa ni/hūṃ/dus gsum bde gshegs yon tan sku gsung thugs//'phrin las mngon rdzogs lhun grub mngon spyod sprul//cho 'phrul bde gshegs 'dus pa'i lha tsho gos shar//ma rig dbang gis phyogs ris sgo sor bzung //sku gsung thugs dang rtsab yan lag gi/dam tshig nyams chags 'gal 'khrul 19na〉spyar pa dang //ting 'dzin ma gsal sngagasadang phyag rgya nor//lta spyod dgongs pa klong du ma gyur pas//rgyal ba'i dgongs spyod zab mo gto ma phyin//thabs dang shes rab ya bral blang dor yod//las bu'i 'dod wo bsgrubs pa'i rgyur gyur pa//bde gshegs rgyal ba'i bka' la bzod par gsol//dbyer med mnyam pa'i ngang la mthol lo bshags/ /gnyis med don gyi 'bras bu stsal du gsol/ /yi ge brgya pa bzla/ bcu bzhi lha tshogasagashegs shing bsdu ba ni/ hūṃ/ 'khor gyi 'jig rten lha tsho gis rang gnas su/ /badz+ra muḥs gshegasastobs ldan nag po nas//rim gyis gcig la gcig thim gtso bo la//gtso bo ye shes sems dpa' de hūṃ la//de yang zhabs kyu nas bzung nā da'i bar//me long has bto rim yal spros bral gyur//bco lnga rgyun spyod srung ba bya ba ni/phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa ces brjod pa'i ngang nyid las//bdag nyid chu lasanya 'phar tshul du ni//che mchog khrag 'thung rdo rje dung khrag 'dzin//dpal dang dur khrod mas brgyad sku la rdzogs//gnas gsum ā+oṃ dkar ā dmar hūṃ mthing mas//rdo rje'i bzhu blugs lus kun khyab par gyur//cis kyang mi tshugs mi shigs pa'i//stong pa'i sho cha bla na med//mtshan ma'i yul kun bcomasanas ni//thams cad du ni rgyas par gnas//chubadz+ra kā wā tsi rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūṃ/bcu drug smon lam rnam dag gdab pa ni/sa mchog 'od gsal rdo rje rtse sdo sa/bdag cag dam wo rnal 'byor bzhugasaso
