bka' brgyad bde gshegs 'dus pa'i las byang khrag 'thung rol ba'i gad brgyangs/ nang ma 6)'tshal//bar ho med par bstan pa mthar phyin nas//kun bzang che mchog he ru gaḥthob shog/brgyabadun ba po shis char du dbab pa ni/ho/sku lnga lhun grub de 9ba ) bzhin gshegs pa'i sku//ye shes lnga rdzogs mas dpe'i 'od kyis spras//'gro ba'i dug lnga dbyings su zhi mdzad pa'i//bde gshegs zhi ba'i lha tsho gos bkra shis shog/dus gsum rgyal ba'i yon to bzhin gyur te//bde wo lhun grub chos dbyings ye shes sku//'gro ba'i gti mug mun pa sel mdzad pa'i//che mchog yon to lha tshogs྾//dus gsum bde gshegs thugs mchoge spros dang bral//dri bral gsal dag me long ye shes sku//'gro ba'i zhe snang me tsho gis zhi mdzad pa//yang dag thugs kyi lha tsho gis ri//dus gsum bde gshegasasku yi bdag wo mchog/rang bzhi mi 'gyur mnyam wo me shes sku//'gro ba'i nga rgyal ri bo 'jomasamadzad pa//'jam dpal sku yi lha tsho gos bkra shis shog/dus gsum bde gshegs gsung gi dbang phyug gtso//so so'i kun tu rtog pa'i ye shes sku//'gro ba'i 'dod chags rgya mtsho skems mdzad pa//pad+ma gsung gi lha tshogs ra//dus gsum bde gshegs 'gro 'dul 'phrin las gtso//lhun grub bya ba grub pa'i ye shes sku//'gro ba'i phrag dog rlung las zhi mdzad pa//phur pa 'phrin las lha tshogs mo//dus gsum bde gshegs dbyings kyi ma mo'i gtso//mdzo rdzogs mi 'gyur ye shes rdo rje'i sku//snang srid 'khor 'das yang ba ma mo'i yum//ma mo rbod gtong lha tshogs〉//dus gsum bde gshegasarig pa 'dzin pa'i gtso//lhun grub phyag rgya wo po'i ye shes sku//'gro rnams bde wo sal 'god mdzad pa'i//rigs 'dzin slob dpon lha'i//dus gsum bde gshegs dregs pa kun 'dul gtso/khro gtum rab 'jigs dpa' bo mchog gi sku//'phrin las drag pos sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung //20na po jig rten mchod bstod lha tsho gos mo//dus gsum bde gshegs drag sngags kun 'dul gtso//stobs ldan nag po 'jigs byed 'bar ba'i sku//zhing bstosgrol mdzad sngags kyi dngos grub stsol//dmod pa drag sngags lha tshogs mo/ /dus gsum bde gshegs rnams kyi spyan snga sa /sangs rgyasabastan pa bsrung bar zhal bzhes pa'i//dam r+pā sgrub pa'i grogs byed dam nyams sgrol//pho nya bka'

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()sdod srung ma'i ba po shis shog/bka' brgyud bla ma'i byin rlabs dang //bde gshegs 'dus pa'i thugasarje dang //da rka zhe mchog gsum gyi bden pa dang //skal ldan rnal 'byor smon lam gyis//sgrub par bar ho med pa dang //dkyil 'khor bzang por byin gas te//slob dpon sku tshe ring ba dang //mched lcam nad med mo//nad gdon zhi ba'i ba po shis shog/tshe dpal rgyas pa 'kho//mos pa dbang sdud྾//dgra bgegs tshar gcod ma//'dod dgu 'byung zhing bsam pa 'grub//'jig rten bde zhing lo legs dang //sangs rgyas bstan pa dar zhing rgyas//thams cad mkhyen thob ba po shis shog/khro mkhar rdzong 'phrang gis mtsho ni bka' ma yis//gnubs gnags nyang sogs rim byon brgyud tshul dang //gong 'og rdor gling lha brag la so gos pa//gter byon bka' brgyad chos tshulu pha mtha' yas/bde gshegs sa pa 'o ma'i rgya mtsho cher/khrol gzhan gnad kyi mar bcud tshang ba'i phyir//rab 'byams zhi khro'i dkyil 'khor ma lus pa'i//yang rtse mnga' bdag chos kyi rgyal po'i gter//bskyed rdzogs las byang sgrub khog rgyas bsdus 'bring //mang las dbang dang las sbyor rgyun khyer ding //bstar bar 20bta cang rgyas dang nyung ba'i mthar//ma lhungs dbu mar gnas pa'i klu dbang bzhi//lugs mang thos yi blo gros na phra yang //rdo rje lang dngos yongs 'dzin 'ga' bstan mthus//snga 'gyur rgyud dang rgya gzhung man ngag la//blta ba'i mig bu cung zad yangs bas bkod//dge 'dis rang rig che mchog he ru gaḥsnying dbus 'og min zhing du sangs rgyas nas//sna tsho gis thabs kyis 'gro kun thar pa dang //thams cad mkhyen pa'i sal 'god nus shog/de yang mnga' ris paṇa wo chos kyi rgyal po'i gsung las//rnying ma tshad ldan zhig byed na bka' mas khog phug gter ma'i man ngag gis brgyan pa zhig dgos zhes gsung ba dang /rdo rje 'chang pha bong kha pas kyang bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan gyi mdzad pa'i phur pa 'di la/sbyang gzhi sbyong byed sogs lam gyi 'gros rnams snga 'gyur gyi gsung rab gong ma rnams kyi dgongs pa'i gnad tshang zhing /gsar ma'i rgyas bkab ma yin pa'i rnying nyams chen po zhig yang gsung pa yang yang thos shing 8/bka' ma'i rgyud dang sgrub thabs rnams la bltas

bka' brgyad bde gshegs 'dus pa'i las byang khrag 'thung rol ba'i gad brgyangs/ nang ma 9)kyang de kho na ltar snang la/ gter kha gong 'og gnyis kyang bka' ma dang mthun chas che ba mang / grub thob me long rdo rje'i chog sgrigs der mkhas pa mang pos legs so mdzad mod/ skyon chen pos dus gsum bsgribs med du gzigs pas gdul bya'i blo mchog dman bar gsum dang bstun pa'i gter kha so sor dus skabs dang bstun pa'i rgyas bsdus sna tsho gos yong bar gor ma chag rung / deng sang rnying rlom rgyal khams ma mthong a ma'i gsang gnas la mtshar 'dzin du mas gter gzhung tshig nyung tsho dang mthun na rnying ma yin la/ de min gsar ma nas lhad bcug go snyam pa'i log rtog (21na skong bgros gleng ba mang mod/ lha sras rnam sprul chos kyi rgyal po 'bri gung pa rin chen phun tshogs kyis paṇa chen rin po cher bde 'dus rtsa ba'i dbang tsam dang / mi 'gyur kun dga' dpal bzang la khro rol sogasalas tshogs skor mang tsam las tshang bar gsan ma thub pas gter chen chos kyi rgyal po legs ldan rdo rje'i drung du rdzogs par gsan cing / dpon slob gnyis bka' bgros pa'i thog nas bskyed rdzogs 'bring po'i thog nas bskyed rdzogs 'bring po'i chog sgrigs mdzad pa 'di khungs btsun kyang / sgrub chen gyi dus bzhir las byang gyer ba dang khro rol sogs kyi skabs cung zad 'byongs dka' ba'i skyon snang bas dgongs don gyi snying po gzhir bzung / chos rgyal gter bdag gling pas mdzad pa'i las byang bde ba chen po'i rnam rol/ gter gzhung gi dgongs don gyi gnad rnams bsdus pa las thugs bzo sogs gtan med pas zur brgyan/ las byang gyer pa la tshigs bcad stabs bde gshis tshigs lhug rnams tshigs bcad du bsdabs pa tsam ma gtogs yig rnying rnams byin rlabs kyi tshan kha che bas rang sor bzhag /bar gyi mtshams sbyor dang lag len byed tshul sogs gas nas khog phug pa'i dbang du btang ste ma bris pa'i las byang khrag 'thung rol pa'i gad brgyangs 'di ni 'phyong rgyas dpal ri sgrub sde'i slob dpon legs ldan 'od zer sogs spyi tshogs kyis 'bad pa chen pos bskul ba dang / rong chos sdings pa rigs 'dzin phun tsho gis gling sogs bde 'dus byed pa mang por phan pa'i lhag bsam gyis kun nas blangs te zur thams cad mkhyen pa chos dbyings rang grol gyi drung du gter kha gong 'og —29

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()byang gter gyi bka' brgyad gsum tshang ba dang /khyab bdag khra 21ba ) tshang pa chen por gsang rdzogasabaskyar ba ldabs shin tu rgyas pa/chos rgyal gter bdag gling par rgyal sras rdo rje gling pa'i gsang rdzogs sogs kyi bka' drin nos shing yul lho rgyud du skyes pa'i za hor gyi sngags la zang che mchog 'dus pa rtsal lam skyon yab yum gyi btags pa rdo rje thogs med rtsal du 'bod pas rab byung bcu gcig pa'i drag po zhes pa lcags pho spre'u'i lo tha skar zla ba'i tshes bcu'i dus dge bar pho brang chen po rgyal khab dmar po rir sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dpal grong sngags rams pa ngag dbang dge legs kyisabagyis pa su sti bha wa skyo//sarba maṅga lo//gter kha gong ma'i drag po bde 'dus kyi bsnyen yig me rlung 'khrug pa'i tsha ngar bzhugs so// na ma pad+mā kā rā ya/snang srid dregs pa kun gyi srog snying la//dbang sgyur he ru ka dpal pad+ma 'gyung //sangs rgyas kun dngos khyod nyid rang rig tu//rang ngo 'phrod min de srid thugs rjes skyongs//thugs sgrub drag po'i gter kha 'o ma'i mtsho//yang zab mar gyi nying khu srin sbar ma//mkha' 'gro'i kha rlangs ma nyam zil dngar bas//'thung ba'i sngags gyis tshogs rnams skal bzang dpyid//de phyir phyogs 'dir thugs sgrub lugs gsum gyi//rab rgyas gzhung chen bde gshegs 'dus ba yi//gter gzhung gsal byed lhan thabs bsnyen yig dag/'dri la ma mgon sdebargyad gnang ba stsol//de la 'dir e nyi ya na'i slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas zhes dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi mkhyen brtse nus pa'i bdag nyid can srid pa gsum na che ba'i brtul zhugs grub pa'i dbang po des lha srin sde brgyad kyi gnyen por dbang drag pad+ma he ru ga'i rnam par bstan pa'i zab mo thugs kyi sgrub pa ma 'ongs snyigs ma'i dus su sde brgyad rlung ltar ༷tshub cing khyad par klu dang sa bdag rgyal bsen

gter kha gong ma'i drag po bde 'dus kyi bsnyen yig me rlung 'khrug pa'i tsha ngar/ nang ma (ka)rnams me ltar 'bar ba'i dus su sems can rnams sdug bsngal de dag las skyob pa'i don du gter kha mang por phyag (2na)rgyas btab pa las/ zab pa'i mthar thug brag srin mo sbar rjes nas mnga' bdag sku'i sprul pa nyang ral pa can gyis spyan drangs pa'i bla ma drag po'i chos skor 'di nyid gangs can gyi ljongs 'dir ming tsam rlung ltar grags kyang / sngags gsar ma ba phal cher gyis gsar ma'i rjes gnang rgyas 'gebs kyi blos byas kho na dang / sa 'byug gi phyogs nas 'di la cung zad 'dris rlome 'gas kyang 'bring po me'i spu gri'i dbang la nyang lugs kyi drag po'i dbang zhes pa tsam las rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum gyi dbye ba ma phyed cing / lugs 'di da'i rang skad med pa'i rnying ma spyi 'gro'i las byang gi rgyas 'gebs la gsar ma'i lhad chen po bcug pa'i gsar rtsom rnams la yid brtan mi 'dug cing / sngags rnying ma'i phyogs su yang zab gnad 'di skor la dbyar chu'i drod tsam las med pa mang bas/ mnga' ris paṇa chen pad+ma dbang rgyal dang rigs 'dzin legs ldan rdo rje gnyis kyi gdams pa'i chu rgyun chad pa med par mnga' ba'i bla ma dam pa'i phyag bzhes ltar bsnyen yig lhan thabs kyi tshul du 'dri ba la/ gter kha 'di nyid la smin byed dbang dang byin rlabs kyi rim pa mang du yod na'ang /rgyas pa bde (2ba)gshegs 'dus pa la smin lam dbang gi rgyal po snang srid lha 'dre'i srog dbang 'di nyid gtso che zhing / dbang chog rdo rje spyi blugs 'di cung zad grags chung bas/ la la rdo rje gling pa'i gter kha nas gas sam snyam pa'i som nyi byed pa yod 'dug kyang / 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i zhabs kyis dbang 'di rigs 'dzin chen po la nges par gsan pas the tshom ma dgos/ 'bring ba me'i spu gri'i dbang chog sku/ thod/ me long / bum pa bzhi la brten nas bskur ba'i mtha' rten 'phrin lasarnam bzhi'i rjes gnang can de yin/ bsdus pa dpa' bo lha gsum la sger du dbang med cing / byin rlabs lu gu rgyud sogs spyi khyab tu mdzad par 'dug pas/ de yang mtshan ltas las/ mos gus dam tshig ldan pa'i rnal 'byor pas dang po bka' lung dbang rnams thob par bya: zhes pa'i don ltar dbang lung man ngag phyag bzhes dang bcas pa legs par nos te bsnyen pa'i rim pa nyams su blang ba la/—31 —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()gnas khang byi dor bya/bla ma zhi drag gi sku 'bag sogs dkon mchog gi rten dgram/sman rag gtor ma/ phyi mchod/ nang mchod/ tshogs/ ma mgon sde brgyad dang legs rtsal spun gsum gyi gtor ma bshams/nye bar mkho ba'i yo byad thams cad tsho gos par byas/thogs mar bgegs gtore btang nas gu gul thun dang bcas bgegs bskrad pa spyi 'gro ltar dang /chab gtor bsngos te bar chad zhi ba'i 'phrin las bcol/de nas bla ma drag po skyabs yul du dmigs pa la bde gshegs 'dus pa'i nyams len dngos gzhi nas/brgyud pa'i rtsa ba bla ma rje zhes sogs kyi skyabs sems rgyud dang 'dresanges bya/tshogs zhing ni/mdun gyi nam mkha' la 3na ) po pad+ma maṇ+ḍal hūṃ/zhes sogs yan lag bdun pa tshig dang dmigs pa bstun nas rgyas par bya/de rjes mdun gyi lha rnams bdag gi spyi bor byon nas:zhes pa nas bzung ste/mgar mal gyi tsha tsha lta bu 'od zer gyi tsha tsha spung nge byed pa zhig tu gyur ces pa'i bar 'don cha dkyus bzhin la/sems can gyi rnam shes dbang du bsdu lugs dang /sde brgyad kyi tshe srog dbang du bsdu ba gnyis la man ngag zhal las shes shing /bde bar gshegs pa'i skabasa3 las sa pa'i 'od zer kyi sne la mchod lha spro ba dang /sku sku gzugs/gsung yig 'bru/thugs phyag mas gyi rnam par spyan drangs pa 'od zer gyi rnam par zhu nas rang la thim pa dang /dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i skabs kyang byin rlabs 'od du zhu nas rang la bstim pa yin no//nyu de las chu las nya 'phar ba'i tshul du:zhes pa nas/stong gsum rtsad nas bcad cing 'khor lo'i dpal la lcags bsregs kyi sdig pas mtshan pa zhig bskyed:ces pa'i bar dkyus bzhin la/de'i mjug tu khro bcu rgyan gyi shog dril nas/gser gyi 'khor lo rtsibs bcu la:zhes pa nas ba thung ste/gdug pa ma lus 'dul bar bsam:zhes pa'i bar sbyar/dmigs pa'i go rim dkyus ma dang mi 'dra ba'i gzhal yas khang gi lte ba'i lha'i gdan bskyed/rim pa bzhin du chos 'byung gru gsum zla gam dmar po sum ldan la bskor ba'i thod rwa zlum po thog dang mi mgo'i tog dang bcas pa gzhal yasakhang gi 'og gzhi'i 'byung ba lnga/gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi/gzhal yas khang gi phyi'i gser gyi

gter kha gong ma'i drag po bde 'dus kyi bsnyen yig me rlung 'thug pa'i tsha ngar/ nang ma yina'akhor lo phyogs mtshams kyi rtsibs brgyad steng 'og gi rtsibs gnyis dang bcas pa'i srung 'khor khro bsto3brkong bcas pa bskyed pa yin no//yang hūṃ de las 'od zer dmar po'i tsho gis losaḥzhes pa nas bzung ste/me'i khro bo dpag tu med pa'i tsha tsha 'phro ba:zhes pa'i bar dkyus bzhin/dmigs pa/me'i 'khor lo'i sa bon kyang raṃ gyis byed/me'i 'khor lo de khog stong lte ba shin tu ldir zhing rtsa rtse'i bar du rim gyis phra ru song ba rtsibs rnams phyir mi mngon par nang nas rtsibs log gi tshul du yod pa zhig bsgom mo//gzhal yas khang de'i dbus su paṃ las sna tshogs pad+ma zhes pa nas bzung ste/rdo rje'i rwa bar nas drag po'i tsha tsha sil li li khol ba zhes pa'i bar ngag 'don dkyus bzhin/phyis kyi gter kha mang por sdig pa bzung ba'i rnam pa dang bshad tshod yod kyang /lugs 'di la pe dkar gyisasprul pa'i sdig pa de'i gnyen por sdigs mdzub kyi rtse nas sdig pa phar 'gyed pa'i tshul yin/de rjes lha thems gsal ba'i sgron me nas/bdag nyid zil gnon pad+ma ye:zhes pa nas bzung ste/dbang rnamasathams cad thob par bsam zhes pa'i bar gyi 'don cha rnams dkyus bzhin la/de yang go cha'i lha bskyed pa la dmigs pa zur pa med kyang ye shes pa spyan 'dren pa skabs 'di la dmigs pa'i zur khyad cung zad yod pa zhal las 'dri/de'i mjug tu ngag 'don med par dmigs pas thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'phros pa'i 'od zer gyis khro bo bcu spyan drangs te dam tshig pa la thim par mos/yang bde 'dus kyi nyams len dngos gzhi'i nang gi/bdag gi thugs ka'i hūṃ dang ba spu'i bu ga thams cad nas lasabyed kyi khro bo yag me dbal zhes pa nas bzung ste/bsrung bya thams cad gzhal yas khang gi nang du chud par 4na thas ma/de rnams kyang lha'i rnam pa zhes pa'i bar ngag 'don dkyus bzhin la/yag me dbal gyi dmigs pa dang bsrung bya'i dmigs pa zhal las 'dri/go cha'i lha rnams kyi sku la drag po'i tsha tsha 'ur 'ur 'bar ba la brten nas sdig sgrib bsreg par ma zad lus kyi nang kun mun khung du sgron me bteg pa ltar gsal zhing gzi brjid phun sum tshogs pa khro bo kun gyi rje btsan 'gran zla dang bral bar bsam/de nas bzlas pa bya ba ni/bdag gi thugs rin po che:zhes pa nas bzung ste/sgor re

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (25)'khor bar bsam zhes pa'i bar gyi dmigs pa klog tshul dang sgra la sems 'dzin pa/ me dbal spro ba/ bdag byin rlabs kyi dmigs pa/ go cha'i lha'i sku las 'phros pa'i mes bdag gi sdig sgrib bsreg pa sogs kyi dmigs pa rnams la gtso bo nan tan byed cing / gzhan yang me gser gyi 'khor lo'i bar du dgra bgegs gtubs/ las bzhi'i dgas pa spyi 'gro rnams kyang skabs dang sbyar/ sdebargyad dbang du 'du ba'i dmigs pa zab mo yang zhal shes ltar bsnyen sngags la yang 'dra min mang du yod pa'i 'khrul med kyi phyag len ma nor ba gnad che'o/ /de yang bla ma drag po'i rigs la gong gnon gyi bsnyen pa sngon du ma song na lha srin 'tshubs pa'i skyon gyis sgrub pa por smyo 'bog sogs 'tshub cha cher 'ong bar grags shing / gsar ma ba 'dras sgrub thabs 'khyar pa la brten nas bsnyen pa byas pas 'tshub kyi dbang du song ba mang / brgyud ldan gyi gsung sgros la/ pad+ma gling pa'i gter kha'i drag po la thog mar phyi sgrub nas rim gyis mdzad pas 'jam par grags shing / rat+na gling pa'i gter kha'i drag po'i phyi nang gsang gsum ga'i sgrub pa drag po kho na yin pas(4ba〉rgog mar thugs sgrub yang snying 'dus pa'i bsnyen pa sngon du mdzad pa phyag len khungs mar 'dug mod/ lugs 'di la de rigs kyi spros pa mi dgos par gong gi sgrub thabs kyi dmigasarim rnams gsal btab pa'i mjug tu zon skyor tsam gyi gong gnon dang / shin tu rtsub na drag po'i bsnyen pa byed pa dang lhan du rgyud 'jam par byed pa'i nyams len gyi gnad zab mo bla ma'i zhal las blang bar bya'o/ /thun mtshams su gtor ma 'bul ba ni/ thun par gtor ma'i shog dril gyi nang nas/ tre maṇ+ḍal:zhes pa nas bzung / ti ra baṃ maṇ+ḍal: zhes pa'i bar dkyus bzhin la/ gtor ma'i shog dril gyi ngag 'don nas/ hūṃ dur khrod me ri smug nag 'bar ba'i klong dkyil nas: zhes pa nas bzung ste/ bstod cing gsol ba btab pa'i bar dkyus bzhin/ mtshams 'dir bka' srung ma mgon sde brgyad kyi gsang sgrub nas mchod gtor rgyas bsdus ji ltar rigs pa phul/ spyir bde 'dus kyi srung ma ma mgon sdebargyad —34

gter kha gong ma'i drag po bde 'dus kyi bsnyen yig me rma 'khrug pa'i tsha ngar/ nang ma zhanadang /me'i spu gri'i srung ma legs rtsal sbun gsum la ngos won cing /sdebargyad kyi nang du bdud btsan klu gsum yang don gyis tshang bas rgyun du de tsam gyis cho go cing /bsnyen pa'i dus bdud btsan klu gsum la yang sger gsol re byed/nub dang po dngos grub tsho gis kyi shog dril nas tshogis kyi mchod pa rgya cher 'bul/gtor ma'i ngag 'don gyi bskul bya/nub dang po la tsho gos yod pas de tsam gyis chog mod/gzhan du bskul gyi mjug tu dpal mgon bdun cu rtsa gnyis sogs la gtor ma bsngo ba thun bar gtor ma'i shog dril nas bshad pa de yang byed/mthar rdzogs rim ka dag gi ngang du cung zad mnyam par bzhag ste/de las langs pa'i spyod lam sogs spyi dang na 'dra/de lta bu'i thun bzhin bcad de nyams su blang ba'i 3 ni/gzhung chen las/bsnyen pa'i ra ni gsum yin te/dusadang grangs dang rtags gsum las dus na zla drug bsgoms pa yis sdebargyad bka' yi bran du 'gyur grangs ni 'bum phrag drug gis ni nus pa pad+ma nyid dang mnyamaḥrtags ni lha 'dre thub rtags dang :ye shes lha yi rtags gnyis so:zhes bshad pas dus las grangs ga de las kyang rtags gtso bsazhi btu byas na mtshan ltas/gsal ba'i me long las/dbang po rab kyi zla ba gsum gyis 'grub 'bring gis zla ba drug gis 'grub par 'gyur tha mas zla ba bcu gnyis dag gis ni:nges par 'grub 'gyur gu ru nyid kyis gsung :zhes sgrub pa po dbang po'i khyad par gyis zla ba'i grangs kyang mtha' gcig tu ma nges shing /'bum phrag drug gis rang lus byin gyis rlob:'bum phrag bcu yis las tshogs thams cad 'grub bye ba gcig dang 'bum phrag gsum gyis ni nus pa skyon pad+ma nyid dang mnyam:zhesagrangs kyang mang ba'i phyogs byung ṣ+ka rab ni zhal mthong dbang bskur byin gyis rlob:thod rnga rkang dung sgra sgrog lung ston 'byung :zhing skyong mkha' 'gros dngos su gtor ma len bka' srung chos skyong thamasacad sprin ltar 'du:snang srid lha 'dre kun gyi rang srog 'bul:gang brtsams las rnams thogs med 'grub par 'gyur 'bring gis nyams dga' bag dro byin chen 'thibs:sman rag gtor ma khol dang rlangs pa 'byung : rang lus sgrid cing 'phar 'dar rang dbang med dben khang dris gang 'khor la

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()mkha' 'gro 'bab legs 5bakhis smra zhing sgra skad sna tshogs 'byin tha ma rmi lam mtshan ma 'di ltar 'byung :zhes sogs sgrib pa dag pa/bar chad las rgyal ba/lha so so'i 'grub rtags gsal bar gsungs shing /mi 'dod gnod byed bgegs kyi mtshan ma ni:zhes sogs bar chad kyi glags lta ba'i rigs rnams la/de rnams 'dul zhing gas gzir gyi man ngag rigs 'dzin brgyud pa'i zhal lung las blang bar bya/don dril na bzang po dge ba'i mas ma ci byung yang :dga' spro rlom sems 'khri ba rtsad nas gcod ga pa'i mtshan ma ltas rnams ci byung yang :bag chags zhabrul snang yin pas lam du khyer:thams cad sems las byung bas spros pa gcod:sems nyid chos sku chen por la zla'o:zhes rang bzhin rdzogs pa chen po ka dag gi gnas lugs la mnyam par 'jog pa ni gnad kyi dam pa'o//bsnyen pa thems pa'i sngags thun la tsho gos dang dngos grub len chog sogs spyi ltar bya'o//de ltar bsnyen pa thems pa'i sngags spyon rnams la dgos pa'i don ni gnyis te/gzhung chen las/phyi mar slob dpon pad+ma yi:thugs rje'i lcags kyus bzung nas kyang :bde 'dus bla ma'i go 'phang thob cesamachog gi dngos grub dang :de ltar mas ltas rab rdzogs nas rang dang gas nyid bsrung ba dang :zhes pa nas bzung ste/gang bsams las rnams ba par 'gyur:zhes pa'i bar gyis mtsho ni te rgyasapar byung bas mchogo thun gyi dngos grub dbang gi rgyal po la longs spyod par 'gyur ro:smras pa/gter ston rgyu skar dbus na nyi zla ltar//zla bral gong 'og gnyis su nyer grags pa'i//nyang ral gter༄༄da thugs snab drag po'i lam//nyams su len 'di bgo nams6na ) bye bas kha sgrubs//bzang rdzu'u ga pa sbos ltar rab 'gyings pa'i//ban sngags 'byung po'i bya tshogs ches mang yang legs bshad 'od snang spros tshe zab don gzugs/ /blta ba'i rnam dpyod mig ldan re re tsam/ /zab las ches zab gnyan las ches gnyan pa/ /me long byad ltar gsal ba yi ge sto /sngon chad bkod pa med mod rigs 'dzin mchog/chos kyi bdag por bsams nas legs par bris//dpe 'di bka' rgyas dam du ma bcings na//las 'bras rgyab tu bor ba'i ham can 'gas//brgyud pa med kyang spel nas rang

bka' brgyad gsang rdzogs kyil byang lhan thabs dgongs pa kun 'byung / nang ma (ka)gzhan kun/ /'gal me lta bur mgo bo bskor gyi dogs/ kha rbad gzhan snang bsgyur tshig ma yin pa'i/ /don ldan nges rnyed pad+ma thod phreng bka'/ /tshul bzhin nyams su bstar bas 'di phyi'i don/ /bsgrub la bden par yid ches da gdod 'ong / /de skad drag po bde gshegs kun 'dus pa'i/ /bsnyen yig me rlung zhakhrug pa'i tsha ngar 'di/ /bkod pas nag phyogs bdud kyi sde'i g.yul las/ /rnam par rgyal ba'i ru mtshon bsgreng bar shog /des bla ma mnga' bdag chen po nyang gi gter byon drag po bde gshegs 'dus pa'i bsnyen yig me rlung 'khrug pa'i tsha ngar zhes bya ba 'di ni/ zhang sna nam pa rdo rje bdud 'joms kyi sprul pa'i zlos gar rigs 'dzin blo bzang pad+ma 'phrin las theg mchog dbang gi rgyal po yongs 'du'i sdes yang rdzong drag sngags phug tu lo gsum gyi bcad rgya'i skabs thugs kyi bzhed pa ltar rdo rje'i rnal 'byor spel ba'i ched du mkhas grub chen po rigs 'dzin ma ti'i mtshan can gyi drin las gter kha gong 'og gi zab chos rnams la mi 'jigs pa'i spobs pa dge ba za hor sngags spyon gyis sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'jam dbyangs dpal bzang ngo / /maṅga lo//bka' brgyad gsang rdzogs kyi las byang lhan thabs dgongs pa kun 'byung bzhugs so/ /na ma shan+ta kro dha pa ri sa man+ta de we saḥ zhi khro yongs rdzogs bka' brgyad lha/ /ka dag rig pa'i rnam 'phrul can/ /gdod ma'i mgon la gus btud nas/ /gyer sgom nyer mkho'i lhan thabs 'dri/ /'dir bka' brgyad gsang rdzogs kyi las byang gi lhan thabs med du mi rung ba rnams bkod pa la/skyabs sems lhan thabs ni/ /thog mar tshig bdun gsol 'debs kyi 'jug tu/ sgrub khog las/ bla ma sangs rgyas 'khor dngang sa kun nas bdag la dgongs su gsol: bla ma dkon cog rnam gsum la byang chub ma thob bar du ni skyabs kyi mchog tu bzung bar bgyi sngon nas bsags pa'i sdig —37

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (25)snying ba bshags 'gro don sangs rgyas thob bya'i phyir smon pa'i byang chub sems ni bskyed sems can yongs su smin bya'i phyir gsang sngags spyod pa rlabs chen spyad don dam spros bral byang chub sems rang byung mtha' bral stong gsal bsgom lan gsum brjod/ yan lag brgyad pa'i lhan thabs ni/ — rat+na maṇ+ḍal/ paṃ pad+ma maṇ+ḍal/ ma su rla maṇ+ḍal/ a tsan+d+ra maṇ+ḍal/ badz+ra sa ma ya dzaḥ lhang ma bka' ma'i rgyud las/ rdo rje slob (2na po pon sangs rgyas dpal sogs bya/ brgyud 'debs ni/ dpal ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma/ blo ka gcig gi rjes su sman mchod lhan thabs kyi bla brgyud rnams kyi tshig rkang bzhi pa gsol ba 'debs so dngos grub rnam gnyis stsole zhes 'don pa bsgyur nas mjug tu/ phyi dkyil smin byed lam gyi lha skur shar/ /lus dkyil dbang gi rtsa khams bde drod 'bar/ /phyag rgya la brten dga' bzhi'i bde chen rgyas/ /rang sems ka dag kun bzang mngon gyur shog /rdor dril rnga byin rlabs ni/sgom khog gi tshig cung zad bde ru btang ba/ rdo rje mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i 4 las hūṃ las byung ba'i rdo rje yar gyi rwa lnga rigs lnga yab lnga dang / mar gyi rwa lnga rigs lnga yum lngar gsal ba'i lte ba mkha' gsang byang chub kyi sems su 'khyil ba las 'od 'phros pas 'phags pa mchod cing 'gro don 'byung bar gyur/ ā+oṃ āḥ& badz+ra tiṣ+ṭha dzñā na sam ya hūṃ/ dril bu mi dmigs rki/ 4 las byung ba'i dril bu yum gyi mkha' nang du yab kyi rdo rje dril lcer gyur pas sbyor ba byas pas byang chub kyi sems chos nyid kyi rang sgras stong gsum gang bar gyur/ sum̐ ku lan+ta ri ga rje (2ba)sno rnga rnga lcag dang bcas pa mi dmigs pas rki/ a las rnga kun tu bzang mo'i mkha' la rnga lcag kun tu bzang pos sbyor ba byas pas byang chub kyi sems nam mkha'i mtha' klas par bla med snying po'i chos sgras gang bar gyur/ dharma dh+wa tu hūṃ hūṃ baṃ snye sam ya ho bgegs gtore lhan thabs ni/ raṃ yaṃ kho/ ā+oṃ āḥ// oṃ a kā ro sogs/ sgrub khog las/ yang dag don la mi mos shing : mi dang mi min log 'dren bgegs lan chags re gtor 'di khyer la gnas 'ar khor yug tshun chad du skad cig tsam yang 'da' ma byed gal te nga yi bka' 'das na bde gshegs mkha' 'gro kun 'dus nas lusang ga rdul phran —38

bka' brgyad gsang rdzogs kyil byang lhan thabs dgong pa kun 'byung / nang ma (ka)bzhin du rlog mtshams gcod kyi lhan thabs ni sgom khog gi tshig bde ru cung zad btang ba/chosathams cad stong zhing bdag med pa nam mkha' lta bu'i klong nas/rang nyid skad cig dran rdzogs su bka' brgyad tshom bu dgu'i khro bo'i tsho gis kyi skur gyur pa me dpung 'bar ba'i klong du gsal ba las/sprul pa yang sprul gyi khro tshogs skar ltar 'khrugs pas bgegs thams cad sran phung la rdo brgyab pa ltar bskrad par the)'gyur 'a )srung 'khor mjug gi lhan thabs ni/sgom khog gi tshig cung zad bde ru btang /slar yang thugs ka'i hūṃ las khro bo 'tshol pa ṭak+ki rā dza sku mdog mthing nag g.yas tho ba dang g.yon zhags pa bsnams pa rab 'jigs gtum po dpag tu med pa spros phyogs skyong bcu bkug ste steng 'og phyogs mtshams su bsnol ba'i steng du hūṃ bcu 'phros par 9) gyur/byin khā+e )'bebs kyi lhan thabs ni/gter gzhung bcos med/hūṃ/byin chen ngo mtshar khyad par can:ru ḍā ldan snying dang stobs bzang ro:shar phyogs dur khrod bsil ba'i tshal:nya yi shing rgyan zhing skyong ni:gnam 'phrodakar po glang mgo can gri gug thod khrag phyag na bsnams phyogs skyong brgya byin sku mdog ser glang chen steng na rdo rje bsnams mtsho nang mtha' yas klu dbang dkar sbrul mgo gdengs shing thal mo sbyar shar sprin dkar la shing sdong ser mchod rten mdangs ldan bde byed brtsegs ke ri ban dmar gyis dbyug mthing :ma mo chen mo gshegs su gsol:ston pa mkhas shing snying stobs che:/ kwa ra yis byin phob cig gu ru de wa ḍā gi sam ya sarba lha hri āḥzhes pa'i skabs su sgra'i tshogs bsgrag cing bya'o:sngags kun la sbyar ro//hūṃ/byin chen ngo mtshar khyad par can:lha chen mgo dang 'chi bdag ro lho phyogs dur khrod sku la rdzogs:shing chen ba po shis tsū ta sngo:zhing skyong 'tsho byed ma he'i gdong :phyogs skyong gshin rje sngo nag brjid:thod dgrag thogs nas ma he zhon:klu chen 'jog po gser mtsho 'dzin sprin chen gnam sdud sngo skya 'khyil:mchod rten ta la rin cen brtsegs tse'u ri mda' gzhu 'gengs ma ser ma mo chen mo gshegs su gsol ston pa rang byung rju'aphrul ldan 'jam dpal bshes gnyen byin phob /ga gu ru de war:྅/byin wo ngo mtshar khyad

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()par can:lha r+ṣa nang khrol dbang phyug ro:nub phyogs dur khrod lang ka brtsegs shing chen a ta a li ga:zhing chen rol chen chu srin gdong :phyogs skyong chu lha dmar skya sprul chung ma dang bcas chu srin zhen:klu rgyal dung skyong mtsho dmar skya sprin sgrogs 'jigs pa dmar 3ba ) na ga 'khrug mchod rten bde rgyas khams gsum sgrol bra ma chu srin rgyal mtshan dmar ma mo chen mo gshegs su gsol:ston pa chos 'chad 'byor pa ldan klu sgrub snying pos byin phob cig gu ru de ba ḍa gi:/ hūṃ/ byin wo ngo 'amatshar khyad par ༅:lha r+ṣa mas ma khyab 'jug ro:byang phyogs dur khrod pad+ma brtsegs ar pu ta na mdzes pa'i shing :zhing skyong dud ka rta mgo ljang :phyogs skyong gnod sbyin dbyug thogs ljang :chung mar bcas te rta dmar zhen:klu rgyal stobs rgyu mtsho chen ljang :thugs byed myos sprin ljang gur 'thibs:mchod rten don yod 'phrin las gter:pe ta mthing nag rdo rje 'phyar:ma mo chen mo gshegs su gsol:ston pa myang 'das mas rtsal che:pra chen hastis byin phob cig gu ru de wa /hūṃ/byin chen ngo mtshar khyad par can:lha li lag g.yas dga' dbang ro:shar lho dur khrod lhun grub ga kho shing chen n+ya ya gro ta bzang : zhing skyong 'dungs pa ra gdong ser phyogs skyong me lha zhugs bum can chung mar bcas te ra la chen:klu rgyal pad chen mtsho bcas sngo gdung byed sprin chen dmar ser 'khyil mchod rten go'u te shan ti:bu ka dmar ser zhing rgyu 'dren ma mo chen mo gshegs su gsol:ston pa rolartsed zas bcud che:bi mā mi tras byin phob cig:gu ru de wa dze:྅/byin chen ngo mtshar khyad par can:lha r+ṣa lag g.yon tshogs bdag ro:lho nub dur khrod gsang wo rol shing r+pā zhi khro rdzogs ldan 'od:zhing skyong sprul pa mi gdong sngo phyogs skyong srin po gri thogs smug chung mar bcas te mi la zhen:klu chen hu lu mtshor bcas smug sprin chen gha 4na sko ser khra 'khyil:mchod rten med gragasaka ni ku kas ma dung dmar dkrug 'thung ljang : ma mo chen mo gshegs su gsol: ston pa bdud 'dul byin rlabs can dha na lha: tas byin phob cig gu ru de wam //byin li ngo mtshar khyad par can:lha r+ṣa rkang g.yon 'bring gi ro:nub byang // khrod he r+ṣa brdal shing wo ta dzha nag po 'khril:

bka' brgyad gsang rdzogs kyilas byang lhan thabs dgongs pa kun 'byung / nang ma (ka)zhing skyong sto 'phyang sha ba'i mgo:phyogs skyong rlung lha ba dan 'phyar dud ka chung bcas sha ba zhen:klu chen rigs ldan mtshor bcas ljang :sprin pa rab ldan char 'bebs ser mchod rten dge ldan ma hā bha sme sha nag mo tsit+ta za ma mo chen mo gshegs su gsol:ston pa khab bzhes btsun mor ldan rom bu gu phyas byin phob cig gu ru de war:྅/byin chen ngo mtshar khyad par can:lha chen rkang g.yas smin drug ro byang shar dur tsā da 'jig rten brtsegs shing chen ta la 'od 'bar 'khyil:zhing skyong dregs pa ce spyang gdong :dbang ldan ljang skya rtse gsum can:chung mar bcas te ce spyang zhon:klu chen ba su mtshor bcas dkar sprin chen nya can nag por 'khrug:mchod rten klu gnas shing kun te:tsan+ta ser skya mchog lus gol ma mo chen mo gshegs su gsol:ston pa cho 'phrul bzo la mkhasashān+ti ga lhas byin phob cig gu ru de wa ḍā ki ni snga:྅/byin chen ngo mtshar khyad par can phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad dur khrod bdag:zhing skyong ma mo kun gyi rje:rigs 'dzin grub thob brgyad kyi gtsoglu sogs sde brgyad kun gyi gnyan:mchod rten shing chen kun tu bzhugs ston pa mthu stobs lha 4bsrin 'dul skyon pad+mas byin phob cig ma dang mkha' 'gro gshegs su gsol gnas 'dir byin phob bdag dbang bskur bgegs dang log 'dren bar gcod sol mchog dang thun mong dngos grub (li stsol:(i)mchod pa sman gtor ra t+pa brlab pa'i lhan thabs ni/sgom khog gi tshig bde ru cung zad btang ba/bdag gi thugs da'i hūṃ las re yaṃ kho 'phros pas phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod rdzas rnams kyi ma dag pa'i skyon rnams ye shes kyi mes bsregs/cho se nyid kyi rlung gis gtore/tshad med kyi chus bkrus te mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid du gyur pa'i ngang las/oṃ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du/bdug spos ma sngon mo spos khang 'dzin pa/me tog ma dmar mo me rtag 'dzin pa/dri chab ma dkar mo dri'i dung chos 'dzin pa/mar me ma dmar ser snang gsal 'dzin pa/zhal zas ma dkar mo bshos gtsang 'dzin pa/rol mo ma ljang gu sil snyan 'dzin pa de rnams re re las kyang rang 'dra'i lha mo dpag tu med pa dpal /kun tu bzang po'i mchod pa'i sprin phung nam mkha'

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (25)mdzod lta bur zad mi shes pas khyab par (sa gyur: (aḥ)smran phud kyi snod bcud rnams mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid du gyur pa'i ngang las las rlud / raṃ las me/ kai las thod pa'i skyid bu gsum gyi steng du āḥlas ban+ta yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi pa'i lte bar byang sems/ seng ge'i sha /sman bzang po drug shar gyi rtsibs la dri r+pā/ glang po che'i sha /dzāti/ lho'i rtsibs la sha wo/ rta'i sha /ka ko la/ nub kyi rtsibs la/ pad+ma rak+ta/ rma bya'i sha /li shi /byang gi rtsibs la dri chu/ khyung sha /gur kum rnams (ldan)rlung gis me sbar te zhu ba yongs su gyur pa las phyag mtshan bcu so so'i lte bar hūṃ ā+oṃ swā e hā rlu lo me bye snya gyi mtshan pa las 'od zer 'phros/ 'khor 'das kyi bcud thams cad bsdus te thim pa yongs su gyur pa las rigs lnga yab yum lngar gyur pa'i sbyor mtshams nas byang chub kyi sems dkar dmar gyi rgyun babs pa'i steng du rigs lnga yab yum 'od du zhu nas thim pas bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por (ka)yir/ gha gtor ma'i snod bcud mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid du gyur pa'i ngang las thod pa dum bu gcig pa stong gsum dang mnyam pa'i nang du oṃ āḥ/ zhu ba las byung ba'i lha'i zhal zas 'dod yon lnga'i lha mo sprin gyi phung po 'khrigs par (nga)gyur/ (5)rak+ta'i snod bcud mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid du gyur pa'i nga las pad+ma 'bar ba'i snod r+ṣa por/ ra las rdo rje sgeg mo dmar mo kha nas khrag babs te nyon mongs pa bag chags dang bcas pa 'joms pa'i rak+ta'i rgya mtsho rba klong rgya mdud kyi tshul du 'khrugs pa la/ lha mo nyid 'od du zhu nas thim pas 'khor ba stongs par (dzā)gyur/(ja)rgyu'i ting nge 'dzin gyi lhan thabs ni/ sgom khog gi tshig lhug pa tshigs bcad du bsdebs pa/ rang sems rgyu yig hūṃ sngon po/ /'od 'bar rang byung chos kyi dbyings/ /mkha' la zla ba lding ba bzhin/ khyu yi yi ge hūṃ de las/ /raṃ yaṃ khaṃ gsum rim bzhin 'phros/ /me yis 'jig rten dngos 'dzin bsregs/ /rlung gis rnam rtog gzung 'dzin gtor/ /chu yis bag chags zhen snang rtoḍa༄krus/ /(ta)gtso bo bskyed pa'i lhan thabs ni/ /sgom khog gi don nyung tso bsdus pa/ /spro zhing bsdus nas 'od du zhu/ /de nyid rdo rje rtsedagur (tha)yid /(na〉kha' gsang byin rlabs kyi lhan thabs ni/ /ma (5bsko'i maṇ+ḍal sogs42

bka' brgyad gsang rdzogs kyilas byang lhan thabs dgong pa kun 'byung / nang ma zhan(pa)so/ /(la)dbang bskur ba'i lhan thabs ni/ sgom khog gi tshig bde ru cung zad btang ba/ tshom bu dgu'i lha tshogs rnams kyi dung khang 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pa'i lte bar rnam snang dkar po thugs kar ā+oṃ gyisamatshan pa/ ljags pad+ma 'dab brgyad kyi lte bar snang ba mtha' yas dmar po thugs kar āḥsamatshan pa/ thugs rdo rje rgya gram gyi lte bar rdo rje sems dpa' mthing ga thugs dar hūṃ gis mtshan pasadus gsum bde gshegs bla ma rigs 'dzin thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs yongs su rdzogs pa thob/ tshom bu dgu'i lha tsho gos rnams kyi gtsug tor gyi steng du hūṃ mthing ga / dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ rna gong g.yas su swā ser po/ stag par gyi dmar po/ snyan gong g.yon du hā ljang gu lasarigs lnga sogs zhi ba bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis kyi lha tshogs mnyen lcug 'khril ldem gzhen tshul can/gsal 'tsher lhun stug gzi brjid 'bar ba ste zhi ba'i tshul dgu 'bar bar bzhugs nas dbang chen rab 'byams kyi dbang bskur ba thob ste 'gro don la dpa' bar (wa)gyur/ ltas na mchod kyi lhan thabs ni/ gsal sgrigs/ kun bzang rigs lnga dam pa tog dkar po/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i sprul pa rnam pa gsum/ /gsang bdag dam pa'i rigs can gra ma lngar/ /dam rdzas myong grol sman mchod 'bul gyis bzhes/ /ā+oṃ mahā sarba pañtsa a thi ta kha raṃ khā hi/ las kyi dbang mo dbang chu'i brgyud pa drug /rgya gar rigs 'dzin brgyad dang pad+ma 'byung / /bod kyi rje 'bangs nyi shu rtsa lnga la/mor/'gro mgon mnga' bdag myang chen yab sras dang : gter ston chos dbang bka' babs sman lung pa/ /dgas ston gnyan ston se sdings (6na〉ba sras la/skor/gu ru chos 'od mtshungs med dpal 'byor dbang / /chos kyi dbang po ga me gu ru'i mtshan/ /de sras dbang 'byor rig pa'i rdo rje la/skor/slar yang legasaldan rdo rje mkhyen brtse'i zhabs/ /dbang phyug rab brtan 'jam mgon bsod na mas mchogo /zur chen kun mkhyen rtsa ba'i bla ma la/skor/bcom ldan bde gshegs zhi ba'i lha tshogs dang / /dpal chen che mchog yon tan yang dag thugs/ /'jam dpal sku dang pad+ma gsung gi lhar/sko ra/phur pa 'phrin lasam mo rbod gtong tshogs/ /rigs 'dzin slob dpon 'jig rten mchod bstod dang / / dmod pa drag —43—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()sngags dpal gyi bka' srung (ha)la/〉〉/9)bstod pa'i lhan thabs ni/gter gzhung bcos med zhi khro spyir dril nas bstod pa/hūṃ bcom ldan bde gshegs kun bzang rigs lnga yab gdug pa 'dul phyir khrag 'thung sku lngar ston bzang mo la sogs kro dhī yum rnams 'khril:sems dpa' lcam dral mthar byed thub pa drug:dregs pa 'joms mdzad gtum rngam tshogs dang bcas zhi khro yongs rdzogasalha la phyag 'tshal bstod dkyil 'khor tshom bu dgu la so sor bstod pa ni/hūṃ bcom ldan dpal chen che mchog he ru ga gnyis med bde sbyor gnam zhal dbyings phyug 'khril:rigs bzhi he ru ka yab yum yon to sras:sprul pa'i khro bcu sgo skyong 'khor gyis bskor bde gshegs dgongs 'dus che ba'i yon to rgyas:che mchog yongs rdzogs lha la phyag 'tshal bstod:྅/bcom ldan dpal chen badz+ra he ru ga chags med bde sbyor kro ti shwa rī 'khril khrag 'thung rigs bzhi yab yum thugs kyi sras gnas dang yul gyi ma tshogs sgo mar bcas:dri med rnam dag thugs mchogo 'gyur pa med yang dag yongs rdzogs lha la phyag 'tshal bstod:྅/bcom ldan dpal chen 'jam dpal gshin rje gshed:sku lnga sbyor dang dug lnga sgrol yum 'khril:gshed bzhi yab 6ba)thum sku yi sras dang bcas phyogs stong ging bdud sgo bzhi phra men bskor rab 'jigs rngam pa'i sku mchog khyad par che gshin rje yongs rdzogs lha la phyag 'tshal bstod:྅/bcom ldan dpal r+pā rta mgrin pad+ma dbang :pad+ma gzi ldan bde chen yum mchog 'khril:dbang chen rigs bzhi yab yum gsung gi sras phra men zil gnon khro rgyal sgo bar bcas gsung gi dbang phyug rta skad phyogs bcur sgrog dbang chen yongs rdzogs lha la phyag 'tshal bstod:snyi/bcom ldan dpal chen rdo rje gzhen nu che:gsang chen dgyes mdzad 'khor lo rgyas 'dabs 'khril:'phrin las sras bzhi khro bcu yab yum bcas:za gsod ma tshogs ming po sgo bas bskor 'phrin las bdag nyid rtsal r+ṣa 'gro ba 'dul phur ba yongs rdzogasalha la phyag 'tshal bstod //bcom ldan dpal chen che btsan ma rga rdzogs sku dgyes mdzad yum chen nyid zhi mu kha 'khril:rtag rgyal ma lnga bde che/ /na gyi sras ye shes rje mo sman mo sgo stong bcas:

bka' brgyad gsang rdzogs kyil byang lhan thabs dgongs pa kun 'byung / nang ma (ka)las kyi bdag mo rbod gtong pho nyar 'gyed ma mo yongs rdzogs lha la phyag 'tshal bstod nyu/bcom ldan dpal chen rigs 'dzin thod pa rtsal mi dmigs rdo rje rnal 'byor gsang yum 'khril:thugasakyi sras mchog slob dpon rigs bzhi ste:dpa' bo dpa' mo sgo bzhi srung mdzad bcas rgyud lung man ngag mnga' bdag rig pa 'dzin:bla ma yongs rdzogs lha la dze:྅/dregs pa kun 'dul khro rgyal mi bzad pa khams gsum srid pa spyi 'dul yum mchog 'khril thugs sras pho nya sdo bzhi yab yum bcas sde dang dpon bcas sgo skyong dregs pa'i tshogs:7na8 rgyas dbang drag las rnams ci bcol sgrub 'jig rten yongs rdzogs lha la phyag 'tshal bstod snyi/mas stobs rtsal ldan rab gtum khro bo'i rgyal:kun grol 'byung ba lnga bdag yum mchog 'khril thugs sras dregs pa las mkhan yab yum bzhi dam tshig dbang gis bstan srung sngags bdag tshogs:drag po bco brgyad gdug pa'i mtshon ngar can:drag sngags yongs rdzogs lha la mo:bka' srung gi bstod pa ni/hūṃ/dus gsum bde gshegs yongs rdzogs spyan snga sa dam nos rang rtags srog gi snying po phul:bka' stsal gnyer blangs rdzu 'phrul gar gyi bdag ma ltar byams shing sring ltar dungs sems kyis dkyil 'khor ming 'dzin rnal 'byor yongs la stob bka' srung yongs rdzogs lha la ri:don gyi bstod pa ni/hūṃ/rnam dag ye shes thugs kyi dkyil 'khor du 'gro don 'dod dgur bsgyur zhing gtso dang 'khor ji ltar sprul yang ye shes rig pa'i rtsal rang shar rang grol bde gshegs g.yung drung lha:rnam dag chos kyi dbyings las ma g.yos pa'i thams cad chos sku yongs rdzogs lha rke)la bstod: tshogs9)byin rlabs kyi lhan thabs ni/sgom khog gi tshig don tshigs bcad du bsdebs pa:tsho gis kyi yo byad stong pa'i ngang :a dang ma las nyi zla yi snod du 'bru gsum zhu ba las 'dod yon lnga ldan phung por gyur:bskang rdzas byin rlabs kyi lhan thabs ni/gsar sgrigs/gzhan yang thugs dam skong ba'i rdzas su gyur pa/bdud rtsi sman gyi mchod pa/rak+ta dmar gyi a:/tho du byung ba'i gtor ma/sha r+pā lang ling sna tsho gis su zhun chen mar me'i snang gsal/4 5 chen gsung gi dud pa/thod pa ltag sprod/rnga/

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()dung wo/rkang gi gling bu/a mong mchod pa sna tshogs/lo byung dam rdzas mdangs ldan/ri rab gling bzhi'i mdos chen sogs dngos su 'byor ba dang yid kyis sprul pa'i mchod pa'i sprin phung phyi 'dod yon gyi lha mo/nang ye shes kyi bdud rtsi/gsang ba byang chub sems kyi rang bzhin/rgya nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam zhing dus 'khor ba ji srid kyi bar du 'byung bar ṇa)gyur/bskang 9༄'i lhan thabs ni/gter gzhung bcos med/dang po dgongs su gsol ba ni/hūṃ/zhi khro rgyal ba yongasardzogs lha 'gro la phan mdzad thugs rje'i bdag sems can kun gyi gnyen gcig pu kun nasabadag la dgongs su gsol:zhes brjod pas chos sku las gzugs skur bzhengs par bsem mo de nas bshags pa bya ba ni/hūṃ/shar nas badz+ra a k+ṣiṃ saḥrdo rje rigs kyi thugs dam la zhe sdang dam tshig nyams so 'tshal:'di yang mi 'chab mthol lo bshags:྅/lho nas rat+na 6bha 4rin cen rigs kyi thugs dam la:nga rgyal dam tshig 'grer 'di yang mi 'chabar:྅/nub nas pad+ma de ba hrī:pad+ma rigs kyi thugs dam la 'dod chags dam tshig nyams so 'tshal:'di yang ma mo:lha/byang nas a mo gha sirnyi las kyi rigs kyi thugs dam la phrag dog dam tshigs 'di yang rki:྅/dbus na be+e ro tsa na bzhugs de bzhin rigs kyi thugs dam la gti mug dam tshig ra:'di yang mi 'chabarki:de nas bskang rdzas dang rang rtags brjod pa ni/mchod rdzas rnams thogs te dkyil 'khor la bskor zhing 'di skad do://bskang ngo bskal bas thugs dam bskang :ni lnga skang ba med de khamasagasum yongs kyis bskang :sbyor ba med de khams gsum yongs las sbyor sgrol ba med de khamasagasum yongs kyis sgrol ye sbyor ye sgrol chen pos thugs dam bskang :thugs dam gnyan po bskang ba'i rdzas rnams ni:rtsa brgyad stong las sbyar ba'i bdud rtsi dang :khyad par lo du byung ba'i gtor ma dang :'khor ba rgyu las bsgral ba'i rat+na dang :rnam dag rgyu bsgral ba ma chen rdzas mchogo dang :'bru bcud stong las sbyar ba'i dza gad dang :phyi nang gsang ba'i longs spyod sna tsho gis kyi bskang ngo bskang pas thugs dam bskang :de nas bye brag tshoX 6bur bskang ba ni/zhi ba lhun gyis spyi skul ltar mas

bka' brgyad gsang rdzogs kyilas byang lhan thabs dgongs pa kun 'byung / nang ma zhan༅ra/grub pa'i dkyil 'khor nas: zhes pa nas/ bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis rgyal ba thugs dam can: mi mngon dbyings nas spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol dam tshig dbang gis dkyil 'khor brtan par bzhugs gnyis su med par phyag 'tshal mchod pa 'bul thugs dam skong gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsol: zhes tshomi bu dgu'i lha thams cad la 'gres su shes par bya ste/ mtshan don bye brag tu bskang ba'o: skabs su dam rdzas dang rang rtags gong bzhin brjod la bskang ngo / /de rjes su sgos dmigasa'adod gsol gdab pa ni/ nad gdon bar chad thams cad zhi bar mdzod: tshe dbang longs spyod thamasacad rgyas par mdzod: khams gsum srid gsum gdul bya dbang du sdus gnod byed dgra bgegasa'abyung po tshar chod cig: ces dmigs pa dang / sgos khung sa'i lha dang / rang bsten pa'i (4) srung ma rnams la yang bskang gso mtshan nas brjod de bya'o/ /de nas rkyen bzlog byol gdab pa ni/ lha'i nga rgyal dang ldan pas thal mo brdab cing 'di skad do/ /sngo na ltar bskang bskang gsogasonas: da 'di ltar kho nar bzlog bsgyur mdzod: rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la yas kyi bdud du g.yos pa bzlog: mas kyi sri ru langs pa bzlog:pha tshan nang gi rgya 'dre bzlog dar tshan nang gi stong 'drer g.yas na pho brgya mdang brdar bzlog g.yon na mo brgya dug g.yos mo rgyab ni mi gsum gros byed mo: mdun na rta gsum srab 'cha'adze:'ug pa spo la rgod par srin bya gong khar 'bod par: logs la wa spyang brgyal bar: srod la khyim bya 'tsher brki: tho rangs sgo khyi ngu bar ltasang na brgyad cu rtsa gcig bzlog ban bon ngan sngagasazor khar lo skag zla skag ki dang sgeg slo bur brgyad cu rtsa cig gar: ye 'byog sum brgya drug cusko bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi'i nad rnams ra dus min 'chi ba rnam brgyad snga: stong phrag brgyad cu'i bgegs rnams sko rtsis byas rde'u nag por mo ngan rmi lam ngan par mi nag skye bo'i ya ga mo:bran khol ga pa'i dmod mchu bzlog pho bh+yo de ni g.yas su bh+yo: mo byol de ni g.yon du byol phyi bdud de ni mkha' la byol ngan pa thams cad sdang ba'i dgra lar dgra dang bgegs la bh+yo bh+yo bh+yo:—47

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()zhes thal mo brdab 9)bo/bskul 9)gyi lhan thabs ni/hūṃ/mi ma ro zhe dbyings na bzhugs pa rgyal ba zhi khro'i tshogs āḥbazhengs shig bzhengs shig chos kyi dbyings nas bzhengs chu/bskul lo bskul lo sems can don la bskul gyi mdzod cig mdzod cig bcol ba'i 'phrin las mdzod āḥchos sku 9na ji ba med pa'i ngang nyid las:zho/skye ba'i cho 'phrul longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku:྅/sprul sku 'gro ba sems can don mdzad pa saḥzhi khro bka' brgyad lha tshogs thugs dam can rtswa/gzugs snang thams cad sku yi rang bzhin la:āḥsgra bsgrags thams cad gsung gi ngo bor snang :lha/dran rtog thams cad thugs kyi dgongs par 'dus saḥphyogs bcu dus bzhi'i bde gshegs bcom ldan 'das:྅/zhi ba lhun rgyas grub pa'i dkyil 'khor nas seng ge glang chen rta khyung rma bya'i khri rin cen nyi zla pad+ma 'od 'bar steng :dpal 'bar zhi ba yongs rdzogs lha tshogs ni rdo rje semasadapa' sangs rgyas kun gyi gtso nam mkha' kun bzang bde gshegs yum chen sbyor rnam snang rin 'byung mtha' yas don yod grub:sangs rgyas spyan dang mā ma gos dkar sgrol sa snying nam snying spyan ras phyag rdor dpal:lu se mā le girti nirti ma byams pa sgrib sel kun bzang 'jam pa'i dbyangs:sgru pe puspro ni pe ga rje ma kun bzang yid la bzang mo chos dbyings yum:lha dbang brgya byin thagasabazang shākya thub seng ge dam brtan kha 'bar chos kyi rgyal rnam rgyal gshin rje rta mgrin bdud rtsi 'khyil:lcags kyu zhags pa lcags sgrog dril 'khrol sogs:bzhi pa cu rtsa gnyis rgyal ba thugs dam can mi mngon dbyings nas gnas 'dir sku skyod cig:dam rdzas bdud rtsi 'bar ba 'di bzhes la thugs dam rgyud bskul bcol ba'i 'phrin las mdzod hoḥbade gshegs zhi ba'i lha tsho gos thugasadam can khyed rnams la mchod pa 'bul ba ni/phyi nang gsang ba sman rag gtor ma'i mchod pa bzhes shig:mahā pañtsa bha kla ta 9ba ) rak+ta sarba pā tsa khā gi bshags par gsol ba ni/spyi dang khyad par rtsa ba yan lag gi dam tshig la nyams chags dang 'gal 'khrul du gyur pa mthol zhing bshags so sa ma ya āḥ'aphrin las su bcol ba ni/zhi rgyas dbaX /ga gi 'phrin las rnam bzhi bdag gi yid bzhin

bka' brgyad gsang rdzogs kyilas byang lhan thabs dgongs pa kun 'byung / nang ma (ka)du sgrubs la log lta gdug pa can thams cad myur du tshar chod cig 'jigs brgyad sharnying ku ru ye swāhā 'byor drug ri nga mo: khams gsum ba she ku ru ye swāhā dgra bgegs mā ra ya rbad dusamin 'chi ba'i nad gdon bar chad rbod zor ltas ga bzlog bh+yo: de ltar mchod bshags bcol gsum 'og ma tshom bu dgu char la mtshan 'gres su shes par bya'o: // khro bo rol pa'i dur khrod chen po nas byol song gtso brgyad lha chen khri steng na: nyi ma zla ba pad+ma ge sar steng : che mchog yon tan yongs rdzogs lha tshogs ni bcom ldan dpal chen che mchog he ru ga gnyis med yum chen gnam zhal dbyings phyug 'khril raka gu ya bi sha yag ste: he ru ka bzhi kro ti yum dang bcas lha dang dri za me lha gshin rje srin chu bdag rlung lha gnod sbyin bgegs sa'i bdag: phyogs skyong 'dul byed khro bo chen po bcu: pra sgo ya ma pad+ma bi ghan te: ta spo ta sgo skyong ce spyang ma brgyad sogs sum cu rtsa gnyis rgyal ba thugs dam can mi mngon dbyings ma dze ra nyo che mchog yon tan lha tshogs thugs dam can khyed rnams la zhes 'gre/ hūṃ/ khrag 'thung rol pa'i dur khrod chen po nas: dregs pa ru tra bsnol ba'i khri steng na: nyi ma zla ba pad+ma ge sar steng : thugs mchog yang dag yongs rdzogs lha tshogs ni:bcom ldan (10na)dpal chen badz+ra he ru na gnyis med yum chen kro ti shwa rī 'khril: burnya rat+na pad+ma ga me ste: he ru ka bzhi gro ti yum dang sbyor: ko'u ri tse'u ri pra ma spre ta li pu ka ghasma sma sha tsan+ta li:sidha bya gh+ri sri la shwa na ma kri ta ga sko kha 'a hu lu ma gnas yul ko sing bcu drug ma tsho gis dang :lcags kyu zhags pa lcags sgrog dril bu ma sgo bzhin rab rngam ye shes sgo ma bzhi: bka' stod dbang phyug nyer brgyad la sogs te lnga bcu rtsa brgyad rgyal ba thugs dam can mi mngon dbyings〉 kho ra:hūṃ/ gshin rje rol pa'i dur khrod chen po nas chu glang zung bzhi bshibs pa'i khri steng na nyi ma zla ba pad+ma ge sar steng : sku mchog gshin rje yongs rdzogs lha tshogs ni: bcom ldan dpal chen 'jam dpal gshin rje gshed sbyor sgrol yum chen pe ta dza ti 'khril: ya ma rā tsa ral gcig myos byed gtum: ārla 'od zer tshar dgu re ma 〉 sku sras gshed bzhi yab dang yum du bcas nag 'joms—49

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (25)re ti phya sangs gdong dgu ma brag 'joms shel mig glang mgo mche gtsigs ma ya ba rngam stabasamig dmar khrag ral can dmigs pa klu mo tel pa spyan gcig ma bdud 'joms ral gcig chosargyal ral pa can rje mar ral nag thod dbyug phag mgo ma phyogs skyong gshed chen bcu gnyis yum dang bcas rgod stag gang ka spyang mgo sgo skyong bzhi gyi thogs ging bzhi kham thogs bdud po bzhi shod thogs rtsis bzhi sgog gcod bshan pa bzhi gdug pa gza' gdong yi dwags la sogs te: lnga bcu rtsa lnga rgyal ba thugs dam can mi mngon dbyings〉 sko ra ca'ajam dpal sku'i lha tshogasathugs dam can sogs 'gre/ hūṃ/ pad+ma rol pa'i dur khrod (10ba thin po nas klu rgyal gdug pa pho mo'i khri steng na nyi ma zla ba pad+ma ge sar steng : gsung mchog pad+ma yongs rdzogs lha tsho gos na: bcom ldan dpal chen pad+ma dbang gi ga cha gnyis med yum chen pad+ma gzi ldan 'khril sku las sprul pa byi la pu shud mgo: rdo rje rin cen pad+ma las dbang chen: dbang phyug rigs bzhi yum bcas gsung gi sras zhi khro zil gnon mi pham khro gnyer ma ma khyung zil gnon ro langs spyan gcig ma pho mo zil gnon khro mo gshin rje mo gza' klu zil gnon klu mo gnod sbyin mo zil gnon khro bo yab yum brgyad rnams dang : 'gugs 'dren sdom brdeg ye shes sgo ma bzhi khams brgya ma drug dmus long rgyab 'grel bzhi ye shes dpal gyi spyang brgyad khyi brgyad dang : pho nya mche gshog ngur 'brug dbang phyug sogs drug cu rtsa gsum rgyal ba thugs dam can mi mngon dbyings sko sko ra hoḥ pad+ma gsung gi lha tsho gis sogs 'gre/ hūṃ/ phur pa rol pa'i dur khrod chen po nas mahā de wa bsnol ba'i khri steng na nyi ma zla ba pad+ma ge sar steng : 'phrin las phur pa yongs rdzogs lha tsho gis ni: bcom ldan dpal chen rdo rje gzhen nu'i sku gnyis med yum chen 'khor lo rgyas 'debs 'khril: sras mchog bzhi rat+na pad+ma dang : dzirna ki lu ya sogs yum dang bcas lha kā ra rnam rgyal dbyug sngon gshin rje gshed mi g.yo rta mgrin 'dod rgyal bdud rtsi 'khyil: khams gsum rnam rgyal stobs chen khro bo bcu: sgra 'byin bsnyems ma sder ma dur khrod bdag: gtun khung gtum mo mda' bsnyems rlung 'byin ma gsod ma —50

bka' brgyad gsang rdzog kyil byang lhan thabs dgong ga kun 'byung / nang ma (ka)skul byed la sogs khro bo bcu: phag dang rmigs bu stag dang (11na)bya rgod mgo g.yag dang bya rog sha ba 'ug pa'i mgo: gzig dang khā ta byi la pu shud mgo spyang mo khra dang seng ge pha wang mgo dom dang sre mo dred dang byi ba'i mgo za byed gsod byed phra thabs nyi shu'i tshogs pu shud skya ka srin bya khra mgo ma: sgo skyong phra men chen mo bzhi rnams dang : shā na shwa na sri ka sri la ma ri ti ri ti re dza re ma 0 ya byin de byin bse byin phag byin ma brtse yi skyes bzhi lcags kyi skyes bu bzhi/ dung gi skyesabu bzhi dang 'byung po ser bdun cu rtsa brgyad rgyal ba thugs dam can mi mngon dbyings〉〉mo:'a phur pa 'phrin las kyi lha tsho gos thugs dam can sogs 'gre/ hūṃ/ ma mo rol pa'i dur khrod chen po nas srid pa'i ma mo 'bum bsnol khri steng na nyi ma zla ba pad+ma ge sar steng : khrod gtong ma mo yongs rdzogs lha tsho gos ni: bcom ldan dpal wo bla med he ru da gnyis med yum wo wo zhu mu kha 'khril snang gab55 'od gab55 mnyen gsal yang gsal g.yos bkrag gsal la sog tha/dbyings kyi yum chen drug bde 'gro thod 'phreng khrag 'thung ma mo dang : srid pa bde sbyor khams gsum 'tsho byed drug mig gcig myos byed za byed tshe 'phel bzhi dbyings phyug bdag nyid gcig pu rgyan rgyal bzhi chags byed cha snyoms ral gcig mthu mo che dbang sgyur srid 'degs gar dbang pad+ma gar kun grags kun bzang dregs bsnyems ye shes mchogo: 'od gsal g.yu sgron gsal 'bro chen mo bdun mche gtsigs kha 'phyang mchu 'jib rkang bldag bzhi har ting dun ting shan ting grub ting bzhi mgyogs ma khyung lding g.yag thod sder chen bzhi: (11ba ji pa' mo dbu dgu dbu lnga tsa mun ti:khram gtong gling dbang thig chen rgya mtsho bzhi stag srin bam srin kong srin 'byog srin bzhi ro kha tsan tri dza mun dza ti bzhi ro langs nag mo 'jig rten phung gsum dang : gsang ba'i ma gsum gsang ba'i pho nya gsum bdun cu rtsa gnyis rgyal ba thugs dam can: mi ma rga dbyings mor mo sngo ma mo rbod gtong lha tsho gos thugs dam can sogs 'gre/ hūṃ/ rigs 'dzin rol pa'i dur khrod chen po nas dar chen ltab khri brtsegs pa'i khri steng na nyi ma zla ba pad+ma ge sar steng : gdung 'tshob rigs—5/—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (25)'dzin yongs rdzogs lha tshogs ni: dpal chen rigs 'dzin gtso mchog thod pa rtsal mi dmigasayum chen rdo rje rnal 'byor 'khril lhun grub phyag rgya tshe dbang rnam smin bzhi yang dag rigs 'dzin rdo rje bsam grub rtsal 'jam dpal rigs 'dzin rdo rje grub pa rtsal: gsung gi rigs 'dzin rdo rje drag po rtsal phur pa'i rigs 'dzin rdo rje thod phreng rtsal yon to rigs 'dzin rdo rje gro lod rtsal rbod gtong rigs 'dzin rdo rje dbang sdud rtsal mar bstod rigs 'dzin rdo rje gzhog rgod rtsal:drag sngags rigs 'dzin rdo rje mtheb gshog rtsal: sgo bzhi skyong mdzad rdo rje slob dpon ni dam tshig dbang gi slob dpon chen po dang : man ngag lung gi slob dpon chen po dang : shes rab rgyud grol slob dpon chen po dang : nyams chags skong ba'i slob dpon chen po bzhi rdo rje rin cen pad+ma las mkha' 'gro: rdo rje rin cen pad+ma las kyi ging : dpa' bo dpa' mo la sogs nyi shu drug: bla ma rigs 'dzin rgyal ba thugs dam can mi mngon dbyings〉 〉 sko ho rigs 'dzin slob dpon (12na)thugasadam can sogs 'gre/ hūṃ/ 'jig rten rol ba'i dur khrod chen po nas: dregs pa pho mo bsnol ba'i khri steng du nyi ma zla ba pad+ma ge sar steng : mchod bstod bstan srung yongs rdzogs lha tsho gos ni bcom ldan dpal chen dregs pa kun 'dul che gnyis med yum chen khams gsum spyi 'dul 'khril: lha chen yab yum thugs sras dregs pa 'dul gshin rje gsod byed skos rje bdud mo dang : glog phreng sbal mgo gnod sbyin gnod sbyin mo sham+bha gnam the spyi mdud dkar po gsum srid rgyal sngags srung mkha' 'gro nag mo gsum bdud 'dul srog zan yam shud dmar po gsum gu lang bgegs rgyal dmu bdud nag po gsum: sgo bzhin srog bdag pe har ma sangs dang : mgon nag la sogs dbang chen sde bzhi dang : gza' bdud gnam sman klu bdud klu mor bcas ging chen bdud nag gza' klu srin po dang : gnod sbyin ma mo la sogs sde brgyad tshogs sum cu rtsa gnyis rgyal ba thugs dam can:mi mngon dbyings 〉 〉 〉: sngo 'jig rten mchod bstod lha tshogs thugs dam can sogs 'gre/ hūṃ/drag sngags rol ba'i dur khrod chen po nas dgra bgegs pho mo bsnol ba'i khri steng du nyi ma zla ba 52

bka' brgyad gsang rdzog kyilas byang lhan thabs dgong pa kun 'byung / nang ma zhanapad+ma ge sar steng : dmod pa drag sngags yongs rdzogs lha tsho gos ni bcom ldan dpal chen stobasaldan nag po che gnyis med yum chen 'byung lnga'i bdag mo 'khril: 'chi bdag srog bdag bdud pho bdud mo dang : srin nag 'joms byed gangs bzang sha za mo lha chen mgon nag thar pa dmu rje dang :sgo skyong rgyal po yab shud rdo rje legs: khu le lag dgu la sogs bka' nyan dang : khyab 'jug chen po klu rgyal gzhen nu gtum: bshan pa lha (12brdzin sdebargyad la sogs te: nyi shu rtsa brgyad rgyal ba thugs dam can mi mngone dbyings nas gnas 'dir sku bskyed la/ dam rdzas bdud rtsi 'bar bas:thugs dam rgyud bskul sko hoḥ dmod pa drag sngags lha tsho gos thugs dam can sogs 'gre lha/dkyil 'khor chen po'i bar khyams 'khor yug nas: bka' srung pho nya yongs rdzogs lha tshogs ni:dbang phyug nyer brgyad mkha' 'gro sum cu gnyis ging chen bco brgyad laṅka bcu drug dang : 'bar ma brgyad dang ye shes ma mo bdun sring mo rnam bzhi rtog byed 'joms byed ma gdab phur brgya rtsa brgyad po mthu rtsal can stag gdong dkar mo phag gdong nag mo dang : sprel gdong dmar mo spyang gdong ljang gu ste 'dzin 'ching sdom brdeg ye shes sgo ma bzhi: lcags ri skyong mdzad pho nya drug stobazhi:sa bdag chen mo sum sto rtsa gnyis dang : rigs 'dus mkha' 'gro 'bum phrag nyi shu dang : ma yamasabastan ma bcu gnyis la sogs te: pho nya yongs rdzogs dgra 'dul thugs dam can mi mjosgo dbyings nas gnas 'dir sku bskyod cig dam rdzas bdud rtsi 'bar ba 'di bzhes la thugs dam rgyud bskul bcol ba'i 'phrin las mdzod ho dpal gyi bka' sdod lha tsho gis thugs dam can khyed rnams la mchod pa 'bul ba ni sogs rigs 'gre/ tshogs tha ma'i lhan thabs ni gter gzhung bcosamed/ hūṃ/ chos kyi dbyings nas rang byung grub pa'i lha: khro bo rol pa'i dur khrod chen po nas shin tu mi bzad rab 'jigs skur stan pa dpal chen yongs rdzogs drag po'i 'phrin las mdzod // nga ni che mchog he ru ga sras dang sprul pa bya ba 'bum (13na) bka' sdod rab 'jigs pho nyar bcas:che mchog lha tshogs dus la bab g.yas kyi phyag na phur pa 'dril: g.yon gyi phyag na lcags kyus—63

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (25)'gugs: lcags kyus bzung la phur pas thob gnod byed dgra bgegs rdul du rlog: ྅/ nga ni badz+ra he ru da sras dang sprul pa man chad 'gre'o/ /hūṃ/ nga ni 'jam dpal gshin rje gshed lha/ nga ni rta mgrin pad+ma dbang : ྅/ nga ni rdo rje gzhon nu che: ྅/ nga ni bla med he ru da lha/ nga ni rigs 'dzin thod pa rtsal // nga ni dregs pa kun 'dul rje: ྅/ nga ni stobs ldan nag po che sras dang sprul pa la sogs 'gres su sbyor: drag sngags so lnga pa dang bcas te tshe lung khrus lung gi dgongs pas phur ba gdab khā+e)bo: ྅/ 9)che mchog 'khor bcas rol pa'i bro dgra bgegs dam sri'i srog la brdung : badz+ra he ru gas dgra bgegs dam sri'i snying la brdung : gshin rje gshed por dgra bgegs dam sri'i dpul bar brdung : rta mgrin dbang chenamo dgra bgegs dam sri'i mgrin par brdung :rdo rje gnyon nur dgra bgegs dam sri'i lte bar brdung : bla med he ru gar dgra bgegs dam sri'i gsang bar brdung : rigs 'dzin thod rtsal sko dgra bgegs dam sri'i spyi bor brdung : dregs pa kun 'dul mo dgra bgegs dam sri'i brla g.yasarki: stobs ldan nag por dgra bgegs dam sri'i brla g.yon mo zhi khro bka' brgyad mo g.yasasu bskor te dgra la brdung : dgra yang phye mar 'thag pa'i bro g.yon du bskor te bgegs la brdung :bgegs kyang dum bur gtub pa'i bro g.yas g.yon thabs dang shes rab bro ru tra dam sri thal bar rlog yo lo hūṃ (13ba〉spe sa bha ya 9 ) na naḥ tshe ṇa)'gugs dngos grub len pa/ sgrub khog las/ hūṃ/bde gshegs rgyal ba kun gyi thugs dam dang : sbyor lam tsho gos la ma gnas pa'i dam can tshogs:rnal 'byor bdag la sngon gyi thugs dam gyi tshe dang chos dang las bzhi myur sgrub dang : rkang mgyogasamig sman ril bu mkha' spyod dang : srid nor zas sogs mthu rtsal dngos grub stsol: a la la sngobadud rtsi 'thung / hūṃ/ chos sku mchog las kun 'byung longs spyod rdzogs 'gro don lhun grub sprul sku gcig gi ngang : ma bcos gnyis med sku gsum lhun gyis rdzogs mchog gi dngos grub bdag la stsal du gsol:—54

bka' brgyad gsang rdzogs kyilas bya lhan thabs dgong pa kun 'byung / nang ma (ka)bshags pa ni/sgrub khog las/ā+oṃ āḥ//rgyal ba zhi khro rdo rje slob dpon dang :bde gshegasayongs rdzogs srung ma dam tshig can:sku gsung gdung 'tshob rdo rje lcam dral mched:dbang gyur skyabs mchog ma lus dgongs su gsol bdag ni ma rig lus dang ngag sems kyis rdo rje slob dpon mched sogs ngan smras shing :yi dam sngags dang phyag rgya gsang ba bsgrags rtsa ba'i dam las 'gal gyur mthol zhing bshags shes bya lnga dang spyad par bya ba lnga mi spang lnga dang bsgrub pa bya rgyu lnga dang len lnga sogs yan lag dam tshig kun:nyams gyur rang gnong 'gyod pas mthol zhing bshags:sngags la the tshom bla med theg pa smad lta spyod ya bral bsnyen sgrub gzhung ma srongs long yod le los dus kyi mchod pa chag:sdom gsum thun mong dam nyams mthol zhing bshags rig pa'i rtsal chung snying po'i don ma rtogs sgom pa sran chudas gnas lugs so ma thub:blo yi 14na skobs chungasaspyod pa bogs ma thon legs bsam spyad kyang don log thugs 'gal bsags:gos bu yid smon gyur pa mthol zhing 'a)bshags ba po shis lhan thabs ni/gter gzhung bcos med/hūṃ/ma bcosaspros med byang chub snying por gsal:gdod nas ma skyes rang byung mtha' dbus bral kun khyab rnam dag lhun grub kun tu bzang :chos sku'i bkra shis dam pas bde legs shog rnam snang bkra shis chos dbyings ye shes sku bkra shis des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog:rdor sems bkra shis me long ye shes sku bkra shis mo rin 'byung bkra shis mnyam med ye shes sku ba po shis mo mtha' yas bkra shis kun rtog ye shes sku bkra shis mo:don grub bkra shis nan tan ye shes sku bkra shis mo lha/che mchog he ru yon to lhun grub dpal yid bzhin gter gyi ba po shis deng 'dir stsol:badz+ra he ru rang byung thugs kyi dpal skye med thugs kyi ba po shis deng 'dir stsol:'jam dpal gshin rje snang srid sku yi dpal 'gyur med sku yir dbang chen rta mgron chos sgo 'dus pa'i dpal 'gags med gsung gas rdo rje gzhon nu mthu stobs yongs rdzogs dpal 'phrin las thogs medamo bla med he ru ma mo 'dus pa'i dpal ma tsho gos las la 'khor ba'i sko rigs 'dzin gtso mchog

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (25)rgyud lung man ngag dpal shes rab gsum la mnga' brnyes bkra shis shog dregs pa kun 'dul bdud dpung 'joms pa'i dpal sdebargyad bran du 'khol ba'i ba po shis shog: (14ba tshe stobs ldan nag po snang srid srog bdag dpal dgra bgegs thal bar rlog pa'i ri zhi khro yongs rdzogs dposagrub rgya mtsho'i dpal bsnyen sgrub mtha' ru phyin pa'i ba po shis shog 'jam rol dang bcas me tog sil mas kun tu khyab par bya'o: zhi khro yongs rdzogs kha skong lhan thabs rnams/ /klu bdud sto ba'i zab gter dgongs don tshogs/ zhabrul med brgyud pa'i phyag len gsung rgyun bzhin/ za hor rig sngags yong bas yi ger bkod/ dge des bde gshegs zhi khro ma lus pa'i/ gsang gsum mi zad 'khor lo'i bang mdzod las/ mchog thun dngos grub 'dod dgu'i char chen pos/ skal bzang gdul bya'i re ba skong gyur cig /rang rig ngo bo ka dag kun tu bzang / /rang bzhin lhun grub zhi khro sgyu 'dra'i gar/ /thugs rje kun la khyab pa'i 'phrin las kyis/ /don gnyis yid bzhin 'grub pa'i bkra shisashog /ces bka' brgyad gsang rdzogs kyi las byang gter byon ma'i lhan thabs gter kha 'di nyid nas kha skong dgos pa la rjes 'jug 'ga' zhig gis ha cang mangs pa dang / dgos nges khungs ma chod pa'i 'khrul pa'i lam du 'phyan pa'i mtha' gnyis kyi skyon spangs te/ dpal skyon chen po'i dgongs pa gter ston gyi phyag len 'phyugs med zab chos kyi bka' babs mkhas grub shākya 'od sogs brgyud ldan dam pa'i gsung rgyun las 'ongs pa ltar/ mahā yo ga'i sgom khog ma gtogs pa'i gter gzhung gi tshig bcos lhad med par rang sor bzhag /sgom khog gi tshig lhug 'don mi bde ba rnams cung zad tshig sna ring du btang nas 'go mjug (15na tha sgrigs pa'i lhan thabs dgos pa kun tshang 'di ni bzhad pa rtsal gyis bkod pa'i yi ge pa ni 'jam dpal lo/ /sarba meg la kurba skyo/ /—56

zhi khro bka' brgyad gsang ba yongs rdzogs sgrub chen gyi reg ga 'khrul bral mthong bas re skong / nang ma zhanazhi khro bka' brgyad gsang ba yongs rdzogs sgrub chen gyi reg zig 'khrul bral mthong bas re skong bzhugs/badz+ra su ru pad+ma sirnyi hūṃ/ gsang rdzogs sgrub chen la sta gon bcu cig yod pa'i sa bcad gsum pa 'di thog mar yong bas/ khren dkon mchog spyi mchod btang bas de'i thog ma'i skyabs sems byed pa'i go chod/ 9)cha gsum rgyas pa'am yang na bsdus pa/ 9)tsha tsha gzhung ngam ma 'grub na spyi 'grosa'athus/ khre)chu gtor ram ma 'grub na gtor ma brgya rtsa yongs grags kyis 'thus ba mdzad/ gsung sgrog /bshags 'bum ni dri med bshags rgyud klog /byis ston bya/ sbyin sreg ni skabs 'dir mi mdzad/ phud ni 'grub na bde 'dus nas mchode pa phud stong mdzad/ ma 'grub na bsangs dang gser skyems kyis 'thus pa mdzad/ 'di yan la phyi bshags zer nyin dang po dpon slob tsho bgos nasamadzad/ 'di nyin las mi mdzad/sta gon gyi sa bcad dang po sa chog la sa brtag pa ni lto 'phye brtag myong ba'i gnas rnying par mi dgos/ 'on kyang sngar sto 'phye brtag ma myong ba'i khang pa lta bur lto 'phye nye skor gyi sa rjen par thig btab/ de nas brkos pa'i sa nang gi zhal ba'i steng du gtor/ 9)sa byang skol ba'i lag len tsho dang lhag tu gus pa de mdzad/ /mi snang bar blang ba la chab gtor (2na)9)nas len nam brgya rtsa gang rung / skyob pa sangs rgyas thams cad sogs blo ka gcig gi gsham du ji ltar sngon gyi dbang mdzad ltar sogs/ bum gter stegs bu bshig mi dgos pa'i rigs la dbus dang phyogs bzhin sba/ de min sgrub khang gi gyang ngam ri brag sogs gang 'os su sba/ bum pa'ang ma 'byor na gcig gis chogs bzung ba la sgrub khog tu gsal ba ltar phur pa gcig lag tu bzung ba ngag 'don zin pa'i mthar sa rjen pa la brgyag /zhal ba lta bu la phur gdan dgos/ sa sbyang ba ni sgrub khog ltar la mjug —57

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (25)tu las byang gi phyag rgya gar mchod byed/ grub na phur pa'i skabs kyi slob dpon phyogs bzhi nas zhu ba dang rtsa 'chams byas na shin tu legs/ sta gon gyi sa bcad gnyis ba stegs bu brtsigs nas/ las thig la byin rlabs ma byas par thig rtsa ltar yongs rdzogs brgyag /byin rlabs slar me thig 'og tu yod pa des 'thus/ der dri thig tshom bu bkod/ sta gon gyi sa bcad bzhi pa/ sgroms khri dang lding khri 'di dus mi mdzad par thig dang tshom bu'i steng du mañdzi lta bu'i khar ka khyo ra lta bu nas kyis bkang ba'i steng du bum thod rten dgu phur pa/ mar me sogs(2bsko1gsam log par kha yig ltar bkod nasamadzod/ mda' gri sogs sa bcad bzhi pa nas bshad pa'i sgrub rdzas mchod rdzas rnams lam tsam bsham zhing mda' sogs nyal stabs su 'jog pa las mi slong / phyogs bzhir las bum 'jog dgos pas mnal lam ltar rdo rje sems dpa'/ sgrub khog ltar rnam 'joms/ mnga' ris paṇa chen ba ched pa sme brtsegs dang bdud rtsi 'khyil pa yang bsnon pas bzhi ga bsgrubs pa legs/ slob dpon gyi dbang gi skabs bgegs bsang ba byed dgos byung tshe mchod g.yog gis rdor sems kyi bum pa len/ thog ma dang gung gnyis la slob mar khrus chu bum pa bzhi ga nas snod gcig tu bsres kyang yong /mi lcogs na bum pa bzhi ga khyer nas btang yang yong ngo / /sta gon gyi sa bcad lnga pa bgegs sgrod las byang sgrub khog gi gi bgegs sgrod ji lta ba me thun chu thun yungs kar gsil ma ging bas phur pa gdengs/ sgrogs/ nyin rjes ma tsho mi dang rdzas gsar pa phyi sgo nas sgrub khang du yong mkhan yod na ma gtogos/ nang mi yong bzhin par mi dgos/ sta gon gyi sa bcad drug pa slob ma khrus nas dbyung ba nyin dang por ma zad nyin star gung gnyis la byed/ sta gon gyi sa bcad bdun pa la/ maṇ+ḍal/ sngon 'gro'i chos skor/ sgrub khog gi dbu'i bcom ldan 'das zhi khro rab mas nas bzung ste/ rgyal ba dgongs brgyud/ rigs 'dzin brda brgyud/ mkha' 'gro gtad brgyud/ grub thob rnal 'byor brgyud yan song rjes/ dbang bum nas/ dang po dbang gi chu bo rgyun ma chad pa'i babs so bstan pa ni zhes pa nas/ rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang sgo bi ma la la phye nas bskur ro'i —58—

zhi khro bka' brgyad gsang ba yong rdzogs sgrub chen kyi reg zig 'khrul bral mthong bas re skong / nang ma (ka)bar/ de nas sgrub khog nas/ gang zag snyan khung brgyud pa'i nyams len skor dgu po dang bcas zhusaso yan gyi rjes la/ (3na rko bang bum nas phyi ma'i dus su yang zhes sogs kyi lung bstan tshang bar byed/ de nas yang sgrub khog nas/ don drug pa rtsom pa po'i rnam thar nas bzung ste phun sum tsho gis pa bdun gyis sgrub chen gyi gzhi gzung ngo'i bar shar mar byed/ dbang zhu ba tshor dal 'byor rnyed dka'/'chi ba mi rtag pa/ 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs/ las rgyu gos rnams lod/ 'di skor a ti'i don 'khrid ltar bshad na legs/ sgrub khog gi skyabs sems 'bogs/ mchod pa rnam lnga bsham/ sta gon gyi sa bcad bdun pa'i yan lag bcu pa'i rjes zlos dang bcas dpon slob lhan cig tu mchod pa de phul/ rdor sems kyi sgom bzlas phog /lha sta gon dang bsnyen pa kha gso ba'i ring dmigs pa bsgom pa dang yig brgya 'dren no/ /sta gon gyi sa bcad brgyad pa lha sta gon las gzhung bsrang / sta gon gyi sa bcad dgu pa bsnyen pa kha gso na lha sta gon dang sbrel nas byed/ sa bcad brgyad dgu'i skor du bum pa sgrub srol 'dug kyang dkyil 'khor 'dri ba'i skabs bsgrub pa 'jug pa bde zhing legs/ sta gon gyi sa bcad bcu pa slob ma 'jug pa'i cho ga ni zhes pa nas/ lhag par gnas pa tshul bzhin bya bo'i bar/ de nasas bcad de ga'i skyabs su 'gro zhing sdig pa bshags su gzhug pa nas/ rang byung mtha' bral stong gsal bsgom gyi bar/ de nas sa bcad de ga'i so shing nas bzung / rmi lam brtag pa'i bar gyi mjug tu nus pa'i dbang lnga bskur ba'i lugs yod pa mang yang skabs 'dir de'i tshab la dbang rgyun mi chad pa dang bde 'dus dang yang mthun khyad nas mgyogs dbang bum pa'i rgya can sta gon gyi dkyil 'khor la brten nas dbang bskur kyang 'gal ba med/ de nas sa bcad bcu pa de ga'i/ ho (3ba)bla ma slob dpon dgongs su gsol nas/ ā+oṃ āX/ gi bar dang / zhi ba dril sgrub/ khro bo dril sgrub thub na legs kyang / da lta 'jug pa bde ba/ dpal chen dril sgrub kyi lung phab sngags 'dren 'jug pa mdzad/yang rigs gsum mgon po lta bu lha gzhan la mos na yang de ga'i sgom lung byas chog go /—dam

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (25)sta gon gyi sa bcad bcu gcig pas sta gon gyi lha nam mkhar bteg /rmi lam brtags ngan na sbyin sreg bya/ dngos gzhi la sa bcad so brgyad yod pa'i dang po rgyal chen la mngon rtogs bskyed pa/'phrin las 'chol ba sogs gsang rdzogs gzhung na med pa tsho bde 'dus dang sa phur rtogs sla nas gang legs kha skong / rgyal mtho bsdams nas nang du yong zhen da' slob byings kyis dam sgriganon cing /las kyi slob dpon zhig gis sgrub khang thog tu mnal lam rta dkar ma nas bshad pa'i brgya byin sogs kyi rta bsdom/ la dngos gzhi'i sa bcad gnyis pa/ dam sri'i liṅga bya mchu can bris pa dong zur gsum gyi nang du kha yar bstan bzhag /bskyed dgug phur thun tshom bskul tshogs las ltar byas nas liṅga kha mar sbub/ thun dgu po rgyag srol yod 'dug kyang ka dpe ma ma byas kyang 'thus/ dam sri bya ba'i las ngan 'di sogs kyi tshig nga bstun thun brgyag /ri rab brjid pa'i 'og tu mnan gyi dus ri rab gling bzhis mnan/ de nas sa re g.yog pa dang rdo rje'i ri mo 'dri ba'am/ yang na g.yam pa bcu la rdo rje rgya gram bris pas/ gcig ni brjed mad nyag gcig rgya sogs dang bstun nas gnon bro brdung / dngos gzhi'i sa bcad gsum ba sgo byang ni/ dam sri mnan tshur lam sgrub khang gi phyi sgo'i ya them la ra sog phur pa gshin rje'i sku btags/ shog byang la gsang chen lhun grub ma bris pa sgo la sbyor ram 'dogs/ lha bskyed mchod bstod kha 'geng dang bcas bya/ de nas nang du byon sgo bcad(4na tha dud rtsi 'khyil pa lug sog phur pa ya them dang sgo la khro rgyal bdud rtsi sogs shog bur bris pa sbyor/ mchod gtor 'phrin las bcol/dngos gzhi'i sa bcad bzhi pa ma tre la dkyus ltar la/ gnyis med ral gyis sgo dbye ba'i tshe gris sto ba gshog /de nas slob dpon gyis mchan bu ltar/ snying shar dur khrod bsil ba'i tshal sogs kyi tshig dang bstun snying sogs phyogs su bskyur/ de'i ring dmangs ma sim me sdod/ rdo rje'i 'gros yan song nas bde 'dus kyi bsnyen sgrub pra khrid kyi ru tra'i lo rgyus kyi lung mdzad/ de nas maX nang mtshams kyi phur pa dkyil 'khor 'dri sar/ gdab/ de slar dkyil 'khor gyi mthar 'god/ dngos gzhi'i sa bcad lnga pa ni slob dpon gyis ting nge 'dzin tsam gyis so/ /snang srid snod bas stong par brlab/ khang pa gzhal —60

zhi khro brka' brgyad gsang ba yongs rdzogs sgrub chen gyi reg zig gzul bral mthong bas re skong / nang ma (ka)yas khang du brlab/ bdud rnams lhar brlab mchod rdzas brlab/ sbyor sgrol brlab pa'i don no/ /dngos gzhi'i sa gcad drug pa sman mchod kyi ka pā la 'khyer nas thor yab kyis gdab/ dngos gzhi'i sa bcad bdun pa thig skud sna lnga bsgril zin pa gzung ma 'am las kyi rdo rje'i lag g.yon gyi thig sne bzung ba'i sor mo rnams spyi bor gtad/ de bzhin du slob dpon gyis kyang byas nas las byang mkha' gsang byin rlabs kyi sngags brjod/ mtshan ldan bkra shis sogs kyi mjug tu gnam thig 'og nas gsum 'debs/ shar nub ma gtogos gzhan mi 'dengs/ snying gar theb nas bar thig kyang gong 'dra tshig bde chen spros bral ma/ dpon slob gnyis kas sngar gyi las thig btab pa'i thig steng du/dur khrod gsang ba sogs kyis shar nub kyi tshang thig steng du gsum gdab spang bya sogs spyi dang 'dra/thig skud byin rlabs mkha' gsang byin rlabs (4ba)kyis 'thus kyang rigs lnga'i byin rlabs byas pa legs/ dngos gzhi'i sa bcad brgyad pa tshon 'gyed pa phur shul du tshon sdugs pa ni dkyil 'khor gyi sgo ru thig 'debs dus dkyil du phur pa btsugs nas de'i skyong mor sdugs rgyu red kyang da lta phur pa mi 'dzugs pas dkyil du tshon rim brtsegs kyi rten 'brel tshon byed las mi byed/ tshon bra brtag pa brtag byang bkol ba nas len/ bris zin phral gzhal yas don bstod byed/ dbang bum gyi bum pa'i chas nas rdzas sdug cing so so'i sngags brgya tsam bzlas nas bsgrub/ bum par bskyed chog mi byed dbu rgyan rigs lnga bum pa'i khar bsdam/ dngos gzhi'i sa bcad dgu pa rgyan 'god gzhung ltar ro/ /che mchog thod sku'i kha khyer la dpal dgu'i snying po byung na bri lha'i dbu ltag pa'i phyogs la gtod/thog ma nas sman cung zad sdugs/ dar gyi na bza' gsum rim la dar khang du ming btags/ sku rten tsaka li 'god pa'i chos dbyings skye ba med pa'i ngang nyid la sogs kyis dbang tsaka min pa'i zhi ba zhe gnyis khro bo rnams kyi sku sman bla'i pho brang ltar 'god/ rab tu gtso phur dgu sras rigs bzhi rnams la zhal yod ba lha gnas su 'god/ gdab phur rgya mdud ma brgya dang brgyad po thod ra gru bzhi'i phyi sgo'i khyams rtsig pa ngos skab/nang gi khyams la 'god/ khyams de gar gdab phur brgya dang brgyad kyi phyi 61—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (25)rol du sgo ba yab yum brgyad la phur pa brgyad/ gnyis gnyis 'god pa zhal yod pa 'god/ dbang phyug dang bstan ma'i rtsangs nyer brgyad dang bcu gnyis la so so'i sngags kyang sngags byang skor lde'i rgya can nas bris pa srin mo 'gros su dur khrod kyi mtha'i lcags ri nag por 'god pa 'di ga phyag len yin/ bde 'dus ltar bka' so sor sgo rdzogs byed na gdab phur bgo sha rgyag lugs sgrub khog na gsal po yod/ thun phur gang (5na〉der 'jog /thod pa'i nang du bzhugs rgyu'i bka' dgu'i tsaka li dang snying po'i sngags bcu gcig po chung ngu bris nas gzhug shel la a bris pa sogs dgos/'og tu phur pa/ de steng mar me/ de steng thod dgu rten dgu/ de steng bum bzhi/ rgyan bkod la rjes slosamadzad kyi yod 'dug /sa bcad 'og gi bco lnga pa yar blangs nas lha brkos la gdab pa'i don nam mkhar bteg pa'i lha mar phab gral la 'god pa yin/ sta gon gyi sa bcad bcu pa slob ma 'jug pa'i a khaṃ shrī ra hūṃ gis mig dar bcing / phu bī ra hūṃ gis me rta ge gtod/ tsho gis kyi dkyil 'khor chen po ru nas/ dbang chen rab mchog bskur du gsol gyi bar/ de nas las byang brda sgo dbye/ brda phyag 'tshal/ skyabs sems phog /thugs rjes bzung ba/ 'khor ba'i sems can thams cad kun sogs kyis nang du 'khrid/de rjes dkyil 'khor la bskor ba gsum byas/ me tog dor ba'i stang ka bya/ slob dpon gyis me tog spyi bor bcing / ye shes dbab pa bde gshegs 'dus pa'i byin 'bebs chen mo len/ spyan dbye/ mahā yo ga'i sgom khog nas gzhal yas khang dang bcas pa'i don rtags ngo sprod/ slob dpon gyis sku gsung thugs kyi dam tshig ni zhes sogs gsung / de nas dam tshig ston pa rgyud kyi le'u bcu gcig pa'i 'dir mdzad/ slob bus rdo rje slob dpon bka' drin che sogs kyi rjes zlos byed/ de nas dngos gzhi'i sa bcad bcu gcig pa sre mnan ni/ rgyu lam 'bras bu sogs la rjes zlos/ ji snyed sangs rgyas sogasakyi dam ma 'dres pa'i gsar pa tshor bdud rtsi sbyin/ rnam dag lta spyod sogs kyis rnying pa dam 'dres zin pa tshor sbyin/ 'di nas gral 'dzin byed/ de nas (5ba)'a)dus dbang lnga bskur/ yang na mgyogs—62

zhi khro bka' brgyad gsang g.yongs rdzogs sgrub chen gyi reg zig 'brul bral mthong ba re skong / nang ma zhanadabang gi tshab la bskur/dngos gzhi'i sa bcad bcu gnyis pa slob dpon dang rgyal tshab gnyis la chas ldan du 'bul/yum chas bu mo med na thig sna 'dzin/sman brdung mi la 'bul/ging chas nyul le sgrod mi la 'bul dmangs mar mi mdzad/dngos gzhi'i sa bcad bcu gsum pa mnga' gsol la ma da na ka pā la gang khyer slob dpon gyi phyag tu phul nas thur mgos gsol gral pa kun la'ang tshig dang bstun thur mgo re 'gyed/tshig ni slob dpon gyi rjes zlos kun gyis byed/'dren mkhan las kyi rdo rjes byed/dngos gzhi'i sa bcad bcu bzhi pa/sman sgrub byed na 'di nas bzung sman sgrub khrol bu zhag gsum gyi bar khro bo'i dkyil 'khor ma grub par zhi ba'i dkyil 'khor sman sgrub kyi nyin spo tshul yod pa des 'thus/de grub nas bka' brgyad las gzhung bsrangs te phye ma sgrub pa yin/sman sgrub mi byed par dbang rkyang bskur tshe/che mchog gi rten thod du sman cung zad blug/de nyin sgrub mi dgosasang sgrub pa'i las gzhung bsrangs nas/'dzab kyi dus sman la dmigs nas zhi ba dang khro bo'i dmigasapa dang sngags bzla ba cung zad byed pa yin no/dngos gzhi'i sa bcad bcu drug nas nyer gnyis kyi bar man ngag las bdun tshar gcig byed pa dpon slob thams cad kyi lhan cig tu'am/blor zin pa dang dpe cha ma 'byor na rjes zlos yin/bcu dgu pa'i dam bca' la/9)dam bca' bcu gnyis pa bsnan srol kyang yod cing la las mi mdzad mod/thog mtha' la dam bca' bcu gnyis pa byas rgyun du ma byas kyang 'tsham pa 'dra/byin 'bebs la tshig bdun gsol 'debs dang /stong gsum stong gi steng du dur khrod brgyad kyi byin 'bebs mdzad/dngos gzhi'i sa bcad nyer gsum pa 'phrul 'khor 6nabarlab pa dang de'i mjug gi dge sbyor la bskul ba mdzad/sman sgrub yod na 'di nyin nas nyin gsum gyi bar zhi ba'i dkyil 'khor la brten nas sngags rgyun 'dzin dgos pa gong du bshad pa ltar ro//dngos gzhi'i sa bcad nyer bzhi pa la sman sgrub mi byed tshe sang thegs las byang gzhung bsrangs nas gyer te dkyil 'khor sgrub 'dzab nas sngags rgyun byed/nyin gsum gyi bar bum pa la gzungasabatags nas dbang bum gyis bum pa'i bskyed choX byas/bka' so so'i sngags gsham du bum dbang

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (25)nas gsungs pa'i bum sgrub kyi sham bu sbyar nas nyin gsum so so'i dmigs pa yang bsgyur nas rang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bor bzhugs pa'i mdun du bum ba bskyed/ sman sgrub yod na nyin gnyis gsum tsam khrol bur sgrub ring bka' brgyad kyi las byang dngos gzhi ma gtong bas bum pa mi sgrub/ phye mar bsgrub pa nas bzung zhag gsum gyi bar thun pa khag gcig gis sman sgrub dang khag gcig gis bum pa bsgrub dgos/ zhag grangs dpe tsam yin/ dngos gzhi rgyun ring thung tsam byed la rag lus/ dper na bum pa bsgrubs zin nas dbang la zhag grangs drug tsam byed na pra khrid kyi dgongs dmigs dang bcas zhag gnyis la bsnyen pa/ zhag gnyis la sgrub pa/ zhag gcig la sgrub pa chen po/ zhag gzhig la las sbyor gyi dmigs pa dang sbrags nas sgrol dbang dang 'grig rtsis mdzad/ zhi khro gang gi yang sgrub pa tshugs nas bzung man ngag las bdun nyin star byed/ 'khrul 'khor brlab pa/ dge sbyor bskul ba tsha rting ngam dgongs ja lta bu skabs gang 'grig la nyin re tshar re mdzad/ las byang rab dus bzhi ma grub na dus gsum byed/ dngos gzhi'i sa bcad nyer lnga pa nyul le ni/ dus so sor (6bakhi shasakyis ging dang bcas skrod/ dpon slob thams cad kyi dgongs star srod la kun thub rgyal mo bskul nas skrod do/ /dngos gzhi'i sa bcad nyer drug pa rgyun gyi dngos grub las byang kha stong ltar byed pa las byang tshogs 'khor dang bcas byed pa'i dgongs thun la 'grig ba yongs/ dngos gzhi'i sa bcad nyer bdun pa dang nyer brgyad pa gnyis la khrigs byed rgyu med/ dngos gzhi'i sa bcad nyer dgu pa dbang bskur ba la dbang bum nas/ spyi don gnyis pa dbang gi chu ngo bo zer rgyu yin/bo gang zhe na zhes sogs dang cod pan gyi dbang bskur/ gong du 'jug pa'i dus kyang me tog dor ba dang 'phyi ba byung rung 'dir byed srol yod pa ka 'o ra 'brus bkang bar dpal dgu'i tsakli sgor mor bkram nas der dor/ de nas dbang bum las/ rgyu ngan pha ma'i khu khrag la sogs kyis lhar bskyed do/ /yungs kar tsam dkar shar shar sogs kyis byin 'bebs/ slob ma rig pa'i dbang lnga gar che mchog tu bskyed pas rigs kun —64—

zhi khro bka' brgyad gsang ba yongs rdzogs sgrub chen gyi reg zig zhagrul bral mthong bas re skong / nang ma (ka)gyi khyab bdag yin pas legs/ dbang rdzas ni gsar ma ba tsho yang lha de dang de 'od du zhu ba'i rdzas kyi rnam par byed bas/ 'dir yang lha de'i ngo bor mos pas khyab bo de yang bum pa bzang bo sogs kyi mjug tu/ zhes brjod pas gong gi yig 'bru lnga zhes pa gong gi rgyu ngan pha ma'i khu khrag sogs kyi nang du slob bu'i gtsug tu ā+oṃ āḥ& hrī hā lnga yin no/ /thal mo bkan pa'i phyag rgya ni g.yas kyi sor mo lnga rigs lnga yab/ g.yon sor lnga yum du gsal ba'i dbang du btang nas sor mo lnga rtse bsnol ba'i phyag rgya mgo bo'i gnas lngar gtug /bum chu spyi bor blug zer bar ku shas sdugs/ bum chus dbang bskur byang chub sems sogs kyis bum chu ster/ de'i rjes ma gnyis la bum pa mgor 'jog /bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun dag (7na)pas dbang bskur ba sogs kyis kyang bum chu ster/ 'di man tshang ma bum pa rang mgor 'jog /gral phyi nang mang po yod na gral re la bum pa gnyis re bskor/ gral gcig las med na yang dag dang gshin rje'i bum pa bskor rjes/ rta mgrin dang phur pa'i bum pa bskor ba sogs brgyad ka bskor ro/ /bum skor mgor mi 'jog lag par 'jog /de nas sku gsung thugs dbang yan song ba'i rjes su sgrub khog gi sgrub pa lung dbang gi thugs kyi dbang chen yongs rdzogs gyur gyi bar gnang / de nas dbang bum gyi ye shes lnga dang / rab gnas/ mnga' gsol/ de nas dregs pa'i srog dbang
