bskur ba la/ thog mar sde dpon sum cu gsol ba la/ gtor ma bang rim bzhi pa/ dang po dbang phyug dang mdun du u ma'i gtor ma/g.yas g.yon du mar me/ bang rim gnyis pa'i logs bzhin gtor ma re/ bang rim gsum pa'i logasabazhir gtor ma gnyis re/ bzhi pa'i logs rer gtor ma bzhi re ste/ gtor ma sum cu po zur gsum sha khrag mtheb skyus brgyan pa/ sman rag gsham/ drag sngags so lnga pa nas mā ra ya rbad kyi bar yonanang ji lta ba la/ mahā de wa e/ u ma de bā e/ ya ma rā tsa ya/ ya ma da rnyi ya/ ma ma ru lu ma/ e /dzati thog /du phrag du/ du rnying du/ rā tsa tsa/ ging gar tri/ badz+ra sa tu ti/ rā hu la pa/ rag ra/ ra smo ra/ yak+ṣa k+ṣa/ yaklo k+ṣa/ mahā kā la k+ṣi/ ru tra dhi/ mu na mu na pa/ ti ra ti /tha/ de wa a/ a rtse la a/ tiṣ+ṭha dri tī —65

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo r+sāng rgya mtsho gsung 'bum/ (25)tsa a bi shu spu/tri pa sha litri/ lha she tri/ byi na ya /u/ na kyi ni me/ nā ga phuḥ nā ga kro ti shāri phu sarba du cho hring hring dza dzas spyan drangs/ thod par tsa gli bkram par bstim/ rang che mchog tu gsal ba'i mdun du sngags bdag rnams rang gzugs mtsho ni cha thogs par bskyed/ raṃ yaṃ kho/ oṃ āḥ& (7ba)gis ri rab 'dod yon sna tsho gos su bsam/ sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung bar zhal bzhes pa/ /dbang phyug che sogs lha srin sdo brgyad la/ /rnam dag bdud rtsi'i dam rdzas mnyes mchod 'bul/ /mthu rtsal drag po'i dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /'dod yon rgyan gyis brgyan pa'i gtor ma dang / /las ga nyamasapa bsgral ba'i rak+ta dang / /dug gsum rnam dag sha khrag rus pa'i tshogs/ /dregs pa'i 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la 'bul/ /dgra bo gdug pa bsgral phyir bzhes su gsol/ /lha srin sdebargyad khyed rnamasamachod pa'i dam rdzas ni/ /dkar dmar la sogs kha dog bye brag rnams/ /lha srin sdebargyad sku la mchod par 'bul/ /snyan dang mi snyan sgra yi bye brag rnams/ /lha srin sdebargyad gsung lamachode par 'bul /tsit+ta smug po dzo ltar spungs pa yang / /lha srin sdebargyad thugs la mo/ /sku gsung thugs kyi mchod pa 'di bzhes la/ /sgrol ging pho mos las rnams grub par mdzod/ /lha srin sdebargyad 'dir spyon sha la spyon/ /dam nyams dgra bo'i sha 'di zan pasazhim/ /lha srin sdebargyad 'dir spyon khrag la spyon/ /dam nyamasadagra bo'i khrag ni chang bas zhim/ /lha srin sdo brgyad 'dir spyon rus la spyon/ /dam nyams dgra bo'i rus ni mar bas zhim/ /lha srin sdebargyad rnams la dug gsum mchod par 'bul/ /dug gsum bzhes la dgra bgegs bsgral du gsol/ /oṃ mahā de wa e mahā ba li ta khā hi/ mahā pañtsa za/ mahā rak+tas 'og ma kun la 'gre/ ā+oṃ āḥ& sam ya a mṛ ta khā hi/ ho snying nye bran pho bran mo'i tsho gos nas/ rnal 'byor sku dgra khyed kyis sgrol ba'i bar dbang bum nas len/ /pho nya sgos bskul nas/ hūṃ/ bkra shisadam ldan mthu che ba/ /snang srid dregs pa'i sde dpon bzhengs/ /dbang phyug mahā de wa (8na rkong / /bas mo u ma de wa bgos/ /zhes pa'i mjug gi tshig sa zad bsgyur nas/ 'dod yon ma rdzo gtor 'di bzhes la/ /bcol ba'i 'phrin las sgrub par mdzod/ /des gzhan tsho la'ang 'don pa bsgyur/ gong —616

zhi khro bka' brgyad gsang ba yong rdzogs sgrub gyi reg zig ga khyul bral mthong bas re skong / nang ma (ka)gi bkra shis dam ldan gyi tshig rkang gcig po yang thol yin/ man tu rgyas par byed na dregs pa'i sde dpon gyi las byang chen mo'i ma lcogs na gong gi khosko pas su la byang byu tsho/mjug gi bskul skul 'di shin tu gas no/byed/ deng sang 'di yan song nas slar tsakli la sdebargyad bstim pa 'dug kyang gong ma 'gre(spru chags/ dregs pa'i srog sngags bzla ba nas/ rnal 'byor sku dgra khyed kyis sgrol gyi bar/ bla ma'i 'phreng ba dregs pa'i chos skor tsa gli tshad ma'am gang mos pa de'i sku rnams lag tu gtod cing e ma rigs mchogo nas/ de phyir thub dbang gces par bzung gi bar brjod 9)pa'i nang gi khyim gsum tshang bar klog /dpal mgon ma ning gi tsakli de gong gi dregs pa sde brgyad kun 'dus su bsamasanas/ dregs pa'i srog dbang chog sgril gyi dbang / de rjes zhal gdams kyi dbang / de rjes slob nusapa'i dbang brgyad dang me dbang bskur/ dbang dum gyi 'phrin las sbyor nus pa'i dbang de 'og tu sgrol dbang dang bstun 'og tu byed pa'i lugs ltar na/ bka' rab 'byams nus pa dbyangs gsal gyi dbang yig 'bru spyi por bstim pa'i mthar snying gar pad 'dab la yig 'bru gsal ba de ga dag tu sbyong / sgrub pa lung dbang gi rtags gdab pa nas zhabs rjes bar 'dir byas na yong / yang dkyus de gar yang rung ngo / /rgyal srid sna bdun nas rigs brgyud kyi dbang gi bar bskur/ 9) bum dbang gi tha rams brjod ma hā'i sgom khog bshad/ gsang dbang gi yum dang slob ma sbyong ba'i dmigs(8ba)pa byed pa dang dngos dbang yin kyang ye shes kyi phyag rgyar brten nas byed/ de rjes maṇ+ḍal gsol gdab man gzhung ltar/ gsang dbang gi tha rams/ a nu'i sgom khog bshad/ shes rab ye shes la/ maṇ+ḍal/byin 'bebs/ las byang gi phyag /gzung mar me tog dor dkyus ltar bskur/ tha rams/ chags lam gyi khrid lung byed/ lta ba spyi stims kyi dbang / spyi rgyal thabs blug gi dbang / tha rams/ a ti'i sgom khog bshad/ rgyud lung man ngag thams cad rdzogs pa'i rtsal dbang / dngos gzhi'i sa bcad sum cu pa bro ni rdo rje lu gu brgyud du sbrel/ rkang pa yang phyi nang du spo res dang bcas bskor cing blo 'don na ma rjes zlos gang rung / dngos gzhi'i sa bcad sogacig pa bshags pa/ dngos gzhi'i sa bcad soganyis —67

rgyal dbang lnga pa pag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()pa dngos grub blang ba ni/dbang yongs rdzogs bskur na smos ma dgos/sgrub pa lung dbang tsam/sgrub khog gi khog phug phyin byed dgos pas na dbang rdzas tshe dngos grub kyi rdzas su mi byed par/dngosagrub kyi rdzas gsar pa sgrub khog ltar sta gon byas na dkyil 'khor mdun du bsham/bgegs sgrod/byin 'bebs/byin rlabs sogs bde gshegs 'dus pa ltar bya/mdun du khrag gi snod ka pā la dang /chang bdud rtsi bsres pa'i ka pā la bsham/tshig ris la rak+ta rang gtso che ba 'dra 'dug kyang /khamasagasum 'od du zhu tshig de rak+ta dang /sangs rgyas kyi byang sems kyi tshig chang la sbyar/de 'og gi tshig thams cad la rak+ta 'thor ba lce thog gnas gsum reg pa'i skabs chang yang tshig de gas tsos pa byed rgyu yin/dngos gzhi'i sa bcad so gsum pa dbogs chog gnad 'bebs da lta ni ye mi mdzad/ltas bzang po ma byung na byed rgyu yin/de'i bdud rtsi bum gcig zer ba che mchog gi sku rten thod pa'o//dngos gzhi'i sa9na ) bcad so bzhi pa ba po shis dkyus ltar/sgo lnga pa ni lung bstan ni tshar gcig gsung ba de ga'o//so drug pa ni btang snyoms su 'jog go/de yang gzhung gi dgongs pa ltar na bsnyen pa/sgrub pa/sgrub pa r+ṣa po gsum po song nas dbang bskur rgyu yin 'dug kyang /da lta ha cang 'gor ches dogasabasnyen sgrub sgrub chen gsum dang dbang bskur zhag grangs 'tsham par gsang dbang la a nu/sher dbang la rtsa rlung /rtsal dbang la a ti'i dmigs pa bsgyur ba ma gtoges sngags rgyun sbrags nas mdzad pas/sgrub pa wo po sgob dang dngos grub len pa yid ces 'di ltar mdzad nas der rjes sgrol dbang mdzad/yang lugs gcig la/rtsa rlung gi dbang gi rjes su sgrol dbang gnang /de nas dbyangs gsal nas gto rgya'i bar shar ma/de rjes dngos grub kyi skor mdzad pa'ang yod/de ltar mdzad tshe rtsa lung yan la sgrub pa chen po yan song ba byas nas/de rjes las sbyor byas nas bsgral dbang bskur bas /de man la sngags rgyun mdzad thebs med pas dngos grub blang ba'i bar la sngags rgyun med par dogs pa cung zad 'dug/bsgral dbang la/'diX lo bris pa zan ling go steng du 'jog pa sgrub khog

zhi khro bka' brgyad gsang ba yongs rdzogs sgrub chen gyi reg zig 'khrul bral mthong bas re skong / nang ma (ka)nas bshad/ la la 'brub khung du 'khor lo 'ding de steng zan ling 'jog /phal cher 'bor lo mi 'dri ba mang / gang ltar hom khung / 'khor lo/ ling ga sogs bsham/ sgrub khog gi dmigs pa kha bsgyur lugs dang drag sngags so lnga pa 'dren/ las byang gi mjug tu spyi bskul sgos bskul btang nas dgra bgegs 'gugs/ dgug gzhug tshad ldan gyis bkug kyang yong ba 'dra snyam/ dbang bskur nyin rgyal ba spyi bskul nas dgug gzhug gi bar khro rol ji lta ba la drag sngags so lnga pa'i sham bu rje tri sogs sgrub khog ltar/ (9bsda rjes nyams gnad gdams kyi/ /dam nyams dgra bo sdig can la/ /'go bar byed pa'i lha khyod nyon sogs dang / sgrub khog gi sngags brjod/ byug bdug brab gsum byed/ dbang bum gyi bskur tshig /dpal r+pā yongs rdzogs sogs nas smon lam gyi bar brjod/ slob mar phur pa/gtso bo gcig la gtod/ gtso phur gzhan bud med min pa kun la gang 'dengs gtod/ slob ma gsum bzhi la med tshe gtso phur nas gdab phur/ brgya dang brgyad sogs tshang ma rgyag dgos pas phur pa lag tu bzung bcug /tshe khrus kyi dmigs pa sprod/ gtso phur snying gar btab nas rnam shes spar/ slar gnas so sor sngags ring so so dang bcas 'debs 'jug /da lta ni drag sngags so lnga pas go gcod pa mang / phur pa bsdus nas thun kyang brgyag /de nas dbang bum nas dam tshig bsgrag /dbang thob pa'i phan yon/ yon phul nas dbang rtags 'dogs pa byed/ de rjes gtad rgya'i dbang la/ nga ni che mchog he ru ka sogs la rjes zlos/ kye ho bu mchog sogs bla mas gsung / dngos gzhi'i sa bcad so brgyad pa zhi rgyas dbang drag gi sbyin sreg 'grub na gong gi lid+ma'i stod bstab pa dang smad drag po'i sreg rdzas dang mnan pa byed/ mjug chog gi sa bcad dang po bzhag nas khro rol mi byed na sgrub gtor gyi lha rang la bsdus gtore ma nas gter sped la cung zad 'jog /gser skyems dang sgo dbye nas gtor ma dpag tsho gos lhag dang bcas byin gyis brlabs tshogis lhag btang / chad mtho btang nas go gsar pa sngon du byas gtore ma bskul/ phyi rol du dpang gzug /chos kyi dbyings na rang byung grub pa'i lha sogs dang /nga ni khro rgyal kun gyi rje sogs kyis dpung bskyed/ snang ba'i dgra (10ji gegs dam sri 'di sogs —69

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()kyis zor 'phen/bstan ma bskyang /phyi rnyogs/bro/tshe 'gugs/gter sped la stegs bu yod na de'i phyogs la sped/med na khang pa'i phyogs la sped/bla'i gtang rag/mar me'i smon lam dkyil 'khor la gtang rag/bshags pa/dkyil 'khor bsdu lus bsrung /mched lcam nang bshags/ba po shis/mtho grol lo//zhes zhi khro bka' brgyad gsang ba yongs rdzogs sgrub chen gyi reg gzig 'khrul bral mthong bas re skong 'di'ang za sto gyi bzhes bris//sarba maṅga lo////nyang lugs drag po bde gshegs 'dus pa'i rgyun khyer rigs 'dzin brgyud pa'i zhal lung bzhugs/sangs rgyas kun 'dus pad+ma thod phreng gi/thugs sgrub zab pa'i mthar thug mnga' bdag ga kho/zhan tu khyer bde'i rnal wor yi ngu'i rdzo/'dri bar mkha' 'gro ga kho srung gnang ba stsol//skyabs sems ni/brgyud pa'i rtsab bla ma rje dngos grub 'byung ba'i yi dam lha legs par byin brlab mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rtsa ba gsum la skyabs su mchi:bdag gzhan gnyis med don phyir du drag bo khro rgyal kun bsgrubs nas:snying po bla med mchos pa dang //gas don dbyer med sems bskyed do:tshogs zhing ni/dbang drag pad+ma'i lha tsho gos spyan 'dren gshegs//nyi zla pad+ma'i gdan la bzhugs su gsol//gus pas phyag 'tshal phyi nang gsang mchod 'bul//nyes bshags dug gsum 'dul la rjes yi rang //mya ga mi 'da' chos 'khor bskor bar bskul//dge ba 'di yis byang chub mchog thob shog/dngos gzhi ni/lha tsho gos thim pas rang lus 'od du zhu//rang semasa3 las 'od dmar dpagamed spros//sems ro la phog bde gshegs mchode pas mnyes//dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma bskul//tshur 'dus gzi na skon mas cha'i tshogs spros pas//gdon bgegs tshar bcad dregs las la bkol//slar 'dus raṃ 'phros dur khrod 'bar ba'i dbus//ke las thod mkhar zlum dbus

nyang lugs drag po bde gshegs 'dus pa'i rgyun khyer rig 'dzin brgyud pa'i zhal lung /nang ma (ka)bad zla'i gdan//de steng hūṃ las sa bon rim 'phros pas//'byung bzhi rim brtsegs rus ri wo steg/thod pa skams las grub gzhal yas khang /khru bzhi sgo bzhi dur khrod rgyan gyis brjid//slar yang 'od zer ser dmar tshogs 'phros pas//gser me'i 'khor lo g.yas g.yon drag tu 'khor//dbal las lcags bsregs sdig pa'i tsha tsha 'phro//phyi rol rdo rje'i gur khang me dpung dang //khyung dmar khro bo bu yug lta bur 'tshub//gzhal yas dbus su paṃ las pad+ma dang //a las zla ba ma lasanyi dkyil steng //rang rig hūṃ dmar 'od du zhu ba las//bde gshegs 'dus pa pad+ma drag po dmar//zhal bgrad mtshe gcigs spyan gsum sdang mig gzigs//dbu skra phyed brjes thod skam lnga yis brgyan//ag tshom dmar ser phyag g.yas rtse dgu pa'i//gser rdor hūṃ raṃ dgus mtshan me 'bar 'phyar//g.yon pa sdigs mdzub rtse las lcags sregs kyi//'jigs rung sdig pa kha dgu mig 2ba ji gu 'gyed//stag sham zhing lngags rked bcings glang lpags kyis//stod g.yogs rigs bzhi'i klu yisayan lag dkris//byug pa'i rdzas gsum rin cen rus pa dang //thod tho lnga 'tshe o gyis sgo tu spras//brjid gtul rngam khro khams gsum dbang du sa//srid gsum zil gnon g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang gis/khregs pa'i steng bzhugs ba spu'i bu ga nas//gser rdor ra dbar tsha tsha chil chil khol//dung khang ser po g.yas ra la sridang g.yon gis mdzub/'jam dpal mgrin par rta dmar po g.yas tsā ga pa dang g.yon sdigs mdzub/mgrin dbang / /thugs kur phyag mthing nag g.yas gser rdor g.yon sdigs mdzub/rdor lte bar mkha' 'gro dmar rdzogayas gri gug/g.yon thod khyag kha ṭ+wā ཾ ga/lor rnams rigs spu tso/lnga//spyir bor bya khyung tshang nag sbrul na por phrag rigs kyi snang bromatha' yas sprul sku'i cha byad ༅/bdag/gser 'khor rtsibs la gtum tshang nags tho nga dang g.yon lcags kyu lon pa/chen khro bo bcu//bsrung dang bzlog pa go bgo'i 'phrin las mdzad//thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od 'phros lha tshogs rnams//thogs med byon nas dam tshig pa la thim//sa bon sngags 'phreng ba spu'i bu ga nas//me dbal spros pas phyi nang steng 'og khyab//gnod byed gdon bgegs thal ba'i rdul du brlag/bsrung dang bzlog pa'i wen las ma lus mdzad//go

ma'i gdan la hūṃ mthar sngags kyi phreng //mgal me lta bur 'khor las 'od 'phros pas//'phrin las mtha' dag lhun gyis grub par gyur//gtor ma 'bul ba ni/raṃ yaṃ 3nas/oṃ 40PROB mahā bha kla ta/te dzo bha khrag rus pa'i tshogs//'bul gyis mchoge thun dngos grub stsal du gsol//oṃ āḥ/ mahā me sa khā hi/mahā rak+ta khā hi/mahā tsit+ta khā hi/mahā bha su ta khā hi/dbang po lnga khā hi/go ro tsa na khā hi/zhes 'bul/bstod cing 'phrin las gsol ba ni/snang ba mtha' yas sku gsung thugs kyi sprul//mthu stobs dbang phyug pad+ma drag po rtsal//sna tshogs sprul ba 'jigs byed khro bcur bcas//dkyil 'khor lha tsho gos rnams la phyag 'tshal bstod//bdag cag bla med byang chub bsgrub pa la//bar du gcod pa'i dgra bgegs 'byung po kun//gas chen khyod kyis zhal du rab bzhes nas//drag po'i las sa 'dul ba'i 'phrin las mdzod//thun bar du gsol ba 'debs pa ni tshig bdun gsol 'debs lta bus kyang 'thus//bka' skyong gter srung mchod pa ni/dbang drag pad+ma'i bka' srung mthu rtsal can//mahā kā la lha mo re ma ti//sdebargyad dregs pa'i 'khor gyis bskor ba dang //legs rtsal spun gsum 'dir spyon gdan la bzhugs//oṃ badz+ra ma hā kā la/badz+ra re ma tī/a ya mdu ru tsa sha na/chab dud tri sam ya/cha shu la rā dza/yon ga rā dza sa pa ri wā ra mahā bha kla ta/mahā pas ma hā rak+ta kha raṃ khā hi/zhes pas 'bul/bka' skyong gter gyi srung ma 'khor kyi bcas sa//dam rdzas gtor ma 'di long rigs 'dzin bdag/bad+ma drag po'i thugasasgrub nyams len pa'i//'gal rkyen 3bsko zhing mthun rkyen sgrub par mdzod//ces tshwan las bcol/badz+ra muḥs rang gnas su gshegs//rdzogs rim 'od gsal du bsdus/slar yang lha'i nga rgyal la gnas pas bsngo ba smon lam shis brjod ci rigs pa bya'o//

ga4 rdzog ri dang sman sgrub kyi na bris gaṅgā'i chu sa/ nang ma (ka)mnga' bdag gter byon bde gshegs 'dus pa yi/khyun khyer rigs 'dzin brgyud pa'i zhal lung bzhin//mkha' 'gro'i kha rlangs mnyams bkod pa las//gter kha gzhan dang gsar ma'i bsre bslad med//gang 'di rigs brgya'i khyab bdag zha lu pa//rin cen bsod chom nams mag grub dpal bzang po'i//thugs dam la slad za hor sngagarnyan gyis//bkod pa'i yig mkhan gnas ba 'jam dbyangs so//gsang rdzogs sgrub 0 dang sman sgrub kyi zin bris gaṅgā'i chu rgyun bzhugs/gsang rdzogs sgrub chen la/phyi bshags rnams song zin pa byas/wo dang po las byang btang /mi snang ba la sa bslang pa'i chab gtore/sa bzung ba/sbyang ba/stegs byang shar dma' ga byed zer gas da la mi byed/bu brtsig/las thig 'debs/tshom bu/sgrom khri btsugs/khyad par rten dgu/gtso dgu'i phur pa/mchod gtor mda' gri sogs a bkod/mchod pa sman raka gtor ma sogs lam tsam bsham/ yol bas bcad/ khrus bum bsgrubs/ slob ma la bgegs bskrad/ khrus nas byung /maṇ+ḍal/a mong chos bshad/lo rgyus phun tsho gis bdun yan bshad/skyabs sems 'bebs/bla yobade gshegs mkha' 'gro gnas rjes slog 'dir gshegs sogs kyis phyi mchode sna lngar shams pa 'bul/rdo rje sems dpa'i sgom bzlas phog/dmangs ma dal 'byor rnyed dka' sogs dang yig brgya 'don 'jug/dpon slob rnams kyis las gzhud 〈khu phun/bgrangs nas lha sta gon byed/bsnyen pa kha gson lha lta gon la brten nas byed/rnam rgyal gyi bum sgrub kyang 'dir byas na 'grig/de nas slob ma sta gon ni/bla ma slob dpon dgongs su gsol nas/lhag pa gnas pa tshul bzhin bya'o'i bar/bu khyod 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal las nas/ku sha gto pa'i bar/der rjes nus pa'i dbang lnga 2na snal

rgyal dbang lnga ngang ga dang blo r+sāng rgya mtshogasung tshom/phywa logs su yod pa bskur/sgrub lung zhu ba ni/ho rdo rje slob dpon dgongs su gsol nas/ā+oṃ āḥ&gi bar dang / sngar nas yi dam gyi nyams len med ya tshor ni khro gang rung bsgom bzlas bsashing slob/dus gsum rgyal ba 'dus pa'i sku nas/sta gon la ni gnas par mdzod ces pa'i bar gyis sta gon la gnas par gsol bas pa kha mi ga thon lha rtogon gyi las byang ga sto spun 'di'i bar la nyin snyag/ba 'debs/rmi lam brtag/ga na sbyin sreg/nyin gnyis pa rgyal chen/dam sri/sgo byang /ma tri/sgrub pa'i yo byad byin rlabs nas/yum du bskyed par bya'o'i bar ma/gi khog par bsgom rgyu slob dpon gyi dmigs pa tsam yin/ dkyil 'khor chag chag /thig 'debs/ tshon byin rlabs/ tshon 'gyed/gzhal yas don bstod/thig tshon gnyis/rigs lngar bskyed chog byas na legs/sman lung sangs rgyas na wo yang byu byin rlabs zur pa mdzad/dkyil 'khor rgyan 'god/hūṃ rang bzhin lhun grub gzhal yas khang nas/ā ba sha ya a'i bar gyis lha skos la gdab nyin gsum pa mig dar/mo zhi ra/tsho gos kyi dkyil 'khor r+ṣa po ru nas/brda phyag bya ba'i rim pa/las byang nas skabs 'dir len gyi bar/me tog 'dor ba/byin 'bebs/spyan dbye/dkyil 'khor ston pa/dam tshig/rdo rje slob dpon nas/na raka skan gyi bar/ 2bskom bsre ba/mas gos/mnga' gsol/sman bsdu/sman sgrub mi byed kyang dgos/1brda sgo/man kolas bon zer ngas ri na be star byed/med na sgo mar las byang yod tshe byin thab rgya pyodang /nyag pa dmo ba mar rnams las byang dkyu la bya nas/thog mar sa bar kyi sto nga gal bdun 'a ༄ga byas na spos du ma byas kyang chog pa 'dra snyam kyang /da ltas ri bstos༅ man par las bdun sa du mdzad do//2brda phyag /3btags gdab/ 4dam bca'/ 5bshags pa/ 6byin 'bebs/ 7phud gtor brlab/'phrul 'khor bslab bya/dge sbyor la bskul/be dang pos ltar rjes ma tshar skabs gang 'os la byed/nyin bzhi pa sgrub sbra khrid grog gzer spyan gyi rgya mā na gad pa'i dmig pa dang yos zhag grang du mo bu gsum byas pa'i gnyas po bar+sā sgrub/gzhig la geba' po dang la sbyor/byed pa'i long bod sgrubang gtso bor byed na sa drug lamatshon na sto sde sgrub/sa ga spyi kyi dang po la sgrubang 'a po byed rgyu // kyang /po wo po mas dang snga dgos bya g.ye mo dbang

gsang rdzogs sgrub chen dang sman sgrub kyi zin bris gaṅgā'i chu rgyun/ nang ma (ka)bskur/nyin tsam 'thog mi mang nyung la 'gro/drag po sgrol dbang la slebs nas nyin gcig las sbyor gyi 'dzage byed/de'i sang nasal sbyor man byed/zhag grangs skabs dang bstun/las sbyor gyi las byang sngags sgrub byas na lha thams cad sku mdog nag por bsgyur ba la 'brel chags/pa dngos gzhi'i las byang /dus bzhi'am gnyis la nyung mtha' byas nas las byang gtong /nyul le/tso thung nub re star bya/dus drug gi de ging pa dang co bsdus kyi dus so sor byed/rgyun gyi dngosaXpyob/'di sgrub༅ ring wo star byed pa yin cing rgyun gyi las byang la go mthas zor dang bstan skyang bzlog pa gang 'os tshe 'gugs/rgyun gyi dngos grungarnam byed srol bod/bgegs sel/ltas brtag/me dbang gi lo rgyus dpe nang ltar 'dir mdzad kyang 'gor mdzad na legs/tog cod pan nas sku gsung thugs dbang bar dbang bum nas len/rtags kang nas zhas sa rjes kyi bar gyi dang gnang tshe 'di ga'i khug tu bya/de nas sgrub pa lung dbang /de nas ye shes lnga'i dbang nas rtsa rlung gi bar dbang bum ltar/sgrub khog nang gi sgrol 3na ji bang /dbang bum gyi bka' rab 'byams nus dbang nas gtad rgya'i bar shar ma/ dngos grub bgegs sel gyi bro/ rgyun bshags/ dngos grub dngos/gnad dbab pa/ba po shis/dus byang /sbyin sreg ma 'dres yongs rdzogs las zhi rgyas/sgo dbye nasabro'i bar/tshe 'gugs/gter sped/bla ma la gtang rag/mar me'i smon lam/dkyil 'khor lagatang rag/yig brgya sogs kyis lha la bshags pa/dkyil 'khor bsdu/hūṃ ngar 'dzin rnam dag sgyu lus 'ja' 'dra 'di sogs kyis rgyun spyod lhar ldang / rang lus bsrung / mched lcam nang bshags/ba po shis/mtho 'grol lo/dbang gis dus sngon 'gro rgyal ba rgya mtsho dang mnyam nyid ma/dngos gzhimajug gsum gyi sa bcad 'khrugs sdeb byas pa'i stabs kyis gong 'og ma gcig pa ma gtogos ma chad tsamatshar spa khrig mdzad srol 'dug/sman sgrub ni/khrol bu la sgrub chen gyi lding khri'i khyad par rten dgu'i dbus su pad+ma 'dab brgyad khyams sgo mu khyud sogs bris pa'i steng du 'og thod thod ga rdzogayod na thod par brisachog kyang /khrol med na rigs brgya rags lnga rigs gcig rnams rig par bsgrub dgos pas shog bur bris bkon chog pa byed la ghi hang gis bad 'dab brgya pa bri/steng thod la mi dgos/'di rigs brgya'i dkyil 'khor yin/rigasalnga'i dkyil 'khor la 'og tu 'khor lo rtsibs baX mu khyud sgo rdzogs/thod pa gnyis ka la 'khor lo

rten brten pa tso dpajo bor+sāg la ldog pa thad da 05na rgud du byed/mi byed par a dkar byed pa sogs bsgyur khro bo'i ma' rtogs kyi sgo la don bkol ba nas rigs brgya'i g.yi bya/spyan 'dren ma rdzo byed/'dzab kyi dus yig 'bru ke gsum la sogs kyi bskyed chog ga mjug tu rigs lnga snyom 'jug gi byang sem su zhu na rdzas la thim/nas spyan lha spyan drang pa rdzas bdud rtsir gyur par tsa sto/'dren ga4 rdzogs sgrub dang sman sgrub kyi zan bris gaṅgā'i chu rgyun/ nang ma (ka)dngos ga sto sgrub pa'i du lhar mi gsal bar bdud rtsi de ga yin no//pa de ga yin/zhag gsum par dkyil 'khor spos/sman dbus su sbyar/las byang man ngag las na rtog pa bsal ba/sogs mag rtogs bsgyur ba ma gtage bang ltar/'dzab dngos 'bru bcu ā+oṃ sarba pañtsa a khra ta badz+ra tsit+ta sam ya hūṃ/bzhi pa yin/dmigs pa yang lha 'od zhu sogs de ga'i dmigs pa ltar ro//sman khrol bu'i mjug don gyi cha la sman sgrubaca pa btagapa deg/mchod/bstod pa/dngos grub blang zhing bsdu ba dkyus ltar/rigs lnga'i dkyil 'khor rdul tshon yin ba bsnol/yab kyis yum gyi lag mgo bsdams nas sman brdung gzhan sbol ba'i bar dkyusaltar/dkyil 'khor bsgyur ba bka' brgyad dkyil 'khor med pa'i dbang du byas pa yin/sgrub chen dang 'brel na mi dgos/de nas slob dpon mas su zhugs nas sman rang dga'i rtog pa sbyong ba byed/steng du hri hūṃ dang phyogs tshore rigs lnga'i phyag mas sogs shog bur bris nas sbyor/gsang rdor mi byed/rdor dril byug nga dudagos/thig gus bsdam rang phyogs kyi gzungs thag gi sne la phur ba dgos/glu bro zer ba las byang gi phyag rgya gar mchod mjug gi de yin/gzhan dril bur gzhal ba sogs zhib cha rnams che mchog bdud mi 'khyil ba'i sku'am yang na sku dngos gzhi bris kyang yong steng thod la 'dri 'og thod la rigs lnga'i sa bon 'dri/ltar byed/de nas sman dkyil 'khor la bkod/man ngag las bdun rtog pa bsal ba/khros/las byang gi bdag mdun tshe ri 'dab 'brel du bskyed/ mchod bstod bya/ 4bslar gnas hrū ra thod pa dang che mchog bsnyed rtsi 'khyil 'ju 'dul byed pas las byang phyi ma tshor mchod rten las dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs su mi bskyed 'ju sil/dmigs pas mthus/par bskyed pa'i dmigs pa dang bcas bcu drug par sngags rgyun byed/sgrub chen dang mi phrel na skrub chen nas bshad pa'i dngos grub len/ sman rten dad bang thos 'di lhar du ma thob kyang tshar tso/dbang bla ma rang gis blangs de nas slob ma la bskur/bum pa kha cung zad phye zer ba dar dmar gyi khug ma nas sman len sgrub sman gsar ba na/ /nga zad blangs te chang la btab rang dang slob ma 'thung /thub

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/nges kha 'bye/ gsang mtshan btags nas dkyil 'khor la sman phud 'bul/ bcang thabs dang ngo sprod gzhung ltar byed sman mang na thod pa lnga byed pa sgrub rten gyi thod pa dgu la mi the ba dgos/ma shong na lding khri la thog gcig thol la byed srol kyang snang ngo //rin cen khro chu'i gdengs can sto ba'i bca/smin byed nyang ston brgyud pa'i phyag len ltar//za hor bzhes:na thor bkod pa'i dges//bka' brgyad chos kyi nyi 'od rab gsal shog/bkra shis//bka' brgyad gsang ba yongs rdzogs kyi las byang bklags chog dgos pa kun tshang bzhugs/na ma shān+ta kro dha pa ri sa mag de we saḥngo bo chos sku ka nas me dag kun bzang snang ba mtha' yas gdangs//'gag med rang bzhin lhun grub longs sku 'ja' tshon ltar bkra bka' brgyad lha//thugs rje sprul sku rigs 'dzin slob dpon mtsho skyes rdo rje gzugs gzhan du//yongs bsgyur dkyil 'khor spro bsdu'i byed po zur r+ṣa chos dbyings rang grol rgyal//nus mthu'i nor rgyas zhagasabacings mkhyen brtse'i ri/khyud lung man ngag rgya mtshor bsgril ba las//gnad gsang bdud rtsi ster ba'i 'chi med gtso//myang ston blo gros mchog gi rdo rje bsngags//spyi dang bye brag zhi khro'i smin grolalam//yodang mkha' 'gro'i zhal lung rgyud mang glu/rnabar len la zla bral bka' drin can//'gro 'dulagater bdag gling pa phyag gi yul/phyi rol snod bcud zhi khror shar ba'i rtsal//nang du rang byung lusal yongs tshang ba//gsang ba rig pa'i che mchog brjod bral lha//gzhan nas 'tshol 2na min gto gyi skyabs des skyongs/ /sgrub chen gsang rdzogs 'phrin las kha stong rnams/ /bskyed pa ma hā yoga'i sgom khog nas//'geng 'os dam pa'i zhal lung ji bawo du//'dri bar chos srung ga bdag gnang ba stsol//de yang mnga' bdag gsung gi sprul pa gu ru rin po sdo chos kyi dbang phyug gis lho brag gnam skas can

bka' brgyad gsang ba yongs rdzogs kyi las byang bklags chog dgos pa kun tshang / nang ma (ka)nas sbyan drangs pa'i klu bdud lto ba'i zab gter bka' brgyad gsang ba yongs rdzogs kyi las byang la lhan thabs sgom khog sogs nas len 'os med du mi rung ba rnams chu babs su bkod pa la/ zhi khro gsang ba yongs rdzogs kyi sgrub chen las gzhung bsrang ba la sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes dang gsum sngon 'gro thun mong las bdun te mtshams bcad brda sgo brda phyag 'tshal: dam bca' byin dbab mchod bshags bya zhes gsungs pa ltar/ thog mar skyabs 'gro'i lhan thabs tshig bdun gsol 'debs ni/ o rgyan yul ni nub byang mtshams pad+ma ge sar sdong po la ya mtshan mchog gi dngosagrub (2ba lnga rnyes pad+ma 'byung gnas zhes su grags: 'khor du mkha' 'gro mang pos bskor khyed kyi rjes su bdag bsgrub kyi byin gyis brlab phyir gshegs su gsol: sgrub khog las/ bla ma sangasargyas 'khor dang bcas kun nas bdag la dgongs su gsol: bla ma dkon cog rnam gsum la:byang chub ma thob bar du ni skyabs kyi mchog tu bzung bar bgyi lan gsum/ sngon nas bsagasapa'i sdig sgrib bshags 'gro don sangs rgyas thob bya'i phyir: smon pa'i byang chub sems ni bskyed sems can yongs su smin bya'i phyir gsang sngags spyod pa rlabs chen spyad: don dam spros bral byang chub sems rang byung mtha' bral stong gsal bsgom lan gsum brjod/ yan lag brgyad pa'i lhan thabs ni/ tre rat+na maṇ+ḍal/ paṃ pad+ma maṇ+ḍal/ ma su rla maṇ+ḍal/ a tsan+d+ra maṇ+ḍal/ badz+ra sa ma la dza: rnying ma bka' pa'i rgyud kyi/ rdo rje slob dpon sangs rgyas dpal sogs bya/ brgyud 'debs ni/ dpal ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma rin po che/ /bdag gi snying gar pad+ma'i gdan bzhugs la/ /bka' drin chen po'i sgo nasarjes gzung ste/ /sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /gsar sgrigs/ kun bzang rigasalnga dam pa tog dkar po/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i sprul pa rnam pa gsum/ /gsang bdag dam pa'i rigasacan dra ma lngar/ /gsol ba 'debs so dngos grub rnam gnyis stsol/ /las kyi dbang mo dbang chu'i brgyud pa drug /rgya gar rigs 'dzin brgyad dang pad+ma (3na smo khyung / /bod kyi rje 'bangs nyi shu rtsa lnga la/ /gsol ba ྾/ /'gro mgon mnga' bdag myang chen yab sras dang / /gter ston chos dbang bga' babs—79

rgya la dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (25)sman lung pa/ /dwags ston gnyan ston rtse sdings yab sras la/ /gsol ba ྾/ /gu ru chos 'od mtshungasamed dpal 'byor dbang / /chos kyi dbang po rkarma gu ru'i mtshan/ /de sras dbang 'byor rig pa'i rdo rje la/ /gsol ba ྾/ /slar yang legs ldan rdo rje mkhyen brtse'i zhabs/ /dbang phyug rab brtan 'jam mgon bsod nams mchog /zur chen kun mkhyen rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ /gsol ba ྾/ /phyi dkyil smin byed lam gyis lha skur shar/ /lus dkyil dbang gis rtsa khams bde drod 'bar/ /phyag rgya la brten dga' bzhi'i bde chen rgyas/ /rang sems ka dag kun bzang mngon gyur shog /rdor dril rnga byin rlabs ni/sgom khog gi tshig cung zad bde ru bto ba/ rdo rje mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i 4 las hūṃ las byung ba'i rdo rje yar gyi rwa lnga rigs lnga yab lnga dang / mar gyi rwa lnga rigs lnga yum lngar gsal ba'i lte ba mkha' gsang byang chub kyi sems su 'khyil ba las 'od 'phros pas 'phag bas pa mchod cing 'gro don 'byung bar gyur/ ā+oṃ āḥ& badz+ra tiṣ+ṭha dzñā na sam ya hūṃ/ dril bu mi dmigs ྾/ // las byung ba'i dril bu yum gyi mkha' nang du yab kyi rdo rje dril lcer gyur pas sbyor ba byas pas byang chub kyi sems chos nyid kyi rang sgras stong gsum gang bar gyur/ (3ba7 ku las ri gu rnga rnga lcag dang bcas pa mi dmigs par/ a las rnga kun tu bzang mo'i mkha' la rnga lcag kun bzang yab kyi rdo rjes sbyor ba byas pas byang chub kyi sems nam mkha'i mtha' klas par bla med snying po'i chos sgras gang bar gyur/ dharma rdzo tu hūṃ hūṃ baṃ k+ṣe sam ya sngo bgegs gtore lhan thabs ni/ raṃ yaṃ khaṃ/ ā+oṃ āḥ// a kwa ro lan gsum gyis bsngo/ sgrub khog las/ yang dag don la mi mos shing : mi dang mi min log 'dren bgegs lan chags re gtor 'di khyer la gnas 'di khor yug tshun chad du skad cig tsam yang 'da' ma byed: gal te nga yi bka' 'das na bde gshegs mkha' 'gro kun 'dus nas lusangag rdul phran bzhin du rlog: mtshams gcod kyi lhan thabs ni/ sgom khog gi tshig bde ru cung zad btang ba/ chos thams cad stong zhing bdag med pa nam mkha' lta bu'i klong nas/ rang nyid skad cig dran rdzogs su bka' brgyad tshom bu dgu'i khro bo'i tshogs kyi skur gyur pa me dpung 'bar ba'i klong du —80

brka' brgyad gsang ba yong rdzog kyi las byang bklags chog dgos pa kun tshang / nang ma (ka)gsal ba las/sprul pa yang sprul gyi khro tshogs skar ltar 'khrug pas bgegs thams cad sran phung la rdo brgyab pa ltar bskrad par gyur/mtshams bcad pa ni/hūṃ/rgyal ba zhi khro yongs rdzogs dkyil 'khor du:snang srid rnam dag ye shes lha yi tshogs kun bzang chos kyi dbyings las ma g.yos kyang :rig rtsal rnam dag thabs shes g.yung drung lha 'di la log par lta ba'i dgra dang bgegs bdud 4na tshe ldodapung bcas thams cad phyir dengs shig nga ni nga byu: gro hā gu pa ya gro sna pa ya :ā na ya hobha ga bān bi du rā dza hūṃ phaṭa:྅/bdag nyid dpal chen khrag 'thung thugs ka nas:drag po'i byin rlabs mtsho ni cha'i 'od zer 'phro:mtshon cha'i gur chen ye shes me dpung 'bar phyogs mtshams steng 'og kun tu khyab par bsrung :྅ badz+ra tsakra sde rkarma ki la ya dz+wa la re srung 'khor mjug gi lhan thabs ni/sgom khog gi tshig cung zad bde ru btang ba/slar yang thugs ka'i hūṃ las khro bo 'chol pa shāk+ki rā dza sku mdog mthing nag g.yas tho ba dang g.yon zhags pa bsnams pa rab 'jigs gtum po dpag tu med pa spros phyogs skyong bcu bkug ste steng 'og phyogs mtshams su bsnol ba'i steng du hūṃ bcu 'phros par gyur //dregs pa lha chen phyogs skyong bsnol ba'i steng :che mchog la sogs dpal chen khro rgyal tshogs gar dgu'i tshul gyis hūṃ sgra sgrog cing bzhugs:bar chad 'byung po thams cad rdul du rlog:ā+oṃ badz+ra krodha swā bhā wa sam ya ru lu ru lu hūṃ phaṭa:྅ hūṃ hūṃ bi shwa badz+ra tsakra dz+wa la maṇ+ḍal ha la ha la hūṃ phaṭa brda sgo dbye ba ni/hūṃ/snang srid thams cad bde chen gzhal yas khang :gzugs snang thamasacad rang rig ye shes lha:de nyid ma rtogs ma rig sgo bcad pas:rang gsal ye shes 'char sgo da phye zhig:: pra be sha ya phaṭa brda phyag 'tshal ba ni/hūṃ/rang byung ye shes snying po sems kyi lha:ma 4brtogs rang ngo rang gis ma shes pas ye nas rang dang 'grogs kyang zhal ma mjal:rang gsal brda yi don dang mjal phyag 'tshal:lha he ru /a ti pu ho pra titsā sngo dam bca' ni/hūṃ/dus gsum bde gshegs rgyal ba zhi khro'i tshogs bskal pa sngon ༷das dus nas yi dam lha da lta gnyis med don

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (25)dam rang ngo shes: srog gi phyir yang mi btang bsgrub lags so: ྅ ba1tsit+ta sam ya hūṃ/ byin dbab ni/ hūṃ/ chos dbyings ye shes lnga yi pho brang nas: chos sku skye med dbyings las ma g.yos kyang : longs sku rigs lnga zhi khro 'khor dang bcas: sprul sku yi dam dkyil 'khor lha tsho gis rnams thugs dam dbang gis gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol: sku gsung thugs kyis byin gyis brlab tu gsol ye shes lnga yi dbang mchog bskur du gsol: gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor 'di la byin zhig phog khyed kyi thugs rje mchog gis gzung du gsol: zho shrī badz+ra krodha he ba de ba sarba dus ḍā gi ni sa ma ya ru lu ru lu hūṃ bh+yo hūṃ ā be sha ya a āḥbyin 'bebs kyi lhan thabs ni/ gter gzhung bcos med/ hūṃ/ byin chen ngo mtshar khyad par can: phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad dur khrod bdag: zhing skyong ma mo kun gyi rje: rigs 'dzin grub thob brgyad kyi gtso klu sogs sde brgyad kun gyi gnyen: mchod rten shing chen kun tu bzhugs ston pa mthu stobs lha srin 'dul skyon pad+mas byin phob cig: ma dang mkha' 'gro gshegs su gsol:gnas 'dir byin phob bdag dbang (na tha skur: bgegs dang log 'dren bar gcod sol: mchog dang mthun mong dngos grub stsol: sdu ru de wa ḍā ki ni sa ma ya sarba hri hri go mchod brlab ni/ hūṃ/ rang dang gnyis med lha tshogs gsal: mar me sman gtor rak+ta dang : phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod sprin rnams: thugs dam bskang phyir 'dul gyis bzhes: mchod pa sman gtor rak+ta brlab pa'i lhan thabasani: sgom khog gi tshig bde ru cung zad btang ba/ bdag gi thugs ga'i hūṃ las raṃ yaṃ khaṃ 'phros pas phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod rdzas rnams kyi ma dag pa'i skyon rnams ye shes kyi mes bsregs/ chos nyid kyi rlung gis gtor/ tshad med kyi chus bkrus te mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid du gyur pa'i ngang las ā+oṃ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du/ bdug spos ma sngon mo spos khang 'dzin/ me tog ma dmar mo me tog 'dzin/ dri chab ma dkar mo dri'i dung chos 'dzin/ mar me ma dmar ser snang gsal 'dzin/ zhal zas ma dkar mo bshos gtsang 'dzin/ rol mo ma ljang gu sil snyan 'dzin pa de rnams re re las byang rang 'dra'i lha rmyo dpag tu med pa dpal kun tu bzang po'i mchod pa'i sprin phung —82

bka' brgyad gsang ba yongs rdzogs kyi las byang bklags chog dgos pa kun tshang / nang ma (ka)nam mkha' mdzod lta bur zad mi shes pas khyab par gyur/ ā+oṃ āḥ& badz+ra/ pe snro badz+ra pu 〉 snri badz+ra.ā lo ke snro badz+ra 1 snri badz+ra ni bi sdi snro badz+ra shabha snro badz+ra sarba pā dza me gha sno sman phud kyi snod bcud rnams mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid du gyur pa'i ngang las/ (5ba〉〈 las rlung / raṃ las me/ kai las thod pa'i skyed bu gsum gyi steng du āḥlas ban+ta yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi ba'i lte bar byang sems/ seng ge'i sha /sman bzang po drug shar gyi rtsibs la dri chen/ glang rin che'i sha /dzāti/ lho'i rtsibs la sha chen /rta'i sha //kol/ nub kyi rtsibs la pad+ma rak+ta/ rma bya'i sha /li shi /byang gi rtsibs la dri chu/ khyung sha /gur gum rnams rlud gis me sbar te zhu ba yongs su gyur pa lasaphyag mtshan bcu so so'i lte bar hūṃ ā+oṃ swā e hā hūṃ lī myo shrī two gyis mtshan pa las 'od zer 'phros/'khor 'das kyi bcud thams cad bsdus te thim pa yongs su gyur pa las rigs lnga yab yum lngar gyur pa'i sbyor mtshams nas byang chub kyi sems dkar dmar gyi rgyun babs pa'i steng du rigs lnga yab yum 'od du zhu nas thim pas bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ ā+oṃ āḥsnyi sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta hūṃ hrīḥṭhaḥlan gsum/ gtor ma'i snod bcud mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid du gyur pa'i ngang las thod pa dum bu gcig pa stong gsum dang mnyam pa'i nang du/ ā+oṃ 40PROB zhu ba las byung ba'i lha'i zhal zas 'dod yon lnga'i lha mo sprin gyi phung po lta bur 'khrigs par gyur/ ā+oṃ āḥ& mahā ba smra ta he dz+wa ba kla ta ba la bha te gu spo sam ye swāhā/ lan gsum/ rak+ta'i snod bcud mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid du gyur pa'i ngang las pad+ma 'bar ba'i snod chen por/ ra las rdo rje sgeg mo dmar mo'i mkha' nas khrag babs te/ nyon mongs pa bag chags dang bcas pa 'joms pa'i (6na)rak+ta'i rgya mtsho rba klong rgya mdud kyi tshul du 'khrugs pa la lha mo nyid 'od du zhu nas thim pas 'khor ba stongs par gyur/ ā+oṃ āḥ/ mahā rak+ta sa man+ta maṇ+ḍal hūṃ phaṭa: lan gsum/ ā+oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pā dzaḥ mahā pathu mahā ba kla ta: mahā rak+ta: a ho su kha sa ma ye swāhā bshags pa ni/ hūṃ/ bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro thams cad dgongs: bskal pa sngon nas da lta'i dus yan chad: rtsa ba yan lag dam tshig nyams chags sogs: rang gnong 'gyod sems drag pos—83

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (25)mthol zhing bshags rtswa āḥ& swāhā/ badz+ra sa ma ya dzaḥ na ra sa bre ta ga: ti rlu sga ni bi sha: de ba a li bi shud+dhi: da k+ṣa ka shu khye shud+dhi swās rtswa ye shes sku mchog rang bzhin dkyil 'khor ni/ /zla rgyas bzhin du spros pa mi mnga' yang / /thugs rje nyi gsal 'od bzhin snyoms mdzad pa/ /'dir gshegs bdag la dgongs shing bzhugs su gsol/ /brjod med shes rab mi g.yo chos kyi sku/ /bde chen longs spyod rdzogs sku rigs lnga'i gtso/ /thugs rje thabs mkhas rgya che rol pa yi/ /zhi khro sprul pa'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dngos su 'byor dang yid kyis rnam sprul pa'i/ /kun tu bzang po bla med mchod sprin gyis/ /mkha' dbyings rnam dag rgya cher yongs bkod de/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa rgya mtshos mchod/ /kun tu bzang mo gsang ba'i bha ga la/ /rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor rab 'byams ma lus kun/ /'du 'bral med pa'i ngang du ro gcig pa/ /gnyis (6ba thad byang chub sems kyis mnyes gyur cig /sems kyi rang bzhin chos dbyings nam mkha' che/ /chos rnams rnam dag ye nas 'od gsal zhing / /rnal 'byor nyid dbyings smra bsam las 'das pa'i/ /mnyam nyid byang chub sems la rtag tu 'dud/ /āḥ kun bzang rdzogs chen ye nas brdal ba la/ /phyi nang gsang ba bkod pa'i dkyil 'khor ni/ /snang srid rnam dag lha dang lha mo'i dbyings/ /'byung dang 'byung gyur yab yum lhun rdzogs rnams/ /gsang chen rab dgyes gzugs can bdag nyid ma/ /mkha' dbyings klong yangs pad+ma 'khyil ba la/ /gnyis med thig le chen por 'od gsal zhing / /ma bcos spros med byang chub snying po'i sku/ khor yang snang ba bde chen g.yung drung lha/ /'du 'bral med pa gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor 'dir/ /bdag nyid chen po rigs lnga yab yum dang / /byang chub lcam dral khro bo khro mo'i tshogs/ /rdo rje lha mo tshogs rje tshogs kyi bdag /rigs lnga dpal chen khro rgyal yab yum bcu/ /gnas dang yul gyi phyag rgya sgom bzhi/ /ye shes sprul pa'i lha tsho gos mang po dang / /ma ltar byams shing sring ltar gdung la sogs/ /legs nyes bstangs 'dzin dam tshig rjes spyod ma/ /phyi nang mkha' 'gro rnal 'byor ma yi tshogs/ /dpang gyur rdo rje dam can dgongs su gsol/ /hūṃ/thugs rje'i gdung 'tshob rig 'dzin bdag cag gis/ /'gro ba'i don du byang chub sems bskyed de/ /—84

bka' brgyad gsang ba yongs rdzogs kyi las byang bklags chog dgos pa kun tshang / nang ma (ka)bla med go 'phang 'grod par bya ba'i phyir/ /bstan pa rgya mtsho (7na〉sgo so'i 'dul khrims dang / /sku gsung thugs dang mnyam sbyor sdom pa'i mchog /rdo rje 'da' dka' dam tshig gnyan gyi gter/ /spyi dang khyad par lhag pa'i dam tshig rnams/ /snga phyir mnos shing gnyer du smras so 'tshal/ /yun du mi gtong 'da' bar mi bgyid cing / /don las gol zhing ldog sems ma mchis kyang / /gdod bya long yod snyam pa'i le lo yis/ /klong du ma gyur rtsal shugs chung ba dang / shes bzhin mi ldan bag med dbang gyur te/ /sgom la mi brtson bsnyen sgrub g.yel la sogs/ /tshor dang ma tshor ma rig dbang gis na/ /ston pa'i bka' dang dam las 'gal gyur te/ /rnal 'byor gang zhig dam tshig nyams pa dang / /skad cig tsam yang phrad par mi bya zhes/ /bka' las 'byung zhing de ltar ma lcogs te/ /gsang sgo 'chol bas dbye gsal dkas pa dang / /mngon shes med pas skyon can ma rtogs te/ /nyams dang tshogs 'dres nyams pa bskang ba dang / /nyams dang snod min rnams la chos bshad dang / /nyams la ma 'dzems nyams pa'i skyon la sogs/ /nyams dang 'grogs shing nyams pa de dag gi /nyams grib skyon gyis gos par gyur to 'tshal/ /tshe 'di'i rkyen dang yun gyi sgrib gyur rnams/ /rab gnong 'gyod pa'i semasakyis mthol lo bshags/ /byams pa'i thugs brtses bdag la dgongs nas kyang / /gnyis med dbyingasalas mi 'gyur bdag bkod de/ /dmigs med btang (7ba〉snyoms ngang du bzhugs nas kyang / /gnyis med don gyi tshangs pa stsal du gsol/ /don dam brjod med spros las 'das pa na/ /rnam rtog gang yang dmigs par mi 'gyur zhing / /kun rdzob sgyu ma tsam gyi dbang gis na/ /nongs pa mchis na rab nongs bzod par gsol/ /zhes gdung shugs drag po'i sgo nas brjod/ dngos gzhi las rim nyer lnga ste: ting 'dzin rnam gsum 'byung rim brtsegs: gzhal yas lha bskyed byin brlabs bskur: rang bzhin spyan drang brtan par bzhugs: phyag dang phyag rgya glus mchod cing : phyi dang nang dang gsang mchod bya: dug gsum sman gtor rak+ta dang : bdud rtsi gsang nan sbyor sgrol mchod: bstod bshags dzub bzlas dngos grub blangs: zhes gsungs pa ltar ting 'dzin rnam gsum ni/ hūṃ/ spros med yang —85

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()dag de bzhin nyid:mnyam yangs phyogs bral kun tu gdal:ma nor ma bcos chos kyi sku:rang bzhin lhun grub ngang gis gsal zho mahā shā n+ya dzñā na badz+ra su bhā wa āt+pa ko3ṇ+ḍi ྅ /de bzhin kun khyab kun tu snang :ma rig 'khrul snang 'khor ba'i klong :gzung 'dzin bag chags rab tu 'thas:ma rtogasasems can snying re rje:zho dharma dh+wa tu su bhā ba bi shu khye maṇ+ḍal /:྅/chos rnams rang byung rten 'brel te:rgyu las ma byung gang yang med:྅ ni thams cad bskyed pa'i rgyu dgos 'dod 'byung ba'i yi ge bsgom:tsit+ta badz+ra sa mā dhi snro rgyu'i ting 'dzin gyi lhan thabs ni/8na skom khog gi tshig lhug pa tshigs bcad du bsdebs pa/rang sems rgyu yig hūṃ sngon po//'od 'bar rang byung chos kyi dbyings//mkha' la zla ba lding ba bzhin/khyu yi yi ge hūṃ de las//'byung ba rim brtsegs ni/raṃ yaṃ kho gsum rim bzhin 'phros//me yis 'jig rten dngos 'dzin bsregs//rlung gis rnam rtog gzung 'dzin gtor//chu yis bag chags chen snang bkrus//raṃ yaṃ kho:྅/bskal pa gsum gyis 'jig rten stongs ye nasadag pa'i ngang nyid las:snod bcud sbyang phyir 'byung rim brtsegs rnam dag yum lnga'i mkha' klong gsal:྅ e me ru saṃ ke raṃ zlo:྅/e las nam mkha' mtha' dbus med:ye las rlung gi dkyil 'khor steng :ra las rat+na'i rgyal mtsho 'khyil / las zhing chen sa gzhi brdal:ke las rus pa'i ri rab steng :re las bskal pa'i me dpung 'bar gzhal yas khang bskyed pa ni/hūṃ/sne las rin cen gzhal yas khang :dur khrod rab 'jigs dkyil 'khor bskyed:zla gam ye shes 'char sgo'i dbus:chos sku 'gyur med e ru gsal:bhañdza skam rlon pho brang brtsigs rin cen mdzes pa'i dkyil 'khor dgu:'khor lo rtsibs bzhi mu khyud bcas gru chad bar khyams sgo khyud rdzogs:rang byung lhun grub ngo mtshar che:dregs pa pad+ma nyi zla'i gdan gtso dang 'khor lo 'tsham par gsal:: bi shwa bi shu khye bhañdza dzñā na e tsakra maṇ+ḍal / ru dra kro dhi snyi ra bo:ma su rla maṇ+ḍal:a ho loṇ+ḍa maṇ+ḍal po pad+ma maṇ+ḍal:lha bskyed pa ni/hūṃ/rgyu yi yi ge gdan la babs:gtso bo bskyed pa'i lhan thabs ni/sgom khog gi don yi ngur bsdus pa/spros shing bsdus nas 'od du zhu//de nyid rdo rje rtse dgur gyur//spro bsdu'i sbyor

bka' brgyad gsang ba yongs rdzogs kyi las byang bklags chog dgos pa kun tshang / nang ma (ka)bas dpal chen sku bdag nyid che mchog he ru ga mthing nag zhal gsum phyag drug pa: zhabs bzhi gyad kyi dor stabs bgrad g.yas dkar g.yon dmar dbus mthing zhal: rigs lngas dbu brgyan thugs srog 3 spyan dgu zhal bgrad mche ba gtsigs g.yas kyi phyag gsum rdo rje gsor: g.yon gyi phyag gsum bhan dmar 'dzin dur khrod 'jigs pa'i mas kyis brgyan gnam zhal yum chen kun bzang 'khril: zhal gcig phyag gnyis sku mdog mthing : g.yas pa gtsor 'khyud kha ṭ+wāṃ bsnams:g.yon pa dung dmar gtso la stob mkha' gsang byin rlabs ni/ ma srurla maṇ+ḍal: ྅ badz+ra chu a tsan+d+ra maṇ+ḍal: e e sa ma ya ho: sa ma ya sa ra ho lha rā ga yā mi: dzaḥ& baṃ ho: sa ma ya mu dra: pra pe sha ya phaṭa: zho ā+oṃ chu / hūṃ : phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa: snga ra ṇa phaṭa: ྅ hūṃ hūṃ : yab yum sbyor ba'i byin rlabs las rigs bzhi la sogs 'khor bcas gsal bskal pa'i me dpung klong na bzhugs rtswa badz+ra kro dha mahā shrī he ru ka hūṃ phaṭa: mahā kro khyu shwa twa ri sa lha/ dpal chen yab yum thugs ka nas:phyogs bzhi mtshams bzhi dkyil 'khor du: mthing nag hūṃ chen yig 'bru spro: (9na sog 'thung yab yum sras bcas bskyed: mkha' 'gro brda yig zhig yod/ hūṃ/ shar du badz+ra he ru ga badz+ra kro sgyi shwa rī yum rigs bzhi la sogs 'khor bcas gsal rtswa ru lu ru lu hūṃ bh+yo:྅ phaṭa: ྅/ lho ru 'jam dpal gshin rje gshed za byed be+e tā nag mo yum rigs bzhi la sogs 'khor bcas gsal) rtswa a kro te ka ya mān+ta ka ha na ma tha bhañdza hūṃ phaṭa: // nub tu dbang chen rta mchog dpal pad+ma gzi ldan khro mo yum rigs bzhi la sogs ri/ /ā+oṃ pa dhan+ta kṛ ta mahā kro dh+wa ha ya sgyi ba hu lu hu lu hūṃ phaṭa: ྅/byang du rdo rje gzhen nu che: 'khor lo rgyas 'debs dpal gyi yum rigs bzhi la sogs mo/ ā+oṃ badz+ragī li ki lā ya sarba bi baṃ hūṃ phaṭa: ྅/ shar lhor bla med he ru da nyid bzhi bde mchog chen mo yum ma lnga la sogs za/ /ā+oṃ gu spo dzñā na shrī he ru ka gu spo dzñā na kro dhī shwa rī rto ma ma yo gi ni ru lu ru lu hūṃ bh+yo hūṃ phaṭa // lho nub rigs 'dzin thod pa rtsal rdo rje rnal 'byor gsang ba'i yum: rigs bzhi ldosogs ra/ /ā+oṃ badz+ra mahā gu ru sarba hūṃ phaṭa: ྅/ nub byang dregs pa kun 'dul dpal: khams gsum —87—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (25)srid pa spyi 'dul yum: rigs bzhi la sogs sko/ /ā+oṃ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa sarba dus hūṃ phaṭa: ྅/ byang shar stobasaldan na gabo cho khrung ba lnga yi bdag mo yus rigs ba ni la za/ /ā+oṃ badz+ra sarba du / e dza bh+yo hūṃ phaṭa: //nyi ma dang ni 'od zer bzhin: dpal chen so so'i sprul 'khor (9bsta sa phyi rol sgo ba rigs bzhi ni: ya mā na pra dzñā na pa dha na big lcags kyu zhags pa lcags sgrog dril: tshom bu dgu yi lha tshogasarnams: sku mdog phyag mtshan rgyan cha lugs: ma 'dres yongs su rdzogs par gsal: dzaḥ& baṃ hoḥ lha/phyi rol lcags ri khor yug la mkha' 'gro dbang phyug ging lag 'bar ma ma sring bka' sdod tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab yongs rdzogs gtings mahā mu dra sam ya 'a byin gyis brlab pa ni/hūṃ/ rang byung dkyil 'khor dpal chen rdzogs mthu rtsal yongs su rdzogs bya'i phyir sku gsung thugasasu byin rlobs la: ye shes rnam lngas dbang bskur cig rtswa āḥ&: dbang bskur ba ni/ ā+oṃ hūṃ swā hrīḥlhadabang gi lhan thabs sgom khog gi tshig bde ru cung zad btang ba/ tshem bu dgu'i lha tshogs rnams kyi dung khang 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pa'i lte bar rnam snang dkar po thugs kar ā+oṃ gyis mtshan pa/ ljagasapad+ma 'dab brgyad kyi lte bar snang ba mtha' yas dmar po thugs gar āḥs mtshan pa/ thugs rdo rje rgya gram gyi lte bar rdo rje sems dpa' mthing kha thugs gar hūṃ gis mtshan pas dus gsum bde gshegasabla ma rigs 'dzin thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs yongs su rdzogs pa thob/ tshom bu dgu'i lha tshogs rnams kyi gtsug tor gyi steng du hūṃ mthing kha/ dpral bar ā+oṃ dkar po/ rna gong g.yas su swā ser po/ ltag par smiḥdamar po/ snyan gong g.yon du hā ljang gu las rigs lnga sogs zhi ba bzhi bcu (10na)rtsa gnyis kyi lha tshogs mnyen lhag 'khril ldem gzhen tshul can/ gsal 'tsher lhun sdug gzi brjid 'bar ba ste/ zhi ba'i tshul dgu dang ldan par bzhugs nas dbang chen rab stims kyi dbang bskur ba thob ste 'gro don la dpa' bar gyur/ ā+oṃ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta kā ya lha bī khyu dzñā na pañtsa badz+ra swā bhā ba āt+pa ko3gi spyan 'dren ni/ hūṃ/ rnam dag chos dbyings mnyam nyid las zhi khro yongs rdzogs sku bzhengs la: srid gsum gdug pa'i tshogs bsgral phyir gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs —88—

bka' brgyad gsang ba yongs rdzogs kyi las byang bklags chog dgos pa kun tshang / nang ma (ka)su gsol: zho e gye hi sa ma ya: dzaḥ/ baṃ ho: tri hri dzaḥ brtan bzhugs ni/ hūṃ/ bde gshegs kun 'dus dkyil 'khor 'dir: dam tshig ye shes dbyer med par: chu la chu bzhag ji bzhin du du ma ro gcig brtan par bzhugs: sa ma ya ā be sha ya ti sgo sa: phyag ni/ hūṃ/ chos rnams rang bzhin ye nas dag rtog 'khrul 'jig rten sems can la: sku gsung thugs yon 'phrin las ston dkyil 'khor lha la phyag 'tshal lo: a ti pu ho: na mchu gar mchod ni/ hūṃ/ gdul bya'i mos blo tha dad pas zhi dang khro dang 'dres pa'i tshul: sku mdog zhal phyag bsam 'das kyang : lha rnams gsal 'debs gar mchod 'bul: snyi/ dpal chen che mchog he ru da: dbu gsum phyag drug zha khas bzhi bgrad: g.yasadakar g.yon dmar dbus mthing zhal: rigs lngas dbu brgyan thugs srog gsal: g.yas kyi phyag (10bsko sum rdo rje gdengs : g.yon gyi phyag gsum bhan dmar 'dzin: yum chen gnam zhal kun bzang 'khril: g.yas pas gtsor 'byud kha ṭ+wāṃ ga: g.yon pa chags pa'i dung dmar stob yab yum thabs shes zung 'jug rgya: phyag rgya gar gyi mchod pa bzhes: // dpal chen badz+ra he ru ga dbu gsum྾/ /g.yas dkar〉/ /rigs lngas za/ /g.yas gsum rtsedagu kha ṭ+wāṃ rnga: g.yon gsum dril bhan rgyu zhags bsnams yum chen kro lha shwa rī ma: g.yas pas rki/ /g.yon par/ /yab yumadze/ /phyag rgyas/ /hūṃ/ dpal chen 'jam dpal bzhin rje gshed: dbu gsum ri/ /g.yas dkar〉/ /rigs lngas sko/ /g.yas gsum be con ral gri sta g.yon gsum sdigs mdzub mdung bhan dmar: yum chen ba1be+e tu snyi:g.yas pas ma/ /g.yon par/ /yab yumadze/ /phyag rgyas/ /hūṃ/ dpal chen rta mgrin pad+ma dbang :dbu gsum ma/ /g.yas dkar g.yon sngo dbus dmar zhal: dbu gtsug rta skad phyogs bcur sgrog rigs lngas dze/ /g.yas gsum rdo rje kha ṭ+wāṃ zhags: g.yon gsum dril bu bhan dmar sgrog yum chen e ka dzā gim g.yas pas ra / /g.yon pa ra / /yab yum dze / /phyag rgya 'i / /hūṃ/ dpal chen rdo rje gzhen nu che: dbu gsum ri/ /g.yas dkar snga/ /rigs lngas kho/ /g.yas gnyis rtse dgu rtse lnga ste: g.yon gnyis me dpung kha ṭ+wāṃ ga mtha' gnyis ri rab phur bu 'dril: yum chen 'khor lo —89

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (25)rgyas 'debs ma g.yas pas ra/ /g.yon par/ /yab yum mo/ /phyag rgyas/ / (11na〉〉/dpal chen bla med he ru ga: dbu gsum mo/ /g.yas dkar〉/ /rigs lngas mo/ / g.yas gsum rdo rje khyung sprul zhags g.yon gsum dung dmar zhing ga yum chen nyid bzhi yu kha cha g.yas pas sko/ /g.yon par/ /yab yum mo/ /phyag rgya mo/ /hūṃ/ dpal chen rigs 'dzin thod pa rtsal: zhal gcig phyag gnyis zhabs gnyis bgrad: sku mdog dkar dmar rus rgyan mdzes: rigs lngas mo/ /rdo rje dril bu'i phyag rgya bsgyur: yum chen chos dbyings rnal 'byor ma: gnyis med 'khril sbyor bde chen bskyed yab yum mo/ /phyag rgyas/ /hūṃ/ dpal chen dregs pa kun 'dul che dbu gsum sko/ /g.yas dkar〉/ /rigs lngas mo/ /g.yas gsum rdo rje lha brgyad mgo: g.yon gsum bhan dmar klu brgyad mgo: yum chen srid pa spyi 'dul ma: g.yas pas za/ /g.yon par/ /yab yumadze/ /phyag rgyar/ /hūṃ/ dpal chen stobs ldan nag po che: dbu gsumadze/ /sku mdog mthing nag 'gas pa la: rigasalngas mo/ /g.yas gsum rdo rje lha brgyad snying : g.yon gsum bhan dmar klu brgyad snying : yum chen 'byung ba lnga yi bdag: g.yas pas gzugs khams mkha' la 'degs g.yon pas 'dod khams sa la gnon yab yum mo/ /phyag rgyas/ /hūṃ/ so so'i rigs bzhi 'khor tsho gis rnams: zhal dang phyag mtshan cir yang bsgyur bde gshegs thams cad gar gyi bdag phyag rgya gar gyi mchod pa bzhes:mahā mu dra pā dza ho glu mchod ni/ (11bstu/ stong pa'i rang bzhin cir yang snang : snang ba'i mtshan nyid skye ba med glu ni 'du 'bral med pa'i glu bro ni bar chad med par brdung / rtswa mahā dzñā na te na hūṃ te te snrophyi mchod ni/ hūṃ/ rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i dkyil 'khor du bdug spos me tog mar me dri: zhal zas sil snyan mchod pa'i sprin dbyings nas btan te dbyings su 'bul: zho pa na po: pe nu su ri to ti pu pa ra mu: sarba ta tha ga ta sirnyi sa ma ya ho swo shrī badz+ra rā ga sgru pe snro pus lha: ā lo ke hrī: gharnye ho:ni bi sdi a gi ti shabha snro nang mchod ni/ ā+oṃ/ mchod pa'i phyag rgya wo po ni: sems kyi yid bzhin sprin tsho gis gtibs: gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya chos: 'dod yon lnga ldan mchod par bzhes : rtswa sarba pā dza —90

bka' brgyad gsang ba yongs rdzogs kyi las byang bklags chog dgos pa kun tshang / nang ma (ka)sam ya lho gsang mchod ni/ hūṃ/ 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug che: nga rgyal phrag dog nyen mongs lnga:ye nas rigs lnga'i rang bzhin yin: sbyor sgrol ting 'dzin dam mchod bzhes: ha la pañtsa pā dza hodug gsum mchod pa ni/ hūṃ/ sha khrag rus pa rnam pa gsum: dug gsum mchod pa bla na med: ye nas sku gsum rang bzhin te: rang grol nyid du mchod par bzhes: mahā phe sa: mahā rak+ta: mahā ke : ti khā sti sman mchod ni/ hūṃ/ rang byung gdod nas rnam par dag: rtsa brgyad stong las sbyar ba'i sman: rigasalnga dam tshig lnga yi dngos ye shes lnga rdzogs grub pa'i rdzas: rgyud lnga sems can kun bsgral phyir: dug (12na sko sel ba'i bdud rtsi che rtswa āḥ& sa rba pañtsa a mṛ ta hūṃ sngo hūṃ/ rtsa brgyad yan lag stong sbyar ba'i thun mong mchog dang khyad 'phags 'di: dus gsum bla ma yi dam lha: rgyal ba zhi khro'i lha tshogs la: rnam dag bdud rtsi dam rdzas mnyes mchod 'bul: thugs rjes brtser dgongs dbang dang dngos grub stsol : ca āḥ& sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta kha raṃ khā hi: sman mchod kyi lhan thabs ni gsar bsgrigs/ tshig snga ma gsum po brgyud 'debs ltar la/ dam rdzas myong grol sman mchod 'bul gyisabazhes/ ā+oṃ mahā sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta kha raṃ khā hi zhes kun la sbyar ba'i mthar/ bcom ldan bde gshegasazhi ba'i lha tsho gis dang / /dpal chen che mchog yon tan yang dag thugs/ /'jam dpal sku dang pad+ma gsung gi lhar/ /dam rdzas sko/ /lha'i/ /phur pa 'phrin las ma mo rbod gtong tshogs/ /rigs 'dzin slob dpon 'jig rten mchod bstod dang / /dmod pa drag sngags dpal gyi bka' srung la/ /dam rdzas mo/ /zhor/ /hūṃ/ lce yi dam tshig rdo rje la dam tshig can gyis hūṃ bsgoms te: mtheb srin thabs shes phyag rgya yis: myangs na dngos grub mchog thob 'gyur kā ya sirnyi 'o: lha kri rnyi āḥ tsit+ta sirnyi snro sarba sirnyi phyi gtor ma ni/ hūṃ/ dam rdzas lo byung gtor byu po 'dod yon lnga yi phung por 'bar thams cad tshim byed mchod sbyin che zhi khro yongs rdzogs thugs dam bskang : mahā ba smra ta khā hi: rak+ta (12ba ji/hūṃ/ ru dra bsgral ba'i khrag chen po lcang lor bcas pa'i bhañdza ra bskyil: 'khor ba dbyings su dag bya'i phyir dpal chen tshogs kyi zhal du 'bul: mahā rak+ta ji hi bdud rtsi gsang nan ni/ hūṃ/ rgyu gnyis —91

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ khodarkyen sbyar 'bru bcud 'di dug lnga sman gyur dam pa'i rdzas:dza gad dpa' bo'i bdud rtsi 'dis rgyal ba zhi khro'i thugs dam bskang :mahā pañtsa a mṛ ta dza gad khā sti sbyor mchod ni/hūṃ/dbyings rig gnyisamed sbyor ba yis:'khor 'das nyis su med par sbyor:gnyis med rtogs pa'i sbyor mchod 'dis rgyal ba yab yum mnyes gyur cig:dzaḥ/ baṃ ho:pad+ma yo gi ni sa ma ya bra be sha ya phaṭa:sgrol mchod ni/hūṃ/yang dag don rtogs blo yis ni:ma rtogs sems can gnas su bsgral:dus gsum bde gshegs de la mnyes:mchog gi mchod pa chen po bzhes/rtswa mahā shrī he ru ka ma tho ru dra bra bhañdza tsakra hūṃ phaṭa:pra be sha ya phaṭa:ti hūṃ a yaṃ lpa ra ṇa phaṭa:bstod pa ni/ā+oṃ/mnyam nyid chos sku'i rang bzhin las kun bzang zag pa med par bden sems can don la de bzhin gshegs thugs rje'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod āḥrtsol med rang byung chos sku'i sgra ma 'gags rang gsal 'dzin pa med:chags med skyon bral pad+ma'i gsung :yang dag gsung la phyag 'tshal bstod:྅/spros pa med pa dbyings kyi ngang :ma skyes 'jigs med rdo rje'i thugs blang dor med pa chos kyi dbyings 'gyur med 13nathugs la phyag 'tshal bstod:swā/chos dbyings rol pa chen po las rtsal dang rol par mi dmigasakyang :nam mkha' mdzod kyi cho 'phrul gyis yon tan re skong phyag 'tshal bstod:hā/rang bzhin cir yang ma nges kyang :dkyil 'khor chen po'i cha bzung nas rtog med dregs pa ngang gis 'dul:'phrin las mdzad la phyag 'tshal bstod:zho āḥ& byu mo lha da ya tshwa na maḥbastod pa'i lhan thabs ni/gter gzhung bcos med zhi khro spyir dril nas bstod pa/hūṃ/bcom ldan bde gshegs kun bzang rigs lnga yab gdug pa 'dul phyir khrag 'thung sku lngar ston bzang mo la sogs kro dhī yum rnamasa'akhril sems dpa' lcam dral mthar byed thub pa drug:dregs pa 'joms mdzad gtum rngam tshogasadang bcas zhi khro yongs rdzogs lha la phyag 'tshal bstod dkyil 'khor tshom bu dgu la so sor bstod pa ni/hūṃ/bcom ldan dpal chen che mchog he ru ga gnyis med bde sbyor gnam zhal dbyings phyug 'khril:rigs bzhi he ru ka yab yum yon tan sras:sprul pa'i khro bcu sgo skyong 'khor gyis bskor:9

bka' brgyad gsang ba yongs rdzogs kyi las byang bklags chog dgos pa kun tshang / nang ma (ka)bde gshegs dgongs 'dus che ba'i yon tan rgyas:che mchog yongs rdzogs lha la phyag 'tshal bstod:hūṃ/bcom ldan dpal chen badz+ra he ru ga:chags med bde sbyor kro dhī shwa rī 'khril:khrag 'thung rigasabazhi yab yum thugs kyi sras:gnas dang yul gyi ma tsho gos sgo 13bsgor bcas:dri med rnam dag thugs mchog 'gyur ba med yang dag yongs rdzogs ra//hūṃ/bcom ldan dpal chen 'jam dpal gshin rje gshed:sku lnga sbyor dang dug lnga sgrol yum 'khril:gshed bzhi yab yum sku yi sras dang bcas phyogs skyong ging bdud sgo bzhi phra men bskor:rab 'jigs rngam pa'i sku mchog khyad par che:gshin rje yongs rdzogs kho//hūṃ/bcom ldan dpal chen rta mgrin pad+ma dbang :pad+ma gzi ldan bde chen yum mchog 'khril dbang chen rigs bzhi yab yum gsung gi sras:phra men zil gnon khro rgyal sgo bar bcas gsung gi dbang phyug rta skad phyogs bcur sgrog:dbang chen yongs rdzogs za//hūṃ/bcom ldan dpal chen rdo rje gzhen nu che:gsang chen dgyes mdzad 'khor lo rgyas 'debs 'khril:'phrin las sras bzhi khro bcu yab yum bcas:za gsod ma tshogs ming po sgo bas bskor:'phrin las bdag nyid rtsal chen 'gro ba 'dul:phur pa yongs rdzogs lha lam//hūṃ/bcom ldan dpal chen che btsan mngon rdzogs sku dgyes mdzad yum chen nyid bzhi mu kha 'khril:rtag rgyal ma lnga bde chen kun gyi sras:ye shes rje mo sman mo sgo skyong bcas:las kyi bdag mo rbod gtong pho nyar 'gyed:ma mo yongs rdzogs dze//hūṃ/bcom ldan dpal wo rigs 'dzin thod pa rtsal mi dmigs rdo rje rnal 'byor gsang yum 'khril:thugs kyi sras mchog slob dpon rigs bzhi ste:dpa' bo dpa' mo sgo bzhi srung 4na 'dzad bcas:rgyud lung man ngag mnga' bdag rig pa 'dzin:bla ma yongs rdzogs྾//hūṃ/dregs pa kun 'dul khro rgyal mi bzad pa:khams gsum srid pa spyi 'dul yum mchog 'khril:thugs sras pho nya sde bzhi yab yum bcas:sdodang dpon bcas sgo skyong dregs pa'i tshogaslozhi rgyas dbang drag las rnams ci bcol bsgrub:'jig rten yongs rdzogos mo//hūṃ/mthu stobs rtsal ldan rab gtum khro bo'i rgyal:kun grol 'byung 9ba mnga' bdag yum mchog 'khril:thugs sras

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (25)dregs pa las mkhan yab yum bzhi: dam tshig dbang gis bstan bsrung sngags bdag tshogs drag po bco brgyad gdug pa'i mtshon ngar can: drag sngags yongs rdzogs mo/ /bka' srung gi bstod pa ni/hūṃ/ dus gsum bde gshegs yongs rdzogs spyan snga phu dam mnos rang rtags srog gi snying po phul:bka' stsal gnyer blangs rdzu 'phrul gar gyi bdag ma ltar byams shing sring ltar dungs sems kyis:dkyil 'khor ming 'dzin rnal 'byor yongs la skyob bka' srung yongs rdzogs mo/ /don gyi bstod pa ni/hūṃ/ rnam dag ye shes thugs kyi dkyil 'khor du: 'gro don 'dod dgur bsgyur zhing gtso dang 'khor:ji ltar sprul yang ye shes rig pa'i rtsal: rang shar rang grol bde gshegs g.yung drung lha: rnam dag chos kyi dbyings las ma g.yos pa'i thams cad chos skur yongs rdzogs lha la bstod: bshags (14ba)pa ni/ hūṃ/ zhi khro bde gshegs yongs rdzogs dgongs: sngon nas rang dang mnyam nyid don:ma rtogs rigs mtshan so sor bzung : dbyer med rnam dag klong du bshags sa ma ya e ho shu rje ā:ā+oṃ shrī badz+ra he ru ka sa ma ya: ma nu pā la ya badz+ra he ru ka twe no pa ti khru rdo me bha ba su to stso me bha ba/ a nu ra sto me bha ba su po skyo me bha ba sarba sirnyi m+me pra la sarba na me su tsa me tsa sto shri ya ku ru hūṃ ha ha ha ha ho bha ga wa na badz+ra he ru ka mā me mu he ru ko bha ba: mahā sam ya satwa āḥ& phaṭa dzub ni/ rgyud las: zhi bar bsnyen cing khro bor bsgrub ces pas zhi bsnyen dzub bskul ba ni: ྅/ gsang ba yongs rdzogs dkyil 'khor du: che mchog dpal dgu'i dbu rgyan nang : thabs shes nyi zla pad+ma'i steng : mi bskyod rnam par snang mdzad dang : rin 'byung snang mtha' don yod grub: yum chen kun bzang sangs rgyas spyan: mā ki gos dkar dam tshig sgrol: rgyal ba yab yum phyag mtshan bcas: kun bzang yab yum dgyes par sbyor sras mchoge sos dpa' sems mar bcas sprul sku thub drug mthar byed brgyad: mnyen lhag 'khril ldem gzhen tshul can: gsal 'tsher lhun sdug gzi brjid 'bar dbu rgyan cod pan 'phreng ba dang / do shal dpung rgyan se mo do: rin cen dar dpyangs chas rnams rdzogs gsung ni yang snying sngags sgra sgrog: thugs ni rang byung ye shes gsal dzub kyis sku gsung thugs rgyu da —94

bka' brgyad gsang ba yongs rdzogs kyi las byang bklags chog dgos pa kun tshang / nang ma (ka)bskul: spros pas stong (15na〉gsum sku yis gang : sku las gsung byon sngags 'brug ldir: bsdus pas chos dbyings mkha' la thim: ma gsal bar du bskyed cing bsgom ma grub bar du mi btang ngo :ā+oṃ ā li kā li dzñā na pañtsa satwa kro dha mu na ye swāg swo bo dhi tsit+ta mahā su kha dzñā na dh+wa tu griPROB PROB āḥ& swāhāhūṃ lī māṃ bī 〉 snying po brgya stong bzlas rjes su: rtags dang sbyar la stong tshigs mchode: ྅/ dbusaphyogs 'khor lo'i gzhal yas su: zla gam dbang chen e dkyil du: byol song gtso brgyad dregs pa'i steng : thabs shes nyi zla 'od kyi dkyil: ma chags pad+ma'i ge sar la: bcom ldan che mchog he ru ga:yum chen gnam zhal dbyings phyug ma gnyis med 'khril sbyor cha lugs ni sgeg pa dpa' ba 'jigs su rung : sgod dang gshe dang snying rje rngam: 'bar khro zhi sogs gar dgur ldan: sku la dur khrod chas rnams rdzogs: gsung ni drag po'i sngags sgra sgrog: thugs ni sgrol mdzad srog dang bcas:dzub kyis sku gsung thugs rgyud bskul: phaṭa kyis spros pas stong gsum gang : bsdus pas yum gyi mkha' la 'khyil: gsang ba'i sbubs nas thugs kur thim ma gsal bar du bskyed cing bsgom: ma grub bar du mi btang ngo : zho badz+ra kro dha mahā shrī he ru ka hūṃ phaṭa: zho ru lu ru lu hūṃ bh+yo ྅: zho hrī:hiḥwi kri tā na na hūṃ phaṭa rtswa ha ya snri ba hu lu hu lu hūṃ phaṭa tshwa badz+ra gī li gī lā ya hūṃ phaṭaḥ nī gu spo dzñā na shrī he ru ka kro sgyi shwa rī (15bstu phaṭa: rlu badz+ra mahā gu ru sarba hūṃ phaṭa swo badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa sarba dus na hūṃ phaṭa: rlu badz+ra sarba du gu na e dza bh+yo hūṃ phaṭa: ྅/ yang sprul khyung chen bka' sdod tshogs bzlas brjod bsnyen pa'i mchod pa bzhes: khro ga ru ḍa hūṃ phaṭa: sarba ḍā ka ni sa ma ya hri hrī hūṃ phaṭa: rlu badz+ra mahā kro dha pad+ma kro sgyi shwa rī badz+ra gī li ki lwa ya mahā ya ka k+ṣa la rū pa ga me raṃ raṃ dz+wa la raṃ hūṃ phaṭa: ྅/ ye shes lha tshogs spyan 'dren gshegs phyi nang gsang ba'i tshogs mchod 'bul: sku gsum thugs yon 'phrin las bstod: nyams chags 'gal 'khrul ci mchis bshags tshwa āḥ& mahā pañtsa ba kla ta rak+ta ra sti zhes stong tshigs mchod pa bya zhing : rtags sam grangs bsnyen bdun 'bum nyi khrir sbyar zhing bzlas so:dngos grub blang ba ni/ hūṃ/ lha dang rigs 'dzin mkha' 'gro dgongs: 'dir 'dus rigs 'dzin bdag —95

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()cag rnams smin grol gnyis kyi rgyud sbyang zhing :bskyed rdzogs gnyis kyi las gzhung bsrang bsnyen sgrub rnam gsum mtha' ru phyin las dang thugs rje mthun pa yi zhi rgyas dbang drag yid bzhin gter:sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub stsol:zho āḥlha kā ya lha kyi t+ta sirnyi hūṃ a rjes kyis las khrigs bstogacig ste:che ba bskyed cing 'phrin las bskul:tshogs dang lhag chog gtor skyong bya:gtor zor bstan ma rnam bzhi'i bro dkyil 'khor bsdu bskang rgyun spyod bya:de dag las gzhud rtsa thor sdebs:skal ba can dang 'di phrad shog:ces gsungs16na ) pa'i tsho gos ni/yo byad bdud rtsis bsang zhing /ā+oṃ u ( be+e tā lī kro dha ni sarba dra bye /sho dha ni hūṃ phaṭa swāhā//rdo rje lta bu'i ye shes kyis:chosakun thams cad sgyu mar rig:rig pa'i ye shes raṃ yaṃ kho tsho gos kyi dngos po bsreg sbyang bkru:re yaṃ kho tshogs byin rlabs kyi lhan thabs ni/sgom khog gi tshig don tshigs bcad du bsdebs pa/tsho gos kyi yo byad stong pa'i ngang //a dang ma las nyi zla yi//snod du 'bru gsum zhu ba las//'dod yon lnga ldan phung por gyur//bskang rdzas byin rlabs kyi lhan thabs ni/gsar bsgrigs/gzhan yang thugs dam skong ba'i rdzas su gyur ba/bdud rtsi sman gyi mar pa/rak+ta dmar gyi a:/༅ du byung ba'i gtor ma/sha chen lang ling sna tshogs/zhun chen mar me'i snang gsal/sha chen gsur gyi dud pa/thod pa ltag sprod/rnga/dung wo/rkang gi gling bu/thun mong mar pa sna tshogs/lo byung dam rdzas mdangs ldan/ri rab gling bzhi'i mdos chen sogs dngos su 'byor pa dang yid kyis sprul pa'i mchod pa'i sprin phung phyi 'dod yon gyi lha mo/nang ye shes kyi bdud rtsi/gsang ba byang chub sems kyi rang bzhin/rgya nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam zhing dus 'khor ba ji srid kyi bar du 'byung bar gyur/ā+oṃ āḥ&:྅/rgyal ba zhi khro'i lha tsho gos rnams:ye shes rol pa'i tshogs la gshegs dam tshig dkyil 'khor gnas 'dir bzhugs:bdag dad gus pas phyag 'tshal lo 16ba3/gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya chos:mdzes snyan dri zhim ro bda' zhing :reg bde glu gar chos yid tshim:'dod yon mar pas thugs dam bskang :bskang ba'i lhan thabs ni/ gter gzhung bcos med/ ༷༷ po dgongs su gsol ba ni:// zhi khro rgyal ba

bka' brgyad gsang ba yongs rdzogs kyi las byang bklags chog dgos pa kun tshang / nang ma (ka)yongs rdzogs lha 'gro la phan mdzad thugs rje'i bdag: sems can kun gyi gnyen gcig pu kun nas bdag la dgongs su gsol: zhes brjod pas chos sku las gzugs skur bzhengs par bsam mo: de nas bshags pa bya ba ni: ྅/ shar nas badz+ra a khyo sa: rdo rje rigs kyi thugs dam la: zhe sdang dam tshigs nyams so 'tshas 'di yang mi 'chab mthol lo bshags ྅/ lho nas rat+na /bha tswa rin chen rigs kyi ra/ /nga rgyal྾/ /'di yang ྾/ /hūṃ/ nub nas pad+ma dhe ba 3 pad+ma rigs kyi mo/ /'dod chags mo/ /'di yang ྾/ /hūṃ/ byang nas a mo gha si phyi kyilas rigs kyi rki/ /phrag dogs/ /'di yang ྾/ /hūṃ/ dbus na be+e ro tsa na bzhugs: de bzhin rigs kyis/ /gti mugs/ /'di yang ྾/ /de nas bskang rdzas rang rtags brjod pa ni/ mchod rdzas rnams thogs te dkyil 'khor la bskor zhing 'di skad do/ /hūṃ/ bskang ngo bskal pa'i bar du thugs dam bskang : bskang ba med de khams gsum yongs kyis bskang : sbyor ba med de khams gsum yongs la sbyor: sgrol ba med de khams gsum yongs kyis sgrol ye sbyor ye sgrol chen (17na)pos thugs dam bskang : thugs dam gnyan po bskang ba'i rdzas rnams ni: rtsa brgyad stong las sbyar ba'i bdud rtsi dang : khyad par ra du byung ba'i gtor ma dang :'khor ba rgyu las bsgral ba'i rak+ta dang : rnam dag rgyu bsgral baṃ chen rdzas mchog dang : 'bru bcud stong las sbyar ba'i dzā gad dang : phyi nang gsang ba'i longs spyod sna tshogs kyis: bskang ngo bskal pa'i bar du thugs dam bsnang : de nas bye brag tshom bur bskang ba ni/ zhi ba lhun gyis grub pa'i dkyil 'khor nas zhes pa nas/ bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis rgyal ba thugs dam can: mi ma can dbyings nas spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol dam tshig dbang gis dkyil 'khor brtan par bzhugs: gnyis su med par phyag 'tshal mchod par 'bul: thugs dam skong gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsol: zhes tshom bu dgu'i lha thams cad la 'gres su shes par bya ste/ mtshan don bye brag tu bskang ba'o/ /skabs su dam rdzasarang rtags gong bzhin brjod la bskang ngo / /de rjes su sgos dmigs 'dod gsol gdab pa ni/ nad gdon bar chad thams cad zhi bar mdzod tshe dbang longs spyod thams cad rgyas par mdzod kham —97

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (25)gsum srid gsum gdul bya dbang du sdus: gnod byed dgra bgegs 'byung po tshar chod cig cesasbyar ro/ /sgos khud pa'i lha dang rang bsten pa'i srung ma rnams la'ang bskang gso mtshan nas brjod de bya'o zhes pa ltar/ ma ning gi gsol mchod ni/ hūṃ/ dad pa dang ni (17bskom tshig gis tshur gshegs tshur gshegs lha chen po mahā kā la mthu bo che: gsang ba'i khro rgyal stobs po che: 'chol ba'i khro rgyal dgra bgegs gshed ma ning nag po kun gyi rje: 'og min gnas mchag dam pa dang : gsang chen lhun grub gtsug lag khang : dur khrod rab 'jigs gzhal yas nas: gnas 'dir brtse phyir gshegs su gsol: thugs dam dbang gis gshegs su gsol bstan pa bsrung phyir gshegs su gsol: e gye hi bha ga lhan shrī mahā kā la ga ṇa gu pho dzaḥdza:hūṃ/ dur khrod rab 'jigs gzhal yas dam pa 'dir: dregs pa ru dra bsnol ba'i khri yi steng :nyi zla pad+ma brtsegs pa'i gdan steng du: khro rgyal ma ning 'khor bcas brtan par bzhugs: ྅/ chosadabyings skye ba med pa'i pho brang nas skye ba'i cho 'phrul khro rgyal ma ning sku mnyam med mthu mnga' gtum chen me ltar 'bar ru dra 'joms mdzad bdud dpung thal bar rlog: mthar byed gzhen nu 'joms pa'i gad brgyangs can: mahā kā la khyod la phyag 'tshal lo: khyod la mchod pa dam pa 'bul ba ni: thod wo brgyu tho pa'i snod mchog 9 ba kla gtor ma'i tsho gos ni rongs se rong : mahā rma sal sogs sha sna stong : mahā tsit+ta la sogs snying sna stong : ba su ta dang nang khrol rnam pa lnga dbang po lnga dang go ro tsa na dang : 'dod yon lnga yi mchod pa dam pa 'dis che mchog he ru ka yi thugs dam bskang : dpal mgon ma ning nag po'i thugs dam bskang : (18na tshe sprul 'khor nyi khri chig stong thugs dam bskang : 'khor dang bcas pa'i thugs dam skongs gyur cig rtswa shrī mahā kā la ga ṇa spo raṃ sirnyi hūṃ dza mahā pañtsa a skṛ ta ba kla ta rak+ta sarba pū tsa khā myi zhes pa tsam mam/ spro na bstod pa 'dir bya zhing /yang na bstod pa kho nas kyang chog par gsungs pa 'di ltar/ hūṃ hūṃ/ 'jig rten 'das pa'i dus nasasngon byung ba: che mchog he ru ka dpal sku gsum rdzogs: srid rtsa bdag 'dzin ru dra sdogasum 'dul:—98

bka' brgyad gsang ba yong rdzogs kyi las byang bklags cho go dgos pa kun tshang / nang ma (ka)rtsal wo 'phrin las mdzad la phyag 'tshal bstod dpal chen dngos sprul nag po chen po'i sku:'chol pa'i khro rgyal ma ning dgra bgegs gshed:lha chen dpal 'bar chos skyong yongs kyi rje dmag dpon ོ po'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod:྅/dur khrod thod mkhar me rma 'tshe dkyil nas rnal 'byor dpal mgon khyod kyi cha lugs ni:sku mdog mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa sku gsum ldan phyir spyan gsum gyen thur gzigs:rab 'jigs khro gnyer sum ldan gas la rngam rin r+pā thod skam lnga yis dbu la brgyan:sbrul nag ral pa nag pos sa gzhi khyab:g.yas pa ru mtshon g.yon pa snying zhags bsnams tsan+dan beng chen sked btsugs lha dmag 'gyed thod pa skam rlon snying 'phreng sbrul chun spras:dar nag ber gsol gser sked mi lpags bcings las la yos tshe srog bdud cha lugs 'dzin srid gsum gzigs phyir spyan gsum brang la shar dmag dpon 147zhi 'gyed spyan bzhis lhu tshigs brgyan stag ral gzigs shubs btags nas rta nag zhon bdud mda' dgra snying gzer nas gling bzhir rgyug spyan nas khrag 'dzag me yi kha rlangs 'bar:kha ṭ+wāṃ gri gug lcagasapar thogs nas ni snang srid pho rgyud thams cad pho yi 'gyed ci bcol las rnams skad cig yud kyis bsgrub rtag tu grogs mdzad mgon po nag po'i sku ma bskul bar yang brnag pa'i dgra bgegasasgrol ltag nas spyan gcig ma tsho gos dmag dpung 'gyed gar bskul sa ru mi ro'i tshar ma rtser:bzlog pas mi bzlog sngags bzlog mkhan gyi gshed sdo brgyad bran 'khol stag sham mi lpags brgyan:gtsug lag khang bsrung dkor rkun rtsad nas gcod:dregs pa kun 'dul khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod:dam rdzas bdud rtsi wor ba 'di bzhes la:rnal 'byor bcol ba'i tshon las sgrub par mdzod:dregs pa'i sde dpon sum cu'i gsol ka ni/drag sngags so lnga pa'i mjug du badz+ra sarba dus e dza bh+yo:sha nyu hur /dza mā ra la rbad mahā de wa e/u ma de sa e/ya ma rā tsa ya/ya ma da rnyi ya/ma ma ru lu ma/e ka dza ti tso/du khrag du/du ca du/rā tsa tsa/giṅka ra tri/badz+ra swā dhu tri/rā hu las/raka ra/ra smo ra/yak+ṣa k+ṣa/yaklo k+ṣa/mahā kā la/9/ru dra dhi/mun mun pa/tirti /tha/de wa a/a

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (25)se la a/ tiṣ+ṭha dri ltu tsa/ a pi shu ku/ tri pa sha li tri/ (19na7 she tri/ byi na ya ga u/ ḍā gi nī me/ nā ga phu nā ga kro tī shwa ri phu sarba dun hri hri dzaḥdza mi spyan drangs re yaṃ khaṃ/ ā+oṃ āḥ/ gis ri rab 'dod yon sna tshogs su bsam/ sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung bar zhal bzhes pa dbang phyug che sogs lha srin ldebargyad la rnam dag bdud rtsi dam dzos mnyes mchode 'bul: mthu rtsal drag po'i dngos grub stsal du gsol: 'dod yon rgyan gyis brgyan pa'i gtor ma dang : las ngan nyams pa bsgral ba'i rak+ta dang : dug gsum rnam dag sha khrag rus pa'i tshogs: dregs pa 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la 'bul:dgra bo gdug pa bsgral phyir bzhes su gsol: lha srin sde brgyad khyed rnams mchod pa'i dam rdzas ni:dkar dmar la sogs kha dog bye brag rnams: lha srin sde brgyad sku la mchod par 'bul snyan dang mi snyan sgra yi bye brag rnams: lha srin sde brgyad gsung las tsit+ta smug po dzo ltar spungs pa yang / lha srin sdebargyad thugs la spo: sku gsung thugs kyi mchod pa 'di bzhes la/ /sgrol ging pho mos las rnamasasgrub par mdzod: lha srin sde brgyad 'dir spyon sha la spyon dam nyams dgra bo'i sha ni zan pas ni ma:lha srin sdebargyad 'dir spyon khrag la spyon dam nyams dgra bo'i khrag ni chang bas zhim: lha srin sdobargyad 'dir spyon rus la spyon dam nyams dgra bo'i rus ni mar bsazhim: lha srin sdebargyad rnams la dug gsum mchod par 'bul dug gsum bzhes la dgra bgegs bsgral du gsol: (19ba tshe skyo ma hā de wa e sogs kyi mthar/ ma hā ba sla ta khā hi/ ma hā pañtsa ri/ /ma hā rak+ta'i/ /lan gsum gyi rjesasu ā+oṃ āḥ/ sam ya a my-i ta khā hi: snying nye bran pho bran mo'i tshogs dam las ma 'da' sam ya bdag gi srung mar mnga' gsol lo: sangs rgyas bstan pa khyed kyis srungs dkon cog dbu 'phang khyed kyis bstod rnal 'byor sku dgra khyed kyis sgrol: ྅/ bkra shis dam ldan mthu che ba snang srid dregs pa'i sdod pon bzhengs dbang phyug mahā de wa dang : btsun mo u ma de ri bcas 'dod yon mchod gtor 'di bzhesal bcol ba'i 'phrin las sgrub par mdzod: ྅/ ba po shis dam ldan ri/ /snang srid dregs pa'i sko 'chi bdag ya ma rā tsa dang : skye 'gro srog gi ma mo bcas 'dod ྾/ /—100

bka' brgyad gsang ba yong rdzogs kyi la byang bklag chog dgos pa kun tshang / nang ma (ka)bcol ba'i ྾//hūṃ/bkra shis zo//ma mo srid pa'i rgyal mo dang :sngags srung e ka dzā smi bcas:'dod ྾//bcol ྾//hūṃ/bkra shis ྾//snang srid ྾//bdud po skos rje brang dkar dang :bdud mo nag mo ri tī bca'adod ྾//bcol ྾//hūṃ/bkra shis ྾//snang srid ྾//rgyal po chen po pe skar dang :srog bdag tshangs pa dkar po bcas:'dod ྾//bcol ྾//hūṃ/bkra shis ྾//snang srid ྾//skyes mchoge rdo rje legs pa dang :gza' bdud chen po rā hu la:'dod ྾//bcol ྾//hūṃ/ba po shis ra//snang srid ྾/sti'i po nag po glog 'phreng dang :srin mo sbal mgo khrag mig bcas:'dod ྾//bcol ྾//hūṃ/bkra shis mo//snang 20na jid ྾//gnod sbyin yak+ṣa tshe dbawa dang gnod sku mon mon ga mo ba cha 'dod ྾/kha khyol྾//hūṃ/ba po shis za//snang srid ྾//mgon nag ma hā kā la dang :ban chen rdo rje bdud 'dul bcas:'dod ྾//bcol ྾//hūṃ/bkra shis sko//snang srid ྾//rmu bdud nag po bkrag med dang :mu stegs gu lang nag po bcas:'dod ྾//bcol ྾//hūṃ/bkra shis mo//snang srid ྾//srid pa'i lha rabs sham po dang :gnam sman thog gi bu yug bcas 'dod ྾//bcol ྾//hūṃ/bkra shis ྾//snang srid ྾//ma sangs g.ya' spang skyes gcig dang :brag btsan srog zan dmar po bcas:'dod ྾//bcol ྾//hūṃ/bkra shis ྾//snang srid ྾/khrog bdag gnam the'u dkar po dang :bzha 'gong yam shud dmar pob ma 'dod ྾//bcol྾//shu bkra shis za//snang srid ྾//bgegs rgyal bi na ya ga dang :dpal ldan nag mo mgyogs byed bcas 'dod ྾//bcol ྾//hūṃ/bkra shis ྾//snang srid ྾//klu bdud nag po mgo dgu dang :klu mo nag mo gdug byed bcas:'dod yon mchod gtor 'di bzhes la:bcol ba'i 'phrin las sgrub par mdzod:gter bdag gi gsol ka ni/dge bsnyen she'u kha ri dang :jo bo klu bdud mgo dgu dang :ston ka nag po ti pa tsa gter srung tsho gos rnams gnas 'dir spyon nyer spyod 'dod yon gtor ma sogs:mthun pa'i dam rdzas tshogos kyis mchode/nyams chags 'gal 'khrul ci mchis bshags:

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (25)(20ba)thugs dam skong ngo dngos grub stsol: a kā ro lan gsum gyis gtore ma bsngo de wa nā ga sapa ri wā ra a nas sha rdi'i bar brjod de nas rkyen bzlog byol gdab pa ni/ lha'i nga rgyal dang ldan pas thal mo brdab cing 'di skad do/ /ho/ de ltar bskang bskang gso gso nas 'di ltar kho nar bzlog bsgyur mdzod rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la yas kyis bdud du g.yos pa bzlog mas kyis sri ru langs pa moḥ pha tshan nang gi rgya 'dreraḥ dar tshan nang gi stong 'dresaḥ g.yas na pho brgya mda' brdar〉ཿ g.yon na mo brgya du g.yos riḥ rgyab na mi gsum gros byed moḥ mdun na rta gsum srab yo 'khoḥ 'ug pa spo la rgod paraḥ srin bya gong khar 'bod pa mo: logs la wa spyang brgyal bskoḥ srod la khyim bya 'tsher b.raḥ tho rang sgo khyi ngu bzaḥ ltas ngan brgyad cu rtsa gcigasaban bon ༅ sngags zor khamaḥ lo geg zla keg ki dang mo glo bur brgyad cu rtsa gcig skoḥ ye 'byog sum brgya drug curaḥ bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi'i nad rnams〉ཿ dus min 'chi ba rnam brgyad loḥ stong phrag brgyad cu'i bgegs rnams moḥ rtsis byas rde'u nag po oḥ mo ngan rmi lam ngan paraḥ mi nag skye bo'i ya gsaḥ bran 'khol ga pa'i dmod mchu〉ཿ pho bh+yo de ni g.yas su bh+yo: mo byol de ni g.yon du byol: spyi bdud de ni mkha' la byol: ngan pa thams cad sdang ba dgra la bh+yo: dgra dang bgegs la bh+yo bh+yo bh+yo: zhes brjod/ tsho gos phud rim pa gsum spros te: snyi/ bla med (21na skoyo go gi mchod sbyar bsaye shes lnga yi 'od zer 'phro: 'dod yon lha mos rab brgyan 'bul dam skongs dbang dang dngos grub stsol( tshwa na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yo bi shwa mu khe saḥ sarba thā kho ldi te lpa ra ṇa i mo ga ga na — swāhālan gsum/ hūṃ/ ma rig bdag cag lusang ga sems bag med dam 'gal 'byor tsho gos chudas bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro yi: thugs dang 'gal gyur bzod par gsol: a ho ma hā su kha sa ma ya ho:che ba bskyed pa ni/ hūṃ/ snang srid thams cad gzhal yas khang : gzugs snang thams cad he ru ga:thams cad thams cad bran du khol: nga las che ba su yang med / hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ snro 'phrin lasabaskul ba ni/ hūṃ/ chos sku skye med ngang nyid las: gzugs sku 'jigs pa'i cha lugs bzhengs zhi —102

bka' brgyad gsang ba yong rdzogs kyi las byang bklag chog dgos pa kun tshang / nang ma zhanargyas dbang dang mdzo spyod las bcol ba'i phren las sgrub par mdzod / hūṃ hūṃ/badz+ra sarba sa ska:ā+oṃ shān+ti:swā gos ā lo zu hā mā ra ya phaṭa:sarba sirnyi ku ru byu zor sarba bzlog bh+yo:bskul gyi lhan thabs ni/hūṃ/mi mngon dbyings na bzhugs pa rgyal ba zhi khro'i tshogs āḥbazhengs shig bzhengs shig chos kyi dbyings nas bzhengs tshwa/bskul lo bskul lo sems can don la bskul gyi mdzod cig mdzod cig bcol ba'i 'phrin las mdzod āḥchos sku skye ba med pa'i ngang nyid las rtswa/skye ba'i cho 'phrul longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku:2bstu/sprul skus 'gro ba sems can don mdzad pa:khyiḥzhi khro bka' brgyad lha tsho gis thugs dam can:chu/gzugs snang thams cad sku yi rang bzhin la:āḥsgra grag thams cad gsung gi ngo bor snang ://dran rtog thams cad thugs kyi dgongs par 'dus:gyi phyogs bsto dus bzhi'i bde gshegs bcom ldan 'das lha/zhi ba lhun gyis grub pa'i dkyil 'khor nas seng ge glang chen rta khyung rma bya'i khri rin chen nyi zla pad+ma 'od 'bar steng :dpal 'bar zhi ba yongs rdzogs lha tshogs ni:rdo rje sems dpa' sangs rgyas kun gyi gtso nam mkha' kun bzang bde gshegs yum chen sbyor rnam snang rin 'byung mtha' yas don yod grub:sangs rgyas spyan dang mā ma gos dkar sgrol sa snying nam snying spyan ras phyag rdor dpal:lu se mā le gi ti ni rti ma byams pa sgrib sel kun bzang 'jam pa'i dbyangs sgru pe pu 〉 di pe gharnye ma kun bzang yid la bzang mo chosadabyings yum lha dbang brgya byin thags bzang shākya thub seng ge rab brtan kha 'bar chos kyi rgyal:rnam rgyal gshin rje rta mgrin bdud rtsi 'khyil:lcags kyu zhags pa lcags sgrog dril 'khrol sogs bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis rgyal ba thugs dam can:mi mngon dbyings nas gnas 'dir sku skyod cig:dam rdzas bdud rtsi 'bar ba 'di bzhes la:thugs dam rgyud bskul bcol ba'i 'phrin las mdzod ho/bde gshegs zhi ba'i lha tsho gos thugs dam can khyed rnams22nal mchod pa 'bul ba ni:phyi nang gsang ba sman ra gagatore ma'i mchod pa bzhes shig ma hā pa: bha smra ta rak+ta sarba pā tsa khā sti bshagasapar gsol ba ni/spyi dang khyad par rtsa ba yan lag 0gi dam tshig la nyams chags dang 'gal 'khrul du

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()gyur pa mthol zhing bshags so:sam ya ā:'phrin las su bcol ba ni/zhi rgyas dbang drag gi 'phrin las rnam bzhi bdag gi yid bzhin du sgrubs la log lta gdug pa can thams cad myur du tshar chod cig 'jigs brgyad shān+ti ku ru me swāhā lor drug pustimaḥkhams gsum pa shesaḥdagra bgegs mā ra ya rbad dus min 'chi ba'i nad gdon bar chad rbod zor ltas ga bzlog bh+yo:de ltar mchod bshags bcol gsum 'og ma tshom bu dgu char la mtshan bsgyur 'gres su she sa par bya'o:྅/khro bo rol pa'i dur khrod r+ṣa po nas byol song gtso brgyad lha chen khri steng na nyi ma zla ba pad+ma ge sar steng :che mchog yon tan yongs rdzogs lha tsho gos ni:bcom ldan dpal chen che mchog he ru ga:gnyis med yum chen gnam zhal dbyings phyug 'khril raka gu spo bi sha ya sgo ste:he ru /bzhi kro tī yum dang bcas lha dang dri za me lha gshin rje srin chu bdag rlung lha gnod sbyin bgegs sa'i bdag:phyogs skyong 'dul byed khro bo chen po bcu:pradzha ya ma pad+ma big nan te:ta spo ta sgo skyong ce spyang ma brgyad so gos sum sto rtsa gnyis rgyal ba thugs dam can:mi mdzom:dam rdzas zo thugs dam mo ho/che mchog yon to lha tshogs khyed rnams la ri://khrag 'thung rol pa'i dur khrod wo po nas:dregs pa ru dra bsnol ba'i khri steng na nyi ma zla ba 22ba ) pad+ma ge sar steng :thugs mchogo yang dag yongs rdzogs lha tsho gos ni:bcom ldan dpal chen badz+ra he ru
