ga:gnyis med yum chen kro tī shwa rī 'khril:burnya rat+na pad+ma ga mi ste:he ru ka bzhi kro tī yum dang sbyor tse'u ri tso'u ri pra mo pe tā li pu ka ga sma sma sha tsan+ta li:sidha bya gh+ri sri la sho na ma kṛ ta gaṅka khā kha hu lu ma gnas yul ke sing bsto drug ma tsho gis dang :lcags kyu zhags pa lcags sgrog dril bu ma:sgo bzhin rab rngams ye shes sgo ma bzhi bka' sdod dbang phyug nyer brgyad la sogs te:lnga bcu rtsa brgyad rgyal brki:mi mngon mo:dam rdzasaza thugs dam rki ho/yang dag thugs kyi lha tsho gos za //gshin rje rol pa'i dur khrod chen po nas chu glang zung bzhi gshibs pa'i khri steng na nyi ma zla ba pad+ma ge sar steng :sku mchog gshin rje yongs rdzogs lha tshogs ni bcom ldan dpal // 'jam dpal gshin rje bshed sbyor sgrol yum

bka' brgyad gsang ba yong rdzogs kyi las byang bklags chog dgos pa kun tshang / nang ma (ka)chen pe ta dza ti 'khril ya ma rā tsa ral gcig myos byed gtum: ārla 'od zer tshar dgu re ma 〉 sku sras gshed bzhi yab dang yum du bcas: nag 'joms re twe phya sangs gdong dgu ma brag 'jomasashel mig glang mgo mche gtsigs ma ya ba rngam stabs mig dmar khrag ral can: dmigs pa klu mo tel pa spyan gcig ma bdud 'joms ral gcig chos rgyal ral ba can rje dmar rab nag thod dbyug phag mgo ma phyogs skyong gshed chen ba lcaganyis yum dang bcas rgod stag gaṅka spyang mgo (23na〉sko skyong bzhi gyi thogs ging bzhi khram thogs bdud bo bzhi shod thogs rtsis bzhi srog gcod bshan pa bzhi gdug pa gza' gdong yi dwags la sogs te: lnga bcu rtsa lnga rgyal bar mi mngon ra dam rdzas ra: thugs dam o ho/ 'jam dpal sku'i lha tsho gos rki: ྅/ pad+ma rol ba'i dur khrod chen po nas klu rgyal gdug pa pho mo'i khri steng na nyi ma zla ba pad+ma ge sar steng : gsung mchog pad+ma yongs rdzogs lha tsho gos ni: bcom ldan dpal chen pad+ma dbang gi ga cha gnyis med yum chen pad+ma gzi ldan 'khril sku las sprul pa byi la pu shud mgo: rdo rje rin cen pad+ma las dbang chen:dbang phyug rigs bzhi yum bcas gsung gi sras zhi khro zil gnon mi pham khro gnyer ma ma khyung zil gnon ro langs spyan gcig ma pho mo zil gnon khro mo gshin rje mo: gza' klu zil gnon klu mo gnod sbyin mo zil gnon khro bo yab yum brgyad rnams dang : 'gugs 'dren sdom brdeg ye shesasgo ma bzhi khams rgya ma drug dmus long rgyab 'brel bzhi: ye shes dpal gyi spyang brgyad khyi brgyad dang : pho nya mche gshog ngur 'brug dbang phyug sogs drug cu rtsa gsum rgyal bas mi ma cane kho dam rdzas mo: thugs dmadze ho/ pad+ma gsung gi lha tshogs ri: ྅/ phur ba rol ba'i dur khrod chen po nas ma hā de wa bsnol ba'i khri steng na nyi ma zla ba pad+ma ge sar steng : 'phrin las phur ba yongasardzogs lha tsho gis ni bcom ldan dpal chen (23ba)rdo rje gzhen nu'i sku gnyis med yum chen 'khor lo rgyas 'debs 'khril sras mchog bhud+dha rat+na pad+ma dang : karma gī la ya sogs yum dang bcas hūṃ kār rnam rgyal dbyug sngon gshin rje gshed mi g.yo rta mgrin 'dod rgyal bdud rtsi 'khyil khams—/05

rgyal dbang lnga par gdabang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (25)gsum rnam rgyal stobs chen khro bo bcu: sgra 'byin bsnyems ma sder mo dur khrod bdag gtun khung gtum mo mda' bsnyems rlung 'byin ma gsod ma bskul byed la sogs khro mo bcu: phag dang rmigasabu stag dang bya rgod mgo: g.yag dang bya rog sha ba lug pa'i mgo: gzig dang khā da byi la pu shud mgo spyang mo khra dang seng ge pha wang mgo dom dang sre mo dred dang byi ba'i mgo za byed gsod byed khra thabs nyi shu'i tshogs bu shud skye ka srin bya khra mgo ma sgo skyong phra men chen mo bzhi rnams dang : sho na sha na sri ka sri la ma re ti ri ti re dza re ma tso ya byin de byin bse byin phag byin ma bse yi skyesabazhi lcags kyi skyes bu bzhi dung gi skyes bu bzhi dang 'byung po ser bdun cu rtsa brgyad rgyal brki:mi mngon rki: dam rdzas mo: thugs dam rki ho/ phur ba 'phrin las lha tshogs ra: ྅/ ma mo rolaba'i dur khrod chen po nas: srid pa'i ma mo 'bum bsnol khri steng na nyi ma zla ba pad+ma ge sar steng :rbod gtong ma mo yongs rdzogs lha tsho gis ni bcom ldan dpal wo bla med he ru ga gnyis med yum chen nyid bzhi mu kha 'khril snang gsal 'od gsal gnyen gsal yang gsal g.yos bkrag gsal (24na〉pa sogs dbyings kyi yum chen drug bde 'gro thod 'phreng khrag 'thung ma mo dang :srid pa bde sbyor khams gsum 'tsho byed drug mig gcig myos byed za byed tshe 'phel bzhi dbyingasaphyug bdag nyid gcig pu rgyan rgyal brdzi chags byed cha snyoms ral gcig mthu mo che dbang sgyur srid 'degs gar dbang pad+ma gar kun grags kun bzang grags bsnyems ye shes mchogo: 'od gsal g.yu sgron gsal 'phro chen mo bdun mche gtsigs kha 'phyang mchu 'jib rkang ldag bzhi: har ting dun ting shan ting grub ting bzhi mgyogs ma khyung lding g.yag thod sder chen bzhi dpal mo dbu da spyad bu lnga tsa murnyi: khram gtong gling dbang theg chen rgya mtsho bzhi stag srin bam srin gong srin log srin bzhi ro kha tsarnyi dza mun dza ti bzhi ro langs nag mo 'jig rten phung gsum dang : gsang ba'i ma gsum gsang ba'i pho nya gsum bdun sto rtsa gnyis rgyal bsko mi mgar dam rdzas mo:thugs dmar ho/ ma mo rbod gtong lha tsho gis mo // rigs 'dzin rol ba'i dur khrod chen po nas 106

bka' brgyad gsang ba yongs rdzogs kyi las byang bklags chog dgos pa kun tshang / nang ma (ka)dar chen lhab khri brtsigs pa'i khri steng na: nyi ma zla ba pad+ma ge sar steng : gdung 'tshob rigs 'dzin yongs rdzogs lha tsho gis ni dpal chen rigs 'dzin gtso mchog thod pa rtsal mi dmigs yum chen rdo rje rnal 'byor 'khril lhun grub phyag rgya tshe dbang rnam smin bzhi: yang dag rigs 'dzin rdo rje bsam grub rtsal 'jam dpal rigs(24ba 'dzin rdo rje grub pa rtsal: gsung gi rigs 'dzin rdo rje drag po rtsal: phur pa'i rigs 'dzin rdo rje thod 'phreng rtsal yon to rigs 'dzin rdo rje gro lod rtsal rbod gtong rigs 'dzin rdo rje dbang sdud rtsal: mchod bstod rigs 'dzin rdo rje gzhog rgod rtsal: drag sngags rigs 'dzin rdo rje mtheb gzhog rtsal: sgo bzhi skyong mdzad rdo rje slob dpon ni:dam tshig dbang gi slob dpon chen po dang : man ngag lung gi slob dpon chen po dang : shes rab rgyud grol slob dpon chen po dang : nyams chags skong ba'i slob dpon chen po bzhi rdo rje rin cen pad+ma las mkha' 'gro: rdo rje rin cen pad+ma las kyi ging : dpa' bo dpa' mo la sogs nyi shu drug: bla ma rigs 'dzin rgyal brki: mi ma 'kho: dam rdzas ra: ci ho/ rigs 'dzin slob dpon lha tsho gos ra: ྅/ 'jig rten rol pa'i dur khrod chen po nas dregs pa pho mo bsnol ba'i khri steng na nyi ma zla ba pad+ma ge sar steng : mchod bstod bstan srung yongs rdzogs lha tshogs ni: bcom ldan dpal chen dregs pa kun 'dul che: gnyis med yum chen khams gsum spyi 'dul 'khril: lha chen yab yum thugs sras dregs pa 'dul: gshin rje gsod byed skos rje bdud mo dang : glog phreng sbal mgo gnod sbyin gnod sbyin mo: sham po gnam the spyi bdud dkar po gsum srid rgyal sngags srung mkha' 'gro nag mo gsum bdud 'dul srog zan yam shud dmar po gsum: gu (25na〉spang bgegs rgyal rmu bdun nag po gsum sgo bzhin srog bdag pe har ma sangs dang : mgon nag la sogs dbang chen sde bzhi dang : gza' bdud gnam sman klu bdud klu mor bcas ging chen bdud nag gza' klu srin po dang : gnod sbyin ma mo la sogs sde brgyad tshogs sum cu rtsa gnyis rgyal ba mi macanarki: dam rdzas sko: thugs dam mo ho/ 'jig rten mchod bstod lha tsho gos ri // drag sngags rol pa'i dur —107—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()khrod chen po nas dgra bgegs pho mo bsnol ba'i khri steng na nyi ma zla ba pad+ma ge sar steng :dmod pa drag sngags yongs rdzogs lha tsho gos ni:bcom ldan dpal chen stobs ldan nag po che:gnyis med yum chen 'byung lnga'i bdag mo 'khril:'chi bdag srog bdag bdud pho bdud mo dang :srin nag 'joms byed gang bzang sha za mo:lha chen mgon nag thar pa rmu rje dang :sgo skyong rgyal po yam shud rdo rje legs khu le lag dgu la sogs bka' nyan dang :khyab 'jug chen po klu rgyal gzhen nu gtum:bshan pa lha srin sdebargyad la sogs te:nyi shu rtsa brgyad rgyal bsko mi mgom dam rdzas ri thugs dam zo ho/dmod pa drag sngags lha tsho gis zo:྅/dkyil 'khor chen po'i bar khyams khor yug nas bka' srung pho nya yongs rdzogs lha tsho gis ni:dbang phyug nyer brgyad mkha' 'gro sum cu gnyis ging chen bco brgyad laṅka bcu drug dang :'bar ma brgyad dang ye shes ma 25ba〉du bdun sring mo rnam bzhi rtog byed 'joms byed ma gdab phur brgya rtsa brgyad po mthu rtsal can:rta gdong dkar mo phag gdong nag mo dang :sprel gdong dmar mo spyang gdong ljang gu ste:'dzin 'ching sdom brdeg ye shes sgo ma bzhi lcags ri skyong mdzad pho nya drug cu bzhi:sa bdag chen po sum cu rtsa gnyisadang :rigs 'dus mkha' 'gro 'bum phrag nyi shu dang :ma yam bstan ma bcu gnyis la sogs te:pho nya yongs rdzogs dgra 'dul thugs dam can:mi ma 'kho:dam rdzas ma thugs dmadze:ho/dpal gyi bka' sdod lha tsho gos ma:tsho gos tha ma'i lhan thabs ni/e rje tri dza na mo/sangs rgyas kyi bka' bden pa dang /chos kyi ma dge 'dun gyis:rgyal ba zhi khro'i lha tsho gis rnams kyis bka' srung pho nya las mkhan rnams kyis gzhan yang gsang sngags dang rig sngags dang gzungs sngags dang /snying po dang /phyag rgya dang /sngags 'chang bdag gi phyag rgya dang ting nge 'dzin dang bden pa'i stobs kyis bdag cag rnal 'byor pa dpon slob yon mchod dge sde gra tshan 'khor dang bcas pa la gnod cing 'tshe bar byed pa'i gzugs can gyi dgra/gzugs med kyi bgegs/bar chad kyi rkyen/khyad par du byad ma rbod gtong lha dang bcas pa rnaX/mgon byed kyi lha'am/tshe dang dbang thang ngam

bka' brgyad gsang ba yong rdzogs kyi la byang bkrags chog dgos pa kun tshang / nang ma zhanabasod nams dang dus kyi dbang du ma btang bar/da lta nyid du liṅga 'di la khug cig/drag sngagasasolnga ba'i gzham bur/rtsi tri 26na)'a / dzaḥdzaḥ& baṃ hoḥ.a be sha ya a āḥzhes lan gsum brjod/gter gzhung bcos med/hūṃ/chos kyi dbyings nas rang byung grub pa'i lha khro bo rol pa'i dur khrod chen po nas shin tu mi bzad rab 'jigs skur ston pa:dpal chen yongs rdzogs drag po'i 'phrin las mdzod lha/nga ni che mchog he ru ga sras 'khor sprul pa bye ba 'bum bka' sdod rab 'jigasapho nyar bcas che mchog lha tshogs dus la bab g.yas kyi phyag na phur pa 'dril g.yon gyi phyag na lcags kyus 'gugs lcags kyus bzung la phur pas thob:gnod byed dgra bgegs rdul du rlog:hūṃ/nga ni badz+ra he ru ga sras ra bka'am yang dag lha mo g.yas ma g.yon dze lcags mo:gnod ma:྅/nga ni 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed sras za bka' spo:gshin rje'i mo:g.yas za g.yon mo lcags snga:gnod sko:྅/nga ni rta mgrin pad+ma dbang :sras sko:bka'akho rta mgrin mo g.yas mo g.yon mo lcags ra gnod mo:྅/nga ni rdo rje gar+sha zhe nu che sras snga:bka'akho phur pa'i mo g.yas ra g.yon za:lcags spo:gnod mo:྅/nga ni bla med he ru ga:sras rki bka'akho ma mo'i mo g.yas mo g.yon kho:lcags sko gnod mo://nga ni rigasa'adzin thod pa rtsal sras kho:bka'akho rigs 'dzin mo:g.yas sko g.yon ra lcags snga:gnod spo:྅/nga ni dregs pa kun 'dul rje sras za bka'adze:mchod bstod za g.yas za:g.yon za 26bskogs mo gnod za:྅/nga ni stobs ldan nag po che:sras mo bka' mo drag sngags sko g.yas sko g.yon ma:lcags za gnod za:drag sngags so lnga pa'i gsham du dgra bgegs gnod byed 'byung po thams cad mā ra ya hūṃ phaṭa:ces brjod de tshe lung khrus lung gi dgongs pas phur pa gdab bo hūṃ/dpal chen khrag 'thung lha tsho gis zhal phye zhig:bag chags kun sbyong 'khor ba'i lam dgag phyir dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i dug gsum sha ༷༷ rus za byed mi 'gyur chos nyid klong du rol:

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()badz+ra yak+ṣa kro dha bi dza ya 'a sti ho/zhal zas tshogis kyi mchod pa 'di 'dod yon ma spangs longs spyod brgyan dngos grub sna tshogs 'di las 'byung :rnal 'byor dgyes par tsho gos la rol sirnyi pha la a la la ho: ྅/ sngon nas da lta yan chad du rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas rnams bsod nams dge ba'i tsho gos 'khor gyis tshe dbang longs spyod brtan rgyas shog:lhag chog ni/gser skyems/byin rlabs gter mdzod rtsa brgyud bla ma dang //dngos grub char 'bebs zhi khro bka' brgyad lha bar chad kun sel dpa 'bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs//gser skyems 'di bzhes rnal 'byor mthu dpung skyed/ /bstan srung dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs spyi dang / khyad par dpal mgon nag po ma ning che/ /dregs pa'i sde dpon sum cu 'khor bcas rnams//gser skyems ri/tshe rabs rigs brgyud la brten srung ma dang //'go ba'i lha 27na sko yul gzhis gnas kyi bdag/lo zla zhag tshes phyogasamatshams sgo 'phrang lha//gser skyems 'di bzhes rnal 'byor mthu dpung bskyed//hūṃ/chos dbyings skye med rnam dag las skye ba'i cho 'phrul zhi khro'i tshogs:'dir spyon rgyan gyi mchod gtor bzhes:sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub stsol:྅/dang po phud kyis mi mchod du bka' brgyad yongs rdzogs lha rnams gnyan:bar du lhag mas mi mchod du:ma dang mkha' 'gro lhag la dgyes tha ma gcig tu mi bsre phu chos nyid ye nas rgyu 'bras gcig lha/dpal gyi bka' nyan lhag sdud ma:rigs bzhi mkha' 'gro shugs 'gror bcas dbang phyug chen mo nyer brgyad dang :mkha' 'gro sum sto rtsa gnyis rnams gnas bzang de ni dur khrod 'dzin gos bzang de ni zhing wo rgyan: skyogs bzang de ni bha3 thogs zas bzang de ni me sa gsol:skyems bzang de ni rak+ta 'thung :dam tshig bsrung zhing mkha' la 'gro zas su sha dang khrag la dgyes las su gsod dang gcod la brtson sha khrag gtor ma 'di bzhes la sngon tshe dpal gyi bka' bzhin du:bcol ba'i 'phrin las sgrub par mdzod:྅/dpal gyi bka' nyan lhag sdud ni skyes mchogo ging chen bco brgyad po dbu la ral phur shar ra ra phyag na gri thogs zings rtse zing :ging pho dgu ni shar ra ra ging mo dgu ni sil li li thams cad 0

bka' brgyad gsang ba yong rdzogs kyi la byang bklags chog dgos pa kun tshang / nang ma (ka)ru mtshon chems se chem: dam tshig ri: zas sum las (27ba〉ci mo: sha khrags: sngon tshe྾tsha tshal ba'i mo // dpal gyi bka' nyan lhag sdud ma mo ma mo bdun dang sring mo bzhi 'bar ma chen mo brgyad rnams dang : pho nya drug cu rtsa bzhi rnams mdzes pa'i sku la sgeg tshul can dur khrod rgyan cha spungs se spung : rnal 'byor kun gyi drod myul zhing : sgrub pa po yi grogs mdzad ma dam tshigamo zas su mo las su mo sha khrag mo: sngon tsher: bcol ba'i mo // dpal gyi bka' nyan lhag sdud ma laṅka dur khrod bdag mo dang : 'bum phrag yangs pa'i mkha' 'gro ma: lha srin sde brgyad thams cad kyang : dur khrod rdzas la longs spyod cing : bstan pa'i dgra bgegs g.yen por che dam tshigs zas sum las sum sha khrag mo: sngon tsher bcol ba'i za tshwa mahā shrī he ru ka sa ma ya de sa kro dha sarba ba smra ta kha kha khā hi khā sti 'o āḥ& u sgyu gi badz+ra a nga sa mu dra grwa ma sa ma ya hūṃ phaṭa: lha hūṃ sno hrī hrī phyi sto bh+yo bh+yo: a ra li dza: gtor skyong ni/ hūṃ/ sngon tshe 'das dusabaskal pa dang po la 'og min dga' ldan gnas mchog dam pa phu bcom ldan dpal chen khrag 'thung chen po yis: snang srid ma mo dam la btags pa'i tshe: go ri la sogs gnas kyi ma mo brgyad sidha la sogs yul gyi phra men brgyad rta gdong la sogs ye shes sgo ma bzhi so so'i gzugs mchog dam pa bstan nas kyang : bka' yi gtor ma len par ma chad dam rnal 'byor tshe srog bsring bar ma chad dam (28na tha col ba'i 'phrin las bsgrub par ma chad dam: sngon tshe zhal bzhes dam las ma 'da' bar: sha khrag brgyan pa'i mchod gtor 'di bzhes la: thugs dam rgyud bskul bcol ba'i 'phrin las mdzod de 'og bar gyi bskal pa dbus ma la: bal yul yang le shod kyi dben gnas su slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas dang : slob ma mkhas pa bi ma mi tra yis rdo rje dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor zhal phye che: rdo rje rigs kyi srung ma yongs 'dus nas so so'i mo bka' yis rnal wor sko bcol ba'i ra sngon tsher: sha khrag ra: thugs dam mo de 'og bskal pa dus kyi tha ma la bsam yas lhun gyis grub pa'i gtsug lag sa slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung —111—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (25)gnas dang : slob ma'i dngas ma rje 'bangs grogs gsum gyis zhi khro yongs rdzogs dkyil 'khor zhal phye tshe: sgrub pa bka' brgyad dam can yongs 'dus nas so so'i mo bka' yis rnal lhorarki: bcol ba'i sko: sngon tsher: sha khrags thugs dam rki: de 'og lnga brgya dus kyi snyigs ma la dpal ri pad+ma 'od kyi gzhal yas su slob dpon chen po pad+ma thod 'phreng dang : thugs rje chen po'i rnal 'byor chos dbang gis gsang ba sgrub chen dkyil 'khor zhal phye tshe: dregs pa'i sde dpon chen po sum cu yis: so so'i zo bka' yis rnal 'byor dze bcol ba'i ri: sngon tsher sha khragarki: thugs dmadze: gtor zor ni/ hūṃ mnyes dpang du dkon mchog bzhugs:(28brkog bgegs ma gtogs sku gzur cig bka' brgyad lha tshogs dmag dpung bskyed: dgra bgegs snying la gtor zor rgyob badz+ra sarba du gi na hrig nan: ye hur thum dza dgra bgegs: tri sha nyu mā ra ya rbad bstan skyong ni/ hūṃ/ bstan pa skyong mdzad ma dang sring : dpal gnas ma dang yang dag shes khyung btsun kong lha g.yu bun ma me stag zla 'od byang rgyal ma gser thang kun bzang shān+ti dpal klu mo gzi 'bar la sogs pa'i bstan ma bcu gnyis gtore ma long : mi mthun gnod pa'i phyogs rnams bzlog rtswa āḥ& badz+ra a phru ta khā hi: ma ma hri ma ma lha khā hi 'a hi bro ni/ lhaḥ sangs rgyas kun gyi sku gsung thugs:yon tan 'phrin las rdzogs pa'i dpal gti mug burnya rdo rje la zhi ba'i lha dang lha mos bskor dngul lam dkar po'i shing dag la: mgo bo rgya mdud rtse mo zlum ngos la zhi ba'i lha bkod de btab pas 'jigs brgyad zhi bar 'gyur zhi bar ma gyur gang yang med zhi mdzad lha la phyag 'tshal bstod ā+oṃ ā+oṃ ā+oṃ mi mthun phyogs rnams shan+ti ku ru ye swāhā ྅/ sangs rgyas mo yon tan mo: 'dod chagasapad+ma rdo rje la: dbang gis zangs sam dmar po'i sko mgo bo rgya mdud rtse zla gam ngos la mo:btab pas snang srid dbang du 'gyur: dbang dur dbang mdzadas: lha hrī hrīḥlha 'dre mi gsum wa tsa ku ru ye swāhā/ hūṃ/ sangs rgyas ri yon tanas: phrag dog ga mi sko: drag po'i za lcags sam (29na jig po'i zo mgo bo rgya mdud rtse zur gsum: ngos la drag po'i ri btab pas dgra —/12

bka' brgyad gsang ba yongs rdzog kyi las byang bklag chog dgos pa kun tshang / nang ma (ka)bgegs brlag par 'gyur: āḥ brlag par za: brlag mdzad sko hā hā hā gnod byed dgra bgegasamā ra ya hūṃ phaṭa: ྅/ che mchog 'khor bcas rol pa'i bro dgra bgegs dam sri'i srog la brdung :badz+ra he ru gas dgra bgegs dam sri'i snying la brdung : gshin rje gshed po'i dgra bgegs dam sri'i dpral bar brdung : rta mgrin dbang chen: dgra bgegs dam sri'i mgrin par brdung :rdo rje gzhon nus dgra bgegs dam sri'i lte bar brdung : bla med he ru ga mo: dgra bgegs dam sri'i gsang bar brdung rki: rigs 'dzin thod rtsal rki: dgra bgegs dam sri'i spyi bor brdung : dregasapa kun 'dul ma dgra bgegs dam sri'i brla g.yas brdung : stobs ldan nag por dgra bgegs dam sri'i brla g.yon brdung : zhi khro bka' brgyad snga g.yas su bskor te dgra la brdung :dgra yang phye mar 'thag pa'i bro g.yon du bskor te bgegs la brdung : bgegs kyang dum bur gtub pa'i bro g.yas g.yon thabs dang shes rab bro ru dra dam sri thal bar rlog: chu lo hūṃ lo sku bha ya nan // sangs rgyas ra yon tan ri nga rgyal rin cen ri 'i rgyas pa rki gser ram ser po'i sko: mgo bo rgya mdud rtse zur bzhi: ngos las bto pas lhor drug rgyas par 'gyur rgyasapar ri rgyas mdzad zo:(29ba spu swā swā tshe dang bsod nams snyo ku ru ye swās ca sa sogasabarjod/ tshe 'gugs ni/ ā+oṃ āḥshā na mo bha ga wa te a pa ri mi ta ā yu rdzu na su bi ni nyi ta te dzo rā dzā ya ta thā ga tā ya: a rta te sa myakle bud+dhā ya: ta du thā zho sarba so sku ra pa ri shurnya dharma te ga ga na sa mu ṅga te su bhā wa bi shu khye mahā na ya pa ri wā ra swāhā 'i sne badz+ra ā yu she ā yudzñā na sirnyi a rgyu ci mang bzlas rjes/ hūṃ/bcom ldan mgon po ye shes tshe dpag med: 'byung ba lnga la dbang sgyur lha mo'i tshogs rnal 'byor bdag gi tshe dang g.yang spel cig steng 'og phyogs bcu snod kyi 'jig rten la 'phros dang 'khyams dang yar ba'i tshe khug cig stong phrag brgyad cu bgegs kyi tshogs rnams kyis brkus dang phrogs dang ba 'khas pa'i tshe khug cig: khrung ba dgra wa shed 'khrugs pa'i las sbyor gyis: nyams dang zad dang 'thor ba'i tshe gsos shig yid kyis dngangs dang had kyis brgyal ba dang : hud kyis 'drogs pa'i tshe dang —113—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()g.yang spel cig tshe khug g.yang skyobs dngos grub bdag la stsol:'byung lnga 'od lnga 'bar ba'i tshe bcud sdus:'chi med tshe yi dngos grub bdag la stsol:ā yurgan bhin+da sa/rtsi sne badz+ra ā yu ṣe ā yuḥdzñā na sirnyi a ༷ /sgrub khog las/hūṃ/bde gshegs rgyal ba kun gyi thugs dam dang :sbyor lam tshogasalam gnas pa'i dam can tshogs rnal 'byor bdag la sngon gyi thugs dam gyis tshe dbang chos dang las bzhi myur 30na yo grub dang :rkang mgyogs mig sman ril bu mkha' spyod dang :srid nor zas sogs mthu rtsal dngos grub stsol:a la la sngo bdud rtsi 'thung /hūṃ/chos sku mchog las kun 'byung longs spyod rdzogs 'gro don lhun grub sprul sku gcig gi ngang :ma bcos gnyis med sku gsum lhun gyis rdzogs mchog gi dngos grub bdag la stsal du gsol:bshags pa ni/sgrub khog lasa.ā+oṃ āḥ:rgyal ba zhi khro rdo rje slob dpon dang :bde gshegs yongs rdzogs srung ma dam tshig can sku gsung gdung 'tshob rdo rje lcam dral mched:dpang gyur skyabs mchog ma lus dgongs su gsol:bdag ni ma rig lus dang ngag sems kyis bla ma rdo rje mched la ga smras shing :yi dam sngags dang phyag rgya gsang ba bsgrags:rtsa ba'i dam las 'gal gyur mthol zhing bshags:shes bya lnga dang spyad par bya ba lnga mi spang lnga dang bsgrub par bya rgyu lnga dang len lnga sogs yan lag dam tshig kun:nyams gyur rang gnong 'gyod pas mthol zhing bshags:sngags la the tshom bla med theg la smad lta spyod ya bral bshen sgrub gzhung ma srongs:long yod le los dus kyi mchod pa chag:sdom gsum thun mong dam nyams mthol zhing bshags rig pa'i rtsal chungs snying po'i don ma rtogs:sgom pa sran chungs gnasalugs so ma thub blo yi stobs chungs spyod pa bogs ma thon:legs sam spyad kyang don log thugs30ba 'gal bsags:'bras bu yid smon gyur pa mthol zhing bshags:tshangs pa bzhes nas dngosagrub stsal du gsol 'dir chos skyong rnams la gtang rag bya/lhag chad bskang ba ni/a ā:i snyi:u lha ṛ 2 bla lo:e i:o yo:e aḥka kha ga gha nga :tsa tsha dza dzha lha:ṭa ṭha ḍa lha ṇa ta tha da dha na pa pha ba bha ma ya ra la wa:sha ṣa sa ha k+ṣa:yi ge/ brgya pa brjod/dkyil 'khor bsdu ba ni/hūṃ/dang

bka' brgyad gsang ba yongs rdzog kyi las byang bklags chog dgo pa kun tshang / nang ma (ka)po chos sku skye med ngang nyid las 'gro don skye ba'i cho 'phrul tshom bu dgur zhi khro yongs rdzogs 'gro ba kun btul nas slar yang chos dbyings rnam dag klong du bsdu zho āḥ& badz+ra muḥ rgyun spyod ni/ hūṃ/ngar 'dzin rnam dag sgyu lus 'ja' 'dra 'di dpal chen sku gsung thugs kyi rgyas btab ste: bden pa dbyer med lta spyod zung 'brel bas: rgyun du 'gro ba 'dren pa'i spyod lam bya'o tshwa āḥ/ badz+ra 3smon lam ni/ ho/ bsod nams ye shes tshogs gnyis mthu byin gyis bdag gzhan 'gro ba ma lus thams cad kun zhi rgyas dbang drag 'phrin las mnga' brnyes shing : sku gsum lhun grub 'gro don mthar phyin shog bkra shis lhan thabs ni/ gter gzhung bcos med: ྅/ ma bcos spros med byang chub snying por gsal gdod nas ma skyes rang byung mtha' dbus bral kun khyab rnam dag lhun grub kun tu bzang : chos sku'i bkra shis dam pas bde legs shog rnam snang bkra shis (31na〉byas dbyings ye shes sku bkra shis des kyang deng 'dir mo: rdor sems bkra shis me long ye shes sku bkra shisarki: rin 'byung bkra shis mnyam nyid ye shes sku: bkra shis dze: mtha' yas bkra shis kun rtog ye shes sku ba po shis des kyang ra don grub bkra shis nan tan ye shes sku ba po shis sko: lha/ che mchog he ru yon tan lhun grub dpal: yid bzhin gter gyi bkra shis deng 'dir stsol: badz+ra he ru rang byung thugs kyi dpal skye med thugs kyis 'jam dpal gshin rje snang srid sku yi dpal 'gyur med sku yis dbang chen rta mgrin chos sgo 'dus pa'i dpal: 'gag med gsung gis: rdo rje gzhen nu mthu stobs yongs rdzogs dpal: 'phrin las thogs med dze: bla med he ru ma mo khrus pa'i dpal:ma tshogs las la 'khol ba'i bkra shis shog: rigs 'dzin gtso mchog rgyud lung man ngag dpal shes rab gsum la mnga' brnyes ya: dregs pa kun 'dul bdud dpung 'joms pa'i dpal sdebargyad bran du 'khol ba'i mo: stobs ldan nag po snang srid srogs bdag dpal: dgra bgegs thal bar rlog pa'i mo zhi khro yongs rdzogs dngos grub rgya mtsho'i dpal bsnyen sgrub mtha' ru phyin pa'i ba po shis shog: 'jam rol dang bcas me tog sil mas kun tu khyab par bya'o: zhi khro gsang ba yongs—115

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (25)rdzogs kyi sgrub chen las gzhung srong ba'i chog khrigs skyon pad+ma thod phreng (31bsol bdag gi phyag bzhes: cho ge rgyal khri srong lde btsan dang : gnubs nam mkha'i snying po dang : mkhar chen bza' 'tsho rgyal gsum la zab par gdams pa'o: zhi khro bka' brgyad gsang ba yongs rdzogs kyi sgrub chen las gzhung srong ba'i rim pa rdzogs so sam ya: rgya rgya rgyas gter tso gtad 7 zab tso shes rab blo ldan snying rje can dang phrad par shog brag gnam skas can nas gu ru chos kyi dbang phyug gis gter nas brta zhe pa'o: bka' brgyad yongs rdzogs kha skong lhan thabs rnams/ /'phrin las gzhung dang sbyar nas spel legs su/ /'khrul med brgyud pa'i phyag len gsung rgyun bzhin/ /za hor rig sngags 'chang bas yi ger bkod/ /dge des bde gshegs zhi khro ma lus pa'i/ /gsang gsum mi zad 'khor lo'i bang mdzod las/ /mchog a dngos grub 'dod dgu'i char chen pos/ /skal ldan gdul bya'i re ba skong gyur cig /rang rig ngo bo ka dag kun tu bzang / /rang bzhi lhun grub zhi khro sgyu dra'i gar/ /thugasarje yongs la khyab pa'i 'phrin las kyis/ /don gnyis 'bad med grub pa'i ba po shis shog zhes bka' brgyad gsang rdzogs kyi las byang gter byon ma'i lhan thabs gter kha 'di nyid nas kha skong dgos pa la rjes 'jug 'ga' zhig gis ha cang mangs pa dang / dgos nges khungs ma chod pas zhabrul lam du 'phyan pa'i mtha' gnyis kyi skyon spangs te/ dpal skyon chen po'i dgongs pa gter ston gyi phyag len (32na〉khyugs med zab chos kyi bka' babs mkhas grub shākya 'od la sogs pa'i gsung rgyun drin can bla ma rigs 'dzin blo mchog rdo rje'i zhal lung las 'ongs pa ltar mahā yo ga'i sgom khog gi tshig lhug 'don mi bde ba rnams cung zad tshig sna ring du btang / gzhan gter gzhung gi tshig zur tsam min pa bcos bslad med par rang sor bzhag /las byang dwags po rtse le'i bar ma yod pas zor yang ba'i ched chu yos zur du bkod kyang par de cung zad 'khrugs pa'i ka tho bsgrig dka' bas 'jug pa bde phyir lcags pho spre'u'i lo ma bu chu babs su bsgrigs pa bka' brgyad gsang ba yongs rdzogs kyilas byang bklags chog dgos pa kun tshang 'di ni g.yo ru lho rgyud du skyes pa'i sngags pa rgan po che —116

bka' brgyad gsang ba yongs rdzogs kyi dbang bskur du sgrub yongs 'du'i 'khri shing / nang ma (ka)mchog 'dus pa rtsal gyis pho brang chen po po ta lar sbyar ba mchog thun dngos grub thams cad lhun gyis grub par gyur cig /bka' brgyad gsang ba yongs rdzogs kyi dbang bskur dus sgrub 'bum dang dbang 'bum bsdebs nas chu babs su bkod pa yongs 'du'i 'khri shing bzhugs/ /na mo dzi na shan+ta kroṅgā māṃ de wā ya/ mtha' klas zhing khams rgya mtshor rigs brgya la sogs zhi dang khro'i/ /dkyil 'khor mgon po chos dbyings rang grol khyab bdag khra tshang pa/ /byang chub bar du 'bral med snying ga'i pad+ma ra legs bzhugs nas/ /gsang gsum sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i rol pa yid ngor rtag 'char mdzod/ /gdod nas rnam dag mkha' khyab spros bral chos sku yi/ /rang gdangs dbang gzhu ltar bkra longs spyod yongs rdzogs pa/ /ris med skye dgur nyer gzigs thugs rje sprul pa'i sku/ /bka' brgyad lha yis mchog thun dngos grub yid bzhin stsol/ /legs byas rab bsags grangs med skye ba'i mtshor/ /thugs rje'i zla snang ma 'gags nyer shar te/ /sa lam yon tan tshe 'dir ster mdzad pa/ /slu med gtan gyi skyabs la su zhig bston/ /he ru naḥ dpal gangs can stor/ /gos dkar tshul 'chang spang ston rje/ /chos kyi dbang phyug snyan grags rnga/ /srid pa'i rtse mo'i bar du ldir/ /skal ldan sgrib gnyis dri ma bzhi/ /dbang bzhi'i chab kyis rab bkrus nas/ /sku bzhi'i dbang phyug kun bzang gi /go 'phang ci bder myong 'di mtshar/ /de'ang gnam skas klu bdud lto ba'i zab chos gsang ba yongs rdzogs kyi dkyil 'khor du mngon par dbang bskur bar snod ldan slob mas rgyang ring po nas gsol ba btab don bzhin gnas dus yo byad phun sum tshogs nas de la 'dir bka' brgyad gsang ba yongs (2na tshe sdogs sgrub chen dang 'brel —117—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (25)ba'i phyag len la sgrub khog dang dbang 'bum gnyis ka sdeb dgos shing sa bcad kyang kha yar 'khrugs pa sdeb dgos pas phyag dpen mi mthun pa dang dag mi dag sogs sna tshogs snang ba 'dir khyab bdag sman lung pa blo mchog rdo rje'i phyag bzhes ji lta ba nag po 'gro shes su bkod pa la sgrub khog gi sta gon la chos bcu gcig yod pa'i sa bcad gsum pa thog mar len dgos pas/ dkon mchog spyi mchod btang bas de'i thog ma'i skyabs sems kyis skyabs sems byed pa'i go bcad de zur pa mi dgos/ cha gsum gter gzhung rgyas pa'am yang na bsdus pa/ swā ts+tsha gzhung ngam ma grub na spyi 'gro/ chu gtor ram ma grub na gtor ma brgya rtsa yongs grags/ gsung sgrog /bshags 'bum ni dri las g.yi gyer dgos rgya par spro na sgyu phrul dong sprug mdzad skad/ med gzhung med bshags rgyud klog /byis ston bya/ sbyin sreg skabs 'dir mi mdzad phud grub na bde 'dus nas mchod pa phud skong len ma grub na bsangs dang skyems gtong /'di yan la phyi bshags zer nyin dang por dpon slob (2bcu bgos nas mdzad pa phyog len yin zhing nyin phyi ma tshor bldab mi dgos/ sa bcad dang po sa cho go la lto 'phye dang sa'i bdag po'i mi la rin gzhal mi dgos pa shas che/ mi snang ba la blang ba gter gzhung ltar gyi chab brgya rtsa dang nga bde 7tu nyam pa mdzad/ gtor ram brgya rtsa yongs grags gang rung btang rjes/ sa der r+yā bu sgor mchod mdzad/ dkar gtor rtsi sman bran pa gcig dang sa lha'i rdzas bum gter gcig khyer la sngags drug phyag rgya drug la sogs pas byin gyis brlab/ rang gi lag pa sa la brdabs te sa'i lha mo gser mdog sku stod lte ba yan chad sa'i steng du 'thon pa/ g.yon du gser bum g.yas mchog sbyin phyag rgya can 'khor sa bdag gis bskor ba la bsngos la 'di skad do/ /skyob pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /spyod pa'i tshul gyi khyad par yang / /sa dang pha rol phyin pa la/ /lha mo khyod ni dpang du gyur/ /zhes kha 'geng / hūṃ ji ltar sngon gyi dpang mdzad ltar/ /sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir/ /bdag ni byang chub nges bsgrub pas/ /mchod 'bul dpang mdzod sa 'di zhu/ /bcu gnyis lo yi rta la zhon/ /ko long sdom pa'i lha dgu sogs/ /'byung po'i tshogs rnams ma lus kun/ /sa glud mchod sbyin gter bzhes la/ /sa phyogs 'di dag bdag —118

bka' brgyad gsang ba yongs rdzogs kyi dbang bskur dus sgrub yongs 'du'i 'khri shing / nang ma zhanal zhu/ /'byung po sa yi bdag po kun/ /gnas rten gzhan du khyed spos la/ /sa 'di ba po shis mdzad du gsol/ /sa spru bhu ta pā tsa gh+ri ha ji hi shān+ti ku ru ye swāhā/ chos byin bshad pa bden bdar ni/ ye dhar dang / chos rnams thams cad rgyu las byung / /zhes so gos kyi chos bshad/ shākya seng ge skyob pa yis/ /ji ltar bdud kyi sdebacom pa/ /de bzhin bdag gi bdud (3na7sa ni/ /rgyal bar bya phyir dkyil 'khor 'dri/ te yi dpang gyur lha mos kyang / /sa gzhi byin gyis brlabatu gsol/ /sngon bcom ldan 'das rgyal ba shākya thub pas bdud btul nas sangs rgyas te chos kyi 'khor lo rim pa gsum du bskor ba yang sa gzhi rin po che'i steng du mdzad cing lha mo khyod kyis sa byin par byas pa yin pas/ de'i rjes 'jug sgrub pa po bdag che ges kyang tshogs gnyis rdzogs shing sgrib gnyis sbyang ba'i slad du gnas 'dir rgyal ba zhi khro dka' brgyad rigs 'dzin bka' sdod yongs rdzogs kyi pho brang 'debs par 'tshal bas/sa'i bdag po 'khor dang bcas pa khyed rnams glud chen po 'di khyer la gnas 'di brtan cing bkra shis byin btsan par mdzod cig ྅sa brjod cing stegs bu gto du 'jog na de'i phyogs bzhir bum pa sba/ de min sgrub khang gi byang ngam ri brag sogs su gzhug bsdu na bum pa gcig gis chog go /de nas sa bzung ba ni/ de ma thag tu yi dam khro bo'i nga rgyal gyi thugs ka nas khro bo bcu pos sa gzhi gang / phur pa zhig lag tu gsor zhing de la khro bo'i tshogs shi 'dusang thim pa de nyid stod zhal gsum phyag drug smad lcags kyi phur pa dbal zur gsum du bsams te/ rdo rje sder mo'i sngags 'di lan gsum du brjod la gzugs so/ /oṃ gha gha gha ta ya gha ta ya sarba dun badz+ra dha rod adzñā pa ya ti sa spru bi na kwa ya wā ka tsit+ta badz+raki li gī lā ya hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ ces btab pas phur pa'i me 'od kyis sa gzhi dbang tshad khebs par bsam mo/ /phur pa gcig gis 'thus shing sngags brjod pa dang mnyam du sarjen pa'am khang pa'i nang du phur gdan la gdab/ sa sbyang ba ni/ rang yi dam du gsal ba'i (3ba)thugs ka nas yi ge : smug nag gcig bsams la/ de las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros pasasangs rgyas rnams la phog sras su dgongs/ sems dpa' khro bo lcam dral rnams la phog pas spun —1/()

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()grogs su di gongs/ma mo mkha' 'gro rnams la phog pas rigs kyi gtso bor mthong sems can rnams la phog pas sgrib pa sbyangs/'od zer slar 'dus ma thag tu sa gzhi gzung ba ste rin po che sna tshogs kyi rgyu las grub pa'i sa gzhi mnyam zhing bde ba'i steng du rin po che'i gzhal yas khang dang ldan par bsams te rdo rje slob dpon la 'khor gyi las byang gi phyag rgya gar mchod byed cing rgyas par spro na phyogs bzhi nas gsol gdab dang bcas khrag 'thung gi gar 'chams byas na legs zhes gsung lasabyang gi stong pa'i rang 7 skyo cir yang snang zhes so gos kyis glu bros kyang byin gyis ga kha/'di yan sto dang po/stagon gyi sa bcad gnyis pa sgrub khog gi gzhung bzhin stegs ding 4 lhas bar mdzad pa shas che/bu shar ngos cung zad dma' bar byas par las las thig 'debs pa'i sngon du sgrub khog gi lo rgyus song ba byas na tsho gis bsag dkyil 'khor gyi tshom bu rgyan mchod sogs dgod/de na tshogs bsag la byang gi gzhung bsrang te bdag mdun sgo sor bsgrung cing bsnyan pa khag sgo rnama'ajoms/smre brtsegs/bdud rtsi 'khyil pa gsum gyi bum pa sgrub/de nas sa bcad lnga pa bgegs bskrad dang drug pa khrus dgung gnyi kho sgrong tshigatso du rdzas da' sa smo kyib465ba/thig rdzogs par gdab gling dgur bskor bar dri thig tshom bu dgod/sta gon gyi sa bcad bzhi pa tshom bu'i steng du ma zhi'i khar rin po che'i gzhed ba 'brus bkang ba bum thod rten dgu phur pa mar me sogs phyogs ma log par kha yig ltar bkod nas 'jog/mda' gri sogs sgrub rdzas mchod rdzas rnams la ma tsam bsham zhing mda' sogs nyal stabs su 'jog pa las mi slong /phyogs bzhin las4na〉bum 'jog dgos pas mnal lam ltar rdo rje sems dpa'/sgrub khog ltar rnam 'joms/mnga' ris paṇa wo gyi bzhed pa'i sme brtsegs dang bdud rtsi 'khyil pa yang bsnan pa'i gzhi ga bsgrub pa legs/sa bcad drug pa'i sgrub lugs las bum pa bzhir khrus chu/dri mchog rdzas ldan dmigs med ngang las gzhal yas khang du gsal ba'i dbus su hūṃ las 'od 'bar dkrong bskyed du dpal rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa sku mdog mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas rdo rje rgya gram g.yon dril bu/'od kyi me klong na bzhugs pa'i thugs kar hūṃ la snying pos bskor bar dmigs te nye snying brgya rtsa brjod/sngags 'phreng las bdud rtsi bum par 'khyil/lha bdag la

bka' brgyad gsang ba yongs rdzogs kyi dbang bskur du sgrub yongs 'du'i 'khri shing / nang ma (kanabasdu/gzhan gsum gyi sgrub tshul khog tu mi gsal ba gzhan nas len chus mched rnams khrus nasadabyung ngo //slob dpon gyi dbang gi skabs bgegs bsang ba byed dgos byung tshe mchod g.yog gis rdor sems kyi bum pa len/sta gon gyi sa bcad lnga pa bgegs skrod pa la gtor ma cha gsum la sogasabagegs gtor chu gtor btang la bden pa'i bka' bsgo zhing bgegs bskrad pa ni las byang gi hūṃ yang dag don la mi mos pa//mi dang mi min log 'dren bgegs//lan chags re gtor 'di khyer la//gnas 'di'i khor yug tshun chad du//skad cig tsam yang 'da' ma byed//gal te nga yi bka' 'das na//bde gshegs khro bo kun 'dus nas//lusang ga rdul phran bzhin du rlog/hūṃ bzhi dang khro bcu'i sngags bzla bzhin pa'i ngang nas me thun chu thun yungs gar sil ma ging gis gri phur gdeng /hūṃ/sgra sgrog gu gul nag pos bdug pa sogs tsha rngam bya'o//sta gon gyi sa bcad 4bajug pa slob ma khrus nas dbyung ba ni/nyin dang po'i thog ma dang gung gnyis la slob mar khrus chu bum pa bzhi ga nasasnod gcig tu bsres kyang yong /mis lcogs na bum pa bzhi ga khyer nas btang kyang yong zhing ji ltar bltams pa sogs kyis khrus byed/sta gon gyi sa bcad bdun pa tsho gos bsag pa ni bla ma la yon du maṇ+ḍal 'bul/bla mas nyan par gdams nas thun mong sngon 'gro'i chos bshad la dal 'byor rnyed dka'/'chi ba mi rtag pa/'khor ba'i nyes dmigs/las lā sa rnam gzhag mdor bsdus tsam a ti'i don 'khrid nas bshad na legs/yid ches pa'i lo rgyus la/sgrub khog gi dbu'i bcom ldan 'dasazhi khro rab mas nas bzung ste rgyal ba dgongs brgyud/rigs 'dzin brda brgyud/mkha' 'gro gto brgyud/grub thob rnal 'byor brgyud yan song rjes dbang bum 'di wo spel shing sgo sor mdzad sroganyi snyug pa gis zhag mo bsnang/nas/dang po dbang gi chu bo rgyun ma ho pa'i babs sgo bska pa ni zhes pa nasardo rje dbyings kyi dbang sgo bi mā la la phye nas bskur ro'i bar/de nas sgrub khog nas gang zag snyan khung brgyud pa'i nyams len skor dgu po dang bcas pa zhus so yan gyi rjes la dbang bum nas phyi ma'i

rgyal dbang lnga gang ga dbang blo bzang rgya 40 gsung 'bum/ (2)dus su yang zhes sogs kyi lung bstan tshang bar la la la tadakar rme sa 'os/byed/de nas yang sgrub khog nas don drug pa rtsom pa po'i rnam thar nas bzung ste phun sum tshogs pa bdun gyis sgrub r+pā gyi gzhi bzung ngo'i bar shar mar byed/ sgrub khog gi skyabs bla ma los rgyas lor dang sal/tson bdag la dgong su gsol/bla mdas tso'am gsum la/byang chus ma thong bas du ni//skyabs kyi mchog tu bzung bar bgyi/semasa'abogs/phyi mchod lnga bshams la yan lag bdun ba ni rjes zlos dang bcas/bla ma bde gshegasamakha' 'gro gnas ( ldan dir gshegs//nyi zla pad gdan mdzes la dgyes par bzhugs//lusang ga yid gsum gus pas phyag 'tshal lo//phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod sprin kun gyis mchode//sngon nas da bar mi dge ci bsags bshags//dus gsum dge spyod mdzad la yi rang 'bul//bdag gzhan yongs sgrol chos 'khor bskor du gsol//'gro mgon mya ngan mi 'da' bzhugs su gsol//sgo gsum dge spyad ma lus byang chub bsngo//mkha' mnyam 'gro rnams sku gsum mngon gyur shog/ces dpon slob lhan cig bas mchod ba phul/rdor sems kyi sgom bzlas 'bebs so//sta gon gyi sa bcad brgyad pa lha sta gon la chog shes pa rnams kyis las byang gzhung bsrangasanas bsgrub/mi shes pa tshos sngon 'gro'i dmigs pa bsgom zhing yig brgya bzla/sta gon gyi sa bcad dgu pa bsnyen pa gson lha sta gon dang sbrel nas mdzad/sa bcad brgyad dgu 'di gnyis kyi skabasabum pa bsgrub srol 'dug pa slob dpon dkyil 'khor 'dri na mgyogs sgo ra na rnam bu mo 'di gar nges ra bsgrub gos/skabs 'dir bya la mi 'dri na dkyil 'khor 'dri ba'i ring bya/sta gon gyi sa bcad bcu pa slob ma 'jug pa la de yang sgrub mchod gsar rnying bsres kyang rung dbang bskur ba'i phyir 'jug na yang shin tu 'jug chog gal che bas gong ltar lha bskyed mchod bzlas tshar ba'i skabs su dkyil 'khor yol bas bsgribs te slob bu gsar pa de sgo drung nas dbyung zhing bgegs bskrad nang du bos te lasakyi rgyas thebs kyis sna drangs te spyan dar spyan yon bcas te dkyil 'khor lan gsum bskor te shar sgo nas phyag bya pus btsugs te bla ma sta gon la /nas par gsol ba gdab pa ni/rdo rje slob dpon

brka' brgyad gsang g.yong rdzogs kyi dbang bskur dus nga yongs 'du'i waṃ shing / nang ma (ka) dgongs su gsol/ /zhi khro (5ba〉(dzongs rdzogs dkyil 'khor du/ /sku gsung thugs kyis bzung slad phyir/ /lhag par gnas par mdzad du gsol/ /lan gsum zhus rjes su gnang ba sbyin pa ni bla mas/skal ldan rigs kyi bu mchog khyod/ /zhi khro yongs rdzogs dkyil 'khor du/ /dbang bskur byin rlabasasgrub chen phyir/ /lhag par gnas pa tshul bzhin bya/ /zhes brjod do/ /de nas skyabs su 'gro zhing sdig pa bshags su gzhug ste bla mas 'di skad brjod/ bu khyode 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal las/ /thar pa'i mgon gyur da rka ne mchog gsum/ /yid kyis dmigs te phyag 'tshal lo/ /skyabs song sdig pa bshagasapar bgyi/ /de nas slob bus maṇ+ḍal phul/ phyag btsal te me tog dbul bla mas skyabs 'gro semasabaskyed 'bogs pa ni/ bla ma sangs rgyas 'khor dang bcas/ /kun nas bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /bla ma dkon mchog gsum po la/ /byang chub ma thob bar du ni/ /skyabs kyi mchog tu bzung bar bgyi/ /sngon nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib bshags/ /'gro kun sangs rgyas thob bya'i phyir/ /smon pa'i byang chub sems ni bskyed/ /sems can yongs su smin bya'i phyir/ /gsang sngags spyod pa rlabs chen spyad/ /don dam spros bral byang chub sems/ /rang byung mtha' bral stong gsal bsgom/ /zhes lan gsum dam bcas te sdom pa 'bogs par bya'o/ /de nas thugs rjes bzung ste 'i lcags kyu phyag rgya bcas te/ hūṃ/khams gsum 'khor ba'i sems can rnams/ khyu drug lam gyi sgo bcad nas/ /mtho ris thar pa'i sgo phye ste/ /dang po yang snying 'bru lnga yis/ /bla med mchog gi gnas su drangs/ /ā+oṃ āḥlha swāhā sa mā dzaḥdzaḥde nas sgrib pa che chung dang lha (6na skong gi rigs su brtag phyir so shing dor te/ dri ldan shing rtsa sor brgyad pa me tog gis brgyan pa slob bu la gto lha ngo gzung ste/ ho bla mas gnang ba'i so shing 'di/ /zhi khro yi dam lha brtag phyir/ /maṇ+ḍal dbus su bdag dor gyis/ /gang yin skal ldan der 'bab shog /oṃ badz+ra ha sa ha zhes nas kyi maṇ+ḍal la rigs lnga'i tsa gli bcas pa'i steng du dor ro/ /ma a bar du lan gsum bskyar ro/ /de nas bar chad bsrung phyir srung skud tshon sna lnga la 'dom gang gsum bltab sku gsum sngags mdud can g.yon gyi dpung par 'ching bar bya ste/ hūṃ/ ye shes lnga ldan srad bu 'di/ /—123

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho gsung 'bum/ ()sku gsung thugs kyi mdud par ldan//g.yon gyi dpung par bcings pa yis//sgo gsum bar chadage gsabasrung shog/ā+oṃ badz+ra ma hā kro ta pad+ma kro ti shwa rī badz+raki li gī lā ya/mahā yak+ṣa kā la rā pa/rkarma raṃ raṃ dz+wa la raṃ hūṃ phaṭa/de nas las 'phro'i rmi lam brtag phyir ku sha gtsang ma dris bsangs te gto pa ni/ho las 'phro skal ldan rigs kyi bu//khyor chu/6kro ti rwa ri gro 〉bye /rwa dha ya hūṃ dzo kyis/gegs sa chas/chu/sdig/ku shagatsang ma rnamachogo 'di//dngos grub rtags mas gsal bya'i phyir/khyod nyid nyal ba'i sngas stan gyis//zhes phyag rgya bsnol badz+ra k+ṣi mar gnang / pa/mkha 'gro ga4 rdzogs las byung ba 'di lta ste/hūṃ lku du mo wa ra'i me kho 'di brgyalas na ni res 'kha smo 4 rgyas 'ag rten 2yi ga las gis gyi tshe ni mi nga ltar de bsto ga4 sngags zang mo'i chos tshe 'di ṣ+ka lasangs rgya pas las ga skal ldan ma yin pa skal med rnam kyi spyod yul min spro nga da la gu mur gyis zhes so//gto do//de nas nus pa'i dbang lnga bskur ba'i lugs mang yang de'i tshab la dbang rgyun mi chad cing bde 'dus kyi phyag len dang mthun pa'i ched du mgyogs dbang bum pa'i rgya can 6bsko gon gyi dkyil 'khor la brten nas bskur ba sgros gtsang /sta gon gyi sa bcad bcu gcig pa lha rnams sta gon la gnas par gsol ba gdab pa ni/mched rnams gral gsum rim du thal mo sbyar te langs nas 'di skad do//ho/dus gsum sangs rgyas 'dus pa'i gtso//thugs rje'i byin mas byang sems ldan//dgongs brda rna brgyud thugs bcud mnga'/khyud grol byang mu lam la 'dzud//dus gsum bla ma sku drin can//thams cad gsha cing dgongs su gsol//rang bzhin lhun grub pho brang nas//zhi khro rgyal ba yongs rdzogs lha//sku gsung thugs yon 'phrin las dang //ma mo rigs 'dzin 'jig rten lha//bdag la gsan cing dgongs su gsol//ma dang mkha' 'gro dam tshig can//sangs rgyas bstan pa 'dzin skyong bsrung //dmod pa drag sngags mthudang ldan//sgrub mchog skyong mdzad rnams kyang dgongs//dkyil 'khor bzang po ngas bris nas//bdag cag bsnyen sgrub lasagazhung srong //stagon la ni gnas par phyag rgyad mdzod/zhes brjod la dkyil 'khor gyi lha rnams bar snang la 'od kyi dra bar bzhugs par 4bsam/de nub slob ma rnams nyal zhing rmi lam

bka' brgyad gsang ba yongs rdzogs kyi dbang bskur ri yongs 'du'i 'khri shing / nang ma (ka)brtag ngan na sbyin sreg bya phyag len la lar 'di'i rjes su nus dbang lnga dang sgrub dbang snang yang legs par mi sems/ 'di yan gnyis pa/dngos gzhi sa bcad so brgyad yod pa'i dang po phyi mtshamasargyal po bzhi la gtad pa ni/ gnas kyi phyogs bzhir mtho brtsigs de la so so'i tsakli rgyab tu snying po 'dod gsol dang bcas bris pa bkod dkar gtor dang mchod pa bsham/ a sri tas bsangs/ su bhā was stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las sa las rin po che'i snod (7na〉ngas shing rgya che ba'i nang du oṃ 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i gtor ma bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por bsams te/ oṃ āḥ/ gis byin gyis brlabs/ nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags dang phyag rgya bya/ a mṛ tas bsangs/ su bhā wa brjod/ sku gzugs dang mtho mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che'i khri'i steng du shar du khru/ lhor baṃ/ nub tu paṃ/ byang du be+e rnams yongs su gyur pa las/ yul 'khor bsrung dkar po bi wang bsgreng ba/ 'phags skyes po sngon po g.yas ral gri dang g.yon be con bsnams pa/ mig mi bzang dmar smug g.yas rin chen dang g.yon sbrul zhags 'dzin pa/ rnam thos sras ser po g.yas rin chen gter sgrom dang g.yon be con 'dzin pa rnams kyi dpral bar ā+oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūṃ gisamatshan par bsam/ thugs ga'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas rang 'dra'i ye shes pa ā+oṃ badz+ra sa mā dza yig spyan drangs/ shar phyogs skyong ba'i yul 'khor bsrung / /lho phyogs skyong ba'i 'phags skyes po/ /nub phyogs skyong ba'i spyan mi bzang / /byang phyogs skyong ba'i rnam thos sras/ /btsun mo sras dang blon por bcas/ /gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol/ /oṃ mahā: ta rā gi bi ru dhi ka bi rū pak+ṣa be+e shra ma ṇa sa pa ri wā ras hi/ dzaḥ/ baṃ hoḥs bstim/ pad+ma ka ma la ya ri gyis gdan phul/ gong gi sngags gsham du a nas sha rdi'i bar gyis mchod/ sngags gsham du na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bh+yo ba shwa sogs btags te lan gsum gyis gtore ma 'bul/ hūṃ/ sngon tshe rgyal ba'i spyan snga ma khas blangasadam bcas chos skyong dpal/ /mthu chen rgyal po (7ba spro sko po bzhi/ /'dir gshegs mchode sbyin gtor ma long / /ri rab gling bzhi'i ngos bzhi nas/ /phyag na rdo rje dbang gi mthus/ /bstan pa bsrung bar zhal —125

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (25)bzhes pa'i/ /rgyal po chen po sdebazhi rnams/ /bdag cag re ba bskang ba'i phyir/ /ma dag 'khor rnams mtshams cho de cig /hūṃ/ shar phyogs rgyal chen yul 'khor bsrung / /zhi ba'i 'phrin las mthar phyin sku mdog dkar/ /thugs rje'i dbang gis 'gro don pi wang bsnams/ shar phyogs dri za'i tsho gis rnamasamatshams cho de cig /'o: ta rwa gi ye swāhā/ hūṃ/ sto phyogs rgyal po 'phags skyes po/ /mngon spyod tshul gyis 'gro don sku mdog sngo/ /dug gsum 'joms mdzad be con ral gri bsnams/ /lho phyogs gshin rje'i 'khor tsho gos mtshams cho de cig /ā+oṃ bi ru khyu ka ye swāhā/ hūṃ/ nub phyogs rgyal chen spyan mi bzang /sku mdog dmar smug dbang ldan 'jigs pa'i sku/ /bsod nams tshogs rdzogs rin chen sbrul zhags bsnams/ zhub phyogs klu dbang 'khor tshogs mtshams cho de cing / /ā+oṃ bi rū pak+ṣa ye swāhā/ hūṃ/ byang phyogs rgyal chen rnam thos sras/ / che ba'i yon to mthar phyin ljang gur ldan/ /rin chen gter dang be con ne'u le bsnams/ /byang phyogs gnod sbyin tsho gos rnams mtshams cho de cig /ā+oṃ be+e shra ma ṇa ye swāhā/ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra zhes brjod cing me tog gtor/ zhes brjod gtor ma bto / rnal 'byor pa rnamasamatho khongs las phyir mi rgyu/ phyi mi rnams tshur mi bto / dngos grub nor rdzas skyel na rung / phyi ging las pa phyir 'gro srid na/ phur ba re bskul tshul sne de dus mtshams gcod re bya'o/ /rgyal mtho bsdamasanas nang du yong pa'i zhor (8na tha dpon slob byings kyi dngos gzhi'i sa bcad gnyis pa dam sri gnon zhing de'i ring las kyi slob dpon zhig sgrub khang thog tu mnal lam rta dkar ma nas bshad pa'i lha mi phyag sbrel gyi gta' bsdam lugs logs su gsal/ dam sri la dug shog liṅga bya mchu can gyi snying gar ya ma dam sri ga pa ri mā ra ya dzaḥdza zhan tri'u tri'u ya na ma sho dzaḥ khug nan sogs 'dre ling mtshan nyid pa bris te them pa'i phyi'am lam rgya gram lta bur kha yar bstan gser skyems ye ling bskyed pa dgug gzhug /phur thun tshom bskul tshogs las ltar byas nas liṅga kha sbub bsdun 'di tsam gyisa'athus rgyas par spro na thun dgu gang rgyag rgyas bsdus mang yang thun rgyag pa'i bskul tshig ni/hūṃ/ dam sri bya ba'i las ga 'di/ /rdo rje slob dpon sku la bsdos/ /rdo rje mched la bar chad /26

bka' brgyad gsang ba yongs rdzogs kyi dbang bskur dus sgrub yongs 'du'i 'khri shing / nang ma (ka)byas/ /rnal 'byor bdag la gnod byed cing / /rgyal khams yongs su gnod pa byas/ /sbyor sgrol mang po'i sgo yang bkag /bka' las 'da' byed dam sri rnams/ /nam yang btang bar ma gsungs pas/ /rdo rje khro bo'i phur pas gdab/ /lcags phye rdo phye zangs phyes brab/ /gu gul sbyar ba'i dud pas bdug /thun gyis brab cing mtshon chas gtubs/ /rdo rje srin po'i zhal du stobs/ /ma mo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la sbyin/ /ri rab brjid pa'i 'og tu mnan/ /zhes brjod cing ro g.yam la ri rab gling bzhi bris pasamanan/ de nas tshig dang bstun nas sa re g.yogs par rdo rje'i ri mo 'dri ba tshar bcu byed srol 'dug rung rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan gyi phyag len du g.yam pa bcu la rdo rje rgya gram bris pa bcu ston byas nas/ hūṃ/ gcig ni ting 'dzin rtse gcig rgya/ /(8na po nyis ni thabs dang shes rab rgya/ /gsum ni sku gsung thugs gyi rgya/ /bzhi ni tshad med rnam bzhi'i rgya/ /lnga ni ye shes lnga yi rgya/ khrug ni pha rol phyin drug rgya/ /bdun ni yan lag bdun gyi rgya/ /brgyad ni rnam thar brgyad kyi rgya/ /dgu ni theg pa rim dgu'i rgya/ /bcu ni sa bcu dbang bcu'i rgya/ /don dang brda sbyar rtags kyi tshul/ /gnyis su med pa'i rgyas gdab bo/ /ā+oṃ lo hūṃ le sto bha ya nan/ de nas bro ra bcas te/ hūṃ/ sangs rgyas kun gyi sku gsung thugs/ /yon tan 'phrin las rdzogs pa'i dpal/ /gti mug bde gshegs 'khor dang bcas/ /de bzhin rigs mchog ma lus kyi/ /'jig rten khams na rab 'byams nas/ /zhi ba'i thugs rje chen po yi/ /zhi bar ma gyur gang yang med/ /zhi mdzad lha la phyag 'tshal lo/ /nad gdon rnam rtog zhi ba shān+ti ku ru ye swāhā/ /hūṃ/ sangs rgyas kun gyi sku gsung thugs/ /yon tan des 'gre'o/ /nga rgyal bde gshegs/rin chen rigs/ 'jig rten/ shin tu dbul ba'i sems can kun/ /tshe dang longs spyod rgyas par byed/ /rgyas par ma gyur/ rgyas mdzad lha la/ tshe dang bsod nams pu lja ku ru ye swāhā/ /hūṃ/ sangs rgyas/yon tan/ 'jig rten/ 'dod chags/ bde gshegs/ pad+ma rigs mchoge 'jig rten/ shin tu chagasapa'i sems can kun/ /thams cad dbang du 'dus par mdzod/ /dbang du ma 'dus gang yang med/ /dbang mdzad lha lar/lha 'dre mi gsum wa she ku ru ye swāhā/ hūṃ/ sangs rgyas/ yon tan/ bde gshegs/—/27—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho' gsung 'bum/ ()zhe sdang /rdo rje rigs sko/'jeg rten/rdul du ma brlag gang 9na〉nga med//brlag mdzad lha la mo/dgra bgegs gnod byed mā ra ya hūṃ phaṭa/sgrub khog na bro brdung 'di bzhin 'dug kyang las byang gzhung bzhin byas na 'jug pa bde bar mngon/dngos gzhi'i sa bcad gsum pa sgo byang gdags pa ni/dam sri mnan pa'i tshur lam sgrub khang gi phyi sgor ra sog la gshin rje'i sku bris pa phur pa gcig dang bcas pa lhan cig tu ya them la btags/gsang chen lhun grub ma bris pa sbyor ram shog byang 'dogs pa gang rung byed/ma rdzo gtor sman raka bsham/sman raka ma rdzo gtor las byang bzhi rgyas bsdus gang rung gis byin gyis brlabs/su bhā was sbyangs/stong pa'i ngang las 2 las pad+ma dang raṃ las nyi ma'i steng du hūṃ las gshin rje nag po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/srin po'i gzugs can g.yas be con dang g.yon mtshon cha'i 'khor lo bskor ba/dur khrod kyi chas brgyad kyis brgyan pa zhabs g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang gis ye shes kyi me rab tu 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/de'i spyi bor ā+oṃ/mgrin par āḥthugs kar hūṃ/de las 'od zer sa pas bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa ā+oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥdzaḥ/ baṃ sngo gnyis su med par bstim/ā+oṃ ya ma rā dza sa pa ri wā ra a nas shasta'i bar gyis mchod/sngags mjug tu sman rag gtor gsum gyi sngags btags te dbul/gnyer du gtad pa ni/hūṃ/gsang chen lhun grub pho brang nas//las kyi gshin rje'i rgyal po la//bcom ldan rdo rjes bka' stsal ltar//de bzhin rigs 'dzin sgrub pa pos//bka' gsang gzhung chen 'di bsgrubs pas//yang dag don ོ ma mthong bar//9ba 'di laganod cing bar gzha pa'i//lha srin 'byung po sdebargyad kun/khyod kyi 'khor dang g.yog lags pas//rnam par smin pa'i chos gzhong la//bla med 'bras bu ma thob bar//sa 'di yan chad bgegs ma btang //dpal chen mi pham bka' ma 'da'//bdag cag gnyis med dbyings su gcig zhes brjod cing me tog gtor/sgo'i nang du 'ongasanas sgo bcad lugs sogs la bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i sku bris pa phur pa khro rgyal bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i shog byang dang bcas pa ya them la zhal nas bstan / gdags/mchod gtor bsham pa dang brlab pa

bka' brgyad gsang ba bongs rdzogs kyi dbang bskur dus sgrub yongs 'du'i 'khri shing / nang ma (kanasngar ltar bya'o//su bhā was sbyangs stong pa'i ngang las pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan la hūṃ las khro bo bdud rtsi 'khyil ba sku mdog ljang gu g.yas rgya gram dang g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/dur khrod kyi chas brgyad kyis brgyan pa'i gnas gsum byin brlabs dang bstims gong ltar byed/a khra ta la mchod pa sman raka gtor ma'i sngags btang ste dbul//gnyer gtad pa ni/hūṃ/khro bo bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'i sku//sprul pa'i 'od zer dgra bgegs 'dul//dngos grub bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho bskyil//dam sri thal ba'i rdul du rlog/ā+oṃ a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍali tshin+ta tshin+ta dam sri mā ra ya hūṃ phaṭa/ces brjod cing me rtag gtor//dngos gzhi'i sa bcad bzhi pa ma tre bsgral ba la//sbyin pa'i sa la ma tre ru tra'i gzugs byas la/gan rkyal du mgo lho nub tu bstan la dkyil 'khor dbus su bzhag ste/thog mar ka dag gi ngang nas chos nyid kyis bsgral ba ni/rang che mchog tu gsal bas 'di skad do//hūṃ/ma tre bya ba'i sdig can khyod//sngon yang sgrub pa kun la bsgribs//de tshe dpal chen he ru gas//bsgral nas10na'i ra khrod chen por byas/khungs bcad rtsad bcad gang nas byung /khungs dang rtsad bcad bdag las byung //bdag med stong pa'i tho bas gzhom//ā+oṃ mahā shā n+ya tā dzñā na badz+ra su bhā wa rna ko3nya/zhes brjod chos nyid kyi don la mnyam par bzhag/cho gas bsgral ba ni gser skyemasabaskyed dgug rgyas par bya/de yang sngon byung gi rnam thar dang tshul mthun pa tsam las don du sgrub po la bar du gcod pa'i gdon bgegs dam sri dgug/ma tre ka ru tra dzaḥ.a kra r+sha ru tra dzaḥkha ṭ+wāṃ ka ru tra dzaḥdzaḥm snya ru tra prabha(tsakra hūṃ phaṭa pra be sha ya phaṭa/ti hūṃ a yaṃ ṇa snya ra ṇa phaṭa/ces ral gris bsgralate/hūṃ/dregs pa bsgral ba'i phung po 'di/zhol lor mchog gog nas su bya//sgo ni gzung 'dzin rtog pas bcad//gnyis med rang grol sgo phye'o//zhes brjod cing ral gyis lhob gzhag/hūṃ/snying shar dur khrod bsil ba'i tshal//mgo lhor dur khrod sku la /gas//nang grol nub tu dur khrod laṅka brtsegs//

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsus 'bum/ ()mtshan ma byang du dur khrod pad+ma brtsegs//lag g.yas shar lho dur khrod lhun grub gter//lag g.yon sto nub dur khrod gsang ོ rol//rkang g.yon nub byang dur khrod nye cha gdal//rkangs byang shar dur rna 'ag rten 'khos//khas brgyad ngo rma'i tshe ma ho//ro brgyad bris pa'i steng du dgram ste gnas brgyad du bsam mo//de nas mnan te/hūṃ/ma tre bya ba'i sdig can khyod//rol pa'i stobs kyisamanan pa ni//'jigs byed chen po he ru gas//mgo ni lho nub mtshams su bstan//rkang pa byang shar mtshams du bstan/khro rgyal zhal ni g.yas g.yon gyi//gyad kyi dor stabs tshul gyis mnan/ā+oṃ mahā shrī he ru ka/10ba〉du ti shwa rī sam ya sto/mahā de ba ru dza dza hūṃ/zhes snying dur khrod bsil ba'i tshal du bsgyur ba sogs byin 'bebs kyi tshig dang mthun par slob dpon gyis dor//rdo rje'i 'gros bya zhing khog pa gzhal yas khang du brlab pa ni/zlo dzñā na tsakra maṇ+ḍal hūṃ/bdag gi thugs ka' hūṃ las zlo grangs med pa 'phros pas/ma tre gi khog pa la phog ste/de nyid ne dur khrod kyi gzhal yas khang nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa/bhan+dha gsar rnying gi rtsig pa byas pa/gnam lcagasakyi gzer btab pa las rak+ṣa'i zham chu 'bab pa/bhan+ta lcang lo can gyi kha bad bteg pa/dregs pa can rnams kyi ka ba btsugs pa/lha chen brgyad kyi gdung ma byas pa/lha bran mang po'i dral ma byas pa/zhing lpags kyi thog phub pa/rin chen rnam bzhi'i sgo mo bcad pa/rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa/nang pho brang rtsibs bcu pa phyi dur khrod kyi gnas brgyad kyis brgyan pa/de'i phyi rim lcags ri dang me ris bskor bar gyur//gnyis pa sgo dbye ba ni/khu tshur dang bcas pa' sdigs mdzub bsgreng zhing /sa bra pe sha ya phaṭa/lan bdun brjod/hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ/ha ha ha/phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa/ces brjod cing bskor ro//de nas ma tre nasamatshams bcad de/hūṃ/bdag nyid dpal gyi thugs kanas/khro rgyal ṭak+ki rā dza 'phros//dmar skya zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa//g.yas g.yon tho ba lcags kyu thogs//'phros pas phyogs bcur rab 'phrosapas//phyogs skyong bcu po bkug nas ni//phyogs ba/kun tu gdan du bting //pho mo gan rkyal kha sbub

bka' brgyad gsang ba yong rdzogs kyi dbang bskur dus sgrub yongs 'du'i 'khri shing / nang ma zhanabasnol/ /ā+oṃ / bha sogs dang / rjes su/ in+d+ra ye ti ra baṃ/ asna ye/ ya ma ye/ ni ri ti ye/ bā ru ṇa ye/ (11na)bā ya be/ ku be+e ra/ i shwa ṇa ye/ su rla tsan+d+ra/ pra ti khyo ti ra baṃ/ dzaḥ/ baṃ ho khya zhes phyag rgya bzhis bgegs rnams bkug /phur ba dar nag cod pan can bcu la/ bdag ni dpal gyi thugs ka nas/ hūṃ bcu spros bstim khro bcur sngags kyis bskyed la bskul ba ni/ hūṃ/ steng 'og phyogs mtshamasa'ajig rten kun/ /zhe sdang rdo rje bla na med/ /sku gsung thugs sprul stobs dang ldan/ /ta kṛ ta khro rgyal khrag 'thung bcu/ /'jigs tshul rngam pa'i lta stangs kyis/ /gdun pa'i tsho gis rnams brlag par mdzod/ /dur khrod gsang ba'i gnas mchog 'dir/ /rang byung khro rgyal chen po bcu/ /log 'dren bdud dang mtshams bcad phyir/ /phyogs bcur phur pa gdab par bya'o/ /gnas kyi phyogs bcur sngags kyis gdab/ /ā+oṃ badz+ra gī li gī lwa ya mahā kro ta hūṃ phaṭa/ hūṃ ka ra hūṃ/ gnod byed 'byung po ga ji ga ji hūṃ phaṭa/ bi dza ya hūṃ/ha na ha na hūṃ phaṭa/ ni la daṇ+ḍa// gnod byed da ha da ha hūṃ phaṭa/ ya mān+ta ka hūṃ/ gnod byed pa tsa pa tsa hūṃ phaṭa/ ārla a tsa la hūṃ/ bhan+ta bhan+ta hūṃ phaṭa/ ha ya snro wa hūṃ/ hu lu hu lu hūṃ phaṭa/ a pa ra tsit+ta hūṃ/ tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha hūṃ phaṭa/ a mṛ ha kuṇ+ḍali hūṃ/ tshin+ta tshin+ta hūṃ phaṭa/lha lo kya bi dza ya hūṃ/ sde ༷ hūṃ phaṭa/ mahā ba la hūṃ/ h+pho ṭa h+pho ṭa hūṃ phaṭa/ rjes su che mchog 'khor bcas rol pa'i bro sogs kyis bro brdung ngo / /dngos gzhi'i sa bcad lnga pa sgrub pa'i yo byad byin gyis brlab pa ni/ sa ma ti lnga ste/ dang po yongs su rdzogs pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyis chos thams cad mnyam pa nyid du byin gyis brlabs te/ bdag rdo rje rgyal po'i thugs ka nas 'od zer lnga 'phros pas gur khang 'od du zhu/ 'od kyang (11ba thad ga la 'dus bdag kyang 'od du zhu/ de nyid mtha' nas dbus su thim nas stong par byin gyis brlab bo/ /de nas dbang bskur thabs kyi ting nge 'dzin gyi gnas byin gyis bas ste/ stong nyid kyi ngang nas yi dam lha bskyed pa'i thugs srog hūṃ las/ e 'phros shing 'dus pas nam mkha' gru gsum dugyur/ yaṃ los rlud gi dkyil 'khor du gyur/ ra las rak+ta'i rgya mtshor gyur/ / las sha chen sag snyo gyur/ ke las rus pa'i ri rab tu gyur/ raṃ las me dpung du gyur/ de'i steng du rgyu las gzhal yas —131—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()khang du byin gyis brlab bo//de nas lhag par mos pa'i sa ma tis lhar byin gyis brlab pa ni/bdag nyid lhar mos pa tsam gyis yongs rdzogs dpal chen 'khor bcas su bskyed/de nas tshogs chen bos pa'i ṣi nge 'dzin gyis ma rdzo rdzas byin gyis brlab pa ni/mgo rdzas sha lnga bdud rtsi lngar dmigs la/de nas3 yaṃ khaṃ gsum gyis sbyangs te/a tre las bdud rtsi dang rin po cher bsam mo//de nas ging chen sgrol ba'i sa ma tis rgyu dang yum byin gyis brlab pa ni/rgyu bsgral lo mtshal gyi gnas lngar rigs drug sa bon a : su tri pre du dgod/sgrol na 'khor ba dong sprug go/yum gyi gnas lngar dpa' bo 'bru lnga bkod de spro bsdus rigs kyi yab yum du bskyed par bya'o//sa yod lnga pa slob dpon kho nas mdzad cing de yang ting nge 'dzin tsam gyis srong dgos don ni snang srid snod bcud stong par brlab/khang pa gzhal yas khang du brlab/bcud rnams lhar brlab/mchod rdzas brlab/sbyor sgrol brlab pa'i don no//dngos gzhi'i sa bcad drug pa dkyil 'khor chag chag gdab pa ni/ka pā lar bdud rtsi lnga chang 12na khong sbyar te/rigs lnga yab yum bdud rtsir zhubar bsams nas/'thor yab kyis 'thor zhing 'di skad do//gyi rnam rtog dngos gzhi rtsa ba lnga//dug lnga 'khor ba'i rtags kyi rgya//ye shes lnga ru rab sbyangs nas//dkyil 'khor rnams la yongs su rdzogs//gu gra tsa po dzñā na maṇ+ḍal hūṃ/zhes bde gshegs bzhugs gnas gzhal yas khang rat+na lnga'i maṇ+ḍal mnyam yangs su bsams te/mthar thon la 'jam par bya'o//dngos gzhi'i sa bcad bdun pa thig rnams rim par gdab pa ni/thig skud mkha' gsang byin rlabs kyis thig skud byin gyis brlab rung yang thig tshon lhan cig byin rlabs mdzad pa phyag len gtsang bas stegs kyi khar tshon gyi steng du rang rang gi tshon dang mthun pa'i thig skud bzhag sman rag mchod gtor bsham zhing byin gyis brlab/las sngags kyis bsangs/su bhā was thig tshon rnams mi dmigs pa stong par sbyangs/stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma dang raṃ las nyi ma'i steng du dbus su ā+oṃ dkar po/shar du hūṃ nag po/lhor swā ser po/nub tu e dmar po/byang du hā ljang gu rnams yongs su

bka' brgyad gsang ba yong rdzogs kyi dbang bskur dus sgrub yongs 'du'i 'khri shing / nang ma (ka)gyur pa las/ dbus su burnya he ru ka dkar smug zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis g.yas 'khor lo 'dzin pa/ shar du badz+ra he ru ka mthing kha g.yas rdo rje 'dzin pa/ lhor rat+na he ru ka ser po g.yas rin po che 'dzin pa/ nub tu pad+ma he ru ka dmar po g.yas pad+ma 'dzin pa/ byang du ga rma he ru ka ljang gu g.yas rgya gram 'dzin pa lnga ga'ang g.yon dung khrag bsnams pa'i dril bu bsnams pa/ dur khrod kyi chas kyis brgyan pa/ rdo rje'i gshog pa sogs dpal gyi chas dgu dang ldan pa zhabs gnyis g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang gis bzhugs pa/ (12ba〉rtsam rdo rje dang thod khrag 'dzin pa/ khro mo'i chas rnams kyis brgyan pa sku mdog yab dang mtshungs pas 'byud pa ni/ dpral bar ā+oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/thugs gar hūṃ sngon po/ de las 'od 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas rang 'dra'i ye shes pa ā+oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥ& baṃ sngos gnyis su med par bstim/ ā+oṃ pañtsa kū la sa pa ri wā ra a: nas shabha'i bar gyis mchode/ sngags gsham du sman rag gtor gsum gyi sngags btags te 'bul/ lha lnga'i gnas gsum gyi ā+oṃ āḥ/ las 'od zer 'phros/ sku gsung thugs kyi lha tshogs rnams spyan drangs te thim par bsams la/ 'bru lnga bzla zhing che mchog sogs lha so so'i sngags gsham du su tre ma tri kra ma hūṃ zhes 'dogs/ yang na drag sngags so lnga pa'i rjes su 'dogs/ ā+oṃ ā ཿ / brgya rtsa brjod/ de nasaslob ma dang gzungs ma'am las kyi rdo rje gnyis kyis bsgril nas las kyi rdo rje'i lag g.yon gyi thig sne bzung ba'i sor mo rnams spyi bor gtad/ de dang 'dra ba slob dpon gyis kyang byas te las byang gi mkha' gsang byin rlabs kyi sngags brjod pas/ gnyis med sbyor ba'i byang sems dkar dmar mkha' la bsgreng pas bar snang la bde gshegs rten gnas su gyur par bsams te/ hūṃ/ mtshan ldan bkra shis gzungs ma'i mchog /gzhung dang mthun par mdzes shing brjid/ kha nas ul ngad ldan zhing / /skad kyang ngang pa gzhen nu 'dra/ /snyan par smra zhing ngang tshul bzang / /mnyen lhug 'khril nas dbyer mi phyed/ /rdo rje las don grub ma/ /gsang ba rdo rje thig 'debs ma/ /las rnams ma lus kun gyisashig /r+sā saṃ tri ta dzñā na maṇ+ḍal (13na〉/ zhes gnam thig 'og nas gyen la gsum 'debs thig skud —/33

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (25)snying ga'i thad nas bzung ste/ bde gshegs rten nas chos dbyings ngang las rang bzhin ting nge 'dzin dkyil 'khor shar bar bsams te/ hūṃ/ bde chen spros bral chos dbyings su/ /rig pa ye shes rdo rje'i thig /thabs shes gnyis med byang chub sems/ /dus gsum 'gyur med gdab par bya/ /dur khrod gsang ba mchog gi gnas/ /phyogs mtshams ye shes dgu dang ldan/ /bde gshegs yongs rdzogs pho brang gsal/ /ra dzñā na shrī lhan kra ya swāhā/ zhes gong ltar 'og nas sku na te gyen du lan gsum 'debs 'di gnyis las shar nub ma gtogs thig gzhan rnams mi gdab/ dkyil 'khor shar nub phyed tshal gdab/ /steng du 'then la/ snye dur khrod gsang ba mchog gi dkyil 'khor du/ /bha ga yab yum sa gzhi la/ /byang chub sems kyi thig spros pas/ /zhi khro yongs rdzogs dkyil 'khor ni/ /pho brang tshom bu dgu ru shar/ /zlo dzñā na maṇ+ḍal hūṃ zlo/ dpon slob gnyis gas sngar gyis las thig btab pa'i steng du/shar nub kyi tshangs thig lan gsum gdab cing des mtshon phyogs mtshams logs thig rnams kyang 'debs shing spang bya yang spyi ltar mthun par byed pa ye shes kyi sa thig go /dngos gzhi'i sa bcad brgyad pa tshon bkye ba ni/ phur shul du tshon ldugs par bshad pa sgor thig 'debs dus dkyil du phur pa btsugs shul yin na'ang da lta phur pa mi 'dzugs pas rten 'brel tsam gyi dbus su tshon rim brtsegs cung zad byed/ brtag byang bkol ba nas tshon pra brtag pa len/dkyil 'khor gzhung dang mthong brgyud kyi phyag len ltar 'dri/ bris grub (13ba〉phal gzhal yas khang don bstod bya/ dkyil 'khor 'dri ba'i bar der bum pa bsgrub dgos pas/ bum pa dbang tshom las/ji lta bu zhe na/ spyir sta gon skabs su bstan pa bzhin la/ rgyu ni rab gser/ 'bring dngul/ tha ma zangs sam sa rin po che yang rung ste/ dbyibs ni dpag bsam gyi shing 'bru ltar lto ldir ba/ stod rgyas pa/smad zhol la ma zhus pa kha lteb zhabs lteb cha mnyam pa la zhabs sor gnyis kyis che ba nang du sgrub pa po'i snyim pa bco brgyad shong ba/ rked dpangs zhabs dpangs sor lnga pa'am bzhi pa kha dog chos sku dri ma med pa'i rtags su dkar ram mi 'gyur rtags su mthing ba yang rung / rigs lnga'i phyag mtshan bris —134

bka' brgyad gsang ba yongs rdzogs kyi dbang bskur dusasgrub yongs 'du'i 'khri shing / nang ma (ka)pa'i bum pa dgu'am gcig tu bsdu yang rung ste/ de'i nang du gu gul nag pos bdug cing bdag las kyi he ru ka gsang ba'i bdag por bskyed nas rdo rje go cha'i phyag rgya bcas nas bum pa la gtugs te/bum pa dgu gar la 'di rnams sbyar ro/ /de nas ā+oṃ na maḥs man+ta bud+dhā nā na badz+ra kā ba tsa hūṃ phaṭa rdo rje'i go zhu bzhu lugs su gsol bar bsam/ yungs gar brab cing hūṃ ba chi' sngags kyis bgegs bskrad de/ de nas dri chab kyis bum pa'i nang bsal cing chos nyid rnam dag sngags 'di bzlas so/ /ā+oṃ su bhā wa bi shu rnyo sarba dharmā su bhā wa shurnyo ྅ nya/ de nas spos sbyar dri zhim pos bdug cing / ā+oṃ shā pa ka ri si ti hūṃ zhesabum pa mthu byin bskyed/ de nas bum pa'i ngos bzhi dang kha nas/ ā+oṃ tsa dur mahā mu dra ka la sha saṃ dan su mi si ti hūṃ ā+oṃ swā e hā zhes byin brlab bo/ /de nas nang dngos grub yon tan ldan par byin gyis brlabs te/ ā+oṃ e hūṃ swāhā e ka la sha sarba ghu na si ti hūṃ/ de nas bkra shis (14na tshe kangs dang 'brel ba'i gtsang chab khye'u bkra shis pas blangs te bu mo mtshan ldan gtsang mas blug ste/ chu'i sngags ni khaṃ dzñā na smi mahā ka ru ṇi ka pa ra sha si ti hūṃ a/ de nas gser/ byu sa mu tig /dngul/ mu men/ rnyed na nor bu rat+na dang lnga la/ charat+na ga bo giti hūṃ zhes blug ga /de nas chu'i snying po lan tshwa/ rtsi tog gi snying po mar/ shing tog gi snying po bu ram/me tog gi snying po sbrang rtsi/ 'bru'i snying po til mar dang lnga la/ ā+oṃ pañtsa tsit+ta ma la si ti hūṃ/ de nasadabang po lag pa/ sle tres/ tsan dan dkar po/ shu dag dkar po/ gan dha ka ri dang lnga la/ ā+oṃ pañtsa tre bi sha da ra sa// de nas 'bras/ nas/ til/ gro /mon sran dang lnga la/ ā+oṃ pañtsa bya tsa la sgom la gi ti hūṃ/ de nas gur kum/ tsan dan smug po/ du ru ka /dzā ti/ ga bur dang lnga la/ ā+oṃ pradzha pa ra mi ta dhu pa hūṃ/ de nas dar sna lnga la/ ā+oṃ su dar tsan ḍa si ti hūṃ zhes blug go /de nas 'o ma la/ ā+oṃ bo de tsit+ta si ti hūṃ/ zhes blug go /de nas yungs kar gyi thum bu dang lha lnga la/ ā+oṃ shrī be+e ro tsa na a yu she hūṃ/ ā+oṃ badz+ra a khyo saḥte shwa ra ti a yu she hūṃ/ ā+oṃ rat+na sam bha ba mā ma ki a yu she tho/ e a mi de ba man dha sa ra ni hūṃ a yu she hrīḥ sa ma ya dha ra a mo gha si ti lo ki shwa ra tsa hūṃ/—135—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (25)ā+oṃ42 hūṃ swāhā/ zhes kha rgyan rigs lnga bzhugs so/ /de nas 'bras bu can gyi shing kha chings su gzhug ste/ ā+oṃ ga lnga brik+ṣa hūṃ/ de nas mgul chings ras gtsang ma kha tshar ma nyams pa brog lnga la/ ā+oṃ pañtsa li ka hūṃ zhes bcings/ de nas gzungs thag tshon sna lnga dril sne la rdo rje rtse lnga bcas pa la/ ā+oṃ a yu ba ri su ra ka ba she mi ta hūṃ/ ka ru hūṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa ku ru hūṃ zhes (14ba)stsal lo/ /a ru ra gser mdog zur brgyad rtse dang dgu pa gcig /dpal chen dgu'i rtsa sngags brjod la stsal lo/ /de nas rten 'brel yongs rdzogs bum pa de yi ge zlo du gsal ba las 'od spros sangs rgyas sku gsum mnyes tshur 'dus pas/ snod bcud yongs rdzogs lha'i gzhal yas khang lhar bcas pa bskyed la dkyil 'khor lha'i bsnyen pa tshar dgu bzlas so/ /spyir sngags gong ma rnams kyang re re la brgya rtsa brgyad dam/ nyer re re'am/ tha na bdun bdun bzlas so/ /de nas gtso bum gyi khar dbu rgyan bsdam 'og tu lha bskos la gdab pa'i zhi ba'i tshigasabacad kyang dbu rgyan la dmigs pa gtod rgyu yin no/ /dngos gzhi'i sa bcad dgu pa lha'i stan dang rgyan dgod pa'i rim pa ni sgrub khog nas bshad pa'i phur pa'i rgyu dang tshad dang mas nyid tshang ba rnams la byug bdug brab gsum gyis gzi byin bskyed nas/ hūṃ/ chos sku gcig las sna tsho gis sprul/ /sku gsung thugs yon 'phrin las rdzogs/ khams gsum ma lus bsgral ba'i phyir/ /bdud 'dul phur pa'i tshul du bzhugs/ /sam ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan zhes rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor gling dgu so sor gtso phur dgu la sras rigs bzhis bskor ba/ thod ra gru bzhi'i phyi'i khyams rtsig pa dngos gzhi'i nang du gdab phur rgya mdud ma brgya dang brgyad phyogs rer nyer bdun re dgod/ bde 'dus ltar bka' so sor sgo rdzogs byed na che mchog gi khyams la nyer brgyad dang gzhan rnams la bcu bcu dgod/ lha zhal yod pa'i sgo ba yab yum brgyad po sgo bzhir gnyis gnyis dgod/ dbang phyug gi rtsang nyer brgyad bstan ma bcu gnyis kyi rtsang dang bcas bzhi bcu tham pa so sor sngags (15na sgoms sngags byang skor lde'i rgya can nas bris pa srin mo 'gros su phyogs rer lnga lnga dur khrod kyi mtha'i lcags ri nag por 'dzugs/—136

bka' brgyad gsang ba yongs rdzogs kyi dbang bskur dus sgrub yongs 'du'i 'khri shing / nang ma zhanathun phur ni sa yul gang bder 'jog /de'i steng du/ ā+oṃ/ rang byung ye shes mar me dbus su bzhurgas/me long ye shes mar me shar du bzhugs/ /mnyam nyid ye shes mar me lho ru bzhugs/ /kun rtog ye sheg mar me nub tu bzhugs/ /nan to ye shes mar tshe byang du bzhugs/ /stong nyid ye shes mar tshe sharalhor bzhugs/ /'da' ka ye shes mar me lho nub bzhugs/ /dbyings grol ye shes mar me nub byang bzhugs/ /klong grol ye shes mar me byang shar bzhugs/ /pho brang gling ni dgu ru ye shes gsal/ /dzñā na sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan/ de'i steng du thod pa mtshan ldan dgu dgos pa'i dbus che mchog gi thod pa'i kha khyer la dpal dgu'i snying po gan rkyal du bzhag tshe sngags dbu zha khas mi ldog pa bri/ de'i nang du cibadud rtsi chos sman dang bzang drug sogs sman sna tshogs kyi ril bu'am khrol bus bkang / sman sgrub dang ma 'brel yang rigs lnga'i bskyed chog dmigs bzlas sman gzhung nas blangs te cung zad byed dar nag gi kha bcad pa'i steng du zhi ba'i rten shel dkar a bris pa rdor dril rtse lnga gzungs thag dang bcas pa bsham/ phyogs kyi — brgyad kyi nang du rten dgu'i lhag ma rnams gzhug /dbang tsaka yi mi the ba'i so so'i tsaka li dang snying po dgod/ thod pa rnams kyi mthar dar gyi na bza' sum rim du gsol bas dar khang du grags pa bzhugs su gsol ba ni/ hūṃ/ ba po shis mtshan ldan rdo rje /pā la/ /'phrul bzhad yid bzhin dgos 'dod 'byung ba'i (15bsko ter/ /skal ldan dngos grub 'dod tshad ster ba'i lha/ /pho brang snod bcud rtags ldan rgyan du bzhugs/ /hūṃ/ che mchog sku rten thod sku a mṛ ta/ /yang dag thugs rten me gcig gsal 'grib med/ /'jam dpal sku mchog khram gcig srid gsum gsal/ /pad+ma dbang chen rta zhal gsung gi bdag /zhe sdang bdud 'dul 'phrin las phur gcig ma/ /ma mo yongs 'dus snying gcig gsang ba'i rten/ /thugs rjes rab bskul rigs 'dzin rgyal po'i sku/ /ldebargyad dregs pa'i gtso mchog kun 'dul sku/ /dgra bgegs yongs sgrol drag sngags byang bu gcig /thabs shes zhi khro yongs rdzogs rdo rje dril/ /dngos grub kun 'byung bsnyen sgrub rten du bzhugs/ /tiṣ+ṭha lhan zhes brjod cing gnas su dgod/ /de'i steng du hūṃ phyi nang rten rnams yongs rdzogs bum pa bzang / /—137

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (25)yi dam lha rnams yongs rdzogs bzhugs pa'i gnas/ /dbang bskur byin gyis brlabs mdzad rten mchog tu/ /mnga' gsol dgyes bzhugs dbang dang dngos grub stsol/ /badz+ra tiṣ+ṭha sing pad+ma sa ma ya lhan zhes dar gyi gril nas bzhugs su gsol/ /sku rten zhi khro'i tsaka li rnams/ /hūṃ/ chos dbyings skye ba med pa'i ngang nyid las/ /skye ba'i cho 'phrul zhi dang khro gar bsgyur/ /'gro 'dul zhi khro yongs rdzogs lha rnams dang / /rnam grol mtshon phyir dkyil 'khor gnas su bzhugs/ /ā+oṃ ā li kā li dzñā na sa twa kro ta mu na ye swāhā/ ā+oṃ bho ti tsit+ta mahā su kha dzñā na rte tu ā rtswa āḥ/ swāhā/ hūṃ lī rmā rlu tī/ drag sngags so lnga pa rnams kyi mjug tu sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan zhes brjod nas sman lha'i pho brang ltar dkyil 'khor gyi phyi la rgyan du dgod/ de nas mnga' sogs dgod pa ni/ mda' (16na tha zhi me long re la dar sna re btags pa dang / las bum bzhi dang / gri bzhi/ mtshams phur bzhi thogs la 'di skad do/ /hūṃ/ ma rig ye shes log tog dra ba gcod pa'i gri/ shes rab thabs ldan ma rig 'bigs pa'i mda'/ /sgrib med rang gsal sku gsum me long mdzes/ /rigs bzhi rab mtshon dar tshon sna lnga 'phur/ /ma rigs bag chags kun 'khrung khrus bum bzhi/ /bdud bzhi tshar gcod ye shes phur pas 'jigs/ /yongs rdzogasadakyil 'khor byin rlabs rgyan du bzhugs/ /ā+oṃ mahā dzñā na sha phya tig na a ha ri sha ki la ya dha ma ka ya sa ma ya ho/ zhes zur bzhin bsgral lo/ /de nas tshon skud dra ba dang dar dpyangs gzungs thag dar zab zhing gi bla bre rgyu ma'i dra phyed/ rgyal mtshan 'phan yol ba sha sna snying 'phreng stag sham mgo rgyan dgab 'khor me rta ge chun 'phyang de rnams dgram ste/ hūṃ/ rig pa ye shes thabs shes dbyer medagazugs/ /ye shes lnga ldan tshon skud dra ba dang / /kun bzang kun khyab bla re gur chen po/ /snying po mi nub rtags kyi rgyal mtshan brgyad/ /'gro drug snying rjes skyobs pa'i 'phan bkra dang / khres skyob dar yol dar khang sum rim mdzes/ /srid pa yongs grol snying 'phreng sha rnams 'phyang / /dpa' snyoms stag sham dgab 'khor gsum gnon dang / /rig rtsal sna tsho gos dpa' ba'i me tog 'phreng / /pho brang bkra shis rgyan du gsal bar bzhugs/ /de nas ma chad rdzas dgram ste/ sman gtor rak+ta/ phyi nang gsang mchod 'dod lnga —138—

bka' brgyad gsang ba yongs rdzogs kyi dbang bskur dus sgrub yongs 'du'i 'khri shing / nang ma (kanatsho bkra shis rdzas brgyad dang dur khrod rdzas dgram ste/ hūṃ/ ye shes phyag rgya gtore chen thugs dam bskang / /rnam rtog bdud 'joms ye shes bdud rtsi che/ /'khor ba yongs (16ba〉sgrol thugs rjes chags pa'i khrag /rnam rtog mun sel ye shes mar me gsal/ /bsod nams yongs rdzogs phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod/ /mi 'gyur brtan byed rdo rje ā yum/ /rten 'brel phun tsho gos rdzas brgyad rin chen bdun/ /snang srid longs spyod mchod sprin bsam mi khyab/ /dkyil 'khor byin chen mchod pa'i rdzas su bzhugs/ /de nas rdo rje rtse lnga dang / dril bu dang / rnga dang / ḍā ma ru dang / pi wang dgod/ hūṃ/ chos sku mi 'gyur thabs kyi rdo rje rtse lnga dang / /chos dbyings klong yangs shes rab dril bu dang / /chos sku stong gsum kun khyab rnga mchog dang / /ma tshogs pho nya 'bod pa'i gling bu dang / /dam can ḍā gi sdud byed dha ma mā /tshangs pa'i gsung ldan chos kyi 'brug sgra sgrog /rgyal ba rgya mtsho mchod pa'i rdzas su gzhag /ā+oṃ āḥlha badz+ra ti tha dzñā na sa ma ye hūṃ rlu ku lan dha ri ka ta hūṃ/ dharmā khyu tu hūṃ ba ka /zhes rnal 'byor pa kun ngag gcig tu dbyangs snyan pas bsgral zhing rol mo'i tsho gos kyang bsgrag /sa ma ya ho/ zhes rgyan dgod tshig la rjes zlos byed cing dpe chung de blor yod na gsung ram byas kyang chog /sta gon gyi lha yar bteg pa dkyil 'khor la 'bebs par 'og gi dngos gzhi'i sa bcad bco lnga pa lha bskos la gdab pa ni/ rnal 'byor pa rnams mgrin gcig tu dbyangs snyan pas lha bskos la gdab ste/ de yang zhi ba'i lha tshogs rnams tshom bu'i thog bar la gser dang 'od kyi tshom bur gsal bar dmigs pas bskos gdab pa ni/ hūṃ/ rang bzhin lhun grub gzhal yas khang / /ting 'dzin gzugs brnyan gnyis med gzhug /'khor lo rtsibs bzhi 'od kyi dkyil/ /seng ge glang chen rta rma bya/ /(17na skong shang rin chen khri bzang steng / /nyi zla pad gdan 'od gsal dbus/ /ye nas rang byung grub pa'i lha/ /bcom ldan rnam snang sangs rgyas spyan/ /bcom ldan mi bskyod kun bzang mo/ /bcom ldan rin 'byung mā ma ki /bcom ldan mtha' yas gos dkar mo/ /bcom ldan don grub dam tshig sgrol/ /rang bzhin spyan 'dren gnas 'dir bzhugs/ /ā+oṃ lī/ hūṃ hūṃ/ swā mo/ a ṭ+wāṃ/ ha two/ sa ma ya ta the lhan/ phyogs mtshams kun nas—139

bka' brgyad gsang ba yongs rdzogs kyi dbang bskur nga yongs 'du'i 'khri shing / nang ma tanaklu rigs gdug pa rnam bzhi bsnyel//zil gnon khro bzhi yab yum bzhugs//nyi ma'i//gsung mchog྾//hūṃ/byang phyogs 'khor long//nyi zla pad+ma lha chen steng //rang byung ྾//bcom ldan rdo rje gzhen nu dang //'khor lo rgyas 'debs yum dang bcas//rang bzhin྾//phyogs bzhir//dgra bgegs bzhi bsnol dregs 8na tha yum//nyi zlas/srus mchoge rigs bzhi yab yum bzhugs//nyi ma dang ni sko//'phrin las 'khor bcas brtan par bzhugs//hūṃ/shar lhor//nyi zla pad+ma mi yi steng //bcom ldan bla med he ru ka/nyid bzhi bde mchog yum dang bcas//rang bzhin ྾//phyogasabazhi 'khor rtsibs dbus zur du//bdud gshin gnod sbyin brgya byin bsgyel//dbyings kyi yum chen sde drug bzhugs//nyi ma dang ni ྾//rbod gtong yongs rdzogs brtan par bzhugs//hūṃ lho nub ྾//nyi zla pad+ma gdan khri'i steng //rang byung ྾//bcom ldan rigs 'dzin thod par//mi dmigs rdo rje rnal 'byor bcas//rang bzhin ྾//phyogs bzhi ྾//dar gyi pho brang bzhi yi khri/grub pa'i rigasa'adzin ldebazhi po//nyi ma dang ni ྾//rigs 'dzin yongs rdzogs brtan par bzhugs//hūṃ/nub byanga'akhor lo'i ྾//nyi gla pas lha ོ steng //rang byung ྾//bcom ldan dregs pa kun 2 5 dang /khamasagasum spyi 'dul ma dang bcas//rang bzhin྾//phyogs bzhir//dgra bgegs dam sri gnod byed bskyel//nyi zla pad+ma'i//dbang chen dzi bzhi yab yum bzhugs//nyi ma dang ྾//ded dpon sum cu྾//hūṃ/byang shar ྾//nyi zla pad+ma dregs pa'i steng //rang byung ྾//bcom ldan stobs ldan nag po dang //'byung ba mnga' bdag yum dang bcas//rang bzhin྾//phyogs bzhi mo//mi rta khyi srin ro bzhi bsnyel//nyi zlas//sngags bdag dregs pa yab yum bzhugs//nyi ma dang nirki//dregs pa yongasardzogs brtan par bzhugs//hūṃ/gzhal yas bar khyams18ba ) khor yug tu//dgra bgegs gdug pa bskyel ba'i steng //bka' sdod rab 'jigs gdab phur tshogs//'phrin las kun sgrub brtan par bzhugs//hūṃ/shar lho nub byang sgo bzhi sa/zhing chen bye ltar bting ba'i steng //lcags kyu zhags pa lcags sgrog dril//ta krita sgo skyong brtan par bzhu/sa//hūṃ/byin chen ngo mtshar dur khrod gnas brgyad

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ smyonadu//sprul sku grub thob tshul 'dzin slob dpon brgyad//phyogs skyong klu dang zhing skyong ma wo brgyad//bka' brgyad rigs 'dzin ma lus brtan par bzhugs/hūṃ/dkyil 'khor chen po'i mu ran la//dbang phyug ma mo nyer brgyad sogs//bka' brgyad yongs rdzogs pho nya'i tshogs//sgrub mthar dbyung phyir brtan par bzhugs//sam ya ho/sam ya sto/tiṣ+ṭha lhan/ā+oṃ a be sha ya a/'dir gong gi sta gon gyi sa bcad bcu pa slob ma 'jug pa la/a — sa ra hūṃ gis mig dar bcings/sngags de nyid kyi cod pan gto/de nas dkyil 'bor du 'jug par zhus te/kye ho/tsho gis kyi dkyil 'bor wo po sa/sangs rgyas dang gnyis med dpal/bla ma rdo rje slob dpon dgongs//bdag cag sgo 'dir 'jug par zhu/ /zhes lan gsum bya'o/ /bla mas 'di skad do/ /sngon sbyangs skal bar ma ldan na/ /'jug pa dka' la nyes dmigs che//bka' 'das 'dir sdug phyi mar brlag/las 'phro med na phyir dengs shig/ces brjod do//slob bus 'di skad lan sbyar te/ho/bdag cag skal ldan rigs kyi bu//byang chub snying po mchis bar du//bka' bsgrub dbang zhu dam bsrung lags//gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor 'jug par zhu//19na〉na gsum zhus rjes su/bla mas/zhi khro yongs rdzogs dkyil 'khor du//'jug spro dngos grub stsal ba la//lha dang snying po sgrub pa yi//dam tshig gnyen po bsrung nus sam//zhes dri/slob bus khas blangs te/bla mas ci gsung bka' bzhin du//yi dam gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi//dngos grub rnam gnyis nod 'tshal phyir//dam tshig g.yi po shin tu bsrung //bla mas gnang ba sbyin pa ni//ho/dkyil 'khor lha tsho gos ma lus dgongs//sems can sdug bsngal bsgral ba'i phyir//de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi//pho brang dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs 'dir//bdag gis slob ma gzhug par bgyi//sku gsung thugs kyis byin gyis rlomes//slob bus sgo dbye bar zhub/ho/ye shesadakyil 'khor sgo bzhi sto/bdag ni 'jug par 'tshal lags kyes//yongs rdzogs lha dang zhal mjal zhing //dbang wo rab 'byams bskur du gsol//brda sgo dbye zhing brda phyag 'tshal ba ni//hūṃ/snod bcud thams cad bde chen gzhal yas khang /ga/gas snang thams cad rang rig ye shes lha//de nyid

bka' brgyad gsang ba yongs rdzogs kyi dbang bskur dus sgrub yongs 'du'i 'khri shang / nang ma (ka)ma rtogs ma rig sgo bcad pas//rang gsal ye shes 'char sgo da phye zhig/rgyu pra be sha ya phaṭa/hūṃ/rang byung ye shes snying po sems kyi lha//ma rtogs rang ngo rang gis ma shes pas//ye nas rang dang 'grogs kyang zhal ma mjal//rang gsal brda yi don dang mjal phyag 'tshal//hūṃ a hi pu ho pra la sngon nas skyabs su 'gro zhing sdig pa bshags su gzhug ste//bla mas 'di skad brjod/bu khyod 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal las//thar 9ba ) pa'i mgon gyur dkon mchog gsum//yid kyis dmigasate phyag 'tshal lo//skyabs song sdig pa bshags par bgyi//de nas slob bus maṇ+ḍal phul/phyag btsal te tshe ta go dbul/bla mas skyabs 'gro sems bskyed dpog pa ni/bla masangs rgyas 'khore dang bcas//kun nas bdag la dgongs su gsol//bla ma dkon mchog gsum po la//byang chub ma thob bar du ni//skyabs kyi mchog tu bzung bar bgyi//sngon nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib bshags//'gro kun sangs rgyas thob bya'i phyir//sman
