pa'i byang chub sems ni bskyed//sems can yongs su smin bya'i phyir//gsang sngags spyod pa rlabs chen spyad//don dam spros bral byang chub sems//rang byung mtha' bral stong gsal bsgom//zhes lan gsum dam bcas te sdom pa dpog par bya'o//de nas thugs rjes bzung ste/lcags kyu'i phyag rgya byas te/hūṃ/khams gsum 'khor ba'i sems can kun/khyud drug lam gyi sgo bcad nas//mtho ris thar pa'i sgo phye ste//dpa' bo yang snying 'bru lnga yis//bla med mchog gi gnas su drangs//ā+oṃ āḥ& swāhā sa mā dzaḥdzaḥdakyil 'khor la lan gsum bskor te shar sgo nas me mā cod pan bzung ste/ho/dur khrod gsang ba ma rdzo gi dkyil wor du//rin wo byang tso sems kyi me tog 'di//sku gsung thugs kyi dbyig tu bdag 'bul gyis//dngos grub rnam gnyisabadag la stsal du gsol//bho dhi tsit+ta a/pra ti pā tsa ho/bla mas 'di skad do//hūṃ/rtsa ba sku gsung thugs kyi dkyil 'khor du//rig pa'i me rtag phul ba'i byin rlabs kyis//sku gsung thugs la 20narab tu bstim nas kyang //dngos grub rnam gnyis khyod la sbyin par bya//kā ya lha ska tsit+ta zhes me tog gang babs sar rtsa ba'i lha bstim ste der bcing / //byin brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs kyi gang ga/ 'bebs

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (25)rgyas par spro na bde gshegs 'dus pa'i byin 'bebs chen mo klong chen ma len/ gzhan las byang rang gi byin 'bebs che chung gang rung mdzad pas khyab/ de nas slob bus spyan dbye bar bskul ba/ hūṃ/ bdag cag las kyis bskal gyur te/ ma rig rmonges pa'i ling tog gis/ man tu mdongs par gyur pas na/ /nyon mongs sgrib pa bsal du gsol/ /a sa me hūṃ/ bla mas spyan dbye ba/ sngon gyi mig mkhan rgyal po yis/ /thur mas ling tog bsal ba ltar/ /ma rig mdo nges pa'i ling tog rnams/ /rgyal ba'i dgongs pas bsal bar bya'o/ /tsak+ṣu pra be sha phaṭa/ ces mig dar bshus la dkyil 'khor bstan te/ hūṃ/ bu khyod rtsol sems ma chung bar/ /dkyil 'khor bzang po 'di la ltos/ /da ni dad pa rab tu bskyed/ dngos grub thams cad 'dir thob 'gyur/ /zhes spyan dbye nas ma hā yo ga'i sgom khog gi gzhal yas khang lha dang bcas pa'i don rtags ngo sprad/ de nas dam bsgrag pa ni/ dam tshig gi rdo rje rtse gcig gi phyag rgya slob dpon dang slob ma thams cad kyis byas te/ sku gsung thugs kyi dam tshig ni/ /da lta 'di ru bcas pa bzhin/ khrog la babs kyang ma btang zhig /rtsal ga dam tshig rtag tu srungs/ /sam ya rak+ṣa hūṃ zhes brjod/ rgyud kyi le'u bcu gcig pa ༄ gnyis pa dam rdzo ston pa yin/nas dam tshig rnams ston/ slob bus dam bca' ba ni/rdo rje slob (20brko pon bga' drin che/ /bka' bzhin bgyid do dam tshig bsrung / /rtag tu thugs rjes bzung ba dang / /byin gyis brlab par mdzad du gsol/ /sam ya na ra skan/ /dngos gzhi'i sa bcad bcu gcig pa bsreg mnan bya ba ni/ sngar dam bsres pa rnams sta gon skabs su mjug chog tshar nas skabs 'dir 'di skad do/ /hūṃ/ rgyu lam gos bu dbyer med pa'i/ /rin chen gru gzings lta bu'i lam/ /theg mchog sgo 'dir 'dus so cog /lta spyod dri med dam bsre'o/ /bla mas rdo rjes bdud rtsi blangs te/ ho/ ji snyed sangs rgyas thams cad dang / /byang chub sems dang rdo rje 'dzin/ /de bzhin sgrub pa'i rnal 'byor la/ /gal te snying rings bsnyas gyur na/ /ya ka rdo rje gnod sbyin gyis/ khyod kyi snying khrag bzhos te 'thung / /snying la yang dag rab gnas pa'i/ /'di ni sems can dmyal ba'i chu/ /dam bsrungs mchog thob nyams na brlag /sam ya i dan te na ra skan bak+ṣa gi yasgo —/44

bka' brgyad gsang ba yong rdzogs kyi dbang bskur dus sgrub yongs 'du'i 'khri shing / nang ma (ka) hūṃ/ zhes dam ma 'dres pa'i gsar ba tshor bdud rtsi ster gzhug go /de nas sngar tshos sa la gnon pa ni/ ho/ rnam dag lta spyod bla ma'i bka'/ khyu dang mi 'gal dam tshig nor/ /'di nas kun mkhyen ma thob bar/ / srog phyir mi gtong dngos grub gsol/ /sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya wā ka sirnyi hūṃ/ a mṛ ta re bzhag go /de nas gral bsre zhing gral 'dzin byed/ /dbang byang bkol ba nas nus pa'i dbang lnga len/ de nas sgrub lung zhu ste/ho/ bla ma slob dpon dgongs su gsol/ /bdag cag 'khor ba'i rgyamatsholas/ /byang chub skam sar bsgral ba'i phyir/ /zhi khro yongs rdzogs sgrub lung zhu/ /zhes lan gsum gsol ba gdab bo/ / bla mas (21na sko la lung zhu ste/ hūṃ/ zhi khro lha rnams yongs rdzogs dgongs/ /skal ldan slob ma 'di rnams kun/ /'khor ba'i gnas nas bsgral ba'i phyir/ /sku gsung thugs su byin gyis rlobs/ /de nas lung sbyin te/ zhi khro gsang ba yongs rdzogs lha/ /dus gsum 'gro skyobs 'dren pa'i dpal/ /bsnyen cing bsgrubs na mchog grub phyir/ /snod ldan khyod la bsgo bar bya/ /ā+oṃ āḥ// lung 'bogs pa ni rgyas par spro na/ zhi khro so so'i dril sgrub dang da lta 'jug pa bde ba dpal chen dril sgrub kyi lung phog nas 'dzab 'dren 'jug rigs gsum mgon po lta bur lha gzhan la mos na de da'i bsgom lugs byas kyang chog go /dngos gzhi'i sa bcad bcu gnyis pa chas gos dbul ba ni/ zhi rgyan khro chas yongs su gsol te/ gser la bzo byas rigs lnga'i dbu rgyan zhi chas brog zhu dang / thor tshugs cod pan snyan cha mgur chu se mo do dang / dpung rgyan phyag zhabs gdu bu dang / do shal za 'og stod g.yogasadar gyi sham thabs dri bzang byugs pa dang / rat+na'i 'phreng ba bsham/ khro chas ni khro 'bag lag par bgo ba bya/ thod tshal lnga'i dbu rgyan/ be'u khra mo'i glang chen ko rlon tshul/ zhing chung srab mo'i zhing gos/sbrul lpags mnyen po'i snyan cha lhu rgyan/ stag phrug lngags pa'i sham bu/ gzigs phrug yum gyi sham bu/zhag chen zo ris/ khrag chen thig le/ thal chen tshom bu/ thod pa skam nem rlon gsum ga sha'o/ /dar mthing nag gi gos sha dril ba la gser dngul gyis bris te/ rdo rje go khrab kyi chas so/ /de —145

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 9)yang lha sta gon bsnyen dus ni chas sgrub dus su chas gos g.yob bam spel yang mi 'gal lo//ging la rus pa'i 2bso bo rgyan drug/yum rnams rus kho zhi rgyan gsol ba 'thad do//rgyan mas gsol zhing bskul spa ni/ hūṃ/ rnal 'byor dbang phyug gos bu'i lam zhugs pa/ /rtags kyi phyag rgyas bde gshegs dngos su gsal//dbu rgyan rdzo pan phreng ba dang //do shal dpung rgyan se mo do//stod g.yogs smad dkris sham bur ldan//phyag gdub zhabs gdub rab tu spras//dri mchog ngad ldan rgyan pa'o//'dod yon ma spangs rang grol rgyan du bzhes/khro mas 'di skad gsol te/hūṃ hūṃ don dam spros med sgyu ma'i khong gseng can//ye shes lnga ldan thod pa'i dbu rgyan bzhes//theg mchog don ldan glang ོ ko rlon gsol//'khor ba mi spong mi lpags g.yang gzhi gsol//zhe sdang nyid 'joms sbrul nag chun po gsol//'phrin las rnam ba'i lhun grub stag sham gsol//'khor ba'i bcud bzhes zhag gi sor ris gso me//chags pa dbang phyug rak+ta'i thig legaso me//skye shi rtsad gcod thal chen tshom bu gso me//sku gsum lhun grub thod 'phreng char gsum gsol//cis kyang mi shigs rdo rje'i go khrab gsol//ma rig nags bsreg ye shes me dpung gsol//bzhi bcus yongs sgrol dpal gyi mas brgya 'di//dbang phyug ོ po sku yi rgyan du bzhes//yum chas gsol ba/ho/pha rol phyin drug don drug rus rgyan ldan//shes rab spros bral gzig gi sham bu 'di//'gro drug bsgral phyir yum gyi rgyan du bzhes//ging masagasol ba/hūṃ/rgyud drug ye shes drug tu sgrol cing spor//stag r+pā rus pa'i rgyan drug snying 'phrong gri/rdo rje gsang ba'i ging chen sku la 'bul//zhes chas gos rim par gsol lo//rdo rje slob dpon dang rgyal 2na〉nga gnyis la chas lhan du 'bul zhing yum mas bu mo med na thig sna 'dzin mkhan dang sman brdung mi ging chas nyul le skrod mkhan la 'bul zhing dmangs mar chas sogs 'bul mi dgos/ dngos gzhi'i sa bcad bcu gsum pa mnga' gsol ba ni/ mar chang skyogs bkang rim par drangs shing 'di skad do//hūṃ/sangs rgyas gdung gsob rdo rje rgyal po 'di//sku gsung thugs dang yon to 'phrin las rdzogs/4//ga lnga rtsad gcod dngos grub kun 'byung gnas//

bka' brgyad gsang ba yong rdzogs kyi dbang bskur dus sgrub yongs 'du'i 'khri shing / nang ma zhanaston pa'i sgron mar mnga' gsol dgyes par bzhugs//skyems drang ngo //kun la des 'gre'o//hūṃ/ bla ma'i gdung gsob sku gsung thugs kyi sras gyur pa/ /dam chos char 'bebs tshe dang bsod nams spel//dbang bskur 'phrin las rnam bzhi mthar phyin pa//rgyal theb ston par mnga' gsol dgyes par bzhugs//gnyis med bde bskyed mtshan nyid ra btu bzang //kun bzang yum du mnga' gsol dgyes par bzhugs//phyi nang mtshams gcod bar chad thams cad bsrung //rdo rje mtshams par mnga' gsol dgyes par bzhugs//'phrin las gzhud srong gzugs phung lha la stob//rdo rje ging chen mchog tu mnga' gsol lo//dngos grub dgra bgegs gnyis su drod tshad mkhyen//ye shes spyan mar mnga' gsol྾//phur gtsang bgo mkhas phyi nang rtsa 'byed mkhas//ging gi phyag tshang chen por mnga' gsol ba//g.yos mkhas lhag char med cing gtsang sbra ldan//rdo rje byan mor mnga' gsol྾//gsaladaga'adzab mkhas dad ldan brtson par bya//gser 'phreng mched rnams mang 'ar//kun gyi bka' sgrub phyi yi nyul le skrod//rdul phyag 22ba ) skyes bur mnga' gsol dgyes par bzhugs//las kyi rdo rje ma da na thod pa gang slob dpon gyi phyag tu phul bas tshig dang bstun te sgron skyogs kyis bcus nas phul rim gyi gral pa rnams la so so'i mnga' gsol dang bstun te 'gyed/tshig ni slob dpon gyi rjes zlos bya/dngos gzhi'i sa bcad bcu bzhi pa sman sgrub byed na 'di nas bzung sman khral bu zhag gsum gyi bar zhi ba'i dkyil 'khor du bsgrubs nas/de rjes bka' brgyad las gzhung bsrangs te phye ma bsgrub pa sogs gzhung dang phyag len man ngag las shes/dbang rkyang pa bskur tshe che mchog gi rten thod du sman cung zad blug ste nyin bsgrub mi dgos par sang las gzhung bsrangs nas 'dzab kyi dus sman la dmigs te zhi khro'i dmigs sngags bzlas brjod cung zad byed ba yin no//dngos gzhi'i sa bcad bcu drug pa brda sgo dbye ba 'di nas bzung byin 'bebs yan la man ngag las bdun du grags pa'i dang po ni/rnal 'byor pa rnams phyag rgya bsgyur zhing bzhengs la 'di skad do//ho/ye nas rnam dag kun ldan pa//he ru /yi gnas brgyadang //dur khrod 'a po'i dkyil 'khor 4

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()du//lha dang slob dpon rdo rje mched//phyogs bcu kun nas bos pa rnams//gsal la don rtogasarnal lhor pas//ma bu'i 'du shes nyer bzhag ste/zhol lhor spyod mchog phyag bgyid pa//byams dang snying rje dga' btang snyoms/shar lho nub byang sgo phye zhig/: bra be sha ya phaṭa/ces sgo zhing zhi khro yongs rdzogs lha dang mjal bar bsam mo//dngos gzhi'i sa bcad bcu bdun pa brda phyag bcal ba ni/ho/bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro dgongs//zhi khro yongs rdzogs lha tsho gos la//sgo gsum dang 23nabs brda phyag 'tshal//rang dang gnyis med mjal phyag bzhes//a ti pu ho/zhes lha tsho gos mtshan don nas phyag mang du byas te/lus 'phar rkyang bya'o//dngos gzhi'i sa bcad bco brgyad pa rtags bto pa dpon slob tshang mar byed dgos pas/gong gi mas gos gso me bas kyang chog ste/nan to thugs rjes 'dzin par bya ba ni/skong bu kha gsum par/tso wo/rak+ta/thal wo sbyar te/hūṃ/he ru ka yi gnas bcu dang //dur khrod r+sā po'i gnas brgyad nas//dbang r+ṣa bskur dang byin brlab phyir//dpal byu mkha' 'gro ging gsum dang /zhom thar gcig tu bsre ba'i phyir//tso chen rak+ta thal byu//sngon gyi tha tshig rtags kyi rgya//ā+oṃ sarba na len a bhi khiñtsa hūṃ/zhes zhag gi zo ris rak+ta'i thig le/thal chen tshom bu gdab bo//dngos gzhi'i sa bcad bcu dgu pa dam bca' ba ni/rnal 'byor ba rnams dkyil 'khor la bskor zer yang deng sang mi bskor/gcig gi 'phreng ba gcig la sbrel te 'di skad do//hūṃ/dus gsum rgyal ba'i dgongs spyod ci 'dra bar//de 'dra kho nar bdag kyang 'grub gyur cig/sku gsum lhun grub ye shes lnga rdzogs pa'i//gnyis med bka' dang mthun pa'i sgrub thabs 'di//srog gi phyir yang mi gtong sgrub lags kyi//rdo rje rgyal pos byin gyis brlab tu gsol//lnga brgya tha ma dus kyi 'jig rten 'dir//sangs rgyas mdzad pa ma lus bdag gis bshad//bdag gi bsam pa ma lus 'grub gyur cig/'da' /khyed kyi dam tshig rtag tu bsrung //dam tshig gzungs kyis bsdus pa'i 'phreng thag la//rig pa srog gis bsdus pa'i lu gu rgyud//rtagasaX 23bskon gyi dam tshig mi 'bral bzung //sku

bka' brgyad gsang ba yong rdzog kyi dbang bskur dre yongs bo'i 'khri shing / nang ma (ka)gsung thugs kyi dngos grub mthob bar//lus dang srog gi phyir yang mi gtong ngo //sa ma ya hūṃ/dam bca' bcu gnyis pa zer ba logs su yod pa yang len zhing thog mtha' gnyis la bya rgyun du bzhag na rgyas bsdus ran pa yong /dngos gzhi'i sa bcad nyi shu pa bshags pa bya ba ni/ye shes sku mchog/'khor ba dong sprugs dri med bshags rgyud nas len/chos tshan nang gi rgyun bshags nar ma bya'o//dngos gzhi'i sa bcad nyer gcig pa byin dbab pa dkyil 'khor dang sman la byin 'bebs rgyu sman sgrub med na tshang mar las byang yod tshe nyin dang po dkyus ltar de nas las byang la byin 'bebs rgyas pa ye shes sku mchog sogs spyor bas tsos pa 'dra yang da lta rgyun du mdzad pa ni/bdag nyid dad pas dung sems kyis snying ga'i hūṃ las 'od 'phros/phyogs bcu'i bde gshegs yongs rdzogs 'dus nas/dkyil 'khor byin rlob bdag la dbang bskur dam can gyis dngos grub char 'bebs bar chad thams cad sel bar bsams te/rnal 'byor pa kun rol mo sna tshogs bsgrag cing gu gul nag po dang gsur chen sbyar te dkyil 'khor g.yon du lan gsum bskor cing 'di skad do//stong gsum stong gi 'jig rten na//phyogs bcu stong gi 'jig rten nas//rang bzhin maṇ+ḍal chen po nas//zhi khro yongs rdzogs gshegs su gsol//dkyil 'khor byin phob bdag dbang bskur//he ru ka yi gnas stsodang //dur khrod chen po'i gnas brgyad dang //'og min lhun grub gnas mchog nas//sku gsung thugs yon 'phrin las bdag/lha dang rigs tshan dam can gyis//maṇ+ḍal byin rlobs bdag ( 2 4nadabang bskur//zhi tshogs 'od dang lag sel ma/khro tshogs〉 sgra dir ri ri//rigs 'dzin byin wo thibasartse thib//mkha' 'gro gar stabs shigs sgo shig/chos skyong ru mtshon lhubs se lhub//rtags dang mtshan ma bstan pa dang //sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub stsol//sam ya ho/sam ya sto/a la la ho/a be sha ya a a/zhes byin thibs ma byung bar du bskyar te dbab bo//gzhan yang tshig bdun gsol 'debs/dur khrod chas brgyad kyi rigs 'dzin ḍā gi yar byin dbab bo//dngos gzhi'i sa bcad nyer gnyis pa ༷da gtor brlab cing drangs pa las byang kun gyis

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho gsung 'bum/ (25)shes na dang phal chen gyis mi shes na bla ma gcig pus byin gyis brlab pa ni/ byin rlabs sgrub khog bzhin bya ste rgyal thabs kyis rdzas rim par blangs te/ bla ma la 'bul cing dkyil 'khor mthar dgod do/ /hūṃ/ bka' gsang med byung dkyil 'khor du/ /bla ma yi dam lha tshogs yongs rdzogs la/ /rang byung chos kyi dbyings kyi kong bu sa /rig pa ye shes mar me gtams te 'bul/ /a la la ste bzhes su gsol/ /rtsa brgyad stong sbyar a skṛ ta/ /sku lnga ye shes yongs rdzogs 'bul/ /a la la ste bzhes su gsol/ /gzheng pa rnam dag gtor ma lha/ /'dod yon yongs su rdzogs par 'bul/ /'khor ba yongasabasgral mkha' dbyings dag /chags med rak+ta'i mnyes mchode 'bul/ /a la la ste bzhes su gsol/ /'bru bcud stong sbyar dpa' bo'i rdzas/ /gzi brjid bskyed phyir dza gad 'bul/ /a la la ste bzhes su gsol/ /dngos gzhi'i sa bcad nyer gsum pa 'phrul 'khor bslab bya bstan pa ni/ dpal gsang (24ba)'dus rgyud las/ ye shes lha la rang rgyud pa/ /rtsis gdab khrigs su bcad pa med/ /gdu po bya'i mosablo dang mas par/ /chos sku'i 4 rtsal sto yang snang / /yang na zhi khro sgos sgrub bam/ /drang ba'i don du zhakhrul shes bya/ /zhes dang / yang le'u dgu pa las/ gdul bya'i blo rig tha dad pas/ /sku gsung thugasayon 'phrin las kyi/ /bye brag sgrub la mos na yang / /'di yis bsnyen sgrub skabs la sbyor/ /bde bar gshegs la rang rgyud med/ /gang ltar mos bsam de ltar 'grub/ /ces pas spyir gsang sgrub chen mo 'di/ /zhi khro bka' brgyad thams cad kyi spyi khog skyed byed ma lta bu yin pas/ sngon rjes cho go khrigs 'di sbyin la/ /'dod lha'i tsho dang rdzas gar dgos su bzhi ste/ bar 'dir rang gi sgrub gzhung zhi khro yang phur bdud rtsi ma mo pad+ma thugs rje wo po/ /phyag rdor gang byed 'di'i sgroms nas 'don pas/ /khyad par mchog tu 'gyur ro/ /dkyil 'khor ni 'di'i bsnyen sgrub las gsum gyi bkod pa rdzogs pas/pho brang bsgyur mi dgos/ skabs su gso bar 'thad do/ /gzhan rang gzhung ltar bsgyur ro/ /zhal gdams 'di rnams kyang kun tu 'phrul shes par bya'o/ /—150

bka' brgyad gsang ba yongs rdzogs kyi dbang bskur du sgrub yongs 'du'i 'khri shing / nang ma (ka)rgyud las 'phrul 'khor bde la don mi 'gyur/ /zhes pa yang de nyid las sgrub chen khog nas sgrub 'phrin kun phyungs pas ma tshang ba kha skongs dngos grub tshar ro/ /sgrub chen 'di lta bu'am sgrub chen gcig grub nas bde bar gshegs pa gang nas thams cad kyi las tshogs spyad pas 'grub bo/ /spyir las tshogs man ngag thams cad bka' rgya spyi khongs 'phrul shes par bya'o/ /sgrub chen 'di'am gzhan yang phur pa la sogs skabs 'dir sbyar yang (25na〉ngung ste/ sngon 'gro dang bcas pa'i bskyed rdzogs las gzhud tshar te/ nyin mtshan re re ma chag par bya'o/ /nang nub kyang las byang tshar re tsho gos yan chad bya/ las gzhung nam srong res gtore ma gsar pa re yang bsham/ sman raka mchod pa yang gso/ gtso bo'i 'dzab bam dril 'dzab la gsung mi chad bya/ spyir 'dzab la brtson pa ting nge 'dzin dang mthun par bya'o/ /rdo rje rgyal pos ni de bzhin nyid kyi ting nge 'dzin sgrub pa'i bar du bsgom pa ni gnad kyi gdams pa'o/ /bskyed rim mchod bstod bskul la sogs pa yang rnam rtog rang ga mar ma shor bar ting nge 'dzin 'brel bas chu zla'am 'ja' tshon ltar snang la rang bzhin med pa ngo bo stong / rang bzhin gsal/mtshan nyid gnyis su med pa dbyer med tsam du yang yid kyis ma bcings par nyams su blangs te/ de yang stong pa chos sku/ snang ba sprul sku/ dbyer med du longs spyod pa longs sku/ sku gsum yongs rdzogs bden pa dbyer med/ yid rtog gis ma bcings par goms par sbyangs pas/ ci spyad grol lam chen por 'gyur bas/ sgrub pa dbu zhabs kyi chog khrigs nas spyod lam rnam bzhir 'brel ba gal che'o/ /de yang 'ga' zhig spros pa la mi dga' ba snyom las can gyi blo la cho ga rim pa mang bar snang bas blo sun cing khams gzings par snang na yang log lta mi rung ste/ khrigs dum spungs par yang ting nge 'dzin dang mos pa tsam la brtan kyang mi 'gal lo/ /blo dang khams kyi nus tshad kyi gzhung rgyas par khrigs brkyang na/ nges par dngos grub che la myur ro/ /ci'i phyir zhe na/ cho ga phra mo yan chad kyang phal cher rgyud la byung zhing / 'ga' zhig ni bla ma sgrub pa brnyes pa'i bka' srol phyag (25ba lnga zhes dang ḍā gi ma'i lung dang phyon nga nyid kyis yang le shod du —15/—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (25)nyams dang sbyar ba yin pas/ kun tu the tshom spongs la sgrubs shig /gang the tshom can dang rgyu blang ste/des chog gzu lum mkhan la dngos grub til 'bru tsam yang med do/ /dad mos kho nas nyams su blang bar bya'o/ khams kyi ma nus pa dang / mos pa dag pa thad ga'i ting nge 'dzin dran pa la rgyas bsdus snang ngo / /lar lta bas zin cing 'phrul shes pa gnad che'o/ /rdo rje rgyal pos sgrub mched rnams la cher bskyed de/ nang re nub re kun dge sbyor la 'di skad bskul/ ho/ skal ba dang ldan pa'i mched rnams dang rnal 'byor pa rnams/ slob dpon ni yi dam lha'i dngas mar bzung zhig /bla ma la mi'i 'du shes bskyed du mi rung ngo / /sku gsum lhun grub snying por sgoms shig /de dang mnyam pa'i yon tan 'byung ngo / /mched lcam rnams ye shes lha dang lha mor soms shig /'jig rten gyi 'khrul gtam dang ngan rtog spongs shig /bzhad gad dang bre mo'i gtam dang spyo 'thab dang gzi bcos dang dregs spyod btsog spyod ma byed cig /bdud kyi glags 'tshol ni mang ngo / /dngos grub sad la ma bskur cig /gzhan yang 'jig rten 'di'i ched du 'jug snyam pa'i sems ma byed cig /gcig la gcig zur dmod 'cha'i sems gtong zhing khro tshig ma byed cig /bskyed rdzogs ting nge 'dzin skabs su sgra ngan ma 'don khus ma 'debs/ slob dpon rnams kyis pha lta bu'i sems bskyed la/ brtse ba'i snying rje byams pas mi shes pa rnams la slobs shig /mched lcam rnams kyis kyang rgyal thebs las kyi slob dpon du spyi gtsug gi rat+na ra khur cig /sgos mthun nang bsdebs phyogs ris dang phag kha nye ring ma byed cig /gzungs ma rnams kyis kyang bza' (26na)shug su 'du bar ma sems par mthong ngo dang chags sems dang mig ser dang phrag dog spongs shig /sgos mdza' dang g.yo khram ma byed par gang la gang dgyes ba ched pa skong zhig /lcam dral rnams gcig la gcig brnyas bcos mi rung / re che dang zhe bzhag ma byed cig /'dzab bzlas kyi sgra mi bcag chang dbang dang gnyid dbang dang le lo'i tshod yod yengs ma lam du dus ma 'da' bar sgrub pa la brtson zhig /bka' bsgo ba de dag la gang su 'das pa de ni bdud dbang du 'gyur ro/ /bdud dbang du song ba la dngos grub med pas sgrims shig /byams pa'i ngag dang rgyal ba'i bka' nyen cig /rgyud las 'khor la —/52

bka' brgyad gsang ba yongs rdzogs kyi dbang bskur du sgrub yongs 'du'i 'khri shing / nang ma (ka)bka' bsgo dge sbyor bskul ces pas yang yang du bsgo'o/ /sman sgrub yod na 'di nyin nas nyin gsum gyi bar zhi ba'i dkyil 'khor la brten nas sngags rgyun 'dzin dgos pa gong du bshad pa ltar ro/ /dngos gzhi'i sa bcad nyer bzhi pa la sman sgrub mi byed tshe sang zhe ges las byang gzhung bsrangs nas gyer te dkyil 'khor sgrub 'dzab nas sngags rgyun byed/ nyin gsum gyi bar bum pa la gzungasathag btags te dbang bum gyi bum pa'i bskyed chog byas/ bka' so so'i sngags gsham du bum dbang nas gsungs pa'i bum sgrub kyi sham bu sbyar nas nyin gsum so so'i dmigs pa yang bsgyur nas rang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bor bzhugs pa'i mdun du bum pa bskyed/ sman sgrub yod na nyin gnyis gsum tsam khrol bur bsgrub ring bka' brgyad kyi las byang dngos gzhi mi gtong bas bum pa mi bsgrub/ phye mar bsgrub pa nas bzung zhag gsum gyi bar thun pa khag gnyis byas nas khag gcig gis sman sgrub dang khag gcig gi bum pa bsgrub (26brko gos/ zhag grangs dpe tsam yin/ dngos gzhi rgyun ring thung tsam byed la rag lus/ dper na bum pa bsgrubs zin nas dbang la zhag grangs drug tsam byed na spra khrid kyi dgongs dmigs dang bcas zhag gnyis la bsnyen pa/ zhag gnyis la sgrub pa/ zhag gcig la sgrub pa chen po/ zhag gcig la las spyor gyi dmigs pa dang sbrags nas sgrol dbang dang 'grig rtsis mdzad/ zhi khro gang yin yang sgrub pa tshugs nas bzung man ngag las bdun nyin star byed/'phrul 'khor bslab pa/ dge slong bskul ba tsha rting ngam dgongs ja lta bu skabs gang 'grig la nyin re tshar re mdzad/ las byang / rab dus bzhi ma grub na dus gsum byed/ che ba bskyed la bskul tshogisalhag yan bya/ lhag ma bzhi du bzung / ro mtho/ bstan skyong / zor gtor/ bro brdung gi bar nyin re bzhin byed/ dngos gzhi'i sa bcad nyer lnga pa bar chad nyul le bskrad pa ni/ bar chad 'byung ba'i dusabashad pa dang bstun kha yar gyi ging chas sogs sprod/ srod la dpon slob thams cad kyi kun thub rgyal mo'i bskul dang bcas rgyas par mdzad pa la/ sgrub pa la bzhugs nas dgongs mo nyi ma nub ka zer la nyul le bya rog skad bsgyur ma 'ong ste/ rtags su nyams mi dga'/ gnyid 'thib pa yong / srod —/53

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (25)la brang rkun nag mo 'ong ste/ mar me bkrag nyams chags pa skye dbang med gnyid du 'gro/ nam phyed na 'dod chags dmar po ra nu can 'ong ste/ rtags su dkyil 'khor steng du zhing lngags mgo thur la gtad pa gon nas/ srung mar brdzus te chags pa spyod tshul ston du 'ong ngo / /phyed yol nam smad dun rtser 'ong ste/ nyams seng seng byin (27na thad pa gcig 'ong ngo / /tho rengs skya rengs shar tsa na/ /lag bse mgo ma 'ong ste/ rtags su rig pa 'phrog yong ngo / nyi ma rtse shar tsa na gnam the nag po 'ong ste rtagasashes pa 'phyor 'ong ngo / /'od 'ong / nyi ma dros pa la klu srin sngon mo 'ong ste/ rtags su snying bcu hril byed/sgrub mched la nad drag po gtong ngo / /nyi ma phyed tshal klu chen 'ong ste/ rtags nyal snying 'dod/ gdug sems skye/ dkar dmar snying la 'dod pa'o/ /nyi ma phyed yol nas bdag ma yams 'ong ste/ rtags su nyam chung zhing bying bying byed pa 'ong / nyi ma myur smad la bdud the brang 'ong ste/ rtags su tshig pa za rnam smin mi dran sdig byed 'dod pa 'ong / de yan chad ni dus bcu'i nyul le ma bar chod byed pa'i ltas yin la/ mdor na dam sri rgyal 'gong / sa srin/ klu srin/ sngags pa dam nyams/ btsun pa sdom nyams/bon po mthar lhung la sogs shi 'dre nyams pa rnams bdud kyis bskul nas/ dus thams cad du yang bar chad rtsom/ bzang por ston yang nyams mi dga' ba dam sri/ dgongs ka bya mchu nag mo 'ong ba shas che bas/ de dag gi ltas dri zlog pa ting nge 'dzin mi gsal byin chung nyams seng / snying mi dga' chos spyod byed snying mi 'dod/ the tshom phyogs med du skye/ bla ma mched la snang ba ldog /glu gzhas la rtsi/ sems las su mi rung ba thams cad do/ /de tshe nyul le bskrad pa ni/ rdo rje mtshams pa las sa dus pas ging chas dkar nag 'jigs par zhugs te mi rkang mi lpags lcag 'bras can sngags ldan dang lug mgo bkal ba'i tho ba dang / gu gul dud pa yang bshams te/ drag (27btu brdung zhing e gru gsum dam sri'i liṅga gcig nang du nyul le rnams kyis ming gis sri la bskor ba bris la dgug gzhug bya pho nya btang / phur pa yan pa mang po blangs te/ ā+oṃ gha gha ghā ta ya sarba du/ badz+ra dha rod a dzñā pa ya ti sarba bi na/ kā ya wā snyi lta badz+ra gī li gī lwa ya hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa/ ces hūṃ bzhi'i sngags dang sbrel te/ phur bu —154

bka' brgyad gsang ba yongs rdzogs kyi dbang bskur dre yongs 'du'i 'khri shing / nang ma yodaliṅga la gdab pa'am bong mjis brdung / lcag gi mched thams cad la brab cing bskrad par bya'o/ /gal po nas nyul le re la gnyen po re bskul thabs yod na'ang 'dir dril nas bstan pa yin no/nan tar cho 'phrul che na 'chams stabs sdang mig tu blta zhing / che ba bskyed de dpal gyi pho nya kun thub rgyal po bskul ba ni/ hūṃ/ shar phyogs dkar po dung gi gzhal yas su/ khrag mdog dmar mo bse yi lan pon can/ spyan rtsa dmar po nyi zla ltar du 'phro/ /smin ma glog 'khyug bar snang go skabs 'byed/ /bu yug thog 'bebs shangs nas rdo rje zhakhyug /ba 'ad pa he dang dpal gyi sbu gris gtams/ /rngam pa'i ljags 'dril bskal pa'i me chen 'bar/ /ag tshom me 'bar rab 'byams srid pa bsreg /bskal pa'i phrug sgra snyan nas gsung sgra sgrog /'am/pa dmar po sbu gri 'bum gyis gtam/ /sen mo lcags kyu'i rtse la bskal me 'bar/ /thabs kyi gnam lcags bzhun ma'i rdo rje 'khrug /smin mtshams lcags kyi khro chu'i char 'bebs shing / zhal gyi phur pas srin mo lnga brgya gzir/ /ral pa'i gseb nas khrag gi char chen 'bebs/ tshen tu mi bzad gtum chen khrag 'thung ma/ khran po'i snying 'byin 'chang bar bcug nas gsol/ tshen tu mi bzad 'bar (28na tha'i sku gcig ma/ /dpag tshad lnga brgyar rgyug cing klu srin sgrol/ khros pa'i zhal mdog khrag gi mtshan pa kha/ /na bza' dmar po srin gyi g.yang gzhi gsol/ /phyogs bcur kha bltas phyogs skyong zhabs kyis mnan/ /dus la bab na snying khrag dron mo 'thung / khre la bab na srog rtsa dmar po gcod/ /dgra la bab na dug gi kha chu 'debs/ /bgegs la bab na rū pa rdul du rlog /dpal gyi pho nya dpal gyi thugs las sprul/ /dam nyams dgra dang 'byung po bgegs la sogs/ /phung po dum bur gtub la don snying bsregs/ khrum bu a pa rtse/rū pa rtsen re/ rtsa med sa a ga sha pa ya ka /bi na ya ga /phye ma phye ma rdul phran rdul phran/ tsit+ta rbad nan ces brdung ngo / /skabs su bro yang gzir ro/ /dge sbyor gang la 'jug kyang / nyul le'i bar go 'dul ba 'di gnad zab bo/ /dngos gzhi'i sa bcad nyer drug pa rgyun du 'byung ba'i dngos grub blang ba dngos grub kyi ltas —155

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (25) byung ba dang bstun len par bshad kyang da ltar phyag len la nyin re bzhin tshogs 'khor dang bstun nas len pa ni/ tshul bzhin bsgrub pa'i gang zag la/ dam can dngos grub rgyun du skyel ba ni/ nyi ma dmar thag lha srin sde brgyad kyi dngos grub skyel/ de bzhin du mun nag la srin po dam can/ gung la srid pa ma mo/ nam phyed la re ma ti/ phyed yol la ma bdun/ nam langs tshe dkar mo bde bzhi/ tho rangs shing bco brgyad/ nyi ma rtse shar rdo rje srin po/ nyi dros ha lu man+ta/ nyin phyed klu dam ldan/ dgongs mo klu sman mtsho sman gyi dngos grub skyel du 'ong ngo / /gzhan yang rgyun du rigs 'dzin mkha' 'gro chos skyong dam can rnams dngos grub khyer (28bsni(nga ste/ chos dang tshe ring ba dang / dbang dang mas dang srid dang nor dang 'bru zas dang las sna tshogs pas dngos grub gang yod ster ro/ /dngos grub ltas su sgra snyan gzugs mdzes 'od 'du dri zhim pa brtson 'grus rtsom snying 'dod pa/ cho ga la spro ba ting nge 'dzin gsal ba/ nyams dga' ba byin che gzeng mtho dpa' ba/ spobs pa skye ba/ sems dpa' ba/ sems snye —/sa su rung na/ dngos grub de dag la dga' brod kyang mi bya/ rgyu 'bras su blta/ gong du bstan pa'i nyul le bar chad ltas ngan pa mthong yang mi dga' bar mi bya/ de bzhin nyid kyi rtsal du bltas te/ dran rtog rang sar dag par bsgral lo/ /dngos grub mtshan ltas byung tshe ka pā la mtshan ldan du chang la a mṛ ta bran la bdud rtsi 'khyil par bsams te 'di skad bskul lo/ /hūṃ/ bde gshegs rgyal ba rnams kyi thugs dam dang / /sbyor lam tshogs lam gnas pa'i dam can tshogs/ /rnal 'byor bdag la sngon gyi thugs dam gyi/ /tshe dang chos dang las bzhi myur 'grub dang / /rkang mgyogs mig sman ri lu mkha' spyod dang / /srid nor zas tshogos mthu rtsal dngos grub stsol/ /a la la ho/ bdud rtsi btung bar bya'o/ /rkyen de la brten nas rgyun gyi dngos grub thob par nges so/ /dngos gzhi'i sa bcad nyer bdun pa sgrub pa'i gegs bsal ba dang / dngos gzhi'i sa bcad nyer brgyad pa dngos grub kyi ltas brtag pa gnyis sgrub khog tu gsal/ dngos gzhi'i sa bcad nyer dgu pa dbang bskur ba la dbang bum nas/ spyi don gnyis pa dbang gi chu bo gang zhe na zhes sogs dang —/56

bka' brgyad gsang ba yongs rdzogs kyi dbang bskur 1 yongs 'du'i 'khri shing / nang ma (ka)cod pan gyi dbang bskur gong du 'jug pa'i dus (29na)kyang me tog dor ba dang 'phyi ba byung rung 'dir byed srol yod pa ka ṭo ra 'brus bkang bar dpal dgu'i tsaka li snor mor bkram nas der dor/ de nas dbang bum las/ rgyu ngan pha ma'i khu khrag la sogs kyi lhar bskyed do/ /yungs kar tsam dkar shar shar gyi byin 'bebs/ slob ma rig pa'i dbang lnga gar che mchog tu bskyed pas/ rigasakun gyi khyab bdag yin pas legs/ dbang rdzas ni gsar ma ba tsho yang lha de dang de 'od du zhu ba'i rdzas kyi rnam par byed pas/ 'dir yang lha de'i ngo bor mos pas khyab bo/ /de yang bum pa bzang po sogs kyi mjug tu/ zhes brjod pas gong gi yig 'bru lnga zhes pa gong gi rgyu ngan pha ma'i khu khrag sogs kyi nang du slob bu'i gtsug tu ā+oṃ āḥlha khyuḥhā lnga yin no/ /thal mo bstan pa'i phyag rgya ni g.yas kyi sor mo lnga rigs lnga yab/ g.yon gyi sor mo lnga yum du gsal ba'i dbang du btang nas sor mo lnga rtse bsnol ba'i phyag rgya mgo bo'i gnas lngar gtugs/ bum chu spyi bor blug zer bar ku shas sdugs/ bum chus dbang bskur byang chub sems sogs kyi bum chu ster/ de'i rjes ma gnyis la bum pa mgor 'jog /bdud rtsir chu rgyun dag pas dbang bskur ba sogs kyis kyang bum chu ster/ 'di man tshang mar bum pa rang mgor 'jog /gral phyi nang mang po yod na gral re la bum pa gnyis re bskor/ gral gcig las med na yang dag dang gshin rje'i bum pa bskor rjes/ rta mgrin dang phur pa'i bum pa bskor ba sogs brgyad ka bskor ro/ /bum bskor mgor mi 'jog lag par 'jog pa bla ma dam pa'i phyag len dang gsung rgyun (29ba tshe yin pas blor nges par byas la/ spyi don gnyi mo dang gi lo rnams 'di gar mdzad na legs/ pa dbang gi chu bo gang zhe na/ rang rig gzhan dbang du ma gyur pa'i chos sku rang tshugs thug pa'o/ /spyi don gsum pa dbang gi nges tshig gang zhe na/ rig pa'i rtsal snang srid 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad la byan tshung dbang sgyur ba'i phyir dbang chen bya'o/ /spyi don bzhi pa dbang gi dbye ba bstan pa la gnyis te/ khyad par ye shes kyi dbang bskur ba dang /thun mong thugs rje'i dbang ngo / /dang po khyad par ye shes kyi dbang la bco lnga ste/ phyi mtshon byed dkyil —157—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (25)'khor bum rdzas la sogs pa la brten nas kri yog yar ldan gyi dbang rim brgyad dang / nang lha dbang yongs rje'ogs la brten nas ma hā a nu dregs pa'i mthu dbang la sogs byin rlabs yongs rdzogs kyi dbang rim dgu dang / gsang ba yab yum sbyor dbang bde mchog la brten nas byang sems yongasardzogs sa lam myur mgyogs kyi dbang gsum dang / yang gsang de kho na nyid rgyal thabs spyi blugs kyi dbang la brten nas a ti yo ga yongs rdzogs kyi dbang rim drug ste dbang rim bco lnga'o/ /gnyis pa thun mong thugs rje'i dbang la gnyis te/ bka' rab 'byams nus pa'i dbang dang / thun mong nusapa'i dbang ngo / /de la 'i nus pa dbang la rim pa brgyad/ thun mong gi dbang rim lnga'o/ /de ltar rtsa ba'i dbang rim nyer brgyad la/ phra mor phye na dbang lnga bcu rtsa drug /sgrub lung tshur dril bas nyis brgya so bdun la dbang yongs su rdzogs par bstan no/ /spyi don lnga pa dbang yongs rdzogs bskur thabs dngos bstan pa la gnyis te/ dbang rdzong bsnyen sgrub kyis (30na)khog dbub pa dang / ji ltar dbang bskur thabs kyi ngo ti'i rim pa'o/ /dang po dbang rdzong ni dbang gi bla ma phun sum tshogs pa bcu ldan dang / slob ma phun tshogs snod ldan dang / de bzhin du gnas grogs yo byad dus sgrub chos phun sum tshogs pa la sogs pa/phun tshogs bdun gyis gzhi bzung ste sta gon gyi las khrigs bcu gcig gis sngon 'gro byas pa ni nyan rang byang sems theg pa thun mong gi dbang rang bzhin gyis thob par byed do/ /gzhung gi las khrigs so brgyad kyis bsnyen sgrub byas pas tshogs gnyis rdzogs nas dbang rdzong 'chos par byed do/ /rjes kyi las khrigs bco brgyad kyis mtha' bskyang pas dngos grub kyi rgyun bsring bar byed de sgrub chen gzhung btsugs dbang rdzong chen po bca'o/ /ji ltar dbang bskur thabs kyi ngo ti rim pa ni/ gzhung gi las khrigs rtsa dgu pa dbang bskur ba'i skabs su bab pa yang dbang bskur bya ste/ de yang ji ltar bskur ba'i thabs kyi rim pa'i khrigs la mdo le'u rnam drug ste/ dang po phyi'i dbang rim brgyad bskur/ gnyis pa nang gi dbang rim dgu bskur/—158

bka' brgyad gsang ba yongs rdzogs kyi dbang bskur dus sgrub yongs 'du'i 'khri shing / nang ma (ka)gsum pa nus pa'i dbang rim brgyad bskud bzhi pa thun mong gi dbang rim lnga bskur/ lnga pa gsang chen gyi dbang rim gsum bskur/ drug pa yang gsang spyi 'byams kyi dbang rim drug bskur bar bya'o/ /dang po phyi'i dbang rim brgyad la/ thog mar cod pan ming du bcas pa'i dbang bskur te cod pan ji lta bu zhe na/ dar sna lnga sor lnga par gtubs te lnga dkyus la sku lnga ye shes lngar byin gyis brlabasal slob bu rnams kyis thal mo'i bar du bzung ste/ shar sgo (30bskos 'di skad ces pho brang dbus su mig btsum la dor bar bya ste/ ho/ sngon tshe tshe rabs grangs med nas/ /dge ba'i stobs kyis bsten pa'i lha/ /yi dam lha mchog gang yin la/ /da lta nyid du 'bab par shog /ā+oṃ badz+ra bra ti gh+ri na ho/ cod pan de lha gang la bab pa'i rigs mtshan las gras te/ gsang mtshan gdags te dbus su bab na/ /rdo rje che mchog 'dus pa rtsal/ shar du rdo rje thugs mchog 'dus pa rtsal/ /lho ru rin wo yon to 'dus pa rtsal/ zhub tu pad+ma che mchog 'dus pa rtsal/ /byang du ga me badz+ra drag po rtsal/ shar lhor bla med rdo rje gsang ba rtsal/ /lho nub rigs 'dzin rdo rje thod pa rtsal/ zhub byang dregs pa rdo rje me rtag rtsal/ /byang shar drag po rdo rje stobs mchog rtsal/ /zhes ming gi dbang bskur te/ /ā+oṃ bhud+dha badz+ra rat+na pad+ma da rma na ma a bhi sa ṣañtsa ā+oṃ rdo rje che ge mos yi dam che ge mo'i gsang mtshan gyi dbang dam pa thob par gyur cig ces me tog babs pa'i lha de yi dam du dpog par bya'o/ /de stanas bla mas cad ban gdags shing dbang bskur te/ gyi cod pan 'di ni dpa' bo'i rtags/ /smon lam mthun pa'i lhas byin brlabs/ /bar chad kun gyis mi tshugs shing / /'khor ba'i skyon gyis ma gosashog /ho/ rdo rje che ge mo la cod pan ming du bcas pa'i dbang bskur bas khams gsum srid gsum mchog gsum rgyal ba'i zhing du chos kyis grags pa'i dbang dam pa thob par gyur cig /ces gtsug tu gdags de ltar mched kun la tshar rjes su/ mtshan ston gyi tshogs 'khor yang bya'o/ /'og bzhin rab gnas kyang bya'o/ /de nas tho rangs dbang bskur te/ de (31na〉nga rgyu ngan pha ma'i khu khrag las grub pa'i tha ma'i —159

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (25)lus rdza shing las grub pa'i snod lta bus dbang bcud seng ge'i 'o ma lta bu 'di mi thub pas snod ldan sbyang ba'i dbang ni/ slob bu'i spyi gtsug tu nyi zla'i dkyil 'bor lnga bkod steng du ā+oṃ āḥ/ tre hrīḥhā dang lnga bsgom ste badz+ra su rla tsan+d+ra tha phaṭa yi ge lnga las 'od zer lcags bsregs kyi tsha tsha lta bu 'phros nas slob bu'i lus la thim pas rgyu pha ma'i khu khrag mi gtsang ba thams cad dang lus ngan dri ma dang / sems kyi rtog sgrib dang dri ma ma rig bag chags thams cad bya spu mes 'tshig pa ltar bsreg par bsam/badz+ra a be sha a zhes brjod pas mdun gyi nam mkha' la ye shes kyi lha dkyil 'khor rnams kyi sku gsung thugs kyi dbyig nas byin rlabs yungs gar tsam dkar shar ra ra byon nas slob bu rnams kyi spyi bor thim par bsam/ de nas rang yi dam gang mos su gsal bas dbang zhu'o/ /tha mal gyis zhus kyang dbang mi chags so/ /de'i phyir rang che mchog lta bur bskyed la zhu'o/ /de nas bum pa chen mo spyan drangs gtsug tu bzhag ste/ hūṃ/ bum pa bzang bo gzhal yas khang / /zhi khro yongs rdzogs lha tsho gos bzhugs/ /skal ldan khyod la dbang bskur bas/ /lusang ga yid gsum smin gyur na/ /sku gsung thugs su lhun grub shog /ā+oṃ āḥ& swāhā sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṇiñtsa swāhā/ zhes brjod pas gong gi yig 'bru lnga las rigasalnga'i phyag mtshan lngar bsam/ de nas rgyal thebs kyis bum pa 'dzin du bcug la bla mas rigs lnga 'khril spyor phyag rgya bcas te slob bu'i dpral gtsug tu gtugs la/ ā+oṃ (31bskornya mu tra a bhi khiñtsa ā+oṃ/ badz+ra mu tra ba bhi ḍiñtsa hūṃ/ rat+na mu tra a bhi ṇiñtsa lha/ pad+ma mu tra a bhi ṇiñtsa gyi ga me mu tra sha bhi khi tshe/zhes spyi bor blug ste/ hūṃ/ phyag rgyas dbang bskur bka' 'dul ba/ /rang snang dam tshig gsum brtsegasapa/ /nyams pa rdul tsam med dag pa'i/ /dbang mchog dam pa thob gyur cig /bhud+dha ka la sha a bhi ṇiñtsa ā+oṃ/ badz+ra ka la sha a bhi ṇiñtsa hūṃ/ rat+na ka la sha a bhi khiñtsa lha/ pad+ma ka la sha a bhi 'a ṣañtsa myi rkarma ka la sha a bhi 'i khiñtsa hā/ hūṃ bum bcud dbang bskur byang chub sems/ /bdud rtsis sgrib gnyis kun byang ste/ /chos kyi bdud rtsi chen po la/ /dus gsum mnga' mnyes dbang thob shog /ā+oṃ lī hūṃ / swā — yī sde hā / /—160

bka' brgyad gsang ba yong rdzogs kyi dbang bskur dus sgrub yongs 'du'i 'khri shing / nang ma ldanabo dhi tsit+ta a bhi ṇiñtsa a/ de nas bum pa rgyal thabs kyis bzung la bum dbang bye brag yon tan yongs rdzogs kyis dbang bskur te/ hūṃ/ bum pa dbang bskur rtag tu dpal gnas shing / /mdzes pas dbang byed rdzogos pas ka la sha /spyi bor bzhugs pas pad+ma rwa ga'i mdog /dag cing dri med res kyis mgul dkris shing / /'bras bu rgyas pas shing gis kha brgyan te/ /gzungs thag rnam pa lnga dang rab ldan pa/kha dog thegs bsgyur me tog sna tsho gis ldan/ /'bru lnga spos lnga rin chen snying po lnga/ /sman dar lnga ldan bum pa'i dbang bskur bas/ /rtag tu dpal gnas nyin mtshan bkra shis shog /ā+oṃ shu pa ka ri gi ti hūṃ/bum ba kha rgyan mgul chings la sogs te mdzes pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan/ 'bru lnga sman lnga spos lnga rat+na lnga dang lnga la sogs te/ yid kyi dkyil 'khor la brten nas dbang (32na〉skur bas de bzhin gshegs pa'i rang bzhin yon tan dbang thob par gyur cig /hūṃ/ bkra shis rgyal byed bum pas dbang bskur bas/ /ye shes dbang bcu dag la dbang byas te/ /log 'dren bdud bzhi dgra las rnam rgyal nas/ /rnam pa kun mkhyen go 'phang thob par shog /oṃ ka la sha mahā mu tra sarba tsho na si ti hūṃ/ bum pa : las gzhal yas khang du bsgoms pa'i nang du lha'i dkyil 'khor gzhud bzhin gsal bar bsgoms de tshul bzhin spyan drangs mchod pa phul/ bzlas brjod dag par byas te dbang bskur bas rigs lnga'i dbang yongs rdzogs su thob par gyur cig /hūṃ/ bdud rtsi chu rgyun dag pas dbang bskur bas/ /skye 'gro kun gso nyon mongs sgrib 'joms shing / /rigs gsum mgon po'i yon tan yongs rdzogs te/ /las dang nyon mongs sgrib pa dag gyur cig /ā+oṃ mahā pa ni ka ru bhi shud : hūṃ/ bum pa'i nang gi chus dbang bskur bas de bzhin gshegs pa'i thugs rje chen po'i chus spyi bo dang yan lag thams cad khyab ste/lus sems la yod pa'i sgrib pa thams cad byang zhing dag par gyur cig /hūṃ/ 'bru mchog rnam pa lnga yis dbang bskur bas/ /dge ba'i rtsab rgyu tsho gis chud na yang / /dge ba'i mchog gis sangs rgyas 'bras bu smin/ /ma 'dres sangs rgyas chos dang ldan par shog /ā+oṃ pañtsa ri ba gi ti hūṃ/ bum pa'i nang na 'bru rnam pa lnga gnas pa'i dbang bskur bas mu ge'i bskal ba las thar nas 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las—161—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (25)'das pa'i longs spyod mi zad gter la longs spyod par gyur cig /hūṃ/ sman mchog rnam pa lnga yisadabang bskur bas/ /'jig rten nad sel sman gyi rgyal po ltar/ /(32ba tha zhi brgya rtsa bzhi'i nad rnamasaphyir bsal te/ /stong phrag bshegs las rab tu thar bar shog /ā+oṃ a my-i ta pañtsa da ra smi mahā ka ru hūṃ/bum pa'i nang na sman lnga gnas pa'i dbang bskur bas/ lus la 'bul ba rnam bzhi las gyur pa phyi nang gi nad thams cad byang zhing dag nas 'gro ba gzhan gyi nad sel ba'i thabs ston par gyur cig /hūṃ/ spos mchog rnam pa lnga yis dbang bskur bas/ /dri zhim spos kyis sa dang gdung sel ltar/ khrimasakhrims la so gos chen po lngas/ /nyon mongs dug lnga'i gdung sel shog /ā+oṃ du pa pañtsa a pa ta she mahā pa ta she mahā pa ti sa rnyi te hūṃ/ bum pa'i nang na spos rnam pa lnga gnas pas dbang bskur bas nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa thams cad dang bral nas/ sems can thams cad kyi nyon mongs pa'i gdung ba sel ba'i dbang dam pa thob par gyur cig /hūṃ/ rin chen rnam pa lnga yis dbang bskur nas/ /yid bzhin nor bus re ba kun skongs ltar/ /'gro don bsam pa yid bzhin 'grub pa dang / /'dod yon rnam pa lnga la longs spyod shog /ā+oṃ pañtsa rat+na si ti sar hūṃ/ bum pa'i nang rat+na rnam pa lnga gnas pa'i dbang bskur bas/ yon tan yid bzhin mchog dang ldan nas mtsho ni gyi bskal pa zhi ba dang / mi 'jigs pa'i dbang thob nas sems can thams cad kyi re ba skong bar gyur cig /hūṃ/ snying po rnam pa lnga yis dbang bskur bas/ /lha yi rgyal pos bde ba mchog grub ltar/ /dngos grub snying po myur du 'byung ba dang / /sku lnga lhun gyis grub pa'i dbang thob shog /ā+oṃ pañtsa tsit+ta u pa ta si ti hūṃ/ bum pa'i nang na snying po rnam lnga gnas pa'i dbang bskur bas/ /mchog thun mong gi bcud rgyud la rgyas pa dang (33na〉skyi lnga lhun gyis grub nas 'gro ba thams cad 'dul ba'i ston par gyur cig /hūṃ/ dar sna rnam pa lnga yis dbang bskur bas/ /bar snang 'ja' mos 'gro ba'i yid 'dren ltar/ /ye shes lnga po ma 'gags rab gsal te/ /sprul pa mang pos sems can don byed shog /ā+oṃ su da ra tsa na ta si ti hūṃ/ bum pa'i nang na dar sna rnam pa lnga gnas pa'i dbang bskur bas phung po lnga ye shes su gsal te 'gro ba'i ma rig mun pa sel ba'i —/62

bka' brgyad gsang ba yongs rdzogs kyi dbang bskur dus sgrub yongs 'du'i 'khri shing / nang ma (ka)sgron mer gyur cig /hūṃ/ kha rgyan shing tog rtsa tsos dbang bskur bas/ /dpag bsam shing chen re ba kun skong ltar/ /dran pa nyer gzhag rnams kyi byang chub phyogs/ /sum cu rtsa bdun cho so kyi dbang thob shog /ā+oṃ ka la brik+ṣa su me sa ta su na hūṃ/ bum pa'i kha rgyan gyi dbang bskur bas/ /rten 'brel bcu gnyis dang byang chub kyi chos sum cu rtsa bdun la sogs pa rgyu dang 'bras bu'i chos thams cad kyi don rtogs nas/ sku mtshan gyi me tog la dpe byad kyi 'byu chags par gyur cig /hūṃ/ mgul chings cod pan srog lnga'i dbang bskur bas/ /rgyal thebs gtso bo lta bur dbang sgyur te/ /ye shes rnam pa lnga po rdzogs gyur nas/ /bde gshegs rigs lnga yongs kyi dbang thob shog /ā+oṃ da na rme te ba ka shi ka si ti hūṃ/ mgul chings kyi dbang bskur bas/ slob bu khyed lha'i na bza' pañtsa li ka la longs spyod cing thugs rje gdugs dang 'dra bar sems can gyi duḥkha tshad pa dang 'dra ba las skyob cing bla na med pa'i byang chub kyi tshogs rdzogs par gyur cig /hūṃ/ gzungs thag rnam pa lnga yis dbang bskur bas/ /don gzungs tshig gi gzungs la sogs/ /bde gshegs sku lnga ye shes (33ba〉snga/ /mab du mi ldan gzungs ldan shog /ā+oṃ u pa ya ba ri su ra ga pa sha mi ta ku ru hūṃ/ bum pa'i gzungs thag gis dbang bskur bas/ deng 'dir slob bu rnams gzungs dang ting nge 'dzin sku dang ye shes dngos su mi gtong zhing yongs su 'brel bar gyur cig de nas a ru ra zur brgyad pa phyung la dgu'i rtsa sngags la dzñā na pañtsa mahā si ti hūṃ hūṃ zhes brjod de rdo rje slob dpon gyis gsol bas dbang nyams gso zhing stobs bskyed pa'o/ /de nas rnam rgyal bum pa ma gtogs bum pa brgyad gral g.yas g.yon du bsnol te bskor zhing smon lam gdab ste/ na mo bum pa'i smon lam du gsol ba ni/ ho bum pa zlum por 'dug pa ni chos kyi sku spros pa dang mtshan ma dang bral ba'i rang bzhin no/ /rdo rje rgyal thebs las kyi slob dpon brgyad la mngon du dbang bskur te he ru ka brgyad du gsal bas so so'i rang sngags sham bur a bhi khiñtsa a zhes gral la bsnol la bskor cing bskur ro/ kha khyer nyis brtsegs su byung ba ni/ chos kyi sku las longasaspyod rdzogs pa'i sku/ /longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku las sprul pa'i sku byung ste/ sku gsum dang ldan pa'i bum —/63—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (25)pa 'di/ deng gi slob ma 'khor dang bcas pa la dbang bskur zhing khrus chab gsol bas sku gsum gyi don rtogs shing thos pa'i dbang dang ldan par gyur cig /bum pa'i nang na chu gnas pa ni byang chub kyi sems kyi chu rgyun la sogs bas deng yon bdag gi smon lam ci btab pa rnams chu bo'i rgyun dang 'dra bar tshe dang dbang thang rgyun mi chad par gyur cig /bum pa'i nang na rin po che gnas pa ni yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po ches 'gro ba mtha' dag gi 'dod pa thams cad yid (34na tha zhin du 'grub pa dang 'dra bar deng gi yon bdag gi re ba yid bzhin du 'grub par gyur cig /bum pa'i nang na 'bru rnam pa lnga gnas pa ni/ bcom ldan 'das kyis 'gro ba sems can thams cad zas kyis 'phongs shing nyam thag pa rnams zas dang 'bru'i bcud kyis 'phongs pa bor te nor gyi mdzod mi zad pa'i gter du gyur cig /bum pa'i nang na snying po lnga gnas pa ni don dang nor gyi snying po la sogs pa ni gser la sogasapa yin bas zas nor thams cad kyi mchog che ba'i yon tan 'dus nas/ deng gi yon bdag la bcom ldan 'das kyi dkyil 'khor deng mnyam par gyur cig /bum pa'i nang na sman rnam pa lnga gnas pa ni sman gyi rgyal po be+e ḍūrla 'od kyi rgyal po lta bu'i dbang thob par gyur te/ deng gi slob ma nad bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi dang bgegs rigs stong phrag brgyad cu rtsa bzhi'i gnyen por byin gyis brlabs pas/ nyon mongs pa'i nad rnams dang rtog pa'i bgegs thams cad las thar bar gyur cig /bum pa'i nang na dar sna lnga gnas pa dang / bum pa'i na bza' mgul rgyan ni/ slob ma'i lus la reg pa tsam gyis ngo tsha khrel 'dzem dang chog shes pa'i gos dang ldan par gyur cig /gzungs thag ni thugs rje'i gzungs thag la sogs pas/ deng gi slob ma dang 'gro ba mtha' dag 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho dang khams gsum gyi btson dong nas btone te thugs rje'i gzungs kyis zin par gyur cig /bum pa'i kha rgyan ni dpag bsam gyi shing lta bur byin gyis brlabs te sum cu rtsa gsum gyi longs spyod kyi rgyan 'bras bu yid bzhin gyi zas nang blangs na nang skye nub blangs na nub skye ba dang 'dra bar slob ma dang deng yon bdag (34ba〉tswa sgor bcas tshe dang dbang thang dang dpal dang gzi brjid skye bar gyur cig /ces smon lam 164

bka' brgyad gsang ba yong rdzogs kyi dbang bskur dus sgrub yongs 'du'i 'khri shing / nang ma (ka)'debs shing bum skor byas pas bum bdud mched gang gi spyi bor 'dzom pa de la bkra shis dngos grub 'byung bar nges so/ /de ltar bum pa'i dbang yongs rdzogs thob phan chad sngags phyi pa'i dbang thams cad kyang yongs su rdzogs par nges shes bskyed par bya'o/ /de nas dbu rgyan gyi dbang bskur te dbu rgyan gang zhe na/ rin po che'i zur phud gyen du gzings pa lnga'i dbus na phyi rigs lnga'i phyag mtshan snying por bcasapa brog zhu'i tshul gcig slob bu'i mgo la bkon te/ kye ho rdo rje slob dpon dgongs/ /bdag cag las dang skal par ldan/ /che ge'i dbang mchog bskur du gsol/ /zhes dbang phran kun la yang sbyar ro gsung / me rtag gtor khrus nas dbyung / gu gul bdug /hūṃ/ sangs rgyas bzhugs gnas rin chen 'od/ /rdo rje 'khor lo rin chen mdzes/ /pad+ma rgya gram dam tshig gnas/ /dbu rgyan ze brog dbang bskur ro/ /ā+oṃ badz+ra burnya rat+na pad+ma rkarma ma gu ta t+t+waṃ a bhi khiñtsa a/ dbu rgyan gyis dbang bskur bas snod kyi 'jig rten phyogs bzhi dbus dang lnga gnas gyur te/ rdo rje la sogs pa'i khang bu lngar gyur nas rigasalnga ye shes lnga'i bzhugs gnas byin rlabs kun 'byung zhid bya ba thams cad la ma rmongs par dbang sgyur ba ye shes kyi sku dang ldan par gyur cig /de nas zhi ba'i mas dbang bcu las/ dbu rgyan gong du bstan nas mas brgyad ni/ 'phreng ba snyan cha mgur chu dang / do shal dpung rgyan rtse mo do/ stod g.yogasasmad dkris gdu bu rnams/ /gser dang dngul la bzo byas rab/ /tshon kha bsgyur 'bring / tha ma brisatshon la brten nas/ hūṃ/ (35nas brjed gzung 'dzin rin chen 'phreng / /sku gsung thugs rten 'phreng dbang bskur thob shog /hūṃ/ bdud dpung zil gnon gsung rab chos kun dpa'/ /mi snyan skyon spangs snyan cha'i dbang bskur ro/ /hūṃ/ ye shes rab mdzes rnam dag dbyings su 'khor/ /rat+na gser gyi mgur chus dbang bskur ro/ /hūṃ/ dbyings rig yongs tshol sprul sku sna tsho gos ston/ /do shal ut+pal bsgrigs pa'i dbang bskur ro/ /hūṃ/ thabs shes dpung ldan nyon mongs zil gnon dpal/ /rin chen dpung rgyan 'bar bas dbang bskur ro/ /hūṃ/ gsang sngags rmad byung ye nas thugs gsal —/65—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (25)ba/ /re skong ze khab rtse mo dos dbang bskur/ /hūṃ/ lta spyod rnam dag spyi dang bye brag khyab/ /na bza' stod g.yogs smad dkris dbang bskur ro/ /hūṃ/ rtag tu snying bo don gyi chos snyor bskor/ /phyag zhabasagadu bu rnam bzhig dbang bskur ro/ /sarba rat+na dzñā na a bhi khiñtsa hūṃ/ zhes slob bu'i gnas su rgyan dgod par bya'o/ /des ni dper na blon por dbang bskur tshe bsam rgyud mdun gros la gtong ba ji bzhin du/zhi ba'i chas dbang bskur tshe zhi ba'i sku gsung thugs dang mi 'bral bar mdzad 'gro ba 'dul ba'i go cha bgo bar bya'o/ /de nas dpal gyi mas bcu'i dbang bskur te/ chos bcu gang zhe na/ rgyan dgod skabs su smos pa ltar rab dngos 'bring bcos pa tha ma shog bu la bris te tshon bsgyur rgyab yig can du byas pa thogs la/ hūṃ/ nga rgyal ma spangs rang grol sku lnga 'gro don mdzad/ /ye shes lnga ldan thod 'phreng dbang bskur ro/ /hūṃ/ gti mug ma spangs rang grol shes rab 'gro don mdzad/ /(35brkos bral glang r+ṣa ko rlon dbang bskur ro/ /hūṃ/ zhe snang ma spangs rang grol thabs kyi 'gro don mdzad/ /kun grol sprul gyi chun pos dbang bskur ro/ /hūṃ/ phrag dog ma spangs tshad med 'gro don mdzad/ /'phrin lasabazhi ldan zhing gos dbang bskur ro/ /hūṃ/ 'dod chags ma spangs dpa' bas 'gro don mdzad/ khamasagasum sgrol mdzad stag sham dbang bskur ro/ /hūṃ/ mkha' dbyings rnam dag rak+tas gdug pa sgrol/khams gsum dbang sdud khrag chen dbang bskur ro/ /hūṃ/ bsod nams tshogs chen rgyud drug 'khor ba'i bcud/ /byang chub zhag gi zo ris dbang bskur ro/ /hūṃ/ skye shi rtsad gcod 'khor ba thams cad sgrol mdzad pa/ /gdug pa kun 'dul thal chen dbang bskur ro/ /: mi 'gyur mi bzhigs srid gsuma' joms mdzad pa/ lti tsho kyang mi tshugs sgo khrab dbang bskur ro/ /hūṃ/ ye shes me 'bar 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho skems/ /ma rig mun sel me dpung dbang bskur ro/ /hūṃ/ phar phyin drug ldan shes rab yum dgu'i rgyan/ /rus pa'i rgyan drug gzig sham dbang bskur ro/ /ā+oṃ shrī he ru ka a bhi ṇiñtsa sa ma ya shi ye hūṃ swāhā/ dharma dha tu dzñā na a bhi ṇiñtsa hūṃ/ zhes chas bcu slob bu'i gnas su rim par dgod do/ /des ni dper na khrab sogs go cha gyon tshe bsam sbyor 'khrug pa 'thab pa la byed pa ltar du dpal gyi sku gsung —166

bka' brgyad gsang ba yongs rdzogs kyi dbang bskur dus g.yongs 'du'i 'khri shing / nang ma zhanathugs chas su bzhugs te 'grob rnams sgrol ba'i go ma bgo bar bya'o/ /de nas dam rdzas kyi dbang bskur te/ dam rdzas gang zhe na/ dpal gyi sgrub gtor dang a khra ta dang rak+ta rnga bo ches dbang bskur te/ hūṃ/sman rag gtor chen sgrub rdzas lnga/ /mchod rdzas dam pa'i dbang bskur (33) bas/ /lha dang dmacan rten mchod cing / /gsang sngags spyod pa'i dbang thob shog /oṃ āḥ/ sarba pañtsa a : ta rak+ta bha ling ta dha ma tu sarba pu tsa sam ya a bhi ṇiñtsa si ti a be sha ya a aḥ zhes rim par spyi bor dbang bskur ro/ /de ni yo byad phun sum tsho gos la byin gter gtad pa lta bus te mchod pa la brtson par bya'o/ /de nas zhi ba'i phyag mtshan gyis dbang bskur te/ phyag mtshan gang zhe na zhi ba rigs lnga ste/ rdo rje 'khor lo/rin chen/ pad+ma/ rgya gram/ phyag mtshan lnga po rab dngos/ 'bring bcos/ tha ma bris pa rnams rim par gto de/ hūṃ/rdo rje rtse lngas bdud dpung 'dzoms/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i rten dbang bskur/ /hūṃ/ 'bor lo rtsibs brgyad rnam rtog gcod/ /rnam par snang mdzad rten dbang bskur/ / hūṃ/ rin chen 'bar bsare ba bskongs/ /rin chen 'byung ldan rten dbang bskur/ /hūṃ/ pad+ma rab mdzes skyon dang bral/ /snang ba mtha' yas rten dbang bskur/ /hūṃ/ rdo rje rgya gram 'phrin las sgrub/ / don yod grub pa'i rten dbang skur/ /hūṃ/ shes rab dril bu chos sgra sgrog /rigs kyi yum lnga'i rten dbang bskur/ /ā+oṃ mahā dzñā na pañtsa shasta a bhi ṇiñtsa hūṃ zhes dbang bskur ro/ /des ni bzo mkhan la phyag cha'i sgrom bu gtad pa ltar gang la dpa' ba rnams spyod pa'i dbang thob par nges shes bskyed do/ /de nas khro bo'i phyag mtshan dbang bskur te/ gang zhe na/rdo rje rtsedagu /thod khrag /rdo rje dril bu/ 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad/ sdigs mdzub/rdo rje rtse lnga dril bu/ rdo rje rtse dgu me dpung / rdo rje rtse lnga ba dan/ rdo rje rtse lnga dril bu/ (36bsho rje dung khrag yum thams cad kha ṭ+wāṃ ban dmar/ rab dngos tshong bcos tha ma bris pa byas te/ hūṃ/ theg pa dgu rdzogs wor mtsho skems/ /rdo rje thod khrag dbang bskur ro/ /hūṃ/ sa dgu 'joms mdzad yang dag gsung / /rdo rje dril bu dbang bskur ro/ /hūṃ/ las kun rgyun gcod bdud bzhi gzir/ /'khor lo sdigasamadzub dbang bskur ro/ /hūṃ/ ye shes sngags bdag chags bral gsung / /rdo rje dril bus dbang bskur —167—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (25)ro/ /hūṃ/ theg mchog don ldan khams gsum bsreg /rdo rje me dpung dbang bskur ro/ /hūṃ/ skye mched don ston 'dod mags 'joms/ /rdo rje dung dmar dbang bskur ro/ /hūṃ/ sku lnga rigs 'dzin shesarab ldan/ /rdo rje dril bu'i dbang bskur ro/ /hūṃ/ dregs pa kun 'dul snying khrag rol/ /rdo rje ban dmar dbang bskur ro/ /hūṃ/ stobs chen kun sgrol dug gsum 'joms/ /rdo rje thod khrag dbang bskur ro/ /hūṃ/ sku gsung thugs sbyor nyon mongs skems/ kha ṭ+wāṃ ban dmar dbang bskur ro/ /ā+oṃ mahā mu tra sarba a be sha ṇiñtsa hūṃ/ zhes rim par bskur ro/ /de ni skyes bu go gyon la mtshon gtad pas dgra la 'bebs shing sgrol ba ltar dgra bgegs nye ne mongs bdud dpung tshar gcod gnas su stob pa'i dbang thob pa'i ngesashes bskyed do/ /de yan chad kyis phyi'i dbang rim brgyad bye brag phra mo drug cu tham pas bsten no/ /rab gnas tshogos 'khor bya'o/ /de nas lha dbang yongs rdzogs kyi dbang rim dgu las/ dang po zhi ba'i lha thams cad rigs lngar yongs su rdzogs pa'i dbang bskur te/ dbang rten brog zhu mgo ling lnga pa gcig la/ phyir zhi ba rigs lnga legs par bris(37na skong du khrag 'thung rigs lnga legs par bris pa gcig la dmigs rten byas nas/ re re 'dod 'jug btub pa byas la/ don ting nge 'dzin gyis lha so sor slob bu la bstim pa yin no/ /hūṃ/ rdo rje sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs/ /rdo rje dbyings phyug yum dang sbyor/ /lha dbang thams cad kyi sngon du las byang ltar byin dbab rang bzhin dgug go /gnyis su med pa'i byin rlabs kyis/ /rdo rje thugs kyi dbang yang sbyin/ /badz+ra satwa a bhi ṇiñtsa a/ ho rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum gyi dbang bskur ba/ kun la 'gre'o/ /rigs kyi bu khyod zhe sdang gnas su dag nas me long lta bu'i ye shes lhun gyis grub cing / mthar phyin nas thugs yang dag pa'i dngos grub thob ste/ dpal rdo rje sems dpa' dang yum rdo rje dbyings phyug ma'i sku gsung thugs kyi dbang thob par gyur cig /rnam par snang mdzad de bzhin gshegs/ /sangs rgyas dbyings ma yum dang sbyor/ /gnyis su med pa'i byin rlabs kyis/ /rdo rje sku'i dbang yang sbyin/ /burnya dzñā na a bhi ṇiñtsa a/rnam par snang mdzad yab yum gyis dbang bskur bas nyon mongs pa gti mug gnas su dag nas/—168

bka' brgyad gsang ba yongs rdzogs kyi dbang bskur du sgrub yongs 'du'i 'khri shing / nang ma zhanachos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes mthar phyin cing lhun gyis grub ste sku mi zad pa rgyan gyi dngos grub thob nas/ dpal rnam par snang mdzad dang yum sangs rgyas dbyings phyug ma'i dbang dam pa thob par gyur cig /rin chen 'byung ldan de bzhin gshegs/ /rin chen dbyings phyug yum dang sbyor/ /gnyis su med pa'i byin rlabs las/ /yon tan rgya mtsho'i dbang yang sbyin/ /rat+na dzñā na a bhi khiñtsa a/ rin chen 'byung (37bskon yab yum gyi dbang bskur bas nyon mongs pa nga rgyal gnas su dag nas/ mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes mthar phyin cing lhun gyis grub ste yon tan rin po che'i dngos grub thob nas/ dpal rin chen 'byung ldan dang / rin chen dbyings phyug ma'i dbang thob par gyur cig /hūṃ/ snang ba mtha' yasade bzhin gshegs/ /pad+ma dbyings phyug yum dang sbyor/ /gnyis su med pa'i byin rlabs kyis/ /gsung rab rgya mtsho'i dbang yang sbyin/ /pad+ma dzñā na a bhi ṇiñtsa a/ snang ba mtha' yas yab yum gyis dbang bskur bas nyon mongs pa'i 'dod chags gnas su dag nas so sor rtog pa'i ye shes mthar phyin cing lhun gyis grub nas gsung dbyangs mi zad sgrog pa'i dbang thob nas/ dpal snang ba mtha' yas dang /pad+ma dbyings phyug ma'i dbang thob par gyur cig /hūṃ/ don yod grub pa de bzhin gshegs/ /las kyi dbyings phyug yum dang sbyor/ /gnyis su med pa'i byin rlabs kyis/ /'phrin las rgya mtsho'i dbang yang sbyin/ /ga rma dzñā na a bhi ṇiñtsa a/ don yod grub pa yab yum gyis dbang bskur bas nye zhe mongs pa phrag dog gnas su dag nas bya ba nan tan gyi ye shes lhun gyis grub cing mthar phyin te/ dpal don yod grub pa dang las kyi dbyings phyug ma'i dbang thob par gyur cig /ces slob bu'i spyi gtsug dpral ba snyan gong g.yas ltag pa g.yon du rigs lnga bstim par bya'o/ /des ni dper na lus thob pa las yan lag yongs su rdzogs pa ltar zhi ba yongs rdzogs kyi dbang thob par nges shes bskyed do/ /rab gnas tshogos 'khor bya'o/ /gal te spros pa la dga' ba'i don du/ bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis rdzogs par bskur te/ lha so so'i (38na7tshan don sbyar te/ hūṃ/ semasadapa' tshe ge de bzhin gshegs/ /sems mtshe ge yum dang sbyor/ /gnyis su med par dbang bskur ro/ /bo —169

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (25)de tsit+ta a bhi khiñtsa hūṃ zhes sbyor/ hūṃ/ kun tu bzang po de bzhin gshegs/ /kun tu bzang mo yum dang sbyor/ /gnyis su med pa'i dbang bskur ro/ /bo de tsit+ta 'gre/ hūṃ/ lha dbang brgya byin de bzhin gshegs/ /lha rnams 'dul byed dbang bskur ro/ /bo de tsit+ta ri/ hūṃ/ bdud 'dul khro rgyal gshin rjes gshed/ /rdo rje lcags kyu yum dang sbyor/ /gnyis su med pa'i mo/ bo de tsit+ta a bhi ṇiñtsa hūṃ/ ho sangs rgyas bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis kyi dbang yongs su rdzogs par bskur bas/ rtog tshogs bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis rnam par dag nas/ mkhyen pa'i ye shes bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i dbang dam pa thob par gyur cig /ces brjod do/ /de nas khro bo thams cad khrag 'thung rigs lngar yongs su rdzogs pa'i dbang bskur te/ dbang rten gong gi rigs lnga'i nang logs he ru naḥlnga la dmigs rten byas la klad pa dung khang nang du khrag las lnga bstim pa ni/ hūṃ khrag 'thung badz+ra he rukaḥ /badz+ra kro ti yum dang sbyor/ /gnyis su med pa'i byin rlabs kyis/ /thugs mchogo khro rgyal dbang yang sbyin/ /badz+ra shri he ru ka kro ti shwa rī a gi ṣi ñtsa a/ ho badz+ra he ru naḥyab yum gyis dbang bskur bas rnam par shes pa'i phung po gnas su dag nas thugs mi 'gyur ba chos nyid kyi dbang thob par gyur cig /hūṃ/ khrag 'thung burnya he ru gaḥ/ burnya kro ti yum dang sbyor/ /gnyis su med pa'i byin rlabs kyis/ /sku yi khro rgyal dbang yang sbyin/ /bhud+dha shrī he ru ka bhud+dha kre ti shwa rī a bhi ṇiñtsa a (38bskornya he ru ka yab yum gyi dbang bskur bas/ gzugs kyi phung po gnas su dag nas/ sku mi 'gyur ba chos nyid kyi dbang thob bar gyur cig /hūṃ/ khrag 'thung rat+na he ru ka /rat+na kro ti shwa rī yum dang sbyor/ /gnyis su med pa'i byin rlabs kyis/ /yon to khro bo'i dbang yang sbyin/ /rat+na shrī he ru ka rat+na kro tī shwa rī a bhi ṇiñtsa a/ rat+na he ru ka yab yum gyis dbang bskur bas/ /tshor ba'i phung po gnas su dag nas yon to mi 'gyur ba chos snya kyi dbang thob par gyur cig / hūṃ/khrag 'thung pad+ma he ru ka /pad+ma kro ti yum dang sbyor/ /gnyis su med pa'i byin rlabs kyis/ /gsung gi khro bo'i dbang yang sbyin/ /pad+ma shrī he ru ka pad+ma kro tī shwa tī shwa rī a bhi ṇiñtsa a/ pad+ma he ru ka yab yum gyis dbang bskur bas/ 'du shes kyi phung po gnas su dag nas gsung mi 'gyur ba chos nyid kyi dbang —170

bka' brgyad gsang ba yongs rdzogs kyi dbang bskur dus sgrub yongs 'du'i 'khri shing / nang ma zhanathob par gyur cig /hūṃ/ khrag 'thung ga me he ru ka /rkarma kro ti yum dang sbyor/ /gnyis su med pa'i byin rlabs kyis/ /las kyi khro bo'i dbang yang sbyin/ /ga me shrī he ru ka badze kro tī shwa rī a bhi khiñtsa a/ skadze he ru ka yab yum gyis dbang bskur bas/ 'du byed kyi phung po gnas su dag nas/ 'phrin las mi 'gyur ba chos nyid kyi dbang thob par gyur cig /dbang des ni dper na 'od stong nyi ma'i snying po la rdzogs pa ltar du zhi khro yongs rdzogs kyi dbang thob par nges shes bskyed par bya'o/ /rab gnas tshogs 'khor bya'o/ /de nas sku bzhi yongs rdzogs kyi dbang bskur te/ dbang rten 'jam dbyangs spyan ras gzigs rdo rje sems dpa' kun bzang drug pa rdo rje 'chang dang bzhi'i sku re re la mtshon te slob bu'i gnas bzhin sam tis bstim pa ni/ hūṃ/ spyi bor 'jam (39na8pal ye shes bzhugs/ /phung po'i bdud las rgyal bar shog /mgrin par spyan ras gzigs dbang bzhugs/ /lha bu'i bdud las rgyal bar shog /snying gar rdo rje sems dpa' bzhugs/ /nyon mongs bdud las rgyal bar shog /lte bar rdo rje 'chang chen bzhugs/ /'chi bdag bdud las rgyal bar shog /rgyal ba rigs bzhis dbang bskur bas/ /bdud bzhi rab 'joms dbang thob nas/ /sku bzhi lhun gyis grub par shog /ā+oṃ wā gī shwa ri thu/ ā rlu pa lo ki te shwa rā ya/ badz+ra satwa hūṃ/ mahā badz+ra dha ra a bhi ṣañtsa a/ des ni dper na btsan po'i mkhar du zhugs pa ltar/ sku bzhi'i bdag nyid chen po bdud las rgyal ba'i dbang yongs su rdzogasapar nges shes bskyed do/ /de nas rtsal chen yongs rdzogs bya khyung sprul pa'i dbang bskur te/ dbang rten ni bya rgod rgyal mtshan nam khyung po khyung mo sa su bris pa gcig mtshon te/ / sprul pa'i bya khrung garuḍa/ /bde gshegs nus mthu rtsal chen rdzogs/ /klu 'dul khyung po khyung mo'i tshul/ /gtsug na rin chen rdo rje'i mchu/ /ral gri'i gshog rgyas lcags kyu'i sder/ /yang sprul rigs lnga'i khyung sprul bskor/ /gdug pa 'dul byed khyung dbang bskur/ /bden pa dbyer med don rtogs shog /ā+oṃ āḥ& khrom gha ru ḍa hūṃ phaṭa sarba a bhi ṣañtsa a/ zhes dpung pa gnyis su bstim/ des ni sgong chag khyung bzhin ji mi mnyam pa'i rtsal dbang thob par nges shes bskyed do/ /rab gnas tshogos bya/ de nas bde gshegs zhi khro bka' —171—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (25)brgyad longs rdzogs tshom bu dgu'i dbang bskur te/ dbang rten pho brang gi tsa gli kun gyis mtshon cing dmigs pas bstim par bya ste/ hūṃ/ bcom ldan dpal chen (39ba ji mchog he ru ka /mthing nag dbu gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi bgrad/ /g.yas gsum rdo rje rtse dgu rtse lnga rtse gsum bsnams/ / g.yon gsum ban dmar dung dmar thod khrag bsnams/ /gnam zhal yum 'khril dur khrod chas rnamasardzogs/ /rigs bzhi la sogs che mchog yongs rdzogs lha/ /skal ldan dbang bskur yon tan lhun grub shog /ā+oṃ badz+ra gro ta mahā shrī he ru ko3 sarba sam ya a bhi ṇiñtsa a/ zhes spyi bor bstim/ hūṃ/ bcom ldan dpal chen 'jam dpal gshin rje gshed/ /mthing nag dbu gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi bgrad/ /g.yas gsum 'khor lo ral gri dgra sta bsnams/ /g.yon gsum sdigs mdzub mdung dang ban dmar bsnams/ /sbyor sgrol yum dang dur khrod mas rnams rdzogs/ /rigs bzhi la sogs gshin rje yongasardzogs lhas/ /skal ldan dbang bskur sku lnga lhun grub shog /ā+oṃ gyi spri wi kri tā na na hūṃ sarba sam ya a bhi sa khiñtsa hrīḥ/ dpral bar bstim mo/ /hūṃ/ bcom ldan dpal chen rta mchog dbang gi rgyal/ /dmar nag dbu gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi bgrad/ /g.yas gsum rdo rje kha ṭ+wāṃ sprul zhags snams/ /g.yon gsum dril bu ban dmar lcags sgrog bsnams/ /gzi ldan yum 'khril dur khrod chas rnams rdzogs/ /rigs bzhi la sogs dbang chen yongs rdzogs lhas/ /skal ldan dbang bskur gsung dbyangs lhun grub shog /ā+oṃ ha ya sgyi ba hu lu hu lu hūṃ sarba sa ma ya a bhi ṇiñtsa a/ mgrin par bstim mo/ /hūṃ/ bcom ldan dpal chen badz+ra he ru ka /mthing nag dbu gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi bgrad/ /g.yas gsum rdo rje kha ṭ+wāṃ rnge'u chung bsnams/ /g.yon gsum (40na jil bu bhan dmar rgyu zhags bsnams/ /kro ti yum 'khyud dur khrod chas rnams rdzogs/ /rigs bzhi la sogs yang dag yongs rdzogs lhas/ /skal ldan dbang bskur thugs mchog lhun grub shog /ā+oṃ ru lu ru lu hūṃ bh+yo hūṃ sarba sa ma ya a bhi ṇiñtsa a/ snying gar bstim mo/ /hūṃ/ bcom ldan dpal chen rdo rje gzhen nu'i sku/ /mthing nag dbu gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi bgrad/ /g.yas gnyis rdo rje rtse lnga bsnams/ /g.yon gnyis me dpung kha ṭ+wāṃ rtse gsum —172

bka' brgyad gsang ba yongs rdzogs kyi dbang bskur ri yongs 'du'i 'khri shing / nang ma (ka) bsnams/ g.yas g.yon mtha' gnyis ri rab phur bu 'dril/ /rgyas 'debs yum 'byud dur khrod chas rnams rdzogs/ /rigs bzhi la sogs phur pa yongs rdzogs lhas/ /skal ldan dbang bskur 'phrin lasalhun grub shog /oṃ badz+ra gī li gī lā ya hūṃ sarba sam ya a bhi ṇiñtsa a/ lte bar bstim mo/ /hūṃ/ bcom ldan dpal chen bla med he ru ka /mthing nag dbu gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi bgrad/ /g.yas gsum rdo rje khyung khra sprul zhags bsnams/ /g.yon gsum ban dmar zhing dbyug ga'u bsnams/ /kun bzang yum 'khyud dur khrod chas rnams rdzogs/ /yum drug la sogs ma mo yongs rdzogs lhas/ /skal ldan dbang bskur ma mo lhun grub shog /ā+oṃ su spo dzñā na shrī he ru ka kro tī shwa rī hūṃ sarba sam ya a bhi ṇiñtsa a/gsang gnas su bstim mo/ /hūṃ/ bcom ldan dpal chen rigs 'dzin thod pa rtsal/ /sku mdog ma nges zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ /g.yas pa rdo rje g.yon pa dril bu bsnams/ /zhabs gnyis brkyang bskum zhi dang khro gar mdzad/ /rnal 'byor yum bcas rus pa'i rgyan drug spras/ (40bags 'dzin bzhi sogs rigs 'dzin yongs rdzogs lhas/ /skal ldan dbang bskur byin rlabs lhun grub shog /ā+oṃ badz+ra mahā ru sarba hūṃ sarba ma ya a bhi ṇiñtsa a/ spyi bor bstim/ hūṃ/ bcom ldan dpal chen dregs pa kun 'dul ni/ /mthing nag dbu gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi bgrad/ /g.yas g.yon dang po rdo rje dung khrag zhabrug g.yas kyi 'og gnyis lha brgyad mgo bo bsnams/ /g.yon gyi 'og gnyis klu brgyad mgo bo bsnams/ /spyi 'dul yum 'khyud dur khrod chas rnams rdzogs/ /rigs bzhi la sogs dregs pa yongs rdzogs lhas/ /skal ldan dbang bskur chos skyong lhun grub shog /ā+oṃ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa sarba dus na hūṃ sarba sam ya a bhi khiñtsa a/ dpus mo g.yas su bstim mo/ /hūṃ/ bcom ldan dpal chen stobs ldan nag po che/ /mthing nag dbu gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi bgrad/ /g.yas g.yon dang po rdo rje thod khrag dkrug g.yas gnyis lha brgyad tsit+ta rtsad nas bsnams/ /g.yon gnyis klu brgyad tsit+ta sgong ltar 'drel/ /'byung lnga yum 'khril dur khrod chas rnams rdzogs/ /rigs bzhi la so gos sngags bdag yongasardzogs lhas/ /skal ldan dbang bskur dgra bgegs tshar gcod shog /ā+oṃ badz+ra sarba dus e dza bh+yo sarba —173

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (25)sam ya a bhi khiñtsa a/ pus mo g.yon du bstim mo/ /de nas rigs bzhi so so'i 'khor rnams la/ khrag 'thung 'jigs byed che ge mos/ /dbang chen bskur bas mthu stobs yongs rdzogos shog /snying po brjod ces a bhi ṇiñtsa a/ zhes dbang bskur ro/ /de nas tshom bu'i lha tsho gos kyi smon lam gyi dbang bskur te me tog phyogs bcur 'thor zhing / ho/dpal (41na)gshin rje yab yum sras 'khor bcas pa'i dbang bskur bas bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku yongs su rdzogs pa'i dbang chen po thob par gyur cig /ho/ pad+ma dbang chen yab yum sras/ /'gre'o/ /bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsung / ho dpal badz+ra he ru ka sras/ bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs/ ho dpal che mchog he ru ka yab yum sras/ bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyi yon tan yongs su/ ho/ dpal chen rdo rje gzhen nu yab yum sras/ bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyi 'phrin las yongs su/ ho/ dpal bla med he ru /yab yum sras/ bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyi gzi brjid yongs su/ ho/ dpal rigs won thod pa rtsal yab yum sras/ bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyi chos sgo yongs su/ ho/ dpal dregasapa kun 'dul yab yum sras/ bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyi mthu/ ho/ dpal stobs ldan nag po yab yum sras 'khor bcas pa dbang bskur bas/ bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyi stobs yongs su rdzogs pa'i dbang wo po thob par gyur cig /dbang des ni dper na nam mkhar 'byung bzhi yongs su rdzogs pa ltar phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las gzi brjid rgyud mthu stobs thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa yin no/ /rab gnas tshogs 'khor gyis mnga' 'bul lo/ /de nas sku gsung thugs nan tan gyis dbang bskur te/ dbang rten ni mthing shog la/ ā+oṃ dkar po/ āḥdamar po/ hūṃ mthing nag gsum bris te/ ā+oṃ sku ni mi 'gyur (41bsta65kyi sku/ /'khor lo rtsibs brgyad ā+oṃ dkar gsal/ /dus gsum bde gshegs thams cad kyi/ /sku yi phyag rgyas dbang bskur ro/ /ā+oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta mahā kwa ya badz+ra swa bhā ba āt+pa ko3lha/ ho/ sku'i phyag rgyas dbang bskur bas lus su 'dzin pa rnam par dag nas bde bar gshegs—174

bka' brgyad gsang g.yong rdzogs kyi dbang bskur ri yongs 'du'i 'khri shing / nang ma (ka)rwa 'i sku'i bdag nyid du gyur cig /āḥsu ba mi 'gag chos kyi gsung / /pad+ma 'dab brgyad e dmar gsal/ / dus gsum bde gshegs thams cad kyi/ /gsung gi phyag rgyas dbang bskur ro/ /ā+oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta mahā ba ga badz+ra su bhā ba āt+pa ko3nya/ ho gsung gi phyag rgyas mo/ ngag tu 'dzin par/ bde bar gshegs pa'i gsung gi bdag nyid du gyur cig /hūṃ/ thugs ni mi skye chos nyid thugs/ /rdo rje rgya gram hūṃ mthing gsal/ /dus gsum bder/ thugs kyi ri/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ma hā tsit+ta badz+ra su bhā ba āt+pa ko3lha/ ho/ thugs kya phyag rgyas dbang bskur bas sems su 'dzin pa rnam par dag nas/ bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs kyi bdag nyid du gyur cig /ces spyi gtsug mgrin pa snying ga gsum du bstim mo/ /sgrub pa lung gi dbang skabs 'dir bskur ro/ /dbang des ni lcags la ngar blud pa ltar sgo gsum sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs ngar thogs pa yin no/ /bye brag tu sgrub lung gnasaskabs kyi dbang bskur ba ni/ bla ma la seng ge'i khri bcas te bzhugs/ slob bu rnams kyis me rta ge gtor te/ dbang gi zhu ba 'di skad do/ /ho/ rang bzhin bum pa ban dha'i lcang lo can/ /bdud rtsis bkang ba dbang gi rang bzhin la/ /bdag nyid mdun 'dug ye shes lha rnams kyis/ /sku gsung thugs (42na)kyi dbang mchog stsal du gsol/ /zhes pho brang gi zhu dbul/ bla mas gnang ba sbyin pa ni/ hūṃ/ dur khrod gsang ba mchog gi dkyil 'khor du/ /byang chub rdo rje'i lam la drangs nas kyang / /sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub sbyin par bya/ de nas slob ma dbang stegs 'dab ma brgyad pa'i steng du bzhag ste pho brang ban dha rnam lngas dbang bskur ba ni/ hūṃ/ mthing nag gru gsum 'gyur ba med pa'i sku/ /rtag tu hūṃ chen klong na 'khyil ba yi/ /bde chen byang chub sems su mngon rdzogs te/ /rdo rje rigs kyi ban dhas dbang bskur ro/ /dkar po chos nyid yangs shing gsal ba'i sku/ /mkha' mnyam byidangs phyug ma brgyad rtag rol cing / /srid pa'i chos la yid bzhin dbang sgyur ba'i/ /de bzhin rigs kyi ban dhas za/ /ser po yid bzhin yon to rgyas pa'i sku/ /ri rab spyi sgo brgyad dang rol pa'i sa/ /'dod dgu yid bzhin re ba skong mdzad pa/ /rin chen rigs kyi sko/ /chags pas mi gtong dbang gi rgyal po ste/ /dbang phyug —175

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (25)gter ldan lnga dang 'khril ba yis/ /'khor ba ma lus mya ngan 'das bsdus nas/ /pad+ma rigs kyi ma/ /ljang gu 'phrin las cir yang bsgyur ba'i sku/ /bsnyen pa'i gnas dang gdan dang nges pa'i sa lasakyi rigs kyi ban dhas dbang bskur ro/ /rigs lnga ye shes lnga yi byin rlabs kyis/ /skal ldan 'di la dbang mchog bskur du gsol/ /sku lnga ye shes lnga po dbyer med sku/ /rtogs pas khams gsum ma lus sbyong mdzad pa/ /thugs rje'i byin rlabs dngos grub mchog gsol bas/ /dug lnga gnod pa'i mthu dang rab ldan shog /ces rigs lnga'i dbang tshang (42bskos khyad par rten dgu'i dbang bya ste/ sku gsum thugs yon tan 'phrin las gnas sngar gtug cing dbus kyi thod sku bdud rtsi bum dbang nas rim par bskur te/ hūṃ/ che mchog yongs rdzogs bdud rtsi bum pa'i dbang / /skal ldan rigs kyi bu la bskur thob shog /: yang dag yongs rdzogos me gcig thugs kyi dbang / /skal ldan rigs kyi za/ /hūṃ/ gshin rje yongs rdzogs sku rten khram gcig dbang / /skal ldan ya/ /hūṃ/ pad+ma yongs rdzogs gsung rten rta zhal dbang / /skal ldan sko/ /hūṃ/ 'phrin las yongs rdzogs rdo rje phur gcig dbang/ /skal ldan྾/ /hūṃ/ ma mo kun 'dus snying gcig dam rdzas dbang / /skal ldan mo/ /hūṃ/ rigs 'dzin kun 'dus thod rtsal sku gcig dbang / /skal ldan mo/ /hūṃ/ 'jig rten kun 'dus dregs pa sku gcig dbang / /skal ldan rki/ /hūṃ/ drag sngags kun 'dus sngags kyi byang gcig dbang / /skal ldan rigs kyi bu la bskur thob shog /de yan chad kyis rigs lnga pho brang dgu'i dbang sto sku'i dbang ngo / /gsung snying pos dbang bskur te/ /oṃ bo dhi tsit+ta mahā su kha dzña na khyi tu āḥ/ gsang 'dus snying po 'di brjod pas/ /zhi ba'i lha tshogs yongs bsnyen cing / /sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub thob/ /'gro don nus pa'i dbang thob shog /ā+oṃ badz+ra kro ta ma hā shrī he ru ka hūṃ phaṭa/ gsang ba'i snying po 'di brjod pas/ che mchog yongs rdzogs rab bsnyen cing / /sku gsung thugs kyi ྾/ /'gro don nus pa'i dbang thob shog /ā+oṃ rulu ru lu3 〉gyi gsang ba'i mo/ /yang dgas/ u gsung thugs snga/ /(43na 'gro don nus pa'i ma/ /ā+oṃ akro te /ya man+ta /ha na mtha bhañdza hūṃ phaṭa/ gsang ba'i ma/ /gshin rje'i/ /sku gsung thugs sko/ /—/76

bka' brgyad gsang ba yongs rdzogs kyi dbang bskur dus sgrub yongs 'du'i 'khri shing / nang ma (ka)'gro don nus mo/ /ā+oṃ pad mān+ta kri ta mahā kro ta ha ya grib hūṃ phaṭa/ gsang ba'i mo/ /dbang chen lha tsho gis kho/ /sku gsung thugs mo/ /'gro don nus mo/ /ā+oṃ badz+raki li gī lā ya sarba bi na baṃ hūṃ phaṭa/gsang ba'i kho/ /phur ba'i sko/ /sku gsung thugs mo /'gro don nus rki/ /ā+oṃ tsho phya dzñā na shrī he ru kyithoti shwa rī hūṃ phaṭa/ gsang ba'i sko/ /ma mo'i྾/ /gsung thugs za/ /'gro don nus snga/ /ā+oṃ badz+ra ma hā gu ru sarba hūṃ phaṭa/ gsang ba'i ra/ /rigs 'dzin yongs rdzogos mo/ /sku gsung thugs sko/ /'gro don nus྾/ /ā+oṃ badz+ra tsiṇ+ḍas bo du gin hūṃ phaṭa/ gsang ba'i 'jig rten ri/ /sku gsung thugs za/ /'gro don nus྾/ /ā+oṃ badz+ra sa bo du pyin hūṃ phaṭa/ gsang ba'i snying po 'di brjod pas/ /drag sngags yongs rdzogs rab bsnyen cing / /sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub thob/ /'gro don nus pa'i dbang thob shog /de yan chad gsang ba snying po dgu'i dbang ste gsung gi dbang ngo / /thugs dbang ni bum pas bskur te/ hūṃ/thugs las brtol ba'i man ngag gsang chen po/ /spros bral stong gsal chos sku 'dzin pa med/ /skal ldan mchog gi dngos po dam pa'i gzungs/ /thogs med mthu mnga' rdzas mchogo dam pa 'di/ /dbang bskur gnyis med thugs kyi dbang thob shog /thugs kyi dbang chen yongs rdzogs 'gyur/ /de nas sgrub rdzas kyi dbang bskur te/ /rtags gong thogs la/ hūṃ/ lhag pa'i dur khrod thal chen zhag (43ba)rak+ta/ /he ru ga'i gnas bcu dur khrod gnas brgyad du/ /dpal chen ging dang mkha' 'gro kun dang gcig /dbang chen thabs kyis mthu dang rdzu phrul bskyed/ /bdag nyid chen por rab tu 'byor pa'i rtags/ /sngon gyi thugs dam rtags dang phyag rgya'i dbang 'dis ni ma mo mkha' 'gro rnams kyis kyang / /nang ming dang ni jo bor 'dzin par shog /ces rtags gsum gdab/ de nas a khra ta yod bang bskur te/ hūṃ/ dug lnga ma spangs sku yi rgyan du gnang / /'khor ba thugs rjes bzung phyir zhal dug sol/ /bdud rtsi a khru ta yi dbang bskur bas/ /dug lnga sgrol ba'i dbang dang ldan par shog /de nas gtore mas dbang bskur te/ hūṃ/ gzhed pa chos dbyings gtor ma phyag rgya'i lha/ /dam skongs mnyes mchode mahā bha li ta/ /'dod yon bdud rtsi'i phung pos dbang bskur bas/ /mi zad rin chen gter la longs —177

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (25)spyod shog /de nas byang sems rak+tas dbang bskur ni/ /hūṃ/ srid gsum ma lus yum gyi mkha' la sbyor/ /'dod chags gnas su dag pa pad+ma'i rigs/ /kun tu bzang mo yum gyi bha ga la/ /bde chen mi 'gyur thig le'i dbang thob shog /de nas dur khrod rdzas dbang ni/ 'khor ba ma spangs zhing chen g.yang gzhi dang / sha chen rkang rus thod pa sprul pa'i sku/ khrag gi rgya mtsho thugs rje'i dri chu dang / /nya chen 'phan dang sbrul nag za ra tshags/ /glang chen ko ba stag gzig dra tra'i shun/ khams gsum ma lus dbang sdud dbang thob shog /yungs gar rdzas dbang ni/ hūṃ/ sgrub rdzas yungs kar mchog gi dbang bskur bas/ /phra mo'i ting 'dzin las su rung ba dang / /gzugs can dgra dang gzugs med bgegs 'dul phyir/ /(44na'i la pa mang po 'gyed pa'i dbang thob shog /de nas rdo rje dril bus dbang bskur ba/ /hūṃ/ gsung rab bcu gnyis bstan pa'i sgra sgrog cing / /ye shes dag pa chos kyi dbyings nyid kyis/ /rgyal ba yab yum mnyes par mdzad pa yi/ /dril bu 'di yang skal ldan khyod la byin/ /hūṃ/ dpa' bo dpa' mo thabs la mkhas shing brnyes/ /thugs rje'i byin rlabs phun sumatsho gos pa yi/ /ye shes rnam pa lnga yi rang bzhin mchog /rdo rje 'di yang skal ldan khyod la byin/ /de nas phur pas dbang bskur ba/ hūṃ/chos nyid rtogs par byed pa'i ye shes dang / /phur bu don gyi lta ba'i rang bzhin dang / /phur pa chos skur rtogs pa'i gdengs ldan gyis/ /don dam gnyis med rtogs pa'i dbang thob shog /de nas phreng bas dbang bskur ba/ /sgrub rdzas rin chen 'phreng bas dbang bskur bas/ /bcom ldan lha rnams dngos su grub pa dang / /'khor gyi ma dang mkha' 'gro chos skyong rnams/ /thams cad 'du zhing 'khol nus dbang thob shog /de nas tshe dbang bskur ba ni/ hūṃ/ rdo rje tshe mchog mi 'gyur brtan pa'i dbang / /'di bskur rdo rje sems dang tshe mnyam shog /rdzas thun mong bas bskur ba/ hūṃ/ mda' yis dbang bskur nyon mongs bdud bzhi 'bigs par shog /ral gris dbang bskur gsang ba'i dgra 'joms shog /me long dbang bskur ye shes rab gsal shog /rgyal mtshan dbang bskur bdud las rgyal gyur cig /'phan dar dbang bskur byams pa'i sprin 'phel shog /'jam des dbang bskur byang chub sems ldan —178—

bka' brgyad gsang ba yongs rdzogs kyi dbang bskur dus sgrub yong 'du'i 'khri shing / nang ma zhanashog /zla rgyas dbang bskur tshogs gnyis gter rgyas shog /dza gad dbang bskur (44ba)'gro ba kun 'dul shog /pu tis dbang bskur shes rab gsum ldan shog /zhabs kyi dbang bskur gla ma'i sanon shog /de nas ye shes lnga'i dbang bskur te/ /dbang rten ni man shel dwangs po gcig nyi zer la sprad de/ hūṃ/ kun gzhi rnam shes gnas gyur te/ /bag chags ma lus gtan spangs nas/ /chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes su/ /dbang mchog dam par dbang bskur ro/ /ā+oṃ mahā shu dzñā na dzñā na badz+ra su bhā ba āt+pa ko3lha/ a bhi ṇiñtsa a/ ho/ chos kyi dbyings ye shes kyis dbang bskur bas/ /dngos dang mtshan ma med pa'i dbang thob par gyur cig /hūṃ/ sems kyi rnam shes gnas gyur te/ /bag chags ma lusagatan spangs nas/ /me long lta bu'i ye shes su/ /dbang mchog dam par dbang bskur ro/ /ā+oṃ mahā a dha ri sha dzñā na badz+ra su bhā ba āt+pa ko3lha/ a bi 'a ṣañtsa a/ ho/ me long lta bu'i ye shes kyis dbang bskur bas/ /gsal la 'dzin pa med pa'i dbang thob par gyur cig /hūṃ/ nyen mongs rnam shes gnas gyur te/ /bag chags ma lus gtan spangs nas/ /mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes su/ /dbang mchog dam pa ra dbang bskur ro/ /ā+oṃ mahā sa man+ta dzñā na badz+ra su bhā ba āt+pa ko3gi/ a bhi khiñtsa a/ mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shesakyi dbang bskur bas/ /chos thams cad nga dang bdag tu rtog pa med pa'i dbang thob par gyur cig /hūṃ/ yid kyi rnam shes gnas gyur te/ /bag chagasari/ /so sor rtog pa'i ye shes su/ /dbang mchog dam par dbang bskur ro/ /ā+oṃ mahā sa man+ta dzñā na badz+ra swa bhā ba āt+pa ko3gi/ a bhi khiñtsa a/ so sor rtog pa'i ye shes dbang bskur bas/ /chos thams cad (45na skos la la ma 'dres par sa le mthong ba'i dbang thob par gyur cig /hūṃ/ sgo lnga'i rnam shes gnas gyur te/ bag chags sko/ /bya ba nan tan ye shesasu/ /oṃ mahā kri ha a nu ta lha na badz+ra su bhā ba āt+pa ko3lha/ a bhi ṇiñtsa a/ bya ba nan tan ye shes kyi dbang bskur bas/ chos nyid byang chub sems kyi don mthar phyin cing chos sku myur bar mngon du gyur pa'i dbang thob par gyur cig /ces shel spyi bor bzhag la chos sku rnam dag spros bral las/ /rtsal ma 'gags ye shes lngar 'char ba ni shel lta bu'o/ /zhes ngo sprad do/ /dbang des ni lha khang sgo phye ba —179

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (25)dang 'dra bar rnam mkhyen 'char ba'i rgyu yin no/ /tshogs rab gnas bya'o/ /de nas lha dbang yongs su rdzogs pa de rab tu gnas par dbang bskur te/ dbang rten ni slob bu rnams la me long bstan la/ dri bzang khrus nas dbyung / sam ti gsal btab la bzhag /slob dpon gyis me tog dkar po nas dkar mo dang bsres te rten 'brel brgya rtsa brgyad bsnyen la slob bu la gtor cing / ma hā'i bsgom khog gisasgo gsum lhar/ hūṃ/ dbang bskur byin rlabs yongs rdzogs sras/ /lusang ga yid gsum ltar gyur te/ /'khor 'das chos la dbang sgyur ba'i/ /dbang dang dngos grub rab gnas shog /ces brjod la me tog dor/ 'dis kyang rab tu gnas so/ /ā+oṃ sarba ta thā ga taX da ya ma ni sha ta ti pa ye swāhā/ dharma rdzo tu gar+bhe lha da ya swāhā/ rab tu gnas pa'i yang snying brjod la me tog gtor ro/ /'dis kyang rab tu gnas te/ ā+oṃ e hūṃ swāhā ye dharmā he tu bra bha wā he tu rnye khrin thā ga to tho ba da tra/ te ṣ+ṭhañtsa yo ni ro dha e waṃ wā di mahā shra gaṇaḥswāhā/ (45ba〉sko mahā shā n+ya tā dzñā na badz+ra swā bhā ghā ri ko3gi/ thim par gyur cig /gsal bar gyur cig /mchod par gyur cig /'bar bar gyur cig /rgyas par gyur cig /dbang du gyur cig /ho/ smin 'dzos rigan rtogs par gyur cig /smin 'dzos rigan brtan par gyur cig /smin 'dzom rig na grol bar gyur cig /sam ya ho zhes lan bdun gtor/ gang zag bdag med nas chos nyid rnam dag 'gyur med
