du rab tu gnas so/ /rgyal thob kyi bkra shis brjod/ dbang des ni gser gyi sa gzhi la gser gyi ri rab bzhag pa ltar dbang yongs su rdzogs nas rab tu gnas par 'gyur ro/ /'brang rgyas bcas te sgra snyan sgrog /de rjes mnga' gsol dbang bskur ba'i phyir zhal zas bzang po sna tshogs spod kyis bran dza gad la rgyas phul te/ hūṃ/ bza' dang bca' dang btung ba'i tshogs/ kha mngar skyur rtsub lan tshwa spod/ /dza gad zla rgyas zla phrom dang / /tshe 'dzin me sa kun tu rgyu/ /'jam nges 'dzag ti la sogs te/ /'dod yon lnga yi longs spyod sna tsho gos la/ /dus rnams kun tu longs spyod shog /ā+oṃ badz+ra shā yu she hūṃ ra ṇi dza/ a bhi dzi sti a/ sarba gi ti kun pha la a she sha ya a/ ho/ zhal zas tshogis kyis dbang bskur bas/ /sbyin pa'i —180

bka' brgyad gsang ba yongs rdzogs kyi dbang bskur dus sgrub yongs 'du'i 'khri shing / nang ma (kanaphar phyin yongs rdzogs te/ /dus rtag tu longs spyod dang ldan nas rol pa'i dbang thob par gyur cig /ces tshogs 'khor bya/ bla ma la gser gyi maṇ+ḍal dbul/ phud gtor/ lha la bskang gso bya'o/ /dbang des ni rgyu spyi spungs la rgyan sgos su gtad pa ltar thams cad rwa chod med par longs spyad pas cho go go /(46na〉de nas sham bur dregs pa sde brgyad kyi srog dbang bskur bar bya ste/ dbang rten dregs pa sde brgyad kyi rang gzugs srog snying du bcas pa gsar la/ dregs pa'i srog dbang ni thod ngan nang du dbang rten dregs pa sde brgyad kyi gzugs brnyan srog snying dang bcas par bshams pa'i mdun du mchod gtor bang rim bzhi pa'i dang po dbang phyug dang mdun du dbu ma'i gtor ma/ g.yas g.yon du mar me/ bang rim gnyis pa'i logs bzhin gtor ma re/ bang rim gsum pa'i logs bzhin gtor ma gnyis re/ bzhi pa'i logs rer gtor ma bzhi re ste gtor ma sum cu zur gsum sha khrag mthe bskyus brgyan pa/ sman raka bsham/ sngon du slob dpon gyis lha srin bka' sdod du dbang du bsdu zhing zil gyis mnan pa zhes te/ ci'i phyir zhe na rang gi rnam shes tshogs brgyad ma dag pa'i phyir gzung 'dzin dregs par byung ba yin la/ tshogs brgyad rnam par dag tshe rigs lnga ye shes lnga kho nar bas/slob dpon gi sde brgyad dbang du bsdu zhing zil gyis mnan te/ rang nyid che mchog yongs rdzogs kyi skur gsal zhing lta ba dang ldan pas/ thugs ka nas 'phros pa'i 'od zer gyis sde brgyad rnams bkug par bsams la drag sngags(so lnga par sde dpon sum cu'i sngags btags pa brjod nas spyan drangs te sku so so la thim pas de dag dngos su gyur par bsams nas srog sngags bzla/ sde brgyad kyi nyon mongs pa'i dug gzhom pa'i phyir bsgral ba ni/ phur pa thogs nas/ sde brgyad gzugs rnams rang dang slob bu'i dbus su thod par bkod de sde brgyad so so'i skur bskyed bstim so so'i srog sngags bzlas shing bstim la de yang sde brgyad kyi (46ba/nyon mongs pa'i dug gzhes pa'i phyir bsgral bar bya ste/ hūṃ/nga ni za byed chen po ste/ khams gsum ma lus za bar bya'o/ /gdul dka' ma lus 'dul ba'i phyir/ /sha rus la sogs za bar bya'o/ /gshin rje ma mo rgyal po dang / /dgra lha btsan dang gnod sbyin dang / /—181—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (25)klu dang gza' dang lha srin rnams/ /gdul dka' ma lus 'dul pa'i phyir/ /mngon mthong stobs kyis bsgral bar bya/ /nga ni dpal chen za byed yin/ sha rus la sogs za bar bya'o/ /badz+ra sarba dun na trig nan e hur thums dza mā ra ya rbad/ ces bzlas shing bsgral bar bsams te sha khrag rus pa thams cad zos nyon mongs dregs pa tshar gcod par bsam/ khong pa chos kyi dbyings nas brgyud de/ dpal gyi lhums snam zhal gyis nam mkha' nas sde brgyad rnam shes byung nas/ tsakli'i gzugs la so sor bstim ste/ slob bu'i srung mar gtad de/ skabs der slob bus gzhu dbul te/ raṃ yaṃ zhe/ ā+oṃ āḥ/ gisari rab bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho 'dod yon lnga dang ldan pa sman raka gi rgya mtsho chen por bsams la/ hūṃ/sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung bar zhal bzhes pa zhes sogs kyi gsol ga'i mthar/ ā+oṃ mahā de wa e i rda bha li ta khā hi/ mahā pañtsa khā hi/ mahā rak+ta khā hi zhes pa 'og ma kun la 'gre/ hūṃ/ bkra shis dam lngan mthu che ba zhes sogs kyi 'phrin las bcol/ pho nya sgos bskul gyi nang gi bskul gtong / sdedapon gyi las byang chen mo byas kyang chog mod ha cang mang skyon yong / de nas srung mar bstod pa'i ched du gsol ba gdab pa ni/ ho/ rgyal ba kun dang mnyam par sbyor/ /dregs pa rnams la dbang sgyur ba'i/ /sgrub (47na〉rtsen rnal 'byor bdag la dgongs/ /bdag cag byang chub sems bskyed cing / /'phags mchod 'gro don bgyid dgongs pas/ /bdud dang 'byung po log 'dren dang / /mi nag srin po gdong dam ra gyis/ /byang chub bar gcod bstan pa 'jig /de yi gnyen por dregs pa'i tshogs/ /chos skyong sgos dbang mthu rtsal lu /zhes lan gsum yon cig dbul/ /de nas bla mas 'di skad gu /ho/ zhi khro yo ngas rdzags lha bsnyen na/ /chos skyong rnams kyang bran 'khol byed/ /'on kyang zhu ba de bzhin du/ /snang sri da dregs pa'i gtso sde brgyad/ /bran du gtad kyis dam gtsang srungs/ /zhes gnang ba sbyin no/ /de yang bdag ngan la khyi bcongs kyang mi chun pa dang 'dra bas slob bu nyid rang bzhin bde gshegs yongs rdzogs la rnam pa phyag rdor bsgoms la rdo rje dril bu gtad de/ hūṃ/ dus mchog bzang po de nas ni/ khyod kyang phyag rdor sku ru bsgyur/ /dpal chen phyag na rdo rje yi/ /sku gsung thugs dang —182

bka' brgyad gsang ba yongs rdzogs kyi dbang bskur dus sgrub yongs 'du'i 'khri shing / nang ma (ka)yon tan dang / /'phrin las lnga ru dbang yang bskur/ khyod kyang phyag rdor skur gyur nas/ /dregs pa kun gyi gnyen po ste/ /thams cad dbang sdud tshar gcod shog /ā+oṃ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa sarba dus ta ka ha na da ha pa tsa hūṃ phaṭa/ ho/ bu khyod dpal phyag na rdo rje'i dbang bskur bas/ lusang ga yid gsum mthu stobasakyi bdag po'i sku gsung thugs su gyur nas dregs pa sde brgyad dbang du sdud zil gyis gnon bran du 'khol ba'i dbang thob par gyur cig /des ni jo bos jo bo la bran gtad pa dang 'dra ste/ sdebargyad khol nus pa yin no/ /de nas tsakli rnams sbams te slob (47ba)bu'i srung mar gtad pa ni/ hūṃ/ zhe snang dbang gi dregs pa ni/ /gshin rje bdud kyi rgyal po yin/ /dbang bsdus zil gyis mnan nas ni/ /bran dang khol po yang g.yog dang / /'bangs kyi tshul du khyod la gtad/ /gnyen po'i sgrub pa yun ma thung / /bka' dang dam la gnas par 'gyur/ /ya ma rā dza sam ya dzaḥpa shaṃ ku ru hūṃ phaṭa/ ces gshin rje gtad la/ slob bu'i spyos 'og gtad des 'gre'o// hūṃ/ 'dod chags dbang gi dregs pa ni/ /ma mo mkha' 'gro'i rgyal mo yin/ /dbang bsdus mo/ /bran dang ྾/ /'bangs kyi ྾//gnyen po'i ྾/ /bka' dang dam ྾/ /trag rag sha kha mun tra dza/ pa shaṃ ku ru hūṃ phaṭa/ shu nga rgyal dbang)dregs pa ni/ /rgyal po gi pa gi tshogis yin te/ /dbang bsdus྾/ /bran dang ra/ /'bangs rki/ /gnyen po'i྾/ /bka' dang ྾/ /tri du ru hring du ru har ti dza pa she ku ru hūṃ phaṭa/ hūṃ/ phrag dog dbang gi dregs pa ni/ /rmu dang btsan gyi tsho gis yin te/ /dbang dus/ /bran dur/ /'bangs za/ /gnyen྾/ /bka'akho/ /ga shu la rā tsa tsa ti na tra sha ya dza/ pa she ku ru hūṃ phaṭa/ hūṃ/ las kyi dbang gi dregs pa ni/ /dgra lha ma sangasatsho gos yin te/ /dbang du/ /bran du/ /'bangs/ /gnyen/ /bka'/ /badz+ra sa du sam ya rā dza tri dza pa shaṃ ku ru hūṃ phaṭa/ hūṃ/ nga rgyal stobs kyi dregs pa ni/ /gnod sbyin srin po'i tshogs yin te/ /dbang ྾/ /bran mo/ /'bangs za/ /gnyan྾/ /bka' za/ /hri badz+ra yak+ṣa badz+ra hri hri dza pa shaṃ ku ru hūṃ phaṭa/ /hūṃ/gti mug dbang gi dregs pa ni/ /klu dang klu bdud tsho gis yin te/ /dbang ྾/ /(48na)bran mo/ /'bangs mo/ /gnyen྾/ /bka' mo/ /nā ga rā dza sam ya phu dza pa she ku ru hūṃ phaṭa/ hūṃ/ 'jig rten —/83—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (25)las shugs dregs pa ni/ /gza' dang gdong mo'i tsho gos yin te/ /dbangs/ /bran mo/ /'bangs ri/ /gnyen྾/ /bka' dang ྾/ /rā hu la ma ma khrig dza pa shaṃ ku ru hūṃ phaṭa/ ces sha khas 'og lan re phyung ste thod par bkram la a skṛ tas gso ba ni/ ā+oṃ e hūṃ sa ma ya a : ta ji hi khā hi/ snying nye bran pho bran mo'i tshogs/ /dam las ma 'da' sa ma yā/ /bdag gi srung mar mnga' gsol lo/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa khyed kyis srungs/ /dkon mchog dbu 'phang khyed kyis stod/ /rnal 'byor sku dgra khyed kyis sgrol/ /zhes srung mar bzung zhing gtor ma ma chag par btang ngo / /srog dbang du 'dus par dbang bskur ba ni/ gong gi slob bus zhu phul phyag rdor gyi dbang tshar ba'i rjes su bla mas dpe rgyud sgrub thabs/ 'phreng ba dregs pa sde brgyad dam gang mos sku rnams slob bu'i spyi bor bzhag ste/ e ma rigs mchog gsang ba'i bu/ /'jig rten dregs pa sdo brgyad tshogs/ /yongs rdzogs dpal gyi bka' srung ste/ /de ring khyod kyi rgyud la bsgo/ /dregs pa'i srog shing khyod la sbyin/ /bsad gsod dbab bcad bsrung dang bzlog /drag po'i las kun khyod gyis shig /ces dregs pa gang stod srog snying mjug tu/ ā+oṃ a dza li gi ti hūṃ āḥ sal te gi ti si ti a hūṃ/ sarba ga rma gi ti hūṃ/ ho/ de ltar dbang thob dregs pa dngos/ /khyod dang khyad par ci yang med/ /dbang ma thob na 'bras bu med/ /sa bon med pa'i so nam 'dra/ /de phyir (48bcu dbang srog sbyin zung / /zhes bskur ro/ /de nas gnad kyi khyim/ srog gi khyim/ mi slu ba rdo rje'i khyim gsum tshar gcig bzlas/ de nas dregs pa'i srog tshig dril gyi dbang bskur te/ hūṃ/'jig rten khams kyi dregs pa rnams/ /rang gi rtog tsho gis kho na ste/ /pho mo stong gi dra bar 'dus/ /stong dra sde dpon sum cur 'dus/ /de nyid sngags bdag bco brgyad 'dus/ /de nas dregs pa bcu gnyis 'dus/ /de ni lha srin sdo brgyad 'dus/ /de yang 'byung lnga'i lha 'drer 'dus/ /de nyid pho mo klu gsum 'dus/ /de yang pho mo gnyis su 'dus/ /de nyid ma ning nag po ste/ /'di ni kun gyi mi thub ste/ /gzhan gyis srung bzlog mi nus pas/ /ngar 'dzin ru tra'i rgyal po ste/ /yongs rdzogs gzhal yas khang gi gdan/ /gcig shur dur khrod bdag po ste/ /ma rig na ni rang gi bdud/ /rig na rnam dag he ru gaḥ/ / 184

bka' brgyad gsang ba yongs rdzogs kyi dbang bskur ri yongs 'du'i 'khri shing / nang ma (ka)stong srog rang rig chos skur bcad/ /rang rtsal mthu stobs dbang bskur ro/ /e hur thums dza rbad a bhi shin tsa a/ zhes srog dbang des ni dmag dpon rin po che chas pa ltar/ dregs pa'i tsho gis la rang dbang med par dbang du 'du'o/ /de nas zhal gdams kyi dbang bskur ba ni/ /ho/ 'jig rten lha srin 'di dag kyang / /la las bde gshegs zhal mthong bas/ /dgongs pa mya ngan 'das mod kyang / /spyod pa 'jig rten pa yi tshul/ /dam la btags pa'i dbang gi bu/ /da rung 'jig rten bya ma btang / /dge ba'i las la mos pa dang / /dam las ma thogs lasang na pas/ /sa bon rtsub pas phan gnod che/ /'ga' zhig bde gshegs zhal ma gzigs/ /chos la mi dad nag po'i tshogs/ /ring thung chad 'phel legs nyes sprul/ /(49na ponas med zas su phud gtor nyul/ /de 'dra 'jig rten tsho gos ma bsags/ /gdol pa rgod kyi rigs mangs bas/ /e ma rnal lhor bu khyod kyang / khrod sogs sgo gyis ma thob par/ /mngal skyes lus la brtan nas ni/ /dpa' bsnyems brtul zhugasang rgyal gyis/ /lha srin dregs pa gdul mi bya/ /bsod nams rlung rta gud dus su/ khongs su yal bar ci la 'jog khyu 'bras chos nyid rang snang yin/ /spyod pa ma rtsing rnal 'byor pa/ /mos spyod chos sgor bzhugs pasakyang / /lha srin sdebargyad la sogs pa/ /bla ma'i chos gzhud srung ma dang / /gnas der gnas bsamayul gyi lha/ /lha srin sdebargyad thams cad la/ /gsol ka mchod pa byas na shis/ /bla ma sangs rgyasartag tu mchod/ /mchod rten dmod mo gang sgrub kyang / /mnyes byas sgrub thabs tshang bar lu /phal du spyi mthun rigs ma 'das/ /'dod yon mchod gtong bzang na 'grub/ /legs nyes bstang 'dzin dngosagrub ni/ /dam tshig dgongs pa las lo dang / /sgrub thabs zab dang mi zab dang / /gang nus dngosagrub rim par 'byung / /yid gnyis blo rgod lhangs skyes na/ /las mi 'grub pas the tshom spongs/ /da ltar byas pas ma grub na/ /spogs pa'i cho gas ar la gtad/ /des ni 'jig rten dngos grub thob/ /spyi bstan srungs shig rnal 'byor pa/ /lha ma bsnyen pas 'dre ma sgrub/ /rang rgyud 'grogs kyang mi bde bas/ /skyon yang shin tu mang bar gsungs/ /thams cad chos sku'i rang rtsal du/ /dgongs pa bskyed —185

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (25)cing zab par bya/ /'di dag bran du ba po lo pa yang / khyud la byin (49ba〉khas thob pa yang / / rtog tsho gis nye bar gyur pa dang / /gnyis med gnas lugs gting nas rtogs/ /zag zad 'byung ba dbang du 'dus/ /bden mthong chos nyid rang la rnyed/ /de lta bu yi rnal 'byor pas/ /las la brtson na dngos grub ni/ /dgongs pa dag la mi sgrib par/ /bde bar gshegs pa nyid dang mtshungs/ /'dasadang ma 'ongs dngos grub kun/ /bla ma'i thugs rgyud mnyes las 'byung / /mchog tu dam tshig gtsor bzung zhig /sa ma ya sngo zhes don bkrol la bshad/ /dbang de rnams kyis bka' sdod lha srin sdobargyad bran du 'khol bar 'gyur ro/ /skabs 'dir tshogs 'khor dang rab gnas bya'o/ /de yan chad kyis nang gi dbang rim dgu phra mo zhe bdun tshar ro/ /de nas thun mong slob dpon nus pa'i dbang rim brgyad las/ dang po rdo rje rgyal po nus pa' dbang bskur te/ /dbang rten la seng ge'i khri bsham/ /rdo rje dril bu gdugs rgyal mtshan/ /ā li dang kā li'i yi ge bshams nas slob bu khri la bzhag ste/ hūṃ/ bde gshegs sras po skyes bu dam pa'i mchog /sngon gyi thugs dam bka' dang mi 'gal zhing / /dgongs pa yid bzhin nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam/ /'phrin las thabs kyi rdo rje slob dpon mchog /'gro ba ma lus kun gyi re ba skong / ston ma'i sgron mes ma lus kha lo 'dren/ shes rab thabs rdzogs yon tan lhun gyis grub/ /sdug bsngal skyabs mdzad ma rig sems can 'dren/ /chos nyid don la ma lus sangs rgyas sbyor/ /sangs rgyas gdung sob rdo rje slob dpon mchog /gang yin sngon du gyur pa lhun grub pa'i/ /(50na rko bang chen yongs rdzogs khyod kyis thob par shog /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pu ༅ shwa rā badz+ra su 4 4 ko ྅ lha/ sme ru dharma shwa ra a bhi ṇiñtsa a/rdo rje slob dpon nus pa'i dbang wo po bskur bas/ dam tshig dbang gi slob dpon nus pa'i dbang thob par gyur cig shes rab rgyud kyi slob dpon nus pa'i dbang / /man ngag lung gi slob dpon nus pa'i kho/ /nyams pa stong ba'i ྾/ /bka' brgyud lung ston ྾/ /rang byung mtha' bral don gyi slob dpon nus pa'i dbang dam pa thob par gyur cig /de nas gdugs phub ste/ hūṃ/ gdugs mdzes —/86

bka' brgyad gsang ba yongs rdzogs spya dbang bskur dus sgrub yongs 'du'i 'khri shing / nang ma (ka)gser gyi yu bar ldan/ /skyabs chen byams pa chen po ste/ /nyen mongs gdung ba sal ba yi bkrashis gdugs kyi dbang bskur te/ ā+oṃ sur+ya rat+na a bhi sti mi ho/ /ha gdugs kyi dbang bskur bas/ nyen mongs pa'i tshad pa sel te/ /ye shes kyi snang ba skyes nas/ /thugs rje chen pos 'khor ba las skyab pa'i dbang thob par gyur cig /de nas rdo rje phyag g.yas su gtad de/ hūṃ/ mchod pa'i rdo rje rtse lnga pa/ /sku lnga chos lnga dbyer med ye shes lnga/ /nyon mongs dug lnga 'joms pa'i rdo rje ste/ /thabs mchog rdo rje'i dbang bskur thob par shog /dzñā na pañtsa badz+ra a bhi khiñtsa a a/ ho rdo rje rtse lnga pas dbang bskur bas sku lnga ye shes lnga'i dbang thob par gyur cig /de nas g.yon du dril bu gtad de/ hūṃ/ rnam dag chos sgra dril bu 'dis/ /gsung rab bcu gnyis sgra bsgrags pas/ /ye shes chen po chos kyi dbyings/ /shes rab rig par dbang bskur ro/ /dharma dh+wa tu shabha a bhi khiñtsa a/ ho dril bus dbang bskur bas/(50ba〉byas thams cad sgra snyan lta bu'i ye shes las thabs shes rab dbyer med pa'i dbang dam pa thob par gyur cig /de nas rgyal mtshan bsgrengs te/ hūṃ/ 'jig rten gsum mgon chos kyi rtog /chos kyi rgyal mtshan legs par 'dzugs/ /gsang sngags snying po mi nub phyir/ /ye shes rgyal mtshan dbang bskur ro/ /ā+oṃ rā dza sto shwa ra ho/ ho/ rgyal mtshan gyis dbang bskur bas 'bor ba'i rgya mtshor mi nub cing theg pa'i yang rtser chos kyi rgyal mtshan bsgreng ba'i dbang thob par gyur cig /dbang desani rgyal bu thang 'khyams rgyal sar phyung ba ltar rdo rje slob dpon gyis zin par bskyed do/ /de nas nyan nus pa'i dbang bskur te/ dbang ldan du pu ti gtad de/ hūṃ/ shes rab rnam gsum dag pa yis/ /ston pa'i sgron mar 'gyur ba'i phyir/ /bde gshegs bka' yi byin rlabs las/ /gsang chen thugasakyi man ngag dang / /theg pa phyi nang mtha' dag kun/ /rna ba'i dbang pos nyan pa dang / shes rab blo yis 'dzin pa dang / /thos grol nyan pa'i dbang thob shog /ā+oṃ dharma kha na su bhā ba āt+pa ko3lha/ nyan pa'i dbang bskur bas bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i chos las chos sgo brgyad khri bzhi stong la mthun 'jug nyan pa'i dbang thob par gyur cig /chags shing gis bdud rtsi rna ba gnyis su btig go /de nas 'dri —187—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (25)nus pa'i dbang bskur te/ dbang rten bris cha gtad de/ hūṃ/ bde gshegs gsung sgros bka' rgyud rnams/ /theg pa phyi nang mtha' dag bstan/ /tshig dang yi ger gnas pa yis/ /mi nub spun gyi btsas su 'gyur/ /'dri zhing klog pa'i dbang bskur ro/ /dha ma kha na ā li kā li su bhā ba (51na)āt+pa ko3 snya/ ho/'dri klog nus pa'i dbang bskur bas/ chos thams cad mi mnyel ba'i gzungs dang ldan te/ sprul sku 'gro don byed pa'i dbang dam ba thob par gyur cig /a mṛ tas mtheb mdzub la thig le bya zhing /snag smyug shog bu gto do/ /de nas chos la ra nus pa'o dbang skur te/ dbang rten /pā li bshad chos bzhugs pa gtad de/ hūṃ/ shes rab rnam gsum yongs rdzogs pas/ /'dren pa bla med skyes bur ston/ /theg pa mtha' dag sgrub mthu mnga'/ shes rab rig pa'i mdzod kha phye/ /tshangs pa'i gsung dbyangs kun gyis go /chos bka' theg pa yongs rdzogs pa/ /'chad par nus pa'i dbang bskur ro/ /ā+oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sha lta dharma su bhā ba byu ko3hi/ ho/ chos bshad nus pa dbang bskur bas/ gsung chos sgo brgyad khri bzhi stong rgyu 'bras gang 'dul chos kyi dad ldan skyes bu'i yid tshim par sgrog nus pa'i dbang thob par gyur cig /a mṛ ta lce la bzhag ga /de nas sgrub nus pa'i dbang bskur te/ /dbang brten tsaka li bam po phreng bar dril la/ /hūṃ/ rnal 'byor chen po sku gsung thugs kyi bdag /sdug bsngal 'ganas lha da byang chub bde bsgrub phyir/ /rdzas nyid ye shes lngar bsgrub phyag rgya'i tshogs/ /rnam shes phung po rnam lnga dkyil 'khor che/ /skye mched khams rnams sangs rgyas mang po'i lha/ /bde gshegs thabasakyi 'bras bus gang yin pa/ /bde gshegs lha rnams sgrub byed dbang thob shog /ā+oṃ yo ga sarba dharma mahā ta thā ga ta mahā su bhā ba byu ko3lha/ sgrub pa'i dbang bskur bas khyod kyi phung khams dang skye mched lha dang lha mo'i rang bzhin du gyur nas (51ba tha dam gyi lha bsnyen cing bsgrub pa'i dbang thob par gyur cig /de nas sgom pa'i dbang bskur te/ rdzas ni byang sems dkar dmar/ /tsha ba gsum/ tsha sna gsum/ su smel bu ram gyis mgo bsdus pa'i ril bu bcu gsum ka pā la chang dang sbyar te/ hūṃ/ lusal rtsa rlung thig le'i byang sems gnas/ /de dag sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin te/ g.yin du bsgom —/88

bka' brgyad gsang ba yongs rdzog kyi dbang bskur du sgrub yongs 'du'i 'khri shing / nang ma dzadabya sgom byed ga la yod/ /dbu ma snying po'i rtsa ru sems gnas phyir/ /rtsa rlung thig le drod kyis dbang bskur ro/ /ā+oṃ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍali raṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sha rī raṃ swā bhā ba sto ko ྅ lha/ ho/ rtsa rlung thig le drod kyi dbang bskur bas/ bde drod rtogs pa yongs su rdzogs nas phyir mi ldog pa'i dbang thob par gyur cig /ces chang ril rdzogs par blud de/ ras dmar bo gcig bkon la stong ra dmar po rgya rdza bsregs pa lta bu zhag bdun du bsgom du bcug la/ gtum mo rtsa rlud khrid rim gdab bo/ /dbang des ni rtsa rlud thig le yongs rdzogs su bsgom pa'i dbang thob ba yin no/ /de nas dbang rten bka' rab mas nus pa'i dbang bskur te/ dbang rten ni/ a ā/ i sī/ u lha/ ṛ 2 / bla sī/ e i/ o au/ e aḥ zhes dbyangs yig brgya drug dang / /khag snyang/ /tsa tshadzadzha nya/ /ṭaṭhaḍa lha ṇa/ ta thad gan/ /pa phab bha ma/ /ya ral wa/ sha dzi sa ha k+ṣa/ zhes pa gsalabyed sum cu so bzhi ste/ lnga bcu po mtshon bsgyur/ byang bu la bkod pa ni phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi rgyal ba'i rang bzhin te/ bka' rab 'byams chos sgo thams cad kyi rtsab/ gzugs su snang cing / ngo bo stong pa/ sgrar snang zhing grag stong dbyer med/ (52na ba ྂ na rtog tu snang zhing rang bzhin med pa/ blo las 'das shing blo ngo bo nyid du grol ba/ sku gsum lhun gyis grub pa'i dbang bskur te/ slob bu la yi ge rim par gtad cing 'di skad do/ /a/ skye med blo 'das de bzhin nyid/ /ā dngos med rang bzhin spros bral cir yang snang / i/rang bzhin skye med dbyings su thim/ sī/'khor 'das gnyis med kunasadag /u/ sems nyid ngang gdangs cir yang snang / skyu/ tha snyad mtshon dpe kun las 'das/ /ṛ bsam brjod blo yul ka nas dag /phru 'pho 'gyur med pa snying po'i klong / /'-i skye 'jig med pa'i chosaskur rdzogs/ /lī rang rtsal sku gnyis 'gro ba sgrol/ /e skye 'gag gnyis med rnam par dag /i 'od gsal ye shes klong re yangs/ /o dran med yid la bya ba med/ /au yid gnyis rtsad chod skye shi bral/ /e bag chags 'khrul pa dbyings su zad/ /aḥzangs thal 'gyur med ye sangs rgyas/ /ā li bcu drug dbyangs kyi dbang / /chos kun phyi mo'i dbang thob shog /ces ka phyi mo'i dbang bskur ro/ /ka /chos —189

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()nyid nam mkha'i klong yangs nas/kha/rtsal zer dang gdangs snying po thim/ga/zangs thal ye shesarang sar grol//gha/mun sangs 'od gsal ka dag nyid//nga /gzhi rtsa med pa'i sems nyid bde//tsa/yid rig 'gyur med dran pa dag/tsha/'phrul rkyen g.yo rlung rang sar grol//dza/'gro drug g.yang sa de ru grol//dzha/thams cad yid gnyis gzung 'dzin chod//nya/gsang ba'i sgra gsum rang sar bsgral//ṭa/rig med rang grol ga ni rtsa dgata/'dzin pa'i bdud bzhi dus gcig bcom//52ba ) ḍa/'gyur rig brtags snang chos skur dag snya/thams ro 'dzin med rgyas thebs pa//ṇa/brjod med shesarab snying po thob//ta/stong las dran shar rang sar brlag/tha/sems las rtogs byung nga du dngas//da/sgo lnga yul la 'dzin med grol/dha/'dzin med don gyi snying po sdud//dha/bsdus kyang 'phel 'grib med par gnas//na/spros pa thams cad gzhi thog chod//pa/rig pa dri med rnam par dag/pha/snying po mtha' bral dbus ma grub//ba/ma bcos bsam 'das ngang mdangs nyid//bha/skye med kodag zangs thal nyid//ma/rtol skyesang nga mdangs rang sar thim//ya/cang med dngos med mu mtha' yas//wa/rnam dag dpe med gza' gtad bral//ra/blo yul mtsho ni cha mtshon byed dag/la/dusagasum zangs thal thod rgyal mchoge sha/mi re mi dogs lta dgongs rtsis las 'das/gam rig ye shes dbyer med gnas/ /sa/dbye gsal rtsis gdab 'gyur med bstan/ /ha/ rang sangs gzhan sangs thams cad sangs//k+ṣa/ngar 'dzin dag pas chos sgo rab mas rdzogs//kā li sum cu ye shes dbang //chos sgo yongs rdzogs dbang thob shog/ho/snang ba thams cad kyang rgyal ba'i bka' ste yi ger ma gyur pa'i sku gzugs rdul tsam yang med do//grag pa thams cad kyang rgyal ba'i bka' ste yi ger mi grags pa'i gsung sgra lhang tsam yang med do//dran rig thams cad kyang rgyal ba'i bka' ste//yi ger mi dran pa'i 'phro 'du rtog pa 'gyu tsam yang med do//thams cad bka' las 'da' por pasabaka' ra pams kyi dbang ngo//'dab pa med pa'i rab 53na skokhu pas ni//yi ge nyid dang yi ge med pa'i thig le r+ṣa po chos kyi sku'o//zhes ngo sprad rjeX//ā li kā li sgo gsum brjod de/slob bu'i

—— bka' brgyad gsang ba yongs rdzog kyi dbang bskur ri yongs 'du'i stse shing / nang ma nyanasnying pad+ma 'dab brgyad du gsal ba la bkod par bsam mo//de las 'od los mkha' khyab chos sgra theg pa sna tshogs chos sgo mtha' yas grags par bsam/slar 'dus pas stong gsal brjod med shes rab snying po 'gyur ba med pa'i ngang du bsgom/dbang des ni chos sgo mtha' dag gi bka' la rab 'byams pa'i dbang thob bo//dper na 'jam dbyangs kyi chos sgo thams cad la mnga' brnyes te bshad dbang thob pa lta bu'o//dbang de yan chad kyis rat+na lnga ldan gyi thog lta bus sa thams cad yongs su rdzogs shing /chos rgyal kun tu bzang po'i dbang thob par nges shes bskyed do//de yan ho kyis nusapa'i dbang rim brgyad las phra mor phye bas drug cu rtsa gnyis kyis bstan no//tshogs 'khor rab gnas bya'o//de nas thun mong phan pa'i dbang rim lnga bskur ba la/dang po phun sum tshogs pa rin po che sna bdun gyi phan dbang bskur ba ste/dbang rten mthing shog la gser gyis rin po che sna bdun bris la//cho ga rgyab tu bkod de/rim par bskur ba ni/hūṃ/'khor lo rin chen dbang bcur ldan//'khor ba'i 'khor rgyun rab bcad de//chos kyi 'khor lo bskor gyur cing //sa bcu'i 'bras bu'i dbang thob shog/tsakra rat+na a bhi ṣañtsa.a//hūṃ/btsun mo'i rin chen bsod nams gter//pha rol phyin bcu gzungs dang ldan//tshe dbang longs spyod rgyas gyur cig/yid bzhin dpal 'byor dbang thob shog/pra snyo pa ra mi ta a bhi khiñtsa a/hūṃ/nor bu rin 53bston mchog gsum gnas//'khor ba'i skyon sel bde ba 'byung //yid bzhin re skong gter mnga' zhing //lhag mthong shes rab dbang thob shog/tsin+ta rat+na a bhe khiñtsa.a/hūṃ/khyim bdag rin chen nor bdun ldan//gang la ci 'dul dpag bsam 'dra//gzhan don tshogs gnyis myur rdzogs shing /shes bya thog med dbang thob shog/mahā ma ti rat+na a bhi ṣi di a/hūṃ/blon po rin chen dmag dpon che//rtson 'grus go dgos 'khor yul 'joms//thabs ldan mi 'jigs skyabs sbyin cing //'jig tshogs lta 'joms dbang thob shog/mahā ti ra rat+na a bhi ṇiñtsa a/hūṃ/rta mchog rin chen sal ma bgrod//'khor ba'i mtsho sgrol sprin shugs long //mi gnas ye shes gnas bgrod cing //rdzu phrul rkang bzhi'i daXng thob shog/podze a shwa rat+na a bhi sa khiñtsa a//hūṃ/

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (25)glang po rin chen don dam theg pa che/ /bdud sdodapung bcas rab 'joms stobs dang ldan/ /stobasabacus bdag g.yin don mdzad cing / /yang dag snying po'i dbang thob shog /ha sti rat+na a bhi ṇiñtsa a/ /ho/ rin chen bdun gyis dbang bskur bas/ slob bu rnams phun sum tsho gis pa bdun dang ldan nas/don gyi snying po mthar phyin par gyur cig /dbang des ni 'khor lo sgyur rgyal gyis rgyal bu la phogs gtad pa ltar chos kyi longs spyod phun sum tshogs par 'gyur ro/ /de nas bkra shis par byed pa rdzasabargyad kyi phan dbang bskur te/ dbang rten du yungs dar/ dur pa/ bil ba lang tang rtse/ li khri/ ghi lha/zho/ me long / 'bud dung / de rnams rim par bskur te/ hūṃ/ yungs gar rgyal (54na)po sha ri ram/ /bde gshegs rnams kyis byin gyis brlabs/ /stong phrag brgyad cu'i bgegs dpung 'joms/ /dpa' bo stobs kyi bkra shis dbang thob shog /hūṃ/ bkra shis rtomachog dur ba ni/ /lha yi dbang pos byin gyis brlabs/ /nad gdon gnod pa kun las rgyal/ /sdug bsngal zhi byed bkra shis dbang thob shog /hūṃ/rdzas mchog bil ba lang tang tse/ khyu chung 'bras bus 'phel stobs cha/ /stobs dang mi 'jigs sku lnga rdzogs/ /smin rgyas 'phel ba'i bkra shis dbang thob shog /hūṃ/ li khri mtshal chen chu las skyes/ /sems dpa' byin rlabs tshan po chen/ khams gsum lha mi kun dbang sdud/ /thugs rje gzhan phan ba po shis dbang thob shog /hūṃ/ zhi lha khyu mchog las byung rdzas/ /dkar ba'i chos rnams ma lus 'dzin/ /bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi'i nad kun sgrol/ shes bcu rab ldan bkra shis dbang thob shog /hūṃ/ zho ni snying po bcud kyi gzhi/ /dbang po gzi mdangs bcud kun spel/ /bsam gtan ting 'dzin yon tan bskyed/ /sems nyid dri med bkra shis dbang thob shog /hūṃ/ me long zlum gsal sku gsum mtshon/ /chos rnamasagazugs brnyan rnam dag cing / /ma rig bag chags rang sangs nas/ /mngon rdzogs sangs rgyas bkra shis dbang thob shog /hūṃ/ dung mchog g.yas 'khyil rin po che/ /gsung dbyangs yan lag drug cur ldan/ /yon tan rgya mtsho tshangs pa'i gsung / /chos sgra kun khyab bkra shis dbang thob shog /su sti sarba su nyi/ /dharma su ste/ / / rlu a bhi khiñtsa a/ dbang des ni dga' ldan (54bsko phrug ltar 'jig rten —/92

bka' brgyad gsang ba yong rdzogs kyi dbang bskur du sgrub yongs 'du'i 'khri shing / nang ma (ka)dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i bkra shis la dbang bar 'gyur ro/ /de nas zhi rgyas dbang drag las bzhi'i spyod pa'i dbang bskur te/ dbang rten du zhi ba la ras sam shog shog la dung thal sa dkar byugs te/ zla ba'i steng du bum pa ā+oṃ gyis mtshan pa 'dri/ /rgyas pa la bkra shis sa ser byugs te rat+na zur brgyad tre gis mtshan pa 'dri/ dbang la rtag tu khrom 'du ba'i sa dmar por byugs la zla gam steng du pad+ma 'dab bzhi hring gis mtshan pa 'dri/ drag po la dur khrod sa nag byugs la zur gsum steng du phaṭa kyis mtshan pa 'dri ste/ de bzhin 'brang rgyas bzhi la btsugs te snying gar dbang bskur ba ni/ hūṃ/dbyings nas 'bar ba'i skur ston pa/ /'dod pa bsgrub pa'i dpal du shar/ /thams cad yongasardzogs rgyas pa'i lha/ /zhi ba chen pos dbang bskur ro/ /a bhi ṇiñtsa e ā+oṃ hūṃ swā hrī hā/ sngags 'chang 'di la me'i 'jigs pa zhi bar gyur cig /'gre'o/ /chu'i/ nad kyi/ mu ge'i/ dmag gi /mtshon gyi/rgyal po chad pa'i/ dus ma yin par 'chi ba'i 'jigs pa thams cad shan+ti ku ru ye swāhā/ zhes bskur ro/ /hūṃ/ dbyings nas mo//'dod par/ /thams cad yongs rdzogs rgyas pa'i lha/ /rgyas pa chen po'i dbang ྾/ /a bhi ṇiñtsa swā ā+oṃ hūṃ swā gyi hā/ zhes bskur ro/ /sngags 'chang che ge mo'i tshe rgyas par gyur cig /bsod nams mo/ /dpal ra/ /gzi brjid rgyas par ri/ /longs spyod mo/ /'khor rgyas par gyur cig /snyo ku ru ye swāhā/ hūṃ/ dbyings nas rki/ /'dod pa'i/ /thams cad yongs rdzogs dbang gi (55na sko/ /dbang chen rab 'byams dbang bskur ro/ /a bhi khiñtsa hrīḥ/ ā+oṃ hūṃ swā hrīḥhā/ sngagasa'achang 'di la lha 'dre mi gsum bla mar ri/ /pha mar mthong nas mo/ /pa shaṃ ku ru ye swāhā/ zhes dbang bskur ro/ /hūṃ/ dbyings nas zo/ /'dod par/ /thams cad yongs rdzogs drag po'i lha/ /mngon spyod 4nus pa'i dbang bskur ro/ /a bhi ṇiñtsa hā/ sngags 'chang 'dis dgra bgegs ru tra dam sri tshar gcod rdul du rlog pa'i mthu dang ldan par gyur cig /dgra bgegs 'byung po mā ra ya phaṭa/ ces bskur ro/ /dbang des ni 'phrin las bzhi myur du 'grub par byed pa yin no/ /de nas tshe ring ba'i dbang bskur te/ /dbang rten tshe bum bcas nas tshe dbang rgyas par bskur ba sgrub thabs su shes so/ /—193

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (25)bsdun tshe bum spyi bor bzhag ste/ hūṃ/ rgyal ba zhi khro tshe dbang bdag /cis kyang mi 'gyur mi shigs pa/ /tshe srog bla khug rgyas thob la/ /'chi med tshe dbang 'dir gsol cig /ā+oṃ āḥ/ swāhā/ ā yuḥdzñā g.yu tshe a pa ra na ya hūṃ sne swāhā/ ā yuḥ.a bhi ṇiñtsa oṃ e hūṃ si ti pha la hūṃ/ ho che dbang du gyur cig /dbang dngos grub tu gyur cig /mi 'gyur ba'i g.yung drung du gyur cig /mi shigs pa'i rdo rjer gyur cig /tshe srog rdo rje'i brag bas sra bar gyur cig /brtan par gyur cig /ces bskur ro/ /dbang des ni dus ma yin par 'chi ba bzlog par nges shes bskyed de/ de nas rigs brgyud 'phel ba'i dbang bskur te/dbang rten ni phan bkra (55ba〉tes khang pa la ma rdal dkar po gru bzhi byang sems dkar dmar khye'u zho 'thung 'o mas chag chag gdab/ khye'u bzhi bsnol gzugs bris la de'i steng du gang yin khrus byasargyan btags la bzhag ste/ rdo rje brtsegs pa'i gzungs gcig snying gar gdags shing / hūṃ/ bde gshegs rig 'dzin sras dang bcas/ /mkha' gsang dbyings nas byang sems phob/ /mi mo 'di larigs brgyud spel/ /byang sems rdo rje dbang chen bskur/ /ā+oṃ e hūṃ swā hā/ hūṃ/ badz+ra badz+ra gi ti gi ti/a be sha ya a a pu tra dzñā na g.yu tshe / swāhā/ pu nyi ku ru ye swāhā/ bla ma'i dbang rten du zhag gsum dbul lo/ /dbang des ni rnal 'byor pa'i chos rgyud mtha' rgyas par 'gyur ro/ /de yan chad kyis phan pa'i dbang rim lnga la phra mo nyer gcig tu bstan no/ /skabs 'dir tshogs 'khor rab gnas bya'o/ /dngos gzhi'i sa bcad so drug pa sbyor ba'i las mtha' ni gzhan du shes/ dngos gzhi'i sa bcad sgobadun pa sgrol ba'i las mtha' ni dur khrod kyis las grub pa'i 'brub khung bang rim sum ldan du dug khrag ro sol gyis phyi nag nang dmar srin mo 'gros su btsugs pa'i lte bar liṅga ming rus sogs drag sngags spyi sdom nas bshad pa rnams zhakhrul med du 'dri/ de'i phyir tsakra rtsibs sogs brgyad pa la dmod pa drag sngags/ rtsibs mtshan la ming rus/ de'i phyi rim la rtsibs logs drug pa la 'jig rten mchod bstod/ /de'i phyi rim mu khyud la sgrub sde drug gi sngags dmod pa sogs bris pa man ngag ltar lte ba la zan ling dbang po skye mched dod pa'i khong par bcug /dgra dmigs (56na)kyis bsal ba —194

bka' brgyad ga4 g.yong rdzog kyi dbang bskur du sgrub yong bo'i 'a sgo shing / nang ma yodayod na dri ma drug kyang dgos pa/mtshon gzhi bca' ni/snying gzer nag por/dmigs ga 'bemal bca' ba'i dgongs gto yin/de nas nyams len dngos don gsum gyis bstan pa ni/las byang la brten nas lha'i cha lugs bsgyur te/bdag dpal du gsal ba'i dgongs pa dang gcig/bzlasapa'i 'dzab bsgyur te phur pa yak+ṣa kro dhar gsal ba'i dgongs pa dang gnyis/ye'i dbus su liṅga bcas te bzas pa po mngon sum du gsal bas tshes khrus grub mtha' gcig pa'i dgongs pas gdab pa'o//dang po ni las byang lha bskyed pa'i skabs su pho brang gling dgu'i gtso 'khor thams cad chos nyid don la mi 'gyur ba'i brdar/sku mdog mthing nag pa/chos thams cad gnyis med ngo bor gcig par bskyed/thabs shes gnyis su med par sbyor cing /chos skur zangs thal bas phur pa 'dril zhing 'debasapar sgom mo/zhan tu gsal ba ni gnad che'o//de ma yin pa las byang dus bsnyo bsang /'dzab lasasbyor lugs su bgrang ngo //gnyis pa 'dzab bsgyur ba ni/ting nge 'dzin gong ltar gsal bas dur khrod chas gon/phur bu re 'dril zhing khro rgyal yongs rdzogs 'dus pa'i drag sngags gnam thog dang 'dra ba so lnga pa 'di kun gyis bzlas te/gsal dag ngar dang tsos sa 'di skad do//ā+oṃ badz+ra ma hā kro dha pad+mo kro tī shwa rī/badz+raki lī ki lwa ya/ma hā yas kola3 pa/skadze raṃ raṃ/dzol raṃ/dgra bgegasa'abyung po mā ra ya hūṃ phaṭa/ces bzlas pas zhal nas me 'bar/me dpung klong 56baju 'tshub pa kha chu lcags kyi tsha tshar los pas dgra bgegs bsgrub bya rdul du brlag par bsam mo//pho brang gi lha phur la sngags kyi 'od zer gyis bskul bas phur pa thams cad kyang ye shes khro bo zhal gcig phyag gnyis phur pa 'dril zhing 'debs pa//sku smad lcags phur sol mal nas 'thon par ltar tsha tsha ltar 'khrug/reg pas dgra bgegs thal bar gtor bar bsam zhing bzlas pa drag tu bya/gdab sngagasadagul thun du bya zhes gzhung du gsungs ba rnal 'byor pa kun gyis ma grub na/sngags rgyun pa bzhi tsam gyi ngag bcad de gdab sngags dgu 'ur 'don du bya/rdo rje rgyal pos bdag phur 'bem gsum sgrub mtha' gcig pa'i dgongs pa las ma g.yosaX'i ngang nas/rgyal thebs mched dang bcas pas/

rgyal dbang lnga gang ga dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2)gong gi dmigs pa dang bcas so lnga pa kho na 'ur 'don bya/skabs su bstod pa bya zhes gsungs pa/bstod pa mang du yod kyang gtso bor bcom ldan bde gshegs zhes sogs zhi khro spyir bstod pa dang /tshom bu dgu la bstod ba/bka' srung la bstod pa/don bstod rnams re re la'ang tshig rkang drug re yod pas/yongs rdzogs drug bstod du grags pa thun bzhi'am drug gi thun mtshams su bya/de bzhin du mchod byang bkol ba zhes ba nas gsungs pa'i gtor ma bshams te/ho 'di ltar snang srid 'khor 'das kyi zhes pa nas bzung rta mgrin gyi sgo nas/rnam shes gzugs la dbab pa'i bar khro bo rol pa'i chog sgrigs ji lta ba bzhin du byas pas dngos nyams rmi lam du bla rtags srid pa'i gter khyim sogs nas bshad pa ltar gsal bar yid ches pa byung ba dang /nub phyi ma rnams57na ji sa bsad rtags kyang tho re ba yong bas/phur pa'i sgo nas mi 'chor gyang du gzhug/ma mo'i sgo nas dran med spyo ru gzhug go/gsum pa ni/rgyas bar spro na bshad ma thag pa rnams tshar gcig gi steng phur pa'i gzi byin bskyed pa nas dmod pa drag sngags kyi stobs byed pa yan dkyus bzhin gyi khar phyir mi bzlog pa'i dpal dgu'i gdab phur 'debs dus 'og nas 'byung ba'i dpal dgu'i sngags ring rnams bsnan pas khyab kyang ha cang rgyas drags pas dbang gi dus bsgral dbang rgyas bsdus 'tsham pa gong gi sa bcad dang po//gnyis pa'i 'dzab bsgyur ba'i skabs kyi dgra bgegs thal bar bsam zhing zhes pa yan gyi ngag 'don dang drag sngags so lnga pa'i bzlas pa cung zad byas/de rjes 'di ltar snang srid 'khor 'das zhes so gos kyis che ba'i nga rgyal bskyed/de'i don brda sa sprod ni/hūṃ/gsumatshan gsum gyi dgongs don/dpa' gsum/gdengs gsum/ngar gsum ste/hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ ste dang po gsum gyi dgongs don/lus snang stong du dba' ba/ngag brjod bral du dpa' ba/sems skye med du dpa' ba'o/ /yang hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ/zhes bar pa gsum ni gdengs gsum ste/mtha' dang bral ba lta ba'i gdengs//blo las 'das pa sgom pa'i gdengs/khugs kyi 'byung ba spyod pa'i gdengs so//yang hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ gsum ni ngar gsum ste/rig ba mdung ltar rno bas phyi'i rnam rtog 'bigs pa'i ngar/rig pa gsegs brdar ngar 96

bka' brgyad gsang g.yong rdzog kyi dbang bskur dus g.yong 'du'i 'khri shing / nang ma (ka)ma lta bus nang nyen mongs pa brdar ba'i ngar/ rig pa'i rtsal gyis rnam rtog sprin rlung gis bdas pa lta bu'i ngar gyis 'byul pas glags mi (57ba jid pa'o/ /de nas bdag nyid tshom bu dgu'i lha tshogasazhes sogs rgyal ba spyi bskul/ pho nya sgo bskul/ gser skyems gzu dpang gdod nas ma skyes ma/'grub khung liṅga bskyed pa dgug gzhug gi bar dkyus ltar bya/ de nas lha dang phral ba'i ched du yang dag gi mthu dang rdo tshil dbrog pa'i khongs kyi/ hūṃ/ dam nyams dgra bo sdig can la/ /'go bar byed pa'i lha khyod nyon zhes sogs btang / /de nas phur gdab kyi nyams len gyi dmigs pa ngo sprad pa ni de yang / de nas dgongs pa ni gtso bo'i phur pa lag tu 'dril zhing gdab ste/ de yang bdag ye shes lha yongs rdzogs skur gsal ba dang / phur pa dgra bgegs kyi gshed ma ya ka kro dha ra gsal ba dang /bzas pa'i gzugs de dngos su gsal ba gsum yang gzhi chos sku gcig las tha dad ma yin/ lam gnyen po gshed srog gsum sems nyid rtsal las tha dad pa ma yin/ gos bu rang grol phur pa spros bral/ dag chos dbyings su sgrol bas tha mi dad pa ni/ gsang sngags kyi mtha' ste lta ba'i rdzong yin no/ /gsal ba gsum dang ldan pa de sgom pa'i 'phrang / tshe khrus dgongs pas phur ba 'debs pa ni srog 'phrog pa ste/ rdzong 'phreng srog gsum shes pa gnad yin no/ /da ni gsal ba gsum dang ldan pas gdab ste/ gong ltar rdzong 'phrang srog gsum gyi don ci rigs shes pas/ rig pa ye shes kyi phur pa yin la/ de ltar sems can kun gyi ma rig bas kun snying rje la/ khyad par du dgra bgegs ru tra log par lta bas ma rig pa la snying rje phur tshugs su skye/gnyis med du sgrol ba'i thugs rje skye bas tshad med thugs(58na)rje'i phur pa'o/ /bdag nyid dpalache mchog sku la bde gshegs yongs rdzogs su gsal ba'i phyag g.yas pa'i sor mo lnga khrag 'thung yab lnga/ g.yon gyi sor mo lnga khro mo yum lngar gsal bas thal mo sbyar bas/ phur pa 'dril ba ni/ sbyor mtshams byang chub sems kyi phur pa yin no/ /dngos po rdzas la grub bas/ mtshan ma rdzas kyi phur pa ste/ dril zhing so so'i gdab sngags bzlas shing liṅga gzas pa po dngos su gsal ba'i snying ga'i nang —197—

rgyal dbang lnga gang ga dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (25) nas/ srog gi dngos po khrag dngas ma bye mgo tsam gcig gi dbus na/ a dkar po 'od kyi rang bzhin gyi dkyil na yi ljang gu gcig yod bsags la btab la/ phur rtse zur gsum du rtse dgab tu phaṭa gsum rtse la hūṃ gsum bsams te/ so lnga pas gtso phur gdab phyir phur skor bya ba ni/ ā+oṃ badz+ra ma hā kro ta zhes bsrung phyir klad la lan gsum nang skor pad+ma kro ti shwa rī zhes rang la mi bzlog par byar phyi bskyed la lan gsum phyi la bskor badz+raki li gī wā ya zhes gzir phyir lan gsum mdun du dril/ ma hā ya ka zhes pho rgyud dgug phyir g.yas su tsham rngam bya kā la ྅ pa zhes dbang du bsdu phyir mdun du lan gsum dril/ ga dze raṃ raṃ zhes mo rgyud dgug phyir g.yon du tsha ngam bya/ dz+wa la raṃ dgra bgegs nga po ma ra ya hūṃ phaṭa/ ces spyir dril zhing gdab pa'i bsgral ba'i las so/ /de ltar phur pa gcig po thebasapas kun gzhi rtsad chod de lhag ma brgyad ni skye ba'i sgo lnga 'gegs shing tsho gis brgyad la sogs bsgral nas phyir mi ldog pa'i gnad do/ /zhes gsungs la/ gtso phur bzas pa po'i snying gar : ljang gu la (54tha tab pas snu dang ar bcas phur ba'i rtse la dkar mer 'dus pa de/ tshur bstan pas thugasaga'i hūṃ la 'dus pas bdag bkrag dang gzi mdangs skyes par bsams te tshe lung dgongs pa'o/ /dgra srog : phur rtse'i hūṃ gsum la thim nas/ hūṃ/ gsum rtse dgab kyi phaṭa gsum gyi 'phangs/ 'og min dpal gyi thugs kar thim pas/ thugs ka'i hūṃ gi 'od zer gyis〉 de nyid du zhu/ yang 'phrosamagrin pa'i āḥl phog /yang hūṃ 'od du lu spyi gtsug ca la phog /yang hūṃ gcig 'od du gu 'od gsum gcig tu 'dril/ sgal tshigs rta brgyud/ gsang ba nas yum gyi mkhar phab rgyal ba'i sras su bskyed pa ni gnas spar ba ste bdag gi rtsol sgrib dag /dgra bo'i las ga bag nyem chags na mongs pa dag pasakhrus lung gi dgongs pa'o/ /tshe khrus ni gnad che bas tshogis pa rnams la brda 'phrod par byas la lag len ni/ gu gul sbyar ba'i rdzas mchogo dam pa 'di zhes pa nas bzung saṃ ha ra hūṃ zhes pa'i bar dkyus bzhin dang drag sngags so lnga par gdangs dang bstun slob dpon gyas phur skor byas nas slob ma'i lag tu gtad pa'i bskur tshig ni/ hūṃ/ dpal chen yongs rdzogs phur pa'i sku/ shes rab thabs kyi ngo —/98

bka' brgyad gsang g.yong rdzog kyi dbang ba ra du sgrub yong 'du'i stse shing / nang ma (ka)bo las/ khams gsum srid pa mtha' yas par/ /bde tha shegs na las mdzad pa'i phyir/ khrab 'thung yab yum sbyor ba las/ /byang chub sems kyi phur pa yis/ /rgyal ba'i sras mchoge stong gsum gang / /rig pa ye shes phur pa yis/ /chos kyi dbyi pas su hril li li/ /tshad med snying rje'i phur pa yis/ /'gro drug khyad par ldibs(59na〉〉ldib/ /mtshan ma rdzas kyi phur pa yis/ /dgra bgegs gzhob tu thul lu lu/ /yongs su rdzogs pa'i phur pa yis/ /sku lnga ye shes yal la la/ /phur ba'i 'phrin las ngo mtshar che/ /zhi ba'i tshul gyis 'jigs brgyad skyob/ /rgyas pa'i tshul gyis sbyor drug spel/ /dbang gisamos pa rnam bzhi btud / /drag pos dgra bgegs tshar yang gcod/ /sgrub phur rnams kyis dbang bskur bas/ /ta na gha na'i las sbyor rdzogs/ zhus pa yongs rdzogs dbang bskur ro/ /zhes rtsa sngags re brjod rjes sa badz+raki lwa ya sarba a bhi ṇiñtsa hūṃ/ a/ zhes brjod cing gto de phur bskor bya'o/ /ho/de ltar 'phrin las yongs su rdzogs par nus pa'i dbang bskur bas phur bu rnam bzhi gnas su thebasanas zhi rgyas dbang drag 'phrin las bzhi mthar phyung nas rnal 'byor dbang phyug chen po 'phrin las yongs rdzogs lhun gyis grub pa'i dbang thob par gyur cig /rab gnas tshogos 'khor bya'o/ /zhes che mchog gi phur pa slob ma gtso bo dang gzhan rnams bud med min pa kun la gang 'dangs gtod/ de nas drag sngags so lnga pa phur skor bcas brdeg tu bcug la rnam shes spar bas tshe 'di'i srog dbang 'gags kyang slar 'khor ba las phyir mi bzlog par bya ba'i phyir skye ba'i sgo lnga bcad/ rnam shesatsho gis brgyad bsgral te/ dpal dgu'i snying po drag sngags dgu po so sor bzlas te/ phur pa 'dril zhing gdab pa ni/ che mchog sras bcas gdab pa ni/ ā+oṃ shrī ma hā sam ya badz+ra ya ka he ha hūṃ/ a badz+rabi sha kro dha dza la maṇ+ḍal hūṃ/ ma hā srog sha la thun/ ha la ha la/ phaṭa(59bajoḥdzaḥ che ge mo : dus mā ra ya hūṃ phaṭa/ badz+ra hasta sku/ gsogag/ phaṭa/ badz+ra bi sha kro dha dza la maṇ+ḍal/ ha la ha la man+ta la/ma ma sa ru lu ru lu hūṃ bh+yo hūṃ/ badz+ra ya ka ma ra thog sha hung te ha ra hung bh+yo/ na ga ga ba dzaḥdzaya ra ya dzaḥdzaḥtrag raka baṃ ril/ tsa cha pa ta gtu ba ni dzaḥdzaḥ chu badz+ra ār+ya ma mnyu shrī ma tra a kro te ka ya man+ta —17

rgyal dbang lnga pa nga gdabang blo sa rgya mtsho'i gsung la gum/ (25)ka kā la rā ba hūṃ phaṭa/ a ha ha dza dza ha ta ha thorbad gī li ki lā ya ni rbad/ ces pa rtsal gdab bo/ /sras bzhi de'i phyogs bzhin gdab bo/ /de nas badz+ra lha ru ka sras bcas gdab ste/ ā+oṃ ru lu ru lu hūṃ bh+yo hūṃ/ ā+oṃ eḥ/ ha he phaṭa/ hūṃ ni ma tsi ta ma/ rdul phran rdul phran/ kon rak+ta ma ri tsa snying la shad shad/tsit+ta ma rus la kon /ru tri sha rbad/ dzaḥ/ baṃ sngo dbugs la tso thab/ ga/ he ma ma bh+yo dzaḥ ru lu ru lu ra smo bh+yo dzaḥ ki li ki lwa ya : rbad/ ces badz+ra he ru /snying la gdab/ sras bzhi de'i phyogs bzhin gdab/ de nas gshin rje sras bcas gdab ste/ ā+oṃ a kro te ka ya mān+ta sna ha na mtha bhardzi hūṃ phaṭa/ ā+oṃ sam ya mnyu shrī ya mān+ta ka /ya ma rwa dza ma ma e /dzāṭi dza dzaḥ trag raka kha mun tra snying kha ra yi bh+yo bh+yo/ra smo te kumadza dzaḥ kha la ma hi bh+yo bh+yoḥ ma ma lon mon tsi dha na mal bh+yo dzaḥ snying kha rag srog la bh+yo bh+yo/ā+oṃ ya mun/ ā+oṃ rnal ma rnal te srog la rngam/ srog la mer sris la chum/ /yis/yis/ lcags kyi rgyocig mas dag bo'i snying phyung / mā ra ya rbad/ ki li gī wā ya: bod/ ces gshed phur dbral bar gdab/sras bzhi phyogs bzhir gdab po/ /de nas pad+ma dbang chen sras bcas gdab ste/ ā+oṃ paṅgān+ta krita ha ji ba ma hā kro ta e /dzā (60na sam ya/ ru lu ru lu hūṃ bh+yo hūṃ/ a ra li dza/ ā+oṃ thub thub/ myagasamyags/ mug mug shar shar/ zhar bar bya'o/ /zhi bar bya'o/ / da da klag klag du da du da/ rbad rbad dz+wadza bh+yo bh+yo/ hūṃ hūṃ myagasarbad phyogasarbad/ mo du sod mo du ra yag chod/ srog gi dbang po snying kha la rak+ta tsa ra ya ta bya thā/ snying rbad ya khrag ri mo ro/ ma ri khrag sha ya/ mgo khrag dza ni chod/ sha la kyi khyer/dgra bo'i snying srog rtsad nas phyungs shig swāhā/ zhes dbang chen lte la gdab/ sras bzhi phyogs bzhin gdab po/ /de nas rdo rje gzhen nu sras bcas gdab ste/ ā+oṃ badz+raki li ki lwa ya sarba bisnan spre hūṃ phaṭa/ma ra smo ya smo kwa la rū pa snying rtsal yaṃ yaṃ/ srog rtsa la yaṃ yaṃ/ snying rtsal khril khril/ srog rtsa la chumachum/ tsit+ta srog tung tung / snying khrag shad thums ril li li/ snying rtseg rtseg 'ur 'ur shig shig /gulagul/ myags myags/ dha ti ma ma ga rma shi tre ka ra ye/ ma ra pa ni bra ma ta ni tri che ge mo snar ya hūṃ phaṭa/ki li ki lwa ya : dzaḥ zhes lte bar rdo rje gzhen nu gdab bo/ /de'i phyogs bzhin sras bzhi gdab bo/ /—200

bka' bas gtso ba yong rdzog kyi dang bskur dus g.yong bo'i waṃ shing / nang ma zhanade nas bla med he ru ka ma drug gis btab ste/ ā+oṃ lhu rgya dzñā na shrī he ru ka tsho phya dzñā na kro tī shwa rī : ma ma yo gi ni/ ru lu ru lu hūṃ bh+yo hūṃ phaṭa/ ā+oṃ badz+ra ni la kha tre kro ti shwa rī bha ga pad+ma rgyas bde klong sho na ma dza dza〉〉ཿbh+yoḥ mam raka/ ma mar ka/ ru luru lu ra smo snying khrag la stoḥ skyug raka ma sib a sto/ tshe ge mo: thi na mā ra ya phaṭa/ badz+ra lha sku/ rmugs sha /rmugs sha / rbad dha ra rbad dha ra/ mug gi phyogs sha sod/ tsi sib snying ri ya ya/ srog ri ya ya/ mig dkyus nas byungs shig khris ba rtsad nas da cig /lte lkog nas drongs shig /ā+oṃ ma ma ra smo tse tse snying kha rag rbad du bh+yo/ ra smo ra smo rbad bu chem 5rā ya chom/ rbad mā ra ya rbad/ sod (60ba)mā ra ya sod/ thus sa ril ya/ trag sā rbad ya/ gtubasagatubs dum bu baṃ baṃ/ dgra bgegs kyi srog la mā ra la rbad/ gī li kyi lnga ya:rbad/ ces bla med he rus gsang gnas su gdab/ mo mo lngas phyogs bzhir gdab bo/ /de nas rigs 'dzin thod ba rtsalasras bcas gdab ste/ ā+oṃ badz+ra ma hā gu ru sarba hūṃ phaṭa/ kā la rū pa dgra bgegs che ge mo'i srog lamār ya phaṭa/ gī liki lā ya : rbad/ ces thod pa rtsal gyis gtsug tu gdab/ sras ba ni phyogs bzhin gdab bo/ /de na dregs pa kun khrul dbang ོ bzhin tsos ba gdab ste/ ā+oṃ badz+ra sarba dur tshedza bh+yo/ dgra bgeg sha nyu yi thums dza snar ya rbad/ giṅka ra giṅka ra zhu tri dza bh+yo/ che ge mo sha sgru yi tsos mā ra ya bod/ mud tri mā ra duḥ sarba du dzaḥbh+yoḥ che ge mo sha nyu yi sa sa dz+wa mā ra ya rbad/ rdzabhi shu sarba tsa tsha bh+yo che ge mo sha ri hur thums dza mā ra ya rbad/ pa sha mi ki sarba pa dzo bh+yo che ge mo sha hūm̐ hur thums dza mā ra ya bod nā ga sarba phuḥdza skyo che ge mo sha 4 hur thums dza mā ra ya rbad ya ka sarba k+ṣa dza bh+yo che ge mo sha / hur tsos dza mā ra ya rbad/ raka sarba rā dza bh+yoḥ che ge mo sha / hur tsos dza mā ra ya bod/ ma ma sarba ma dza bh+yoḥ che ge mo sha ri hur thus sa dza mā ra ya rbad gi li ki wā ya dgra bo : rbad/ces kun 'dul brla g.yas dkyil du gdab/ 'khor phyogs bzhin gdab bo/ /de nas stabs ldan sngags bdag sdebazhi gdab ste/ ā+oṃ badz+ra sarba dur a tsita lha lha dzaḥ che ge mo: hur tsos dzo mā ra ya rbad/ ya ma sarba tsit+ta lha lha dzaḥ che ge mo/ ma ma sarba tsit+ta hri lha dzaḥ che ge mo/ (61na rdo ga raka sarba tsit+ta —201—

rgyal dbang lnga ga pa/dang blo r+sāng rgya 40gsung 'bum/ (25)hri hri dzaḥ che ge mo/ de ba raka sarba tsit+ta tri lha dzaḥ che ge mo/ rā hu lar ka sarba tsit+ta hri hri dzaḥ che ge mo/yas raka sarba tsit+ta tri hri ྾/ /che ge mo ྾/ /dha sha gi ba sarba tsit+ta lha hri dzaḥ che ge mo : hur thunas dza myu ra ya rbad/ gī li gī lwa ya : rbad/ ces stobos ldan brlag yon dkyil du gdab/ 'khor bzhi phyogs bzhin gdab bo/ /de nas phur pa gzhan thams cad drag sngags so lnga pa la/ che ge mo hur thums dza mā ra ya rbad/gī li gī lā ya : rbad/ ces gdab ste/ sgo ba yab yum brgyad yan lag bzhi'i tshigs bzhi la gdab/gdab phur gyis lhu brgyad la gdab bo/ /rtsang phur rnams mthil bzhi la gdab bo/ /thun gyis kyang brab/ mdor na phur pa gang 'debs kyang phyi'i lha dang dam can srog sngags la ma song bar gdab bo/ /de nas phur pa rnams mched rim par bskor te/ so lnga pa so so'i sgos dgra la gdab bo/ /slar ral gyis dum bur gtubs pa'i stod kyi dum bu rnams stob pa ni/ hūṃ/ dpal chen khrag 'thung lha tshogasarnams zhes sogs kyi lha tsho gos rnams kyi zhal du phul bas dgyes par bsam/ smad las sbyin sreg byas pa' thal ba la cha nan pa bya/ de yang bdag chos dbyings kyi rig rtsal dpal du shar ba dang gcig /phur pa chos sku'i rang rtsal dgra bgegs kyi gnyen por snang ba dang gnyis/ dgra bgegasachos nyid ma rig pa'i ga rtsal bla med gnas su tshe khrus dgongs pas bsgral/ phung po la phyir mi bzlog pa'i ched du gdab/ gcod stob sreg mnan pa bya ste/ byang chub rnam pa gsum grub mtha' gcig ste/ bdag chos sku/ phur pa longs sku/ gzas pa po rgyal sras (61ba tshe sprul sku gsum chosadabyings skye med gcig pa'o/ /gdab phur 'bem gsum grub mtha' gcig ces pa'i don no/ /de yang sgrub khog tu dngos grub blang ba sogs song zin pa'i sa bcad so bdun par bsgral dbang yod cing /dbang 'bum na me dbang gi mthug tu sbyor sgrol gyi dbang mdzad/ phyag len lugs gcig la phan pa'i dbang rim lnga rdzogs nas mdzad pa'i lugs gsum byung ba dang po'i dgongs pa ni/ bsnyen pa/ sgrub pa/ sgrub pa chen po/ las sbyor dang bzhin bshad pa'i/ rgyud las/ de nas las sbyor sum cha yi/ /—202

bda' brgyad gsang g.yong rdzogs kyi dbang bskur du sgrub yong 'du'i 'khri shing / nang ma (ka)dgongs pa gsum gyi mtha' bsgyur te/ /zhes bkra shis yan chod la bsnyen/ sgrub/ sgrub chen gsum rdzogs par sum cha gnyis dang las sbyor la sum cha gcig yin pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis sgrub pa chen po'i khongs gsang dbang la a nu/ sher dbang la rtsa rlung / rtsal dbang la a ti'i dmigs pa bsgyur ba ma gtogs sngags rgyun nar mar mdzad pas sgrub pa chen po song mtshams dngos grub len pa 'thad cing /de nas las stor gyi sngags rgyun dang sbrags bsgral dbang mdzad pa 'os/ lugs g.yin gnyis ltar na/bsgral dbang man chad la sngags rgyun ma byung bas/ de na dngos grub len pa'i bar la sgrub pa ma byasapa'i skyon du 'gyur gsung ba zhig tu 'thad mdog kha yang / sgrol dbang bum dbang gi cha lag nus dbang gi sdebs yin pa dbang phyi ma rnams kyang song nas bskur ba'i rkyen dang khyad par dngos grub blang rjes bskur ba 'thad par mi sems/ de yan la las sbyor yan gyi sgrub pa byed pa dngos gzhi rdzogs rung dbang phyi ma rnams la so so'i kha bsgyur dang sgrags pa'i sngags(62na〉〉na/ lhag tu dngosagrub len pa'i 'dzab bzla dgos pas sngags rgyun ma byung dogs pa'i som nyi mi 'tshal/ 'o na bsnyen/sgrub/ sgrub chen/ las sbyor bzhi ga song nas slar yang sgrub pa yong ba ci zhe na bzhi po de ni bum dbang bskyed rim gyi lam la gtso bor sbyar gyi/ dbang phyi ma rnams kyi des bum dbang gi sgrub pa lhag po zhig 'byung ba'i dogs mi bya/ gter gzhung ltar rtsa rlung gi rjes su bsgral dbang bskur na las bzhi'i tha ma mngon spyod yin pas nus dbang nas gsang dbang gi bar la sngags rgyun bya ru med pa'i dogs pa dang /gal te 'jam po gsum byas na go rim bzlog pa'i nyes pa nas zhi rgyas dbang gsum gyi las sbyor gyi rjes su drag po 'byung ba nus dbang gi rjes la bsgral dbang / phan dbang rnams kyi mthar bskur ba phyag len khungs mar mngon no/ /bca' gzhi rnams thog ma nyid nas dgongs kyang e'i dbus su liṅga bcas te gzas pa po zhes pa'i tshig la brten khugs rtags bsad rtags byung ba'i mjug tu dmigasarten bca' ba srid pa'i gter khyim dang snying gzer sogs kyi dgongs pa dang mi mthun dogs pas sa bcad so bdun pa'i skor 'dir khyab bdag blo mchog rdo rje'i gsung tshad ma'i dpang por byas pa la —203—

rgyal dbang lnga gang gdabang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (25)chos rgyal 'bri gung pa rin chen phun tshogs/ khri srong rnam snyul bkra shis stobs rgyal/ yug nor bu dbang rgyal sogs sdo brgyad bran du bkol nus pa'i sngags rgan ral ba can rnams kyi ma rga spyod kyi gsung rgyun drin can bla ma chos dbyings rang grol las thos pas cung zad kha bkang ngo / /bum dbang tha rams phyi la bshad do/ /mahā yo ga'i sgom khog bshad/ de nas gsang dbang yongs(62ba tshe(gsadabang la gsum gyi ston pa gsang dbang gi yum dang slob ma sbyong ba'i dmigs ba byed pa dngos dbang yin yang ye shes kyi phyag rgyar brten nas byed pas/ dang po yab yum gsang ba byang sems dbang bskur te/ dbang rten ni las rgya dang byang sems te/ pad+ma can nam/ dung can nam/ glang sna can nam/rigs ldan rtsa ldan zhing skyes sogs gang rnyed btsal te/ bla ma'i yum dang dbang rten slob bu lagatad pa'i las rgya gnyis so/ /de yang bkra shis yid du 'ong ba/ lo ni bcu drug nas rtsa lnga tshun chad lon ba zhig rgyud sbyangs dbang bskur sngags la spro ba bskyed/ rnam rtog bsal la khrus byas rgyan btagasarigs kyi yum du bskyed lag dan khar bzhag /slob dpon che mchog yab yum du gsal bar bsgomasate/ mkha' gsang sgom khog ltar byin gyis brlab/ brda' dang phyag rgya bzhi so gos kyis snyom par 'jug ste/ dkyil 'khor gyis srubs la bde ba bskyang / gnam zhal kun bzang lta bu yab yum gnyis su med ba'i bde nyams skye bas bde ba hūṃ du bsams te/ hūṃ ring nyu thung sna nas drangs/ mkha' gsang bar nas hūṃ spros la slob bu gzungs mar bcas pa'i snying gar bstim pas shes rgyud dag par bsgom/de nas yul gsum gyi nyams rtags te/ phyi lus kyi yul du bde ba skye/ tha mal lus su tshor ba med pa 'byung / nang yid kyi yul du rtog pa 'gag cing dbugs rgyu ba mi tshor ba 'byung / gsang ba sems kyi yul du bde stong 'bar te tha mal 'dod chags bde stong me shes su 'bar te/ tha mal 'dod chagasanyon mongs zhi ba 'byung ngo / /de rtsa na gsang ba'i dgra gsum yang gsod de/ phyogs bral dmigasa'adzin (63na7da pa phyi'i dgra gzung 'dzin bsad/ 'dod mags bde r+ṣa ye shes su wor ro/ /nang dgra dug lnga dug gsum bsad nas/ rnam rtog mtshan mo'i bag chags zhi ba 'byung / gsang dgra —204

bka' brgyad gsang ba yong rdzog kyi dbang bskur du sgrub yongs 'du'i 'khri shing / nang ma (ka)bdag tu rtog pa bsad de skye shir 'dzin ba'i 'phrang rang sar grol/ ting nge 'dzin de yis 'jigasapa'i bdud bzhi choms te/ yab yum sku la bltos pa med par reg bya phung po'i bdud bcom/ /bde ba skyes pa lha ste dga' brod bcas pa la dor 'dzin med pas lha'i bu'i bdud bcom/ yab yum thabasashes rab dbyer med rdo rje'i skur rtogs pas skye shi med pas 'chi bdag bdud bcom/ de tsam na lasadang bag chags rnam rtog rang sems rnam dag he ru da'i don dang ldan pas/ skye ba'i rang dbang thob/'gro drug g.yang sa cho de pa'o/ /de'i rjes su phyi nang dbang rdzogs pa'i slob bus yul bla ma yab yum la byang sems dbang zhu par gsol ba gdab/ a nu'i sgom khog gis lus kyi dkyil 'khor lhar bcasango sprad de/ ye nas dkyil 'bor rang gnas mchode pa dang bcas par shes shing khong du a par bya'o/ /rlung bum pa can dang me rlung gyen rdzogs dbe nges shes bskyed do/ /de nas bla ma yab yum gong ltar chas su tshud pa'i mdun du ras kyi yol bas bcad pa'i phyi rol du slob bu gdong dar gyis bkab ste/ me tog thogs la 'di skad du/ ho/ bla ma yab yum gsang ba'i bdag /gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor bdag la ston/ /bde ba chen po'i dngos grub nod/ /gsang ba'i dbang chen bskur du gsol/ /zhes lan gsum rjes su skor ba byas te/ bla ma yab yum gnyis ka la me rtag bzang po dbul/ gsang (63ba tha'i dam tshig dbab byin dbab mig phye la yum gyi gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor bstan/ de nas bla ma yab yum gyi byang sems 'khor lo bzhi nas dbab pa'i sbyor ba bya/ phyi dbang nang la rdzogs par ngo sprad de/ de nyid yum gyi mkha' gsang nas lces len par bya ba'am/ yong na yum gyi kha spub la me long rang ku can du byang sems gtigs la /pā lar mngar gsum ga bur tsan dan bdud rdzi lnga dang dza gang du sbyar te bla ma rigs 'dzin lha tsho gis kyi sbyor mtshamasanas byang sems yongs rdzogs su dbas bstim nas slob bu'i ngag tu bskur ba ni/ ā+oṃ dri med skyon bral shes sgong rtsa tig 'dra/ /pad+ma rak+ta chags pa chen bo'i gnas/ /chos nyid dag pa'i 'gro don mthar phyin cing / /byang chub sems kyi dbang chog thob bya'i phyir/ /bo dhi tsit+ta yab kyi byang chus sems/ /don —205

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2)dam dbyer med byang tso wo po'i dbang //gis dmar po yum gyi byang chub sems//don dam dbyer med byang chub chen po'i ngang //thar pa'i lam mchog bde ba'i lam 'dren cing //'khor ba'i lam las kun rgyal dbang thob ste//gnyis med byang chub sems kyi dbang thob shog/bo dhi tsit+ta ka ma la si ti hūṃ mahā su kha ho/zhes blud de/ho yab yum gnyis su med pa byang chub sems kyi dbang bskur bsathabs shes rab gnyis su med par 'byor nas dbyings ye shes gnyis su med pa dang med pa'i dbang dam pa thob par gyur cig/gsang dbang de nyid du dbang bzhi ldan tshul kyang yab yum lus kyi bum pa nas byang sems kyi chu byung bas bum dbang /lce thog tu myangs pas gsang dbang /gtsang rme'i rtog pa med de bde lam thob pas shes rab ye shes/gnyis64na〉da mngon du mthong bas bzhi pa'o//de ltar ngag tu bstim pas bla ma yab yum slob ma gsum sems nyid yul gsum gcig tu 'dres dri med thob pa'i thabs so//ngag sgrib sbyangs pa da ma can gyi sar spor ba'o//de nas grol lam du ma bstan pa'i rtsa rlung steng sgo'i man ngag bstan pa a nu'i sgom khog bshad/lha yab yum gnyis su med pa'i shes pa bskyed/zhi khro yab yum 'khril ba'i sku brdar bstan te don de nyid la dgongs par bstan/rtsa ba yan lag tu bcas pa'i longs spyod dang du blangs//sems mtsho ni gnyis 'dis bde zhing gsal ba/sangs rgyas thams cad dang dbyer med sbyor ba'i ting 'dzin bsam/de ltar dbang thob nus pas ni bdud bzhi 'joms/gos bu rnam smin 'bras 'joms dri med gnyis med rig par byed do//skabs 'dir tsho gos bya'o//tha rabs phye la bshad do//a nu'i sgom khog bshad/de nas sbyor ba chags lam shes rab ye shes kyi dbang la maṇ+ḍal/byin 'brebs/las byang gi phyag gzung mar me rtag gtor nas/rang gzhan lus kyi dkyil 'khor la brtan ces pas/bum gsang tshar rjes su 'og sgo bde chen la mos pa'i slob bus bla ma yab yum la gsol ba gdab ste/gnyis med ye shes bde chen po//mkha' wa ma bde mchog bde//rlung sems bsra ba'i thabs chen po//'khor lo bde mchog dbang chen bskur//byin dbang phyag 'tshal me tog dor/shes rig mi phye la yum gyi lus kyi dkyil 'khor ma 06

bka' brgyad gsang g.yong rdzog kyi dbang bskur dus g.yongs 'du'i 'khri shing / nang ma (ka)lus rdzogs par bstan te/ yum des 'di skad no/ /ho/ bde mchog 'dod pa'i skal ba can/ /nga yi bha ga cho me kyi dbyings//dus gsum rgyal sras 'di las ba glang //lus kyi dkyil 64ba ) 'khor bde ba che ho//zhes bstan no//de nas bla mas slob bu nyid kyi las rgyar rung ba bla mas gto de/hūṃ/shes rab bkra shis mtshan ldan yum//skye med chos dbyings rig pa'i rgya//phrin las bzhi ldan mchog gi rgya//yab yum gnyis med rol ba las//lhag pa byang sems dkyil 'khor spro//'phags lam bde sgrub gos bu snyems//ba nge/na ba dbyer med bde chen bskyed//'khor lo'i gnas bzhin dbab bzung la//brten nas chos smi don rtogs byos//gnyis med don spyod dag pa'i tso//dgyes pa'i ro mchogachos nyid dbang mchog 'di//skal ldan khyed la bskur thob shog/ā+oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ste tho bra dzñā sha ra su bhā wa byu ko ྅ lha/o su kha bha3 mok+ṣa ho/ho shes rab yum gyi dbang chen gsang bar bskur bas/thabs shes gnyis su med pa'i dbang thob ste dgyes pa'i ro bstar bas nyon mongs pa ye shes su shar nasashes rab dbyings kyi yum la dbang thob par gyur cig/de nas slob bu las rgyar bcas pa yol ba'i phyir 'bol ba'i gdan la bzhag la/lha yab yum du gsal gdab la mkhas gsang byin gyis brlabasate chags chen bskyed pa'i gtam brjod skad cig dga' bzhis rgyun dbab sgrom du zhugs la dbang sgo sbyor lha phaṭa ces brjod/gcig la gcig blta 'khyud la gsang sgo sbyar nu ma mnye bskyod cing snyomasapar 'jug cing byang sems dbab/phyi nang gsang ba'i tshul gyis brtag dbang bzhi 'dir ldan bde chen snying nas lus kyis myong bud med la brten rtsa rlung bzung ba'i thabs chen des ni zag med bde ba skad cig mtshon cing sems sgrib sbyangs te ma chags pad+ma spyan pa la sleb man ngag dam pa rgyan du che/zeg 65na ) le dbab tshe bde mchog lhan cig skyes pa brjod bral rang 'byung nyams su 'char ba ngosazung ste/bde ba la bzung stong la sbyang dbyer med du rgyas gdab//sems kyi dri ma 'dag pas smig rgyu ba srin bu nam mkha' lta bu'i nyams 'byung skad cig bzhi brda bstan/rang rig bdud rtsi lngar longasan/'khor lo bzhi dang rdzogs rim bsgoms paX/sgrib 'joms phyag rgya'i bde thob nus//sprul sku

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho gsung 'bum/ smyonabade 'a rnam smin rgyu mas cho ge sku dri med bdud bzhi 'joms pa'o//gong ltar yul gsum gsal lam mi gsal sgra gsum sod dam ma sod/bdud bzhi chams sam ma choms/'gro drug g.yang sardzo dam ma rdzo/bla ma'i tos ra dang ldan nam brtags te/ldan na sto mongs pa spangs rang sar dag ste rang byung ye shes rgyud la shar te/pad+ma ༅ pa rnams non nas phyir mi ldog go/mi ldan na'ang bde wo lam bsgom man ngag sbyin cing dbab bzung bzlog dgram rgyas gdab 'phrul 'khor gyis go 'phangs bgrod par nges so/kher dbang gi tha 4 dang gsal ma gyi wed lung byed/de nas rig pa'i ye shes bde r+ṣa lta ba spyi stims kyi dbang bskur te/dbang 'di'i me tog tu/rang lus bu dang chung gnor gyi dbyig thogs te zhu ba/bsdus pa dang rgyas pa gnyis 'di bsdus pa'o//ho/gsang wo rol ba'i gzhal yas 'dir//bga' drin bsam 'das gla ma la/khyu gsogs spangs tshe tog 'bug /yang dag snying po bstan du gsol//zhes lan gsum zhu'o//dbang rten ni lag tu rdo rje dril bu gto mdun du me long shel bcas lkor te/de yang li gi don ma' du ngo sprod du bskur bar byab ni/hūṃ/rang rig ye shes65ba〉de wo 'byam//thugs mchog 'gyur med de laganas//dus gsum dusamed dus kyi mchog /sems nyid gang shes bla mar mos//bsam gyis mi khyab khyed kyi sras//gnyisamed ye shes dkyil ra che//4 rig rang mthong rang rig gas//de ṣ+ka gang mthong spyan phyed pa//gom stobs la nus dkyil 'khor mthong //kun la dbang sgyur rang rig che/khril wo rdzogs pa 4 dbang mchog/lta ba theg pa spyi yims rna/khong du a pa'i rnam grangs yin//'di nyid gsang ba bla go de//gsum lha gos brjod pa tso yongs rdzogos//mnyam smi ye shes wo po ste//gcig dang du mar 'dzin las grol/ /'od gsal bzhi dang lam 'bras bu/ /sems nyid chos nyid ngo bo nyid/ /thabs gsum dang ni shes rab gsum//snang ba gsum dang stong pa gsum//ma lus zung 'jug dbyer med phyir//'di la sgrib dang mi sgrib med//dbyer med ye shes bla ma ste//rdzogs pa wo po'i sa zhe sabya'o//de la bstan bya yod min cing //ston pa byed pa med wo bas//rtags rnams kun gyi mchog 08

bas brgyad gtso g.yong rdzog kyi dbang bskur dus sgrub yong 'du'i la rtsi shing / nang ma 9)gyur cing //snang dang srid pa ji snyed brda//rnam par rtog pa thams ro rdzas//de dgongs sel med lhag ma med//'gran zla med par de yis nus//kun gyi mchog gyur gos bu yin ho//zhes pa'i don bgro lo ngo sprad de/nan to tshig gi rjesang byin pa ni//shu sems i gsal la 'dzin rtog go//sna dag lhun grub ye shes sku//gnyis med 'dzin bral thugs rje'i gsung //rang rig yang dag rdo rje'i thugs//rang byung rig par dbang bskur ro//dzñā na pañtsa sto kā ya a/ho/rig pa ye shes kyi dbang bskur bas/rang srin ) rig sku gsum lhun grub ye shes lnga la longs spyod par gyur cig zhes dpe don bskur tshig gis ngo sprad do//pha ngag gti'i sgom khog skabs 'dir bshad do//de ltar gsang ba yongs su rdzogs pas nyone mongs pa spangs rang sar dag par 'gyur ro//de yan ho kyis gsang ba'i dbang bstan pa'o//gong du bstan pa'i dbang rnams kyis ma smin pa smin par byas pa'i dbang yin la smin nas grol lam du sgrub par bya dgos so//de nas theg pa thams cad kyi yang rtse spyi 'byams kyi dbang zhib mol rim pa drug gis stone pa las/dang bo rgyal thabs spyi blugs kyi dbang bskur te/gsang 'dus rgyud las/de ltar gsang dbang yongs rdzogs nas//yang gsang lta ba spyi 'byams dbang //yongs rdzogos rgyal thabs 'di nyid de/khres rab mig ldan waṇi ga la bskur//zhes gsungs pa'i don gang zhe na/de ltar gsang ba yongs rdzogs zhes pa'i don ni gsang dbang yan chad kyi sngags phyi nang mahā a nu yan chad kyi dbang rdzogs pa ni 'di'i sngon du 'gro ba yin/ci'i phyir zhe na mkhar lan gyi rtsol grub ma mthong na mkhar phog pa dgar ma tshor ba bzhin no//yang gsang zhes pa ni/kun gyisasangs rgyas rang ma mthong bas so//lta ba spyi 'byamasazhesapa ni/'dis theg pa kun grol cing khyab bas so//yongs rdzogs ni theg pa thams cad a tir yongs su rdzogs pas so//rgyal thabs zhes pa ni/rgyal bu rkang 'khyams rgyal sar 'don pa dang mtshudas pas so/shes rab mig ldan ces pa ni/shes rab dman cing log lta che bas mi rigs la/ shes rab mig ldan slob bus rig pas snod slobaces pa'o//bskur thabs dngos la gnyis te/gyoX na babs dper brjod la brten nas bskur ba dang /

rgyal dbang lnga par ga dab pa blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (25) rig pa rtsal dbang cho gas ngo sprad de bskur ba'o/ /dang po rgyal thabs dper brjod kyi dbang gang zhe na/ sngon rgya gar gyi yul gyi mgo phar 'das skyon gyi yul dbus zhig na/ rin chen khang pa sgo lnga/ longasaspyod zlad mi shes pa'i pho brang na/ rgyal po chen po nam mkha'i snying bo zhes bya ba/ rgyal 'bangs brgyad khri bzhi stong 'bangs du ma la dbang byed pa/ btsun mo dri med 'od ldan yid 'ong ma bya ba la/ sras rgyal bu 'od zer bya ba shed ma bye ba rmugs rtseb zhig yod skad/ blon po rig pa can nyi ma'i 'od zer bya ba dang / mdor na 'khor srid mnga' thang longs spyod phun sum tsho gos pa bdog pa la/ dus lan cig tsa na/ rgyal po'i pho brang la nye ba'i tshong dus mu po zhig yod pa de sa ltad mo rab tu che ba zhig byung nas/rgyal bu 'od zer 'khor bcas ltad mo gzigs su byon pa las/ sgyu ma mkhan wa ma la sogasaltad mo sna tsho gis la rgyal bu ltar 'gro 'gro nas yengs/ 'khor dang bral/ pho brang du 'ong ba'i lam 'byugs/ sgo stor nas mi rigs mi gcig pa'i yul du rgyal bu rkang 'khyams te/ sprang por gyur rang yul brjed de/ grong khyer thams cad kyi sgo re mos su 'khyams shing / sprang zas zos/ sprang gos ga pa gon/ dmangs sbrang rnams dang 'grogs skas sgo sgo khang kun tu nyal/ rab tu sdug bsngal myong zhing lo zla mang po lon cing rgyal srid kyang rgyal bu stor bas zhig tu nye/ rgyal ba nam mkha' snying po gdung chad kyis dogs par gyur ce na/ der rgyal bu sprang phrug des grong khyer thams cad kyi sgo 'grims stobs(67na khyas/ blon po rig pa tso nyi ma'i 'od zer gyi sgo rtsar 'bor ba la/ blon pos rgyal bu yin par ngo shes nas/ 'o sngon nged kyi rgyal bu stor ba 'dir byung bas/ khyed sprang mi dgos pho brang du 'deng zer te khrid pa las/ rgyal sprang gis smras pa/ nga ni rgyal bu ma yin te/ dran pa rnyed nas sprang po kho na yin pas/ pho brang du khrid kyang rgyal po mi btub mi 'gro zer ba la/ yang blon pos smras pa/ khyod ni rgyal bu chung ngu'i dus kha rmus pa shed ma bye ba gcig tshong 'dus su sgyu ma mkhan gyi ltad mo ltar phyin pas ltad mos yengs nas pho brang srid dang bral te stims pa yin no/ /da lta sbrang yang rgyal bu yin pas rgyal sa gtod pa yin gyis/ gal te khyod the tshom pa ltar rgyal bu ma yin nam snyam na/ khyod kyis dang po'i yul —210

bka' brgyad gsang ba yongs rdzogs kyi dbang bskur dus sgrub yongs 'du'i 'khri shing / nang ma yodagang lin/ pho brang gang / grong gang / khyim la/ rigs gang / pha ma/ 'khor byed spyod gang yin dris pas/sprang pos smra rgyu ma rnyed par skyengs nas/ 'o na nga'i de dag thams cad yin lugs zhib tu smros la sprod cig zer ba las/ blon pos ming don sbyar te/ yul bstan/ de bzhin du/ gnas pho brang dang / grong /khyim mal/ rigs/ pha ma/ rgyal bu/ thams cad brjod de/ rig pa can gyi bram zes rgyal bu khrus nasabartan/ khri la bzhag /pho brang nang du bcug khod pan btags/ dbu rgyan bkon/ rgyal gos bkon/mnga' ris longs spyod phog /dga' ston mnga' gsol byas/ rgyal srid gtad/ rgyalas ra dus gcig tu phyung / yab dang 'dra bar gyur te/ skad cig la sprang po ma spangs la/ sprang tshul mi gnas/ sprang ba'i sdug bsngal rang sangs te/ rgyal srid dang mnga' ris thams cad ma (67ba)lus par mngar 'dus te/bde skyid phun sum tshogs par gyur skad/ dpe mthun don bsdus su ngo sprad pa'i lung ni/ dpal chen gsang ba yongs rdzogs le'u bcu gsum pa nas/ thog mar kun bzhi bcos bslad med/ /cir yang rgya chad phyogs lhung bral stong khyab nam mkha' lta bu las/ /rang rtsal 'gyu byed rlung gis g.yos/ /ma rig rtog pa'i gzung 'dzin gyis/ /nan gyis mkha' la mdud pa dor/ /rtsal la rang dbang ma thob par/ /'gyus dran 'dzin dang chags dbang gis/ khams gsum 'khor cing rang rgyud bsreg /ma rtogs log par rtog pa las/ /rtsal la dbang thob kun bzang gis/ /grol thabs theg pa sna tsho gos bstan/ /ces pas/ thabs gong du bstan pa'i dbang bka' thams cad theg pa brgyad kyi chos thams cad de/ khyad par du rgyal thabs dpes mtshon don mthong gi thabs de dag thams cad bsdu na rgyal po'i pho brang lta bu'i kun gzhi la/ rgyal bu rkang 'khyams dpe 'brul tshul brjod pa dang / blon pos rgyal sar phyung ste/sangs rgyas rang ngo sprad pa dang / rtsal spyi 'byams rim par bskur ba'i bar gyis rig rtsal 'khor 'das chos la rang dbang thob par bya ba'i thabs khrid gnad shin tu che bar bstan par go bar bya'o/ /rgyal thabs dpe don rigs chad rjes su bzung thabs kyi brda ni gong gi rgyal bu de nyid sprang gi bar du sprang mo dang 'dus mna' mtho byas sprang phrug la chags na rgyal sar dbyung du mi rung bas/ sprang —211—

rgyal dbang lnga dzig dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()khyu nas btone tsam gyis dmangs su longs spyod phan btags nas 'jog pa dang 'dra bar blo dman chags sdang a 4 theg dman wo pas rtsal dbang mi thob pas de dang mthun pa'i chos bstan/6ni stan song thar tsam byas la bzhag go/de nas rig pa'i rtsal dbang spyi 'byams cho gas ngo sprad de yongs su rdzogs par rang dbang thob par bya ba ni/snying po skye med rang byung rtol skyes rgyal thabs kyi ngo 'phrod nas spyi blugs kun khyab yongs rdzogs su nan gyis sprad de chos min rang sar grol ba ni 'di dag go/de yang dbang rten ni snod bcud 'dzom pa gces pas/bla ma yab yum gnyis dang slob bu yab yum thams cad kun bzang yab yum du gsal gdab/de min na dbang bcud thub par dka' bas so//de nas slob bus 'khor gsum yongs dag byas rjes su/nor bu rin po che phyag rten du thogasagazhan gang gis kyang 'di yi dbang yon mi spogs pas so//bla ma'i phyag g.yas mthil du a dkar la la'i ba zhig bzhag don gyi snying bo rang byung ston pa'i brda'o//de ltar brda a dang cho ga/rtags rang sgos chos sku/sgra ngo sbyod kyi gsung /don rang gi rtsal dbang /brda rtags sgra don sbyar 'di skad do//hūṃ/tham go lhun grub tso tu bzang po dngos//rang bzhi brjod med kun tu bzang mo'i ngang //gnyis med thabs kyi rgyal po yongs la khyab//dbyer med chos kyi dbyings su dbang bskur bas//kun tu bzang bo rang byung bcom ldan 'das//chos kyi dbyings la gcig tu bzhugs pa yis//rang rig byang chub sems kyi lha yin te//don dam sems kyi lha la bdag phyag 'tshal//de nas phyag g.yasa.ar bcas slob bu'i spyi bor bzhag ste/hūṃ/tso tu bzang po dri ma med pa yis//yongs la dbang sgyur ye shes rgyal por shar//rang sems rnam dag lta ba'i rgyal por shar//byang 64skos snying po bde ba chen por shar//thams cad ma lus lhun grub chos kyi sku//chos rnams thams cad rang gi sems su 'dus//sems kyi bdag nyid ci yang ma yin pas//thig le spros pa med pa'i rang bzhin nyid//mnyam pa'i rgyal po kun la dbang sgyur te//chos wo rig pa'i rgyal po rdzogs pa che//ma 'dres cir yang ston pa theg pa'i mchog/de dag ma lus myur du rdzogs bya'i phyir//spyi blugs lta ba'i dbang mchog 'di

bka' brgyad gsang ba yongs rdzogs kyi dbang bskur dus sgrub yongs 'du'i 'khri shing / nang ma (ka)bskur bas/ /yongs la dbang sgyur lta ba'i rgyal por 'gyur/ /ā+oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pa la bha tra she he ra tsa ta na sha swā bhā wa āt+pa ko3lha/ a nyer gcig bzlas te/ spyi bor a bstim mo/ /de nas lta ba'i dbang bskur ba ni/ dbang rten ni/ slob bu'i mig 'bras sna rtse nas mgo gang nam mkha' la gtod du bcug la/ hūṃ/ ltos shig stos shig rigs kyi bu/ /mdun gyi nam mkha' 'di la ltos/ /gsal la dngas pa mtha' dang bral/ /gang la 'dzin med bde chen 'di/ /lta ba phyogs lhung mtha' bral yin/ /'di nyid don la gnas par gyis/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas dgongs pa yin/ /a ti ho/ de nas sgom pa'i dbang bskur te/ /dbang rten ni mar me gcig bte gal/ /ltos shig ltos shig skal ldan bu/ /rang gi semasal nang du ltos/ /gsal la mi rtog ma yengs pa/ /mar me rlung gis ma bskyod 'dra/ /sgom pa rang gsal 'dzin pa med/ /'di yi don la rtag tu bsgom/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas dgongs nyams yin/ /a ti ho/ de nas 'bras bu'i dbang bskur te/ /dbang rten ni bdud rtsi dza gad sbyar bas kha bskang ste ma 'di pa la phaṭa kyis byas pas smra brjod mi shes/ gser (69na yo) seng ge gcig gtad la/ hūṃ/ ltos shig ltos shig skal ldan bu/ /chos sku 'gyur med don la ltos/ /smra bsam brjod pa'i mtha' las 'das/ /mkhur ba chus bkang smra 'dod 'dra/ /gang yang ma grub stong pa'i ngang / /mi skye mi 'gag chos kyi sku/ /gos bus mi 'gyur gdengs ldan yin/ /'di yi don la gnas par gyis/ /dus gsum sangs rgyasa'adi la gnas/ /a ti ho/ de nas spyod pa'i dbang bskur te/ dbang rten ni gar stabs byed du bcug la/ hūṃ/ nyon cig skal ldan rigs kyi bu/ /rang byung ye shes rol pa las/ /ma 'gags thabs kyi rgyal po yis/ /gang snang sangs rgyas mdzad spyod la/ sgyu bder spyod pas rang sar grol/ /spyod pa spyi 'byamasayang dog med/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas spyod pa yin/ /a ti hūṃ/ dbang gi tha ram dang a ti'i sgom khog bshad/ de nas rgyud lung man ngag thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i rtsal dbang bya ste/ dbang rten pad+ma 'dab ma drug pa'i steng du shel gyi mchod rten bang rim dgu pa rgyu 'bras yongs su rdzogs pa gcig gtad de/ hūṃ/ de ltar lta sgom spyod gos bzhi/ /sus mthong don la rab gnas na/ /theg pa spyi —213

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (25)mas dbang chen thob/ /dbang rnams de las rab tu 'phros/ /de phyir dbang gi rgyal po yin/ /hūṃ/bskyed dang rdzogs dang rdzogs pa che/ /'di las 'phros pa grol lam ste/ /ting 'dzin rnam gsum dbang chen gsum/ /cho ga gsum dang lha gsal 'debs/ /byin rlabs dbang bskur ye shes bstim/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i phyag rgyas ma chad/ /bstod bskul 'dzab bsnyen dbul la sogs/ /bskyed rim 'grol ba'i lam yin (69bsnya/ /thams cad sems kyi cho 'phrul yin/ /rang sems rtsal sbyong chen po'o/ /hūṃ/ lha rnams gnas su rdzogs sgo ni/ /yid ni yab la chos ni yum/ /phung po yab la 'byung ba yum/ /rnam shes yab la yum lnga yum/ /dbang po yab la dus bzhi yum/ /nyon mongs drug ni sprul pa'i sku/ /lus chos yab la mu bzhi yum/ /thabs ni yab la shes rab yum/ /rang bzhin de ltar shes pas na/ /ma bkag ma bsgrubs rang lhar gnas/ /rang byung gnas gyur rdzogs rim yin/ /hūṃ/ rang byung lhun grub rdzogs chen ni/ /sangs rgyas thabs mkhas thugs rje yis/ /theg sgo bsam mi khyab gsungs kyang / /thams cad blo yi brid thabs yin/ /cho me rnams thams cad sems la rdzogs/ /chos kun bden pa dbyer med pas/ /thams cad yid la gang yang min/ /sangs rgyas mthar thug chos kyi sku/ /kun la rdzogs te ngo ma shes/ /ho/ 'khor ba dang ni mya ga 'das/ /zhabrul snang 'dzin pa gnyis su byung / /yang dag don la dbye ba med/ /gnyis rkar rang rig sems la rdzogs ho/ /chos su 'dzin pa thams cad ni/ /sprosapa blo'i chos yin phyir/ /sku gsum rang yang grangs su zad/ /'dus byas chos kyi sangs mi rgya/ /ho/ /sangs rgyas chos su 'dzin tshad ni/ /mthar thug 'khrul blo chen po yin/ /sangs rgyas chos gcig na gcig gis rgya/ /blo 'das rdzogs pa chen po yin/ /ho/ /rgyas bsdus rim par rang lus bzhin/ /rim pa dbang gis bgrod par bya/ /sa ma ya ni shel sgong ltar/ /gzhi ni dam tshig gtsang mas bzung / /ting 'dzin lus dang grib ma ltar/ /nyams su ting nge 'dzin gyis long / /man (70na〉ga gar chang 'thungs pa ltar/ /don ni man ngag zab mos bsgrub/ /lta ba nam mkha'i mdung bskor bzhin/ /thag dang 'phang ni lta bas bcad/ /sbyor ba mi sha 'don pa bzhin/ /la ni spyod pas dor bar bya/ /zung du 'brel la gol sa—214

bka' brgyad gas ba yongs rdzogs kyi dbang bskur dus g.yongs 'du'i 'khri shing / nang ma (ka)med/ /tshig tu rtogs la ma brten par/ /sku gsum don po gcig tu dril/ /mtha' drug rgyud la rdzogasapar gyis/ /mthar thug don dam nang nas long / /nam mkha' la ni nam mkha' bzhin/ / thams cad stong pa'i ngang la gnas ho/ /ma rtsal ye nas rdzogs pa'i dbang / /bskur thob mtshon pa'i mtha' bzhi grol/ /dbang bzhi bskur bas dri bzhi dag /lhan skyes kun brtags bsam brjod zhen/ / blo dngosamu mtha' rang sar grol/ /grol ma grol kyang rnam par dag /bskur thob rang dag ngo mtshar che/ /chosanyid mtha' yas dkyil 'khor na/ /rang byung 'od gsal lha tsho gos bzhugs/ /de la bde gshegasayongs rdzogs pas/ /snang srid 'khor ba'i sems can la/ khu mtha' yongs grol dbang bskur bas/ /rang rig chos skur rtsal dbang rdzogs so/ /rgyud las kyang / ji snyed pa yi bde bar gshegs/ /rang rig sems kyi rgyud la 'dus/ /de phyir yongs su rdzogs zhes bya/ /gzhi lam 'i gos bu gsang rdzogs pas/ /gsang ba yongs rdzogs rgyud du zung / /zhes pas dbang thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i don/ /de nas shel gyi mchod rten bstan te/'o chos thams cad ma 'dres la yongs su rdzogs pa sku gsum lhun gyis grub pa kho na'o zhes ngo sprad do/ /spros chos rtsa rgyud las kyang / /kun gyi spyi bsdus sems kyi (70bskobang / /dbang sems gnyis su med par 'brel/ /gnyis med gcig tu 'dres tsam na/ /dbang ni cho ge sku skye 'jig med/ /bskur ni 'pho 'gyur med par bskur/ /thob ni 'gyur med snying po thob/ /mtshan ma'i dbang bskur ji snyed pa/ /da sogs dbang gi sde tshan rnams/ /yid la byar med spros pa chod/ zhes pas/ snying po chos min ming med yul 'das kun bral yongs su rdzogs pa'o/ /rgyal thabs spyi 'byams rtsal dbang de dag gis ni kun khyab ngang dngas nam mkha'i klong / /nyi zla gza' skar 'byung bzhi phyi nang snod bcud yongs su rdzogs pa ltar du/ rnal 'byor gyi rnal 'byor shin tu rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug ོ por dbang thob par byasapa yin no/ /de yan chad kyis rgyal thabs spyi kyi stims dbang rim drug las/ phra mor gsil nasabacu gsum gyis bstan no/ /—215

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (25)mdor na yongs rdzogs kyi dbang gi rnam grangs rtsa ba dang bcas pa/ phra mor ril bas nyis brgya sum cu rtsa bdun gyis yongs su rdzogs par bstan no/ /tsho gis 'khor bya'o/ /tha ram dang a ti'i sgom khog spyi don drug pa dbang drug pa dbang srog dam tshig gis bzung bar bstan pa ni spyir chos bsam gyis mi khyab na'ang / 'dir gsang 'dus rgyud las/ rgyud don dam tshig bsrung bya ba/ /rtsa ba yan lag nyams mi bya/ /yang na mnyam rdzogs rgyal por gnas/ /zhes gsungs pas/ dam tshig la drug ste/ ngo bo/ nges tshig /dbye ba/ srung thabs/ nyams skyon/ bsrungs pa'i dgos ched do/ /ngo bo ni 'da' dka' byang chub sems so/ /nges tshig ni bsrung bya ma nyams na 'khor ba'i bud shing 'tshig la/nyams na rang rgyud (71na di myal bar 'tshig ga /'on te lta ba'i so ma nyams na/ /ma rig 'tshig cing skye med don dam mo/ /dbye ba la bzhi/ rtsab gsum/ yan lag nyer lnga/ spyi'i stsogacig /khyad par gyi gcig go /ji ltar dam tshig bsrung thabs rim pa ni/ /sku'i dam tshig tu rdo rje slob dpon dang mched dang lcam dral la bsrung bya'i mdo ni/ brdeg brtsog dang rku 'phrog spya sems skur pa 'debs pa dang ngan sems dang thugs 'gal thams cad bsrung bar bya'o/ /gsung bar dam tshig tu/ dbang thob yi dam dkyil 'khor lha la bsrung bya'i mdo ni/ sku phyag rgya bsgom pa dang / gsung snying po 'dren pa dang /thugs ting 'dzin 'phro 'du byed pa dang / thugs dam bkang sogs rab chu rgyun bzhin spyad/ 'bring nyin mtshan lan gsum gsum mam thun bzhi mi bcug cing / tha ma nyin zhag phrugs re la lan re mi bcag par bsrung bar bya'o/ /thugs kyi dam tshig tu bsrung bya'i mdo ni/ sgrub rdzas lag cha thams cad dam ma 'dres pa rnams la gsang ba dang / de bzhin du sman gtor rak+ta nang gi mchod rdzas gsang ba dang / spyi 'dzab rtsa ba'i snying po rnams gsang ba dang / phyag rgya dang mtshon dpe gsang ba dang / spyor sgrol gyi phyag bzhes gsang ba dang / /'phrin las mdzad spyod gsang ba dang / rgyud dang sgrub thabs man ngag gsang ba dang / mdor na bla ma mched kyi tshang ngam/ chos spyod la sogs pa gsang bar 'os pa kun gsang ba dang / bla ma dang mched kyi ched du man ngag gam gsang gnyer gtad pa kun/ gsang ba'i —216

bka' brgyad gsang ba yongs rdzog kyi dbang ba ra du sgrub yong 'du'i 'khri shing / nang mo3)dam tshig bcu po dag gsang zhes bsrung bar bya'o//rtsa ba'i dam tshig de dag ma bsru pas71ban/bskal pa lngar rdo rje'i dmyal bar 'gro bar rgyud las gsungs so//de nas yan lag gi dam tshig nyer lnga bsrung bar bya ba'i mdo ni/shes par bya ba'i dam tshig ni/phung po lnga dang /'byung ba chen bo lnga dang /yul lnga dang /dbang po lnga dang /ye shes lnga dang /rigs lnga yab yum du spyor shes par bya'o//spyad par bya ba'i dam tshig lnga ni/sbyor ba dang /sgrol ba dang/ma byin par len pyodang /rdzun du skyabadang /tshigaglang po nyon mongs pa lnga po gnyis med mnyam pa'i ngang nas 'gro don spyad par bya'o//mi sbang bya ba'i dam tshig lnga ni/'dod chags dang /zhe sdang dang /gti mug dang /nga rgyal dang /phrag dog lnga ni ye nas rigs lnga'i rang bzhin du rtogs par bya zhing mi spang bar rang sar grol lo//sgrub par bya ba'i dam tshig lnga ni/rdo rje'i rigs dang / de ba'i na gshegs pa'i rigs dang / rin bo che'i rigs dang /pad+ma'i rigs dang /las kyi rigs dang lnga po rnams bsgrub/ting nge 'dzin le lo med par brtson bsabasgrub par bya'o//dang du blang bar bya ba'i dam tshig lnga ni/dri chen dang /dri chu/dmar chen dang /byang sems dkar po dang /mdangs 'a pad+ma raka ta dang /rnam pa lnga ni 'dzin rtog med par dang du blang bar bya'o//de ltar yan lag dam tshig nyer lnga 'das na mnar med pa'i dmyal bar lhung ba gsang rgyud las bshad/thun mong spyi'i dam tshig tu bla ma bkur cing gsung zur tsam yang mi bcag pa dang /bla med theg pa mi spang ba dang //thun bzhi'i rnal 'byor mi yengs pa dang /sngags dang chos spyi la the tshom spang ba dang /mched lcam gdung sems kyis bskyang ba dang /sems(72na〉zha thams cad snying rjesadrang ba dang /nyon mongs rang dgar mi btang ba dang /theg pa
