dang chos kyi zhal zin phyir gzhan la mi smad pa dang /le lo gnyid dang chang dbang spang ba dang /lta spyod zung du 'brel bas bsnyen sgrub mthar dbyung bar bya'o//zhes rgyud las gsungs pa de bzhin du bsrung bar bya'o//yang na mnyag rdzogos rgyalapor gnas//zhes gsungs pa ni/khyad par mchog gi dam tshig ste/khyud las/yang dag don gyi dmatshig tu//'khor 'das chos rnams rang rig sem///gdod nas rang byung chos sku'i nga //de nyid

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (25)nges na bsrung nyams ni/ /mi bsrung blo yis dor du med/ /nyams skyon thob bya'i re ba med/ /ma spangasami gnas gzung 'dzin 'das/ /skye med snying pos mi shigs sa ma/ khu stegs bdag tu 'dzin pa 'tshig /ces gsungs pas rtogs pa'i don las mi 'da' bar bsrung ngo / /mi bsrung ba'i bsrung ba chen por bstan no/ /dam tshig nyams skyon ni/ skabs su brjod pa yang yin te/ so mkha'i mkhar spe'u shor ba ltar rang phung srid phung du 'gro ba yin/ phal cher tshe 'di nyid nas rgyu 'bras yid du mi 'ong ba sna tshogs 'du ste/ brlag nas phyi ma mnar med pa'i rdo rje'i dmyal bar thar ba med par 'gyur ro/ /'on te dge ba mtha' rdzogs kyi lasang na po 'ga' zhig tshe 'dir skyid pa ltar snang ba ni/ snga ma'i bzang las thams cad 'dir zad phyi ma dmyal ba mtha' med du lhung bar rgyud kun nas bshad do/ /gal te dam tshig nyams srid na bshags thabs ni/ sku'i dam 'gal na na rag la brten pa'i phyag dang bskang tshogasakyis bshags/ gsung gyi dam 'gal yig brgya 'bum bsnyen brjod (72ba)byas bshags/ thugs kyi dam 'gal bla ma mnyes byas don khrid zhus te lta bas bshags/ thun mong du dbang bsnyen sgrub chen pos bshags/ rgyun du rgyun bshags na ra mas skongs bar 'gyur ro/ /bskang bshags la brtson pa ni man ngag gi dam pa'o/ /de rjes dam bca' rgyun pas dam bca'o/ /dam tshig bsrung ba'i dgos ched ni/yongs rdzogs rgyud las/ sngar bas 'das pa'i sangs rgyas kyang / /dam tshig 'di la brten te rgyas/ /da ltar bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas kyang / /dam tshig 'di la rab tu gnas slad nas 'byon pa'i sangs rgyas kyang / /dam tshig 'di la brten nas rgya'o/ /zhes pa dang / thun mong nyid thob mchog la sbyor/ /yid bzhin rat+na bsten pa 'dra/ /zhes pas tshe 'di nyid du 'bras bu la reg pa dang / phun sum tshogs pa'i dngos grub 'byung ngo / /gal te sdug bsngal 'phel ba ltar snang na'ang mi dge ba'i las mthar zad bcas bya ste/ sngar gyi las sgrib thams cad dam tshig gi byin rlabs kyis tshe 'dir smin nas phyi ma bde ba mtha' stims la spyor ba'i ltas so/ /dper na de ring sprin 'du tshabs che zhing brlan 'bab —218

bka' brgyad gsang ba bongs rdzogs kyi dbang bskur ri yongs 'du'i 'khri shing / nang ma zhanadrag na sang nyin nam dngas nyi rma gsal ba bzhin no/ /phyi rabs kyi rnal 'byor pa rnams kyi dbang gi srog dam tshig gtsang mar bsrung ba gal che'o/ /spyi don bdun pa dbang chen ma thob par bskyed rdzogasalha bsgom gsang sngags la 'jug pa'i skyon ni/ rgyud las/ dbang ma thob pa'i nyes pa ni/ shes rab gsum sogs rlom na yang / /'bras bu med cing brlag par 'gyur/ /zhes pas/ dbang ma thob na theg pa mtha' dag thob/ bsams/ bsgoms/ bsgrubs kyang 'bras bu mi 'byung ba'i steng du (73na ji rlag par gsungs so/ /dbang yon ma phul shin tu nyams zhes gsungs pas dbang zhus nas yon ma phul na dam tshig nyams pa'i nyes lhung thams cad 'byung bar rgyud las bshad do/ /spyi don brgyad pa dbang chen yongs rdzogs su thob pa'i dgos ched dam rtags sam yon tan ni/ rtsa rgyud las/ de ltar dbang rnams yongs rdzogs par/ /bskur ba'i yon tan bsam mi khyab/ /gsang sngags dngos grub dbang las yang / /thob rtags mkha' 'gros lung ston cing / /thun mong mthar thug sirnyi thob/ /gzung 'dzin nyon mongs rtog pa'i bdud rnams 'joms/ /ltas su yid bzhin rat+na gtsugs na 'chang / /mgo la nyi shar dmag dpon byed/ /mgo dang ro stod lci la bde/ /bum bas tsongs me zas bca zos/ /rang rig rang rtsal dbang bsgyur nas/ /zhes pa dang / rim pa'ang dbang gis bgrod pa yin/ ces pas/ de ltar dbang rim yongs su rdzogs par thob nas ma smin pa thams cad smin par byed nges la smin pa grol bar byed pa sgrub pa la rag cing / sgrub pa'i srog dam tshig gis bzung bar bstan pas snying po'o/ /don mthar 'byin no/ /dang po 'jug pa'i cho ga skyabs 'gro sgos bskyed nas/ dkyil 'khor du zhugs pa yan chad kyis nyan rang byang sems theg pa gsum gyi dbang yar ldan du thob pa yin/ phyi bum dbang la sogs pa brgyad bskur bas kri ya u pa yo ga'i theg pa gsum gyi dbang yar ldan du thob pa yin/nang lha dbang la sogs dgu bskur bas mahā a nu'i theg pa gnyis kyi dbang thob pa yin/ gsang dbang gsum spyi 'byams drug phan nus kyi dbang rnams bskur ba a ti yo ga'i theg (73ba)pa'i dbang thun mong khyad par ma lus pa'i dbang thob cing / mdor na bka' rab 'byams kyi dbang thob pa —219

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (25)yin pas dbang yongs rdzogs su thob pa dang sangs rgyas dgongs pa lon pa dus mnyam par 'byung ngo / /de'i phyir na theg pa yongs rdzogs dbang bka' 'di thob pa'i dgos pa yon tan bsam gyis mi khyab bo/ /spyi don dgu pa dbang yon dbul bar bstan pa ni/ rgyud las/ byin rlabs dbang gi bla ma la/ /rgyal srid yul 'khor rang gi lus/ /bu dang chung ma nor gyi dbyig dbul zhes gsurnga'i pas/ 'khor gsum yongs dag lan gsum bya/ /sgyu lus bla ma'i bran du dbul bar bya'o/ /de nas rtags sbyin te/sku'i dbang thob rtags su ā+oṃ dkar po dang gsung gi dbang thob rtags su āḥdamar po gcig /thugs kyi dbang thob rtags su hūṃ mthing kha gcig /yon tan gyi dbang rtags su a skṛ ta tsho mes gcig /'phrin las kyi dbang rtags su phur pa sor bzhi pa dang lnga po de spyi gtsug dbang ral la gdags par bya'o/ /des ni rgyal pos rtags btab pa dang 'dra ste/ mi nub rgyal mas du 'gyur ro/ /gtang rag mchod tsho gis sgrub khog bzhin bya'o/ /spyi don bcu pa dbang gi gto rgya bstan pa ni/ de yang slob bu mtshan nyid bcu ldan gsum la bka' gtad de/ des kyang 'gro ba 'dul bar mnga' gsol cing / lha srin jil gyis mnan/ dbang du bsdus te bka' gtad phyir/ /dpal chen dgyes pa'i 5bro bya ste/ rnal 'byor pa thams cad dkyil 'khor la gral bsgrigs gsum du bskor te/ rdo rje gzhog pa'i phyag rgya byas te 'di skad do/ /hūṃ/ nga ni che mchog he ru gaḥ/ /zhi khro bde gshegs yongs(4na)rdzogos sku/ /rdo rje'i glu gcig gnam nas len/ /steng gi lha rnams zil gyis gnon/ /rdo rje'i glu gcig sa nas len/ /klu gnyan sa bdag zil gyis gnon/ /rdo rje'i glu gcig phyogs bcur sgrogs/ /phyogs skyong dregs pa zhabs 'og gzir/ /rdo rje'i glu skad rtser re re/ /hūṃ gi 'brug sgra dir ri ri/ /phaṭa kyi gnam lcags tshal le tshal/ /drag po'i bshug glus khams gsum g.yo/ khangs kyi rlung sgras srid gsum sgrol/ /snyan nasa'abrug sgras stong gsum 'gengs/ /ljags las glog 'gyu bar snang khyab/ /spyan nas chu byung stong gsum 'khrud/ /zhal nas mche gtsags bdud bzhi sgrol/ /glu bro 'khor gsum chems rtse chem/ /glu bro 'khor gcig dang po yis/ /gzugs med mu bzhi zil gyis gnon/ /glu bro 'khor gnyis bar pa yis /—220

bka' brgyad gsang ba yong rdzogs kyi dbang bskur dus sgrub yongs 'du'i we shing / nang ma (ka)gzugs khams bcu bdun zil gyis gnon/ /5bro 'khor gsum tha khu yis/ /'dod khams nyi shu zil gyis gnon/ /rdo rje zil gnon glu bro yis/ /lha srin sde brgyad dbang du sdud/ /dregs pa'i tshogs snam sgo 'bub cing rgyal/ /rdo rje'i 'gros stabs lams se lam/ khro bo'i gar stabs log ge log /drag po'i rkan sgra chems rtse chem/ /bro ni dregs pa kun 'dul bro/ /glu ni khams gsum dbang sa glu/ /tshig ni don dam rtogs pa'i tshig 9khas gnyis thabs kyi bro brdzu pas pas/ /bdud bzhi phye mar 'thag pa'i bro/ /dgra ni dum bur gtub pa'i bro/ /dam sri thal bar rlog pa'i bro/ /ā+oṃ lo hūṃ lo ste bha ya raka nan/ zhes chos kyi bar ho log lta'i dregs pa gzir zhing tshar bcad rjes su/ /kye ho bu mchog rdo rje 'dzin pa nyon/ /tsho gis kyi dkyil 'khor chen (4ba kho 'di/ /phyi dang nang sgo gsang tshul du/ /yid la zung la nyams su long / /yid bzhin rat+na'i gter 'dub/ /zhi khro bka' brgyad yongs rdzogos bka'/ /snying nor yin no mig gos yin/ /gdams sogatad do thub par chongs/ /dam nyams rnams la shor srid do/ /log lta mā la shor srid do/ /the tshom mā la shor srid do/ /rtog ge ba la shor srid do/ /snod min rnams la shor srid do/ /bstan pa'i snying 'di tso par srungs/ /gto rgya/ gsang rgya/ gter rgya/zab rgya/ bka' rgya/ mchog rgya/ spyir rgya/ gnyan rgya/ zhes rgya brgyad brjod de/ bga' rgyud gsum la gtad do/ /dngos gzhi'i sa bcad sum cu pa dngos grub len pa'i sngon 'gro gegs sel gyi bro ni/mched rnams kyi dkyil 'khor la gsum rim du bskor ba'am/ mang nyung dang sbyar te dur khrod mas kun gsol/ dpal chen yongs rdzogasang rgyal dang ldan par bya ste/ dgra bgegs ru tra rdul du rlog par bsams te/ dang po lta stangs/ lag pa lu gu rgyud du sbrel/ gral tshags bya/ rkang pa rdo rje rgya grama'agros sam rdo rje rang lugs su bro brdung ste/ dang po glus spyan drangs pa ni/ hūṃ/ zhi khro yongs rdzogasadakyil 'khor du/ /dpal chen che mchog sku sprul nas/ /mkha' 'gro'i tsho gis dang rol pa ni/ /thabasashes gnyis su med par sbyar/ /byang chub sems kyi 'phro 'du las/ khro bo khro mo'i sprin los nas/ /5bro gar gyi thugs dam ste/ /rgyun chad med par bsten par bya/ /bro ni 'bar ba'i phyag rgya ste/ /rgyal —221—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ smyonab stong dang mnyam par sbyor//glu ni tshangs pa dbyangs kyis 'dren//ma dang mkha' 'gro'i thugs dam bskul//tshig ni don dam rtogs pa'i 75nasgo sha/chos sems gnyis su med par rtogs//'di ni glu bro gar gyi brda//gar ni khyab brdal chen po'i gar//phyogs bcu'i zhing khams khyab par byed//phyag rgya sna tsho gos lu gu rgyud//dus gsum rgyal ba zhi khro bskul/khrag 'thung rol pa'i dkyil 'khor nas//che mchog yab yum sras dang bcas//ḍā ki 'khor bcas ma lus kun//sngon gyi thugs dam ji bzhin du//glu bro gar la gshegs su gsol//hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ badz+ra ma hā krodha sarba a be sha ya dzaḥ& baṃ ho zhes rang lugs su 'cham zhing bskor ro//de nas bro skor gyis gzir ba rdo rje 'gros su bya ste/hūṃ/zhi khro yongs rdzogs dkyil 'khor 'dir/khrag 'thung rol pa'i bro zhig brdungs//phyogs bcu'i nam mkha'i khamasabakang nas/khro bo khro mo'i bro brdungs pas//la la thabs dang shes rab bro//la la rdo rje pad+ma'i bro//la la dbang po yum gyi bro//la la 'jig rten dbang sdud bro//la la 'dul sbyong rtags kyi bro//la la dregs pa kun 'dul bro//la la mos pa rkyen gyi bro//la la longs spyod dpal gyi bro//la la spor byed gnas kyi bro//la la sdud byed thabs kyi bro//bro la rnam grangs bsam mi khyab//glu la yon tan brjod mi'ang //tshig lam na ngag sna tsho gos bsal//bro ni 'phrin las rgya mtsho'i bro//glu ni ltab rgya mtsho'i glu//tshig ni 'du 'bral med pa'i tshig/bro yi ming ni ༷ nan//klu yi ming ni pā sha hūṃ//tshig gi ming ni yaṃ gu sha/rgyal ba kun dang mnyam par spyor//kun gyi thugs dam chen po yin//gi gi gi/ hūṃ hūṃ/phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa/de nas las kyi bros tshar bcad de/hūṃ/gsang 75ba tha yum gyi mkha' dbyings su//bde chen rol pa'i bro zhig brdung //sna la pad+ma rol pa'i bro//chags pa med pa'i tshul gyis brdung //de nas rdo rje rol pa'i bro//zhe sa med pa'i tshul gyis brdung //de nas thabs dang shes rab bro//bha ga'i dkyil du dgra bgegs brdung //de nas dbang po yum gyi bro//lha mo brgyad dang thabs gcig rol//de nas rdo rje pad+ma'i bro//phyag rgya wo por rgyas 'debs so//de nas 'dul bya drag po'i bro/khrag 'thung rgyal pos 'khor la brdung //de nas mos pa2 rkyen gyi bro//ma sring rgya mtsho 'khor la brdung //de

bka' brgyad gsang ba yongs rdzogs kyi dbang bskur dus sgrub yongs 'du'i 'khri shing / nang ma (ka)nas sil byed thabs kyi bro/ /phyogs ba na rnal 'byor ma lus brdungs/ /de nas spor ba gnas kyi bro/ /'gro drug sems can dbyings su brdung / /thabs dang shes rab ldan byas nas/ /glu bro dam tshig rgyal po yin/ /bden par bdud bzhi 'dul ba'i bro/ /bro ni bar chad med par brdung / /lta ba dran par bya ba'i phyir/ /glu ni 'du 'bral med par blang / /dkyil 'khor rang la gsal ba'i phyir/ /tshig ni snying po 'dzab tu bzlas/ /ye shes dpal gyi bro ra tshugs/ /bdud dang bar chad ming yang med/ /a la la ho dges pa che/ /de ltar bro la spyan drangs gzir/ /tshar bcad nas yongs su rdzogs pa'i mthar dbyung ste/ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ/ che mchog 'khor bcas rol pa'i bro/ /dgra bgegs dam sri'i srog la brdung / /badz+ra he ru rol pa'i bro/ /dgra bgegs dam sri'i snying la brdung / /gshin rje gshed po rol pa'i bro/ /dgra bgegs dam sri'i klad la brdung / /rta mgrin rgyal po rol pa'i bro/ /dgra bgegs dam sri'i lce la brdung / /rdo rje gzhon nu rol pa'i bro/ /dgra (7na〉gegs dam sri'i lte bar brdung / /bla med he ru rol pa'i bro/ /dgra bgegs dam sri'i gsang ba brdung / /rigs 'dzin thod rtsal 'dus pa'i bro/ /dgra bgegs dam sri'i spyi bor brdung / /dregs pa kun 'dul rol pa'i bro/ /dgra bgegs dam sri'i brla g.yas brdung / /stobs ldan nag po rol pa'i bro/ /dgra bgegs dam sri'i brla g.yon brdung / /zhi khro bka' brgyad rol pa'i bro/ /g.yas su bskor te dgra la brdung / /dgra yang dum bur gtub pa'i bro/ /g.yon du bskor te bgegs la brdung / /bgegs kyang phye mar 'thag pa'i bro/ /g.yas g.yon thabs dang shes rab bro/ /ru tra dam sri thal bar rlog /hūṃ sa rak+ṣa nan bdud sri mā ra ya rbad nan/kha la dza ma li rbad nan/ shig shig dum dum rbad nan/ khram khram bh+yo rbad nan/ rmugs rmugs rbad nan/tir tir rbad nan/ tshal du tshal du bod nan/ zhes rtsa sngags dang sbrel la bdun nam nyer gcig bzlas la phyag rgya dgrol lo/ /des ni bdud bgegs phur kha dam sri thams cad thub myos thul lo/ /so gcig pa dngos grub kyi sna sel du rgyun bshags nar ma bya ba ni/ ā+oṃ āḥ&/ rgyal ba zhi khro rdo rje slob dpon dang / /bde gshegs yongs rdzogs srung ma dam tshig can/ /sku gsum gdung 'tshob rdo rje —223

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (25)lcam dral mched/ /dpang gyur skyabs mchag ma lus dgongs su gsol/ /bdag cag ma rig lusadang ngag sems kyis/ /slob dpon mched sogs sku smad thugs dkrugs shing / /yi dam sngags dang phyag rgya gsang ba bsgrags/ /rtsa ba'i dam las 'gal gyur mthol zhing bshags/ shes bya lnga dang spyad par bya ba lnga/ /mi spang lnga dang bsgrub par bya ba lnga/ /(7brkong len lnga dang yan lag dam tshig kun/ /nyams gyur rang mnong 'gyod bas mthol zhing bshags/ /sngags la the tshom bla med theg pa smad/ /lta spyod ya bral bsnyen sgrub gzhung ma srong / /long yod le los dus kyi mchod pa chag /sdom gsum thun mong dam nyams mthol zhing bshags/ /rig pa'i rtsal chungs snying po'i don ma rtogs/ /sgom pa'i sran chungs gnas lugs so ma thub/ /blo yi stobs chungs spyod pas bogs ma thon/ /legs bsam spyad kyang don log thugs 'gal bsags/ /'bras bu yid smon 'gyur ba mthol zhing bshags/ /zhesagong 'og thams cad kyi skabs su bshags pa bya'o/ /so gnyis pa dngos grub chen po blang ba ni/ /don gnyis su shes par bya ste/ bshams pa'i rdzas dang / dngos grub blang thabs dmigs pa bskul tshig dang bcas pa'o/ /dang po dngos grub rdzas bshams pa ni/ ka pā la mtshan ldan kha sbyar gcig gi nang du phye mar dkar gsum mngar gsum sbyar ba'i lde gu'i rgyu la/ a mṛ ta tshos gcig btab la/ rin po che 'bar ba'i zur brgyad pa/ ā+oṃ āḥ/ gis mtshan pa gcig bcug la/ dar mthing nag gis gril/gzungs thag btags la pho brang dbus su gtso bo'i mdun du bzhag ga /gzhan yang rgyu de la spod btab brnal sha chod par byas te/ tshe'i 'breng rgyas zlum brjid brtan par bya/ mar gyis brgyan/ tshe ril gyis bskor tshe'i srung mar mar dang a mṛ ta sbyar ba'i rdo rje rtse lnga pa hūṃ gis mas pa/ yi dam du bskyed par gzugs sam/ yang na rta zhal gcig rta mgrin du bskyed la bzhag /bum chang la mched grangs kyi mar ril (77na 〉 nga la btab pa'i nang du gzungs thag btags la bzhag /gzhan yang dngos grub rnam bzhi mtshon phyir zlum (a)po/ /gru (sa)bzhi/ zla (a) gam/ gru (ha)gsum de dag kyang rab re re mched grangs thim pa/ 'bring bzhi stongs mched grangs thim pa'am/ tha ma gsum gsum rgyu —224

blta brgyad gsang ba yongs rdzogs kyi dbang bskur du sgrub yongs 'du'i 'khri shing / nang ma (ka)de nyid la gag yang dril bu dang / nas 'dra dang / yid la 'dod pa'i gzugs bcas te/ bse khab brgyad du stsal te/ dpal gyi sgo rgyan g.yas g.yon du bshams/ de rnams kyi zla la sha yibs la sogasapa btsos pa/ mngar gsum mdes shing tog smin pa bdud rtsi thod pa gang ba bzhi rnams bsham mo/ /de 'dzab dngos grub snying bo kwa ya sirnyi ā+oṃ/ lha ska sirnyi āḥ tsit+ta sirnyi hūṃ/ zhes stong la sogs pa bzlas/stong rdzos mgo pa la brten nas/ dngos grub blang ba ni/ slob dpon gyi drung du snod bzang por khrag gtsang mas dang sbyar la/ a mṛ ta sbyar la/ slob dpon bdag yi dam du gsal ba'i thugs ka nas/ ā dmar po 'phros rak+ta la phog pas bdud rtsi dmar por gyur/ de las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros/ khams gsum ma lus bdud rtsir dmar mer zhu/ slar 'dus bdag la thim pas/ sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub thob par bsam zhing / snying ga'i thad kur rak+ta brlabs nas/ lha mo bra mo ha la sogs pas dngos grub ster ba/ 'di skad bskul te/ khams gsum sems can thams cad kyi/ /dug gsum rtsab cad nas kyang / /sku gsung thugs kyi dbyig tu 'bul/ /sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub gsol/ /de nas bdag lha'i nga rgyal dang ldan pa'i thugs ka nas/ 'od zer lcags kyu lta (77ba〉sdu du ma spros nas/ 'og min nas bde gshegs thams cad dkyil 'khor du spyan drangs/ bzhugs par bsams te/ dbyangs tshig gsal bas spyan dra pas te/ hūṃ/ 'og min dga' ldan gnas mchogo nas/ /bde gshegs sa dang bcas pa rnams/ /dzaḥ& baṃ sngos spyan 'dren na/ /'dir gshegs 'bar ba'i gdan la bzhugs/ /sam ya he/ sam ya sto/ sarba burnya satwa dzaḥ de nas bde gshegs sbyor ba mdzad pa'i sbyor mtshams nas/ byang chub kyi sems kyi sprin phyogs bcur 'phros pa las/ 'phags pa kun mchod/ slar skus mdun gyi nam mkha' la bde gshegs rnams kyi sku gsung thugs la thim rab tu dges par bsams te/ tshig 'dis mchode/ hūṃ/ bde gshegs sras bcas yab yum rnams/ /gnyisamed rol pa'i mkha' dbyings su/ /rak+ta dmar dang bdud rtsis mchode/ /'dzab rdzogs mchode 'bul dngos grub gsol/ /sa mo ya ma sam ya ri/ sarba burnya sa tu dzaḥ mahā rak+ta pañtsa a mṛ ta khā hi/ zhes—2256

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (25)'theb srin gyis gtor bas gsol bar bsam mo/ /de nas rak+ta'i lhag ma ka pā la gcig byo zhing /slar blug pas/ bde gshegs rnams sbyor ba mdzad pa'i byang chub sems mang po 'dus/ bdag gi lus ngag yid gsum la thim pas/ sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub thob par bsam zhing bskul ba ni/hūṃ/ bde gshegs sras bcas yab yum rnams/ /dang po ye shes bsnyen pa'i lha/ /bar du bdag gi yi dam lha/ /da ltar rang dang gnyis su med/ /gnyis med rol pa'i mkha' dbyings su/ /dam tshig grangs kyi mchod pa dang / /'dzab rdzogs(78nasgo chod 'bul dngos grub gsol/ /zhes bzlas pa ci rigs bya/ rak+ta gong ltar dbul lo/ /hūṃ/ bde gshegs sras bcas yab yum gyis/ /sgrub mchog rnal 'byor bdag cag la/ /'chi med tshe yi dngos grub gsol/ /'bral med gzungs kyi dngos grub gsol/ /thun mong dngos grub sna tsho gos gsol/ /gnyis med mchog gi dngos grub gsol/ /dngosagrub ngo bo mi dmigs kyang / /sngon gyi thugs dam dbang gis na/ /da lta nyid du dngos grub gsol/ /de nas rak+ta'i snod du bde gshegs yongs rdzogs su gsal ba'i sbyor mtshams nas/ ā+oṃ dkar po e dmar po hūṃ mthing kha dang bcas pa gnas par bsams te/ /bdag gi mtheb srin nyi zla'i dkyil 'khor du gsal bas lce thog tu bzhag ste/ hūṃ/ dpal ldan rdo rje'i sku 'chang ba/ /mi phyed rdo rje'i sku dang ldan/ /da lta bdag byin rlabs nas su/ /rdo rje'i sku yi dngos grub gsol/ /ā+oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ya badz+ra su bhā wa byu ko3lha/ zhes lan gcig bzhag pas/ ā+oṃ dkar po spyi bor thim pas/ dpal rnam par snang mdzad mtshon gang klad pa'i rgyas su bsam/ hūṃ/ dpal ldan rdo rje gsung 'chang ba/ /rdo rje mi phyed gsung dang ldan/ /da lta bdag byin rlabs nas su/ /rdo rje'i sku yi dngos grub gsol/ /ā+oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta lha ska badz+ra su bhā wa ju ko ྅ nya/ lce la bzhag pas/ e dmar po/ mgrin par thim pas lce rtsar 'od dpag med mtshon gang pa gcig gnas par bsam mo/ /hūṃ/ dpal ldan rdo rje thugs 'chang ba/ /mi phyed rdo rje thugs dang ldan/ /da lta bdag byin rlabs nas su/ /rdo rje'i sku yi dngos grub gsol/ /ā+oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta tsit+ta (78ba tha dz+ra swa bhā wa āt+pa ko3nya/ lan gcig blangs pas snying ga'i gnas su rdo rje —226

bka' brgyad gsang ba bongs rdzogs kyi dbang bskur dus sgrub yongs 'du'i 'khri shing / nang ma (ka)sems dpa' mtshon gang pa gcig gnas par bsam mo/ /de nas smon lam btab pa ni/ sku rdo rje gsung rdo rje thugs rdo rje sku gsung thugs rdo rje lta bur lhun gyis grub pa'i dngos grub/ bdag gsang mtshan che ge mo la tshe phyi ma'am dus phyi mar ma 'gyangs par da lta nyid du thob par gyur te/ bdud dang bar chad cis kyang mi tshugs par/ phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub thob par gyur cig /ces pa'i rjes su rak+ta lhag ma rnams bsdus te bzhag go /de yan chad kyis stong tshigs kyis mchod pa la brten nas dngos grub blangs pa'o/ /de nas dngos grub yongs rdzogs blang bar bskul ba ni/ hūṃ/ bde gshegs yongs rdzogs dgongs su gsol/ /deng sang skya rengs dang po shar du nye/ /rdo rje srin po'i nam yang langs su nye/ /bzlas brjod bsnyen pa'i grangs kyang thems lags so/ /bsnyen sgrub zhag grangs tshang ngo dngos grub gsol/ /thun mong ma yin khyad par gcig pa yi/ /'i rgyal ba dpal mgon thugs kyi dpal be'u nas/ /byang chub sems kyi thig le 'od 'phro zhing / /skal ldan bdag la dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /hūṃ/ nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sku mnga' ba/ /mi 'jigs sku yi dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /chagasamed pad+ma lta bu'i ljags mnga' ba/ /'gag med gsung gi dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /'gro drug thugs rjes yongs sgrol thugs mnga' ba/ /skye med thugs kyi dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /'gro ba'i re skong rin chen lta bu yis/ /yon to rin chen gter gyi dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /'gro don lhun grub gnyis med ngang du sgrol/ /'phrin las thogs med dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /dngos grub (79na)stsal dang stsol bar mi dmigs kyang / /sngon gyi thugs dam chen po'i byin rlabs kyis/ /dus las mi 'da' rdo rje dam tshig can/ /skyabs la mi g.yel g.yar dam gcig pa'i mched/ /ye shes lha khyed bdag la dngos grub gsol/ /hūṃ/ che mchog yon tan yongs rdzogs 'dir gshegs dgongs/ /yon tan don ni ma btsal ye grub cing / /he ru gaḥdapal sku gsung thugs mchog dang / /bdag dang 'gro rnams lus dang ngag yid rnams/ /ye nas dbyer med dbyings su ro gcig kyang / /ma rtogs 'khrul —227

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (25)pas 'khor bar mas la gsan/ /'khor ba nyid kyang ye nas mya ngan 'das/ /skye shi gnyis kyang ye nas byang chub lam/ /mnyam nyid don la ma skyes chos kyi sku/ /che mchog dkyil 'khor dngos grub dam pa de/ /sgrub mchog rdzas la brten nas da lta stsol/ /hūṃ/ yang dag thugs lha yongs rdzogs 'dir gshegs dgongs/ /yang dag don 'di 'gre/ he ru nas/ /bdag dang 'gro rnams za/ /ye nas mo/ /ma rtogs ྾/ /'khor ba ྾/ /skye shi ྾/ /mnyam nyid ྾/ /thugs kyi dkyil 'khor dngos grub dam pa de/ /sgrub mchog rdzas la ྾/ /hūṃ/ 'jam dpal sku lnga yongs rdzogs ri/ /sku mchog don 'di 'gres shes par bya'o/ /hūṃ/ pad+ma yongs rdzogs lha tsho gos ra//hūṃ/ 'phrin las phur lha yongs rdzogasalha ྾/ /hūṃ/ ma mo rbod gtong yongs rdzogs lha ྾//ma ni skye med mo ni 'gag pa med/ /skye 'gag gnyis med bla med he ru rkaḥ/ /snang srid ma mo dbang 'dus dngos grub stsol/ /hūṃ/ rigs 'dzin slob dpon yongs rdzogs ྾/ /rigs ni ma nor 'dzin ni ma bcos pa/ /ma nor ma bcos rigs 'dzin thod (79ba)pa rtsal/ /chos sgo mtha' dag yongs rdzogs dngos grub stsol/ /hūṃ/ 'jig rten mchod lha yongs rdzogs 'dir gshegs dgongs/ /kun ni 'khor 'das ma lus 'dul zang thal/ /'khor 'das zang thal dregs pa kun gyi gtso/ /sdebargyad bran du 'khol ba'i dngos grub stsol/ /hūṃ/ stobs ldan sngags lha yongs rdzogs ྾/ /rtogs pa'i stobs las ye shes mngon gyur ldan/ /rtog pa mngon gyur stobs ldan nag po yis/ /dgra bgegs myur du sgrol ba'i dngos grub stsol/ /sgos sgrub la mos pa rang rang gi lugs bzhin 'phrul bas chog go /de nas pho brang dgu 'dus dngos grub blang ba ni/ /rnal 'byor pa rnams dkyil 'khor bskor zhing 'di skad do/ /hūṃ/ dur khrod gsang ba mchog gi dkyil 'khor du/ /ye shes 'bar ba'i klong gi dkyil 'khor dgu/ /dpal chen klong gi dkyil 'khor chen po nas/ /dpal chen he ru dgu ni dbyings nas bzhengs/ /yum chen khro mo dgu ni sku la 'khril/ /thig le dgu ni dbyings nas gsal bar 'dren/ /bhan+dha mtshan ldan dgu ni lcang lor bcas/ /zla gam dgu ni rak+ta 'khrug pa'i dkyil/ /mar me dgu ni ye shes 'od gsal 'bar/ /rdo rje dgu ni mdzes pa'i gur dang —228

bka' brgyad gsang ba yongs rdzogs kyi dbang bskur du sgrub yongs 'du'i 'khri shing / nang ma (ka)ldan/ /rtse dgu nas ni nyi zla dgu yang 'char/ /su la ma shar sgrub mchog bdag la shar/ /sems nyid gsal ba'i nyi ma thugs su shar/ /bka' gsang thugs kyi dkyil 'khor dam pa 'dir/ /bam rim bzang po dag la rten bcas nas/ /zla gam dmar po'i steng du dbang nos shing / /mar me dgu pa dag la mdangs phyungs te/ /mtshan ldan bhan+ta dag la tha tshig dgod/ /sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /(80na)zla gam dmar po dbang gi dkyil 'khor du/ /gsang ba yum chen dgu yi mkha' dbyings nas/ /ma chags rang gsal me shes mar me dgu/ /dpal chen dgu yi thugs dam bskang ba'i phyir/ /gtso mchog dgu yi dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /thabs dgu yul dgu phyag rgya dgu ru spel/ /thabs dang shes rab tshul du mchod par 'bul/ /zla gam tshul du 'od zer 'phro zhing bsnol/ /sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /nam mkha'i mtha' klas chos kyi dbyings la mkhas/ /ma chags spyan sngar grub pas sems can gzigs/ /kun nas 'dus pa ma lus 'dir gshegs shig /skya rengs dang po shar du nye ba'i dus/ /las kyi sems dpa'i dngos grub da stsol cig /rdo rje nam mkhar gsal ba rgyu dus 'dir/ /ye shes sems dpa'i dngos grub da stsol cig /rdo rje sgrub pa'i nam ni langs la khad/ /rdo rje dbyings kyi dngos grub 'ong re ran/ /rdo rje sgrub pa'i nam ni langs su nye/ /che mchog dpal dgu'i dngos grub 'ong re ran/ /bzlas brjod grangs tshang bsnyen sgrub zhag kyang thems/ /rdo rje nam langs yongs rdzogs dngos grub bsdus/ /sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /a be sha ya aḥ bde gshegs zhi khro yongs rdzogs kyi lha thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs las dngos grub kyi rang bzhin ā+oṃ dkar/ e dmar/ hūṃ mthing / 'od dang bcas te rang gi spyi gtsug mgrin pa snying gar thim nas/ lha dang gnyis med du mos par bya'o/ /so gsum pa dpogs chog gi dngos grub nan gyisablang ba ni/ bsnyen sgrub kyi rtags bzang po gang yang rung ba ma byung na/ bsnyen pa nas dngos grub blang (80ba tha'i bar yan chad lan gsum dpogs la gnad 'bebs 'di'i rjes su bya'o/ /ltas bzang ngam dus bsnyen yin na gong gi dngos grub bskul ba rdzogs rjes su/ lha gnad la —229

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (25)dbab cing dngos grub bskul te/ rnal 'byor pa thams cad dkyil 'khor la bskor zhing gdung sems bskyed la rol mo bsgrags shing 'di skad do/ /hūṃ/ nga ni dpal ldan rdo rje 'amang / /thugs kyi 'khor lo rab sgyur zhing / /rdo rje rigs 'dzin 'khor dang bcas/ /thugs dam dbang gis spyan 'dren no/ /dam tshig dbang gis tshul bzhin gshegs/ /dam tshig tshul bzhin ma gshegs sam/ grub mchog dngosagrub ma stsal na/ /sku gsung thugs dang 'gal bar 'gyur ro/ /zhig par 'gyur bar gdon mi za/ /hūṃ/nga ni dpal ldan 'khor lo 'chang / /sku'i bde gshegs des 'gre/ hūṃ/ nga ni dpal ldan rin chen 'chang / /rin chen/ rin chen rigs/ hūṃ/ nga ni dpal ldan pad+ma 'chang / /gsung gi ྾/ /pad+ma rigs/hūṃ/ nga ni dpal ldan rgya gram 'chang / /las kyi 'khor lo/ yum rnams bskul te dngos grub bsdub ni/hūṃ/ shar phyogs pa yi rtog pa rnam dag ma/ /rta gdong dkar mo dung gi mche gshog can/ /rdo rje rigasakyi dngos grub mtha' nas bsdus/ grub mchog rnal 'byor bdag la stsal du gsol/ /hūṃ/ lho phyogasachu yi rnam dag ma/ /g.yu gdong sngon mo g.yu'i mche gshog can/ /rin chen rigs sko/ /sgrub mchog ྾/ /hūṃ/ nub phyogs me yi rnam rtog ྾/ /brtsegadong dmar mo bse'i ྾/ /pad+ma rigs zo/ grub mchog ྾/ /hūṃ/ byang phyogs rlung gi rnam rtog ྾/ /mu men ljang gdong mu men (81na)mche gshog can/ /las kyi ྾/ /sgrub mchog ྾/ /des thun mong dngos grub bskul ba ni/ /zhi rgyas dbang drag las bzhi gang 'dod dang / /mig sman ril bu rkang mgyogs ro langs dang / tshe ring chos srid nor dang zas la sogs thun mong dngos grub ma lus bdag la stsol/ /de nas mchog gi dngos grub bskul ba ni/ /hūṃ/ chos sku mchog las kun 'byung longs spyod rdzogs/ /'gro don lhun grub sprul sku gcig gi ngang / /ma bcos gnyis med sku gsum lhun gyis rdzogs/ /mchog gi dngos grub bdag la stsal du gsol/ /de nas bdud rtsi bum gcig la dmigs te/ rnal 'byor pa rnams langs te/ lag pa g.yas g.yon gyi mtheb srin rtse sprad/ lhag ma gsum bsgreng / rtse gsum phyag rgya bca'/ g.yas 'phreng ba bgrang zhing dngos grub bdud rtsi sbyangs phyir kun kyang mgrin gcig sngags 'di nyer re'am gang lcogs bzlas te/—230

bka' brgyad gsang ba yongs rdzogs kyi dbang bskur dus sgrung yongs 'du'i 'khri shing / nang ma (ka)ā+oṃ āḥ/ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta hūṃ dzñā na a dza skyo ra na phaṭa/ 6ha ra na hūṃ sgyi tha/ 'bru lnga mos bskor/ sbyar la 'brus pa'i ting nge 'dzin ni dngos grub kyi snod /pā la khor yug tsam gyi nang du/ nyi zla'i steng du dbus byang sems/ shar dri chen/ lho me sa/ nub rak+ta/ byang dri chu/ de las ā+oṃ āḥ/ swāhā/ bkod do/ /de las 'od 'phros 'phags pa mchod/ sems can kun gyi don byas/ slar 'dus pas rigs lnga'i phyag mtshan du gyur/ /yang 'od sa 'dus pas sku lngar gyur/ /de las kyang 'od los khrus pas dngosagrub kyi ngo bo'i bdud rtsi dkar po dri ma med par bsam/ de nas dngos grub bskyil ba ni/ bdud rtsi thal (81ba〉sgror gyi phyag rgya bcas te thams cad mgrin gcig tu bsdebs te/ ā+oṃ āḥ& sarba pañtsa a khra ta li kuṇ+ḍa hūṃ hrīḥtha zhes ci nus bzlas shing ting nge 'dzin ni dngos grub kyi rdzas thams cad kyi thad ka bar snang la lha rnams sbyor ba mdzad pa'i sbyor mtshams nas/ 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas tshur 'dus pas/ so so'i yum gyi mkhar dngos grub kyi ngo bo bdud rtsi dkar po'i khu ba mang por 'khyil bar bsam mo/ /de nas ka pā la'i rdzas la bdud rtsi'i dngos grub dbab par bya ste/ rnal 'byor pa rnams phyag rgya nam mkha' nas rdzas la dbab pa'i brda bya ste/ mgrin gcig tu 'di skad do/ /ā+oṃ yīḥ/ sarba pañtsa a phri ta me bra be sha ya sirnyi phebs phebs hūṃ gyi tha/ zhesanyer gcig bzlas shing ting nge 'dzin ni yum gyi bha ga nas dngos grub kyi ngo bo bdud rtsi'i char bzhin babs nas rdzas la sib sib thim par bsam mo/ /de nas bgegs brlags rtsod pa bsrung phyir rnal 'byor pa rnams gung mo dang / srin lag mtheb tu sprad de/ rta mgrin du bskyed/ de nas rkang pa bro 'khrig cing / ā+oṃ chu ྅ sarba pañtsa a gra ta ha ya shrī ba pad+ma pad+ma gyi — ban+ta gyi / gyi tha/ zhes dpal rta mgrin grangs med pas dkyil 'khor dang gnas phyi nang med par khengs nas bar chad bsrung bar bsam mo/ /de nas dngos grub bdag la bsdub ni/ rnal 'byor pa rnams thal sbyor gyen du bzed la/ gral gzhibasate phyag brda nang du g.yob cing 'di skad do/ /ā+oṃ yīḥ/ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta ra sa ya na/ ta na dza ya/ gu ya sirnyi sarba sirnyi sirnyi hūṃ gyi tha/ nyer gcig bzlas shing ting nge 'dzin ni/ (82na rko ngos grub kyi ngo bo bdud —231—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (25) rtsi'i rgya mtsho thams cad/ bdag gi thugs kar 'ab ldeb 'dus shing thim nas sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub yongs rdzogs su thob par bsam mo nges par yang thob par bsam mo/ /de ma thag tu mtshams gcod dmigs pas/ khro bcu'i sngags bzlas shing / bgegs bskrad de/ rings par rings par dngosagrub kyi rdzas zas phud cung zad gcig zhal du gsol lo/ /gral rim par bsdad de ka pā la kha sbyar blangs te ka pā la gnyis po dngos grub kyi chang gis bkang la/ a skṛ ta cung zad gcig phud la stsal te/ phyag rgya bsgyur cing srin mtheb kyis yongs rdzogs lha tsho gos la sman mchod bya'am/ so so'i sngags kyi sham bur mahā pañtsa a khru ta kha raṃ 'a hi/ zhes gtor rjes su/ kā ya sirnyi oṃ/ lha ska sirnyi āḥ tsit+ta sirnyi hūṃ zhes bdud rtsi btung / phyag rgya bsnol zhing lan gsum bskor zhing btung / bsnol tshig gang la dbab nga ra bzang / de nas zhal zas 'brang rgyas la sogs pa rnams bgos te/ cha gcig bla ma la drangs/ cha gcig rigs 'dzin la phud du bzhag /cha gcig thams cad mnyam bor bgos te/ yog tshad du rol ba las mi la mi sbyin pa gal che'o/ /rjes ting nge 'dzin ni rang dngos grub thams cad 'dus pa'i lus rnams lha rnams yongs su rdzogs par gnyis med sku bsgom/ rdo rje'i go gon me dpung klong na bzhugs par bsam mo/ /gtang rag tu sman che ba'i yon tan brjod de sman mchod bya'o/ /so bzhi pa ba po shis bya ba ni/ mched rnams g.yas mda' dar g.yon mar chang zhal bu re thogs la 'cham zhing 'di (82bskod do/ /ho rnam snang bkra shis chos dbyings ye shes sku/ /bkra shis des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog /rdor sems bkra shis me long ye shes sku/ /bkra shis ྾ / /rin 'byung bkra shis mnyam nyid ye shes sku/ /bkra shis mo/ /mtha' yas ba po shis kun rtog ye shes sku/ /bkra shis mo/ /don grub bkra shis nan to ye shes sku/ /bkra shis sko/ /ho che mchog he ru yon to lhun grub dpal/ /yid bzhin gter gyi bkra shis bdag la shog /badz+ra lha ru rang byung thugs kyi dpal/ /skye med thugs kyi ྾/ /'jam dpal gshin rje snang srid sku yi dpal/ /'gyur med sku yi bkra shis bdag la shog /dbang chen rta mchog chos sgo 'dus pa'i dpal/ /'gag med gsung gi ྾/ /rdo rje —232

bka' brgyad gsang ba yongs rdzogs kyi dbang bskur dus sgrub yongs 'du'i 'khri shing / nang ma (ka)gzhen nu mthu stobs yongs rdzogs dpal/ /'phrin las thogs med bkra shis ྾/ /bla med he ru ma mo 'dus pa'i dpal/ /ma tsho gos las la 'khol ba'i ྾/ /rigs 'dzin gtso mchog rgyud lung man ngag dpal/ shes rab gsum la mnga' brnyes ྾/ /dregs pa kun 'dul bdud dpung 'joms pa'i dpal/ /sdebargyad bran du 'khor ba'i bkra shis mo/ /stobs ldan nag po snang srid srog bdag dpal/ /dgra bgegs thal bar rlog pa'i bkra shis shog /zhi khro yongs rdzogs dngos grub rgya mtsho'i dpal/ /bsnyen sgrub mtha' ru phyin pa'i bkra shis shog /sarba sirnyi / / zhes rol lo/ /rtsa ba'i sa bcad so lnga pa lung bstan pa ni/ rgyud las de ltar bsnyen sgrub rim par dag / rab tu lo sgrub rtags la sbyar/ /zhes pa de ni bdag don sgrub pa thob dgos par ston pa'o/ /'bring du zla sgrub grangs dang sbyar/ zhes pa (83na ji gong ltar ma dpogs sam 'on te dbang bskur ba'i sngon 'gro la dgongs pa yin no/ /tha ma zhag bdun zhag lnga sa /zhes pa ni/ des grub pa ma yin yang / gzhan don so so g.yengs shing mi lon pa'i don nam 'on te rang gi dam bca' mi lcogs pa dang bskang gso'i ched do/ /yang rgyud las/ dad brtson drag pos bsgrubs gyur na/ /mtshams med lnga spyad zin mis yang / /dngos grub thob pa gsang sngags khyad/ /theg pa'i khyad de theg chung gi /gos bu snyamasapa bas sngags la mos pa dngos grub che bar bstan pa dam ldan nges par 'grub pa'i lung bstan yin no/ /rgyas par spro na dus byang kol ba las shes par bya'o/ /dngos gzhi'i sa bcad so bdun pa 'phrin las bzhi'i sbyin sreg ni gter gzhung khyab bdag khra tshang pa chen pos mdzad pa'i yig cha sogs las shes par bya'o/ /dngos gzhi'i sa bcad so brgyad pa mad dan mthar rgyas rjes kyi las khrigs la bco brgyad yod pa'i sa bcad dang po re zhig btang snyoms su 'jog dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan sgrub chen dang 'brel ba'i khro rol mdzad pa nyung bas sgrub gtor gyi lha rang la bsdus gtor ma nas gter la sped rgyu cung zad 'jog dgos pas 'jug pa bde ba'i dbang du 'jug gi sa bcad gnyis pa 'di zor las yin pas khro rol mi gtong phyin sgrub gtor las —233

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (25)bzlog gtor gsar du mi bca'/ las byang gzhung bsrangs nas tshogs lhag yan song rjes sa bcad bcu bdun pa mtshams grol ba'i rgyal chen bzhi bdud rtsi 'khyil pa gshin rje rnams la mchod gtor bshams sngon 'gro'i skabs bzhin byin rlabs dang mchod bya/ hūṃ/ rgyal chen sdebazhi 'khor bcas(83ba)kyi/ /sgrub pa'i bgegs rnams bsrung ba yi/ /las bsgrubs gtang rag mchod sbyin 'bul/ /slar yang stong grogs 'phrin las mdzod/ /'di ni gzugs dang lhan cig tu zhes sogs kyis ye shes pa rten la brtan bzhugs byed/ mtho bsdu/ sgo srung gnyis la yang 'don pa bsgyur/ sgo dbye ba ni/ bdag dpal du gsal ba'i sgo ma la lam 'byed pa'i bka' bsgo ba/ bzlog pas 'di skad do/ /hūṃ/ shar gyi sgo ma rta gdong dkar/ /thabs shes lcags kyu'i phyag rgya yis/ shar phyogs dung sgo dkar po phye/ /gtor ma'i zor lam dgra la bh+yoḥ/ /lho yi sgo ma phag gdong ma/ /thabs shes zhags pa'i ྾/ /lho phyogs gser sgo ser po phye/ /gtor ma'i zor lam ྾/ zhub kyi sgo ma dred gdong dmar/ /thabs shes lcagasasgrog ྾/ /nub phyogs zangs sgo dmar po phye/ /gtor ma'i ྾/ /byang gi sgo mo spyang gdong sngo/ /thabs shes dril bu'i ྾/ /byang phyogs g.yu sgo sngon po phye/ /gtor ma'i zor lam dgra la bh+yo/ /badz+ra rat+na pad+ma da rma pra be sha ya phaṭa/ ces dbye'o/ /gsum pa gtor ma bskyang zhing btang ba ni/ gtor ma sgo phyogasasu gsar te/ /gtor phud cha gsum du bgos la/ cha gcig mi zad gter du gong ltar spa/ cha gcig sbyin sreg gseb tu btang / cha gcig gtor ma dang lhag gtor thams cad btang ba ni/ dar 'phyar dung bus/ phud dang / mas sna drangs/ chos skyong gi rū pa 'phyar/ rnga dang rol mor bcas te/ bskul byang ltar bskul btang / gtor skyong chad mtho bya/ dmod byang ltar dmod mo bya/ bzhi pa dpang gzug pa ni/phud phyogs bcur gtor zhing rnal 'byor (84na)pa rnams zhal bcams te 'di skad do/ /hūṃ/ gzu dang dpang du dbon mchog bde gshegs bzhugs/ /bdag gis ma nyes ma yo yo/ /gser skyems 'di gsol bstang ma bzung du gsol/ /dgra dang bgegs la chad pa 'bab par rigs/ /'gro mgon shāka thub lhas byin ngan pas brnyas/ /su bden kun mkhyen mgon pos dpang mdzod la/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs —234

bka' brgyad gsang ba yongs rdzogs kyi dbang bskur dus sgrub yongs 'du'i 'khri shing / nang ma (ka)rgyas thob pa don ma chung / /g.yu tsog sngon mor me rtag bung bas brnyas/ /su bden kun mkhyen ྾/ /stong gsum sgra yis bkang ba don ma chung / khyung chen rgod por ltas ga srin byas brnyas/ /su bden ྾/ /bar snang rlabs kyis cho de pa don ma chung / /seng ge dkar mor ku ku khyi yis brnyas/ /su bden ྾/ /rtsal gsum lus la rdzogs pa don ma chung / /sa bdag spyi rje mtha' 'khob 'bangs kyis brnyas/ /su bden ྾/ /rgyal srid chos bzhin bskyangs pa don ma chung / /rdo rje slob dpon dam nyams slob mas brnyas/ /su bden ྾/ khres rab gsum la mnga' brnyes don ma chung / /yid bzhin nor bu gor ma rdo yis brnyas/ /su bden ྾/ /re ba yid bzhin bkang ba don ma chung / /chos spyod bdag 'dra dgra dang bgegs kyis brnyas/ /su bden ྾/ /rgyal ba yongs rdzogs bsgrubs pa don ma chung / /snang srid lha 'dre thams cad phud bzhes la/ /ma nyes rnal 'byor bdag gi bstang ma bzung / /zor gyi lam phye dam sna dgra la drongs/ /phyogs mtshams kun na srid pa'i lha dang 'dre/ /steng lha 'og klu bar gyi gnyan/ /phyogs skyong bcu la zor mi 'phen/ /gser skyems 'di gsol zor lam phye/ /mtho ba zhabs bskums dma' ba dbu chums shig /zor 'di dgra bgegs sri la 'phen/ /kun kyang grogs mdzod dmag dpung bskyed/ /ces gser skyems gtor zhing bka' bsgo bar bya'o/ /lnga pa go gsar ba ni/ pho lha'i (84bskol bca' ste/ rdo rje slob dpon gyis lta ba'i rdzong bskyed/ lha'i nga rgyal gyis go bca'o/ /rnal 'byor pa rnams ni rgyal theb la sogs sngags 'chang rnams/ /dar nag dar dmar gyi gos gyon/ /ral pa'i thod gdengs bca' phyag g.yas su rdo rje be con phur pa 'phyar/ g.yon lcags kyu dang thun thogs la/ gung gral bcas te dor stobs bya/ /mched pho thams cad gdong dmar nag byugs la/ /zhib bca' mda' stongs te phyir 'dur nang 'dur g.yas gral nas bya/ mo rigs rnams gdong la khrag dang pho tshos la chu byugs te/ g.yas dul nag re re thogs/ g.yon du gtor ma thod pa re thogs la mdun shan thul thabs g.yon gral nas bca'/ ging dkar nag dmar khra bzhi g.yas su ral gri zangs yag re/ g.yon du snying gi gzugs re thogs liṅga la gri bskor/ ging 'chams mdun nas bya/—235

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (25)gtor ma rnams dbus gling du re 'phyang / khyogs la btegs la 'degs pa thams cad kyang / khro bo'i ting nge 'dzin gsal bar rig pa ngar bskyed de/ ā+oṃ sarba du / e dzaḥbh+yo/ dgra bgegs 'byung po mā ra ya hūṃ phaṭa/ ces dir ri ri bzlas shing lam du bzhug ga /drug pa zor 'phang ba ni/ de yang gong ltar go bcas rjes su sngags 'chang phur pa thogs pa rnams kyi sa ma ti ni/ rgyud las/ ye shes lha la rang rgyud par/ /rtsis gdab khrigs su bcad pa med/ /ces dang le'u dgu pa nas/ /dkyil 'khor lha tshogasathams cad kun/ /chos nyid don la 'gyur med phyir/ /thams cad sku mdog mthing nag la/ /rdo rje phur pa 'dril zhing 'debs/ /dgra bgegs las rgyun gcad par bsam/ zhes 'byung ba dang / (85na〉nga stong stong tshigs su khro rgyal bskul zhes pas/ khro bo thams cad sku mdog mthing nag la/ rdo rje phur pa 'dril zhing dgra bgegs snying la 'debs par bsam mo/ /lcags kyus bkug cing phur bas 'debasatshul bya/ rkang pa dor stabs su 44 ṣ+ka 'di skad do/ /hūṃ/ chos nyid dbyings wo rang byung grub pa'i lha/ /zhesapa nas phur thun tshom bskul tshar rjes la/ /hūṃ/ nga ni khro rgyal kun gyi rje/ /nga ni bde gshegasakun gyi gtso/ /nga ni gshin rje kun gyi gshed/ /nga ni ma mo kun gyi yab/ /nga ni mkha' 'gro kun gyi rje/ /nga ni ging chen kun gyi rgyal/ /'khor gyi mkha' 'gro dam la 'du/ /dam can rgya mtsho dmag la 'chos/ /ṭā kyi 'bum tshogs phungs phung / /zhus can stong sdosil li li/ /dpa' bo'i mda' sgra sbrengs4spreng / /dpa' mo'i dul stabs chems se chem/ /dar gyi ru mtshon lhubs se lhub/ /mtsho rtse phur rtse rongasaserong / /yungs kar rbab 'dril shar ra ra/ /mtshe yi bde thung thal la la/ /gtor ma'i sgrogs rdeg chems se chem/ khrag thun dug rlangs chil li li/ /dgra bshegs gnod byed rdul du rlog /ces gdab sngags ni/ ā+oṃ badz+ra mahā kro dha pad+ma kro ti shwa rī badz+ra ki li gī lwa ya mahā yak+ṣa kā la rū pa ga rma raṃ raṃ dza la raṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ dam nyams dgra bgegs gnod byed sha / hur thums mā ra ya rbad/ ces 'dzin ging gnyis kyis 'jag ma'i liṅga bzung la/ dgug gzhug gdab las bya'o/ /de nas g.yas g.yon gyi mda' zor dul thabs dang / ging gi gri shan gtor zor du bstun te/ liṅga la brdeg cing 'di skad do/ /hūṃ hūṃ bh+yo/ sdang —236

bka' brgyad gsang ba yongs rdzogs kyi dbang bskur dus sgrub yongs 'du'i 'khri shing / nang ma (ka)ba'i dgra bgegs dam sri 'di/ /dang po ma rig gti mug 'thibs/ /bar du gzung dang 'dzin (85ba)pa bskyed/ /tha ma las ngan dbang gis 'khor/ /zhe sdang pha yi rgyu las byung / /'dod chags ma yi mngal du skyes/ /nga rgyal phrag dog las ngan spyod/ /lnga phung rtsad nas bcad pa'i phyir/ /srog pa'i rtsa la phur zor rgyob/ /zhe sdang snying la gtor zor ya/ /gti mug sha la mda' zor rgyob/ /'dod chags khrag la thun zor ya/ /zhe sdang rus la rdo zor rgyob/ khrag dog dbugs la dul zor ya/ /lnga phung lus la gri zor rgyob/ /rdo rje slob dpon sku dgra dang / /mched dang lcam dral spyi yi dgra/ /rnal 'byor bdag gi sgos dgra dang / /gzugs med dam sri gnod byed rnams/ /yongs rdzogs zor gyis rdul du rlog /dpal chen rngam pa'i zhal du bstab/ /'khor gyi khro tshogs mchod par bzhes/ /ma mo mkha' 'gro'i tsho gos la sbyin/ /ging chen ral pa'i rngams zas mdzod/ /sems ni rgyal ba'i gnas su spor/ zhesagadab sngags dgus phur thun dang / dug mthun thams cad kyis gdab/ bh+yos gdab phyi mig mi lta bar tshur log nas bsros gdab bo/ /gtor snod bshal chu 'bru dang bcas te bstan ma skyong /bdun pa phyi stog bzlog pa ni/ slob dpon gyis/ hūṃ khro badz+ra ga ru ḍa bh+yo bzlog /ces brjod pas ye shes kyi khyung nag gcig gis mtshams bcad de/ tshur mi ldog /phar thebs par bsam/ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ/ bdud pra mā ra ya rbad nan/ kha la dzam li rbad nan/ shig shig /dum dum rbad nan/ khram khram sa rbad nan/ rmugs rmugs rbad nan/ tir tir rbad nan/ tshal du tshal du rbad nan/ zhes bdun nam nyer gcig bzlas so/ /brgyad pa gtor gzheng mnan pa ni/ sgom dun du bro ra bcas te/ sam ti ni/ (86na)gtor gzhong 'og tu a gru gsum gyi dong gting ring ba'i nang du dgra dang / dam sri'i rū pa drag po'i sbyin sreg thal ba la byas te gzhug /dgra bgegs cad ma sri phyag rgya bzhis dgug /khugs bar gsal ba'i tshe/ hūṃ nyis sbrel gyis steng nas mnan pas mtshor rdo bor ba bzhin bstim bstim song nas chu srin gre bar chud par bsam/ dong kha ri rab kyis chod pa'i steng du/ dpal gyi bro ra bcas par bsam/de'i steng du 'phrin las bzhi'i bro gong ltar brdung / de nas dpal dgu'i sgos kyi bros kyang brdungs te —237

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (25) mnan no/ /dgu pa tshe 'gugs pa zor yang byed tshe lho byang gi gter ma'i tshe 'gugs gang yang rung ba dang rgyas par spro na rdzong chen tshe dbang mdzad 'dug /sgrub khog gi 'di la lung rgyun tsam ma gtogs mi mdzad/ sa bcad bco brgyad pa/ dang po mi zad gter chen sba ba'i cho ga ni rgyud las/ sa yi lha mo mkha' dbyings su/ /gter sbed cho ga rgyas par bya/ /zhes gsungs pas/ sa sbyin po la rat+na lnga brdar te/ bum pa lnga bya ste/ so btang ba'i nang du snying po lnga/ dar sna lnga/ 'bru lnga/ rin chen sna lnga/ sgrub gtor gyi phud cha gcig yang stsal te/ gos bu can gyi shing gis kha brgyan/ mgul chings bya/ kha dog lnga bsgyur/ mar me gnyis gtsugs la lag tu thogs so/ /rdo rje las bas gser gyi 'jor dngul gyi khyem thogs te/ dkyil 'khor gyi logs bzhi dbus dang lngar gter khung brus te/ sa'i lha mo'i mkha' dbye bar bsam ste/ sgrub khang sa chog lta bu byed kyang sbyar ro/ /slob dpon gyi dbu drangs rnal 'byor pa kun gyi dkyil 'khor la bskor te/ zhwa dang phyi gos gsar pa gyon rgyan btags te lag (86ba〉na yon bum pa bzung / /lag g.yas smon lam gyi me tog 'thor zhing sngon la shar phyogs nas 'di skad do/ /hūṃ/ skyob pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das/ /sa yi lha mo'i mkha' phye zhig /sa yi lha mo'i mkha' dbyings su/ /sgrub pa las kyi gter sped do/ /badz+ra he ru gas gter sped do/ /rin chen sna lnga'i gter sped do/ /snying po lnga yi gter sped do/ /dar sna lnga yi gter sbed do/ /sman sna lnga yi gter sted do/ /rin chen sna lnga'i gter sped do/ /dam rdzas gtor ma'i gter sbed do/ /yid bzhin gter chen 'di sbas pas/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la/ /nam zhig 'chi ba'i dus byung tshe/ /gter chen khyod kyis mdun nas bsus/ /'dod yon lnga la longs spyod shog /snying po lnga yi gter sbas pas/ /sku lnga lhun rgyas grub par shog /dar sna lnga yir/ /ye shes lnga dang ldan par shog /sman sna lnga ྾/ /nad kyi bskal pa zhi bar shog /'bru sna lnga yi ྾/ /mu ge'i bskal ba zhi bar shog /rin chen lnga yi gter ྾/ /mtshon gyi bskal pa zhi bar shog /dam rdzas gtor ma'i gter sbas pas/ /mi zad gter gyi mdun bsus shig /phyag rgya lnga yi rgya 'debs so/ /badz+ra a yuḥsirnyi : /—238

bka' brgyad gsang ba yong rdzogs kyi dbang bskur dus sgrub yongs 'du'i 'khri shing / nang ma (ka)zhes bum pa mthing ga shar du sbas te/ ho rin chen bum pa'i gter sbas pas/ / rnal 'byor pa 'dir tshogs thams cad ye shes kyi dngos grub thob ste/ tshe dbang phun sum tshogs pa'i skal pa dang ldan par gyur cig /ces brjod do/ /gtor chog bzhin du rim gyis 'phrul shes par bya ste/ he ru ga'i mtshan lngas gter sped do/ /zhes pa dang / rat+na/ pad+ma/ kurma/ bzhi ā yuḥsirnyi hūṃ/ zhes pa'i 'gres dang / smon lam gyi skabs su (87na〉sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las lnga so sor dngos grub thob ste/ zhes pa'i 'gres su shes so/ /rjes su rigs lnga'i phyag mtshan lnga gter steng du bris la rgyas gdab/ yon tan ni tshe 'dir yang tshe ring / longs spyod 'phel zhing sa bdag gzhi bdag gi ko long zhi ba dang / gnas mal der yang bkra shis par 'gyur ro/ /sgrub phran kun la yang 'di sbyar ro/ /phyi ma sku lnga ye shes lnga'i rgyur gyur/nad dang mu ge'i mtshon gyi bskal pa gsum las thar te/ mi zad gter bdag tu 'gyur ro/ /sngar gyi bsgrubs gtor dang lhan du bzhag nas stegs bu yod na dang med na sgrub khang gi rtsibs logs la sped/ sngar sa chog dus kyi bum gter de yang thog ma nas bum pa bzos grub pa yin na 'di'i khrod nas len pa yin/ sa bcad bcu dgu pa/ bcu bzhi pa smon lam gdab pa ni/ rnal 'byor pa mar me spos reng du bcas pa re thogs la/ dkyil 'khor la bskor zhing mgrin gcig tu 'di skad do/ /hūṃ/ dur khrod gsang ba mchog gi dkyil 'khor du/ /rdo rje slob dpon gnyen gyis dbu bzung nas/ /rgyal ba'i gdung gsob mched dang lcam dral rnams/ /brtse dungs mi 'bral sems can 'di kun kyang / / nam zhig byang chub lam du zhugs pa'i tshe/ /'khor ba'i g.yang sa chen por mi btang zhing / /ma rig mun pa'i dbang du mi btang la/ /gcong rong zab mo'i gnas su mi skye dang / /dmyal ba zangs kha'i nang du mi lhung zhing / /gcan gzan gdug pa'i sgra skad mi grag dang / /mtshon chen gdug pa'i dbal gyis mi 'phog shog /dge ba'i bshes gnyen bka' drin che ba dang / /dam tshig gcig pa'i rdo rje mched lcam rnams/ /(87brko bang gi 'brel ba'i mtshan ldan gzung ma gsum/ /tshe rabs 'di dang tshe brgyud thams —239

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (25)cad du/ /mi 'bral 'grogs pa'i ting 'dzin rtse gcig gis/ /sa bcu rim gyis khyad par bgrod par shog /nam zhig tshe 'phos lus brjes dus byung tshe/ /zhe sdang dbang gi dmyal bar lhung srid na/ /snang gsal mar mes tsha grang sdug bsngal gzhil/ /phrag dog dbang gis lha min yul 'khyams na/ /snang gsal mar mes gdug pa'i mtshon kha bsnol/ /'dod chags dbang gis kla klo'i mir skyes kyang / /snang gsal mar mes shes rab gsum la sbyor/ /nga rgyal dbang gis tshe ring lhar gyur na/ /snang gsal mar mes 'pho lhung sdug bsngal choms/ /gti mug dbang gis byol song gnas 'grims na/ /snang gsal mar mes shes rig sgron me theg /ser sna'i dbang gis yi dwags gnas skyes na/ /snang gsal mar mes bkres skom sdug bsngal sol/ khyu 'di yis ni sa bcu yongs bgrod tshe/ zhes bya'i sgrib byang phyir mi bzlog par shog /snang ba'i go 'byed zhun mar mdangs ldan 'dis/ /bde gshegs yongasal phul ba'i mthu byin gyis/ /sa bcu 'das te sa rnams yongs rdzogs shog /kun tu 'od dang ma chags pad+ma can/ /'khor lo tshogs chen sdug po bkod pa'i sa/ /de pa kun 'dus kun bzang dbyer med pa/ /rdor sems phyi pa lcang lo can gyi sa/ /bla ma'i sa dang srid gsum ngang rdzogs pa/ /spros bral thig le'i sa la lhun grub nas/ /gzugs sku nyid kyis 'gro don yongs rdzogs shog /sa bcad bcu gcig pa dbyangs gsal yi ge brgya pas lhag chad kha bkang / las gzhung nas mchod (88na〉bstod ji ltar rigs pa'i sgo nas gtang rag gtong / sa bcad bcu pa dkyil 'khor bsdu ba ni/ rdo rje thal mo'i bar du bzung ste/ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ/ zhes brjod pas snang srid 'od du zhu nas gzhal yas khang la bsdu/gzhal yas khang yang 'od du zhu lha tsho gos la bsdu/ lha rnams gtso bo la bsdu/ gtso bo nyid kyang 'od kyi rang bzhin du thugs ma'i hūṃ la bsdu/ hūṃ nyid kyang gyen rdzogs su thig ler bsdus te de nyid kyang mtha' rinas dbus su dag ste/ spros bral mya ngan las 'das pa'i ngang du ma bcos lhun grub tu sol le rtog med du lhan gyis bzhag ga /rdo rjes maṇ+ḍal mtha' nas bsdu'o/ /de nas 'di skad do/ /hūṃ/ gsang ba yongs su rdzogs pa'i dkyil 'khor du/ /rnal 'byor sgrub —24(/—

bka' brgyad gsang ba yongs rdzogs spya dbang bskur dus sgrub yongs 'du'i 'khri shing / nang ma (ka)mchog 'khor dang bcas pa yis/ /rgyal ba zhi khro yongs rdzogs bsnyen cing bsgrubs/ /dngos grub mchog blang 'phrin las rnam bzhi spyad/ /snod bcud snying po byang chub sems su bsdu/ /kun gzhi skye med ye nas mya ngan 'das/ /mi gnas ye shes thugs kyi dkyil 'khor du/ /ye shes 'od zer slar bsdu yal la la/ /bde chen thig le'i klong du badz+ra muḥ/ /de nas skad cig ma la yi dam gyi lhar bskyed de/ /bya ba la 'jug pa ni las kyi lha'o/ /ye shes ni rang bzhin bstim gyi bar du'o/ /yi dam ye shes pa mi bskol ba'i tha tshig go /bcu drug pa rang lus srung ba ni/ me dpung klong du rang yi dam du gsal bas gong ltar rgyun spyod kyi ltar ldang ba ngar 'dzin rnam dag ces sogs brjod la/ ā+oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa hūṃ/ ā+oṃ badz+ra ka ba tsa hūṃ/ badz+ra badz+ra badz+ra3 phaṭaḥ rdo rje'i zhu lugs su gtams par (88ba)bsam mo/ /de yang ngo bo stong zhing bdag med don la gnas pas/ a cis kyang mi 'gyur mi shigs pas/ stong pa'i go cha bla na med/ /chos sku skye med rdo rje yis/ /mtshan ma'i spyod yul kun bcoms nas/ /chos kyi dbyings kyi rgyas gdab la/ /sangs rgyas kyis kyang mi gzigs na/ /gnod byed bgegs kyis ga la tshugs/ /hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ/ de ltar dgongs pa dang ldan pas/ /spyod lam rnam bzhir yi dam nga rgyal dang mi 'bral bar bya'o/ /bcu gnyis pa bzod par gsol ba ni/ rnal 'byor pa rnams dkyil 'khor la phyag gsum bya ste skor la zhes pa tsam las 'dir ma byung yang / bka' brgyad bde 'dus nas mched nang bshags zhes 'byung ba ltar/sgrub pa dbu btsugs nas bzung / rdo rje rgyal theb dang / mched rnams phan tshun du thugs 'gal sogasasel zhugs pa yod na/ so sor dag par bya ba'i phyir phan tshun du bshags pa 'bul ba ste/ phyag len 'dul ba'i gso sbyong ltar/ rgyal theb nas bzung gral g.yas g.yon du bshams te/ g.yon gral rnams kyi g.yas gral la phyag btsal nas bshags pa lan gsum du byas pa/ g.yas gral bas dang du blangs nas/ slar g.yas gral bas g.yon gral la phyag gsum btsal nas gong bzhin bshags pa lan gsum byas la thams cad 'khon med du dgyes pa chen pos nyams bsgyur zhing 'bel gtam ji ltar rigs par mdzad do/ /'di la 'dul ba'i gso sbyong du mkhan po'ang g.yas g.yon gang rigs su —24/—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (25)phebs srol 'dug kyang / 'dir rdo rje rgyal po de bzhin nyid kyi ting nge 'dzin las g.yo ba med na phebs pa'i bya rtsol (89nas dgos sam snyam mo/ /de ltar go don phyag bzhes nges par byas nas phan tshun du bshags pa bya ba ni/ 'di skad do/ /lho thams cad rdo rje mched dang lcam dral te/ /bde bar gshegs pa'i slob mar dam nos nas/ /kun kyang mthun par spyod pa'i dam tshig la/ /mnyam nyid ngang la legasanyes dbyer med kyang / /lusang ga rnam par ma dag tshul tsam du/ /gzhung las nyam sa dang thugs dang 'gal ba rnams/ /rnam dag bsam pas mi gnas tshig 'dis bshags/ /'dzin med ngang du bzod par ba che sti snamadzod la/ /rang bzhin dag pa'i tshangs par stsal du gsol/ /a a a/ ches/dag par bsgom/ bcu gsum pa gtang rag gtang ba ni/ gos bsdus bla ma'i khri bstod de/ rnal 'byor pa mched lcam thams cad gral bya ste/ gser dngul skyogs su/ 'bras chang rgun chang bshams pa dang / /na bza' dar chen mdzas pa thogs te 'di skad do/ /ho yang gsang bla med lha yi dkyil 'khor du/ /zhi khro bka' brgyad rigs 'dzin dang bcas pa'i/ /sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub thob bya'i phyir/ /sgrub pa zab mor gnang ba bka' drin che/ /sangs rgyas yin phyir sku gsung thugs thob pa'i/ /ban dha lcang lo bstan pa bka' drin che/ /ye shes lha dang sku lnga'i don mtshon phyir/ /'khor lo rtsibs bzhi bstan pa ྾/ /theg pa rim dgu nang du 'dus pa las/ /dkyil 'khor gling dgur bstan pa ྾/ /ma rig mun pa'i nang du 'thoms pa las/ /mar me dgu pa bstan pa ྾/ /(〈bsgo rtogs skyon gyi grib mas khyab pa la/ /thugs rje nyi ma bstan pa ྾/ /sangs rgyas thams cad sems las mi 'da' phyir/ /'da' ka dam tshig bstan pa ྾/ /rdo rje slob dpon sku tshe g.yung drung ni/ /'gyur ba med par mchog tu brtan par smon/ /mched lcam dus gsum rtag tu 'grogs pa dang / /pho brang chen po g.yung drung tshugs par smon/ /bdud rtsi rnam lnga ro mchog rgyas pa dang / /zhen bral 'dod yon lnga la longs spyod smon/ /zhal zas bdud rtsi'i ro ldan gser dngul skyogs/ /phyag tu bzhes nas dgyes pa skong bar smon/ /lha yi na bza' pañtsa li ka 'di/ /sku la gsol nas 'khor 'dab rgyas par smon/ /zhes skyems drangs/ na bza' gsol/ sgrub yon —242

bka' brgyad gsang ba yong rdzog kyi dbang bskur du sgrub bongs 'du'i 'khri shing / nang ma zhananam dbang yon dngos po dag pa dbul/ de rjes su gtang rag gi bzod par gsol ba ni/ /ho/ rdo rje slob dpon chen po dpal mchog ldan/ /gsung rab rgya mtsho lha mi 'dren pa'i dpal/ /yang dag don ston 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal skyob/ /'jig rten 'di nas pha ma'i tshul las khyad/ /bka' drin bzang yang bsnyen bkur rngo ma thogs/ /sdom gsum bsrung bya dam tshig gang nyams kyang / /nyes lhung sgrib par mi 'gyur dag bya'i phyir/ /mthol bshags bzod par gsol gyis tshangs par mdzod/ zhes zhabs spyi bor blangs shing bla ma gtsug dang bral med du bzung ngo / /bco lnga pa bkra shis gsol ba ni/ rnal 'byor pa rnams me tog 'thor zhing 'di skad do/ /hūṃ/ma bcos spros med byang chub snying por gsal/ /gdod nas ma skyes rang byung mtha' dbus grol/ /kun (90nasgo byab rnam dag lhun grub kun tu bzang / /chos sku'i ba po shis dam pa bde legs shog /rnam par snang mdzad bkra shis don gyi lha/ /bde gshegs sku yi ba po shis gang lags pa/ /dam pa desakyang deng 'dir bde legs shog /snang ba mtha' yas ba po shis don gyi lha/ /bde gshegs gsung gi bkra shis gang lags pa/ /dam pa des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog /rdo rje sems dpa' bkrashis don gyi lha/ /bde gshegs thugs kyi bkra shis gang lags pa/ /dam pa des kyang bkra shis bde legs shog /rin chen 'byung ldan bkra shis don gyi lha/ /bde gshegs yon tan bkra shis gang lags pa/ /dam pa des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog /don yod grub pa bkra shis don gyi lha/ /bde gshegs 'phrin las bkra shis gang lags pa/ /dam pa des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog /'phrin las rnam bzhi bkra shis don gyi lha/ /so so'i yid la re skong bkra shis shog /rgyal po rgyal theb bkra shis don gyi lha/ /dam chos dbang lung yongs rdzogs bkra shis shog /rdo rje mched lcam bkra shisadon gyi lha/ /gser mdog rgyud 'brel 'grogs pa'i bkra shis shog /snod bcud yongs rdzogs bkrashis don gyi lha/ /sgrub chen don dang ldan pa'i bkra shis shog /ces me tog gtor ro/ /bco brgyad pa gnas bsrung ba ni/ zhag gsum du las byang gi gtor ma re re btang / thag —243

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzas rgya mtsho gsung tshom/ ()ring por mi 'gro/gnas su da tshe yugs mdze sprang mi bto ngo //de nas sprul pa'i yo byad lhag ma rnamasacha gsum du bgos te/cha gcig bla ma la dbul/90bsgo gcig rgyal theb la sogs pa rnams la dbul/cha gcig tshar ston bya ste/dge slong bzhi sdo bya/bon rtsis sman bzo bzhi sogs bya ste/rgyal rje so yongs bzhi sde/byis pa ston mo la sogs chang them par bkye'o//de rjes bsngo ba ni/sngo dge ba dri med rgya chen 'dis//mtha' yas sems can ma lus kun//sgrib pa kun bral tsho gis gnyis rdzogs//sa snyo ma lus yongs rdzogs nas//sku gsum dbyer med lhun grub ste//chub ba mya ga 'das pa'i sa//mchog gi dngos grub myur thob shog/ā+oṃ satwa rje : hūṃ/hoḥbasnyen sgrub rnam bzhi mthar tso pa'i byin mas kyis/yul phyogs 'dir yang ba po shis te/mi nad dang phyugs nad rjo go nas//sa chu dus rtsa phebs pa dang /lo legs pa dang /mar dang 5ge'i bskal pa zhi bar gyur cig/gnas mala'adir yang byin bzha te/phyi rabs kyi brgyud won su dang sus bsgrubs kyang //sgrub pa myur du thon nas/mchog dang mas mong gi dngos grub la longs spyad par gyur cig khes pa'i bsngo ba smon lam sgo nas/bsgrub ma rnams la/dam tshig bslab bya dang /chos bshad thems par bshad/zhi khro bka' brgyad yong rtsa rdzogos ba'i spra khrid/gsang sngags spyi'i sgrub khog dpal g.yo ba yongs rdzogos kyi sgrub chen//skyon gu ru pad+ma thod phreng rtsal gyis/rje 'bangs grogs gsum gyi don du mdzad pa rdzogs so//man+ta gu ya/rgya rgya rgya/sam ya/shes rab blo ldan snying rje che//skal ldan zhig dang god par shog/bhā/lha/thā/zhwa/gabs /thas ga)ha kha sku /tha/:61na tha de ldan mgon po'i dri med ye shes spyan//yongs gzigs mtsho skyes rdo rje 'dzam gling 'dir//rig sngags 'chang gtso nus rtsal gangs༅ 'gror//legs byin bka' drin pha mtha' su yis 'jal//de phyir cal sgrog grags rjes 'brang byed pa'i//'a pa rma min mgon khyod snying dbus su//gas nu bum skur rang ngo ma 'phrod bar//rab bzhugasa'aja' lus rdo rje'i sku thob shog/gsung sprul zab chos yongasa'i waṃ shing che//yal 'dab me tog rgyas pa'i grib ma mā/spyi dang khyad par gangs ljoX yid can rnams//bde skyid rdzogs ldan gsar

bka' brgyad bde 'du kyi dang dang khro rol gyi zin bri kun bzang dgong pa'i rol mtsho/ nang ma zhanapa'i 'bras myong shog zhes chu byi hor zla brgyad pa'i nang rnam par rgyal ba'i phan bde legs bshad gling pa sogs la zhi khro kun 'dus bka' brgyad gsang ba yongs rdzogs kyi dbang bskur dus sgrub 'bum dang dbang 'bum bsdebs nas chu 'babs su bkod pa'i zin bris yongs 'du'i 'khri shing 'di'ang za hor gyi sngags ston zil gnon bzhad pa rtsal gyis sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni gnas brtan 'jam dbyangs grags pa'o/ /ma sgo lo/ /bka' brgyad bde kyi 'dus dbang dang / khro rol gyi zin bris kun bzang dgongs pa'i rol mtsho bzhugs/dpal bde gshegs 'dus pa'i dbang gi phyag len khyab bdag pad+ma dbang gi gsung rgyun zin bris su bkod pa la/ sa brtag pa dang snang ba la sa bslang ba gnas khang rnying par btang snyoms su 'jog /nyin dang po la las byang 'dzab kyi bar gzhung bsrang / cog tse'i steng du/ sa lha la gtor ma zlum po bad 'dab ma/ phyogs skyong la de 'dra ba la changs bu yod pa/ mchod pa rnams lnga tshar re bshams nas mi snang bar sa bslang / de nas phyogs skyong dmigs pas bkug in+d+ra ṇa sogs kyi mthar gtor sngags kyis bsngo/ sa lha dang phyogs skyong gnyis ka'i gtor snod chang gis bshal bar nas glugs te sa bdag phran tshe gas tshore bsngo/ sa dbang du byas sgrub khang du lto 'bye mi dgos sngags dang phyag rgyas sbyang ba/ ting nge 'dzin gyis sbyang ba rnams dkyus ltar/ sa gzhi bzung zhing bgegs bskrad ba ni khro bcu'i sngags dang bcas phur pa sal 'debs tshul byed pas mtshams bzung ba yin/ phyogs skyong la gdab pa min/ sa gsar pa min pa'i sgrub khang rnying par 'di'i tshab la 'og gi phur gdab dngos gzhi blangs kyang rung / bsod na rmes kyi dpung bskyed pa dbang zhu mkhan rnams kyis byed/ 'dir skongs kyi cho ga byas kyang rung mod/ des (2na sko mchod yul bum par bskyed dgos pas cung zad nyog por 'gro —245

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung tsom/ 9)bas 'og tu byed pa 'jug pa bde/rgyal chen la mtho so sor sku btsugs pa'i mdun du pad+ma 'dab bzhi'i steng me tog gi tshom bu lnga 'god dkar gtor pad+ma 'dab bzhi pa re re bsham dgos/dam sri dkyus ltar/sgo byang ra'i sogs pa'i phyi la gshin rje/nang la rta mgrin dang bdud rtsi 'khyil pa gshibs nas 'dri/phur bzer yang mda' dar nag po la 'dogs/phur pa gzhan ba ṇi ga la shog dril btags nas dam sri'i li sgor 'dzugs zer ba mi dgos/bdud rtsi 'khyil ba dang rta mgrin la snod gcig tu gtor ma gnyis bshams pa bskyed bstim byas nas rang sngags kyis bsngo/gshin rje la dmar gtor gru gsum byed/'di gnyis la gtor gdan pad 'dab tshom bu mi dgos/ma tre mgo gsum lag pa gnyis byed/ nang mtshams gsang mtshams gtsod mtshams gtso dganyis sgrub khang rnying par sa mtshams 'dzin pa'i skabs byas na des mthus 'dir mi dgos/chos skyong dang bye brag dregs pa'i bskang gso btang /bdag bskyed nyer bsdu bya/nyin gnyis pa lam ga chag gdab/thig skud byin rlabs byas nasasngon ma sa thig gi thig chen brgyad 2ba lnga tab/de nas gnam thig btab rjes lha grangs kyi dri dang tshom bu bkod phyi nang gi mchod pa bshams nas las byang 'dzab kyi bar btang lha nam mkhar bteg 'dir dkyil 'khor 'dri na thig gdab sto byin gyis bas/slob dpon gyis sta gon bzhi po grub rjes pad+ma 'dab brgyad kyi steng du bum pa dgu/de'i steng du dung chos gzungs thag mthar mchod pa dang bcas gzhud ltar bsgrub/de nas/bla ma rgyal ba zhi khro sogs nas las kyi mchod pas bdag 'gyed dngos grub stsol zhes pa'i bar gyi zhu ba zhu lan byas nas/bla mas bzlas pa cung zad dang slob mas yig brgya cung zad brjod pas bsag sbyang gi dod byas te slob ma sta gon dkyus ltar bya/ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor la brten nas sgrub na lha sta gon byas rjes dkyil thang bkram sgrom btsugs sgrub rdzas dkyus ltar bshams nas 'phrin las gzhung bsrangs nas bsgrub pa'i zhor la bum sgrub kyang byed pa yin no//yang dkyil 'khor 'dri ba slob ma sta gon gyi rjes su dkyus ltar byas kyang chog go/nyin gnyis pa nas dkyil 'khor bris par ba/na nyin gsum pa'i bya ba la bam ro ni bam sgrub

bka' brgyad bde 'dus kyi dbang dang khro rol gyi na bri kun r+sāng dgong pa'i rol mtsho/ nang ma yinaste da lta mi dgos rgyan dgu'i mas dgu la lha so sor bris te lte bar bde gshegs bka' 'khor so sor phral nas 'dri/de'i nang du so so'i sgrub rten sman gyi ze'u mar me'i kung zla gam sgo gcig pa'i dbyibasacan/khram shing mdun gyi khram bar du a kro 'bru bcu bdun pa rgyab tu liṅga mtshon cha'i sngags bkod pa/rta dmar zhur can gyi dpral thod la zhal gsum pa rta mgos mtshan pa/lcags phur 'chang bzung rdo rje ma zhal gsum ma/smad phur pa la rgya mdud ma zhal gyi tshab tu byang bu la bla ma rigs 'dzin gyi sku brisapa/phur pa rgya 3nasgo dud rtser snying gzugs/phur pa rgya mdud kyi rtser khram shing gi gzugs//phur pa rgya mdud ma gcig rnams/che mchog/yang dag/gshin rje/rta mgrin/phur pa/rigs 'dzin/ma mo/mchod bstod/drag sngags rnams kyi rten btsugs pa rnams sgrom khri'i steng du 'god dngos su ma 'byor na tsaka li ra bris pas go chod pa/'phrul ba yid yid bzhin sogs kyis bsang rdzas kyi thod pa dgu po dgram pa yin/phur pa sngar gdab phur gyi bcu po yin kyang kyi de la tshig brjod mi dgosapas dur khrod kyi phyi rdo ra'i nang gi khrag 'khyams la 'dzugs/tshang la mnga' mdzad sogs kyi sgrub rten gyi gtso phur rnams 'god/ral gri sogs dkyus ltar mar me gcig sgrom steng dang /brgyad po khrag khyams kyi phyogs mtshams la 'god/mchod pa dang mchod gtor bsham pa gzhung ltar sgrom khri la dbang rdzas 'god lugs dkyil 'khor du sgrub phur dgu de'i steng bum pa dgu/ de'i thog steng thod pa dgu/steng thog sngar gyi thod sku yod na dang med na'ang tsaka li sde tshan bcu gcig/khyad par gtso dgu'i tsaka li ro ras la bris pa sku rten/zhal khebs dar dmar la rang sngags bris pa gsung rten/thugs rten ni 'og tu bkod pa'i phur pa sgrub gtor dgu/bkra shis tshe'i gtor ma ni tshe bum sna tsho gis rdo rjesamatshan pa/dza gad kyi bum pa g.ya' med dkar yol gyi bum pa lta bur chang bu ram sbrang btab pa mar gyi ril bu dang nyi zla'i gzugs bkod pa/zla gam steng dkar po 'og dmar po kha sbyor na tshe ril gyisagang ba rtser rdo rje phyed pas mtshan pa/mchod gtor dbyibs gru gsum dmar po/dug gtor gru gsum nag po dug bsres pa/las bzhi'i gtor ma dka/ po zlum po sum 3ba7rtsegs kyi steng zlum gtor/

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 9zhedes mtsho ni gzhan gsum gyi mdog dbyibs brtsegs pa sogs rigs 'gre/ dbu rgyan dgu/ rdor dril dgu/ rus rgyan rnams 'god/ rdzas dbang gzhan rnams dkyil 'khor gyi mtha'i phyogs gzhan la 'god/ gzi byin bskyed pa sgrub rdzas kun la byed/ de nas bkod grub ci byung grub pa sogs yin/ dpal gyi chas su gzhug pa nas gzung dngos gzhi dbang chog ltar la las tshan sko bzhag dang mas 'jug tshar phral bde gshegs bka'i byon tshul byed/ sman bsdub dang byin rlabasaganyis sman sgrub mi byed na mi dgos/ slob ma'i nyes skyon bsal ba la drug yod pa'i dang po dkyil 'khor skad cig gis gsal gdab/ las byang nas sman mchod dang dngos grub blang / bsre mnan dbang ma thob pa 'ga' zhig la mi dgos/ zhu myong ma myong 'dres tshe myong ba dang ma myong ba gnyis bsre ba yin/bsre lugs/ slob dpon gyis nang mchod byin gyis brlabs sman mchod cig phul/ dbang gral la dbang thob pa re gral mag /ma thob pa re gral mjug byas spel nas phan tshun srin lag sbrel nas/ dpalaldan rdo rje sku 'chang ba sogs/ gsung dang thugs la 'don pa bsgyur nas gsol ba btab/ slob dpon gyis lan du sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje slob dpon dang sogs kyis lan btab nas nang mchod sbyin/ rtsa ba sku gsung thugs kyi dam tshig dang sogs brjod nas/ gsar pa gral mgo dang rnying pa gral mjug tu spo/ 'di nas gral 'dzin byed/ de nub nas thun 'dzin dgos pas bgegs gtor nyul le bskrad/yar log nas bzhengs te byin dbab/ bzhugs nas chad mtho bstan skyong btang / slob dpon la lasakyi rdo rjes gzungs thag gtad nas/ gsang ba'i dkyil (4na tshe tswa sgor sogs kyis 'dzab bskul/ zhi ba'i lha dbang ma rdzogs par zhi ba'i sngags/ de nas rigs 'gre/ nyin bzhi pa nas rnal 'byor rgyun dbang bskur/ bla mas kyang 'di nas bzung rnal 'byor rgyun dbang len/ rdzas dbang la nyi ma tsam dgosaskabs sbyar/ zhi ba nas bka' srung bar gyi lha dbang nyin re la lha dbang sde tshan gnyis gsum zin na bya rung / mi grub na nyin re la tshan pa re re zin dgos/ che mchog lta bu'i lha dbang gi byed la bzhag mi chog /sman sgrub med na che mchog gi lha dbang zin nas g.yang gzhi'i steng du ma zhi'i khar sman mchod 248

bas brgyad bde 2 kyi dbang dang khro rol gyi na bris sa slong dgong pa'i rol mtsho/ nang gzhanabazhag rnga 'chams byas sman byin gyis brlabs/las kyi rdo rjes sman phud 'thor zhing sman mchod phul/lhag 'gyed/sman sgrub yod na 'og tu dngos grub len chog gi sngon der byed/phur pa'i lha dbang tshar rjes bsgral las don brgyad ma dang bcas bsgral dbang 'chams dang bcas bya/rgyal thabs spyi blug yan gzhung ltar yin/dngos grub len par rten khebs sogs gdan gzhi'i khar dkyil 'khor ldobakod pa'i sgrub rdzas thams cad blangs te bkod/sha mar sogs bza' btung sna tsho gis kyang gsar du bsham/bgegs skrod byin 'bebs bka' so so'i sngags mthar sarba pañtsa btags pas byin gyis brlabs/lha gnad la dbab pa song rjes bzed zhal gnyis su chang dang rak+tas so sor 'bul bas/ gsum dang bcas rak+ta lan gsum 'phyar ba 'dra ba zhig chang la yang byed/rak+ta bzed zhal du sdugasapa lta bu chang la byed/khrag chang 'phyar 'bul rnams ni bar byas pa ji lta ba dmod pa drag sngags kyi bar kun la byed/ kā ya sirnyi ā+oṃ/ lha ka sirnyi āḥtsit+ta sirnyi hūṃ dang bcas bdud rtsi gnas gsum du 4ba 'jog pa bka' so so thams cad la dgos shing /bdud rtsi gsang rdzas nas byed/khrag chang bka' srung gi gtor mar sbrengs nas sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub dus 'dir stsol zhes pa'i mjug tu 'phyar ba'i chang dganas gnas gsum du reg/bdud rtsiganas gsum du reg pa thams ro slob dpon nas gsang sgrub pa po kun gyis byed/skabs 'dir dngos grub kyi rdzas la mi rol/gzhan don slob mal sgrub rdzas kyi dbang bskur ba thams cad kyang thog mar slob dpon gyi phyag tu las kyi rdo rjesabhan+dha sogs phul rim gyi slob dpon rang la byin rlabs zhug te dbang blangs nas slob ma la bskur ba yin/'phreng ba'i skabs bka' so so'i dbang gi rjes zlos kyang byed dgos pas/bka' re re bzhin 'phreng ba'i dbang gnang bar 'byon dgos/bcu gnyis pa tshe'i dbang gi skabs sgrub gtor sogasabaza' btung thams cad kyis 'grim pa mdzad/'di rnams dbang zhu ba mtshams khog tu yod pa kho nar byed/khrom ba dmangs mar dbang gnang ba slob dpon khrom gyi khri khar byon tshe bum bsham bla mas sngon 'gro dbang bshad maṇ+ḍal phul/byang chub rdo rje ༷༷sa rgyas la sogs blo ka gcig gis gsol ba

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ slobabatab/7skyabs sems bya/ dngos grub bskul tshig gi dmangs ma bzhag ste nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i dkyil 'khor sogs dang / dur khrod gsang ba mchog sogs thog mtha'i rjes zlos mdzad/de skabs las kyi rdo rje sogs kyis zhwa gyon 'phan gdugs rol cha dang bcas sgrub khang nas dngos grub kyi rdzas rnams gdan drangs nas slebs pa dang rdo rje slob dpon gyis tshe bum bsnams nas khrom la dbang bskur/ slar bla ma khri khar bzhugs dngos grub kyi rdzas khyer pa tsho khrom (ldan tshe) mtha' bskor nas mar me'i smon lam tshar gcig bya/ bkra shis kyi me rtag 'thor/ de nas bla ma sogs nang du byon nas rdzas cha lngar bgos zer yang / cha dgu bgos te/ me lha/ sa lha/ chu lha/ phyi'i mkha' 'gro rnams so/ /bgod lugs thog mar sgrub rdzas kun nas bla mas phud re blangs de rjes bum chu gsang rdzas sogs kyi khu ba byas gtore ma sogs sbol nas/ lha dang rigs 'dzin brgyud pa la phud phul/ rdo rje slob dpon gyi skal ba sngon mas go chod/ gzung ma'i skal ba bla ma rang la sprod/ me lha'i skal ba me thab chung ngu gcig tu 'jig rten pa'i me lha bskyed nas 'bul/ mched lcam dang khrom la 'gyed/bdud rtsi sman sgrub byas na yang skal ba gtong lugs 'dra/ chang ka pā la gang la 'phrin las gzhung ltar byin gyis brlabs/ de 'thung ba dang bkra shis brjod cing me tog 'thor/ sngar dngos grub rol ba'i smon lam ho bde bar gshegs pa sogs kyis gdab/ 'di gtor ma cha gsum du bgos zer yang sngar gyi dngos grub kyi rdzas de ga yin pas/ cha gcig sbyin sreg byed zer ba sngar me lhar bsngos zin/ sngar gyi lha'i skal ba de 'bru sman rin po che sogs dang bcas bum gter byas la 'og khang du dkyil 'khor bzhengs na dkyil 'khor bris pa'i 'og tu sba/ steng khang du bzheng na dgon gnas gang yin de'i sa gnad che sar sba/ chu'i skal ba chur gnas kyi sems can don du chu bo la dor/lhag ma'i cha de phyi rol du mkha' 'gro sogs la gtong / dkyil 'khor bsdu ba man gzhung ltar ro/ /zhi ba'i sbyin sreg byed na slob ma sta gon gyi skabs slob ma'i sdig pa sbyong ba'i tshe byed/ rgyas pa'i sbyin sreg byed na dngos grub len chog gi (5bsko sdon du byed/ skong bshags byed na rgyas pa'i sbyin sreg byed —250

bka' brgyad bde bos kyi dbang dang khro rol gyi na bris kun bzang dgong pa'i rol mtsho/ nang ma zhanacing dngos grub ma blangs pa'i bar der byed/byed tshul sa stegs bang rim bzhi'am yang na rdo tshon
