bka' brgyad lha tshogs dmag dpung skyed dgra bgegs snying la gtor zor rgyob badz+ra sarba dus jig nan:e hur thums dza dgra bgegs:tri sha lha mā ra ya rbad //bstan pa skyong mdzad ma dang sri pa dpal gnas ma dang yang dag shes khyung btsun kong lha g.yu bun ma me stag zla 'od byang rgyal ma gser thang kun bzang shān+ti dpal klu mo gzi 'bar la sogs pa'i bstan ma bgraganyisagator ma long :mi mthun gnod pa'i phyogs rnams bzlog tshwa āḥlha badz+ra a mṛ ta khā stim ma hri ma ma hri khā hi khā gi//sangs rgyas kun gyi sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las rdzogs pa'i dpal gti mug burnya rdo rje la zhi ba'i lha dang lha mos bskor dngul lam dkar po'i shing dag la mgo bo rgya mdud rtse mo zlum ngos la zhi ba'i lha bkod de btab pas 'jigs brgyad zhi bar 'gyur zhi bar ma gyur gang yang med zhi mdzad lha la phyag 'tshal bstod zho ā+oṃ ā+oṃ/mi mthun phyogs rnams shan+ti ku ru ye swāhā&/sangs rgyas kun gyi sku gsung thugs yon tan sko nga rgyal rin ra rgyal pa'i mo:gser ram ser po'i ra mgo bo rgya mdud rtse zur /zhi ngos la rgyas par btab pas 'byor drug

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()rgyas par 'gyur rgyal mdzad za swā swā swā tshe dang bso de nams pu lja ku ru ye swā1 0byu/sangs rgyas ra yon tan mo 'dod chags pad+ma ra dbang gis zangs sam dmar po'i kho mgo bo rgya mdud rtse zla gam ngos la dbang za bto pas snang srid dbang du 'gyur dbang dur dbang mdzadarki:3 ༷sa3lha 'dre migasum wa rdzu ku ru ye swāhā//sangs rgyas ra yon tan ma phrag dog dmezo drag po'i lha dang lhar lcags sam nag po'i ma mgo bo rgya mdud rtse zur gsum ngosaladrag po'i lha ra btags pas dgra bgegs brlag par 'gyur brlag par ma gyur gang mo rlag mdzad lha lar hā hā lhaganod byed dgra bgegs mā ra ya 9) phaṭa:ṇa)jo su5ni te snrozhes sogs9〉rjod:snyi/'khong po cho ge sku skye med ngang wo las 'gro don skye ba'i cho 'phrul tshom bu dgur zhi khro yongs rdzogs 'gro ba kun btul nas slar yang chos dbyings rnam dag klong du bsdu 'o āḥ/ badz+ra mu i sī yu sku/22/'-i swo ye i:o yo e aḥka kha ga gha nga :tsa tsha dza dzha lha ṭa bra ḍa rte na ta tha da dha na pa pha ba bha ma ya ra la wa sha ṣa sa ha k+ṣa:yi ge brgya pa brjod khrin//'khor 'dzin rnam dag sgyu lus 'ja' 'dra 'di dpal r+pā sku gsung thugs kyi rgyas bto ste bden pa dbyer med lta spyod zung 'brel bas rgyun du 'gro ba 'dren pa'i spyod lam bya'o rtswa āḥ/ badz+ralha ho bsod nams ye shes tshogis gnyis mthu byin gyis bdag gzhan 'gro ba ma lus thamasacad kun:zhi rgyas dbang drag phren las mnga' brnyes shing :sku gsum lhun grub 'gro don mthar phyin shog zhi khro gsang ba yongs rdzogs kyi skrub chen las gzhud srong ba'i chog khrigs skyon pad+ma thod 'phreng rtsal bdag gi phyag bzhes:cho sgo rgyal khri srong lde btsan dang :gnubs0bskom mkha'i snying po dang /mkhar chen bza' 'tsho rgyal gsum la zab par gdams pa'o zhi khro bka' brgyad gsang ba yongasardzogs kyi sgrub r+ṣa las gzhung srong ba'i rim pa rdzogs so ko sam lha rgya rgyas ga kho tsogatad sgo sgo4 blo sa stsi rje ༅ dang god par shog brag gnam skas ro nas gu ru chosakyi dbang phyug gis gter nas ban pa'o dwags /na gyi par nas bshus pa'o:bkra shis////

bkang brgyad yong rdzog kyi zhi ba'i sbyin sreg rigs 'dzin ku9 'dod 'jo/ nang ma zhanabaka' brgyad yongs rdzogs kyi zhi ba'i sbyin sreg rigs 'dzin kun+da'i 'dod 'jo bzhugs so//bka' brgyad kun 'dus rigs 'dzin thod 'phreng rtsal/ /dbyer med zur chen chos dbyings rang grol dang /khyab bdag nyang ston blo mchog rdo rje'i dpal//byang chub bar du rigs kyi bdag por bzhugs//bde gshegs ma lus 'dus ba 'o ma'i mtsho'i//snying po mar gyi nying khu yongs rdzogs zhes//gnam skas klu bdud sto ba'i zab gter gyi//bskyed rdzogs rjo gos chen rnal 'byor rnyed dka'i lam//gang de'i 'phrin las chu gter las 'ongs pa//zhi ba'i sbyin sreg ri dwags mtshan ma can//rnam dpyod shar gyi ri dbang las thon nas//nyes brgya'i smag rum sel 'dir spro dga' byos//de la 'dir skyon gyi mkhan po pad+mā ka ra'i thugs kyi nying khu zhi khro yongs rdzogs kyi 'phrin las ji snyed pa'i nang nasabasreg pa'i sbyor ba ni/rgyud gsang ba 'dus pa las/me yi las kun myur du 'grub ces dang /bde 'dus zhi ba'i sbyin sreg gi rtsab las/sdig pa zhi dang bsod nams 'phel sgrub pa po la phan gdags dang :sngags kyi las rnams bsgrub bya'i phyir sbyin sreg cho ga bshad par bya zhes las bzhi mtha' dag rdzas sngags ting 'dzin gyi kha bsgyur la brten nas gang 'dod du bsgrubs2na sgog pa'i phan yon dpag tu med pa dang ldan pa yin zhing /de rnams kyi nang nas zhi ba'i sbyin sreg gi rim pa nyamasasu bstar ba la/zhi ba'i 'phrin las sgrub pa la shis pa'i gza' skar tshes grangs dus sbyor sogs dang bstun/bde 'dus sreg las/shar du kha ltas khrung po la yid dang mthun pa'i gtor ma sbyin:྅ gi sngags kyis sbyang bar bya zhes dang /phyogs skyong sa yi lha mo dang :sa bdag sogs la mchod pa bya zhes khrung ba ltar/sngon chad ma dul ba'i sa yin na/sgrub chen sogs las 'byung ba ltar sa cho go bya/gnas khang rnying pa sngon nas longs spyod bzhin par 6/sa pa rgyas par byed pa phun sum tshogs pa'i yan

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()lag dang /mi spro na'ang chad lhag tu mi 'gyur zhing /gzhi bgegs la bka' bsgo ba dang /sdebargyad cha snyoms pa'i gser skyems bya/sgrub pa sogs dang 'brel ba'i mtho ma bkrol ba'i nang du byed na de dag gang yang mi dgos so//de yang gnas khang du phyag bdar bya/shin tu gtsang zhing ba po shis pa'i sa la stegs bu brtsigs/steng du thig chen brgyad btab/rgyar lte ba nas mtho gang bskor ba'i dbusasu pad+ma 'dab brgyad kyi lte bar rdo rje rtse lnga pa dang / 2ba ) 'dab ma brgyad la mdun nas brtsams te g.yas skor du gri gug/rtsegasum/be con/dbyug to/ral gri/tho ba/phur pa/lcags kyu rnams rim bzhin 'dri ba'am/bsdun tshom bu 'god/lte ba'i mu khyud nas sor bzhi'i tshad kyi zlum por lan gnyis su bskor ba'i kha khyer la pad 'dab bcu drug/lte ba'i pad+ma'i mu khyud dang /mu ran la rdo rje'i 'phreng ba/phyi'i zur bzhir zla phyed la gnas pa'i rdo rje phyed pa 'dri de'i steng du bud shing ni gsang rdzogs kyi lasabazhi'i sbyin sreg las/byang chub skyer ldeng dug shing sogs las mthun shing brtsigs bsreg pa'i rdzas zhes pa ltar byang chub kyi shing /tswas dkar po/'o ma can gyi shing gi rigs gang rung ngam/bzo dbyibs bde bar byed na 'brog dgon pa'i lci ba skam po srog chags med pa lta bu las grub pa'i thab zlum po rgyar khru gang pa dbangs su de'i phyed pa can brtsigs pa la/thos dkar po'i chus/mar+sā na 'bras dkar ram sa dkar tshig khar lho mtshams su me'i tshang bca' zhing ting lo gzhug/thab dang sgrub pa po'i bar du me yol gangs ri dang sa bon sogs phyogs ma log par bris/thab kyi rgyur bshad pa dang bal bu dkar po gang brnyed gas chag med cing rul ba dang srin 'bus zos pa min pa'i yam shing srid du sor bcu gnyis/sboms su mthe'u chung dang mnyam pa mar dang 'o ma dang sbrang rtsis rtsa rtse gnyis spags shing /bdud rtsi dang tswas dkar po'i chus byugs pa/rang mdog can gyi mar khu sogasadzos chen bcu gnyis rang rdzas kyis sbags shing /'bras dkar rlangs btsos rdzas sna brgyad dang ldan pa'i zas mchog/khyad par gyi rdzas/'bru sna lnga/til dkar/dkar gsum/bil wa/spang rgyan/me tagadakar po/sil/ga pur/ldan sgor dkar/༷dod gsol bris pa'i shing byang rnams dam rdzas

bka' brgyad yong rdzog kyi zhi ba'i sbyin sreg rigs 'dzin kun+da'i 'dod 'jo/ nang ma (ka)lngas sbags pa'i shing byang ma gtogs pa rnams so sor bsham pa'am ril bur dril ba skabs dang sbyar ba'i rdzas rnams/ nya phyis/ dung phor/ rin po che/ khams dkar po'i snod du 'das lha la mang ba dang 'jig rten par nyung ba byas te g.yas su las mthun gyi stan la go rim ma zhabrugs par dgod/rang rdzas dang ldan pa'i 'das ma 'das kyi gtor ma/ mchod yon sngon du 'gro ba'i phyi'i nyer spyod dang nang gi wo spyod sgo gnyis re g.yon du bsgrig /mdun du/ dung chos/ tshe tog /thod rnga /rdo rje/ dgang blugs kha sbyar/ dril bu/ sman raka /ku sha brgyad/ dpal 'bar/ rlung g.yab ri mo can/ so rtsi/ gos zungs sogs yo byad mtha' dag ma tshang ba med par bkod/ de nas sgrub pa po zhi ba'i gar chas sam/ma 'byor na 'khor los mtshan pa'i rgyan mas dkar po gyon/ stan dkar zlum po nang tshangs can sogs kyi steng du pad+ma'i 'dug stangs kyis kha shar du phyogs shing smra ba bcad de sngon du las byang ma grub na gzhung bsrang ba nas tshogos las kyi bar bya/ rdor dril bcangs te da nyid dang rnga byin rlabs lhan thabs ltar dang / gzar bu gnyis brlab pa ni/ rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'bros ye shes kyi lha'i thugs rgyud bskul/ byin rlabs rnams 'od zer gyi tshul du bkug nas gzar bu gnyis la thim ste zhu ba las hūṃ las blugs gzar rdo rje dang / a las dgang gzar dril bu'i rnam pa can yongs su gyur pa las che mchog he ru ka mthing nag rdor dril 'dzin pa dang / gnam zhal sngon mo kha/ dung dmar 'dzin pa snyoms par zhugs pa'i rkyen gyis 'od du zhu nas blugs gzar dang dgang gzar gyi rnam par bsam/sa brjod cing (3bathab dang gnas rdzas thams cad la yungs gar gtor/ gu gul gyis bdug /gsang chu ni/ dri bzang gis gang ba'i dung chos la dmigs te/ a mṛ tas bsangs/ su bhā was sbyangs/stong pa'i ngang las chu'i steng du a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi lte bar a dkar po gsal la 'tsher ba/ de las 'od 'phros/ rgyal ba zhi khro'i lha tshogs rnams kyi byin rlabs bdud rtsi'i rnam par bkug ste a la thim/ de zhu nas chu dang ro gcig tu gyur pas ma dag pa'i dri ma rnams sbyong ba'i nus pa dang ldan par bsam/ ā+oṃ sho dha ni sho dha na ye swāhā/ zhes bzla zhed byin gyis brlab/ gtor ma brlab pa ni/ ā+oṃ —271—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (25)kro ti shwa ri sarba dra bye saṃ sho dha ni hūṃ phaṭa swāhā ā+oṃ āḥ& gis bsangs/ gtor ma'i snod bcud ces pa nas gu tho sa ma ya swāhā'i bar bya/ mchod pa brlab pa ni/ g.yas skor gyis ba 4 chu dang sman phud nas kyang gtor/ a mṛ ta dang ā+oṃ kro ti shwa ri sarba dra bye sogs kyis bsangs/ bdag gi thugs ka'i hūṃ las re yaṃ khaṃ zhes pa nas r+sā pā dzo me gha hūṃ gi bar brjod/ sreg rdzas brlab pa ni/ gong bzhin bsangasasbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du rang rang gi ming yig dang po thig les brgyan pa zhu ba las byung ba'i sreg rdzas rnams dngas shing thogs ba med pa so so'i mtshan nyid yongs su rdzogs shing rang rang gi zhi ba'i las rab 'byams ma lus pa sgrub pa'i nusapa dang ldan par mos la phyag rgya dang bcas te/ ā+oṃ ā+oṃ swāhās rdzas rnams bkru/ ā+oṃ āḥswā hās yam shing / ā+oṃ shrī swāhās mar/ ā+oṃ dzi swāhās 'bru/ ā+oṃ ku ru ku ru swāhās rdzas gzhan rnams brlab/ ā+oṃ āḥ/ 'jigs pa brgyad la sogs pa thams cad shan+ti ku ru swāXzhes nus ldan gyi bdud rtsir bsam mo me sgrub pa ni/ (4na tha thab kyi dbus su raṃ dkar po/ /de las 'od zer sa pas rang bzhin gyi me 'bar bar bsams la/ las sngags brjod cing / gzhung nas khrung ba'i me las sbar ba'i lce lde thal mo sbyar ba'i bar du bzung nas lan gsum bskor ba dang lhan cig par drag sngags so lnga pa lan gsum bzla zhing ting lo sbar ba dang bcas ā+oṃ dz+wa la raṃ dz+wa la raṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa ces brjod cing rto cung zad bcug /bshad ma thag pa'i sngags dang bcas blugs gzar gsum gyis me gso zhing / rlung g.yab cung zad g.yob/ me pra ngan pa byung na bzlog thabs bya/ thab sngar bzhin bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las po las pad+ma dang raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du : las byung ba'i zhi ba'i thab khung zlum po kha khyer la pad 'dab dang mu ran la rdo rje'i 'phreng bas zlum por bskor ba/ phyi rol gyi grwa bzhir zla phyed rdo rjes mtshan pa dngas shing thogs pa med pa paṃ las byung ba'i chu'i dkyil 'khor gyi rang bzhin du gyur pa me 'bar ba'i dbus su/ paṃ las sna tsho gis pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa rdo rje'i 'phreng bas bskor ba'i lte bar raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du raṃ dkar po las 'od 'phros 'dus te —272

bka' brgyad yong rdzog kyi zhi ba'i sbyin sgeg rigs 'dzin ku 8 'dod 'jo/ nang ma (ka)gus gcig tu gyur pa 'od du zhu ba las me lha swā ba ka sku mdog dkar po zhal gsum phyag drug pa gsus pa che ba/ral pa'i thor tshugs bcings pa'i cod pan la rnam par snang mdzad bzhugs pa/sma ra'i ag tshom dang tshangs pa'i skud pa 'phyang ba/phyag dang po gnyis rang 'dra'i shes rab ma la 'byud cing /bar pa gnyis gus dang dbyu gu/tha ma gnyis skyabs sbyin dang bgrang 'phreng bsnams pa/rin po che dkar po'i rgyan dang dar dkar gyi na bza' gsol ba/rwa skyes dkar po'i steng na phyed skyil gyis bzhugs pa/sku'i ba spu'i bu ga nas bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun 'bab cing 4ba ) 'od zer dkar po 'phro ba drang srong gi tsho gos kyis bskor ba'i stol bar ā+oṃ/mgrin par āḥthungs kar hūṃ/de las 'od zer 'phros pas ri rab kyi me mtshams nas me lha drang srong gi tshogs kyis bskor ba badz+ra sa mā dzaḥrdo rje bsdu ba'i phyag rgya bya zhing / rtsegasum gyi phyag rgyas g.yabs te/ hūṃ/ dad pa dang ni dam tshig gis tshur gshegs tshur gshegs drang srong mchog rang gi dam tshig tshul bzhin du 'bar ba'i nang du gshegs su gsol e sa hi asna ye de ba sam ya hoḥsam ya sto/zhes dam tshig pa la ye shes pa bstim/gzi brjid 'bar ba me yi lha 'dod pa thams cad sgrub mdzad cing :thugs rje zhi ba'i don mdzad pa 'bar ba'i nang 'dir bzhugs su gsol rtswa byu ye de wa pad+ma ka ma la sam ya skye zhes gdan 'bul/hūṃ/me lha'i rgyal bo drang srong mchog:zhi ba'i don la dam tshig dgongs gzi brjid che zhing thugs rjer ldan bdag cag gus pas khyod phyag 'tshal/rtswa asna ye de ba a ti bu ho bra ti dz+ra ho zhesaphyag bya/hūṃ/rang gi snying ga nas 'phros 'od zer gyis//phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas rnams kyi thugs rgyud bskul gsol ba btab pas byang chub sems kyi chus//gang ba'i bum pa thogs pa'i lha mo'i tshogs//dbag med thugs las spros te nam mkhar byon//bkra shis glu len khrus gsol dbang bskur gyur/hūṃ/a gli'i sku la nyen mongs mi mnga' yang :bdag gi mi mthun phyogs rnams sbyang slad du sku gsung thugs la khrus chab 'di gsol bas mi gtsang skyon gyi dri ma dag gyur cig lha badz+ra.asna ye de wa bra wa ra sa t+pa raṃ bra ti ༷ ཿswāhā/zhes / bzang gi chus bzed zhal du me long la sku khrus

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (25)gsol/ slar yang lha mo rnams kyis legs thogs pa'i/ /rin chen sna tsho gos rgyan gyis brgyan (ldan)par gyur/ /ces rgyan dbul/ hūṃ/ lo ka 'di dang gzhan dag na a lha ji snyed yod pa kun asni'i sku la mchod par 'bul zhi ba'i don du bzhes su gsol swo asna ye de wa a ha ra ji pā dza me gha sa mu dra snya ra ṇa sam ya hūṃ/ hūṃ/ lo gas/ /bdug spos ྾/ /a gri'i shangs ྾/ /zhi ba'i don ྾/ /ā+oṃ asna ye de ba a ha ra lci pe ྾/ /thog mtha'i tshig rkang gnyis po gong ltar la bdug spos kyi gnas su me rta go /snang gsal/ dri chab/ zhal zlas/ sil snyan dang / shangs kyi tshab tu dbu/ spyan/ thugs/ zhal/snyan/ sgru pe'i gnas su ri ā lo ke /ga rnye/ ni bi te/ shabha rnams bcug ste 'bul/ hūṃ/ ting 'dzin dbang sgyur zhal zas bdud rtsi lnga drang srong chen pos sngon chad ma bstar ba'i dag cing gtsang mar sbyar ba 'bul lags kyi: thugs rje chen pos dgongs te bzhes su gsol chu badz+ra kro ta 'i u sna ye de ba pā dza khā snyi sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta khā snyi mahā ba kla ta khā zhi ma hā rak+ta khā two zhes phyi nang gi mchod pa bya/ hūṃ/ gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya chos/ /'dod yon mi zad nam mkha' mdzod/ /longs spyod tshogs kyi mchod pa 'di/ /me lha 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ /ā+oṃ badz+ra kro ta ཿ ye ga na tsakra pā dza khā hisatshogs nas kyang 'bul/ hūṃ/ gzi brjid chen po me yi lha 'dod pa thams cad gsal mdzad pa'i zhi ba'i don grub pa la zhugs: 'dzin byed me lha nyid la rnam par 'dud ces bstod/ bde 'dus zhi ba'i sbyin sreg rtsa ba las/ thabs kyi kho ra khor yug sa ku sha'i rtse mo phyir la bstan zhes pa ltar/ku sha'i sa po brgyad po g.yon du bzung / sngar bzhin bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang lasa3 las byung ba'i ku sha sngo ljang rtsa rtse ma nyams pa dang sa (5ba〉ning thogs pa med pa zhi ba'i las rab 'byams sgrub pa'i nus pa dang ldan par bsams la/ ku sha 'di ni gtsang zhing dge /sa las skyes pa'i snying po mchog /dkon mchog gsum gyis dag byed de/ /tshangs pa yis kyang dag byed yin/ /'di yis bdag la bgegs med cing / /las kyi dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /badz+ra satwa a/ zhes ku sha rnams rtse mo chosaskor du bstan te phyi ma'i rtsa bas snga ma'i rtse non par dgram/ byon zan 'bul ba ni/ me lha'i zhal 'dzum —274

spus bas yong rdzog kyi zhi ba'i na sreg rig lon ku' 'dod 'jo/ nang ma(ka)zhing cung zad gdangs pa'i lce hūṃ las rdo rje rtse lnga pa hūṃ dang /dgang blugs kyi rtse kha raṃ yig gis mtshan par mos nas/ā+oṃ asne ye swāhā/brjod cing blugs gzar bdun gyis dgang gzar bkang la lag gnyis pus mo'i khong las mi 'da' bas rdo rje khu tshur ram byang chub mchog gi phyag rgyas gzar bu gnyis kha sbyar te g.yas su skor zhing /ā+oṃ asna ye de wa na ma mi man+ta bud+dhā rna purba gi sgyi mas ā+oṃ āḥ//bdag cag gi ting 'dzin gsal zhing sngags chad lhag gi nyes pa dang nad gdon sdig sgrib mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad shan+ti ku ru swāhā/zhes lan gsum gyis 'bul/skabs 'dir yang me bra brtag cing ga na srung ba byed/hūṃ/me lha'i thugs nas 'od los bas//bsgrub bya'i nad gdon sdig sgrib sogs//mi mthun phyogs kun dud khu dang /zhag khrag srog chags gzugs brnyan tshul//ba skru'i pug thams ro nas//phyir thon sreg rdzas rnams la thim//zhes brjod cing de nas/hūṃ/asdi de ba me yi lha 'dod pa'i don rnams rab sgrub cing :thugs rjes zhi ba'i las mdzad pa sbyin sreg mchod ba bzhes su gsol tshe dpal bsod nams stobs 'byor dang //lung rtogs chos srid legs tshogisal//bar du gcod pa'i gdon bgegs dgra//gto sel mnan dbye rbod zhabatonge byad/dbulaphongs na da rims dus min 'chi//sdig sgrib nyes ltung ji snyed pa//ma lus byang zhing dgatso ra ba'i//zhi ba'i 'phrin las dus la bab//ces brjod de/mar khu ni/ā+oṃ byu ye de wa na ma rnaman+ta bus nai pu rba hriḥrdzi mas ā+oṃ āḥ//bdag cag gis ting nge 'dzin mi gsal zhing sngags chad lhag gi nyes pa dang 'byor pa phun sum tsho gis pa la bar du gcod pa sogs nad gdon sdig sgrib mi mthun pa'i phyogasathams cad shan+ti ku ru swāhā/zhes pa thog mtha' gnyis su ji ltar 'os pa dang rdzas sngags rkyang pasabadun nam nyer gcig sogs mang nyung skabs dang bstun te 'bul/bsnyen pa kha skong gi spel tshig dod la las gak+ṣ-i na gyis kha bsgyur gang dgos zhal shes ltar bya/sreg rdzas kyi snod lag pa g.yon pas bzung /g.yas pa'i mtheb srin gyis blangs te 'og nas skor zhing mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgyas yam shing ni sngags ring gong ltar la/ā+oṃ badz+ra yu dzñā ya/'byor pa'i gnas su gzi brjid phun sum tshogs

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (25)ba la zhes 'a lcag dgos pa kun la rig pas dpag /sob ni/ oṃ badz+ra bi dzā ya/ nor dang 'bru phun sum tshogs pa la/ sran ma ni/ ā+oṃ badz+ra mahā ba wā ya/ stobs phun sum tshogs pa la/ til mi/ ā+oṃ sarba pā paṃ da ha na badzā ya/ dge ba phun sum tsho gos pa la/ 'bras ni/ ā+oṃ badz+ra pu gi ye/ bsod nams phun sum tsho gis pa la/ nas ni/ ā+oṃ badz+ra ma hā be gā ya/ shugs phun sum tshogs pa la/ zho zan ni/ ā+oṃ badz+ra sgyu /bha de/ bde ba phun sum tsho gis pa la/ gro ni/ ā+oṃ badz+ra gha sma re/ rims med pa phun sum tsho gos ba la/ ku sha ni/ ā+oṃ a bra ti ha ha ta badzā ya/ srung ba phun sum tsho gos pa la/ du rba ni/ ā+oṃ badz+ra ā yu she/tshe phun sum tsho gos pa la/ byang chub shing ni/ ā+oṃ (6ba tha dz+ra bo dhi brik+ta ya/ nyams rtogs phun sum tshogasapa la/ mngar gsum ni/ ā+oṃ badz+ra ma le bu stu ya/ mos pa phun sum tshogs pa la/ sman sna tshogs ni/ ā+oṃ badz+ra ma hā shri me pa ta ye/ nad med pa phun sum tshogs pa la/ shing tog sna tsho gos ni/ ā+oṃ badz+ra ma hā sho pa le/ rigs brgyud phun sum tsho gos pa la/ 'bru mar ni/ ā+oṃ badz+ra tshe tā ya/ sa nya gyi yon tan phun sum tsho gos pa la/ khyad par gyi rdzas spyi rnams/ ā+oṃ a sna ye de wa na maḥs man+ta bud+dhā ni purba rmi rdzi mas ā+oṃ āḥ// bdag cag gis ting 'dzin mi gsal zhing sngags chad lhag gi nyes pa dang nad gdon sdig sgrib mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad shan+ti ku ru swāhā dang / byang bu ni sngags gong bzhin la/ bdag cag la bar du gcod ba'i me'i 'jigs pa dang / chu'i 'jigs pa dang / nad kyi 'jigs pa dang / mu ge'i 'jigs pa dang / pha rol dmag tsho gos kyi ྾/ gdon gyi ྾/ mtshon gyi ྾/ dus ma yin par 'a mi ba'i 'jigs pa brgyad po shan+ti ku ru swāhā/ zhes pas grangs sngar ltar 'bul/ hūṃ/ sreg rdzas mchode bas me yi lha/ /mnyes te sku las 'od zer 'phros/ /bsgrub bya'i snying gar phog pa yis/ /slar yang sgo gsum sdig sgrib bsregs/ /'od zer bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun ltar/ /babs pas nad gdon sdig sgrib sogs/ /mi mthun phyogs rnams rab bkrus te/ /bshang gci'i sgo nas thon par gyur/ /ces brjod/ā+oṃ asna ye de ba badz+ra a lha lha pe nas shabha'i bar gyis mchod/ bstod pas bstod/ bcom ldan 'dasadus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs ye shes me'i bdag nyid 'byung ba chen po —276

bka' brgyad yongs rdzog kyi zhi ba'i sbyin zeg rigs 'dzin ku 8 'dod 'jo/ nang ma (ka)me'i rang bzhin asno chen po khyed kyis bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi skye ba 'di dang brgyud mar bde zhing skyid pa dang / mthar thug khyab bdag kun bzang he ru ga'i go 'phang thob pa la bar du gcod pa'i nad rims (7na po don bgegs dgra dpung mthu byad dbul phongs 'thab rtsod dus min 'chi ba sdig sgrib nyes lhung mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad dz+wa la raṃ shan+ti ku ru swāhā/ mchod rdzas rnams lha tsho gos rnams kyi zhal du stob pa'i 'phrin las mdzad du gsol cesagasol ba btab/ mar blugs gzar gang thab tu blug la drag sngags so lnga pa'i mthar/ badz+ra tha la raṃ zhes brjod pas me lha me de nyid la thim nas me 'bar ba'i rnam pa can du bsam mo /'jig rten las 'das pa'i me lha mchod pa ni/ ye shes me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus/ /: las ye shes gzhal yas khang : nas/ kwa ya wā ka tsit+ta dzñā na pañtsa badz+ra su bhā wa āt+pa ko3lha zhes pa'i bar las byang ltar bya/ de yang / rgyu yi yi ge gdan la babs: zhes pa/ gdan steng rgyu yig hūṃ mthing nag dang /bdag nyid che mchod he ru ga ni/ che ba'i che mchog he ru ga: zhes par bsgyur/ gtso 'khor kun kyang sku mdog rtsa ba'i zhal/ /rab dkar zhi ma khro yi 'grum mdangs can/ /dkar la 'tsher ba'i 'od zer 'phro ba yi/ /zhi ba'i las kun mdzad pa'i rnam par gyur/ /hūṃ/ bdag cag dad dang dam tshig gis:tshur gshegs tshur gshegs yongs rdzogs lha zhi ba'i 'phrin go ri slad du sbyin sreg 'bul ba'i gnas 'dir sbyon ye khyu ha ma hā shrī he ru ka cha ru lu ru lu ma hā ka ru ṇi ka tri sha ho dzaḥ& baṃ sngos spyan drangs la bstim/ hūṃ/ 'bar ba'i rgyal po dbang gi tshogs zhi ba'i 'phrin las rab tu bsgrub thugs rjes 'gro ba kun don phyir zhi ba'i gzhal yas gnas 'dir bzhugs sam ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan gyis bzhugs su gsol/ hūṃ/ me yi rgyal bo zhi khro'i tshogs stobs dang mthu byin bsam mi khyab yid bzhin re skong lha tsho gis la sgo gsum dad pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /a ti pu hoḥpra ti dza hoḥs phyag bya/ hūṃ/ rang gi snying ga (7bskos sa 'od zer gyis/ /zhes pa nas/ bkra shis5len khrusagasol dbang bskur gyur/ /gyi bar brjod/ hūṃ/ ye shes sku la dri ma med khrus gtsang mchod gsol —277

rgyal dang lnga pa ngag dbang blo r+sāng rgya mdzo gsung 'bum/ (2)mi 'tshal yang :'gro rnams nyone mongs sbyang slad du khrus gtsang 'di gsol sgrib sbyang shog zho bra wa ra sa t+pa raṃ pra ti ༷ ཿswāhās khrus gsol/slar yang lha mo zhes pa'i tshig rkang gnyis kyis rgyan dbul/hūṃ/lo ka khams ni thams cad du me rtag bdug spos mar me dang :dri chab zhal zas skul snyan sgra lha rdzas tso gyis yongs su mar rtswa badz+ra/ pe pā dza me gha sa mu dra lpa ra ṇa sam ya hūṃ zhes pa nas rdi pā dza me gha sa mu dra ྅ ra ṇa sam ya hūṃ gi bar gyis phyi ma rdzo 'bul/hūṃ/dri ོ dri chu byang chub sems sha wo pad+ma rak+ta dang :dbang po rnam lnga tso wo me khyad par lo byung kun gyis ma rdzo:ma hā sarba gu tsa ho//ye shes mchog gi dkyil 'khore mchog:gsal ba gzi byin 'bar ba la zhi ba'i 'phrin las sgrub pa'i phyir zhi khro'i tsho gos la nang rdzas 'bul mahā pañtsa a mṛ ta kha raṃ khā stim hā ba kla ta kha raṃ khā stim hā rak+ta kha raṃ khā hi khā gis nang gi mchod pa 'bul/hūṃ/bla med mchog gi mchod sbyar bas sogs kyis tshogis nas kyang dbul/zhi khro spyi dril gyis bstod/byon zan 'bul ba ni/me shesapa'i lha tsho gos rnams kyi zhal 'dzum zhing cud zad gdangs pa'i ljagasa3 las rdo rje rtse lnga par hūṃ dang dgang blugs kyi rtse la raṃ yig gis mtshan par mos nas phyag rgya sogs sngar ji bzhin pas drag sngags so lnga pa bdun brjod cing blugs gzar bdun gyis dgang gzar 'geng ba sogs me lha'i skabs ltar byas te/ā+oṃ asna ye de ba na maḥs man+ta nas bzung ste nad gdon sdig sgrib mi mthun ba'i phyogs thams cad shan+ti ku ru swāhā'i bar gyis sngar ltar lan sha po sum 'bul/me lha'i thugs nas 'od 'phros pas//zhes pa'i rkang pa dang po/'das lha'i thugs nas zhes par bsgyur te sgo bar bya/thog mar che mchog la/hūṃ/ye shes klong yangs 'khyil ba'i hong khung 'dir dam rdzas bdud rtsi 'bar ba'i sbyin sreg 'di che mchog yongs rdzogs lha la mchod pa 'bul 'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa'i phun tshogs la//gnod byed dgra bgegs gnod byed nad rims byur//dbul phongs skal ngan skeg sri dus min 'chi//chags che nyam nga nyes lhung sdig sgrib kun//zhi ba'i 'phrin las myur du sgrub par mdzod ca badz+ra kro ta ma hā shrī he ru ka 0 ye de ba nas bzung sde nad /don sdig sgrib mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad

bas bas yongs rdzog kyi zhi ba'i sbyin sgeg rig lon ku' 'dod 'jo/ nang ma (ka)shan+ti ku ru swāhā/zhes 'jig rten pa'i skabs bzhin mar 'bul/yam shing man chad la lha sngags kyi rjes su asni de wa bor nas na maḥs man+ta man btags te rdzas sngags sogs dang sbyar nas 'bul lugs sngar dang 'dra/ye shes pa'i skabs 'dir bsnyen pa kha skong gi sbyin sreg la rdzas sngags gcig la brten nas stong khri sogs skabs dang bstun te 'bul ba phyag len ltar byed/de bzhin du dmigs bsal gyi las gang sgrub 'dod ba de ga'i rdzas sngags la chig:la du bya ba'ang phyag len las shes par bya'o//de nas yang dag sogs bka' gzhan rnams la gong gi blo ka gnyis po'i tshig rkang gsum pa yang dag yongs rdzogs lha la mchod bar 'bul/de bzhin du gshin rje yongs rdzogs/dbang chen yongs rdzogs/phur pa yongs rdzogs/ma mo yongs rdzogos/rigs 'dzin yongs rdzogos/'jig rten yongs rdzogs/drag sngags yongs rdzogs su bsgyur zhing /gter gzhung du mi gsal yang dpal gyi bga' srung rnams la'ang 'bul bar 'thad pas pho nya yongs rdzogs zhes kyang bya/che mchog gi sngagasakyi tshab tu/ā+oṃ ru lu ru lu hūṃ bh+yo hūṃ phaṭa ci〉〉 a kro te g.ya man ta ka ha na ma tha bhan dza hūṃ phaṭa ā+oṃ pa〉sna kṛ ta ma hā kro ta ha ya gi wa hu lu hu lu hūṃ phaṭa rtswa badz+ra ki li ki lwa ya sarba bisna rna baṃ hūṃ phaṭa:ā+oṃ sme ༅ dzñā na shrī he ru ka gu ༅ dzñā na kro dhi shwa ri ra ma ma yo gi ni ru lu ru lu hūṃ bh+yo hūṃ phaṭa:chu badz+ra ma hā gu ru sarba hūṃ phaṭa 6 badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa sarba dus hūṃ phaṭa chu badz+ra dus ye dza bh+yo hūṃ phaṭa khro ga ru ḍa hūṃ phaṭa sarba ḍā gi ni sam ya hri hri hūṃ phaṭaḥces pa rnams bcug ste rdzas chen bco lnga dang khyad par gyi rdzas rnams bdun nam nyer gcig tsam dang /dmigs bsal gyi rdzas che mchog gi bstocha 'bul/yang rdzas nyung ba dang long chung ba sogs kyi skabs bsdus par 'dod na/yang dag gshin rje rta mgrin phur pa dang //mngon rdzogs rigs 'dzin dregs pa stobs ldan nag/dpal gyi bka' srung bcas la mchod par 'bul//zhes bar gyi tshig rkang gcig po tshig rkang gsum du btang nas so so'i lha sngagasadrag sngags so lnga bas go bcad de gong ltar bya/sreg rdzas mchod pas me yi lha//zhes pa'i tshig rkang dang po/sreg rdzas mar pas me shes ltar ba/ra nas rdzogs par brjod/sngar byon zan gyi dus

rgyal dbang lnga pa ga dang blo bzang rgya mtshogasung 'bum/ ()ltar dgang blugs bdun tshan gsum gshegs skyems su 'bul/hūṃ/lo /khams ni thams cad du:zhes pa nas ma hā rak+ta zhes pa'i bar gyis phyi nang gi mchod pa gong bzhin 'bul/gtor ma las byang gi lhan thabs ltar byin gyis brlabs/dam rdzas med byung gtor chen no zhes so gos kyis 'bul/sgortsi ni/ā+oṃ badz+ra ta'i la ye swāhā dang /gos zungs ni/ā+oṃ badz+ra wasta ye swā hās dbul/bar+sā pa ni rgyasapar spro na drug bstod r+ṣa mo dang /bsdun zhi khro spyi dril gyis bstod/de nas 'dod don la gsol ba gdab pa ni/mkhyen brtse nus mnga' sgrub pa bka' brgyad lhas/bstan pa rgyas dang de 'dzin tshogasarnams9na ) kyi//sku tshe 'phrin las skye dgu'i bde skyid la//bar du gcod pa thams cad zhi mdzad gsol/khyad bar rigs 'dzin bdag cag dpon slob dang //yon ma rdzo 'khor dang bcas pa ma lus pa'i//sngon las 'phral rkyen las byung dgra bgegs gdon//nad rims dbul phongs 'thab rtsod ྾//phyi nang drang srong dmod pa mas byad dang //byur dang skal ga mi shis dus zhi waṃ//sgeg sri langs sogs chags che nyam nga ba'i//'gal rkyen bar gcod thams cad ྾//'phrin las chad lhag dam dzos ma tshang nyams//bsnyen sgrub g.yel zhing dus kyi mchod pa chag/ting 'dzin mi gsal gsang sngags sgra nyams sogs//sdig sgrib nyes lhung ma lus mo//tshe dpal stobs wor dbang phyug phun sum tshogs//lung dang mngon par rtogs pa'i yon tan sogs//'khor 'das dngos grub kun dang khyad par du//dpal chen kun bzang tshe 'dir mngon gyur mdzod/zhes 'dod don gsol gdab bya/he ru spu'i yig brgya lan gsum gyis lhag chad kha bkang //ho/bde gshegs yongs rdzogs ma lus la sbyin sreg mchod pa 'di 'bul gyi bdag gis 'gal zhabrul ci byas pa de dag thams cad bzod par gsol nyams chags sdig sgrib thams cad shan+ti ku ru swā1zhes nongs pa bzod par gsol/ho/ bde gshegs rgyal ba khyed rnams kyis 'phrin las zhi ba'i las kun mdzad sbyin sreg mchod pa 'di phul bas grub pa'i gos stsal ci bder gshegs sko badz+ra mu ye shes pa rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs/ dam tshig pa me'i rnam par bsdum/ hūṃ/ sangs rgyas kun gyi sku gsung thugs

bka' bas yongs rdzog kyi zhi ba'i sbyin sreg rigs 'dzin ku' 'dod 'jo/ nang ma (ka)zhes sogs las bzhi'i nang tshan gyi zhi ba'i bro zlum por brdung ba las byang ltar bya/slar yang 'jig rten pa'i me lha mchod pa ni/ā+oṃ 9ba ) a sna ye dz+wa la raṃ zhes brjod cing mar blugs gzar gang phul ba'i rkyen gyis/me lha me 'bar ba'i rnam pa las skad cig gis rang gzugs su bzhengs par bsams la/hūṃ/lo ka 'di dang gzhan dag na:zhes pa nas/'dzin byed me lha nyid la rnam par 'dud kyi bar gyis mchode bstod bya/hūṃ byu de ba me yi lha zhes pa nas khyad bar ba'i rdzas yan sngar bzhin dang gshegs skyems su dgang blugs bdun phywa gsum byon zan ltar 'bul zhing /so rtsi dang gos zungs ni ta'i la dang wa sdus dkyus bzhin dbul/gtor ma 'das gtor ltar brlabs te/ā+oṃ asna me de ba sa pa ri wā ra ma hā ba li ta pā dza khā hi/zhes lan gsum gyis 'bul/mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes las//zhes pa nas yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog gi bar brjod/bcom ldan 'dasadus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa sogs kyis 'dod don la gsol ba gdab/( me de ba a nas shabha'i bar gyis mchode/yig brgya dang ma 'byor ba sogs kyis bzod par gsol/bdagagi don dang gzhan gyi don//byin za khyod kyis bsgrubs kyi gshegs//ji bzhin dus su tshur spyon zhig/bdag gi dngos grub thams cad sgrubs//ā+oṃ asna ye ya hi la shes pa rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs//dam tshig pa me'i rnam par gyur pa slar yang 'das ma 'das kyi dam tshig pa gnyis su med pa tshom bu dgu'i rnam par gyur pa'i byang shar gyi lha tshogs rnams 'od du zhu nas nub byang gi lha tshogasal thim/de bzhin du mtshams gsum po yang g.yon skor du 'od kyi rnam par zhu nas phur pa'i lha tshogasal thim/phyogs rnams kyang g.yon skor gyis gtso bo la thim/de yang hūṃ la thim rim bzhin zhabs kyu'i ha/ha zla tshes/de thig le/thig le stong pa rang sems skye med kyi klong du bsam/bsngo ba smon lam bkra shisabya zhing phyogs10na yin tu me rtag gi char dbab/rgyun gyi spyod lam la 'jug go/sbrel nas byed na byas zin pa'i shul gyi thal ba ma dkrugs par cung zad bcags ba'i steng du yong kong brtsigs nasaphyag bzhes dkyus bzhin nyams su len/me ma shi ༷ra du bskul skyod mi bya zhing /gal te yul dus kyis

rgyal dbang lnga pa ga dbang blo r+sāng rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2)rtsol las sna ba dgos yod na 'o ma so gos kyis gzhil bar bya/thal ba ni chu bo ོ por dor bas de 'thung ba'i sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib 'byang bar 'gyur la/dgos pa skabs don la longs spyod pa'i ched du tshags bya bar yang nyes pa med do//thab kyi nye 'khor kun tu dri bzang po byugs shing lasakyi rjes mi mngon par bya ba ni gsang sngags spyi'i phyag len ltar ro//zhi khro yongs rdzogs 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor lha//sreg blugs mchod bas 'khor 'das nyes brgya'i mun//bsangs byed zhi ba'i 'phrin las 'od dkar can//rigs 'dzin kun+da'i 'dod 'jo deng 'dir shar//gsang rdzogs gter gzhung bum bzang kha rgyan du//nyang ral rgod kyi ldem phru'i gter ma sogs//sngar 'gyur ring lugs kusha'i sa po las//gsar dad rma bya'i mdongs kyis brgyan pa min//ga kho byon rdo rje'i tshig rnams 'khrul med bkod//'thor dngag ba zhabrugs bas shing mdzo du phyungs//rigs 'dzin brgyud pa'i dmar khrid phyag bzhes kyis//brgyan 'di mkhas rnams dga' ba skyed pa'i gnas//skye mang rnying bstan la sbyangs snyan grags dang //sngags brgyud rigs kyi bsnyems pa ches mang yang //smin grol gdamasapa'i gong la bcur ba na//rngul chu'i thigs pa 'gram par 'phyang ba mang //stong 'ur cher rlom rnamasakyi mun pa'i mda'//rtog ge'i rtsal bshad tshig gi dbu ba'i 'phreng /khyun med 'chad tī nyams su len pa sogs//yang dag bstan pa'i bgrang byar 'os pa min//de phyir rnyed dka'i dal ba don ldan du//sgrub 'dod blo yis rab 'bad rdo rje 10ba〉'ang //yongs yon gzugs su byon rnamasabasten pa'i mthus//theg mchog dgongs don smra ba'i spobs pa thob//grags 'dod kun slong ga pas dbye na bcos te//nyon mo mes du gdang 'dres pa'i brtsams chos dag/ma yin theg pa mchog 'di'i rigs sad pa'i//blo gsal skal bzang mang por phan phyir bkod//kun+da ltar dkar dge tshogs gaṅgā'i rgyun//mkha' mnyam skye dgu'i nyon mongs dri ma kun//sbyangs te rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa yi//mi zad rgya mtsho'i klong du rog ṇi ga shog zhes klu bdud sto ba'i zla ba gter zhi khro gsang ba yongs rdzogs kyi zhi ba'i sbyin sreg rigs 'dzin kun+da'i ༷dod 'jo zhes bya ba 'di ni dpang ston rig sngags

bka' brgyad gsang rdzog kyi bri thang 'dra ba'i gas lo byed gsang gsum mi zad rgyan 'khor/ nang ma tana'achang ba blo bzang ngag dbang /dge slong 'jam dbyangs grags pa gnyis kyis zhi khro yongs rdzogs kyi bsnyen chen dang dga' gdong sngags rams pa don grub rgya mtshos byang gter phur pa lha nag gi bsnyen chen btang ba'i dus kha stong du nye bar mkho ba'i sbyin sreg ngag 'don zhig dgos zhes bskul bas mtshams sbyar/zab chos 'di nyid nyams su len pa'i blo ldan mang por phan pa'i phyir lhag bsam gyis kun nas blangs te gter kha 'di nyid kyi sbyin sreg spyi sgrub chen mo dang /zhi ba'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga ma 'dres yongs rdzogs gnyis la gzhi byas/bka' brgyad bde 'dus dang byang gter sogs snga 'gyur rang lugs kyi yi ge rnams nas kha 'geng dgos pa rnams bkang /cung zad mi gsal ba'i tshig phrad sogs med du mi rung ba rnams kun mkhyen rdo rje gdan pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug gi sbyin sreg la zhib mor dpyad nas mdzes rgyan du byas te zur thams cad mkhyen pa dang khyab bdag khra tshang pa so gos yongs 'dzin dam pa chos bzhin du spyod pa du ma'i bka' drin las theg pa mchog gi tshul la blo gros kyi snang ba rgyas pa'i za hor gyi rig sngags yong ba che mchog 'dus pa rtsal gyis pho brang po ta lar sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni gnas ban 'jam dbyangs so//sarba maṅga lo//bka' brgyad gsang rdzogs kyi bris thang 'dri ba'i gsal byed gsang gsum mi zad rgyan 'khor zhes bya ba bzhugs/che mchog ni/brag ri'i steng du 'khor lo/seng ge/glang chen/stag gzig /ma he/dom/chu srin/sprul rnams kyis bteg pa'i sna tsho gos pad+ma zla ba bris dper nyi gdan la gser gyi rdzem bri bog pa thalas pas li phri rang mdog gi thus/nyi ma/de'i steng du dbang phyug sngon bo/u ma dmar mo/gnyis ka'ang zhi ma khro'i rnam pa dar gyi stod g.yogs smad g.yogs rin po che dang sbrul rgyan sogs yod pa bsnol ba'i steng du che mchog zhal gsum phyag drug zhabaXbazhi pa/g.yas dkar g.yon dmar dbus mthing

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtshogasung 'bum/ smyonab/dbu skra kham nag gyen du brdzes pa/rin po tsho brog zhu dang tsos pa'i thod skam lnga'i dbu rgyan sbrul dkar bris dper ho gyi thag thod skam kyi sa thag gam gdan ma gser li rdzi sogs kyi byas po bris dpe rā yong gi 'dun pa spyo kho bya chog pa2gas /pa la brgyus pa/thod skam gyi kha nas rus pa'i dra ba bridaper ga dra phyed 'phyang ba/snyan gnyis kyi gong du bri po per ra āt+pal sngon po res mas ba/zhal gdangs ljagasa'agril mtsheb gtsigs/spyan gsum sdang mig tu bgrad pa/smin ma ag tshom ser po gyen du 'khyil ba/phyag g.yasa'i snyun mas lon/dang po rdo rje rtse dgu dang g.yon pas ban dha lcang lo phywa khrag gis 2na skong ba thugs ka steng 'og tu bzung nas yum la 'khyud pa/g.yas bar pas rdo rje rtse lnga/tha phyags ma/mas rdo rje rtse gsum pa/g.yon bar pas thod tho lcang lo mā dmar gyis gang ba/tha mas skra med thod skam khrag gis gang ba bsnams pa/bris dpe 'dir/phyag drug gi phyag gzha 0na tso rnams phyag mdun kyi rim pa 'dri ba la/ sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes gsum las/ /dang por skyabs sems tshogs zhing mtshams/ /bshags pa brda sgo dbye phyag 'tshal/ /dam byin mchod brlab bcu yi khrigs/ /de yang rgyud dang (2bskom pa'i zhal lung las byung ba'i mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i gnas bkra shis shing yid du 'ong bar chu gnyis sngon du 'gro ba li: nang gi nyer spyod rol mo sman raka gtor bdag chen sngags 'chang r+pā po tso dga' rin cen pas gtor ma zlum po stod sum gnyis la dpal btod pa zhes gsung pa tarnya he ru ka gal po'i rgyud las/ gtor ma dkar po zlum po ni/ /'di ni zhi ba'i gtor ma la/ /gtor ma gru bzhi ser po ni/ /rgyas pa'i gtor ma yin par bshad/ /gtor ma dmar po zla gam ni/ /dbang gi gtor ma yin par bshad/ /gtor mnag po gru gsum ni// drag po'i las la rab tu shis zhes la sgrub tshul gyi dbang gis gtore ma la mtha' gcig tu nges pa med cing drag po la yang gru gsum dang snying bzo sogs rnam grangs mang ba'i gsang sngags rnying mar dpal bzhos dregs bgos rtsa bas 'byed ces yang phur sogs sgrub sdo brgyad kyi gtor ma rnams dpal bshos su mdzad pa yongs su grags pa gtor zlum la dpal 'don lugs kyi gti thug khrigs de 'dra ci dgos/ de ltar na snod kyi nang du phye la chu sdug lugs sogs kyang dgos pa 'dra/ rak+ta la gri khrag dang rang byung gi khrag sogs dgo par bshad mod/ chang la sha btab pa'i rak+ta de 'dra gsang sngags rnying ma rnam la ni ma grags shing gsar ma phyogs la de 'dra'i rnam gzhag 'ong don yang med pas 'ang ma dpal 'khon gyi gdung brgyud dri ma med pa rnams kyi zhabs la thag pa mi 'dogs pa gu gsum sogs mkho ba'i yo byad rnams ma ga par 'du byas/ dang po dkon cog skyabs 'gro ba/ /bklags pas don grub las/ bdag dang 'gro ba khams gsum nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad/ phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung —292

sangs rgyas thams cad dang mnyam par sbyor ba dpal yang dag zla gam dgu pa'i mun las kyi rgyud don snang byed/ nang ma (ka)thugs yon tan 'phrin las thams cad kyi ngo bo chos kyi phung po stong phrag brgyad cu rtsa bzhi'i 'byung gnas/'phags pa'i dge 'dun thams cad kyi mnga' bdag rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan ldan ) bla ma dam pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o//sangs rgyas la skyabs su mchi'o//chos la skyabs su mchi'o//dge 'dun la skyabs su mchi'o//lan gsum sogs long skabs dang bstun te ji ltar rigs pa brjod nas skyabs yul rnams rang la bsdus te spros bral gnyis med ka dag gi klong du rang babs su bzhag go/gnyis pa sman 'jug sems bskyed pa//dpal khrag 'thung gal po che'i rgyud las//bde gshegs sems kyi snying bo las//ma rtogasa'akhor ba'i sems can rnams//sangs rgyas sa la 'god pa'i phyir//byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed do//zhes pa ci rigs pa brjod cing de don yid la nan to du bsam/gsum pa bsod nams tshogs gsog pa//rang nyid rdo rje khrag 'thung du gsal ba'i thugs ga'i hūṃ las 'od zer los pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas rtsa ba'i bla ma badz+ra he ru ga'i rnam pa la phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs ma tshang ba med pas bskor te mkha' khyab kyi 'khor lor bzhugs pa thams cad oṃ badz+ra rdo rje bsdu shā phyag rgya dang tsos sa mā dzaḥs spyan drangs/rnying ma bka' mar grags che ba'i mthar bklags pas don grub tu tshad med tshigs bcad btags pa ni/rdo rje slob dpon sangs rgyas dpal//dus gsum bzhugs la phyag 'tshal lo//mchog gsum rten pa'i zhing gyur la//gnyis med yid kyis skyabs su mchi//dngos wor yid kyis rnam sprul pa'i//dag pa'i mchod pa bzhes su gsol//dngos grub chu bo gcod pa'i gegs//nyes byas ma lus bshags par bgyi//phyogs bcu 'khor gsum dag pa'i chos//ma chags spyod la rjes yi rang //dag 3ba ) pa'i mtha' bzhi dri ma med//rdzogs pa'i byang chub sems bskyed do//bde gshegs byang chub sems dpa' la//dgos pa gsum gyi lus dbul lo//tshe rabs bgrangs pa'i las rnams kun//bsdus te byang chub chen por bsngo//sems can bde dang ldan gyur cig/sdug bsngal dag dang bral bar shog9/bde dang rtag tu mi 'bral zhing //chos kun mnyam

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (25)nyid rtogs par shog /ces bdun rnam dag dang tshad med bzhi bsgom/ /bzhi pa mtshams gcod bsrung ba'i gur/ /sngags dang tshigs bcad rnams rgyud dang lhug pa dang phyag rgya bklags pas don grub kyi don 'khyer bder sbyar ba ni/ oṃ ༅gas pas don grub tu ye shes lisagasog dang mtshams gcod gnyis sa bcad sgo sor mdzad kyang mtshams gcod kyi khongs su bsdus ga' su na pa bde/ ma hā shu rgyu ta dzñā na badz+ra su bhā wa āt+pa ko3lha/ 'khor 'das kyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid du bsam/ stong pa'i nga nga las pad+ma nyi zla dbang phyug chung ma dang bcas pa gdan gyi steng du rang gi rnam par shes pa hūṃ sngon po/ lpa ra ṇa phaṭa/ 'od zer phar 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ semasacan gyi don byas/ saṃ ha ra ṇa hūṃ/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las rdo rje sngon po rtse dgu pa lte ba la hūṃ gis mtshan pa 'od du zhu ba las/ dpal chen po badz+ra he ru gaḥmathing nag zhal gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi bgrang pa/ dur khrod dang dpal gyi chas rnams kyis brgyan pa/ yum kro lha shwa rī ma dang mnyam par sbyor ba'i sku can du bsam/ ma sur+ya maṇ+ḍal/ rang gi lag mthil g.yas su nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūṃ las rdo rje hūṃ gis mtshan pa/ a tsan+d+ra maṇ+ḍal/ g.yon pa'i mthil du (4na)zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du a las pad+ma as mtshan pa/ g.yas kyi sor mo lnga oṃ hūṃ swā e hās rigs lnga yab lnga dang / g.yon gyi sor mo lnga 4 me lo paṃ rta las yum lngar bsam/ sam ya sto/ mi lnga ba'i thal mo sbyar bsasnyom 'asdug la pa skul/ badz+ra añtsa li hūṃ/ rdo rje thal mo rjes su tsos/ badz+ra ban+dha badz+ra sa lha li dzaḥ rdo rje bas pas3 oṃ ro r+sāg tu ba4/ rigs lnga'i sbyor mtshams nas spros pa'i khro bo'i tsho gos byung ba lag mthil gyi hūṃ dang a la thim/ phaṭa/ rdo rje thal mo/ khro bo sprin rab 'byams lo bar bsams la/ rol mo dbyangasadang bcas te bka' bsgo ba ni/ dpal khrag 'thung gal po che'i rgyud las/ hūṃ/ yang dag don la mi brtson zhing / /byang chub don la mi gnas pa'i/ /mi dang mi min gang yang rung / /thams cad gcig tu bsdus nas na/ /rdul phran bzhin du brlag pa dang / /sems nyid theg pa chen po yi/ /rnam thar dag la 'god pa ni/ /ye shes 'phrin las can gyis mdzod/ /badz+ra sa ma ya dzaḥdzaḥ rnal 'byor chen po'i dkyil —294

sangs rgyas thams cad dang mnyam par sbyor ba dpal yang dag zla gam dgu pa'i 'phrin las kyi rgyud don snang byed/ nang ma (ka)'khor 'dir/ /gsang ba'i dam can so sonas/ /thams cad thugs rjes bskyangs zin gyis/ /da lta nyid du so sor dengs/ sgyu ste mi 'gro 'dug gyur na/ /rdo rje 'dzin rgyal khros nas kyang / /de ma thag tu bkas nas ni/ /bdun brgyud rigs kyang brlag par 'gyur/ /oṃ badz+ra kro dha hūṃ kā ra hūṃ gardza gags phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha bi dza ya hūṃ phaṭa ha na ha na hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha ni la daṇ+ḍa3 da ha da ha hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha ya mān+ta ka hūṃ pa tsa pa tsa hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha ārla a tsa la hūṃ byu — hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha ha ya gi ba hūṃ hu lu hu lu hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha a pa ra dzi ta hūṃ tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha hūṃ phaṭa/ (4ba〉〉 badz+ra kro dha a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍali hūṃ tshin+ta tshin+ta hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha tri lo kya bi dza ya hūṃ ༷ bin+ta hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha ma hā ba la hūṃ spro ṭa h+pho ṭa hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ gi hūṃ / tre / hriḥ/ aḥ/ oṃ dz+wa la badz+ra man+ta nga ni man+ta dz+wa la badz+ra/badz+ra dz+wa la badz+ra hūṃ phaṭa/ ces mtshams bcad do/ /hūṃ/ khro bo rnams rang gi thugs gar thim par bsam/yang thugs ka'i hūṃ las mtsho ni cha sna tsho gos pa 'phros pa sna bug nas 'thon/ g.yas bskor gyis bgegasakyi tshogs bskrad cing sa zhing brtan pa'i bsrung ba'i gur du bsams rdo rje khu gnyis rgyab sbyar/ mthe'u sa sbrel/gung mdzus༅ba'i phyag rtsa stor go/la/ /nga yid kyil 'khor brtan bya'i phyir/ khro rgyal byin rlabs las byung ba'i/ /mtshon cha rnam pa sna tsho gis kyis/ /dkyil 'khor rim pa tshul bzhin srungs/ /oṃ badz+ra sku ca rak+ṣa hūṃ phaṭa/ yang phyag rgya shong bsto cas/ g.yon du bskor zhing / hūṃ/ nga yi dkyil 'khor nas bzung rak+ṣa hūṃ gi bar brjod/ hūṃ/ steng yang rdo rje brdoms pa'i mthe bong mthe'u wo gung mo gsum mnyam ste sgreng / mdzub mo bkug pa'i rtse mo gnyis gung mo'i gas gtso par ā+o sa pa'i phyag rgya/rdo rje'i bla re la/ /'og kyang rdo rje'i sa gzhi ste/ /phyogs mtshams rdo rje 'bar bas gtams/ /rdo rje'i mtshams las ma 'da' zhig /badz+ra badz+ra rak+ṣa hūṃ/steng yang 'khor lo sogs 'don pa bsgyur/ oṃ dzñā na tsakra rak+ṣa/ steng yang lag gnyis mthe bos mdzus mo bkug nas mnan pa'i phyag rgya/ ral gri sogs kyi mthar/ glud :smu tshin+ta rak+ṣa/ steng yang sor mo'i rtse mo rnams bkug ste mgo bo lta bu'i phyag rgya/ dbyug to sogs kyi mthar/ ā ko ṭa ya maṅga ra rak+ṣa/ steng yang rdo rje bas pa las gung rmo gnyis gshibs te brkyang ba/ phur pa sogs kyi mthar/ gī li gī lwa ya rak+ṣa/ (ldan〉steng yang thal mo nang bsdoms—295

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (25)phye ba las mthe bong dang mthu po mo so sor rtse sprad/ me yi sogs kyi mthar/ ji dz+wa la raṃ rak+ṣa/hūṃ/ mtshams bcad nang 'di tshun chad du/ /su yang 'da' bar ma byed cig /ci ste bka' las 'das gyur na/ /tho ba lcags kyu 'bar ba yis/ /snying nas drangs shing brdung bar byos/ /zhes gdug pa can rnams phyir bskrad de bsrung ba'i sa ma dhi la gnas par bya'o/ /lnga pa sdig lhung tsho gis bshags pa/ /rang gi thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros pas bla ma rigs 'dzin khrag 'thung lha dgu dam can srung mar bcas pa oṃ rdo rje bsdu ba'i phyag rgyas/ badz+ra sa ma dzaḥs spyan drangs/ na mo gu ru saḥ na ma phe badz+ra he ru ka maṇ+ḍal sa pa ri wā re khyeḥ zhes bla ma dang lha la phyag bya/ dri med bshags bdag r+pā sngags lang pa 'dir khur las nga ba'i rgyun bshags len par mdzad pa 'jam dbyangs a ra pa tsa na'i rjes gnang gi yi ge sa los mdzad pa de thugs la bod pa'i nyams kyi rnam dpyod che bar byung lags/rgyud las/ ye shes sku mchog rang bzhin dkyil 'khor ni/ /zlo rgyas bzhin du spros pa mi mnga' yang / thugs rjes nyi gsal 'od bzhin snyoms mdzad pa/ /'dir gshegs bzhugs shing bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /brjod med shes rab mi g.yo chos kyi sku/ /bde chen longs spyod rdzogs sku rigs lnga'i gtso/ /thugs rje thabs mkhas rgya che rol ba yi/ /zhi khro sprul pa'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo /dngos su 'byor dang yid kyis rnam sprul pa'i/ / kun tu bzang po bla med mchod sprin gyis/ /mkha' dbyings rnam dag rgya chen yongs bkod de/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa rgya mtshos mchode/ /kun tu bzang mo gsang ba'i bha ga la/ /rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor rab 'byams ma lus kun/ /'du 'bral (5ba)med pa'i ngang du ro gcig par/ /gnyis med byang chub sems kyis mnyes gyur cig /sems kyi rang bzhin chos dbyings nam mkha' che/ /chos rnams rnam dag ye nas 'od gsal zhing / /rnal 'byor nyid dbyings smra bsam las 'das pa'i/ /mnyam nyid byang chub sems la rtag tu 'dud/ /kun bzang rdzogs chen ye nas brdal ba la/ /phyi nang gsang bas bkod pa'i dkyil 'khor 'dir/ /snang srid rnam dag lha dang lha mo'i dbyings/ /byung dang 'byung 'gyur yab yum lhun rdzogs rnams/ /gsang chen rab dgyes gzugs chen bdag nyid ma/ /mkha' dbyings klong yangs pad+ma ra 'khyil ba'i sku/ /gnyis med —296

sangs rgyas thams cad dang mnyam par spyor ba dpal yang dag zla gam dgu pa'i tshon las kyi rgyud don snang byed/ nang ma (ka)thig le wo por 'od gsal zhing //ma bcos spros med byang chub snying po'i sku//cir yang snang ba bde r+pā g.yung drung lha//'du stsol med pa gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor 'dir//bdag wo wo po rigs lnga yab yum dang //byang tso lcam dral khro bo khro mo'i tshogs//rdo rje lha mo tsho gos li tshogs kyi bdag/rigs lnga dpal chen khro rgyal yab yum bcu//gnas dang yum gyi phyag rgya sgo ma bzhi//ye shes sprul pa'i lha tsho gos mang po dang //ma ltar byams shing sring ltar gdung la sogs//legs nyes stangasa'adzin dam li rjes ga rna pa'i/ /phyinang mtsho 'gro rnal ra ma yi rdzos/ /dbang gyur rdo rje dam ༅ dgongs su gsol/ /thugs rje gdung lak+ṣa rdo rje bdag cag gi /'gro ba'i don du byang mu semasabaskyed de//bla medago 'phang bgrod par bya ba'i phyir//bstan pa rgya mtsho so so'i 'dul khrims dang //sku gsung thugs dang mnyam sbyor sdom pa'i mchog/rdo rje 'da' ka dam tshig gto gyi gnyer//spyi dang khyad par lhag pa'i dam tshig las//6na༄ phyir nongs shing gnyer du smra'o 'tshal//yun du mi gtong 'da' bar mi bgyid la//don la gol zhing ldog sems ma mchis kyang //bzod bya long yod snyam pa'i le lo yis//slong du ma gyur btsal shugs chudas pa dang /shes bzhin mi ldan bag med dbang gyur te//sgom la mi brtson bsnyen sgrub g.yel la sogs//tshor dang ma tshor ma rig dbang gis na//ston pa'i bka' dang dam las 'gal gyur te//rnal 'byor gang zhig dam tshig nyams pa dang //skad cig tsam yang phrad par mi bya zhes//bka' las 'byung yang de ltar ma rtogs te//gsang sgo 'chol bas dbye gsal dka' ba dang / /mngon shes med pas skyon can ma rtogs te/ /nyams dang tsho gos 'dres nyams pa bkang ba dang //nyams dang snod min rnams la chos bshad dang //nyams la mi 'dzem nyams pa'i skyon la sogs//nyams dang 'grogs shing nyams pa de dag kun//nyams grib skyon gyis gos par gyur to 'tshal//tshe 'di'i rkyen dang yun gyi bsgribs gyur te//rab nongs 'gyod pa'i sems kyis mthol lo bshags//byams pa'i thugs rjes bdag la dgongs nas kyang //gnyis med dbyings las mi 'gyur bdag bkod de//mi dmigs ba/nga snyoms ngang du bzhugs nas kyang //gnyis med

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()don gyi tshangs pa stsal du gsol//don dam gnyis med spros las 'das pa la//rnam rtog gang yang dmigs par mi 'gyur te//kun rdzob sgyu ma tsam gyi dbang gis na//nongs pa ma mi yon rab nongasabazod par gsol//g.yin yang bklags pas don grub las//sdom gsum sku gsung thugs kyi dam tshig dang //rtsa ba yan lag nyes byas phra mo 6bskong /dam tshig che chung tshor dang ma tshor dang //zla dang zhen gyis dam tshig nyams pa dang /khas len che la nyams len chung ba dang /bka' ltar ma bgyis gzhung ltar ma bsrungs dang ///ting 'dzin slod gyur 'dzab bzlas nyung ba dang //yi dam lha yi sgom pa g.yel la sogs//nyams grib nyes pa'i tsho gos rnams ma lus kun//phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas byang sems dang //bla ma dpa' bo mkha' 'gro rnal 'byor ma//dpal chen yang dag dkyil 'khor lha tshogs dang //dur khrod brgyad gnas dam can mkha' 'gro la/khrir byas lod dang phyin chad sdom sems kyis//sgyu ma lta bu'i ngang du bshags par bgyi//mthol bshags tshangs pa'i dngos grub stsal du gsol//zhes stobs bzhi dang ldan pa'i sgo nas bshags te lha tshogs rnams rang gi snying gar thim par mos/drug pa brda yi sgo dbye ba/dpal khrag 'thung gal po che'i rgyud las/e ma ho/dur khrod gsang ba chen po yi//lo byung zhing khams dga' tshal 'dir//skal ldan dbang phyug rgyal ba'i sras//'dus pa tsho gos pa'i rigs 'dzin rnams//e ma ho dga' mchog bde chen grogs//dam tshag srog gi lu gu rgyud//sprul pa'i gzhog drug gra rgyas pa//chos nyid mkha' la lding bar rigs//de ring tso chad rgyal ba'i sras//dbang phyug yin pas ci bder spyod//rnal 'byor gsang ba'i brda sgo rnams//bya ba'i las rnams thams cad kun//brda yis smra zhing bde bar bya//de phyir don dam chosadabyings kyi//gsang mchog lhun grub dkyil 'khor la//tshad med bzhi yi sgo phye zhig/dzo pra be sha ya phaṭa/bdun pa brda yi phyag 'tshal ba//de nyid las/hūṃ/rigs lnga'i 7na longs rgyas bcom ldan 'das//zhi zhing phra la brtag dka' ste//dbang phyug chen po mchog gi lha//rdzogs pa'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo//ma hā yo gi ni a ti pu sngo pra titsā ho/༷ ༷ la lho brgyad pa mi g.yo dam bca' ba//de nyid

sangs rgyas thams cad dang mnyam par sbyor ba dpal yang dag zla gam dgu pa'i 'phrin las kyi rgyud don snang byed/ nang ma (ka)las/ hūṃ/ rigs 'dus pa yi rnal 'byor rnams/ /yang dag sgrub par dam bcas dang / /ting 'dzin sa laganas 'gyur bas/ / phyag rgya chen por bdag gyur cig /bho dhi tsit+ta sam ya sdo/ dgu pa byin chen 'di ltar dbab/ /rkang gling thod rnga sogs sna tshogs rol mo'i shug glu g.yab dar spos sbyor dbyangs dang bcas te/ khrag 'thung gal po las/ hūṃ/ yang dag khrag 'thung sku dang gsung / /thugs kyi 'od zer 'phrin las mchogo /stong gsum phyogs bzhi'i 'jig rten na/ /'bru brgyad yon rtan bsam mi khyab/ /dpal chen yab yum 'khor dang bcas/ /yun ring dus nas bsnyen bsnyen pa/ /nye ba'i dus su mchod mchod pa/ /bsnyen mchod gos bu mchos par mdzod/ /dkyil 'khor 'di la byin phob la/ /bdag cag rnams la dngos grub stsol/ /sgrub rdzas gnas la byin phob la/ /re ba'i gos bu ma snam lus stsal/ /oṃ ru lu ru lu hūṃ bh+yo hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra ma hā kro dha shrī he ru ka de wa ga na a nga na a be sha ya a āḥ bcu pa mchod rdzas phyin brlab pa/ sum+bha sa bsangs/ shu rgyu tas sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rang nyid dpal chen por gsal ba'i thugs ga'i hūṃ las e paṃ / sgyi swo kai sna she rnams snga ra ṇa phaṭa kyis spros pas mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog /bdug spos/ mar me/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo'i tshogs/ saṃ ha ra ṇa hūṃ/ na maḥs man+ta bud+dhā zhe ga ga na kho sam ye swāhā/ byu badz+ra rā ga a lha a/ pā (7bca pā/ stse pu/hūṃ pe sgru/ ā lo ge ā/ nga ga /ni wi du ni/ shag sha /mchod yon ma la sogs pa'i mchod pa'i lha mo kha dog sna tshogs pa rin po che'i rgyan dang lha rdzas kyi na bza' can/ khrus gzheng dang me tog gi snod sogs thogs pa dpal kun tu bzang po'i rnam par thar pa las byung ba'i mchod pa'i sprin phung nam mkha'i mtha' klas par bsam/ khrag 'thung gal po las byung ba'i sngags ni/ oṃ a nut+ta ra pā dza me gha snya ra ṇa i mo ga ga na khaṃ hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ bsangs sbyangs stong pa'i ngang las a las byung ba'i bhan+dha lcang lor bcas pa'i nang du a su hūṃ ā ga ni sha rnams 'od du zhu ba rnam pa dur khrod kyi rdzas las byung ba'i khrag gi mchod yon/ dbang po'i me togo sha chen gyi bdug spos/ zhun chen gyi mar me/ mkhris pa'i dri chab/sha kyi rus zhal zas/ gzhan yang rkang gling thod rnga gsang ba'i rnge'u chung sogs kyis sa gzhi bar snang —299

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (25)nam mkha'i khyon thams cad yongs su gang bar bsam/ rma badz+ra a: āḥ&/ puṣ+yo nas shasta'i bar brjod/ sman gtor rak+ta gsum byin brlab bklags pas don grub las/ sum+bha sa bsangs/ rang gi thugs ka nas3 dmar po spros pa'i mes bdud rtsi'i snod sa ga storak+ta mar rjos kyi/la reg pas mi gtsang ba bsregs/ yaṃ spros pa'i rlung gis gtore/ khaṃ spros pa'i chus bkrus te dag par byas/ bye spros pasabhan+dha 'bar ba'i snod chen por gyur/ oṃ spros pas mchod rdzas rnams 'dod pa'i yon tan bsam gyis mi khyab pas gang bar bsam/ phud dang gtor ma swa bhā was stong par sbyangs pa'i ngang las yaṃ las rlung / raṃ las me'i steng du/ kai las mi mgo'i skyid bu gsum gyi steng du/ a las byung (shi tha'i thod pa yangs par hūṃ oṃ swā a hā las sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga ye shes lnga'i ngo bor bskyed/ rlung g.yos me sbar rdzas rnams 'od du zhu ba'i rlang pa hūṃ oṃ swā a hā las phyag mtshan lngar gyur pa/ hūṃ badz+ra lha rka rmadzi na dzika swā rat+na :ka a a ro lika hā bradzñā lhag ces brjod pas he ru g.yab yum bcur gyur/ sam ya hoḥzhes brjod pas sbyor ba'i mes 'od du zhu oṃ āḥ/ du gyur/ de las 'od 'phros pas 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i bdud rtsi bkug nas thim/ 'og gi bdud rtsi dang 'dres pas kha dog dri ro nus mthu phun sum tshogs par bsam zhing / oṃ āḥ/ sarba pañtsa a khra ta hūṃ hriḥṭha zhes brgya rtsa brgyad dang / oṃ āḥ& te dzo ba li ta ba la ba ti gu tho sirnyi sa ma ya hūṃ hriḥṭha zhes pa bdun gyis byin gyis brlab/ rat+na'i snod a las thod pa yangs par raṃ las dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i khrag las byung ba'i bdud rtsir byin gyis brlabs la/ ma sur+ya maṇ+ḍal/ ra sla ra ṇa phaṭa/ 6ha ra ṇa hūṃ/ 4 ཿ// mahā rak+ta dz+wa la maṇ+ḍal hūṃ pyi tha/ zhes pas byin gyis brlab bo/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi ting 'dzin gsum/ /'byung rim zhin bsnyen khro rten gdan/ /brten snyan 'dren bzhugs dam brlab dbang / /bstim phyag phyi mchod sman gtor raka /dug gsum mdangs stongasasbyor sgrol mchod/ /glu gar bstod pa bskul zhing 'dzab/ /stong tshigs mchod pa nyer brgyad khrigs/ /ting 'dzin rnam gsum rgyud dang slob dpon hūṃ kā ras mdzad pa'i khrag 'thung lnga bcu rtsa brgyad kyi sgrub —300

sangs rgyas thams cad dang mnyam par stor ba dpal yang dag zla gam dgu pa'i 'phrin las kyi rgyud don snang byed/ nang ma (ka)thabs rgya gar gyi mkhan po bhi dha ka ra sidha dang lo tsā ba ban+de lha rin po ches bsgyur ba/ des mdzad pa'i yang dag gi rtsa ba so dharma (8bsnying pos mchan bur bkrol ba rnams kyi dgongs don brjod bder bkod par/ dang po de bzhin nyid ting 'dzin/ /hūṃ/ chos rnams thams cad rang gi sems nyid de/ /gdod nas skye 'gag gnas gsum dang bral ba/ /ma bcos spros pa med pa ka nas dag /cho ge sku de bzhin nyid kyi ting nge 'dzin/ /oṃ ma hā shu rgyu ta dzñā na badz+ra su bhā wa āt+pa ko ྅ lha/ gnyis pa kun snang ting nge 'dzin/ /hūṃ/ de ltar ma rtogs ma rig zhakhrul pa yi/ khyud drug 'gro ba mi bzod sdug bsngal rgyu/gcod 'dod snying rje chen pos yongs khyab pa/ /longs sku kun tu snang ba'i ting nge 'dzin/ /oṃ dharmā dh+wa tu su bhā wa āt+pa ko3lha/ gsum pa rgyu yi ting 'dzin ni/ /hūṃ/ stong pa nyid dang brtse ba'i snying rje che/ /zung 'jug nam mkha'i dbyings las ma 'gags gdangs/ /rang gi rig pa yi ge a dkar por/ /pad+ma thod 'phreng gi 4zla pa/ gsal ba sprul sku rgyu yi ting nge 'dzin/ /tsit+ta badz+ra sa ma dhi hūṃ/ hūṃ kā ra'i sgrub thabs su sngagasa'adi ma byung yang bka' ma gzhan nas kha bskangs/ bzhi pa 'byung ba rims bskyed pa/ /dpal he ru gaḥ thugs kyi gal po'i rgyud kyi le'u gsum pa dang khrag 'thung gal po'i rgyud kyi brtag pa bcu gnyis par snying po tsam gsungs pa dang so lugs kyi rtsa mchan gyi don legs par bkral te/ hūṃ/ rgyu yig dkar po rdul bral zla ba'i mdog /nam mkha'i dbyings su 'od zer 'bar ba las/ ( kā sha maṇ+ḍal/ gti mug rnam dag mthing skya e chad pa/ /chos dbyings kun bzang nam mkha' cho ge 'byung dbyibs/ /yaṃ rkarma raka snya/ de nang phrag dog rnam dag yaṃ ljang gu /bya grub sgrol ma rlung dkyil rgya gram gzugs/ /ra rak+ta dz+wa la sa mu dra/ de steng 'dod chags rnam dag ra dmar po/ /sor rtog mā gī rak+ta'i rgya mtsho zlum/ /baṃ smin+ta dz+wa la maṇ+ḍal/ de steng (9na gi ti mug rnam dag baṃ ser nag /mnyam nyid spyan ma zhing sa gru bzhin chags/ /ke ni ti dz+wa la maṇ+ḍal/ de steng nga rgyal rnam dag ska dkar po/ /mnyam nyid spyan ma ke rus ri rab brjid/ /raṃ dz+wa la maṇ+ḍal/ de steng zhe sdang rnam dag raṃ dmar po/ me long ye shes gos dkar me dpung 'bar/ /'byung bzhi'i dkyil 'khor bklags pas don grub tu chu dkyil logs su gsungs pa/ gzhung lugs spyi dang mthun —30/—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (25)zhing 'di ga'i sgrub thabs su yang de dang mthun par byung ba mi 'thad pa ma yin kyang gsang chen rnying ma'i rang skad gtso bor byas shing sa dkyil gyi sa sto 4gyi byed pa'ang rgyud dang sgoms du dmigs kyis bkar ro/ /de yang sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor he ru gaḥrigs bsdus pa'i dkyil 'khor slob dpon sangs rgyas gsang bas paṇa chen bi mā lar gnang ba rma rin cen mchog las nye bar brgyud de ding sang sa zhal la dar rgyas che ba'i dbus he ru gshar rnam snang / lto rdo rje nyi ma/ nub pad+ma gar dbang / byang rta mchog rol pa/ byang shar rdo rje sems dpa' ste dkyil 'khor drug ga'i rgyu rdo rje sems dpar bskyed nas/ 'bras bu so so'i gtso bor bskyed par gsungs pa dang sgrub thabs su rdo rje sems dpa' rjes chags kyis 'od du zhu bar lha mo bzhis bskul ba la brten nas khro bo'i skur bzhengs par gsungs pa zhu bskul tsam ma gtogs dbyibs mtshungs shings/ dpal mchog dang po gnas 'gyur nas/ sprul pa'i ting 'dzin la gnas mdzad/ khes dang /'od zer lnga yi 'phro 'du yis/ /dkyil 'khor drug gi las mdzad nas/ /zhes pa'ang rigs bsdus dang phyogs 'dra byung / slob dpon sangs rgyas gnyis pa pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis gnubs nam mkha'i snying por gnang ba dpal mo bya mangs phug nas sprul pa'i gter ston (9ba)byang chub gling pa dpal rgyal mtshan gyis spyan drangs pa'i kun bzang thugs gter gyi zhi khro'i sgrub thabs dang las byang gi dgongs don rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa kho na'i dbang du ma byas par thog mar zhi bar bskyed cing bsgrubs nas slar khro bor bsgyur bar gsungs shing dbang chog dngos grub rgyun 'byung du'ang dkyil 'khor gcig pu de ga'i steng nas thog mar zhi ba'i rten brten par bsgrubs te dbang bskur/ slar khro bo'i rten brten par gnas bsgyur te khrag 'thung gi dbang bskur bar gsungs/ rtsa mchan du bsnyen pa'i don du zhi ba'i dkyil 'khor bskyed nas dngos grub len pa'i bar song rjes khro bor bsgrub pa bstan pa ltar na khrag 'thung gal po'i brtag pa dgu par zhi ba'i sgrub pa bshad pa'i mthar/ tshogs dang bskang bshags gung tshogs mchod/ smon lam yongs su gdab par bya/ /zhes zhi ba'i sgrub pa sbyor dngos rjes tshang nas brtag pa bcu par khro bo'i sgrub pa gsungs pas dril sgrub dang sgos sgrub gnyis ga'i khungs su 'gro la/—302

sang rgyas thams cad dang mnyam par sbyor ba dpal yang dag zla gam dgu pa'i 'phrin las kyi rgyud don snang byed/ nang ma (ka)'phags pa rdo rje rnon pos bkral ba'i mnyam sbyor mkha' 'gro sgyu ma bde ba mchog gi snying po lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor hūṃ kā ras gnyags la gnang zhing de nas gnubs chen brgyud de khu lung pas zur po cher stsal ba dang mkha' 'gro rgyun gtor du grags pa slob dpon hūṃ mdzad la gnubs nam mkha'i snying pos zhus shing de nas jo mo 'tsho rgyal sogs la brgyud par khro rkyang gi sgrub pa bshad pas mtha' gcig tu ma nges na'ang nam mkha'i snying pos gri gus thugs ka gshags te kha phye nas zhi ba'i lha tshogs bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis bstan pa sogs sgrub thabs dang lo rgyus phal cher la zhi bar bsnyen cing khro bor sgrub pa hūṃ kā ra dang pad+ma thod 'phreng gi dgongs pa'i gtso bor snang ba nas de don ltar mdor bsdus tsam bkod (10na)pa 'thad pas/lnga pa zhi bar bsnyen pa ni/ /de steng kha dog lnga ldan zlo yig babs/ zlo bi shwa bi shu khye badz+ra bhañdza dzñā na maṇ+ḍal zlo/ zlo yig 'od zhu ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin/ /rin cen lnga las grub pa'i gzhal med khang / /gru bzhi sgo bzhi mtshan nyid kun ldan dbus/ /pad zla'i gdan steng rgyu yig babs pa de/ /yongs gyur ā li phrag gnyis las grub pa'i/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dkar bsil nya gang ba/ /ya ra la wa ḍa lhas lhag pa yi/ /gsal byed phrag gnyis zhu ba nyi dkyil bar/ /rtse lnga rdo rje dkar po lte bar hūṃ/ /de lasa'od zer sna lnga'i 'phro 'du yis/ /dkyil 'khor drug gi 'phrin las yongs mdzad nas/ /dbyer med 'dres las mngon byang lnga'i bdag nyid/ /rdo rje sems dpa' zla ba'i mdog lta bu/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis rdo rje dril 'dzin pa/ /rang snang yum dang mnyam sbyor zung 'jug sku/ /zhi ba'i na bza' rgyan tshul ma lus rdzogs/ /dkyil 'khor drug dang zhe gnyis sku la shar/ /gnas gsum yi ge gsum gyisamatshan pa yi/ /hūṃ las 'od 'phros zhi ba'i lha tshogs rnams/ /chos kyi dbyings las gzugs kyi skur bzhengs te/ /thogs pa med par badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ/ khrag 'thung gal po las/ hūṃ/ dmigs med mkha' ltar dag pas khyab pa'i sku/ /spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol bar mi dmigs kyang / /thugs rje'i ngang nyid chos sku dag pa las/ /ye shes sgyu mar rol cing gshegs su gsol/ /oṃ badz+ra satwa e hre hi dzaḥlha —303—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ smyonabaṃ hos sa gnyis su med par thim par bsam/khrag 'thung gal po las/hūṃ/chos sku skye ba med pa'i rang bzhin las//gzugs sku sgyu mar skye ba'i skur bstan nas//thugs rjes kun 10ba 'a khyab pa'i don byed pa//rgyal ba bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis la phyag 'tshal//a: rtsas/zhi phe gon pas474dag khesapar so mas du lusang ga yid gsum gus pa phyag gi mchod pa dang phyag rgya gar dang sna tsho gos kun tu bzang po'i phyi nang gsang ba gsum gyi dang skud rtsi sman dang khyad par sa du byung ba gtor ma dang bstod pa glu dang phan pa smon 4 gyi mar pa dang brgyad do//me tog bdug spos dang //mar me dri byu bsgos dang sgra//phyi nang gsang bar sbyar ba rnams//bdag dang mnyam pa'i tsho gos la 'bul//tshogs gtor pañtsa a mṛ ta//ta gan la sogs ci 'byor pa//ting 'dzin yid kyi mar pa 'di//rgyal ba rgya mtshos bzhes su gsol//oṃ badz+ra ya sa pa ri wā ra i rda/a lha/byu pe/di pe/ga rnye/ba kla ta pra titsā hoḥshrī pas kha kha/khā hi/mu hi/dzaḥ& baṃ hoḥmahā pañtsa a mṛ ta/ba kla grihā ho khā hi khā hi/pi ba ho/a la la ho/a mṛ ta khā hi/sgrub thabs las/hūṃ bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyi//sku gsung thugs kyis byin gyis rlobs/oṃ rdo rje rtse lnga'i phyagargyaganas lngar reg la/sarba ta thā ga ta sam ya kwa ya lha ka tsit+ta gu ṇa mdze badz+ra su bhā wa āt+pa ko3lha/zhesabarjod 'dzab ni/oṃ bo dhi tsit+ta mahā su kha dzñā na dh+wa tu āḥzhes ci rigs pa'i bsnyen pa bya/hūṃ las yab kyi gsang gnas rdo rje dang //a las yum gyi mkha' gsang pad+ma yi//nor bu ze'u 'bru rtse mor phaṭa kyis mtshan//sam ya sngos ma ya ra/rā ho snya/rā ga ya mi/dzaḥ& baṃ sngos ma ya mu dra pra be sha ya phaṭa/cham oṃ/hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ/phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa/lpa ra ṇa phaṭa/bde chen 'bar ba'i 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros//rgyal ba sras bcasgom nyes pa'i mchod pa phul//'gro ba'i sgrib sbyangs rdor sems go 'phang bkod//slar 'dus ba spu'i bu ga kun nas thim//11na ) thugs kur 'dod chags chen po'i me yisazhu//rdo rje'i lam nas yum gyi mkhar babs pas//yab yum bde chen 'od kyi thig ler bsam//sprul pa'i lha mo bzhis bskul bar bsams te/sgrub thabs las/stong pa shin tu rnal 'byor med//mkha' nyid dam tshig nye bar gnas//bde bar gaXgs pa bzhengs su gsol//rdo rje sems dpa'

sangs rgyas thams cad dang mnyam par sbyor bdapal yang dag zla gam dgu pa'i wen las kyi rgyud don snang byed/ nang ma zhanaskal bzang bzhengs//ye shes gsang ba'i rgyud bskul nas//thugs rjes 'gro la gzigs par mdzod//ces glus bskul ba'i rkyen gyis bzhengs par bsam pa'i don/rtsa bar/snga ma dag gi gnas bsgyur te//bskal pa'i me dpung 'khrigs pa bzhin//'bar ba'i tshogs ni rnam par bsam//zhes par so mchan du gtso bo bskyed/'khor bskyed/da lta'i dkyil 'khor gsal gdab/ces byung bas zhi sgrub las khro bor bsgyur ba bstan pas/drug pa khro sgrub gzhal yas khang //bskul bas thig le mthing nag 'od du 'bar//ni ba'i dkyil 'khor skad cig gnas 'gyur te/khrag 'thud gzhal yas me shes lnga yi gdangs//sna tshogs rin cen las grub pho brang che/khru bzhi sgo bzhi sgo 'byud glo 'bur tshul//bhañdza bskam rlon rnyid pa bsgrigs pa la//tshes lnga rin po ches khrag mtsho thod pa'i rtsig pa sogs kho ma ba tshos gang dran dran gyi 'jigs 'jigasabyas zhesang tshig dang sa chos rje'i gsung bsko par bya gsung ba bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mas lta bu'i thams cad mkhyen pa la 'khrul pa ga la srid/rin po che'i gzhal yas khang snga 'gyur mang por bshad cing rwa ba'i 'jig byed kyi dkyil 'khor dbus su thod rwa dang khrag mtsho bod pas gsar ma la'ang mtha' ci bkari/tsho gyis phur pa'i mngon rtogs las zhi ba'i pho brang du bskyed de gsung pa'i shugs la drag po yod pa don gyis 'thon par snang /rtse lugs las byung (11bska khungs su mdzad pa'i dpyal phur du dur khrod chen po 'bar ba'i gzhal yas khang /zhes sog rgyas par yod pa 'go mjug tshang mar spyan zur lhungs la che/'on kyang lon las rgya mtsho zur za de ltar na yang phur gyi rgyud phal cher la log rtog tu song bas rgyud mi 'dod par de nas༅da pa'i lha yi dam du bsten pa'ang phag grus chen gyi dam tshig dang 'gal ba'i rigs brgyud snga ma'i rjes su 'brang mi 'tshal lo//gnam lcags ur mo'i gzer gyis 'gyur med gdams//pha gu ser po rab tu bsgrigs pa'i steng //thod pa'i bre phul brtsegs mar ro skra yi//ske rags spa brgyus rgyu ma'i dra ba dang /khri phyed la 'phyang mgo bo dbang po lnga//yan lag skra yi rgyan dang dar dpyangs g.yo//gsal byed me long dril bu g.yer kha 'khrol//nang du klu chen brgyad kyi ka gdan steng //lha chen brgyad kyi ka ba btsugs pa la//gza' chen brgyad kyi ka gzhu bkal ba'i steng //zhing chen bcu drug gdung ma phyogs bcur bris//gza' skar dral lcam ru dra'i pags thog phub/3/༷ rig mun sel nyi zla'i mthongs khung shar//dam

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()rdzas bdud rtsi lnga yi zhal ba byas//rkang lag lhu dum mda' yab shar bu can//rus pa'i pu shu mchod rten rnam bas bskor//mchog chen rus pa'i rgya phiba'adi'i cham rdzo rten gyi byed pa dang mi byed pa'i sa bkang ga kho cha rnam grangs mang na'ang 'dir rgya 'ibs gtso che bar byas/rtse mo sa/mi snying khro bo'i rdo rje'i rtag gisamadzes//sgo bzhin rta babs rus pa'i dra ba dang //chu srin rgyan dang steng na chos 'khor lo/khrag sgrubathabs su/si cen thod pa sna tshogs dang zhes dang /zhing 'phrul sgos pa'i g.yang gzhi sogs//dur khrod rgyan gyis 'jigs par btso//zhes gzhal yas kha dur khrod las grub par rgyud kyi dgongs pa bzhin mdzad cing /rtsa bar/'od zer de dag 'dus bya kyang //dur sgo sa ru cag par bya//zhes par sgoms du dur khrod kyi rgyan rnams dang gzhal yas rdzo gi che ba'i yon to zhesaspyod lag nu pas kyang de dang mas/'dzag mi 12na spogs 'a pa'i ba dan gdugs//rgyal mtshan la sogs rgyan gyi bkod pas brjid//thabs shes zung 'jug zla phyed rdo rjes mas//rtsig pa'i rtsa bar 'dod snam dmar po la//phyi nang gsang mchod lha mo zlos gar bsgyur//de bzhin gshegs pa bzhi 'od kha dog gis//phyogs rnams rab mdzes ye shes rang snang zhing //dbus dang phyogs mtshams brgyad du gnam bas lugs su zla gam sgo snyag gi nang du lor lo rtsibs brgyad dang rgyud tshor yang rtsibs shad do//sgo can//zla gam thabs shes zung du bcug pa'i gdangs//dkar dmar mdangs 'od 'dres pa'i pho brang che//dur khrod ni bklags pas don grub las/phyi rol dur khrod phyogs skyong ṣ+ka skyong klu/mang me ma rdzo rten chu bo grub po brgyad//dpa' bo mkha' 'gro gnod sbyin srin po dang /sha za spyo byed brjed byed ro langs dang //mdung dang gsal shing rtse yis phug pa'i ro//ro dum thod tshal sha khrag rus pas dkrigs//wa dang ce spyang khā lug bya rgod dang / /kai ka la sogs pho sgra sgrogs pas gang //sra sgrub thabs sa rdo rje'i rgya gram sa gzha la zhes gas kyi don/zhing brtan pa rdo rje'i gur khang gi/phyi rol kha dog sna lnga'i me dpung 'bar//bdu na pa gdan rnams gsal 'debs pa/ /pe pad+ma maṇ+ḍal/ dbus dang phyogs bzhi mtshams bzhi'i zla gam nang //paṃ gnubs lugs su/ru dra pho mo bsnol ba la/nyi zla pad+ma brtsegs pa' gdan//zhes las mar bsgom tshul gsalabar gzha/chad sna tsho gos pad+ma 'dab brgyad steng //3 0 /ji maṇ+ḍal/dbus kyi pad+ma'i steng du a chad pas//

sangs rgyas thams cad dang mtshi par sbyor ba dpal yang dag zla gam dgu pa'i tshon las kyi rgyud don snang byed/ nang ma (ka)zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dkar bsil nya gang ba/ /ma su rla maṇ+ḍal/ dbus kyi zla dang phyogs mtshams pad+ma'i steng / /ma chad nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor tsha zer 'bar/ /dzaḥdamar (12ba) 'phros las lcags kyu lta bu yis/ /drag po 'jigs byed chung mar bcas pa bkug /ma hā de wa dzaḥ u ma de sa dzaḥ dbus kyi dkyil 'khor gdan gsum brtsegs pa'i steng / /lha chen dbang phyug yab yum byi chings bsnol/ /ma tre dzaḥ phyogs dang mtshams kyi nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor steng / /bam chen skyel ba'i gdan dang bcas par bsam/ /brgyad pa khrag 'thung lha bskyed pa/ /dkyil 'khor dbus kyi mkha' la hūṃ mthing nag /zla gam dbus ma'i gdan gyi steng du babs/ /lpa ra ṇa phaṭa/ 'od 'phros bde gshegs kun gyi thugs rgyud bskul/ /sems can rnams kyi sgrib gnyis ma lus sbyangs/ /6ha ra ṇa hūṃ/ sangs rgyas byin rlabs tshur bos/ yig la/ /thim pa 'od kyi gong bur yongs gyur las/ /badz+ra hūṃ/ de wo rdo rje sngon po rtse dgur gsal/ /'od zer 'phro 'dus gcig tu gyur pa las/ /tshogs gnyis yongs su rdzogs pa'i dpal wo po/ khrag 'thung badz+ra he ru /ru bsam/ /oṃ ru lu ru lu hūṃ bh+yo hūṃ/ dpal he ru gaḥthugs kyi gal po'i rgyud kyi le'u bdun pa dang / tso he ru gaḥgal po'i le'u bcu bzhi pa nas gtso 'khor gyi mngon rtogs snying po tsam bstan pa bzhin/ hūṃ/ dpal chen yang dag badz+ra he ru gaḥ/ /mun pa'i mdog can dbu gsum khrag 'thung gal po'i brtag pa bcu gcig par zhal bzhi phyag brgyad pa/ zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug pa sogs gdul bya'i snang ngor ma ra sna rdzas gad/phyag drug pa/ /zhabs bzhi g.yas bskum g.yon brkyangs dor stabs bgrad/ /rtsa zhal mthing nag khro zhing gtum la rngams/ /g.yas dkar cung zad ba 'ad pa zhi ba'i nyams/ /g.yon dmar gshe ba 'gro la rjes chags brtse/ /dus kyi me ltar 'bar ba'i spyan dgu bgrad/ /(13na tshe na ma sma ra glog 'khyug shangs bug nas/ /hūṃ 'byin zhal gdangs mche ba zur gsum gtsigs/ /phaṭa phaṭa 'jigs pa'i gad rgyangs phyogs bcur dgod/ /nyi khri tshig stong dmar 0glong dkyil nas/ /zhes pa nas/ mkha' 'gro'i tsho gis bcasangs bsdu'o/ /zhes pa'i bar phyogs 'dra bstan kyang rgyud dang yang phur gzhan gyi lugs 'asdug pa bde bar mngon/ gsum byin brlab pa/ /zil gnon gsung bzhin bsdigs pa'i phyir/ /las kyi phyag rgya rnam gsum sku'i / /zhes pa ltar sgyur lo dang rdo rje'i rgya srung 'bor ltar dang pad rgya gang bsto 4'a/ ting nge 'dzin gyi dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ las 'khor lo dkar po rtsibs brgyad pa'i lte bar oṃ gyis mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las sku rdo rje dkar po 'khor lo dang des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ mgrin par āḥlas pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar āḥs mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las gsung rdo rje dmar po pad+ma dang des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ thugs gar hūṃ las rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa lte bar hūṃ gis mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las thugs rdo rje sngon po rdo rje dang des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ gsum ga'ang dur khrod kyi chas kyis brgyan pa/ rang 'dra'i yum la 'byud cing g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyis bzhugs par bsam/ dpal snying rje rol pa'i rgyud las/ oṃ/dpal ldan sangs rgyas sku 'chang ba/ /rdo rje mi phyed gsum dang ldan/ /deng bdag sangs rgyas sku 'dzin pa/ /byin gyis brlab pa'i gnas mdzod cig /oṃ sarba ta thā (18bston ta kā ya badz+ra su bhā wa āt+pa ko3// āḥ dpal ldan sangs rgyas gsung 'chang ba/ /rdo rje mi phyed gsum dang ldan/ /deng bdag sangs rgyas gsung 'dzin pa/ /byin gyis brlab par mdzad du gsol/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta wā ka badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+pa ko3lha/ hūṃ/ dpal ldan sangs rgyas thugs 'chang ba/ /rdo rje mi phyed gsum dang ldan/ /deng —315

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (25)bdag sangs rgyas thugs 'dzin pa/ /byin gyis brlab par mdzad du gsol/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta tsit+ta badz+ra su bhā wa āt+pa ko3// zhes lus ngag yid gsum bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje'i rang bzhin du gyur par mos/ /bcu bzhi dbang bskur rgyas gdab pa/ /nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i ye shes kyi lha tshogs la dmigs te/ rtsa dum las/ hūṃ/ thabs kyi spyod pas sems can don/ /byams dang snying rjes gang 'dul ba/ /sangs rgyas na las rdzogs par mdzod/ /dbang dang byin rlabs 'dir stsol cig /ces gsol ba btab pas/ hūṃ oṃ tre samaḥ kā ya lha ka tsit+ta gu ṇa ri sid+dhiḥ.a bhi khiñtsa hūṃ/ zhes ye shes kyi chus dbang bskur/ sku gang / dri ma dag /chu lhag ma yar lud pa las spyi snga 'gyur la lar spyan 'dren gyi gong du dbang bskur zhing rigs kyi mas ma bya g.yod kyang sgrung thabs sa 4 gsal dkyil 'bor na drangs nas/ dbang bskur rigs kyi mas ma ba smo/ zhes pa dang dgong poms/ bor hūṃ las badz+ra he ru rkaḥsngon po g.yas rdo rje 'dzin pa/ dpral bar oṃ las burnya he ru da:dkar po g.yas 'khor lo 'dzin pa/ rna gong g.yas su tho las rat+na he ru gaḥser po g.yas rin po che 'dzin pa/ ltag par hrīḥlas pad+ma he ru gaḥdamar po g.yas pad+ma 'dzin pa/ rna gong g.yon du aḥlas ga rma he ru gaḥ ljang gu rgya gram 'dzin pa/g.yon pa thams (19na༄da rang rtags kyis yum byas pa'i dril bu bsnams pa/ rang snang gi yum dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ dur khrod kyi chas kyis spras shing zhabs gnyis g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang ba'i gar rgyas bzhugs par bsam/ oṃ badz+ra shrī he ru da badz+ra kro dhī shwa rī hūṃ/ oṃ burnya shrī he ru — kro sgyi shwa rī oṃ/ oṃ rat+na shrī he ru rkaḥrat+na kro dhī shwa rī khri/ oṃ pad+ma shrī he ru daḥpad+ma kro sgyi shwa rī phyi lta mi me shrī he ru gaḥskadze kro dhī shwa rī aX zhes brjod/bco lnga ye shes lha bstim pa/ khrag 'thung gal po las/ hūṃ/ thugs rje'i lcags kyus rgyud bskul zhing / /byams pa'i zhags pas spyan yang 'dren/ /bka' yi lcags sgrog pho nyas btab/ /bde gshegs dril bus dgyes pa bskyed/ /rang snang dbyer med dkyil 'khor la/ /thugs rje'i mgon gyur ma lus rnams/ /mi phyed dbyings la 'god mdzad pa/ /bdag la dgyes shing thim par bzhugs/ /oṃ badz+ra e —316

//// /lnga//4ཿ/phri /// /rdo// /bye/ ltang rig/sangs rgya thams cad dang mnyam par ra ba dpal yang dag zla gam dgu pa na las rgyud na snang da/ nang ma kaku sha dzaḥm badz+ra pā sha hūṃ/chabadz+ra spro ṭa baṃ/oṃ badz+ra ghaṇ+ḍa ho zhes dgug gtso chang mnyes bya/༄ drug sgo gsum phyag bya ba/khrag 'thung gal po'i rgyud las/hūṃ/dbyings kun rang bzhi rnam par dag pa las/thugs rje'i dbang gis sprul pa'i skur bzhengs pa//dpal ོ khrag 'thung go rī ma brgyad sogs//rang snang lha tshogs rnams la phyag 'tshal lo//sgrub thabs las/oṃ shrī pa ra mu kha/shā ra ṇa yaḥm shrī da ga sam lwa ya na maḥm shrī badz+ra kha ṭ+wāṃ ga bra dza lā ya na maḥm shrī badz+ra gha rje pra dza lwa ya na maḥ.a ti pu sngosarba ta thā ga ta/— rna /ro mi/ma hā yo gi ni/a la la ho/bklags pas don grub tu bdag mdun gnyis ka mar par bzhed ces mchod yul spyan 'dren pa snga tsor bka' gter phal cher la mi snang 19ba〉nga 'khon ston sngags 'chang rnams kyi phyag len zur pa zhig las 'os ma mcha/yang dag gi rgyud rgya bod kyi g.yi bka' gter gang du'ang mi bog par bdag po sngagasa'achang pas phur pa la dpe blangs nas bris pa rje btsun gong ma'i ba lko par ma song mod/'on kyang phug ron 'phongs nas a kor khrung /rna cha 'dogs mkhan rnams la mi phan kyang /phug ron kho ra'i byed lugs a re sdug gi dper gda'o//bcu bdun phyi sgrub thabs su/rdo rje thal mo gyen du dbye/kho sogs phyi nang ga4 ma rdzo dang /rtsa skar du phyag dugs rar sgrol gos rags7gas no//mar rim 'bul ba/khrag 'thung gal po las/hūṃ/ bde bar gshegs sgo bcom ldan 'das//rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i ye shes kyis//srid pa rgya mtsho mtha' yas kun//kun bzang ma rdzo sprin mardzo tu rol//srid rtsa dbyings su shar ba'i mar rdzas de//de wo ma losayum gyi thig ler shar//chags yul bde ba'i 'od phung dmar la 'khyil//nyon mongs dbyings su bstim phyir a: ba spyo//yang ba lnga wo ye shes bcud shar ba//snang srid mdangs ldan rang rig me tog gsal//gnyis med ngang las kha dog cir yang gsal//las bu bcud ldan me rtag 'od phung 'bar//ma los rang byung dam rdzas spos ma 'di/kha dog dbyibs gsal dbang po si byed pa//stong gsum dri bsung dar ba'i bdud rtsi 'di//'bar ba'i shangs la mar pas mnyes gyur go/

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (25)snod bcud dbyer med yab yum dag pa la/ /'bras bu rang byung ye shes mi shar gnas/ /mtha' dbus med par gsal ba'i 'od 'bar 'di/ /'khor ba'i mun khang gzhom phyir bzhes su gsol/ /gnyisamed mkha' dbyings dag pa'i pho brang du/ /nyon mongs skyon bral dag (20na)pa byang chub sems/ /cir yang 'char phyir dri yi 'od phung 'bul/ /zhal gyi dbyings su thim nas mnyes gyur cig /nam mkha' kun bzang dbyings nas cir yang 'byung / /'byung ba'i 'bras bu 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga/ /lha bshosarin chen yid bzhin longs spyod 'di/ /sku gsung thugs kyi ngang du thim par bzhes/ /sgra yi dngos por snang ba yang / /yod pa ma yin shin tu grag /sgra yis rab tu tshim gyur kyang / /sgra nyid rang bzhin gang yang med/ /sgrar 'byung rang bzhin mchod par 'bul/ /sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub stsol/ /oṃ pa na sgru pe nu su ra to/ ti pu pa ra mu/ sarba ta thā ga ta sirnyi hūṃ/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta a/ sbyo tismo ho/ shrī badz+ra gu 〉 pu/ s+t+waṃ brdzu: pe sgru/ shrī badz+ra ā lo ke 〉 shrī badz+ra garnye gan/ shrī badz+ra ni li du ni/ kha kha khā hi/ khā hi/ shrī badz+ra girti gyi rma/ 'dod yon lnga yi ṣ+ka won lha mo ni/ /gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya chos07she gas bla med mchog gi mchod pa sbyar ba 'di/ /nyon mongs dug sel yid bzhin bdud rtsi'i mchog /grelanyid dag pas rigs lnga'i dam tshig lnga/ /ye shes lnga yi 'od zer rnam par 'gro/ /'dod pa'i yon to lnga yis rab brgyan pa/ /thugs dam bzhin du ci bder bzhes su gsol/ /oṃ rū pa shasta tho rā saspar+sha hūṃ/ sgrub thabs las/ sgeg pa dpa' ba 'jigs su rung ba dang / rgod dang gshe dang 'jigasapar byed pa dang / /snying rje rngams dang zhi ba la sogs pa'i/ /sku yi dngos po shin tu bsgyur ba yin/ /gar byas sgrub po rnal 'byor pa/ /gar gyi dbang phyug gtso bo che/ /zla ba la sogs snying po can/ /me sal sogs bro mchog stsol/ /me rtag (20bskor sogs tsan dan 'phreng / /bzang dgu dbul lo zhes su gsol/ /oṃ sarba bi shwa pā dza ho/ /zhes kun tu bzang po'i mchod pas mnyes par bsam/ bco brgyad bdud rtsi sman 'bul ba/ khrag 'thung gal po las/ hūṃ rang byung gdod nas dag pa'i rdzas/ /rtsa brgyad stong las sbyar ba'i sman/ /rā sa ya na la sogs rdzas/ /rigs lnga dam tshig lnga yi dngos/ /ye shes lnga —318

sangs rgyas thams cad dang mnyam par sbyor ba dpal yang dag zla gam dgu pa'i 'phrin las kyi rgyud don snang byed/ nang ma (ka)rdzogs grub pa'i rdzas/khyud drug sems can kun sgrol ba'i//dug lnga sel ba'i bdud rtsi 'di//bla ma khrag 'thung lha dgu dang //mkha' 'gro dam can 'khor bcas la//rnam dag bdud rtsi mnyes mchod 'bul//thugs rjes bzhes te dgyes mdzod la//tshangs pa 'phrul gyi dngos grub stsol//mahā pañtsa a mṛ ta khā hi/hūṃ/chos sku kun bzang dpal chen he ru daḥ//rdo rje sems dpa' dga' rab rdo rje dang //'jam dpal bshes gnyen ro langs bde ba la//sman mchod 'bul gyi dbang dang dngos grub stsal//mahā pañtsa a khra ta khā hi/burnya gu pho slob dpon hūṃ kā ra//pad+ma thod 'phreng bi mā la mi tra/shwe la mañdzu rdo rje 'dud 'joms la//sman mchod 'bul lo dbang dang dngos grub
