stsol//mahā pañtsa a skṛ ta khā hi/gnyags chen dzñā na 'khon ston klu dbang srung //'di slob dpon pad+ma la dngos su gas phe nye brgyud yin ṣ+ka gzha rdo rje rin cen gyi gnyags dang klu dbang srung gnyis sgar gzha pas 'dir ga'i pa yin no//rdo rje rin cen yon tan tso mkhyen rdo rje gdan pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa mkhyen brtse'i gsan yig na shes rab yon to gyi tshab la 'di bzhin byung ba'i rjes su cistsongs/'byung gnas dang / /tshul khrims rgyal po gtsug tor shes rab la/ /sman mchod 'bul lo dbang dang dngos grub stsol//mahā pañtsa a mṛ tā khā hi/ 21na〉khon rigs dge skyabs lon ston rdo rje gdan pa dang rje mkhyen bu'i gas yig na bal po sngon du byung phe rjes su gongs/bal po dang //'khon rigs dge mthong shākya blo gros zhabs/shes rab tshul khrims dkon cog rgyal po la//sman mchod 'bul lo dbang dang dngos grub stsal//mahā pañtsa a mṛ ta khā hi/brtse ba ོ po slob dpon rin po che//rje gas grags pa chos rje paṇ+ḍita/ /chos rgyal 'phags pa 'od ldan kha'u par/ /sman mchod 'bul lo dbang dang dngos grub stsol//mahā pañtsa.a mṛ ta khā hi/bu lung kun rdor lo chen mchog ldan pa//dga' ldan kun bsod gan pa rin rgyal rje//bsod nams rgyal mtshan shes rab rdo rje la//sman mchod 'bul lo dbang dang dngos grub stsol//ma hā pañtsa a mṛ ta khā hi/chos dpal shes rab seng ge rgyal mtshan dang //klu pa bsod dar dmar ston rgyal mtshan 'od//nam mkha' blo gros chag lo gsum pa la//sman mchod 'bul lo dbang dang dngos grub stsol//mahā pañtsa ḍi mṛ ta khā hi/sa lo 'jam rdor rje btsun kun dga'

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (25)lags/ /mkhyen brtse'i zhabs dang dbang phyug rab brtan dpal/ /sa chen kun bsod 'jam dpal rdo rje la/ /sman mchod 'bul lo dbang dang dngos grub stsol/ /ma hā pañtsa a mṛ ta khā hi/ dkyil 'khor kun gyi khyab bdag rdo rje 'dzin/ /rin cen bsod nams mchog grub dpal bzang po/ /bka' drin mnyam med rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ /sman mchod 'bul lo dbang dang dngos grub stsol/ /ma hā pañtsa a mṛ ta khā hi/ rdo rje khrag 'thung khro mo dbang phyug yum/ /go rī la sogs 'khor gyi ma mo brgyad/ /dkyil 'khor lha tsho gis dam can srung ma (21ba 'a/ /sman mchod 'bul lo dbang dang dngos grub stsol/ /ma hā pañtsa a khra ta khā hi/ sman phud phul bas lha rnams bde ba chen po'i ros mnyes par bsams nas bdud rtsi gnas gsum du reg la/ khrag 'thung gal po las/ hūṃ/ lce yi rdo rje dam tshig la/ /rdo rje can gyis/ bsgoms te/ /mthe bong dang ni srin lag rtses/ /thabs dang shes rab 'brel ba yi/ /bdud rtsi rnam lngar sbyar ba la/ /myang na byang chub sems thob 'gyur/ /kā ya sirnyi oṃ/ wā ka sirnyi āḥtsit+ta sirnyi hūṃ/zhes sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub thob par bsam/ /bcu dgu gtor mas dgyes byed pa/ khrag 'thung gal po las/ hūṃ/ ༅ du byung ba'i gtor ma dang / /'dod pa'i yon to rnam pa lnga/ /chos wo skye ba med dbyings las/ /ji ltar dmigs pa bzhin du 'bul/ / ma hā ba lin+ta kha raṃ khā hi/ 'dod yon lnga'i longs spyod kyis thugs dam stong bar bsam/ nyi shu dmar chen rak+ta sbreng / /hūṃ/ lcang lor bcas pa'i dung chen snod nang du/ /nyon mongs rtsa ba bcad pa'i khrag rgyun gyis/ /gtams nas dpal chen lha tsho gos zhal du 'bul/ khams gsum 'khor ba dbyings su dag par mdzod/ /ma hā rak+ta kha raṃ khā hi/ dmar chen gyi rak+ta tshul bas 'khor ba gnas su stongs par bsam/ nyer gcig dug gsum mchod pa ni/ /tan+t+ra he ru spu'i gal po'i rgyud kyi le'u gsum pa nas bshad pa'i don bzhin/ lo chen bsod nams rgya mtshos mdzad pa'i phur pa spu gri'i las byang las/ hūṃ/ gti mug sha chen phungs se phung / /'dod chags khrag mtsho mer re re/ /zhe sdang rus gram nyil li li/ /dpal chen mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la 'bul/ /mahā me sa rak+ta ke ni ti kha raṃ 'a hi/ /(22na)dug gsum rang gnas su dag par —320

sangs rgyas thams cad dang mnyam par sbyor bod pa la yang dag zla gam dgu pa'i 'phrin las kyi rgyud don snang byed/ nang ma zhanabasam/ nyer gnyis mdangs kyis dam bkang pa/ khrag 'thung gal po las/ hūṃ/ dbyings dang ye shesating 'dzin ni/ /kong bu chos dbyings yum gyi mkha'/ /mar me ye shes yab kyi 'od/ /sku gsum 'gro ba'i don yang mdzad/ /chos kyi dbyings kyi gzhal yas nas/ /ye shes chen po sku gsum gyis/ /'khor ba'i ma rig mun bsal nas/ /'khor lo tsho gos chen gsal ler gsal/ /oṃ ā lo ke dz+wa la di pa hūṃ hūṃ/thabs shes zung 'jug gi mar me sbar bsam rig pa'i mun pa sel bar bsam/ nyer gsum sbyor mchod bde bskyed pa/ khrag 'thung gal po las/ hūṃ/ sbyor ba gnas kyi ting 'dzin ni/ /gling bzhi phyi yi sbyor ba dang / /sgo bzhi nang gi sbyor ba dang / /dkyil 'khor bzhi ni gsang ba la/ /bde ba bzhi ni de kho na/ /ma lus thams cad bde stong gcig zhan tu bsgyings pa'i dpa' bo sgeg pa dang / /bkra shisamatshan ldan mi mos brgyan pa gnyis/ /dpa' bo dgyes pa'i sbyor mchod bde ba yang / /skal ldan rnams la 'bul lo rab sprul cig shes rab dbyings ma yum gyi gzhal yas su/ /rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor ma lus mchog bkod de/ /thabs dang shes rab ldan pa'i sbyor mchod kyis/ /'phags pa thams cad mnyes pa'i mchod pa 'bul/ /mnyam nyid dbyings su rtogs pa'i ye shes kyi/ /bde mchog longs spyod rdzogs pa sku yi rgyan/ /'dod rgu yon to mdzes pas rab brgyan pa/ /rnal 'byor ye shes rgyan du bzhes su gsol/ /oṃ a nu rā ga ṇa pā dza me gha lpa ra ṇa i me ga ga na byu hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ mnyam par sbyor ba'i mchod pas dga' bzhi'i ye shes(22ba〉khrungs par bsam/ nyer bzhi nyen rtsa bar/ dmo tshigamachog gi mar pa dang / zhes par so mas du spyor sgrol gyi rten du bdud ji gdang rak+ta bskom pa de gnyis tsho pa zhes byung rgaphur pa la bdud rtsi dang khrag bsres par bsgral ba'i dmigs rten byed par bshad pa dang mthun nam snyam/ sngags rnying ma'i gzhung la lar li sgor bod rtsi 'thor mi rung bar spyod pas sngags rgan ral pa mā rnams kyi sa dpyad do/ /mongs sgrol mchod pa/khrag 'thung gal po las/ hūṃ/ sgrol ba gnas kyi ting 'dzin chen po ni/ /dpa' bo 'bru lnga rlung lha'i rta la zhon/ /a : su tri pre du drug rnams bsregs/ /gnas sbyor ting 'dzin rgyu rnams byin gyis brlabs/ /sdug bsngal mang pos gzir ba'i 'gro ba la/ /snying rjes shugs kyis sdug bsngal bzlog pa'i phyir/ /—32/—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()nyon mongs kun bsal rgyud drug lam bkag nas//byang chub bgrod phyir 'phags lam rnam thar bstan//dam rdzas bdud rtsi lnga dang zhal zas lnga//sku lnga chos lnga dbyer med rang bzhin gcig/de phyir dag pas dag pa nyid mchod de//chos nyid la yang chos nyid thim par mar//dkyil 'khor la yang dkyil 'khor thim par mchod//dam tshig mchog gi mchod pa dam pa 'dis//rgyal ba sras bcas rigs kyi yum rnams dang //phyag brnyan gtum chen rngams pa'i tshogs la sogs//rnal 'byor grub pa'i tshogs dang rig 'dzin dang //rnal 'byor rnam lnga'i tshogs la mchod pa 'bul//oṃ ga ṇa tsakra pā dza me gha sa mu dra skyo ra ṇa sa ma ye hūṃ/'khor bar skye ba'i rgyu'i nyon mongs sa bon bag chags dang bcas pa bsgral nas 'dod yon du dmigs te ro gcig par phul bas mya ngan las 'das pa'i sa la sbyor bar bsam/nyer lnga glu gar gyis mchod pa/khrag 'thung gal po las/'a2na3/shin tu sgeg pa'i gzi brjid 'bar//yid bzhi rin cen phreng ba 'phro//dbyangs snyan yid 'phrog gzi ldan 'bar//gzugs mdzes bskyod pas phyogs bcur g.yo//hūṃ tre khyu/a sa ma ya hūṃ/kun tu tshim byed bro gsung thim//lha mdzes rin cen phung po 'phro//'od gsal 'tsher bas kun tu gsal//bdud rtsi bsil dro 'jam pa'i dbyangs//du bu a ga sa ma ya hūṃ ho/rig pa'i rlabs las byung ba yi//lha mo'i tsho gos kyi mchod pa ni//gar dang dbyangs su byas nas kyang //gzugs dang dbyibs su 'bul lags kyis//sbyor chen tshul du bzhes su gsol//g.yin yang thabs tshul mtha' yas pa'i//mchod sprin bla med phyogs bcur 'bul//nam mkha' mdzod kyi gter la sogs//bla med mchod sprin rab 'byamasarnams//dad pas dmigs te 'bul lags kyis//sngon gyi thugs dam rjes dgongs te//dkyil 'khor rgyan du bzhes su gsol//oṃ pā dza me gha sa mu dra snya ra ṇa sa ma ya ye hūṃ/hūṃ/stong pa nyid dang snying rje'i bdag nyid ni//zhi gnas dang ni lhag mthong zung du 'brel//bde ba las ka spungs rdo rje 'chang ba yi/dngos po dngos med 'byung gnas chen por mkhyen//gsung snyan yi ges kun la khyab pa yis//spros med gsung du 'jig rten dbang phyug bzhugs//mi 2gsung lha mor dam bcas 'dul mdzad pa//sgyu

sang rgyas thams cad dang mnyam par sbyor ba dpal yang dag zla gam dgu pa'i 'phrin la kyi rgyud don snang byed/ nang ma (ka)'phrul tshul mnga' ldan pa 'ga' ma mchis/ /gang du bde chen rang bzhin rjes chags pa'i/ /na chung dag dang lhan cig ba 'ad mdzad de/ /g.yas kyi phyag gis rdo rje gsor nas kyang / /g.yon pa yis ni dril bu'i sgra snyan 'brol/ /(23bsko mo mtha' dag btsun mor gyur pa yis/ /dam tshig rnams kyi bya ba byas par 'gyur/ /gcig gi lag pas kun la 'khyud pa ste/ /gnyis pas rjes su chags phyir bde ba'i mthu/ /gsum pa mi zad me tog 'phreng ba 'thor/ /bzhi pa bde ba yi ni mda' yang 'phen/ /gang zhig glu ni len par byed pa de/ /bde ba rdo rje can dang mnyam par 'gyur/ /rdo rje gsor ba snying rje chen po yin/ /dril bu gsil pa shes rab stong pa nyid/ /gar gyis zhi gnas lhag mthong zung du 'brel/ /bde chen rol pa che la dgongs su gsol/ /oṃ badz+ra dh+wa tu ho/ mchod pa'i sprin phung zad mi shes pas zhi lhag zung 'brel gyis mnyes par bsam/ nyer drug lha tshogs la bstod pa/ khrag 'thung gal po las/hūṃ/ bdag med phyogs bral don dam thugs chud cing / /byams dang snying rje dgra zin mi mnga' yang / /gdug pa 'dul phyir dus las mi 'da' ba'i/ /'jigs byed he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mi gnas mi dmigs chos sku dag pa las/ /bdud 'dul khro bo mchog gi skur sprul pa/ /thugs rje'i gzi ldan gdug pa thabs kyis 'dul/ /bcom ldan khro rgyal la yang phyag 'tshal lo/ khro mo dbang phyug sku la nyer gnas shing / /thabs dang shes rab 'brel ba'i dkyil 'khor 'dir/ /mkha' 'gro mi bzad 'bar ba'i sprin 'phro ba/ /gdug pa 'dul mdzad yum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gsang ba me dpung gi rgyud las/ /hūṃ/ log tog 'khor ba rdul du brlag slad du/ /dur khrod zhing gi dbyug pa phyag na bsnams/ /srid gsum dbang mdzad sngon mo go rī ma/ /bsil ba'i tshal gyi ma mo la phyag 'tshal/ /log rtog las kyi skyon rnams 'bugs slad du/ /thabs dang shes rab (24na skon pa'i mda' 'phen cing / /dbyings kyi ngang sbyor ser mo tso rī ma/ /li yul tshal gyi ma mo la phyag 'tshal/ khor ba mang po thugs rjes bsgral slad du/ /mi nub chu srin rgyal mtshan phyag na bsnams/ /sangs rgyas srid gtso dmar mo pra mo ha/ /bal yul tshal gyi ma mo la phyag 'tshal/ /sa dgu'i rtog 'joms rdo rje rtse dgu 'phyar/ /ru dra sgrol mdzad ye —323—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()shes dbyings la sbyor//nag mo 'jigs tshul ston mdzad be+et+ta lī//tho gar tshal gyi ma mo la phyag 'tshal/khyud drug 'khor ba gnas nas drang slad du//dur khrod zhing gi rgyu gas phyag na bsnams//chos kyi dbyings sbyor dmar ser puska sī//za hor tshal gyi ma mo la phyag la'i//ye shes lnga dang ldan pa mdzad slad du//dbang lnga'i thod khrag ye shes rdo rjes dkrug/thugs rje thabs mkhas sngo ljang snyas ri//skyon tshal gyi ma mo la phyag 'tshal//zhe sdang chen po gto nas 'joms slad du//zhing mchog tsit+ta dmar po tshems kyis 'dren/ /nga rgyal ser sna sbyong mthing sma sha ni/ /siṅgā'i tshal gyi ma mo la phyag 'tshal/ /log rtog skyon rnams so sor bsgral slad du//thugs rje thabasakyisamago lus so sor 'bral//ser skya 'jigs pa'i tshul can tsaṇ+ḍasnyi//gling dgu'i tshal gyi ma mo la phyag 'tshal/khrag 'thung gal po las/nam mkha'i lus can gar yang thogs med cing //'dod dgur bsgyur ba'i gzugs can 'phrul mo che//ma sring byams pa' tshul gyis grogs mdzad ma//dkyil 'khor lha tsho gos rnams la phyag 'tshal lo//oṃ dharma kā ya na mo/sa sto kwa ya na mo/nirmā ṇa kā ya na mo/dzñā na pañtsa kā ya na mo/kā ya wā /tsit+ta gu ṇa rkarma hri da ya na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta na mo na ma dkyil 'khor gyi 24bsko tshogs la bdag las mi gas par bstod do//nyer bdun bskul zhing 'dzab bzla ba/khrag 'thung gal po las/hūṃ/dur khrod chen po'i gzhal yas su//dregs pa khyo shug pho mo dang //zhing chen bsnol dang brkyangs pa'i steng //dpal chen badz+ra lha ru ga'i//dung khang dkar po'i gzhal yas khang //mgrin pa pad+ma'i gsang chen dang //thugs ka gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor du//rang sems byang chub 'bru brgyad nyid//ru lu gser 'phreng rin po che//gcig las ma spros dgu ru ldan//bsam 'phel 'bru brgyad rin po che//rgyal ba kun gyi thugs kyi dbyig/gdod nas ye shes snying po bas//byin rlabs 'bru brgyad phyag rgyar gsal//drod tshad rtags dang ldan pa yis//de bzhin nyid du shes par bya//'bru brgyad ye shes mkha' la spos/ju gsum 'bar ba'i rgya mtsho ni//srog gi snying po 'bru brgyad gsal///nyis med sku gsung thugs kyi ngang //dpal chen

sangs rgyas thams cad dang mnyam par sbyor bdapal yang dag zla gam dgu pa'i phren las kyi rgyud don snang byed/ nang ma (ka)rin cen zur brgyad la/ /ru lu 'bru brgyad 'phro 'du spro/ /gser gyi ba thag gzings pa bzhin/ /phar los pas ni thugs dam bskul/ /tshur 'dus pas ni dpal be'u gang / /dpal be'u rin cen zur brgyad las/ /ru lu rin cen 'bru brgyad 'phro/ /mgal me klad la bskor ba bzhin/ /phar 'phros pas ni sku la thim/ /slar 'dus pas ni 'a sgrubargyad gang / /yid bzhin rin chen zur brgyad las/ /ru lu rin cen 'bru brgyad 'phro/ /lcags kyi tsha tsha gtams pa yis/ /phar los pas ni ljags la thim/ / slar 'dus pas ni dpal be'u gang / /kun gzhi'i rnam shes yul skur gsal/ /yab yum gnyis med sku gsung thugs/ /thugs kyi yon tan 'byung ba'i (25na gi ter/ /thugs mchogo he ru ka yab yum/ /thugs ni rin byu zur brgyad la/ /ru lu 'bru brgyad 'phro zhing 'du/ /phar 'phros pas ni thugs dam bskul/ /ye shes lha la bsnyen pa 'bul/ /slar sa thugs kyi dpal be'u gang / /rnam shes khro mo'i skur snang ba/ /phyag rgya cha lugs ma nges kyang / /gdul bya'i dbang gis cir yang sprul/ /go rī la sogasabargyad rnams la/ /dpal be'u rin cen zur brgyad steng / /ru lu 'bru brgyad 'phro zhing 'du/ /phar 'phrosapas ni thugs dam bskul/ /ye shes lha la bsnyen pa 'bul/ /slar 'dus thugs kyi dpal be'u gang / /dngos grub mchog gi gter du bsam/ /zhes pa'i don ltar dmigs pa'i 'phro 'du dang bcas/ oṃ rtsa ba las/sgom dbyangs yige las bsabs/zhes gsus/ru lu ru lu hūṃ bh+yo hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra kro dhī shwa rī hūṃ phaṭa/ khyad par can gyi snying po rtsa ba'i sngags nyer drug pa sgrub thabs las byung ba/ oṃ shrī he ru ka badz+ra sa ma ya hi/kro dhi sarba du/ sam ya myu dra/ bra 6dza ka hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra go rī nya3 phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra tso rī ta3 phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra bra mo he ha / phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra be+et+ta lī sa/ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra puska sī 〉〉 phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra ghasma rī sa/ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra sma sha ni ha/ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍasnyi nya3 phaṭa/ ces gtso bo yab yum dang 'khor brgyad kyi sngags ci nus bzla/ nyer brgyad mchod cing dngos grub blang / khrag 'thung gal po las/ hūṃ/ ting nge 'dzin gyis spros pas mchod pa'i gter/ me rtag bdug spos lha bskos mar me bcas/ /bla bre rgyal mtshan na bza' 'phan dang gdugs/ /sil snyan rnga dung nor bu mu tig (25bsko phreng / /gzugs sgra —325

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ smyonadri ro reg sogs lha mo'i tshogs//bde wo byang chub sems kyi mchod sprin rnams//dngos su bshamasashing yid kyis ma' sprul nas//ye shes rang snang zhi khro'i dkyil 'khor la//'a bru brgyad 'phro 'dusa'abul ni mchod par bzhes//sku mchog gang 'dod gzugs su de bzhin snang //gsung mchog rnam pa sngags kyi yig 'brur gsal//thugs mchog ye shes dam tshig phyag rgyar gnas//yon tan rin cen bdag gzhan dgos 'dod stong //'phrin las rnam bzhis 'gro drug rnam par sgrol//legs pa mchog rnams yon to mnga' mdzad la//dang bas rab bstod 'bru brgyad dag pas mchod//ces 'dzab stong phrag re'i mtshams su dngos 'byor yid sprul gang rung gi mchod pa 'bul ba khro bo puṇ+ḍa ri ka las lha re re la bsnyen pa stong rtsa brgyad dbul lo//'dzab rdzogs pa dang stong tshigs kyi mchod pa 'bul/zhesargyud kyi dgongs pa yin zhing zhan byung dngos grub kyang len par bshad pas khrag 'thung gal po las/hūṃ/byams mgon thugs la bya rtsol mi mnga' yang //bdag cag re smon grub par mdzad slad du//'phrin las rnam bzhi'i 'dul thabs ji bzhin pas//gdul bya rab 'bring tha mar gyur pa rnams//bzang ngan phan gnod rtse gcig sems dpa' yi//lha bgegs legs nyes byad pa gang yang rung //sbyor ba ga pa'i bag chags gto spangs nas//byang chub sems mchog skye bar sgrub pa dang //thugs rje'i zhing gyur 'gro drug sems can rnams//'khor ba'i mtha' ring mtsho las bsgral slad du//bzlas brjod 'phro 'dus bskul na 'phrin las mdzod//skye 26na shi med pa tshe yi dngos grub dang //'du 'bral med pa gzungs kyi dngos grub dang //'pho 'gyur med pa gnas kyi dngos grub stsol//zhesabarjod/khrag 'thung gal po las/rdo rje'i bzlas dang sems la dmigs//bdag byin brlab dang 'od gsal dang / /zung du 'jug dang 'di lnga la/ /re re la yang gsum gsum yin/ /zhes rim pa lnga'i rdzogs rim gyi rnal 'byor nyams su blang ba ni logs su shes par bya'o//gsum pa mjug chog tshogs brlab drang //rtog bsal spyir 'bul thog ma dang //bar mtha' lhag ma sgo dbye dpang //bstan skyong ho mthojo ra 'phe/ bro//dngos grub gagasol bsdudang bsrung //

sang rgyas thams cad dang mnyam par sbyor ba dpal yang dag zla gam dgu pa'i wen las kyi rgyud don snang byed/ nang ma (ka)smon lam shis brjod bcu dgu'i khrigs//dang po tsho gos rdzas byin brlab ni//stegs kyi khar gcan gzan gyi pags pa lta bu'i gdan la/me sa dang ma dan gtso bor gyur pa'i bza' bca'i rim pa rnams bkod pa la dmigs te/khrag 'thung gal po las/oṃ dbang g.yi du kro lha shwa rī ma byin gyi bas pa'i drisabasgo bar gad po dang dgos lams/kro dhī shwa ri sarba dra bye sho bhā ya hūṃ phaṭa/ā 'as rang bzhin bdud rtsi chu//rdzas la spros te thim pas ni//gzung 'dzin mtshan ma thams cad kun//chos kyi dbyings su rnam par dag/raṃ gyis rtog pa me yis bsregs//ye shes rlung gis gtore byas nas//chu yis rnam par dag pa ni//raṃ yaṃ khaṃ gi mthulas byung //rin cen gzhed pa gyi las grub//tre las zhal zas rin po che//ma/ rat+na te lo kya lpa ra ṇa phaṭa//hūṃ gi 'phro 'dus dag par sbyangs//āḥlas bdud rtsi dri ma med//oṃ las 'dod yon lha mo yis//nam mkha'i 26bakhims kun gang bar bsam//oṃ āḥsnyi/zhes brjod/gnyis pa mchod yul spyan drang ba/hūṃ/dpal chen yang dag he ru gaḥ//go rī la sogs lha mo brgyad//zla gam dgu pa'i dkyil 'khor pa//ma lus tshogos la spyan 'dren gshegs//ru lu sogs spyan 'dren dus kyi sngags dang bcas spyan drangs/sgrub ga kho la ge dze pa snga stir spyi skad dang mas/gsum pa rnam rtog bsal ba ni/ /me sa dang ma da na sogs bteg la/ khrag 'thung gal po las/ hūṃ/gzigs shig mdzes pa dam pa'i chos//'di la the tshom byar mi rung //bram ze khyi dang gdol pa gsum//rang bzhin gcig tu dgongs la gsol//zhes drangs/a la la sngo//bde bar gshegs so cho so kyi mchog/gzung 'dzin dri ma med pa yi//'dod chags dri ma dang bral ba//de kho na nyid bdag cag 'tshal//a ho mahā su kha lho bzhi pa rtsa gsum spyir mchod pa/khrag 'thung gal po las/hūṃ/spos dang me rtag mar me dri//ye shes bzhi las shar ba yi//me long 'phreng ba gling bu gar//gzugs ni rnam snang mdzad ldo'abul//dri ni rin cen 'byung ldan la//sgra ni snang ba mtha' yas nyid//ro ni don yod grub pa ste/reg ni rdo rje sems dpar 'bul//cha ru lu ru lu hūṃ bh+yo hūṃ/sarba ta thā ga tā nī/rū pa/shasta/ga rnye/rā sa/spar+sha/sto ga ṇa tsakra pā dza me gha pra titsā lho zhes spyir mchod pa'i yin la/tshogs kyi yo byad a mong du

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (25)bteg la/ hūṃ/ bla med mchog gi mchod pa dam pa 'di/ /ye shes lnga yi 'od zer rnam par 'phro/ /'dod pa'i yon tan lnga yis rab brgyan te/ /bla ma yi dam lha tsho gos rnams la 'bul/ /oṃ gu ru de wa ḍā ki ni ga ṇa tsakra khā hi/ zhes brjod/ (27na)lnga pa phud gsum thog ma ni/ hūṃ/ nam mkha' mdzod kyi sgo phye mchod pa'i sprin/ /sa dang bar snang nam mkha'i khyon bkang ste/ /yang dag thugs kyi dkyil 'khor lha tsho gis dang / /dam can bka' sdod srung ma'i tshogs la 'bul/ /oṃ badz+ra kro dha shrī he ru ka sa pa ri wā ra ga ṇa tsakra pā dza me gha sa mu dra lpa ra ṇa sa mā ya shri ye hūṃ/ zhes yab kyi g.yon zhal gtso bor byas te lha tshogs thams cad la phul bsadagyes pa chen pos mnyes nas bdag la dngos grub rnam gnyis stsol bar bsam/ drug pa bar pa bshags pa ni/ khrag 'thung gal po las/ hūṃ/ kun gzhi'i slong nas rang byung ye shegashar/ /ji ltar snang ba lha yi dkyil 'khor du/ /nongs pa'i las su gyur pa thams cad kun/ /gnyis su med pa'i ngang du bshags par bgyi/ /yig brgya brjod/ bdun pa tha ma nya bo bsgral/ khrag 'thung gal po'i rgyud kyi brtag pa bcu gsum pa nas bsgral las mdo tsam gsungs pa'i don bzhin 'brub khung phur pa sgrol gri sogs 'du byas/ su bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ e las gnam lcags kyi khang sgrom nag po kha dog cing mthil yangs pa 'jigs su rung ba'i nang du : dang tri las gnod byed dgra bgegs kyi tshogs rnams yan lag lcags sgrog gis bsdams shing nyam thag mya ngan gyi 'dug stangs can du bsams la/ dgug pa gzhug bklags pas don grub las/ 'dod rgyal gyi phyag rgya bcas la/ na mo rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang /sangs rgyas dang chos dang dge 'dun gyi bka' bden pa dang / 'jam dpal sku/ pad+ma (27bsko sung /yang dag thugs/ bdud rtsi yon tan/ phur pa 'phrin las/ ma mo rbod gtong / dmod pa drag sngags/'jig rten mchod bstod/ 'dus pa mdo/ sgyu 'phrul rgyan/ 'chi med tshe/ lhun grub rigs 'dzin/ snying po phyag rgya/ gsang sngags/ rig sngags/ gzungs sngags kyi lha tsho gos rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang /—328

sangs rgyas tham cad dang mnyam par sbyor bod pa la yang dag zla gam dgu pa'i 'phrin las kyi rgyud don snang byed/ nang ma (ka)bka' sdod chos skyong /ma mo mkha' 'gro/dam can rgya mtsho/rigs 'dzin rnal 'byor/chos smi rnam par dag pa'i bka' bden pa dang /bden pa yang dag pa dang /bden pa chen po'i byin gyis brlabs kyis/bla ma'i sku dgra/bstan pa yongs dgra/dam tshig can gyi sdang dgra/sems can yongs la 'tshe ba'i gnod byed/gdug pa can gang ci mchis pa de dag thams cad badz+ra a du sha dzaḥbadz+ra pā sha hūṃ/badz+ra slo ṭa baṃ/badz+ra ghaṇ+ḍa ho badz+ra a be sha ya/sarba sha / nā sha ya/byung ya/sto bha ya/mo ha ya/1 ya/mā ra ya/zhes ci rigs pa brjod rjes/bskul ba ni/khrag 'thung gal po las/hūṃ/rak+ta'i rgya mtsho chen po 'khyil ba'i dbus//keng rus chen po'i ri rab brtsigs pa'i steng //rdo rje brag chen gtamasapa'i sa gzhi la//rab 'jigs rdo rje 'bar ba'i gzhal yas khang //bskal pa'i me ltar 'bar ba'i klong dkyil na//dpal chen 'khor tsho gos mtha' yas bzhugs pa ni//ye shes tshad med sprul pa'i thabs mnga' bas//gang mos dag la de bzhin skur snang zhing //ci la ci 'dul bzhin du cha lugasaston//thugs mtshan sna tsho gis mtshon cha'i char 'bebs shing //ru lu'i sngags kyi sgra sgrogs tsā ga stong ldir//gzi brjid spyan ldog me stag tsha tsha lo//zhal gdangs mche gcigs dug gsum zhal du rngub//mngags pa'i pho nya mgyogs2nya byed glog stong 'gyu//bdud rtsi dmar gyi arnya rgyun gyis mchode//'dzab dbyangs sngags kyi 'phreng bas rgyud bskul na//'dul 'os bsgral ba'i zhing du gyur to 'tshal//byin rlabs tsham rngam drag pos gdug pa sgrol//ru lu'i mthar/oṃ lo hūṃ lo/byung nai/mo ha gha ta ya/bha ga wā na/saḥlha wi kri badz+ra hūṃ kā ra hūṃ/badz+ra gī li gī lā ya/dzaḥ& baṃ hoḥsarba 4 badz+ra ki li gī lā ya hūṃ phaṭa/ces phur pa bsgril zhing snying dkar nag gi mtshams su btab ste rnam shes mi bskyod pa'i zhing du spar/tshe lhag tshur bsdus pas tshe la dbang ba'i rigs 'dzin brnyes par bsam/slar yang sngags dang bcas rkang pa g.yas pa nas rim bzhin gtubs te sman raka sbran zhing stob pa ni/khrag 'thung gal po las/ hūṃ/ dur khrod mchog gi gnas 'di sa /zhing chen gsar rnying ti rar bcas/ /dmar gyi arnya rgya mtshor bskyil//mkha' 'gro 'bar 9ba'i tshogs bcas bzhes//oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa kro dha kha

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (25)kha/ khā hi khā hi/ zhes dgra bgegs kyi sha khrag zhal du bstabs pas/ hūṃ/ nga ni za byed chen po ste/khams gsum ma lus bsgral ba dang / /gdul dka' ma lus 'dul ba'i phyir/ sha rus la sogasabaza' bar bya/ /zhes gsol bas dgyes pa chen pos tshim par bsams la/ rnal 'byor pa rnams sred pa sogs gsog 'jog dang bral zhing 'dod yon lam du byed pa'i mos pas tshogs la rol/ brgyad pa lhag ma gtong ba ni/ /lhag ma rnams bsdus la cud zad spags/ /lhag phud so sor sman ra/sbran/ nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgya bcas la/ oṃ gu ru kro ṅgā rat+na sa ma ya pi sha purba burnya k+ṣe tra pā la k+ṣa bha kā ra hūṃ phaṭa/ (28ba༄sa 'dod yon lnga'i bdud rtsir byin gyis brlabs/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros pas lhag phud la dbang ba'i ḍā ki rnams spyan drangs par bsams la/ 'phrin las rgya mtsho las/ las kyi rdo rje byed par dbang bskur ba'i/ /dbang phyug mkha' 'gro rdo rje gi gi tshogs/ /sngon gyi thugs dam dam tshig rjes dgongs la/ /dam can lhag ma'i lha tsho gos 'dir 'dus shig /e a ra li lha hri/ zhes brjod pas byon/ khrag 'thung gal po las/ hūṃ ha he phaṭa bh+yo/ dbyings nas rnam par bskul ba dang / /byin gyis yang dag brlabs pa dang / /thabs chen yab tu bstan pa dang / shes rab yum du gnas pa dang / khro mo go rī brgyad rnams dang / /yul gyi phra men chen mo dang / /ye shes sgo ma bzhi po rnams/ /yar gyi gnas bdun dkyil 'khor mchod/ /oṃ badz+ra ḍā gi ni pra la i me ba yin hūṃ/oṃ burnya ḍā ki ni pra la i me ba yin oṃ/ oṃ rat+na ḍā gi ni pra la i mo ba yin tho/ oṃ pad+ma ḍā gi ni bra la i me ba yin gyi ma rkadze ḍā ki ni pra la paṃ ba yin aḥ zhes 'bul/ bklags pas don grub pas/ hūṃ/ dang por phud kyis mi mchod du/ /he ru ka ni phud kyi bdag /bar du tsho gos la mi rol du/ /ma tshogs dbang phyug tshogs kyi bdag /bka' yi pham phabs mi gsol du/ khyed rnams nged kyi bran dang g.yog /lhag ma kha phrus mi btab tu/ /rje dang 'bangs su khyad par che/ /rnam gsum gcig tu mi bsre sa /lhag ma'i gnas su khyad par med/ /ye shes sgyu ma'i sangs rgyas dang / /log rtog sgyu ma'i sems can rnams/ /ye shes log rtog khyad che yang / /sgyu mar sangs rgyas sems can mnyam/ /zhes 330

sangs rgyas tham cad dang mnyam par spyor ba dpal yang dag zla gam dgu pa'i 'phrin las kyi rgyud don snang byed/ nang ma (ka)brjod/ cha tshu〉mi ba kla ta bhak+ṣa gi swāhā/ (29na tshe pos lhag ma la kha chus bran/ ru lu 'bru brgyad dang khyung gshog gi phyag rgyas zil gyis mnan/ khrag 'thung gal po las/ hūṃ/ rdo phrul mkha' la 'gro ba'i sum cu gnyis/ /spyor dang sgrol la dga' ba'i ging chen brgyad/ /laṅka tshar gsum rtogs tshad 'bul ba dang / /lusang ga yid kyis gnod pa'i 'bar ma brgyad/ /bdud srin ma ma bdun dang sring mo bzhi/ /drug cu rtsa bzhi dag gi pho nya rnams/ /lhag ma dag la dbang ba'i gnas drug yin/ /nyi shu rtsa brgyad phud lhag dag la dbang / /mar gyi gnas bdun so so'i gtor ma long / /bcol ba'i 'phrin las ma lusasgrub par mdzod/ /tsod tor tsod tor/ khre sa she sa/ par pa ti par pa ti/ re ma ma ra/ tra ma mu ti hūṃ/khā hi khā hi/ zhing snar zhing snar/ pa tra pa tra/ shu la shu la/ rkarma rag sha/ pi bh+yo/ bh+yo bh+yo bh+yo bh+yo ma ma bh+yo dza/ thog raka se ta tsa ra sam ya bh+yo trag raka trag raka ma ma bh+yo ma ma ru lu hūṃ bh+yo hūṃ/ dz+wa la dz+wa la sam ya ru lu bh+yo/ du ne du ba sam ya ru lu ru lu bh+yo/ mahā pañtsa a khra ta arnya pra titsā ho/ zhes brjod/dgu pa sgo dbye lam bstan pa/ /hūṃ dkyil 'khor phyogs mtshams bsrung ba yi/ /phra man sna tsho gos mtsho ni cha 'dzin/ shar phyogs rgyal po yul 'khor srung / /lho phyogs rgyal po 'phags skyes po/ /nub phyogs rgyal po spyan mi bzang / /byang phyogs rgyal po rnam thos sras/ /rang rang sdodapung 'khor dang bcas/ /sgo 'phrang lam gyi lha klu rnams/ /gzhan du sku gzugs gtor ma phye/ /drag po zor gyi dmag sna drongs/ /dgra dang bgegs kyi dpung tsho gos steng / /mngon spyod 'phrin las sgrub par mdzod/ /ces brjod/ brgya pa dbang dang gzu gsol ba/ /hūṃ/ rtsab brgyud pa'i (29ba'i gas 'dzin bla mdang / /sgrub pa sdebargyad yi dam dkyil 'khor lha/ khyad par khrag 'thung yang dag lha tsho gos rnams/ /sgrib bral ye shes spyan gyis nye bar dgongs/ /bsgral ba'i yul gyur dam nyams dgra bgegs 'di/ /'gro la bde skyid 'byung ba'i phan bde'i sgo/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa 'jig pa'i rtsa ba byas/ /bye brag nges gsang rdo rje theg pa yi/ /gtsug lag chos 'khor thos bsam sgom grwa gtor/ /mtshan ldan rdo rje'i slob dpon sku la bsngos/ /dkon cog gsum gyi dbu 'phang gnyan po smad/ /rigs 'dzin sgrub pa po rnams yongs —331

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()la brnyas//yi dam chos skyong srung ma khyad du bsad//'dis ni 'grob mang po 'phung du bcug/mtshams med lnga dang nye ba'i las mang bsags//zhing bcu tshang ba'i mi bsrun gdug can 'di//ring por 'tsho na rang gzhan mtha' dag 'phung //de phyir 'di yi tshe bstungs srog rtsa cho de/khyim shes yab yum mkhar 'phangs sras su bskrun/sha khrag rus pa nang khrol tsho gis rol nas//rnal 'byor bdag gi mgon skyabs dpung ga 'a ོ//dpal wo khrag 'thung thugs rje rgyang ma ring //chos skyong sdo brgyad tshogasarnams rtsal ma zhan//dgra bo mi nor ldebacas lha srung dang //phrol la gnod byed gshed ma'i lag tu sprod//lo zlar ma 'jog drag po'i las kyis sgrol//bcu gcig bstan ṣ+ka ma lhar so la geng tshig mthosabaskul na 'phangs zin pa'i bshal chus blta ma skyong ba dang la lar bska skyong gi gtor ma zur du byed pa mang na'ang bklag pasadon grub dang tshon las rgya 7 kha skong dang sa pa'i rje su gongs na spyod pa yin/skyong chad mtho bsgrag/gtor ma rnams thebs phyogs su bteg/bklags pas don grub las/ho/bod khams skyong ba'i bstan ma bcu gnyis dpal chen po'i pham phabs las mnos te/rnal 30na ) 'byor pa'i stong grogs la/nag mo bzhin mi sdug gi bu mo bdud mo chen mo bzhi dang /dmar mo khro gnyer can gyi bu mo gnod sbyin chen mo bzhi dang /dkar sham bzhin bzang gi bu mo sman btsun ma chen po bzhi rnams sngon gyi thugasadam las ma 'da' bar 'dir gshegs shig/dzaḥ& baṃ sngo'o gi ni hūṃ dzaḥ.e a ra li/lha hri/zhesapas dgug/khyung gshog gi phyag rgyas zil gyis mnan la/hūṃ/bga' yi bran g.yog tsho gos dang bcas nyid du//dpal ldan khrag 'thung de bzhin nam mkha'i sku//tshur gshegs tshur gshegs bstan pa skyong ba rnams//sngon gyi thugs dam dam tshig rjes dgongs la//'dir gshegs dam dgongs mchode sbyin gtor ma bzhes//rnal 'byor bcol ba'i 'phrin las grub par mdzod//bdag nyid chen mo rdo rje kun grags ma//dpal ldan ha ri rdo rje g.ya' ma skyong //gangs kyi yum chen rdo rje kun tu bzang //'brog chen 'khor 'dul rdo rje bgegs kyi gtso//bdud kyi bu mo chen mo khyed bzhi yang //sngon gyi thugs dam dam tshig rjes dgongs la/bran dang g.yog 'khor mang po'i tsho gis dang bcas//lhab lhub rin cen

sangs rgyas tham cad dang mnyam par sbyor ba dpal yang dag zla gam dgu pa'i 'phrin las kyi rgyud don snang byed/ nang ma (ka)mang po'i rgyan dang bcas/ /'dir gshegs dam dgongs mchode sbyin gtor ma bzhes/ /rnal 'byor bcol ba'i las rnams grub par mdzod/ /gangs dkar sha med rdo rje g.yu bun ma/ kha rag khyung btsun rdo rje dpal gyi yum/ /gser byu mkha' rgyu rdo rje rlung mo dang / /sma ri rab stims rdo rje drag mo rgyal/ /gnod sbyin bu mo chen mo khyed bzhi yang / /sngon gyi sogs(30ba)gong bzhin sbyar/ /kong btsun de mo rdo rje bod khams skyong / /btsan la la ro rdo rje sman gcig ma/ /sman btsun lkug chos rdo rje g.yar mo bsil/ /g.yu yi dril bu rdo rje gzugs legs ma/ /sman btsun bu mo chen mo khyed bzhi yang / /sngon sogs sbyar/ che zhes chen mo khyed rnams kyang / /rdo rje thod 'phreng spyan snga sa /zhing chen tsho gis kyisamachod bkram nas/ /rnam lnga bdud rtsi'i longs spyod kyis/ /dbang bskur ming btags dam mnos te/ /thar pa thob pa'i ming btags nas/ /lag tu rdo rje byin nas ni/ /rdo rje 'chang gi gral du bzhag /ji ltar khas blangs dam bcas bzhin/ /rnal 'byor sgrub pa'i grogs byos shig /dgra bgegs thamasacad 'dul ba dang / /nad rnams thams cad bzlog pa dang / /bsam pa thams cad bsgrub bya'i phyir/ /bka' yi gtor ma 'di long la/ /bcol ba'i las rnams sgrub par mdzod/ /dam tshig 'di las ma 'da' zhig /dam tshig 'di las 'das gyur na/ /rdo rje yak+ṣa khros pa yis/ /snying gi dkyil nas khrag drangs nas/ /'o dod 'bod par gdon mi za/ /de bas bdag gis bco pob yi/ /'phrin las thamasacad grub par mdzod/ khres bstan ma dang chad mtho ni/ /hūṃ/ slob dpon chen po hūṃ chen kā ra dang / /sangs rgyas gnyis pa pad+ma thod 'phreng sogs/ /rigs 'dzin grub brnyes spyan sngar zhal bzhes pa'i/ /gnas kyi ma mo yul gyi phra men brgyad/ /mgon po bdun cu mkha' 'gro sum cu gnyis/ /ma bdun sring bzhi dbang phyug nyi shu brgyad/ /bstan ma gnyis la sogs he ru ga'i/ /pham phabs gtogos(31na)rnams badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes spyan drangs nas rtse lugs kha stong hu lun ta'i chu rgyun du byang chub lam sgron nas blangs pa tshig ring thung yod pa rnams cung zad bcos pa 'di ltar/ bh+yo/ sngon gyi bskal pa dang po'i dus nyid na/ /'og min chos kyi dbyings kyi pho brang du/ /dpal chen gar gyi dbang phyug chen po des/ /—333—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (25)srid pa'i ma mo dam la btags pa'i tshe/ /go rī la sogs gnas kyi ma mo brgyad/ /sidha la sogs yul gyi phra men brgyad/ /rta gdong la sogs ye shes sgo ma bzhi/ /so so'i gzugs mchogo dam pa bstan nas kyang / /bga' yi gtor ma len par ma chad dam/ /bcol ba'i 'phrin las sgrub par ma chad dam/ /sngon tshe zhal bzhes dam las ma 'da' bar/ /'dir spyon lo byung bka' yi gtor ma long / /rnal 'byor bcol ba'i 'phrin las grub par mdzod/ /bh+yo/ dus skabs de nyid 'das pa'i 'og rol tu/ /rgya gar rdo rje gdan gyi gtsug lag tu/ /slob dpon r+pā po dga' rab rdo rje yis/ /rdo rje dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor zhal phye tshe/ /mgon po wo bo bdun cu rtsa gnyis dang / /mkha' 'gro r+ṣa mo sum cu rtsa gnyis kyis/ /so so'i gzugs ma ga dam pa bstan nas kyang / /bka' yi gtor ma len par ma chad dam/ /bcol ba'i 'phrin las sgrub par ma chad dam/ /sngon tshe zhal bzhes dam las ma 'da' bar/ /'dir spyon ༅ byung bka' yi gtor ma long / /rnal 'byor bcol ba'i tshon las grub par mdzod/ /bh+yo/ dus skabs de nyid 'das pa'i 'og rol tu/ /lho brag mkhar chu dpal gyi dben gnas su/ /slob dpon (31bsnin po nam mkha'i snying po yis/ /rdo rje phur pa'i dkyil 'khor zhal phye tshe/ /gnam lcags phur pa brag la btab nas kyang / /ma bdun sring bzhi 'khor dang bcas rnams kyis/ /so so'i gzugs mchog dam la bstan nas kyang / /bka' yi gtor ma len par ma chad dam/ /bcol ba'i 'phrin las sgrub par ma chad dam/ /sngon tshe zhal bzhes dam las ma 'da' bar/ /'dir spyon med byung bka' yi gtor ma long / /rnal 'byor bcol ba'i 'phrin las grub par mdzod/ /bh+yo/ dus skabs de nyid 'das pa'i 'og rol tu/ /sba gro stag tshang seng ge'i brag phug tu/ /slob dpon chen po dpal gyi seng ge yis/ /yang dag lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor zhal phye tshe/ /dbang phyug chen mo nyi shu rtsa brgyad kyis/ /so so'i gzugs mchogo dam pa bstan nas kyang / /bka' yi gtor ma len par ma chad dam/ /bcol ba'i 'phrin las grub par ma chad dam/ /sngon tshe zhal bzhes dam las ma 'da' bar/ /'dir spyon ༅ byung bka' yi gtor ma long / /rnal 'byor bcol ba'i 'phrin las grub —334

sangs rgyas tham cad dang mnyam par sbyor ba dpal yang dag zla gam dgu pa'i 'phrin las kyi rgyud don snang byed/ nang ma (ka)par mdzod/ /bh+yo/ dus skabs de nyid 'das pa'i 'og rol tu/ /g.yo ru yar klungs gad kyi phugasaring der/ /slob dpon chen po dzñā na kumā ras/ /phun sum tsho gos pa'i dkyil 'khor zhal phye tshe/ /ce sbyang ma sogs 'khor dang bcas rnams kyis/ /so so'i gzugs mchogo dam pa bstan nas kyang / /bka' yi gtor ma len par ma chad dam/ /bcol ba'i 'phrin las sgrub par ma chad dam/ /sngon tshe zhal bzhes dam las ma 'da' bar/ /'dir spyon rmad byung bka' yi gtor ma (32na〉sgong / /rnal 'byor bcol ba'i 'phrin las grub par mdzod/ /bh+yo/ dus skabs de nyid 'das pa'i 'og rol tu/ /brag dmar bsam yas chu rgyun ne'u gsing du/ /slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis/ /man ngag lta ba'i rdzong 'phreng bshad pa'i tshe/ /dam sri rnam gsum rdul du brlag nas kyang / /bod khams skyong ba'i bstan ma bcu gnyis kyis/ /so so'i gzugs mchag dam pa bstan nas kyang / /rang rang srog gi snying po phul nas su/ /bka' yi gtor ma len par ma chad dam/ /bcol ba'i 'phrin las sgrub par ma chad dam/ /sngon tshe zhal bzhes dam las ma 'da' bar/ /'dir spyon med byung bka' yi gtor ma long / /rnal 'byor bcol ba'i 'phrin las grub par mdzod/ /mahā pañtsa 'a hi/ mahā rak+ta khā hi/ mahā ba lin+ta khā hi/ zhes wen las bcol/ bcu gnyis zor gyi las sbyor ni/ bklags pas don grub lasacung zad kha bsgyur ba/ 'jam dpal sku yi lha tsho gos kyis/ /do nub zor gyi las mdzod cig /de bzhin du/ pad+ma gsung gi lha/ yang dag thugs kyi lha/ bdud rtsi yon tan/ phur pa 'phrin las/ ma mo rbod gtong / rigs 'dzin slob dpon/ 'jig rten mchod bstod/ dmod pa drag sngags/ khyad par khrag 'thung he ru das/ /yum chen kro dhī shwa rī mas/ /'khor gyi ma mo brgyad rnams kyis/ /dbang phyug nyi shu rtsa brgyad kyis/ /sprul pa yang sprul pho nya yis/ /chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs rnams kyis/ /rigs 'dzin rtsal can 'khor bcas sa/ /do nub zor gyi las mdzod cig /(32brko nub zor kha g.yi po 'di/ /steng gi lha la mi zor ro/ /lha gshegs gangs dkar rtse la gshegs/ /zor lam gnyan po da phye zhig /de bzhin du 'don pa bsgyur te/ do nub/ bar gyi bsdo la/ btsan gshegs brag dmar ngos la/ do nub —333—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (25)྾/ /'og gi klu las/ /rgya mtsho'i gting dus/ /do nub zor kha gnyan po 'di/ /yas kyi bdud g.yos shig la zor/ /de bzhin du/ mas kyi sri langs/ pha tshan rgya 'dre can / ma bu'i byur 'dre can /yul mi gdong 'dre can la/ sdang dgra gnod pa'i bgegs/ phung sri'i snying gi dkyil du/ byur sri'i klad pa'i dkyil du/ nyams pa'i snying gi dkyil du/ rmi lam ngan sdigs byed la zor/ /mo ngan mthu sdigasabyed la zor/ /zhes bskul bas gtor ma dug thun du bsams te dgra'i rnam shes mar me lta bu la phog pas bsad cing bsgral bar bsams la/ thebs phyogs dang bstun nas gtor ma 'phang / bsgral mchod kyi sngags sbyor/ bcu gsum sgoms du khams gsum yongs su brdzas zhing srid gsum dbang du bas ba'i phyir glu bro brdung zhes yang / pa bro brdung bya ba ni/ gtor snod kha spub ste/ khrag 'thung gal po'i brtag pa bcu par yod pa dang phur pa'i bro 'dra min 'dug pa brjod bde khyad nas bklags pas don grub las/ hūṃ/dang po gti mug nyid las byung / /bar du gti mug nyid kyis 'khor/ /tha mar gti mug nyid kyisa'adul/ /gti mug rdo rje 'khor bcas kyis/ /dngul lam dkar po'i shing dag la/ /mgo bo rgya mdud rtse mo zlum/ /logs la zhi ba'i lha bsgoms te/ khong stong byang chub sems(33na〉yung bstan/ /rtse mo zlum po btab pa yis/ /thams cad ma lus zhi bar 'gyur/ /zhi bar ma gyur gang yang med/ /zhi mdzad lha la phyag 'tshal lo/ /oṃ ru lu ru lu hūṃ bh+yo hūṃ shān+ti ku ru swā hā/ de bzhin du 'don pa bsgyur la/ dang po nga rgyal/ bar du/ tha ma/ nga rgyal rdo rje/ gser ram ser po'i/ mgo bo rgya mdud rtse zur bzhi/ logs la rgyas/ khong stong / rtse mo zur bzhi/ thams cad ma lus/ rgyas par/ rgyas mdzad/ ru lu'i mjug tu ā yu ṣe pu lja ku ru oṃ/ dang po 'dod chags/ bar du/ tha ma/ 'dod chags rdo rje/ zangs sam dmar po'i/mgo bo rgya mdud rtse zla gam/ logs la dbang gi /khong stong / rtse mo zla gam/ thams cad/ dbang du/dbang sdud lha la/ ru lu'i mjug tu 〉 rdzo tu wa she ku ru ho/ dang po zhe sdang / bar du/ tha ma/ zhe sdang rdo rje/ lcags sam nag po'i/ mgo bo rgya mdud rtse zur gsum/ logs la drag po'i/ khong stong / rtse mo zur gsum/ thams cad ma lus brlag par 'gyur/ brlag par ma gyur/ drag po'i lha la/ ru lu'i —336

sang rgyas thams cad dang 47 par sbyor ga dpal yang dag zla g.yodagu pa'i mun las kyi rgyud don snang byed/ nang ma (ka)mjug tu sha / mā ra ya hūṃ phaṭa/ ces las bzhi'i bro brdung ngo / /bcu bzhi tshe 'gugs dngos grub blang / /khrag 'thung gal po las/ hūṃ/ ye shes lha dang rigasa'adzin mkha' 'gro'i tshogs/ /da ni sgrub pa'i zhag grangs tshang lags so/ /da ni sgrub pa'i nam yang langs lags so/ /bzlas brjod bsnyen pa'i grangs kyang tshang lags so/ /phyi nang mchod pa'i grangasakyang tshang lags so/ /zhag grangs dam bcas bsnyen pa mthar dbyung ste/ /ye shes 'od zer zhabrugs(33bskos mchog bsnol nas/ /bzlas brjod bsnyen pa'i grangs ni khyed la 'bul/ /dmigasabasam 'grub pa'i dngos grub bdag la stsol/ /mkhas rtogs cho me kyi dngos grub bdag la stsol/ /g.yung drung tshe yi dngos grub bdag la stsol/ /dbang thang bu tsha'i dngos grub bdag la stsol/ /mdzod ldan nor gyi dngos grub bdag la stsol/ /rgya mtsho'i klu yi dngos grub bdag la stsol/ /mas dang rtsal gyi dngos grub bdag la stsol/ /sprul pa 'gyed pa'i dngos grub bdag la stsol/ /'phrin las rnam bzhi'i dngos grub bdag la stsol/ /dpal chen sku dang gsung dang thugs dang gsum/ /chos kyi sku dang longs sku sprul pa'i sku/ /ngo bo nyid sku'i dngos grub bdag la stsol/ /sirnyi pha la a la la ho/ zhes sgrub chen gyi tshe dngos grub kyi rdzas rnams bcas/ rgyas par len pa dkyil chog gi mjug gi sa bcad gnyis pas ma spros shing 'dir nye bar mkho ba ni tshe rdzas tsam dang bcas tshe 'gugs kyi tshul du len pa sngags rnying ma la drag las kyi mjug tu tshe 'gugs par bshad pas 'grel chags/ bco lnga gtang rag bzod gsol ba/ /hūṃ/ yang dag khrag 'thung lha dgu'i tshogs rnams la/ /phyi nang nyer spyod sman gtor rak+ta sogs/ /dngos bshams yid kyis sprul pa'i mchod pa 'bul/ /brtse bas bzhes te dngos grub rnam gnyis stsol/ /oṃ badz+ra kro dha shrī he ru ka sa pa ri wā ra / nas sha lta bra la swā hā'i bar dang /mahā pañtsa a mṛ ta kha raṃ khā hi/ ma hā ba lin+ta kha raṃ khā hi/ ma hā rak+ta kha raṃ khā hi/ zhes dang / de rjesabaklag pas don grub las byung ba ltar/ yig brgya'i mthar/ ma 'byor ba dang nas/ bzod (34na)par mdzod/ khyed kyis sems can gyi khams la rjes su brtse bas bka' stsal zhing dkyil 'khor byin —337

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()gyis brlabs te/sems can gyi don mdzad na so so skye bo rnal 'byor la dbang ma thob pa rnams bskyud nges pa'am/yo byad ma tshang ba la sogs pa nyes pa gang cung zad ci mchis pa de dag bzod par mdzad du gsol/ces brjod do//bcu drug dkyil 'khor nyer bsdu ni//oṃ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad//ces sogs kyi mthar sarba sa ma ya sa pa ri wā ra la zhes gtore mgron du spyan drangs pa sogs dam can rnams gshegs su gsol/gsang ba me dpung 'bar ba'i le'u bco brgyad par/dkyil 'khor bsdu chog rgyas par gsungs pa ha cang mang drags pas don gyi snying po brjod bde ba/bklags pas don grub las/rang gi thugs ga'i hūṃ las 'od los pa snod bcud thams cad la phog pas 'od kyi rnam par 'dus/srung 'khor dur khrod gzhal yas khang la/de dag dkyil 'khor gyi lha la/de gtso bo yab yum la/yum yab la bsdus pas/rang gtso bo'i nga rgyal gyis spyod lam thamasacad rjes su spyad par bya'o//bcu bdun bdag nyid lus bsrung ba/sngags cung zad kha bsgyur ba'i dngos gzhi bklagasapas don grub las/oṃ shrī badz+ra he ru ka kro dha rak+ṣa hūṃ phaṭa/ces brjod pas/rang gzi brjid dang ldan par gyur/oṃ badz+ra ka pa tsa hūṃ phaṭa/ces lus la rdo rje'i go gyon pas bar chad kyis mi tshugs par bsam/de nas/rang bzhin sems kyi chos nyid ni//ma bcos lhug par gnas pa'i don//rtag chad ngo bo mtha' spangs shing //brjod bral 34bsgo bzhi las 'das pa//rtsol med gnas pa'i chosaṣ+ka de//ngo bo nyid kyis ma rdzo pa'o//oṃ a kā ro mu — sarba dha ṇi ār+ya yin tāta/ces pas chosa'athams cad gdod nas ma skyes pa'i de kho na nyid/bdag med rtogs pa'i lta bas rgyas gdab bo//bco brgyad smon lam gdab pa ni//theg mchog rnal 'byor zab rma nyams blangs pas//tshe 'dir rlung sems dag pa'i rdo rje sems/kha sbyor bdun ldan zung 'jug he ru gar//mngon la'i rgyas nas 'gro kun 'dren par shog/bcu dgu phun tshogs shis pa brjod//chos longs sprul gsum hūṃ chen kā ra dang //pad+ma thod 'phreng ga lhags chen dzñā na'i zhabs//klu daXng srung sogs gon ston gsang sngags 'chang //

sang rgya thams cad dang mnyam par sbyor ba dpal yang dag zla gam dgu pa'i 'phrin las kyi rgyud don snang byed/ nang ma zhanarigs 'dzin brgyud pa rnams kyi bkra shis shog /dran pa tsam gyis srid zhi'i gdung sel zhing / /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub char 'bebs pa/ /dpal chen yang dag khrag 'thung lha dgu yi/ /dkyil 'khor lha tsho gis rnams kyi bkra shis shog /dga' rab dbang phyug sdebacas ma lus pa/ /phye mar 'thag mdzad gnam lcags rdo rje'i thog /phra men ma sring dbang phyug nyer brgyad sogs/ /bka' srung dam can rgya mtsho'i bkra shis shog /gzhan yang shis brjod kyi rim pa ci rigs pa bya'o/ /sgrub sdebargyad las thugs mchag he ru gaḥ/ /dpal chen yang dag nyams bstar 'phrin las gzhung / /hūṃ chen kā ra pad+ma thod 'phreng sogs/ /'phags yul grub dbang bzhed srol pha mtha' yas /ljongs 'dir rgya tshe bka' dang zab mo'i gter/ /dar las 'khogo ston rig sngags 'chang ba'i lugs/ /saskya'i 'jam mgon rim byon yi dam du/ /mdzad pa mkhas rnams yid ches dga' (35na〉skyed gnas/ /'on te rgyud 'grel man ngag nam mkha'i mtha'/ /mkhyen pa'i pha wang gzhog pas ma chod par/ /phur ba'i lha sngags 'byin 'jug mun khung la/ /skyabs su bsten te rang mtshang ngoms pa bzhin/ /gong ma'i snyan brgyud rgyal po'i khri ma non/ /ngor rdzong spyo blon dra ma'i shul bor nas/ /sna bo'i yab chos yang phur mkhan po sa /rlom yang snga 'gyur brda la ma 'dris nongs/ /'jam dbyangs rigs kyi thig le snum po'i sa/ /༅ spyod rdul gyis skya bor sgyur byed pa'i/ /sngags 'chang chen por bsnyems de bzhi thog khrir/ /phud bzhes smar zhing ci bder gzims 'jam mdzod/ /dga' ldan bstan la tshul 'di grags chung zhing / /za hor brgyud pa'i pha chos ma yin kyang / /bka' gter ring lugs la lta'i mig yangs pas/ khyud don snang ba'i nyin byed 'di na shar/ /gsang chen rnying mar mkhas shing grub brnyes pa'i/ /bshes gnyen du ma'i zhabs rdul gtsug tor rtser/ /bsten pas gsar ma'i lhan par mi re ba'i snga 'gyur rang skad gtsang ma'i gos 'di btsems/ /dge 'dis thugs kyi rdo rje he ru ga'i/ /bskyed rdzogasardzogs chen nor bu'i them skas la/ /'dzegs nas bla med sku bzhi'i grong khyer cher/ /myur zhugs lus can mtha' dag 'dren par shog /gang snang khrag 'thung lha dgu'i gzugs su shar/ /sgra kun ru lugaser —339

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (25)'phreng gdangs su sgrogs/ /dran rtog bde chen zung 'jug rnam par rol/ /gsang gsum rgyan gyi 'khor lo'i ba po shis shog /sgrub sde chen po brgyad las yang dag thugs kyi rgyud man ngag la brten nas mchoge gi dngos grub brnyes pa slob dpon chen po hūṃ kā ra dang sangs rgyas gnyis pa pad+ma 'byung gnas gnyisakyi bzhed srol gnubs nam mkha'i snying po/ sna nam rdo rje bdud (35ba 'joms/ gnyags dzñā na kumā ra sogs rig pa 'dzin pa du mas dar bar mdzad pa'i bka' gter gyi lugs srol mtha' yasapa'i nang nas 'khon ston rig sngags 'chang ba rnams las brgyud de sa skya'i rje btsun gong ma rdo rje 'chang zhal gnyis pa rnams kyi thugs dam kyi gtso bor mdzad na'ang sgrub mchod sogs kyi srol rgyas pa mi snang bas bstan pa rin po che'i btsas su rgyud sdebazhi'i smin grol gar thig dbyangs rol so gos kyi 'grang gnas gong dkar rdo rje gdan gyi chos grwa chen por sgrub mchod 'dzugs pa'i mthun rkyen du byang thang ser grol dgon rten gsum/ mchod rdzas/ thab gdan chas/ lag 'bab nyis brgya skor/ spyil 'dzin them chung lnga dang bcas sa sprel sbyor 'jags byas rjes dpal yang dag zla gam dgu pa'i 'phrin las kyi rim pa rgyud don snang byed ces pa 'di ni chos sde'i bla spyi/ zur 'chang pa/ grwa dmangs sogs spyi tsho gos kyis 'bad pa chen pos bskul ba la brten nas go rim rnying ma bka' gter gyi lugs srol sor bzhag la/ cung zad gsar rtsom dgos pa tshor khungs ma smos shing de phyin khungs btsun pa dang byin rlabs kyi mtshan kha che ba'i slad du yang dag bka' ma'i rgyud rnams la gtso bor bzung ngos tsheg bar dang shad bar thengs so rnams kyi zur cung zad bzos/ hūṃ mdzad sgrub thabs dang rtsa ba so mchan gnyis kyi dgongs pa blangs/ rje btsun brtse ba chen po nas sa lo thams cad mkhyen pa'i bar gyi gdung brgyud rjes 'brangs dang bcas pa'i yig cha yin nges dkon zhing bdag bo sngags 'chang ba'i mngon rtogs der sa lo'i zla gam gcig pa'i sgrub thabs dang lha mo brgyad kyi mngon rtogs sogs thor bu yod tshul tsam las g.yin rnams la khungs skyel rgyu mi 'dug pa'i zla gam (36na sdon cig pa ma gtogs gzhan mi shes pa zhig gis sa lor kha g.yar ba 'dra snyam yid ches kyi gnas su ma gyur pa —340

sangs rgyas thams cad mnyam par sbyor ba dpal yang dag zla gam dgu pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga hūṃ mdzad zhal lung / nang ma (ka)nas/ kha cung zad 'gengs dgos rnams 'jug pa bde phyir thams cad mkhyen pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan la 'khrul pa mi mnga' bas bklags bas don grub dang rtse lugs kyi phur pa'i las byang ma bu sogs khungs smos pa rnams kyis brgyan te khyab bdag mkhan chen zha lu pa chen po rin cen bsod nams mchog grub kyis dkyil 'khor 'di nyid du legs par smin par mdzad cing zur thams cad mkhyen pa chos dbyings rang grol sogs yongs 'dzin rdo rje 'chang chos bzhin du spyod pa du ma'i bka' drin las gsang sngags snga 'gyur gyi dgongs don phyogs tsam rig pa'i za hor gyi sngags 'chang ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho 'jigs med go cha thub bstan lang tsho'i sdes bag yod kyi lo gro bzhin can gyi dkar cha'i bzang po gnyis pa'i tshes la rang byung 'phags pa'i gtsug lag dmar po rir sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni rigs 'dzin gyi btsun pa 'jam dbyangs grags pa'o// maṅga lo//sangs rgyas thams cad dang mnyam par sbyor ba dpal yang dag zla gam dgu pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga hūṃ mdzad zhal lung bzhugs/na mo gu ru ཿ satwa phya badz+ra ma hā shri ya/ sangs rgyas thams cad dang mnyam par sbyor ba dpal yang dag zla gam dgu pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga hūṃ mdzad zhal lung zhes bya ba/ rgyal kun mkhyen brtse nus pa'i bdag nyid mkhan chen zha lu pa tshe dbang lhun grub rab brtan bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po dang khrag 'thung thugs kyi rdo rje dbyer ma mchis par phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o/ /brtse ba chen pos rjes su gzung du gsol/ mtho ris dbang gi chu rgyun chad med bdag blo'i zhing sar rab drangs nas/ /sku bzhi'i sa bon yongs su dar drag lnga ldan ye shes sa bu'i khur/ /dud mdzad dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i byed po drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma dang / /dbyer med yang dag thugs kyi lha kye byang chub bar du rjes su zungs/ /'phags yul grub pa'i gtsug rgyan hūṃ kā ra/ /sangs rgyas gnyis pa pad+ma thod 341—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ smyona'aphreng rtsal//'ja' lus rdo rje'i sku brnyes bi mā la//rig 'dzin rim 2na thar byon rnams phyag gi gnas//sna nam gnyags dang so zur gnubs 'khon sogs//lha sngags ye shes 'khor le'i bdag nyid can//he ru gaḥdapal mi yi sgyu dra'i gar//sngags yong ral pa'i khur ldan tsho gis kun rgyal//shes rab stong nyid dag pa'i e dbyings su//thabs mchogo bde ba'i waṃ dbyibs zung 'jug las//lha be+e ga zhun ma'i gsang gsum 'khor lo'i rgyan//sa skya'i bla chen brgyud par bcas la 'dud//bka' drin zer gyis bdag blo pad+ma'i tshal//bas pas snga 'gyur chos kyi ze'u 'bru'i bas//smin grol sbrang rtsi 'dzad med byed pa po'i//yongs 'dzin wo mo'i mgon rnams gas na bsten//gsar 'gyur dbang gi chog ras bris la//nyer bsten lag len sa mādza drangs pa//hūṃ chen kā ra pad+ma thod 'phreng sogs//sngon rabs dam pa'i thugs la ma shar drang //lha tsam ngo sprod rgyu mas bshal chu yis//ma ngoms yang dag rgyud dang rgya 2bskor gzhung //rig 'dzin bzhed srol 'o ma'i bcud myangs mthus//dkyil 'khor cho ga hūṃ mdzad zhal lung 'dri//de la 'dir dpal yang dag mar me dgu pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga la sngon du 'gro ba/dngos gzhi/rjes kyi rim pa dang gsum las/dang po phun sum tshogs pa khro bo puṇ+ḍa no da'i le'u dang por phun sum tshogs pa phar bshad cing de dang mthun par hūṃ kā ras mdzad pa'i rtsa bar phun sum tshogs pa pha tso nas zhes byung la/de wo kyis mdzad ༅ dang chog yis sa/'khor/tso/yo byad/sa tso sum li par shad na'ang 'dir bas brgyad sogs sbyi dang mas par byas/lngas gzhi bzung ba/sa'i cho ga/sta gon gyi cho ga dang gsum las/dang po la/ston pa/'khor/gnas/sgrub rdzas/chos te lnga las/dang po ston so mag du shes pa tso sums pa zer/pa phun sum tshogs pa ni//dpal khrag 'thung gal po che'i rgyud las/shes pa phun sum tshogs pa ni//rdo rje bla ma slob dpon ni//rgyud lung man ngag rab 'bring tha//mi 'khrug sbyor ba'i sgyu rtsal shes//zhes dang /tan+t+ra he ru ka las/tsho gos kyi slob dpon bya ba yang //kun gyis bya bar ma gsungs te//lta ba gnyis med rtsol dang bral//spyod pa gsang ba'i bka' dang ldan//thabs mkhas 'phrin las thogs rdugs med//dam tshig 'jigaX med 'bar bzhin bsrung //dbang rnams rim par

sangs rgyas thams cad mnyam par sbyor ba dpal yang dag zla gam dgu pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga hūṃ mdzad zhal lung / nang ma (ka)brtsegs pa des/ /rig pa'i rgyal po rang dbang thob/ /de ni tsho gis kyi slob dpon yin/ /zhes dang /dbang gi slob dpon bya ba yang / /kun gyis bya bar ma gsungs te/ /rigs dang mkhas(3na〉 brgyud btsun dang / /rdo rje zam pa ma chad legs/ /de dag rnams dang ldan pa ni/ /'jig rten 'di na masadabang che/ /ma mo mkha' 'gro bran bzhin 'khol/ /de ni dbang gi slob dpon yin/ /zhes dang / slob dpon kun snying gis/ /brtan zhing dul ba blo gros ldan/ /bzod ldan drang la g.yo sgyu med/)sngagasadang rgyud kyi sbyor ba shes/ /dkyil 'khor 'dri ba'i las la mkhas/ /de nyid bcu ni yongs shes pa/ /'di ni slob dpon yin zhes bya/ de yis bstan pa'i gsang sngags rnams/ /'grub 'gyur 'di ni the tshom med/ /ces pa ltar lta ba thag chod pas ting nge 'dzin gsal ba/ spyod pa la dor bas man ngag la mkhas pa/ dgongs pa zab mo rnam par dag pa/ dam tshig gtsang zhing thos pas rgyud grol ba/ / thugasarje r+ṣa pos 'gro ba 'dul ba la mkhas pa'i rdo rje slob dpon no/ /gnyis pa 'khor so mig du thos bsam sgom pa gsal ba dang bcas shes rab bzhi dang nges pa gsum sogs dgosapar shad/ phun sum tsho gos pa ni/ tan+t+ra he ru ka las/ tshogs kyi rgyal tshab bya ba yang / /dper na rgyalapos bka' bsgo ba/ /de ni blon pos bsrung ba bzhi/ /dgongs spyod don dang ldan pa dang / /gas 'dren nus pa'i thabs mkhas dang / /slob dpon sku mnyel thun po pa'i/ /zhal tshab gzhan pa chos ston pa/ /tsho gos kyi rgyal tshab yin par bshad/ /tsho gos kyi ging zhes bya ba ni/ /rang gi sgos ched mi len par/ /rnal 'byor spyi ched dag la brtson/ /zhing bcur gyur pa sgrol byed cing / /dgongs pa'i las rgyud bstan par bya/ /tshogs(3ba〉kye yum zhes bya ba yang / /kun gyas bya bar ma gsungs te/ /gtso bo yab kyi dgongs pa skong / /yangs pa che la nogs pa chung / /gsang sgo sdom dang dam la gnas/ /dad pas mos dang rtog pa chung / /mtshan gyi rgyan dang sems bzang dang / khyu dang ldan pa ma gags pa/ /kun gyis bya bar ngas ma bshad/ /ces dang / dbang gi slob ma bya ba yang / shes pa sgo yangs thos pa che /bsgo ba bran bzhin nyan pa dang / /'di la dbang rnams bskur bar bya/ /zhes dang / khrag 'thung gal po —343

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()las/nyan bshad dbye ba rnam pa gnyis//tshogs dang slob ma dag tu 'dod//snod kyi gang zag rnam pa lnga/āt+pal pad+ma dkar dmar dang //sdo dan rin po che yi dpe//zhes dang /skyed byed yodang sring mo gnyis//las dang phyag rgya len pa'i 'khor//sgom 'chad las dang sgrol ba dang //ging g.yog gtsug lag brda shes pa//lusang ga yid dang yi ge'i brda//'khor rnams phun sum tsho gis 'gyur pa//dgyes pa bskyed pa'i gzung ma dang //mchod stob phyag tshang byan g.yos ma//thugs dang 'thad pa'i semasazin can//rdul phyags skyes bu ldan par bya//zhes blo brtan zhing sgam la brtson 'grus dang shes rab che ba/dbang po dul zhing dam tshig dang sdom pa la nan to du bya ba'i 'khor spyi dang bye brag tu rdo rje rgyal tshab/rdo rje rgyal thabs/gzung ma rdo rje rkarma/rdo rje ging mtshams pa/rdo rje spyan ma/rdo rje dus 'dzin/rdo rje g.yos ma/rdo rje rdul phyags sogs tshom bur 'brel ba'o//gsum pa khro bo srin ri dar yang 44da i gzha/gnas phun sum tshogs pa 4na ji/khrag 'thung gal po las/gnas mchog phun sum tsho gos pa btsal//ting 'dzin ye shes mchog lo|gnas//bkra shis dag pa chen po'i gnas//yid 'ong nyams ni rnam par dga'//de ni gnas kyi mchog yin te//yon tan ma lus kun ldan pa//dgos par bya ba gnas kyi gzhi//sgrub pa dus kyi gnas su bya//zhes dang /phyogs mtshams legs par rab brtag cing //nags tshal skyed mos tshal du ni//dgon pa rab dga' kun dga' ra//yul dang ljongs su brtag par bya//zhes dang /dpal he ru ga'i thugs kyi rgyud gal po las/zhi ba'i dgon gnas lha yi gnas//ri bo chen po 'dus pa'i rtse//gangs dkar shel gyi gtams pa'i 'dabs//gsang chen khros pa'i gnas dang ni//tsan dan nags dang me tog tshal//yid 'ong dben par rab tu bshad/khro bo'i dgon gnas srin po'i gnas//ri bo chen po btsan pa'i ngos//brag dmar gtams pa'i dkyil ngos la//stag dred 'thab pa'i gnas su bya//ma mo'i dgon gnas dur khrod dang /khren tu dben pa'i sa phyogs na//gsar rnying dbugs bral ma bdun khyim//rdo rje rigs kyi dgon gnas ni//dur khrod dang ni lha rten dang //ma mo'i khyim dang yid du 'ong //44

sangs rgyas thams cad mnyam par sbyor ba dpal yang dag zla gam dgu pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga hūṃ mdzad zhal lung / nang ma zhanazhes dang /bka' brgyad gsang rdzogs kyi rgyud las/ bkra shis gangs brgyud ri bzang 'dabs/ /gnam sa pad 'khor kha sbyar 'dra//sngon yang grub thob rkyen thub sar//sgrub khang pho brang lta bur brtsig/ces byung ba ltar skye bo'i ya kha dang //rje dpon lha 'dre gdug pa can/mi rgod/gcan gzan sogasakyis 'tshe ba 4ba thad pa/sa pad+ma 'dab brgyad/logs bkra shis rtags brgyad/gnam dbang go tu dmig bsal gyi gad cing shar dang byang gzhol phyogs gas mtho ba'ang rgyud gas nas༅da pa dang mas/'khor lo rtsibs brgyad dang ldan pa ste gnas spyi'i bkra sgomar du srung thog kyi lha mo kyis bshas gal zer/shis dge mtshan dang ldan zhing bye brag 'phrin las bzhi gang sol ga du phag snod khi ma na ye shes46kheganas zhesazer/sgrub skabs theb kyi dbye dgos na'ang gtso che ba'i dbang du byas nas drag po'i gnas gnam sa gru gsum pa dur khrod dam shing drung gcig pa ri sog po khros pa lta bu/gcan gzan 'du zhing shing tsher ma can gyi mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'o//bzhi pa sgrub rdzas phun sum tshogs pa ni/khrag 'thung gal po las/yo byad phun sum tsho gis pa ni//'tshe ba zas kyi yo byad kyis//bkres dang sgom pa'i dbul ba sel//rkyen sol ga du skul shā ṣ+ka snyol phe drag rdzas kyang shad/zlog sman gyi yo byad kyis//nad khamasadagra bgegs bar gcod sel//sgrub pa rdzas kyi yo byad kyis//med byung gsang ba'i rdzas rnams tshang //mchod pa rdzas kyi yo byad kyis//lha rnams thugs dam skong bar 'gyur//bkra shis gtsang ma'i rdzasatsho gis ni//rigs ni bzang po rab tu btsal//dag pa lha yi rdzas btsal ba//skye sgoms du rigs sto byad bzang smin dkyu ring nga mig dkar nag byed pa/sgro nag cing 'tshe ba/dung sgo 'khor gal ba po shis gtsang ma'i rdzas su bshad tsang shel mig dang rkan na tho lhag po yod pol yang gad/bdun bya rkang grib ma bdun//sgrub pa mchog sgoms las skyesagatso'u nu dpal rtsal dang ldan pa g.yul ngor ga4 shā rdzas la tsā yong /gi rdzas btsal ba//zhes thod sku/rdo rje la sogs pa sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las kyi rten/ldan ji nang gsang ba'i mchod rdzas/tshe dang gal sogs dngos grub kyi rdzas/'tsho ba'i zas skom/dgra zlog pa'i go mtshon/nad zlog pa'i sman/bgegs sel ba'i rdzas 'khor lo sogs yo /da ma tshang ba med pa sta gon du bya'o//

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()lnga pa chos phun sum tshogs pa ni/khrag 'thung gal po las a ho/lung chen zab mo'i 'khor lo 'di//dgongs brgyud sbas pa'i rgyud chen po//lung gi mdo chog snga ma bdun//de bzhin phyi ma bdun nas phyung //sku rnams ston pa'i sdud pa po//gsang bdag phyag na rdo rje nyid//bdag gzhan phyi rabasagrol mdzad pa//rdo rje snying po nyid kyis phyungs//phung po rdo rje rigs lnga nyid//nyon mongs ye shes wo por gsal//bar ho dngos grub ṣ+ka du grol//rdo rje'i sku la 6 bdag med/zhes dang /yang dag gsang ba'i thugs mchog la//sgrub pa'i rnal 'byor dbang phyug rnams//mi tshe gcig la mngon 'tshang rgya/ /lus ma bor bar lha skur 'gyur//zhes dang /rtsa ba las/yang dag grub pa gcig pu nyid//sangs rgyas bde chen kun 'dus pas//rnal 'byor zab mo sku gsum rdzogs//mkha' 'gro sgyu ma bde mchog bde//zhes nyams su blang bya'i chos spyir bskyed pa mahā yo ga/lung a nu yo ga/rdzogs pa a ti yo ga gsum dang bye brag tu sgrub pa sdo brgyad/khyad par dpal yang dag gi sgo nas mchag thun gyi dngos grub rnams 'grub par 'gyur bas rgyud lung man ngag la thos bsam gyi goms 'dris nan to du bya ba'i gnas so//de ltar phun sum tsho gos pa lngas gzhi bzung nas/dus kyang ji skad du/spyir na lo zla gza' 5bskar dang /zhag dus dar dang yar ngo gces//bye brag zhi rgyas dbang drag gam//bsnyen sgrub las sbyor kun la brtsi/ /zhes dang /tan+t+ra he ru ka las/dbang gi dus tshod dus bshad pa//dbyar dgun ston dpyid ra ba'am//ston ra'i so lag las/ru snying po ni/bto pa rang la bya ste chos brgyad lta bu'o ge yang /nya la bskur bar bya//zhes pa ltar lo dang zla ba mi rtsub cing zhag dus tshod gza' skar sbyor byed thams cad 'phrin las gang bsgrub dang bstun te nyams su blang ba gnad yin no//gnyis pa sa'i cho ga la brtag pa/bslang ba rtogs par sla bar 'dor sngon du byung yang puṇ+ḍa ri tso rgyud dang /dbang ga gnyis kyi rjes su stso4/bsod na mas tshogis gsog/sbyang ba/byin brlab/gzung ba/bsrung ba ste bdun las/dang po sa brtag pa la khro bo puṇ+ḍa rī ka zheXs/rdzas dang sa gzhi brtag par bya zhes byung ba

sangs rgyas thams cad mnyam par sbyor ba dpal yang dag zla gam dgu pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga hūṃ mdzad zhal lung / nang ma (ka)ltar/ sto 'phye chu sab po dang gsum las/ dang po sto 'phye brtag pa ni/ sto 'phye la rgyud sde dang nag rtsis nas bshad pa sogs rnam grangs mang na'ang 'dir rgyud nas gsungs pa nyid gtso che bas chos rje thams cad mkhyen bas rtogs par sla bar mdor bsdus tsam gsungs par yid gtan du bya zhing /zhib cha khungs btsun gyi yi ge du ma nas 'byung ba las shes dgos la snying po mchan gyi mdun nas thog mar sa tshogang bskor bang g.yi du sa pu mo nubacu brkos la slar des dgang zhes༅da/ zhing / rgyud dang nag rtsis so so'i zla 'go ngos 'dzin gyis mtshon gnad gsang phra mo rnams deng sang gi sngags rlom phal cher gyis rtogs par dka' zhing dkyil 'khor yang gtsug lag khang sogs gnas du mar byed pa shas che bas zhib pa ma bkod do/ /gnyis pa chus brtag pa ni/ chu dri rtogs slar bdud rtsi lnga'i chu zar/ dbang gzhung na 'di ltar nga mod/bzang po dang bcas pas sa brkos pa'i shul bkang rtogs sar de nas chu sgrogs gang khyer nas shar phyogs su shom pa bdun por/ slar log ste po pas ga na drag po'i sbyin sreg sdugs par gad/ nas/ rdor dril bzung ste ru lu'i mthar sid+dhi hūṃ zhes brjod bzhin pas gom pa mi drag par brgya'i bar phyin te phyir log nas bltas pas g.yas su 'khyil na dngos grub dang de las log na mi 'grub bo/ /gsum pa sa bkra brtag dbang gzhung du bra san la sogs pas brtag go zhes bshad cing ngan na sbyin sreg kyang skabasa'adi'i lhun tu bya bar gsungs/ pa ni/ rtogs par sla ba las rin po che'i bum par rin po che/ 'bru/ sman/snying po lngas bkang ba khung bu'i dbus su gzhug cing / sa yi lha mo 'khor dang bcas/ sngon gyi rgyal ba rnams kyis bsngags/ /byang chub sems kyi gter bum 'di/ /dkyil 'khor 'dri phyir gter du 'bul/ /zhes brjod de sbas la skra dang phub ma thal ba la sogs pa sa ro med pa'i sa sa slar bkang bas lhag cing dbus mtho na dngos grub mchog 'grub ma khengs na ru lu'i mthar pra be sha sa ni hūṃ phaṭa/ ces pas mtshan ma ngan pa bsal lo/ /gnyis gsang 'dus gshed skor bka' brgyad sogs la sa bslang pa rjes su byung na'ang kye rdor la sngon du byung zhing gsar —347

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo slong rgya mtsho gsung 'bum/ ()ṣi tso la mtha' tsog tu ma nges pas sto khe'i sngon du gtor ma gtong dgos pa ltar na rtog par sla ba'i spos da bzhin byas na chag pa bde bar ma' no//pa sa bslang ba la/snang ba dang mi snang ba gnyis las/dang po snang ba la bslang ba ni/ khro bo puṇ+ḍa ri ka las/ sa bdag rnams las rin gzhal/ bslang dang sbyang ba tshul bzhin bya 6ba tshe pos byung ba bzhin yul gyi rje dang khyim bdag sogs sa de dbang ba la gtam 'jam po dang bdog pa'i rin gyis nyo ba sogs ji ltar rigs pa bya/gnyis pa mi snang ba la bslang ba ni/de nyid las/'jig rten sa bdag lha klu la/sa rin gzhal te sa bslang ngo //zhes pa ltar dbang gzhung du gtor ma btang ste mgron tshogs rnams tshim nas las bsgo zhing de las khyad par sa'i lha mo la bslang bar bshad bas rtogs par slab las/ gzhi bdag dkar dmar gang ga 'ba'i gtor ma bshams la/raṃ yaṃ khaṃ rat+na bha lha rma āḥ&/zhes brjod bas bsregs gtor bkrus rin bo che'i snod bdud rtsis gang bar bskyed la/bhū mi pa ti sa pa ri wā ra sa mā dzaḥzhes pas gnas de'i gzhi bdag mdun du spyan drangs la/sa pa ri wā ra'i rjes su a kā ro btags pas phul la rdo rje dril bu bzung ste/sabadag lha klu 'khor dang bcas//gtor ma dam pa 'di bzhes la//bdag gi sgrub pa ma thon bar//khyed la gnas 'di bdag g.yar gyi/sgyu bde bar ni gas du song //sa pa ri wā ra'i rjes su ci btags la gnas gas du dengs par bsam mo//gsum dngags du mne nas kyi rdzo kyi snod dar bya phe phyir zhes sogs gsung pa'i rje su lā pas te bar 'dir bkod kyi sa brtag pa'i sngon du byas kyang 'jug pa bde la/༅riX spa du go rig mi gsal yang /dpang skong ༅ga po dang gtsu go dge rtsa〉 bya bar gad/pa bsod namasakyi dpung bskyed pa ni/khrag 'thung gal po las/'byung po'i gtor ma btang nas kyang //gsang ba'i don gyi las rnams bya//thub pa'i bka' rnams sgrog pa dang /bde gshegs sku gzugs gdab pa dang //7na log chags tshe yang bskyab par bya//lam 'phrang dag kyang legs par 'chos//zhes pa ltar dkon cog mchod cing 'byung po la gtor ma phongs pa la sbyin gtong /gsung rab bklag/la gdab/nye'u 'don pa sogs 'dus byas kyi dge ba4 /ba tshad bya'o//

sangs rgyas thams cad mnya par spyor ba dpal yang dag zla gam dgu pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga hūṃ mdzad zhal lung / nang ma (ka)bzhi pa sa sbyang pa la rdzas dang ṣi 'dzin/chos wo/byin gyis bas pa dang gsum las/dang po rdzas dang kho nge 'dzin gyis sbyang ba ni/dbang g.yi du sngags dang bcas dri byu lor wo dkyil 'khor gyi rgya ji ltar 'dod pa sa thur du brkos pa'i rgo 'phang du rtsig pa tsam las ma byung na'ang rtogs par sla ba'i phyi'i sbyang ba'i rjes su 'brangs te/sum+bha'i sngags kyis dri zhim po'i chus chag chag gdab/dri zhim po'i me tog bkram pa'i dbus su bdag nyid 'dug nas/bdag bskyed bzlasapa yan ho rdzogs par byas/dkyil 'khor bsdus te rang gtso bo yab yum gyi nga rgyal du gnas pa'i mig gnyis sgrub tha4thang pon snangs/ma dang a las nyi zla'i dkyil 'khor du bsams shing /mig g.yas pa'i nyi ma'i 'od kyis snang ba'i dngos po bsregs par bsams la/hūṃ/g.yas he ga gogs kyi les smu khor 'di'i khas sa rnal ra shad/pa'i spyan zur las byung ba'i//ma las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi//'od kyis snang ba'i dngos po kun//thams cad ma lus bsreg par bya//ma su rla maṇ+ḍal da ha da ha bha smin ku ru hūṃ e snya ra ṇa zhes brjod pas thugs ka'i hūṃ las yaṃ spros pa las byung ba'i rlung gis thal pa rnams gtore bar bsams shing /spro na thugs ka'i hūṃ las byung ba yi//waṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor gyis//7brko ngos kun bsregs pa'i thal ba yang //thams cad ma lus gtor bar bya//yaṃ bā yu maṇ+ḍal bhak+ṣa re ṇa ku sa de nas mig g.yon pa'i zla ba'i dkyil 'khor las byung ba'i chus lhag ma thams cad bkrus par bsams shing /g.yon pa'i spyan zur las byung ba'i//a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi//'od kyis snang ba'i dngos po kun//thams cad ma lus bkru bar bya//a tsan+d+ra maṇ+ḍal ṇa pa kus zhes dang /de nas chos thams cad stong pa nyid du bsas shing /oṃ shu rgyu ta sna ra su bhā ba shu (7/zhes brjod/gnyis pa chos wo kyis sbyang ba ni/sna tshogs 'di dag 'khrul pa las snang yang don dam par chos kyi dbyings nyid do//oṃ su bhā ba rtogs sla dang ma mas kyang dbang g.yi du 'di bsto byung /rtogs par sla bar ga4 ༅ sbyang 0byung ba legs na'ang dbang g.yi du mo byung bas grong r+sās su 4sha 19sko 5 sarba ri swa bhā wa shudhe3lha/gsum pa byin

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (25)gyis brlab pa'i sbyang ba ni/ dbang gzhung las/ rang nyid lha'i nga rgyal dang ldan pas ma sne ga ga na re āḥ&/ sa gzhi nam mkha' stong pa'i rang bzhin las 'byung lnga'i dkyil 'khor ri rab dang bcas pasabartan par gyur pa'i rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ ra ba/ gur/ me dpung 'bar ba'i 'od dang ldan par bsam sna tshogs rdo rje'i phyag mnyam pa'i phyag rgya la srin lag nang du bkug sor mo ka ldan rnams bgrad pa'o// rgya sa la reg la/oṃ me di ni badzi bhā wa badz+ra bas hūṃ/ zhes brjod/lnga pa sa gzhi byin gyis brlab pa ni/ rtogs par sla ba las maṇ+ḍal gyi dbus sam mdun du dri'i thig le dang me tog gi tshom bu bkod la/ paṃ pad+ma maṇ+ḍal zhes pas pad+ma'i gdan du bskyed de/ bdag gi thugs sa'i hūṃ (8na tshe pas 'od zer lcags kyu lta bu spros pas sa'i lha mo sa 'og nas spyan drangs par bsams shing / skyob pa tshigs bcad rnams dbang gzhung du 'dra min 'dug kyang 'jug pa bde khyad nas rtogs sla dang 'dung byas/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /spyod pa'i tshul dang khyad par gyi/ /sa dang pha rol phyin pa la/ /lha mo khyod ni dpang du gyur/ /ces brjod cing thal mo sa la lan gsum brdabs pas sa 'og nas sa'i lha mo 'thon te pad+ma'i gdan la bzhugs pa sku mdog ser mo rgyan gyis brgyan pa phyag na bum pa ser po bsnams pa rnal 'byor bka' stsal ji ltar bgyi zhes smra bar bsams la/ oṃ badz+ra ā ha ra hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra dhu pe hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra ā+o hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra ā lo ke hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra ga rje hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra ut+ta pa la ye hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra bi sgru ra ye hūṃ/ zhes dang / shākya seng ge skyob pa yis/ /ji ltar bdud kyi sde bcom ltar/ /de bzhin bdag gas bdud las ni/ /rgyal bar bya ste dkyil 'khor bri/ /de phyir dpang gyur lha mos kyang / /sa gzhi byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ /zhes lan gsum brjod pas/ lha mos dga' ba'i ma dpas phyung ste/ khyod ni slob dpon dam pa yin/ /sems can don phyir dkyil 'khor bris/ /zhes gnang ba byin nas sa de nyid du thim pas gser gyi sa gzhir gyur par bsam mo/ / drug pa sa gzung ba la blo dang stang stabs gnyis las/ dang po blos gzung ba ni/ rtogs sla las/ bdag gis sems can don bya'i phyir/ /lha mo khyod kyis dpang gyis shig /rin cen sna tshogs phye —350

sang rgyas thams cad mnyam par sbyor ba dpal yang dag zla gam dgu pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga hūṃ mdzad zhal lung / nang ma (ka)btags pas/ /bdag gi don yod dkyil 'khor bri/ /zhes brjod cing don bsam mo/ /gnyis pa stang stabs kyis(8ba)sa gzung ba la gsol gdab dang / bgegs skrod gnyis las/ dang po gsol ba gdab pa ni/ khrag 'thung gi gar 'cham byed na dpon slob thams cad bse zhu phod ka sogs kyi chasagazhug bya/ mi byed na slob dpon gar gos sngon po/ rgyan drug gis spras shing rdor dril thogs/ phyogs bzhir go rī ma sogs lha mo'i nga rgyal 'dzin pa'i slob ma rnams rdor dril dang bcas mchod rdzasasum+bha sa bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bhan+ta 'bar ba'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod rdzas dngas shing thogs pa med pa dpal kun tu bzang po'i rnam 'phrul las byung ba bsam gyis mi khyab par bsam/ oṃ a ha ra nas oṃ badz+ra bi spu ra ye hūṃ gi bar brjod/ las byang nas/ hūṃ rang byung gdod nas dag pa'i rdzas zhes pa nas ma hā pañtsa a skṛ ta khā hi bar gyis sman mchod dbul/ rol mo dbyangs dang bcas te/ shar nas/ dbang gzhung las/ oṃ/byams chen tam mkha'i rigs sbyor ba/ /'jig rten 'dzin rgyal 'jigs pa'i skyabs/ /rnam h+phu dgas la ba'i chos mchog can/ /yang dag ye shes spyod pa grol/ /a la la lho lho nas/ swā/ thugs rje'i gnasamachog dag pa'i ngos/ /mnyam nyid chos kun 'byung ba'i zhing / /yon to rin cen mdzod ston pa'i/ /rnam 'phrul chos la ra btu grol/ /a la la lho nub nas/ e/ dga' ba'i pad+mo mtshan ldan pa/ /kun rtogs dngos gsal chags pa med/ /rdo rje gsang gsum sngags 'don ba'i/ /brjod 'byung tshig lasa'adas pa'o/ /a la la hoḥ byang nas/ hā/ btang snyoms gnas ngan dra ba len/ /(9na〉'an lasabadag po stobs rdzogs pa/ /bya ba'i ye shes mthar mdzad cing / /sprul pa'i dkyil 'khor bsten du gsol/ /a la la hoḥ de nas thams cad kyi mgrin gcig tu/ /o/ sangs rgyas thams cad mnyam sbyor ba'i/ /mkha' 'gro sgyu ma'i dkyil 'khor gtso/ /sdig pa thams cad las grol zhing / /bsod namasadangos grub kun 'byung ba'i/ /rgyal ba kun gyi 'byung gnas mchog /mthong dka' mthong bas grol byed pa/ /lam mchog gsang ba chen po'i tshogs/ /bdag nyid chen pos bstan du gsol/ /a la la hoḥ—351—

rgyal dbang lā pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ smyonazhes bstod cing gsol ba gdab/gnyis pa bgegs skrod pa la byin brlab/bka' bsgo/stang stabs dang gsum las/dang po byin gyis brlab pa ni/dbang gzhung gi dgongs pa dang phal cher mtshungasapas rtogs sla las/dzi 47tshor rigs sku tshonas gad/ha hi hi dzaḥdziḥ& hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa/ces tsā bstodang gas brjod pas skye mched byin brlab nas byung ba'i rta dbang ga gi dmigs sa7/mchog rol pa'i nga rgyal gzung /ma su rla maṇ+ḍal/a tsan+d+ra maṇ+ḍal/zhes pas mig g.yas g.yon gnyis byin gis brlab/sna'i rtse mor yaṃ dbang gas 4khrung /ljang gu dang rkang mthil gnyis su sna tsho gos rdo rje rer bsams la/hūṃ bi shwa badz+ra zhes brjod bas byin gyis brlabs la/spro na/g.yas g.yon spyan zur ma a las//byung ba'i nyi zla'i dkyil 'khor las//spros pa'i 'od dang sna rtse'i yaṃ//las sa rlung gis bgegs sogasakun//ma lus thams cad bskrad par bya//badz+ra ༷ sna ma a/yang g.yas su bskor bas phyogs mtshamasasteng 'og 9baṣ+ṭha mas cad rdo rje'i ra gur du gyur par bsams shing /g.yas g.yon mig gnyis ma a las/khyung ba'i nyi zla'i dkyil 'khor las//spros pa'i rdo rje rab 'bar bas//phyogs kun rdo rje'i rwa bar gyur//kro dha rgyu ma a/zhes brjod cing don bsam mo//gnyis pa bka' bsgo ba ni/g.yas rdo rje gsor/g.yon dril bu gsil te ru lu dang 'bru bcu brjod cing rdo rje'i 'gros kyis byang shar du song la/dbang g.yi las/hūṃ/lha klu gnod sbyin yang po dang //dri za srin po sha za'i tshogs//gshin rje ma mo mkha' 'gro gdug/gnod byed drag po ma lusarnams//gang dag sa gzhi 'dir gnas pa//srung byed sa yi bdag po'i bka'//thos pa tsam gyisamyur du dengs//nga yi bka' las 'da' ma byed//gang zhig gnas pa'i mthu bo che//rdo rje tho ba kha ṭ+wāṃ gis//thal ba'i thog bzhin gsheg par byed//rab 'bar khro bos gnas 'joms pa//rdo rje 'bar ba'i gzugs 'di yis//gal te gang gis dam tshig bcag/'dod gsum skyes rnams dag byas te//'jig par 'gyur zhing gzhan 'dis med//ces lan gsum brjod la ru lu 'bru bcu — bzla/sa rdzo rā dza'i spos kyis bdug/rol mo'i snga yir sgrub 'a ltar byed na yis/chu tso/yungs kar sil ma/gri shing sogs kyis

sangs rgyas thams cad mnyam par sbyor ba dpal yang dag zla gam dgu pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga hūṃ mdzad zhal lung / nang ma (ka)zung mche bar byed/sgra rgya cher bya/de nas rdo rje'i 'gros kyis g.yas skor du lan gsum bskor zhing hūṃ gi sgra drag tu bsgrags pas/nyi ma zla ba rdo rje las 'od zer byung bas gdug pa can rnams bsregs bcom rlung gis gtor lhag ma rnams gzhan du byer bar bsam mo//gsum ba stang stabs dngos bya ba ni/ byang shar nas slob dpon dbus dang slob ma phyogs bzhir 'khod de/shar du g.yas brkyang /lhor 10bskoyon brkyang /nub tu sa ga/byang du zlum po/dbus su mnyam pa/kha sbyor/rus sbal rtse gcig/bung ba'i dra ba ste stang stabs brgyad bya la/spros pa che bar 'dod na/phur pa'i rtsa 4 mas la lha 'byin 'jug byas na spyir bka' brgyad dbyibs gcig pa dang /khyad par yang phur zung 'brel yin pas rig bzo'i mgon mang la blo bzo'i phur 'chams 'gebs pa dang ni mi 'dra'o// bdun pa bsrung ba bya ba la phur gdab dang bsrung 'khor gnyis las/dang po phur bus gdab pa ni/khrag 'thung gal po las/phur pa dar gyi cod pan can//ngos la hūṃ bcu bris pa yang //khro bo bcu ru byin brlabs nas//zhes dang /dbang ༅ni skar 44sa kyi dus phur bud ra gyi cod pan ༅ bshas la zhesabyung /gzhung las/khro bo chen po stobs chen dag sprin sgra la sogs pa'i phur bus gdab/ces dang /de nas bsrung ba'i 'khor lo'i sbyor bas mtshams kyi las byas te/phur bu dar gyi cod pan can bcu khro bo chen bor bskyed cing ye shes kyi khro bo dgug gzhug gnyis su med par byas nas/mchod cing bstod nge bzlas brjod rdzogs par phul bas mnyes shing brtan par byas nas/phyogs skyong gi gzugs la gdug pa'i sems phab ste gdab par bya'o zhes pa tsam las ma byung yang /rang nyid rta mchog hūṃ mdzad kyi rnam par bsgyur ba ni/khrag 'thung gal po las/hūṃ/nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dbus gnas pas/ /dbyar gyi sprin phung lta bu nyid//bskal pa'i tshe dpung rab tu 'bar//g.yas brkyang bar ni rab tu gnas//smin mtshams khro gnyer dmar ba'i spyan//zhal gsum mche gtsigs rnam par bsgyur//phyag gnyisa3 gi rgya bcings pa'i//0brkong po rdo rje dril bu 'dzin//g.yas gnyis lcags kyu ral gri dang //g.yon

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (25)gnyis dgra sta zhags pa bsnams/ /gtum chen khro bo 'bar ba'i gzugs/ /bzod par dka' ba'i gzi ldan bsam/ /hūṃ kā ra badz+ra mahā kro dha hūṃ/ zhes pas rang nyid hūṃ mdzad kyi bskyed rim gsal btab/ mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i phur pa bcur/ rak+ta'i thig le sogs byug pa'i rdzas gsum 'byug /gu gul gyis bdug /yungs dar gyis brab/ oṃ badz+raki li ki lā ya brnya hūṃ phaṭa/ ces brjod cing mthu bskyed/ su bhā was sbyangs/ de nyid las/ hūṃ/ rdo rje phur bu nyid gnas pas/ /ut+pal sngon po'i 'dab 'dra ba/ /'bar ba'i 'phreng ba mugs pa'i 'od/ /lte ba man chad cha rnams ni/ /rtse mo lta bur rnam par bsam/ /sku stod khro bo lta bu nyid/ /zhal gsum phyag kyang drug pa ste/ /dpal dang dur khrod mas brgyan bsam/ khro bo bcu'i sngags brjod/ e lpa ra ṇa phaṭa/ phur gdan gru gsum 'bar bar bsam/ khyud kyi dgongs don yi ngur bsdus te/ rang nyid hūṃ mdzad du gsal bas khro bo 'dod pa'i rgyal po la bka' bsgos pas/ gu rla tsan+d+ra ya/ isgru ya/ asna ye/ ya mā ya/ : ta ye/ wa ru ṇa ya/ wā ya be/ ku be rā ya/ yī sha nā ya/ nā ge saḥ phyogs skyong gdan du btang bar bsam/ / slar yang hūṃ mdzad kyis gnod mdzes la bka' bsgos pas/ sprul pa'i gnod mdzes phyogs bcur spros te bgegs rnams bkug par bsam/ sa brjod cing dzaḥ& baṃ sngos bstim/ phur pa bsgril zhing gī lā ya nyer gcig sogasabazlas nas gnod mdzes kyi phyag g.yon gyi phur bu bgegs tshogis kyi spyi bor btsugs/ g.yas kyi tho bas brdungs pas rkang mthil gyi bar phug ste dbang (11na slobi gser gyis gzhi la thug gi bar song bar bsam/ ogha gha ghā ta 'a/ghā ta ya sarba du/ phaṭaki lwa ya gī lwa ya phaṭa/ sarba pā paṃ phaṭa/ hūṃ hūṃ/ badz+raki lwa ya/ badz+ra dh+wa ra ā dzñā pa ya ti/ kā la wā kyi t+ta/ badz+ra ki lā ya hūṃ phaṭa ces brjod de phur gdab bya'o/ /gnyis pa bsrung 'khor dngos ni/ las byang gi thugs ga'i hūṃ las mtshon cha sna tshogs zhes sdogs kyis bsrung 'khor rdzogs par bsgom/ gsum pa sta gon la gtor ma/ rgyal chen/ dam sri/ sgo byang /ma tre/ chag chag /thog 'debs/ lha sta gon/ bum pa sta gon/ slob ma sta gon te bcu las dang po gtor ma skabs 'dir mgron rigs rnams la gtor ma ga sto ba dbang gas du byung ba'i rjes su ngas puṇ+ḍa rī kwa'i rgyud du'ang gtor ma cha —354

sang rgyas thams cad mnyam par skyor spu dpal yang dag zla gam dgu pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga hūṃ mdzad zhal lung / nang ma (ka) gsum ga sto bar ༅da cing so mig du rang cha bco lnga phreng cha gsum mtha' ma chu ga sto zhes byung /gtong ba ni/maṇ+ḍal gyi steng du dri dang bcas pa'i tshom bu bkod/mchod pa dang gtor ma bzhi bshams te/sa slong ba'i skabasaltar byin gyis brlab/rang gi thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od zer sa pas dkon cog sri zhu'i mgron/mgron po yon tan gyi mgron/rigs drug snying rje'i mgron/lan chags bgegs rigs kyi mgron dang bcas pa thams cad skad cig gis yo badz+ra sa mā dzaḥs spyan drangs/pad+ma ka ma la ya ri gyis gdan phul/a: nas sha lha bra byu swā hā'i bar gyis mchode/khrag 'thung gal bo las/hūṃ/sangs rgyas sku gsum rnam par dag/don dam bsgrub dang bstan pa'i chos//nyan rang byang chub sems dpa' la//mchod sbyin gtor ma 'bul gyis bzhes//gtso bo snang mdzad snang mtha' yas//sa spyan gos dkar mā ma 11ba tha//'jam dpal spyan ras phyag rdor dang //gshin rje rta mgrin bdud rtsi 'khyil//rtse mo rnon po gī lwa yar//mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di 'bul gyis//oṃ a rdo rje thal mo kha phye phe phyagasang cas/kā ro mu khaṃ/sab dharmā ṇi sgo nut+pan+da tā ta oṃ āḥ〉 phaṭa swāhā/lan gsum gyis dbul/hūṃ/gnod sbyin nor bu bzang po dang //nor bzang gnod sbyin gnod sbyin che//rgyal ba sul pa rol pa'i phreng //sgo dbang spyod dbang gnod sbyin brgyad//ma rdzo sbyin gtor ma 'di 'bul gyis//bzhes la sgrub pa'i 'phrin las mdzod//oṃ ya hā shwa ra ye swā ma las/thal rdzobs te gung mo sgreng /ga sto pa ma phur bkug gnod sbyin rgya//zhes3da/tso mthar gong gi gtor sngags sbyor/hūṃ/dbang phyug che dang biṣ+ṭha dang /bh+riṅgi ri ti dga' byed dang //ga cho zhe nu smin drug tsho gos kyi bdag/stobs bzang legs ldan lha chen brgyad//mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di 'bul gyis/bzhes la sgrub pa'i 'phrin las mdzod//oṃ de wa pra sa nā ya khong stod gung mo skyobs la la/ma phur bkun mthe tha' bag/lha/zhes so//swāhā'i mthar gtor sngags sbyor/hūṃ/mtha' yas dang ni 'jog po dang //stobs kyi rgyu dang rigs ldan dang //nor rgyas bu dang dung skyong dang //pad+ma chu lha klu chen brgyad//mchod sbyin gtore ma 'di 'bul gyis//bzhes la sgrub pa'i 'phrin las mdzod//oṃ re re na ti nā thal mo sgrul mgo'i gdengs ka ltar/bzung ba klu rnams phyag rgya yin/zhes so//ga li ri li ri phu ta ta re

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()tse te swā tso mthar gtor sngags sbyor/hūṃ/pa wa sangs dang mig dmar dang //phur bu dang ni sgra gcan 'dzin//zla ba dang ni nyi ma dang //gza' lhag spen pa gza' chen brgyad//mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di 12na tshes rgyal gyis//bzhes la sgrub pa'i 'phrin las mdzod//oṃ gza' rnams la gag sdi4khog tu sbyar/ma ga lha bas te bsgreng /zhes so//gra he shwa ri t+ya pra ba ta dzo ti mā ya swā hā'i mthar gtang sngags sbyor/hūṃ/smin drug dang ni snar ma dang //ma spyodang lag dang na bas sodang //rgyal dang skag ni shar na gnas//mchu dang gre dang sbo dang ni//me bzhi nag pa sa ri dang //sag bdun ni lho na gnas//lha mtshamasagazi brjid r+ṣa mo dang //de bawo ston dang snubs dang ni//chu stod dang ni chu smad dang //gro bawo byi bawo nub na gnas//mon gru dang ni mon dre dang //de bzhi khrums stod khrums smad dang //nam gru dang ni tha skar dang //bra nye bdun ni byang na gnas//ma rdzo sbyin gtor ma 'di 'bul gyis//bzhesal sgrub pa'i 'phrin las mdzod//yon k+ṣa tra ni ran pa ni ye swā hā'i rgyu rnar rnams kyi de ṣ+ka lag/gung mo4stang gnyis ldog sbyar//zhes so//mthar gtor sngags sbyor/hūṃ/lha dang klu dang dri za dang //mi'am ci dang sto 'phye dang //'dab bzang grul bum srin po brgyad//ha ri ka dang pa nyi dar//mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di 'bul gyis//bzhes la sgrub pa'i 'phrin las mdzod//oṃ gas4di sbyin ci rgya swā hā/yon ga
