swā hā/oṃbi shudhe su ra hi ni swā hā/oṃ mahā sa nan bi ha sa nan swāhā/oṃ ga ra lan bi ra lan swāhā/i 3 ha swā hā/cha'i shud+dhi swā hā/charak+ṣa ni swā hā'i mthar gtor sngags sbyor/hūṃ/lha yi gdon dang 'byung po'i gdon//sgos pa gnod sbyin dri za'i gdon//srin po'i gdon dang klu yi gdon//log 'dren gdon dang brjed byed gdon//smyo byed gdon dang lha 12bsgo yin/sha za'i gdon dang srul po'i gdon//be sar yi gdon dang ni//nam gru'i gdon dang bya yi gdon//skem byed gdon dang ga smo nu'i gdon//mchod gtor 'di long 'phrin las mdzod//oṃ de ba g.yas pas mchod sbyin 'debs pa las//g.yon pas mar sbyin mig la gto//ces so//ga ṇi saḥswā hā/nā ba ga ṇi saḥswāhā/a su ra ga ṇi ༷ ཿswāhā/ma ru ta ga ṇi ༷ ཿswāhā/ga ru ḍa ga ṇi saḥswāhā/gan+ta rba ga ṇi khyeḥswāhā/lka na ra ༷ ṇi khyoḥswāhā/ma ho ra ga ga ṇi saḥswāhā/yak+ṣa ga ṇi

sangs rgyas thams cad mnyam par sbyor ba dpal yang dag zla gam dgu pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga hūṃ mdzad zhal lung / nang ma (ka)༷ ཿswāhā/ rāk+ṣa sag ṇi ༷ ཿswāhā/ pre ta ga ṇi saḥswāhā/ pi shā tsa ga ṇi 6 ཿswāhā/ bhū ta ga ṇi saḥswāhā/kum+bhaṇ+ḍa ga ṇi saḥswāhā/pu ta ga ṇa sgoḥswāhā/ka ta bhū ta ga ṇi thoḥswāhā/kun+da ga ṇi khyoḥswāhā/ut+pan+ta ga ṇi 6 ཿswāhā/tsa me ga ṇi saḥswāhā/a pa smu rā ga ṇi saḥswāhā/i ta rag ga ṇi saḥswāhā'i mthar gtor sngags sbyor/ hūṃ/ 'gro ba rigs drug la sogs pa/ /lan chags snying rje'i mgron tsho gos dang / /bgegs rigs stong phrag brgyad cu rnams//mchod sbyin 'di yis tshim par byos/a su : tri pre du dza/gu sko ra gu rla lag pa g.yon po khus gong /mdzus mo gang la ga 'a yo pa kha //zhes so//ra swāhā/pi tsi pi tsi swāhā/ra ra sa sa/tri tri/ga nu nu/dzaḥ& baṃ hoḥm ṣ+ka re r+sha ri swā hā/pi tsi pi tsi swāhā/gu rla ri gu sko ri swāhā/a man+ta tik+ṣa rā dzā nā na swāhā/bo bu ta mun swāhā/ba la ta la ba sa nā na swāhā/mi tri nā na swāhā/gra ha nā na swāhā'i mthar gtor sngags sbyor/zhes bsngos te 'jig rten pa'i gtor ma rnams phyir dor ro//gnyis pa rgyal rtogs par sla bar 'og tu nga ba thams cad mkhyen pa la 'khyul pa mi mnga' zhing rnying ma phyogs la mtha' gcig tu nges pa mi 'dug rungs 'dir dbang g.yi dang bka' brgyad (13na togs snga 'gyur phal cher mas par byung ba'i rjes su stsongs shing so mas du sto wo gyi ga 'a ma gong gi phung tsho khos su bsdus/chen mtho 'dzugs ni/khro bo puṇ+ḍa ri kwa'i le'u dang por/sa bcad tsam dang dbang gzhung du khyad par gyi gtor ma bzhi rgyal po ོ po sde bzhi la 'bul zer ba'i khungs tsam las ma byung zhing khrag 'thung gal po che las/phyogs bzhir mtho bzhi btsugs nas kyang//rgyal po chen po sdebazhi la//phyi mtshams gcod pa'i 'phrin las 'chol//zhes pa ltar byung na'ang don la khyad par med phyin 'jug pa bde ba'i dbang du byas te rtogs par sla ba las/phyogasabazhir mtho bzhi brtsigs la rgyal chen bzhi'i tsaka li gzugs/thog mar shar gyi rtsar dri'i maṇ+ḍal byas mchode pa lnga dang dkar gsum dngar gsum/'bru sna tsho gis pa'i gtong ma bshams la/rang yang dag snga dro las byang gyer yod na 'di dang skyabs sems mi dgos pa 'dra'o/khu gsal btab la su bhā was sbyangs stong pa'i ngang las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod gtor dngas shing thogs pa med pa sa dang nam mkha' bar snaX /mas cad khyab pa kun tu bzang po'i rnam 'phrul

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ rtonalas byung ba'i mchod pa'i sprin phung lta bu bsam gyis mi khyab par bsam/skyabs 'gro sems bskyed/stong nyid bsgom pa sngon du 'gro bas sku'am mtho/rin po tsho khri'i steng du lha las rgyal po ོ po yul 'khor srung ljang gu phyag gnyis kyis yi waṃ bsgreng ba/dri za'i tshogs kyis yongs su bskor bar bskyed/gnas gsum yi ge gsum gyis byin gyis brlab/rang gi thugs ka nas 'od 'phros grong khyer yul 'khor 13na ) srung nas ye shes pa spyan drangs par bsams shing /dri za dag gi bdag po'i rgyal//shar gyi phyogs rnams skyong byed pa//rgyal po wo po yul 'khor srung //yul ga bor srung nas gshegs su gsol//oṃ mahā rā dzā lha ta ga sa pa ri wā ra e gye ti zhes brjod/pad+ma ka ma la yi sto gyis gdan dbul/dzaḥ& baṃ sngos gnyis su med par bstim/gtsang zhing gtsang mar sbyar skyes pa'i//lha rdzas dam pa'i mchod rdzas 'di//rgyal chen 'khor dang bcas la 'bul//bzhes nas bdag la dges par mdzod//sa pa ri wā ra'i rjes su/i rda/a lha/pā rgya/pu mi sgru paṃ/dī paṃ/ga /a ha ra/shasta/bra la swāhās mchod la/sa pa ri wā ra'i rjes su/dzo po pad+ma 'a thal mo sbyar slo/na ma ༷sarba ta thā ga te bh+yo bi shwa mu khe saḥsarba thā kho ut+pa te lpa ra ṇa i me ga ga na kho gro sne rda ba kla te swāhā btags pas gtor ma dbul/shar phyogs na ni gnas srung po//'jig rten skyong ba gzi brjid ldan/shar phyogs dag ni skyong byed pa//rdzu rol che la stobs kyang che//mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di snoms la/zhal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas//bar chad thams cad zhi ba dang //dngos grub ma lus stsal du gsol//na mo/mar sbyin gyi ga kho ma rgya r+ṣa po 'di rgyal po wo po gnas srung po 'bor dang bams pa la 'bul lo//gsol lo bsngo'o//sngon gyi thugs dam la gnos te bdag cag gi dkyil 'khor chen po'i bya ba mthar ma phyin gyi bar du 'dir brtan par bzhugs nas phyi'i dgra bgegs nang du mi btang zhing bar chad thams cad zhi ba dang phyi mtshams srung zhing dngos grub ma lus pa 14phrin grub pa'i 'phrin las dam pa mdzad du gsol/zhes brjod cing tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra sa brtan par bzhugs par bsgom/de bzhin du lhor gzhan 'dra ba las bi las 'phags skyes po sngon sdo g.yas ral gri g.yon gdan la brten pa grul

sangs rgyas thams cad mnyam par sbyor ba dpal yang dag zla gam dgu pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga hūṃ mdzad zhal lung / nang ma (ka)bum gyi tshogs kyis bskor bar bskyed/ gnas gsum yi ge gsum gyis byin gyis brlab/ grong khyer 'phags par skyes nas ye shes pa spyan drangs bar bsams shing / grul bum dag gi bdag po'i rgyal/ /lho yi phyogs rnams skyed byed pa/ /rgyal po chen po 'phags skyes po/ /'phags par skyes nas gshegasasu gsol/ /oṃ ma hā rā dzā bi ru khyu ka sa pa ri wā ra nas ma da pa'i bar dang gtor sngags su/ : ta mas gnas su bi ru khya /gzhug /dbul ba ni/ lho phyogs na ni 'phags skyes po/ /zhes dang / lasa'achol dus 'phags skyes po zhes go brje/ nub phyogs su/ bi las mig mi bzang dmar po g.yasasbrul zhags/ g.yon mchod rten 'dzin pa klu'i tshogs kyis bskor bar bskyed/ grong khyer sna tshogasagazugs nas spyan drangs par bsams shing / klu rnams kyi ni bdag po'i rgyal/ khub kyi phyogs rnamasaskyong byed pa/ /rgyal po chen po mig mi bzang / /sna tsho gos gzugs nas gshegs su gsol/ /oṃ mahā rā dzā bi ru pāk+ṣa sa pa ri wā ra nas mchode pa'i bar dang gtor sngags su/ bi ru pāk+ṣa gzhug /dbul bar/ nub phyogs na ni mig mi bzang / /zhes dang / las 'chol ba'i skabs su mig mi bzang zhes 'don pa bsgyur/ byang phyogs su/ be+e las rgyal po chen po rnam thos bu ser po g.yas rin po ches mtshan pa'i dbyug (14bto/ /g.yon ne'u le 'dzin pa gnod sbyin gyi tshogs kyis bskor bar bskyed la/grong khyer lcang lo can nas ye shes pa spyan drangs par bsams shing / gnod sbyin rnams kyi bdag po'i rgyal/ /byang gi phyogs rnams skyong byed pa/ rgyal po chen po rnam thos bu/ /lcang la can nas gshegs su gsol/ /oṃ ma hā rā dzā be shra wa ṇa sa pa ri wā ra nas mchod pa'i bar dang gtor sngags su/ be+e sha wa ṇa gzhug cing / dbul bar/ byang phyogs na ni lus ngan po/ /zhes dang / 'phrin las kyi skabs su rnam thos zhes 'don pa bsgyur ro/ /gsum pa dam sri gnon pa ni/ dbang gzhung du mi gsal yang khrag 'thung gal po las/ maṇ+ḍal nag po gru gsum du/ /bar chad dam sri mnan byas te zhes dang / khro bo puṇ+ḍa rī dar/ dur khrod mnan pa'i thod pa la/ /nang du dam sri bris nas ni/ /zhes sogs dang / gsang ba'i don gyi las rnams bya/ /—359

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()zhes pa'o//so mas du dam sri gnon zhes mdo tsam gsungs pa'i don/shog bu la dam sri'i liṅga yan lag lcags sgrog gis bsdams pa sngags dang dmod byang sogs phyag len mtshan nyid dang ldan pa bris la 'brub khung du bcug pa mdun du bshams te gser skyems btang /'byub khung bskyed chog nas bden pa chen po'i byin rlabs kyi bar tsho gis mtha' ma ltar la/de nas bstan 'gro'i phan bde dang rnal 'byor pa chos bsgrub pa la bar du gcod cing khyad par sgrub pa 'di'i dngos grub 'phrog par byed pa'i dam sri 'byung po gdug pa can ci mchis pa de dag thams cad badz+ra a du sha sogs dang bskul nas phur gdab kyi bar dkyus ltar byas rjes/liṅga ring chas 15na sta nyungs thod par bcug mnan chas mtshan nyid dang ldan pa byas nas them 'og gam lam rgya gram sogs su dong brus la/khrag 'thung gal po las/hūṃ/dur khrod chen po'i gnas brgyad du//sprul pa'i rbod gtong ོ bo dang //za byed chen po'i rngam stabs kyis//mnan pa'i las rnams dus la bab//hūṃ mdzad ārla a tsa la//sprul pa'i 'od zer rngam mdangs ldan//hūṃ dang phaṭa kyi sgra sgrog cing //dgra bgegs tshogis cho mes mi g.yo mgon//'phung byed dam sri 'byung po 'di//ri rab wo po'i yo du sba//ya ma rā chu zas su sbyin//chu srin 'bar ba'i kha ru brdzangs/'khor lo 'bar ba'i phyag rgyas mnan//bdun brgyud rigs ni brlag 'gyur na//nam yang ldang bar mi 'gyur te//byang chub sems ni skyes na btang //hūṃ ārla a tsal ban+ta — gī li ki lwa ya hūṃ phaṭa/sarba sku bha ya nan zhes bskyur zhing ro g.yam dang sa sa spyibs pa'i steng du 'phrin las bzhi'i bro brdung ngo //bzhi pa rtsoms du sgo byang gdags tshe༅nga /sgo byang gdags pa ni/dbang gzhung du mi gsal yang khro bo puṇ+ḍa ni ka las/de nas ra sog g.yas pa la/khrag gi yi ge bris nas ni//gzhaX yas sgo la gdags par bya//zhes pa'i don ltar/ra sog la khro bo bdud rtsi 'khyil pa dang lug sog la gshin rje'i sku mngon rtogs bzhin bris pa'i snga ma sgo gong gi nang dang rjes ma phyi la btags so sor dmar gyi gtor

sangs rgyas thams cad mnyam par sbyor ba dpal yang dag zla gam dgu pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga hūṃ mdzad zhal lung / nang ma (ka)ma dang mchod pa bsham/sgo'i phyi nas su bhā was sbyangs/stong pa'i ngang las a las byung ba'i thod pa yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga las grub pa'i mchod 15ba ) gtor bzang zhing gya nom pa bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por bsam/byuḥ& gis byin gyis brlabs/sku rten su bhā was sbyangs/stong pa'i ngang las pad+ma dang nyi ma/dgra bgegs bsnol pa'i gdan la ya las gshin rje nag po khro zhing gtum pa zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/g.yas be con 'phyar zhing g.yon 'khor lo bskor ba/dur khrod kyi chas kyis brgyan pa/zhabs g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang gis ye shes kyi me rab tu 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'i dpral bar oṃ/mgrin par āḥthugs kar hūṃ gis mtshan par bas marang gi thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros/lho phyogs 'chi bdag gi grong khyer nas gshin rje lor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥs spyan drangs/pad+ma ka ma la ya sa gyis gdan dbul/dzaḥ& baṃ sngos gnyisasu med par thim par bsam/oṃ badz+ra karma ya ma rā dzā sa pa ri wā ra i rda/a lha nas/sha lta bra la swāhā'i bar gyis mchode/sngags mthar 'bru gsum btags te nang mchod dang /sa pa ri wā ra'i rjesasu na maḥsarba sogs rgyal chen gyi skabs ltar btags nas gtor ma dbul/khrag 'thung gal po las/hūṃ/gsang chen lhun grub pho brang nas//las kyi gshin rje'i bdag po la//bcom ldan chos rjes bka' stsal ltar//de bzhin rigs 'dzin sgrub pa po//bka' gsang gzhung chen 'di bsgrub cing //yang dag don la nges 'jug na//'di dag nor bu lhu wo te//'di la gnod cing bar gno pa'i//lha srin sdebargyad 'byung po kun/khyed kyi 'khor dang g.yog lags kyi/zhom par smin pa'i chos shod la//gsang ba mchog gi rnal 16na ) 'byor pa//bla med tsos bu mthob par//sa 'di yan chad ma btang zhig/dpal wo mi pham bka' ma 'da'//bdag cag ye nas gnyis su med//phyi 'khor skyong ba'i mu ra la//rdo rje'i yal gam thub par mdzod/chaya ma rā dzos do me ya kriṣ+ṭha ya 〉ri sam ya sde/de nyid las/phyi nang bgegs rnams bskrad pa yi//gsang sngags 'phreng ba bshad kyi nyen//zhes 'di dang bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'i bsrung sngags ring mo gnyis sbyar na legs /da kyang chad lhag tu mi 'gyur bas ma spros/na mo

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (25)mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma zhes pa nas/ brtan bzhugs kyi bar rgyal chen ltar la/ rgyal po chen po gnas srung po dang phyi mtshams gnyis las kyi gshin rje dang nang mtshams su 'don pa bsgyur ro/ /sgo'i nang nas ma chad gtor sngar bzhi bas/ sku rten swā bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i tswa lasapaṃ las pad+ma dang raṃ las nyi ma/ bgegs kyi rgyal po'i steng sdu / las khro bo bdud rtsi 'khyil pa sku mdog ljang gu ljang dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi dang po gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu thugs kar bsnol ba/ g.yas lhag mas nor bu dang ral gri/ g.yon lhag mas pad+ma dang rgya gram 'dzin pa/ sbrul gyis spras shing thod rlon dang tshangs skud 'chang ba/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ zhabasagayas bskum g.yon brkyang gis me dpung rab tu 'bar ba'i slong dkyil na bzhugs pa dpral bar oṃ nas/ gtor ma 'bul ba'i bar gong dang 'dra ba la lha'i mtshan bdud rtsi 'khyil ba dang sngags/ oṃ a khru ta kuṇ+ḍali ra bsgyur/ de nyid las/ hūṃ/ bskal (16ba)pa me dpung 'bar 'dra'i slong / /'chi med khro bo chen po'i sku/ /zhal g.yas rab tu bzhad pa ni/ /nge nā da'i gser 'od 'dra/ /dbus ma margad ljang gu'i mdangs/ /g.yon pa pad+ma rā ga 'dra/ /dbu yi thor tshugs rgya gram mdzes/ /rigs bdag don yod grub pa bzhugs/ /thabs mchoge snying rje'i rdo rje dang / khres rab dril bu thugs kar bsnol/ /yid bzhin nor bu rin po che/ /mtshon cha'i rgyal po ral gri g.yas/ /chags med skyon bral pad+ma dang / /las kyi rdo rje rgya gram g.yon/ /gdug pa sprul gyi phyag zhabs brgyan/ /thod 'phreng tshangs skud do shal mdzad/ /dpa' bo stag lpags sham thabs can/ /bgegs chen bsnol ba'i gdan steng na/ /'phrin las thog ser bgegs la 'bebs/ /dngos grub bar chad srung du gsol/ /oṃ a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍali tshin+ta sam ya ri/ na mo mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma sogs rigs 'gre sbyor/ lnga pa ma tre sgrol ba ni/ de yang rtogs slar ma tre ngam dam sri mnan pa zhes don gcig tu mdzad pa so mchan las/ bdud ru dras tshe 'di la bar du gcod/ /gshin rje ru dras srid pa bar dor gnod/ /dam sri ru dras chos 'khor gnyan po 'jig /kyi lus ngar 'dzin ma tre ka ru dra/ /ngag gi ngar 'dzin a kur+sha ru dra/ /sems kyi ngar 'dzin —362

sangs rgyas thams cad mnyam par sbyor ba dpal yang dag zla gam dgu pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga hūṃ mdzad zhal lung / nang ma (ka)kha / ka ru dra/ /zhes bshad/ ma tre ru dra'am thar pa nag po de srin yul du mngal las skyes pas dam srir mi ga rta gos shing sngar nas bsgral zin pa slar sgrol rgyu med kyang sngon byung gi rnam thar dang mthun pa'i ched du de'i gzugs la dgra bgegs spyi dang khyad par sgrub pa'i gegs byed dam sri ru dra bkug ste (17na〉sgral bas de nyid don gcig mdzad pa mi 'thad pa ma yin na'ang sngags rnying ma'i phyag len la ru dra'i khog par dkyil 'khor bzheng pa dang bcas so sor mdzad pa'i phyag bzhes ltar bkod kyi/ ga rma pa mi bskyod rdo rjes dam sri mir ngos bzung ba nag rtsis kyi sri'i rnam gzhag tsam yang ma mkhyen pa'i 'dzam gling rgyan gcig gi brtul zhugs kho na'o/ /de la yang cho ga /chos nyid/ byin gyis brlab pa dang gsum las/ dang po cho gas sgrol ba ni/dbang gzhung las/ de nas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad bdag la bsdus nas/ dmigs pa med pa'i don la gnas pa las/ yang sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' gzhan dag gis slong bar bsams nas/ rdo rje sems dpa'i skur bzhengs te 'di brjod do/ /hūṃ/ rgyal ba rigs lnga'i dkyil 'khor ni/ /'byung ba lnga yi mtshan nyid pas/ /zhi ba las ni lhan ne ba'i/ /thugs rjes 'gro kun de las skyes/ /de'i tshe sems can thams cad ni/ man tu khro dag gtum par 'gyur/ /de tshe sems can thams cad ni/ man tu gti mug che bar 'gyur/ /de ltar dug gsum bdo ba la/ /zhi bas phan par mi 'gyur te/ shes rab thabs kyi nyi ma las/ /rnam par rgyal phyir rab tu drag /oṃ mahā shrī he ru nasam ya/ kro dha ha la ha la hūṃ phaṭa/ ces brjod nas/ thams cad gcig tu 'dus pa las rngams pa'i sgra sgrogs te/ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ/ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa/ hūṃ/ mi rtag mtshan nyid bstan pa'i phyir/ /nam mkha'i khro bo za byed cha/ /'jigs pa'i mtshon cha 'od phung 'khrigs/ /zhal du stong khams ma lus thim/ /zad par (17ba)byed cing stongs par byed/ /rgas rgud rlag par byed pa'o/ /glog gi 'khor lo zhes bya ba/ /myur ba'i za byed chen po lngas/ /skye rga na 'chi 'joms byed cing / /rlag par byed cing stongs par byed/ /rin chen za byed khros pa'i tshe/ /sku ni sngo skya thal ba'i mdog /'od zer dmar po rab tu 'brigs/ /ru lu ru —363

rgya yod bang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (25)lus ma lus za/ /'bar ba'i 'khor lo tsho gos bcas pas/ khreg cing 'jig la 'thor zhing 'khru/ /gang 'dir bskal pas kun brlag cing / /gzhan zhig 'ong 'jig ma yin te/ /za byed khros pa lnga po yi/ /zhal du stong khams ma lus thim/ /oṃ burnya shrī he ru ka sa ma ya kro dha oṃ oṃ ha ha hūṃ phaṭa/ dbu la de bzhin gshegs pa'i khro bo dkar po phyag g.yas na 'khor lo dang g.yon thod khrag 'dzin pa grangs med pa'i tshogs rnams sprul pa dang bcas pa gnas par bsam/ oṃ badz+ra shrī he ru ka sam ye kro dha hūṃ hūṃ ru ru hūṃ phaṭa/ lag pa g.yas pa la rdo rje khro bo sngon po lag na rdo rje rtse lnga dang kha ṭ+wāṃ ga thogs pa grangs med pa'i tsho gos rnams sprul pa dang bcas pa gnas par bsam/ oṃ rat+na shrī he ru ka sa ma ya kro dha tre tho he he hūṃ phaṭa/ lag pa g.yon pa la rin cen khro bo ser bo dbyug to dang ral gri thogs pa grangs med pa'i tshogs rnams sprul pa dang bcas pa gnas par bsam/ /pad+ma shrī he ru ka sam ya kro dha hrīḥphyid ha na hūṃ phaṭa/ rkang pa g.yon pa la pad+ma'i khro bo dmar nag phyag na ral gri rtse gsum dang gas shing thogs pa grangs med pa'i tshogs rnams sprul pa dang bcas pa gnas par bsam/ oṃ gan shrī he ru ka sa ma ya kro dha ha ha traka ka hūṃ phaṭa/ rkang pa g.yas pa la las(18na〉kye khro bo ljang nag phyag na rdo rje dang lcags kyu thogs pa grangs med pa'i tsho gis rnams sprul pa dang bcas pa gnas par bsam ma shrī be ra ba hūṃ mahā de wa hūṃ phaṭa/ mtshan ma la lha chen po mdog dkar po phyag na tri shā la dang thod pa thogs pa 'khor dang bcas pa gnas par bsam/ oṃ biṣ+ṭha kai sam tsakra3 phaṭa/ snying gar khyab 'jug mthing nag phyag na 'khor lo dang thod pa thogs pa 'khor dang bcas pa gnas par bsam/ oṃ raka shrī ba hūṃ phaṭa/ mgrin par srin po'i rgyal po sngo ljang lag na dgra sta dang thod pa thogs pa 'khor dang bcas pa gnas par bsam/ oṃ ma hā pa sha ha la hūṃ phaṭa/ sku'i gnas su gas pa nag po sngo skya lag na zhags pa dang thod pa thogs pa 'khor dang bcas pa gnas par bsam/ chabadz+ra bhe ra ba hūṃ phaṭa/brla gnyis la rdo rje 'jigs byed rnam par 'jigs pa ljang skya rdo rje rtse gsum pa dang thod pa thogs pa 'khor dang bcas pa gnas par bsam/ de dag kun kyang rang rang gi yum dang 'khril ba'i tshul du —364

sangs rgyas thams cad mnyam par sbyor ba dpal yang dag zla gam dgu pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga hūṃ mdzad zhal lung / nang ma (ka)gnas par bsam/lag pa'i sor mo khrag 'thung gal po las/lag pa g.yas pa'i mkhrig ma la/khra dang spyang gi lug pa khas/lag pa g.yon pa'i mkhrig ma la//na bya rog gre mos/zhes gad/bcu la mche ba can dang ster mo can dag sngags 'dis gsal bar bya'o//oṃ mahā khru gi sha ri bi ka sha ri bi ka ma ru shu ha ha he he ru lu ru lu hūṃ phaṭa/lha tshogs bskul ba ni/hūṃ/ye shes glog gi 'khor lo dang //'jigs pa'i khro bo gtum pa'i tshogs/khor yang 'gyur ba'i mtshon cha yis//sdug bsngal gnas rnams rab tu choms//ma rungs dur khrod 14bzhig pa'i phyir//stong gsum gnas rnams bsgral bar bya//'jigs byed drag shul chen po yis/khamasagasum gtsig par bsgral nas kyang //za byed ོ po'i zhal du ni//'gro kun yud tsam gcig la 'dren//'gro dang mi 'gro snod bas 'di//'jigs byed khyed lngas kun za na//dngos por gyur ba'i bgegasa'adi kun//ngas stob khyed kyis yud la gsol//ga song gsum gyi 'jigs byed du//sems can nyon mongs sdang byed pas//de phyir nga ni rdo rje che//zhe sdang zhes ni grags pa yin//ga song 'jigasabyed chen po sa/sems can thams cad rmonges byed pas//de phyir nga ni gti mug che//rtag tu thub pa mchog yin no//srid pa 'dod chags myos pa rnams//'dod chags kho kyis mtshams sbyor bas//de phyir chos kyi rdo rje nga //'dod chags wo po'i mchog yin no//bde wo sbyin pa'i sprin gyis ni//sems can thams cad nga rgyal bskyed//nam mkha' bde bas bsdus pa'i phyir//bde chen 'dod pa nga yin no//ro la sogs pa mnyam sbyor bas//phrag dog rdo rje gdon mi za//sna tshogos las kyi khro bo'i sku//phrag dog chen po'i mchog yin no//nga ni dus gsum bzhugs pa yin//sangs rgyas kun gyi ye shes sku//ye shes rno dbal mtshon cha yis//log rtog 'khor ba'i rgyun bcad de/chos dbyings mnyam nyid nam mkha' la//ye shes glog gi 'od 'phro ba//gnas med dmigs pa yod ma yin//rtsab med cing brten pa med//oṃ da ha da ha sarba na ra kā ga ti he tī hūṃ phaṭa/oṃ pa tsa pa tsa sarba pre ta kā ga ti 19na ) lha stu hūṃ phaṭa/oṃ ma tha ma tha sarba tirla kā ti 6he nyu hūṃ phaṭa/chasarba du rga ga ti sarba mi me/sarba kle

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (25)sha tshin+ta tshin+ta hūṃ phaṭa/ pa ra bi dan tshin+ta hūṃ phaṭa/ pa ra bi da kha zhe tshin+ta tshin+ta hūṃ phaṭa/ rmi ༷ bi sha mu la tshin+ta tshin+dha hūṃ phaṭa/ dpal chen 'bar ba rgyal po'i sku/ /rngams brjid khros pa'i cha lugs 'bar/ /gar dgu dur khrod rgyan gyis brdzid/ shes rab sku dang 'bril sbyor zhing / /'jo tshul gar mdzad lta ba yis/ /bdud dang srin po 'dul bar mdzad/ /ma tre la sogs dregs byed rnams/ /gzugs dang bcas pa'i tsho gos bsdus te/ /pra ti tā yi phyag rgya yis/ /nges par gzugs la dbab par bya/ /gzugs brnyan bris pa la sogs dang / /phyag rgya bris pa la sogs la/ /phyag rgya bzhi yisangs byas nas/ /sngags kyi 'od 'phro phyag rgya yis/ /de yi 'khor tsho gis bsdu bar bya/ /gser skyems btang / /las byang bzhin 'brub khung bskyed/ de'i nang du ngo bo gnod byed dgra bgegs la rnam pa ru dra'i gzugs mgo gsum lag pa drug /rkang pa bzhi pa/ gshog pa brgyangs pa/ mya ngan gyi 'dug stangs can du bsam/ bden bdar dam sri'i dus bzhin byas pa'i mthar dgug sngags dang dur khrod kyi bskor dbang gzhung mi bde bas khrag 'thung gal po las/ ma tre ka ru dra dzaḥ kha tre ka ru da dzaḥ a po〉 ru dra dzaḥ o ma hā dmu gci na yang / kai pa la dha ri sha ya hūṃ a ga ste ya hūṃ/ dzaḥ/ baṃ ho lan gsum brjod/ rdo rje gshog pa'i phyag rgyas las mnan cing bstim/ de nyid las/ hūṃ/ ma tre bya ba'i sdig can khyod/ /(19ba) sngon yang dpal chen he ru gas/ /bsgral nas dur khrod wo por mdzad/ /de yang rnal 'byor dbang phyug ngas/ /bsgral nas dur khrod wo por bya/ /dzaḥ& baṃ hoḥ shrī he ru ka ma hā badz+ra sarba tsu sam ya mu dra pra ban tsakra hūṃ da hūṃ na hūṃ phaṭa/ ces kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dang phur mtshon btab ste rnam shes sbar/ khro bo puṇ+ḍa ri ka las/hūṃ/ mgo ni lho nub das g.yi du/ro yang lho yi womo gling du/ /bor nas tswakho gyur po ni/ zhes byug mtshams su bsgral/ /rkang pa byang shar mtshams su bsgral/ /yan lag gling bzhi'i yul du bsgral/ /lag pa g.yas pa'i dur khrod ni/ /rgya sgoms du rgya gar sogs phyi'i dur khrod kyi gnas phyed brgyad/ mgo bo sogs nag gi dur khrod phyed brgyad/ mig gi rnam shes sogs gsang ba'i dur khrod phyed brgyad rnams bshad/ gar yul du bsgral bar bya/ /de yi bdag mo go rī ma/ mthing nag 'bar ba'i ral pa can/ dur khrod lag pa g.yon pa ni/ /li yi yul du bsgral —366

sangs rgya thams cad mnyam par sbyor ba dpal yang dag zla gam dgu pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga hūṃ mdzad zhal lung / nang ma (ka)bar bya/ /de yi bdag mo tso rī ma/ /ser mo 'bar ba'i ral pa can/ /mche gtsigs rkan rdeb dur khrod sgrol/ /dur khrod rkang pa g.yas pa ni/ /bal po'i yul du bsgral bar bya/ /de yi bdag mo pra mo ha/ /dmar mo 'bar ba'i ral pa can/ /mche gtsigs rkan rdeb dur khrod sgrol/ /dur khrod rkang pa g.yon pa ni/ /tho gar yul du bsgral bar bya/ /de yi bdag mo be+et+ta lī/ /nag mo 'bar ba ral pa can/ /mche gtsigs rkan rdeb dur khrod sgrol/ /dur khrod 'di yi mgo bo ni/ /za hor yul du bsgral bar bya/ /de yi bdag mo puska sī/ /dmar ser 'bar ba'i ral pa can/ /mche gtsigs rkan rdeb dur khrod sgrol/ /dur khrod mkhal ma g.yon pa ni/ /phyon yul du bsgral bar bya/ /(20na ti yi bdag mo ghasma rī/ /dkar ljang 'bar ba'i ral pa can/ /mche gtsigs rkan rdeb dur khrod sgrol/ /dur khrod 'di yi pho mtshan ni/ /siṅga yul du bsgral bar bya/ /de yi bdag mo sma sha ni/ /mthing nag 'bar ba'i ral pa can/ /mche gtsigs rkan rdeb dur khrod sgrol/ /dur khrod mkhal ma g.yas pa ni/ /gling dgu'i yul du bsgral bar bya/ /de yi bdag mo tsaṇ+ḍasnyi/ /ljang ser 'bar ba'i ral pa can/ /mche gtsigs rkan rdeb dur khrod sgrol/ /dur khrod dpung mgo g.yas g.yon ni/ /phra men stag dang seng ge'i rdzas/ /dur khrod brla ni g.yas dang g.yon/ /phra men wa spyang bya rog lug /pho nya'i rgyal mo de yi rdzas/ /dur khrod thar pa rkang lag bzhi/ /pho nya 'gugs ma de bzhi'i rdzas/ /dur khrod bdag po spyan drangs te/ /bgegs kyi rgyal po ru dra bsgral/ /bde ba chen po'i ngang yin te/ /nga ni dur khrod dbang phyug ste/ /sangs rgyas sku ste ye shesayin/ /'jam dpal rnon po'i mtshon cha yis/ /log rtog 'khor ba'i rgyun bcad de/ /dbang gzhung las/oṃ sarba pā paṃ ka ra he/ ti pa ti bi ni ma tre ka ru dra hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ sarba pā paṃ kā re he pā paṃ bi gi kha hre ka ru dra hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ sarba pā paṃ ra ge ha ta pa bi gi a kā r+ṣa ru dra hūṃ phaṭa/ ces brjod cing mgo bo dang yan lag rnams tshig dang bstun nas phyogs ma log par 'jog cing 'phrin las bzhi'i bro brdung / sgoms du nyad/las byang gi bsrung 'khor tshar gcig brjod/ gnyis pa chos nyid kyis sgrol ba ni/ dbang gzhung las/shar phyogs 'jig rten las sgo nas/ /yang dag thar lam gcod byed pa/ /'byung po gtum po nga rgyal —367

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (25)can/ khyod ni sgrib pas(20ba〉kyin la bsgribs/ /yang dag thar lam ye shes kyis/ khungs rtags rtsad bcad bdag las byung / /bdag 'dzin dag gi rtog pa rnams/ /bdag med stong pa'i tho bas gzhes/ /āt+pa na hi/ mahā shu rgyu ta brjod/ chos kun rtag tu rang gi ngo bos stongs/ /rgyal ba'i sras kyi bden 'dzin rnam par 'jig /srid pa ji bzhin thams cad stong pa ste/ /nyi tshe'i nying nyid mu stegs can gyi'o//gang dag stong nyid mi shes pa/ /de yi mya ngan 'das mi shes/ /de phyir dngos po dngos med pas/ /'jig pas stong nyid shes par bya/ /stong pa chen po zhes bya ba/ /kun mkhyen ye shes rdzogs byed pa/ /de bsarnam pa thams cad du/ /stong nyid rjes su dran par bya/ /oṃ dharmā ṅgā tu badz+ra su bhā wa āt+pa ko3lha/ zhesapas mtshan ma'i rtog tshogs kun mi rtog pa'i ye shes kyis gzhom par bya'o/ /mkhas pa chen po chag lo chos rje dpal sogs kyi rnying rgyud rnams rdzun mar mdzad nas phur pa rtsa dum dang skyon chen pos mdzad pa'i rdo rje las rim/ hūṃ kwa ras mdzad pa'i yang dag gi sgrub dkyil sogs tshad mar bzung ba'i lugs kyi yang phur rnam par dag go gsung ba'i hūṃ mdzad kyi gzhung du ma tre gyi skor sogs snga 'gyur gyi brda chad ngo mtshar ba mang bas rnying ma la thugs sdang sems dang 'phags pa rin po ches bod chol kha gsum la mnga' sgyur bar ngo 'dzin gyi gya gyu ma mdzad par ke ri pi ri'i thal rtsed la brtson par zhu/ gsum pa ma tho gi khog pa byin gyis brlab pa ni/ khrag 'thung gal po las/khog pa ༷ las gyur pa yi/ /zhes sogs kyi don bsdus te/ : dzñā na tsakra maṇ+ḍal hūṃ/ bdag gi thugasaga'i hūṃ las sa grangs med pa spros pas/ (21na 〉 pa tre gi khog pa la phog ste de nyid dur khrod kyi gzhal yas khang nam mkha'i mtha' rdeng mnyam pa bhan+ta gsar rnying gi rtsig pa byas pa/ gnam lcags kyi gzer btab pa la rak+ta'i zhal chu 'bab pa/ bhan+ta lcang lo can gyi kha bad btang ba/ lha chen brgyad kyi ka ba btsugs pa/ gza' chen brgyad kyi ka gzhu bkal pa/ zhing chen gyi gdung ma bres pa/ gza' skar mang por dral ma byas pa/ zhing lpags kyi thog phub pa/ rin cen rnam bzhi'i sgo mo bcad pa/ rgyan sna tshogasakyis spras pa/ nang pho brang zla gam dgu pa/ phyi dur khrod kyi gnas brgyad kyis brgyan pa/ de'i phyi rim —368

sangs rgyas thams cad mnyam par sbyor ba dpal yang dag zla gam dgu pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga hūṃ mdzad zhal lung / nang ma (ka)lcags ri dang me ris bskor bar bsam/ khu tshur dang bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub bsgreng zhing / sne badz+ra kha ta li bra pe sha ya phaṭa/ ces zha bdun brjod pas sgo phye/ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ/ zhes nang du blta bar gzhug /badz+ra.a lha gis sgo bcad nas/ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ/ zhes brjod pas khang pa mo dpung 'bar ba'i rang bzhin du bsam/dbang gzhung las/ kha ṭ+wāṃ ga la rgyab brten bcas/ /nam mkha'i phyag rgya rnal 'byor bcas/ /nam mkha' kun las 'gro ba kun/ /dngos po thams cad mkha' 'byin pa/ /mkha' ༷ ma kun blangs nas/ /lus pa med par der za'o/ /ghaṇ+ḍi to yis sgrol bar mdzod/ /la lar mkhas pa'i gzugs kyang 'dzin/ /la lar tshangs pa bzhin du zhi/ /la lar gshin rje bzhin du rngams/ la lar dus mtha'i me ltar 'bar/ /'jig rten khams ni stong dag tu/ /mi sdug rigs kyi gzugs 'dzin pa'i/ /mkha' 'gro 'bar ba'i tshogs bcas kyis/ ma lus lus pa med par sgrol/ /zhes (21ba〉rdo rje'i glu blangs/ hūṃ/ bstab bo gsol zhig he ru daḥ/ /gang la bya ba'i dngos po 'di/ /phra men gshed ma thams cad kyis/ /dbang dang rig sngags byin brlabs te/ /rig sngags kyis ni rmongs mdzad nas/ /drag po las kyi sgrub byed cing / /'di la sogs pa rnams pa yang / /de dag longs spyod rkyen du 'bul/ sha dang rkang khrag 'dod pa rnams/ /rig sngags kyis ni byin brlabs nas/ /'tsho ba phyogs nas ci bde bar/ khyod kyis de la longs spyod cig /bhan+ta bcud yangs zab pa na/ khor yug gtogos pa'i dngos po 'di/ /bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin yin pa'i phyir/ /'jigs byed bka' bzlog dgyes shing rol/ /rdo rje gsum 'bar sku gsung thugs/ /srid gsum 'joms mdzad tri shu la/ /dug gsum rtsad nas gcod pa'i phyir/ khamasagasum cig car bsgral bar bya/ /'jigs byed drag shul chen po yis/ khams gsum cig car bsgral nas kyang / /za byed chen po'i zhal du ni/ /'gro kun yud tsam zhig la 'dren/ /'gro dang mi 'gro'i snod bcud 'di/ /'jigs byed khyed lngas kun za na/ /dngos por gyur pa'i bgegs 'du kun/ /ngas bstab khyod kyis yud la bzhes/ /oṃ mahā shrī he ru ka ha ha ha ha/ ru lu ru lu/ hūṃ bh+yo hūṃ bh+yo/ 'a hi khā hi/zhes zhal du bstab bo/ /drug pa chag chag rtogs par sla bar sa chog gi khrod du byung nga mi yid pa ma yin kyang dbang —369

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (25)gci sogs ca ma spyi dang mas par byas/ gdab pa ni/ khrag 'thung gal po'i brtag pa bdun pa dang puṇ+ḍa ri rka'i le'u gsum po nas bshad pa dang don gcig pas 'jug pa bde phyir rtogs par sla ba las/ der steg bas bu gru bzhi dbang gzhung las/ stegs du lab(22na)phyung lnga/ sman spos/ bdud rtsi lnga 'byug po dang so mchan du stegasabu rtsigs dkyil 'khor byin dang ldan pa'i phyir chag chag gdab ces byung / pa brtsig pa'am ma grub na bdud rtsi lnga'i skyang nul bya zhing sum+bha brjod pa'am spro na/ chos dbyings dag pa'i bdud rtsi mi bskyod pas/ /rgyal ba'i thugs kyi dngos grub bsgrub pa'i phyir/ bka' gsang rmad du byung ba'i dkyil 'khor 'dir/ /gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor chen por chag chag 'debs/ /oṃ mahā spru tre maṇ+ḍal hūṃ/ de bzhin du 'don pa bsgyur te/ me long dag pa'i bdud rtsi rnam snang 'dis/ /rgyal ba'i sku yis/ /bka' gsang sogs 'gre/ cham hā bi tra maṇ+ḍal oṃ/ mnyam nyid dag pa'i bdud rtsi rak+ta 'dis/ /rgyal ba'i yon tan sogs/ cham hā ru dhi ra maṇ+ḍal swā/ kun rtog dag pa'i bdud rtsi byang sems 'dis/ /rgyal ba'i gsung gi sogs/ oṃ mahā shukla maṇ+ḍal e/ bya grub dag pa'i bdud rtsi sha chen 'dis/ /rgyal ba'i 'phrin las sogs/ cham hā me sa maṇ+ḍal hā/ zhes brjod de bdud rtsi lnga'i skyang nul bya zhes 'byung bas so/ /bdun pa thig 'debs la las thig dang ye thig gnyis las dbang gzhud du lha rnams kyil nas su reg pa'i thig gdang cing / zhes pa tsam las 'dir mi gsal yang slob ma sta gon gyi 'og tu ye thig bshad cing der gsal/ dang po lasathig sgom chan du las bya ba go bde ba bya ba'i phyir thig gdab/ ces byung / khrag 'thung gal po'i brtag pa bdun pa/ puṇ+ḍa ni rka'i le'u gnyis pa/ snying rje rol pa'i le'u dad po rnams nas phyi nang gi thig 'debs tshul gsungs shing zla gam rnam rtsib kyi nang du 'bri bar shad r+pā 'dug cing deng sang mi mdzad pa mang / gdab pa ni/ nang thig ma gtogs rtogs sla las/ sboms su sgo'i nyi shu cha dkyus dkyil 'khor las gnyis sbom dang ring thung dbang ga dang mas/ 'gyur (22bstes ring ba la sogs pa'i mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i thig skud kyis thig gdab ste dkyil 'khor ji tsam byed pa de'i phyed ma bas cung zad ring ba'i skud pas lho byang nas dbus su nya bris la kha mjug tu thig skud then pas shar nub kyi tshangs thig 'byung / de'i dbus nas ji tsam rigs pa'i zlum po bskor te zlum 370

sangs rgyas tham cad mnyam par sbyor ba dpal yang dag zla gam dgu pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga hūṃ mdzad zhal lung / nang ma (ka)po'i thig dang tshangs thig 'dzom pa nas sngar gyi zlum po'i phyed kyi tshad kyi zlum po bskor/ de gnyis kyi dkyil drang por btab pas tshangs thig gnyis pa 'byung / de bzhin du lho byang gi zlum po tshangs thig gnyis pa dang 'dzom pa'i sa nas zlum po sngar bzhin bskor bas mtshams bzhir nya bzhi 'byung / de'i kha nas thig skud then pas zur thig bzhi 'byung / de nas dkyil 'khor ji tsam byed pa'i zur gyi mtshan ma zur thig steng du bya/ g.yin nas khrung ba'i cha chen bcu drug dang cha chung gi cha dbye ba rnams byas la/lte ba nas phyi rol tu cha chen gcig dang cha chen gsum phyin te zlum por bskor/ de'i phyir cha chen re re yod pa lan gnyis su bskor/ zlum thig phyi ma'i phyed cha nas thig brgyad pad+ma'i gces thig bzhin gdab/ phyogs mtshams kyi lte ba nas gtso bo'i gnas la ma reg tsam gyi zlum thig re bskor/ gtso bo'i sgo zlum thig gi shar nas chung gnyis nang du phyin te bcad pas grub/ de rjes gdus thig gi bcad kha nas sgo dang sgo khyud sgo logs mnyam pa bri/ phyi rol tu sna tsho gis rdo rje 'ded pa ltar na pad+ma dang / mi 'dod ba ltar na zur thig gi rtse nas zlum thig gcig dang / de nas cha chen gcig dor bar dam can gyi gnas dang yang cha wo gcig dor bar dur khrod dang / yang cha phran gnyis kyis rdor ra dang / cha chen gcig gis me ri'i zlum bskor bya'o/ /gnyis(23na)pa ye shes kyi thig gdab pa la/ gnam thig dang sa thig gnyis las/ dang po gnam thig gdab pa ni/ khrag 'thung gal po las/ ras bal pad+ma'i rgyus pa dang / shi ba'i skra yi skud pa'am/ bha su ta yi thig skud bya zhes byung ba'i skud pa'i rgyu dang 'khel mkhan/ khro bo puṇ+ḍa ri ka las/gzung ma mtshan dang ldan pa gcig /las kyi rdo rje mor dbang bskur/ /thig skud 'khel du gzhug pa'o/ /zhes dang / gsang ba me dpung thugs kyi rgyud las/ shes rab mtshan dang ldan pas bkal ba yi/ /thig skud byang chub sems dang ldan pas gdab/ /ces pa ltar ras bal gyi thig skud sna lnga so sor 'khel du bcug ste 'du byas pa dkyil 'khor gyi dbus dang phyogs bzhir bkod/ tshon gyi cho ga 'og tu byung yang 'jug pa bde phyir ting phor lngar tshon la rigs lnga'i sa bon bris pa dang thig skud lnga —371—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (25)phyogs mtshungs su bzhag lamachode pa lhag mas/ sum+bha gong gzhungs rigs kyi yi ge lhar ho cing dgug gzhugamachod bstod bya tshul phyogs mtshungs shing khrag 'thung gal po'i brtag pa bdun par r+sā byin bslas skad/ bsangs/ su bhā was thig tshon sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las dbus dang phyogs bzhin paṃ pad+ma maṇ+ḍal/ a tsan+d+ra maṇ+ḍal/ma su rla maṇ+ḍal/ mahā de wa dzaḥ u ma de sa dzaḥ in+da dzaḥya ma dzaḥ wa ru ṇa dzaḥ ku be+e ra dzaḥ zhes pad+ma dang zla nyi'i gdan gyi dbus su dbang phyug yab yum dang phyogs bzhir rang rang gi phyogs skyong rnams bkug ste gnas par bsam/ las byang nas byung ba'i hūṃ tiṣ+ṭha rat+na srurla oṃ zhes pa nas bzung ste/ rdza ra ṇa phaṭa byang sems dkar dmar 'dres zhes pa'i bar dkyus ltar la/ sras kyi sa bon hūṃ oṃ swā e hā/lngar gyur yum gyi mkha' nas gdan steng du/ babs pa zhu ste thig tshon (23bskong 'dres pas/ dbus su badz+ra he ru da sngon po/ shar du kyā he ru gaḥdakar po/ lho ru rat+na he ru g.ye po/ nub tu pad+ma he ru gaḥdamar po/ byang du skadze he ru gaḥljang gu /zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas pa rdo rje dang / 'khor lo rin cen pad+ma rgya gram bsnams/ g.yon pa rang rtags yu ba byas pa yi/ /dril bu bzung nas yum dang mnyam par sbyor/ /dur khrod chas can zhabs g.yon brkyangs te bzhugs/ /gnas gsum yi ge gsum gyis mtshan par bsam/ /rang gi thugs ga'i hūṃ las 'od los pas/ /rang 'dra'i ye shes sems dpa' sa mā dzaḥs spyan drangs dzaḥ& baṃ hoḥs gnyis med bsam/ oṃ badz+ra a ha ra sogs kyis mchod/lha rnams 'od du zhu nas thig tshon so so la thim pas srad bu dang tshon gyi rnam par bsam/ ru lu 'bru brgyad kyi rjes su su tre ma tikra ma hūṃ/ zhes pa brgya rtsa bzlas pa srad bu dang tsi tra ma ti badz+ra sa ma ya hūṃ āḥ zhes brgya rtsa brgyad kyis tshon brlab thig tshon oṃ 40PROB gis mtshan pa'i 'od kyis sku gsung thugs kyi lha thams cad spyan drangs/ yig 'bru la thim/ 'od du zhu bas sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs kyi rang bzhin du byin gyis brlabs te tshon rnams rin po che'i rang bzhin du bsams la oṃ āḥ& mang du bzla/ de nas bdag gi thugs ka nas rta mchog rol pa sprul par bsams shing / skadze badz+ra hā zhes pa dang oṃ di bha pa gi tiṣ+ṭha e ku sha dbang g.yi nas tsā da/ snosnosnosnosno dz+dza ye kha brjod de thig —372

sangs rgyas thams cad mnyam par sbyor ba dpal yang dag zla gam dgu pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga hūṃ mdzad zhal lung / nang ma (ka)skud rnams shar nas nub tu rtsa bar/ dkyil lor nub phyogs de pos 4kho/ khres par sgoms du slob dpon gyisadagong pa nub nas mdzad par ngos bang / rim bzhin brkyangs la thabs kyi gsang gnas su drangs te oṃ āḥsnyi snosnosnosno dpon slob gnyis kyis gcig tu bsgril zhing / 'jig rten khams ni ma lus pa'i//sems can rnams kyi don bya'i phyir/ /(24na〉ngas rgyas thams cad ma lus kun/ /byang chub sems ni gcig tu bsam/ /a rgyo n+ya a nu gā lhas spru rgyaḥ.ā ra lpa ra a nu pra bi gi sa spru sna a dun a nu bra bigs spru ra zhes brjod/ bdud rtsi lnga'i chus byugasang oṃ āḥ& bzlas la/ rdo rje dril bu thogs te/slob dpon nub/ slob ma shar du 'dug pas/ khrag 'thung gal po las/ hūṃ/ bkra shis mtshan ldan gzung ma yum/ /zhal nas ut+pal ngad ldang zhing / /skad kyang ngang pa gzhen nu 'dra/ /snyan par smra zhing tshul dang ldan/ /bkra shis mtshan ldan yid du 'ong / /mnyen lhug 'khril ldem dbyer mi phyed/ /rdo rje las kyi dngos grub ma/ /gnyis med sbyor ba'i byin rlabs kyi/ /gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor thig 'debs kyi/ /las rnams ma lus kun gyis shig /sa ma ya hoḥ sa ma ya rtoḥ thabs dang shes rab ldan pa'i byin rlabs las/ /gsang ba mchog gi dkyil 'khor chen po 'dir/ /gsang ba'i byang chub sems kyi thig btab pas/ /ye shes ga' kha yas pho brang lhun gyis grub/ /oṃ gu phya a gra dzñā na maṇ+ḍal hūṃ/ dbang gzhud las/ stobs chen dpa' bo dgongs su gsol/ /rdo rje thig le sgra ldan pas/ /nam mkhar dkyil 'khor legs grub cing / /'gro ba'i don la bskul bar bya/ /oṃ bo dhi tsit+ta sarba satwa hūṃ/ zhes tshangasathig dang po nam mkhar 'ong nas steng du gdab la sangs rgyas thams cad byon nas thig la thim par bsam mo/ /gnyis pa sa thig gdab pa ni/ khrag 'thung gal po las/ hūṃ/ thabs dang shes rab ldan pa'i byin rlabs las/ /gsang ba mchog gi dkyil 'khor chen po 'dir/ /gsang ba byang chub semasakyi thig btab pas/ /dur khrod brdal ba'i gzhal yas lhun gyis grub/ /oṃ badz+ra sngags 'di gas thig gdabokhro bo ༅ri ga'i le'u dang po nas༅da/ su khri ma ti kra ma hūṃ/ zhes shar nub kyi tshangs thig dang po gdab/ de bzhin du slob dpon lho/ slob ma byang (24ba)du gnas pas tshangs thig gnyis pa gdab/ slob dpon —373

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (25)me/ slob ma dbang ldan du gnas pas shar phyogs gdab/ slob dpon nub byang / slob ma srin por gnas pas nub phyogs gdab/ slob dpon de nyid/ slob ma dbang ldan du gnas pas byang phyogasagadab/ slob dpon me/ slob ma bden bral du gnas pas lho phyogs gdab/ slob dpon de nyid/ slob ma lung du gnas pas zur thig dang po/ slob dpon bden bral/ slob ma dbang ldan du gnas pas zur thig gnyis pa gdab/ 'bros 'ded kyi tshul gyi/ de nas dpon slob gnyis nub dang shar du gnas pasathig skud bsdu/ dbang gzhung gi dgongs don bsdus pa ye thig la mchod bstod bsdus pa zhig byas te gshegs su gsol/ rang ltar gsal ba'i mig gnyis nyi zlar bsam/ hi zhes lta stangs dang bcas rdo rje slong ba'i phyag rgya dang oṃ badz+ra be gwa kra ma hūṃ/ zhes dkyil 'khor gyi nang du zhugs shing sgo dbye/ de nas phyogs mtshams thams cad nas mnyam pa nyid du dmigs nas tshig 'dis dag par bya'o/ /oṃ thams cad rnam 'phrul rang bzhin mchog /dngos med zhi ba'i 'od ldan gsal/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa gter chen 'dzin/ /dkyil 'khor dag par byin gyis rlobs/ /mnyam pa'i sngags blo rnam gsal bas/ /nyes pa'i zug rngu dag par bya/ /zhes brjod cing thams cad lha'i rang bzhin du lta'o/ /brgyad pa lha sta gon la lha bskyed/ mchod bstod/ snyan gsan dang gsum las/ dang po lha bskyed pa ni/ ting 'dzin rnam gsum snga 'gyur phal cher las byang gi sngon 'gro rnams kyang mdzad pa shas che zhing dbang gzhung du'ang sbyong ba dang srung ba byin gyi bslas pa zhes byung ba ltar byas kyang mi legs pa ma yin mod 'dir rtogs par sla ba dang phyogasamatshungs par byas/ bsgom pa nas phyi rol kha dog sna lnga'i me dpung 'bar zhes pa yan las dbang gzhung du gzhi'i ting nge 'dzin rang rten gyi ting nge 'dzin dang brten pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi rdo rje sems dpa'i dkyil 'khor gsal bar bya/ zhes kyang /byang ltar bskyed/ de nas rang (25na'ang gi sngags lan bdun re brjod cing gtso bor gru bzhi dang gzhan dbang g.yi du yo 'di bas byung /rnams la zlum por di'i thig le bya/ paṃ pad+ma maṇ+ḍal zhes me tog gi tshom bu sgom mchod lha so so'i mdun du mar me g.yas su zhal zas/ g.yon du sbos bkod pa'i nang gi shar mchod yab/ nub mchod yum/ nub phyi ma go rī ma/ 'dod snam gyi thad nas g.yas skor du phyi mchod/ sman raka gtor gsum sogs bsham/ sgos mchod ngor rdzong gi lugs—374

sangs rgyas thams cad mnyam par sbyor ba dpal yang dag zla gam dgu pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga hūṃ mdzad zhal lung / nang ma yodaltar zhing tu bris mod/ dmu gca du'ang zang pa'i tsho gis dgram zhes bshad/ dgod/ a tsan+d+ra maṇ+ḍal/ ma su rla maṇ+ḍal/mahā de wa dzaḥ u ma de sa dzaḥ ma tre dzaḥ zhes rang rang gi gdan bskyed/ hūṃ/ dpal chen yang dag badz+ra he ru gaḥzhes pa nas/ 'phro 'du ba thag gzings pa lta bur gsal gyi bar la yum gyi sngags dor/ shar du go rī sngon mo phyag g.yas kyi zhes sogs lha mo brgyad kyi sngags rnams dor ba'i tshigs bcad dkyus bzhin dang snyan gsan dbab pa nas phyag 'tshal ba'i bar bya/ gnyis pa mchod bstod bya ba ni/ lasabyang gi mchod rdzas byin rlabs byas rjes phyi mchod nas bstod pa'i bar brjod/ gsum pa snyan gsan dbab pa ni/ dbang gzhung las/ de nas bus mo btsugs te g.yas spos snod thogs la g.yon pasadril bu 'khrol zhing tshig 'di brjod do/ /hūṃ/ thugs rje chen po bcom ldan 'das/ /ma lus sems can don mdzad pa'i/ /rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor sras dang bcas/ /stobs mchog rgyal chen rnams la bstod/ /sangs rgyas thams cad mnyam sbyor ba/ /yang dag bsgrub pa gcig pu nyid/ /mkha' 'gro sgyu ma'i dkyil 'khor ni/ /mgon gyur las rnams grub pa'i phyir/ /rdo rje gsang ba bdag gis bri/ /brtse bas slob ma rnams phyir dang / /bdag nyid rnams la mchod pa'i phyir/ /bcom ldan khyod la bdag gus te/ /dgyes mdzad 'os par gyur pa las/ /bdag cag rnams la dgongs su gsol/ /bya ba chen po'i 'khor lo'i phyir/ /'bras gnas byang chub sems tshogs dang / /gsang sngags(25ba tshe nasang ba'i lha nyid dang / /'byung tshogs 'jig rten skyong ba dang / /rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi rjes dga' ba/ /bstan la dga' ba'i 'gro ba dag /yang dag rdo rje'i spyan ldan pa/ /rigs rnams 'dul ba'i dkyil 'khor gtso/ /don grub gsang ba bdag gis brtsam/ /rjes su brtse bas nyer dgongs te/ /gnang bar mdzad du gsol lags so/ /zhes lan gsum gsol ba btab a ha ra sogs kyis slar yang mchod cing bstod pa'i thog mtha'i sho lo ka gnyis kyis bstod do/ /dbang gzhung du mchod rdzas/ rnal 'byor pa'i rgyan chas/ sbyin sreg /rdo rje sems dpa'i sbyor —375

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (25)bas lusang ga yid gsum gyi mthu bskyed par gsungs pa ni bka' brgyad la lha sta gon gyi skabs dkyil 'khor rgyan dgod kyi mda' sogs nyal stabs kyi bshams/ las gzhud bsrangs te bsnyen pa byed par gsungs pa dang dgongs pa gcig cing rnying lugs tshor phyag len dar na'ang 'dir bde khyad dus phur lha khra dang phyogs mthun du bzhag /tshogs gsog par bshad pa sngar gong du bsags pas go chod/ tshogs mchod dang bkang bshags ni dngos gzhi'i skabs su 'byung bas so/ /dgu pa bum pa bsgrub pa ni/ dbang gzhus du/ bum pa mgrin ring lto ba zlum/ zhes sogs bum pa/ kha rgyan/ gzungs thag /bum rdzas/ sgrub lugs sogs kyi sdo mos mdo tsam byung ba dang rtogs sla dgongs pa mthun pa brjod bder bkod pa ni/ 'byor na rin po che'am ma 'byor na rgyus la sogs pa la byas pa'i bum pa bcu kha dog dkar por bsgyur/ ras tshon lngas mgul bcings/ shing 'o ma can lo 'bras dang bcas pas kha brgyan/ nang du sman lnga/ 'bru lnga/ dri lnga/ rin cen lnga/ snying po lnga/ bdud rtsi dang chu srog chags med pas bkang / de nas pad+ma 'dab brgyad bris par me tog gi tshom bu bkod pa'i dbus dang 'dab mar 'god cing las bum logs su bzhag go /sum+bha sa bsangs/ su bhā was (26na)sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las zlo dkar po las byung ba'i bum pa yangs shing rgya che ba'i dbus kyi bum pa'i lte ba dang phyogs mtshams brgyad du paṃ pad+ma maṇ+ḍal nas/ ma rta dzaḥ'i bar/ phyogs mchams kyi bum pa brgyad du ma su rla maṇ+ḍal/ ma rta dzaḥ las bum du paṃ pad+ma maṇ+ḍal/ ma srurla maṇ+ḍal/ zhes gdan rnamasabaskyed/ dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du hūṃ las rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa lte ba la hūṃ gis mtshan pa/ nang dang phyi'i phyogs mtshams kyi gdan la ge rtsa lpu baṃ paṃ r+ghaṃ sgro rtsa dang las bum gyi nang du hā rnams las 'od 'phros/ don gnyis byas/ tshur 4'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ hūṃ dpal chen yang dag badz+ra he ru gaḥnas/ sems dpa' gsum brtsegs kyi bar dang lha mo brgyad bskyed pa sogs las byang bzhin la so so'i sngags rnams dor/ las dbang gzhung las bdud rtsir byin gyis brlabs pa'i chu 'thor zhing rta mchag gi sngags kyisabasrung zhes khungs dang 'brel/ bum nang du hā las bdag chen sngags 'chang pas/ sa phur nas 'khyil ba g.yang pe mdzad 'dug —376

sangs rgyas thams cad mnyam par sbyor ba dpal yang dag zla gam dgu pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga hūṃ mdzad zhal lung / nang ma (ka)kyang 'di ga'i sgos lha rta 4go rol pa yod pas dog la'i mi mdzad pa lu rta mchog ljang zhes pa nas/ sna tsho gos rdo rje thod pa thogs pas 'khril zhes pa'i mjug tu/ ye shes me dpung 'bar ba'i klong na bzhugs/ /snyan gsan dbab pa nas bzung phyag 'tshal ba'i bar dang a lha me tog ces sogs zhi sgrub ltar la sngags badz+ra satwa'i tshab shrī he ru kur bsgyur/ bstod pa thog mtha'i glo ka gnyis kyis bstod/ gzungs thag nas bzung ste gtso bo'i sngags brgya stong sogs ji ltar rigs pa dag de las rim gyis phri ba'i 'khor gyi sngags dang las thams cad badzi ha sogs dang rgyas bzla zhing mthar ru lu dang hūṃ brjod pas rnam rgyal (26ba)gyi lha thams cad 'od du zhu/ byang chub kyi sems kyi chus yongs su gang bar bsam lasabum la dmigs te/ ji srid dkyil 'khor gyi bya ba rnams mthar ma phyin gyi bar bgegs bzlog pa'i 'phrin las mdzad du gsol/ ces tshon las gzhol/ dkyil 'khor gyi khor yug tu ras yug gi steng du me tog dkar po gcal du bkram pa'i steng du gtso bum shar dang gzhan rnams rang rang gi phyogs su bzhag /las bum byang shar du dgod do/ /bcu pa slob 'di nas slong ma stogon mo rdzogs kyi bar khungs smos pa dang la gros sbyor ma gtogs dbang g.yi bsto no/ /ma sta gon la spro ba skyed/ sdom gzung / byin brlab/ so shing / dri chu/ ku sha /srung skud/ chos bshad/gtor ma/ mchod bstod/ rmi lam ste bcu gcig las/ dang po spro ba bskyed pa ni/ bgegs gtore bsngo nyid thun gyis brab/ sa dzorā dza'i spos kyis bdug /slob ma rnams khrus byas/ phyag btsal/ rtsa bar/srog lus man chad rdzas kyi rnam/ /bla ma mnyes par bya phyir dbul/ /zhes pa'i so mchan du/ dgongasa'adus kyi lung drangs par/ skyo dub med pa'i dad pa dang / gyong sems med pa'i mnyen lcug dang / /ser sna med pa'i zang zing dang / /som nyi med pa'i sri zhu dang / /g.yo rgyu med pa'i drang brtan dang / kha gsag med pa'i rang rgyud dang / /rmongs pa med pa'i shes rab dang / /dri ma med pa'i lhag semasabargyad/ /dam pa de la rdzogs par dbul/ /zhes pa ltar/ sngon du maṇ+ḍal 'bul dgos pas dri bzang gi chu dang me tog bkye bsdu sogs phyag len ltar byas rjes/ oṃ badz+ra bhū mi āḥ&/ gzhi dbang chen dag —377

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()pa gser gyi sa gzhi/oṃ badz+ra re khe āX//phyi lcags ri khor yug mu khyud kyis bskor ba'i dbus su hūṃ ༷ ri'i rgyal po ri 27na dzeb/shar lus 'phags po/lho 'dzam bu gling /nub ba lang spyod/byang sgra mi snyan/nyi ma/zla ba/dbus su lha dang mi'i dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs pa ma tshang ba med pa 'di nyid/bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo tha mi dad pa'i spyos drung du/slob ma sta gon gyi chos zab mo zhu ba'i yon du dbul bar bgyi'o//thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol/bzhes nas byin gyis brlab tu gsol//zhesamaṇ+ḍal phul/me tog dang bcas pa'i thal mo sbyar nas mdun du 'dug la/bu khyod tshul ldan snod yin pas//theg chen gsang ba'i gzhung bzhin nyen//gsang sngags spyod tshul cho ga ni/khyod la yang dag bshad par bya//rdzogs sangs rgyas tshogos 'das rnams dang //de bzhin gang dag ma byon dang //de ltar byung ba rdzogs sangs rgyas//'gro la phan phyir gnas bzhugs la//de kun gsang sngags zab mo yi//cho ga zab mo 'di rtogs nas//skyes mchog rang gi gnas nyid du//thams cad mkhyen pa tshad med brnyes//gsang sngags sbyor ba mnyam med pa//bcom ldan che ge'i dkyil 'khor gyis//bdud tsho gos shin tu mi bzad pa'i//dpung chen mtha' dag rnam bcom pas//de phyir kun mkhyen ye shesaphyir//bu khyod blo gros 'di gyis shig zhes brjod la don bshad/gnyis pa sdom pa gzung ba 7skyabasasu 'gro zhing dam bca' ba/sdig bshags/yi rang /sems bskyed/sdom gzung dngos dang lnga las/dang po skyabs su 'gro zhing dam bca' ba ni/slob mas sbyor dang dngos gzhi yi//dang po yan lag rnams bkod de//zhes pa ltar/dbang po dul zhing 27bsko zhan du ma yengs pas pus mo btsugs/thal mo sbyar/mgo bo 'dud de/sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun la//rtag tu skyabs su 'gro bar bgyi//rnal 'byor mkha' 'gro gsang sngags can//rigs kyi dkyil 'khor so sgo yi//'khor lo bzhugs pa'i bdag nyid rnams//kun la skyabs su 'gro bar bgyi//dpa' bo pho mo 'khor bcas dang //byang chub sems dpa' bdag wo che/khyad par du yang sloX ཿdpon la/khyod kyis skyabs su 'gro bar bgyi//

sangs rgyas thams cad mkho par sbyor ba dpal yang dag zla gam dgu pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga hūṃ mdzad zhal lung / nang ma (ka)ma lus phyogs na bzhugs pa yi//dkyil 'khor bdag la dgongs su gsol//bdag ni dus 'di nas bzung ste//ji srid byang chub snying po'i bar//de yi tshangs spyod gnyis med par//bdag gi sdom pa ma lus gzung //zhes lan gsum gyis sdom pa gzung bar khas blangs/gnyis pa sdig pa bshagasapa ni/dkon cog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo//dkon cog gsum po gzung bar bya//bdag gis sdig pa bgyis pa dang //bgyid stsal rjes su yi rang ba//mgon po'i spyan sngar ma mis nas su//de dag thams cad bshags par bgyi//zhes pa'i rjes zlos byed du gzhug/gsum pa rjes su yi rang ba ni/rgyal ba sras bcas tsho gos rnams dang //rang rgyal dgra bcom 'gro rnams kyis//bsgom bzlas la sogs bsod nams la//dad pas rab tu yi rang ngo //zhes brjod du gzhug go/bzhi pa sems bskyed pa ni/dge ba'i tshogs mang spel ba'i phyir//byang chub gnyis med don bskyed nas//'gro rnams de ring don du gnyer//sangs rgyas gyur nas bdag gis ni//'gro rnams srid pa'i gnas las 'don//zhes khas len du gzhug/lnga pa sdom pa gzung ba ni/sems ninyid mdzo par sangs rgyas dang //chos kyi 'khor lo skor byed cing //mas spyo byang tso sems dpa' la//bdag gis gus pas skyabs su mchi//sangs rgyas rnam 'byung ji lta bar//skal ldan byang chub sems dpa' yis//thub mchog byang chub rgya chen bo//'gro ba rgya chen don la dmigs//mgon rnamasabadag la dgongs su gsol//ma lus phyogs bzhugs dkyil 'khor rnams//dus 'di nyid nas sangasargyas la//bla med rgya chen dang bar gzigs//ji ltar dus gsum bde gshegs rnams//byang chub mchoge tu nges mdzad nas/ /byang chub sems ni bla med pa/ /dam pa bdag gis bskyed par bgyi/ /sangs rgyas rnal 'byor sdom pa la//tshul khrims kyi ni bslab pa dang //dge ba'i chos ni sdud pa dang //sems can don byed tshul khrims gsum//bdag gis brtan por gzung bar bgyi//sangs rgyas chosadang dge 'dun te//bla na med pa'i dkon cog gsum//deng nas brtsams te bzung nas ni//nam du yang ni mi spang ngo //rdo rje rags ma rdzo wo po yi/// rje dril bu phyag rgya yang //yang dag nyid du gzung

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (25)bar bgyi/ /slob dpon dag kyang gzung bar bgyi/ /rin cen rigs mchog wo bo yi/ /dam tshig yid du 'ong ba la/ /nyin re bzhin ni dus drug tu/ /sbyin pa rnam bzhi rtag tu sbyin/ /byang chub chen po lasabyung ba'i/ /pad+ma'i rigs chen dag pa la/ /phyi dang gsang ba theg pa gsum/ /dam pa'i chos ni gzung bar bya/ /las kyi rigs mchog chen po yi/ /sdom pa thams cad ldan par ni/ /yang dag nyid du gzung bar bya/ /mchod pa'i las kyang ci nus bgyi/ /byang chub mchog (24) sems bskyed cing / /bdag gis sdome pa ma lus gzung / /ma grol ba rnams grol bar bya/ /ma bsgral ba rnams bdag gis bsgral/ /dbugs ma phyin pa dbugs dbyung zhing / /thams cad mya ngan 'das la 'god/ /dge ba'i las rnams 'di dag gis/ /'jig rten sangs rgyas myur 'grub nas/ /'khor ba'i rgya mtshor bying ba rnams/ /bla med byang chub gnas par bgyi/ /zhes rig pa 'dzin pa'i sdom pa len du gzhug /gsum pa byin gyis brlab pa ni/ gnas gsum mtshan ma yi ger bcas/ /rdo rje sngags bcas dri yis byugs/ /zhes pa'i don bzhin/ slob ma rnams/ sum+bha sa bsangs/ su bhā was stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las pad+ma zla nyi lha chen yab yum gyi steng du hūṃ las slob ma rnams badz+ra he ru gaḥnag dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi bgrad pa/ g.yas gsum rdo rje kha ṭ+wāṃ ju'u chung / g.yon gsum dril bu dung dmar rgyu zhags 'dzin pa/ yum kro lha shwa rī ma dang mnyam par sbyor ba'i sku can du bzhugs pa'i gnas gsum du oṃ āḥ/ dkar dmar mthing gsum gsal gdab/ slob dpon rdor dril 'dzin pa'i lag pa g.yas kyis slob ma'i gnas gsum du dri chus reg cing 'bru gsum brjod pa'i rkyen gyis slob ma'i dpral bar oṃ las 'khor lo dkar po zhes pa nas/ g.yon brkyang gis bzhugs pa'i bar las byang bzhin/de ltar gyur pa mchod pa'i yul du bzang bas dbu la me tog shangs la bdug spos/ spyan lam du mar me/ thugs kar dri'i byug pa rnams so so'i sngags kyis dbul/ bdag po sngags 'chang pas ma khri gi skabs lus dang yan lag la bkod pa'i lha thor bu 'god sa nor ba zhig (29na 'dir blangs 'dug pa/ sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlab par rkang lag la lha 'god pa gsar rnying phal cher la ma —38()

sangs rgyas thams cad mnyam par sbyor ba dpal yang dag zla gam dgu pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga hūṃ mdzad zhal lung / nang ma (ka)grags pa'i gser gar blug las grub pa'i dngul sku mthong ba don ldan yin pa 'dug cing / gnas gsum mchan ma yi ger bcas/ /zhes pa las bdag po kun rin pa'i mkhyen rab de 'dra hūṃ kā ra'i thugs la ma shar bar snang / bzhi pa so shing sbyin pa ni/ u dus ra la sogs shing / /drang po gas med 'bu rjes bral/ /sor tshad bcu gnyis dri yis byugs/ /rtse mor me tog bcas pa la/ /zhes pa ltar slob dpon gyis rig sngags mang du bzlas te mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i so shing dor ba'i gzhi yang / sa gzhi ba yi ko ba'i tshad/ /rnam lnga maṇ+ḍal byas pa sa/ zhes gshin rje'i phyogs su maṇ+ḍal la ba byung lnga ko ba'i srab 'thug tsam byugs nas/ pad+ma 'dab brgyad bris par slob ma bzhag pa la sbyin/ shar phyogasakha bltas mi smra bar/ /bca' zhing lce yi skyon bsal nas/ /zhes pa'i don ltar kha shar du bstan la rtsa ba ma 'chos par dor du bcug pas mtshan ltas kyang / rtse mo bdag la bstan pa dang / /rtse mo gyen la phyogs gyur na/ /mchog gi dngos grub mtshan ma yin/ /mtshams dang byang du kha bltas na/ 'jig rten pa yi las 'grub 'gyur/ /rtse mo thur du bstan pas ni/ /sa 'og dngos grub nges par 'grub/ /phyogasabazhi rtse mo bye brag gis/ /las bzhi'i mtshan ma shes pa ra bya/ /zhes pa'i don bshad/ lnga pa dri chu blud pa ni/ dri chab byin brlabs sngags ldan pa'i/ /'thor 'thung khyor chus kha bshal bya/ /zhes pa ltar slob ma'i phyi nang gi dri ma thams cad dag par byed pa'i chu/ (29bkro thu hrīḥbi shu d+dha sarba dharmāḥpā paṃ ni tsa su/ saṃ sho khyu ya sarba pi ga lhan a pa na ya hūṃ/ zhes blud pas dri ma rnams dag par bsam/ drug pa kusha sbyin pa ni/ ku sha sngas dang stan du sbyin zhes pa ltar ku sha rtsa ba dang rtse mo ma nyams pa che chung gnyis/oṃ āḥ/ gis byin gyis brlabs la slob ma rnams kyis rmi lam mi 'khrugs par bya ba'i phyir chung ba sngas dang che ba stan du sbyin/ bdun pa srung skud ni/ srung skud mdud pa gsum ldan pa/ /ku sha gsum 'gyur sbom phra'i tshad/ /dpung par bsrung ba'i don du sbyin/ /zhes pa ltar skud pa kha dog sna lnga pa bsgril ba lus tshad dang mnyam pa la rdo rje'i mdud pa lnga dbang gas du mdud pa gsug byung yang sngags rtogs sla'i dgongasapadang mas/ byas par hūṃ oṃ swā a hā lnga bkod/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas rigs—381—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ smyonalnga spyan drangs yig 'bru la bstim/de zhu ba skud par thim pas rigs lnga'i ngo bor bsams lasabon lnga bzlas pas byin gyis brlab/hūṃ a/oṃ a gyi a tre a hā aḥs sarba tu rnye ku ru ku ru swāhā dang oṃ āḥ/ bzlas pas byin gyis brlabs la skyes pa'i g.yas dang bud med kyi g.yon du 'ching zhing ra bzlas pas bgegs rnams bsrung bar bsam/brgyad pa chos bshad pa ni/kun mkhyen 'jig rten khams yang ba//u dus ra'i me rtag bshin//brgya lam na ni res 'ga' zhig/'byung 'gyur yang ni mi 'byung ngo //gsang sngags spyod tshul zab mo 'di//de bas kyang ni rnyed par dka'//gang gisasems can dpag med don//mya ga mi 'da' byed nus pa'i//bskal pa bye ba grangs med du//gang gis sdig pa byas pa gang //dkyil 'khor 'di 'dra mthong bas ni//de 30na rkog thams cad zad par 'gyur//sngags spyod tshul la gnas pa yi//mnyam par gyur pa gzhan gang yod//tshe 'di nyid la sngags bzlas pas//bla med gnas su 'gro 'gyur te//sdug bsngal kun 'byung nyam thag pa'i//ngan 'gro'i sdug bsngal spong bar 'gyur//des na spyod mchog tshul 'di la//blo gros shin tu brtan pas na//de ring khyod ni rnyed pa mchog/bdag nyid wo po thob par 'gyur//gang gis rgyal ba thams cad ni//sras bcas rnams kyi bstan pa 'di//blo mchog ldan pas yongs gzung ste//gnas shing bdag nyid wo po la//theg wo gsang ba'i gnas dag tu//de ring 'gro bar 'gyur ba yin//lam mchog 'di ni dpal dang ldan//theg wo snang ba cher 'byung bas/khyod ni 'gro bar gyur pas ni//de bzhi gshegasapa 'byung bar 'gyur//zhes pa'i don bshad do//dgu pa ga sto ma ga sto ba ni/lta gon gnas ma ga 'di wo du//ma rdzo tshol ga kho ma bto byas la/ /zhes pa'i don bzhin rtogs sla las/ phyogs skyong bcu'i gtso bo la dkar gtor/ 'khor rnams la dmar gtor 'bul bar 'dod la/tshul ni thog mar phyi rol gyi byang shar du song nas/dri'i maṇ+ḍal gyi steng du tshom bu bkod mchod pa dang gtor ma bshams te/mchod gtor gong ltar byin gyisabarlabs la//thugs ka'i hūṃ gi 'od kyis spyan drangaX par bsams shing /byang shar 'byung po'i bad ga

sangs rgyas tham cad mnyam par sbyor ba dpal yang dag zla gam dgu pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga hūṃ mdzad zhal lung / nang ma zhanapo 'khor dang bcas//gtor ma phul ba 'di dag bzhes su gsol//rab tu dges pa'i yid kyisabazhes nas kyang //rang gi phyogs su legs par bzhugs nas su//rang gi bu smad mdza' bshes30bskowo 'dun dang //nad mi dmag dang dpung cas lhan cig tu//phreng ba me 'a dri dang byug par bcas//bstod dang gtor ma mar me gus 'bul na//'di dag bzhes shing legs par sgoms nas kyang //bdag gi las kyi gos bu mchis par mdzod//oṃ sī sha nā ya sa pa ri wā ra sa mā dzaḥs spyan drangs/pad+ma ka ma la ya sto gyis gdan phul nas arnya la sogs pas mchod pa'i rjes su langs te lag pa pad+ma'i thal mo sbyar bas gtore ma gzung la sa pa ri wā ra'i rjes su/na maḥsarba nas ba kla te gtso bar lan gsum gyis gtor ma phul la/dbang dang ldan pa 'dren pa'i lha//'byung po'i rgyal po gdon gyi bdag/byang shar gdon gyi rdzos cas la//ma rdzo cing bstod de phyag kyang la'i//mar sbyin gtor ma 'di snoms la//rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor sa sa kyi//bar ho thams cad zhi ba dang //dngos grub ma lus stsal du gsol//zhes pas phul/sa pa ri wā ra'i rjes su la btags la gshegs su gsol//de bzhi du shar phyogs su song la/gas sngar dang 'dra ba las/spyan 'dren la/shar phyogasadabang po'i lha tsho gos 'khor dang bams//zhes dang /sī sha na'i gnas su/in+d+ra ya bcug pa dang bstod pa'i skabs su/dbang po rdo rje 'chang ba'i lha//lha yi rgyal po/zhes dang /shar phyogs zhes kha spos la/shar lhor/shar lho drang srong lha tshogs/in+t+ra'i gnas su asna ye bcug pa dang bstod pa'i skabs su//me ste bsreg bya za ba'i lha//drang srong rgyal po zhes dang /shar lho zhes 'don pa spo/lhor/lho phyogs gshin rje'i lha tsho gos 'khor dang bcas//asna me'i gnas su ya mā ya bcug pa dang 31na〉stod pa'i skabs su/gshin rje be con 'chang ba'i lha//ma mo'i rgyal po/lho phyogs/lho nub tu/lto nub srin po'i lha tshogs/zhes dang /ya ma'i gnas su ni ri ta ye bcug pa dang bstod pa'i skabs su/bden dang bral ba legs ldan lha//sren po'i rgyal po// nub srin po'i/nub tu/nub phyogs chu bdag lha

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (25)tshogs/ zhes dang / ba ru ṇa ya/ zhags pa thogs pa chu yi lha/ /klu yi rgyal po/ nub phyogs/ rlung du/nub byang rlung bdag lha tshogs/ bā ya be+e/ rlung ste srog kyang 'dzin pa'i lha/ /rig 'dzin rgyal po/ nub byang / byang du/ byang phyogs nor bdag lha tshogs/ ku'i rā ya/ gnod sbyin lag na dbyug to thogs/ /nor skyong rgyal po/ byang phyogs/ yang shar du/ steng phyogs tshangs pa'i lha tshogs/ ā: brahā ṇi/ gu rla gra ha a dhi pa ta ye/ tsan+d+ra/ na k+ṣa tra a lha pa ta ye/ steng gi tshangs pa chen po dang / /nyi ma zla ba gza' chen po/ /gza' dang rgyu skar bcas pa la/ /de nas nub tu/ 'og phyogs sa bdag lha tshogs/ arnyo bṛ thi pi saḥ.a su re saḥ nā ge ༷ ཿ 'og gi klu de sa yi lha/ /sa 'dzan lag pa chen po dang / /dam tshig shes pa'i tsho gos bcas la/ /zhes sogs 'don pa bsgyur la bya/ bsdu na gtor ma gcig la cha gsum gyi phyogasaskyong gi gtor ma ltar bto yang rung ngo / /bcu pa mchod bstod bya ba ni/ slob dpon nang du mnyam gzhag pas/ /dkyil 'khor mchod cing bstod par bya/ /zhes pa ltar/ nang du song la dkyil 'khor la lan gsum bskor/ phyi nang gi mchod pas mchod cing bstod do/ /bcu gcig pa rmi lam brtag pa ni/ ku sha'i sngas stan legs pa la/ /mi smra dge de'i (31ba)sems bcas kyis/ /seng ge'i nyal stabs legs byas te/ /rmi ltas mtshan ma brtag par bya/ /zhesapa'i don ltar rtogs sla las slob ma rnams ku sha'i gdan la mi smra bar seng ge'i nyal stabs kyis bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo tha mi dad la mos pa rtse gcig par nyol la rmi lam gang mthong ba nangs par nga la spros shig ces bsgos la rmi lam brtag tu gzhug go /de las/ rang gi sems la dbang thob dang / /sna tsho gos sprul pa lta bu dang / /'gro gang dbang du 'dus pa dang / /rdzu rol dasagis 'gro ba dang / /sal mi thogs chur mi 'bying / /nam mkha' dag la bya bzhin 'phur/ /semasacan mang po bsgral ba dang / /g.yul ngo dag las rab rgyal ba/ /zhes sogs ltas bzang na mchog thun gyi dngos grub 'grub cing ngan pa'i ltas byung na sbyin sreg sogs bya bas/ de mthar mtshan ma bzang —384

sangs rgyas thams cad mnyam par sbyor ba dpal yang dag zla gam dgu pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga hūṃ mdzad zhal lung / nang ma (ka)mthong nas/ /yi rang dngos grub rab 'bring bstan/ /ngan pa'i ltas dag sbyin sreg bya/ /gtor ma sngags dang phyag rgyas bzlog /ces byung ba ltar gyi lung stond to/ /mjug chog rgyas bsdus ci rigs pa byasate rdo rje gtsug tor gyi phyag rgya dang oṃ badz+ra rtogs slar dkyil 'khor sgrubaskabs stagon gyi lha bsre ba'i gsal kham zung zhes gdam ngar mdzad kyang khro bo puṇ+ḍa rī ga'i le'u gsum pa dang bda' brgyad sogs mang por bskos gdab ces bsre bar bshad pas4tsho pa phyi ma ltar bya so/ 56lta zhes sta gon gyi lha nam mkhar byon par bsam/ srid pa gsum na mgran zla dang bral ba lta bu'i chos kyi rdzas rtogs slar so shing dor ba'i sngags sogs rdo rje las rim du mi gsal ba rnams thugs bcad ma nus pa bdag po sngags 'chang pas gsar ma yongs grags the tshom med (32na)par bsnan pa chos la dbang za ba'i rnam thar du dogs shing gsung bshad du rgyun bshad nub gsung ba thugs bden shas che yang cho ga'i lag len dang dbang bskur nub gsung ba bde 'dus dang gsang rdzogs kyis thog drangs pa'i sgrub chen stod smad kun tu dar ba chos kyi rgyal po 'phags pa'i dus kyi gañdzi ra bod yul du che bar grags pa de shod du 'bebs pa/ mgon po'i gzungs bzhugs kyi mu tig 'don pa thams cad mkhyen pa bu ston dang dpal ldan bla ma dam pa zhal brgyas kyis bzhengs pa'i rdor dbyings blos bslang 'jig pa sogs thugs brel 'gang ches bas ma gsan pa 'dra la rgyud sde'i dbye ba'i skabs/ a nu yo ga la tan+t+ra sdebaco brgyad gsung ba rnying ma bka' gter gang la'ang ma grags/ rtsa ba'i rgyud lnga 'dren skabs zla gsang thig le sku dang sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor gsung du mdzad pa go log cing yon tan la yang dpal mchog gi tshab bdud rtsi mchog gis mdzad 'dug pa gtso che chung ma dgongs pa 'dra ste gsang sngags rnying ma la yo ga rnam pa gsum du grags pa'i gsum pa mahā yo ga la rtsa bar gyur pa sgyu 'phrul/ bshad pa dang cha mthun pa tan+t+ra sdebaco brgyad/ bye brag pa sgrub pa bka' brgyad ces gsum du ngos 'dzin cing tan+t+ra chen po sde bco brgyad la rtsa ba sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las kyi rgyud lngar/ sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor/ zla gsang thig le/ gsang ba 'dus pa/ dpal mchog dang po/ ga me mā le ste lngar rim gyis ngos 'dzin pas thub bstan yongs su rdzogs pa'i tshad thub —385

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (25)kyi bshes gnyen chen po 'gos lo ye bzang rtse pas deb sngon du/ tan+t+ra sdo chen po bco brgyad ces(32ba)bshad pa'i thog ma gsum ni/ dpal gsang ba 'dus pa/ zla gsang thig le/ sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor rnams la thugs gsung sku'i rgyud ces byas nas/ zhes gsungs pas kyang rtogs par nus shing sgrub pa'i lag len ston pa'i rgyud lnga'i skabs su yon tan gyi rgyud bdud rtsi rol pa'am bdud rtsi mchog tu grags par ngos 'dzin cing spyod pa'i yan lag gi rgyud lnga'i sku la glang po che rab 'bogs kyis mtshon pa rnams rim bzhin bshad/ rje sgrol ma ba'i gsung rgyun gyi khog 'bub tu rnam snang sgyu dra/ thabs kyi zhags pa/ dam tshig sam ya 'bum sde bkod pa ste spyi rgyud gsum du bshad cing snga ma gnyis ma tshang ba kha skong ba'i rgyud du'ang ngos 'dzin pas kong yul du ma phyin pa'i kong bshad kyi dpes sa lo 'jam dpal rdo rje yan gyi zhabs la thag pa cung zad btags kyang gdung brgyud du song gshis bu brgya skyes pa'i rabs chad la thabs ci yod/ de las rgya nag ri bo rtse lngar mgon po 'jam dpal dbyangs bzhugs pa la bston zlos mi mdzad par gsol ba 'debs so/ /rtsa ba'i sa bcad gnyis pa dngos gzhi la sgrub pa dang dbang bskur ba gnyis las/ dang po dkyil 'khor bsgrub pa la 'dri ba/ byin brlab/ ting 'dzin dang gsum gyi/ dang po dkyil 'khor 'dri ba la tshon bkye/ mtshan ma dgod pa/ rdzas dgod/ bsre bsnan/ chas 'bul/ mnga' gsol ba ste drug las/ dang po so mchan las/ dmigs pa gsal ba'i phyir na/ tshon bkye/ zhes byung / tshon bkye ba ni/khrag 'thung gal po las/ 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po'i rdzas/ /sku sha rā ga gser dang ni/ /pad+ma rā ga mgod ta/ /in+d+ra ni la tshon du sbyar/ /mi yi dbang po nas sam 'bras/ /(33ba)bra'o ram bu nasadamar dang / /ljang bu sran ma la sogs pa/ /'bring ngam zhi ba'i tshon du bshad/ /dur khrod thal chen sdong ros dang / /de yi so phag du bo dang / /sol bas bri ba khro ba yi/ /dkyil 'khor dag la rab tu shis/ /rdo thal sa ser ba bla sdong / /rgya skyegs dmar po bya ba dang / /rams las byas dang 'bru bsregs pa/ /tha ma'i rdul tshon dag tu bshad/ khes dang / dbang gzhung du rin po che sna lnga'i tshon rtse gang yang rung ba dag —386

sangs rgyas tham cad mnyam par sbyor ba dpal yang dag zla gam dgu pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga hūṃ mdzad zhal lung / nang ma zhanasnod lnga'i nang du blug ste zhes byung ba ltar tshon rtsi mngon par 'du byas la byin brlab ni/ 'jug pa bde ba'i dbang du byas te sngar thig dang lhan cig tu zin cing so sor sprod na tshon brlab pa 'dir bya/ bum pa dang mchod rdzas rnams gzhan du bsal/ slob dpon gyis lag pa g.yon bas byang shar nasabartsams te g.yas bskor gyi mdzub gang gi bar du rtsig pa drangs te/ de nyid las/ 'di ni chos dbyingasarnam dag par/ /sems can rnams ni rab sgrol byed/ /dpal ldan rgyal po che ge mo'i/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gnas/ /yang dag bden pa'i byin rlabs kyis/ /dkyil 'khor las rnams shis par mdzod/ /ces brjod cing rtsig pa'i go rim ni/ nang nas rim bzhin dkar mthing dmar ser ljang gu bya bar dbang gzhung las byung / rtogs slar nag dkar dmar ser ljang gu dang gzhan dang bstun na nag ljang dmar ser dkar po'am nag dkar ser dmar ljang gu sogs gdam ngar gsungs shing gtso bo'i sku mdog dang bstun nag po byas na 'thad dam snyam/ steng nas thod pas kha bcad rtsig pa sbrel ran pa na thod pa kha phye nas tshone bkra brtag (33ba)pa dbang gzhung las/ de yang thig ni phyi nas gdab cing tshon ni nang nas bkye ste dang po rdo rje rgyal thebs kyis 'bri zhing phyi nas ci dga' shes pas bri ste mtho zhing drang bar bya'o/ /gang zhig re khā dma' ba dang yo ba dang chad pa dang 'byul pa dag gis ni mi 'grub bo/ /zhesabyung zhing rtogs slar dma' na dngos grub med cing yo na bgegs zhugs la/ chad na slob dpon dang slob ma 'chi bas/ ā+oṃ badz+ra ki li gī lā ya sarba sha / hūṃ phaṭa/ ces mtshan ma ngan pa la phur bu gdab par gsungs so/ /tshon bkye tshul ni/ zla gam dgu dmar skya/ lha snam phyogs mdog /pad ra'i phyi rol tu dbang puṇ+ḍa ri na las/ de yi phyi 6 dmar na galas/ /dang rgyun nyi shu rtsabs dgod/ khres thong / phyug gam dam can gyi gnasasnam bu dmar nag /gzhan spyi dang 'dra/ rgyas par spro na/ dkyil 'khor gyi rgyan sogs las byang nasabyung ba ltar dur khrod kyi rdzas dang mthun dbang gci du dur khrod r+sā po brgyad 'bod de zhes pa nas/ṣ+ka skyong la sogs—387—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (25)pa'i gzugs 'bri bar bya'o zhes pa'i bar dur khrod brgyad kyi rnam gsan kyang bshad/ pa 'dri'o/ /rtsa bar/ khams gsum khrag tu dmigs nas kyang / /zhes pa'i so mchan du khrag gis chags pa mtshon pas thugs rje chen po dang / dur khrod kun tu khyab par bsam/ zhes pa la ro mang po yod par dur khrod zer ba bzhin khamasagasum gyi sems can thams cad rtag chad kyi mthar shi bas gti mug gi ro zhes byung ba dur khrod la grangs nges kyis dbye bar mngon/ /gnyis pa mtshan ma dgod pa ni/ phur cha ma 'byor na/ dbus su pad+ma dang zla nyi lha chen yab yum gyi steng du rdo rje dril bu/ zla gam brgyad la nyi ma dang zhing rkyang gi gdan la (34na'ang rang gi phyag mtshan g.yas pa 'dri zhing so sor med pa la ngo thog 'god/ gsum pa rdzas dgod pa la rten rdzas/rgyan mchod tshe rdzas/ dbang dzos dang bzhi'i/ dang po rten rdzas la phur pa/ mar me/ thod sku/ bum pa dang bzhi las/ dang po phur pa dgod pa ni/ dbang g.yi du de'i gnas rnams su steng gi mas ma gang rung gzhag go /zhes byung / rtsa bar snang ba'i 'od dang bcas pa dgram/ zhes par so mchan du thugs mkhyen pa'i ye shes dgu mo 'gag par shar ba'i rtag su mar chadagu dgod 'i gong ma rnam tsheb po cag gsung / sgrub sdebargyad mtha' dag la rgyas par byed na phur cha 'god srol yod pas gong gi mtshan ma dgod pa'i tshab la phur rtsa bar dmigs kyi rten yang mgi par waṃ zhes pa'i so mchan du gser dngul la lugs su blugs pa'i lha'i gzugs ba dang shing 'bur dod dam dar ras la ri mor bri gsungasapa'ang dbyibs rma chas/ pa dgu po sbyangs/ mthu bskyed/ rang sngags kyis lhar gsal/ las byang ltar ye shes pa dgug gzhug dang dbang bskur bya/ de nas khrag 'thung gal po las/ hūṃ/ dbus nas rang byung grub pa'i lha/ /thugs mchogo badz+ra he ru daḥ/ /badz+ra kro sgyi shwa rī gnyis/ /rang bzhin dkyil 'khor chen po nas/ /dur khrod chen po'i snam gnas mchag dang / /dug gsum bsgral ba'i dkyil 'khor 'dir/ /lha chen bsnol ba'i gdan steng du/ /dgyes shing brtan par bzhugs su
