pa'i slob ma la/kye khyod ci la dga' bas 'dir 'jug pa yin/zhes dri/slob mas/bdag skal ba bzang po la dga' bas 'dir 'jug pa'o zhes lan gdab/yang des khyod la ci dgos zhes dri/rdo rje 'dzin pa'i dngos grub 'dod pa'i phyir ro//zhes lan 'debs/gsum pa gsol ga lhogalapho brtag pa drug par yang shad cing rtsa bar dngos grub 'dod pas gsol ba gdag ces byung /ba gdab pa ni/sta gon gyi maṇ+ḍal ltar la dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa zhu ba'i sogs kyis maṇ+ḍal phul la/bde gshegs sras bcasadam tshig pas//yon dbul thugs rjes bdag la dgongs//sangs rgyas sku gsum rang bzhin mchog/slob dpon mgon la bdag 40bskyobs mchi//skal bzang lha mo tsho gos bcas pa'i//dkyil 'khor tsho gos la phyag 'tshal lo/ /thar pa chen po'i grong mchog tu/ /mgon po bdag ni gzhug tu gsol/ /zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba gdab bo//bzhi pa gnang ba zhu ba ni/slob dpon gyis dkyil 'khor la mngon du phyogs te zhwa phud rdor dril bzung nas/rgyal ba kun gyi gnas bzhugs pa'i//dkyil 'khor chen po nyams dga' ba//snying po'i go khrab chen po 'dir//bdag gis slob ma gzhug par bgyi//zhes lan gsum brjod/gnyis pa nang du 'jug pa la phyag bya ba/rnal 'byor du sems bskyed pa/skyabs su 'gro zhing dam bca' ba/sdig bshags/yi rang /semasaX/da/gsang bar gdams pa/ye shes dbab pa/

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()dkyil 'khor bstan pa ste dgu las/dang po phyag bya ba ni/rgyas dang dpa' bo 'bru lnga brjod cing slob dpon gyi lag gi rdo rje la 'jus te yol ba bsal nas dkyil 'khor gyi nang du zhugs par bsams shing shar sgo nas/rtogs sla las/dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi//sku gsung thugs kyi bdag nyid mchog/bde gshegs rgyal ba 'khor bcas la//lusang ga yid kyis phyag 'tshal lo//zhes phyag lan gsum byed du gzhug go/gnyis pa rnal 'byor du sems bskyed pa ni/slob ma'i snying gar smon 'jug byang tso kyi sems zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du chos thams cad spros pa dang bral ba rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i rnam par gsal bar bsam du bcug la/dbang gzhung las/oṃ sarba yo ga tsit+ta u pa ta ya mi hūṃ zhes brjod du gzhug/skyabs 'gro/sdig bshags/yi rang /sems bskyed bzhi sta gon gyi skabasaltar 41na ) bya/drug pa gsang bar gdams pa ni/de wo las/me tog dang bcas rdo rje snying gar bzhag la/oṃ bde gshegs kun gyis khyod nyid de//de ring byin gyis brlabs pas na//de bzhin gshegs pa'i gsang chen 'di//dkyil 'khor dag tu ma zhugs shing //dad pa med pa'i mi rnams la//nam yang smra bar bya ba min//oṃ su ra te sam ya rto haXmi'i sa d+dha badz+ra ya thā su byu/zhes zhan byung du semasabaskyed brtan par bya/bdun pa ye shes dbab pa la dam bzhag/sdom bzung gsol gdab/ye shesadabab pa dngos dang bzhi'i/dang po dam la bzhag pa la phan yon/nyes dmigs/gnyi ga /bka' gto pa dang bzhi las/dang po dkyil 'khor du zhugs pa'i phan yon gyi sgo nas dam la bzhag pa ni/rtogs sla las mgo bor rdo rje bzhag la/rigs kyi bu mchog tshur sto cig/deng khyod bde gshegasa'akhor yos//nang du'ang khyod kyis zhugs pa yin//slob dpon lung bstan ngas kyang ni//bcom ldan khrag 'thung he ru ga'i//ye shes khyod la bskyed par bya//rnal 'byor bu mchog khyod kyi kyang //de bzhin gshegs pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi//dngos grub dam pa thob par 'gyur//dngos grub gzhan lta smos ci dgos/rna kyi dkyil 'khor ma mthong ba'i//mdun du skyabar ma byed cig/gal te smra bar gyur na ni//dam tshig nyams te dmyal bar 'gro//zhesaX/da/gnyis pa ye shes dbab pa ma bsams pa

sangs rgyas thams cad mnyam par sbyor ba dpal yang dag zlog ma dgu pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga hūṃ mdzad zhal lung / nang ma (ka)nyes dmigs kyi sgo nas dam la bzhag pa ni/rdo rje snying khar bzhag la/sa bcad phyi ma gsum dang 41brdzi shes dbab pa'i gsol 'debs dbang gzhung las/oṃ/rdo rje sems dpa' khyod nyid kyi//snying la yang dag zhugs mdzad de//gal te tshul 'di smras na ni//de ma thag tu bral te gshegs//chasam ya ut+ta ga thā/zhes brjod/gsum pa dam tshig bsrungs ba dang ma bsrungs pa'i phan yon nyesadamigs gnyi ga'i sgo nas dam la bzhag pa ni/thod pa'i stod du bdud rtsi lnga sbyar ba'i chu sbyin la/'di ni khyod kyi dmyal ba'i chu//dam tshig 'das na sreg par byed//dam tshig bsrungs na dngos grub ni//rdo rje bdud rtsi'i chu 'dis hrūb//yo.āḥ& sarba pañtsa a skṛ ta hūṃ/badz+ra yu da nga/zhes brjod/bzhi pa slob dpon bka' gnyan pa'i sgos nas dam la bzhag pa ni/mgo bor rdo rje bzhag la/de ring phyin chad khyod nyid kyi//rdo rje sems dpa' nga yin pas//gang zhig bsgo ba'i las rnams byos//nga la brnyasapar ma byed cig/gal te cung zhig brnyas byas na//dus min 'chi zhing dmyal bar lhung //zhes brjod/gnyis pa sdom pa bzung ba la dam bsgrags pa dang dngos gnyis las/dang po dam bsgrags pa ni/rtogs sla las/sangs rgyas chos dang dgo'adun te//dkon cog gsum la skyabs su song //'di ni sangs rgyas rigs dag pa'i//dam tshig yid du 'ong ba'o//rdo rje dril bu phyag rgya yang //blo chen khyod kyis gzung bar gyis//byang chub sems ni rdo rje ste/shes rab dril bu zhes kyang grags//slob dpon khyod kyis gzung bar gyis//bla ma sa rgyas kun dang mnyam//'di la brnyas par ma byed cig/'di ni rdo rje'i rigs dag pa'i//rdo rje dam tshig 42na than par grags//nyin re bzhin ni dus drug tu//chos dang zang zing mi 'jigs byams//sbyin pa rnam bzhi rtag tu sbyin//rin cen rigs kyi dam tshig go/phyi dang gsang ba theg pa gsum//dam pa'i chos kyang ma lus gzung //'di ni pad+ma'i rigasadag pa'i//dam tshig yid du 'ong ba'o//las kyi rigs mchogo chen po la//sdom pa thams cad ldan par ni//yang dag nyid du gzung bar gyis//mchod pa'i las kyang ci nus gyis//zhes brjod/gnyis pa sdom pa gzung ba dngos ni/sta gon bzhin bya/9/bang gzhung du tshogs gsog zur pa zhig dkyus

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (25)'dir byung yang sta gon gyi skabs las dgos don lhag po mi 'dug pas ma bris/ gsum pa ye shesadabab pa'i gsol 'debs ni/ maṇ+ḍal ri rab gling bzhi nyi zla zung gcig lha mi'i dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs pa ma tshang ba med pa 'di nyid bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo tha mi dad pa'i drung du ye shes dbab pa zhu ba'i yon du dbul bar bgyi'o/ /thugs rjes sogs kyis maṇ+ḍal phul te/ rgyal ba kun gyi ye shes thugs/ /sku dang gsung 'phrul las mdzad pa/ /phyag rgya'i cho ga gang dag gis/ /de ring bdag la dbab tu gsol/ /zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba gdab/ las sngags kyis bsangs/ slob ma rnams sta gon gyi gnas gsum byin rlabs kyi skabs ltar gtso bo yab yum du bskyed pa'i spyi bor waṃ las chu'i dkyil 'khor dkar po zlum po bum pas mtshan pa la ha/ snying gar lo las sa'i dkyil 'khor gru bzhi ser po zur bzhin rdo rje rtse gsum pas mtshan (42ba)pa la hūṃ/ lte bar raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor gru gsum dmar po rno zhing 'bar ba la āX/ rkang 'og tu yaṃ las rlud gi dkyil 'khor sngon po gzhu'i dbyibs can g.yo ba'i ba dan gyis mtshan pa la dzhai / drag cing bzod dka' ba'i gzugs can rlung gis bskyod pa rkang mthil nas zhugs/ lte ba'i me dang 'dres nas 'bar bas snying ga'i sa bsregs/ spyi bo'i chu khol ba lasabadud rtsi'i tsho gos babs pas tshim par gyur cing rkang 'og gi rlung gis 'degs bzhin par bsam/rang gi thugs rka'i hūṃ gi 'od las gnod sbyin ma lcags kyu thogs pa dpag tu med pa spros/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas yang dag sbyor ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs dpag tu med pa spyan drangs pa rnams dang dkyil 'khor gyi lha tsho gos rnams las kyang / de 'dra ba tshad med pa 'phros pas slob ma'i snying gar pad nyi'i steng du hūṃ la thim par bsams pa'i 'od kyis nang gang bas sdig sgrib thams cad sbyangs/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs dang phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thamasacad kyi sku gsung thugs kyi ye shes zhugs par bsam/ rol mo dbyangs dang bcas pas las byang gi byin 'bebs gyer/ — brjod cing bgegs bskrad/ oṃ dzñā na a be sha ya/ sa ya/ — ya/ ra ra 400

sangs rgyas thams cad mnyam par sbyor ba dpal yang dag zla gam dgu pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga hūṃ mdzad zhal lung / nang ma (ka)ra ra/ tsa la ya tsa la ya/ hūṃ āḥnya sna zhes brgya rtsa bzlas/ sa dzorā dza dang bdud rtsi lnga la sogs pa'i spos kyis bdug cing rol chen zad mthar 'bebs/ dbang gzhung las/ nam zhig ye shes babasapa'i tshe ni sku gsung thugs kyi rtags ston par 'gyur ro zhes pa ltar/ sku phebasgo na 'phar g.yo/ gsung (43ba)phebs na smra rgod/ thugs phebs na mi rtog pa'i ting nge 'dzin skye ba la sogs pa lus ngag yid gsum gyi nyams la dpags te ngo sprad do/ /yang phur gyi gzhung gnyis na mi gsal yang rnying ma spyi lugs ltar tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra zhes spyi bor rdo rje rgya gram gyis rgyas gdab bo/ /ye shes dbab pa'i dmigs pa dbang gzhung gi dgongs don ltar la/ sum mdor 'byung ba 'god pa mi gsal zhing mgrin par snang ba dmigs pa ma bde bas gsang sngags spyi gzhud ltar bkod la/ bdag po sngags 'chang pa'i der spyi bor rlung gi dkyil 'khor 'dug pa 'di dang mnyam spyor rigs bsdus sogs yi ge gzhan du'ang ma byung bas 'di'i phyogs su mi gtogs pa'i dpe 'dra gzigs pa dang chang gis thugs bad pa thug pa ni min las che'o/ /dgu pa dkyil 'khor bstan pa la sngon 'gro dang dngos gzhi gnyis kyi/ dang po sngon 'gro la bden brjod/ gnang ba 'dri ba/ me tog dor ba/ me tog 'phreng ba/ mig dbye ba dang lnga las/ dang po bden pa brjod pa ni/ slob dpon 'grengs la zhwa phud rdor dril bzung dkyil 'khor la 'dud pa dang bcas te/ dbang gzhung las/ mgon mchog gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor 'dir/ /slob ma mchog 'di gzhug par bgyi/ /rigs kyi lha yi bye brag dang / /bsod nams gang yin de bzhin shog /de bzhin dngos grub mtshan ma dag /snying po'i gnas 'dir legs par ston/ /zhes brjod/ gnyis pa snang ba 'dri ba ni/ khyed kyi mig la ji ltar snang / /zhes dris pas/ dkar ser dmar nag tu mthong na 'phrin las bzhi dang ljang gu'am khra bo snang na las sna tshogs hrūb ces lung ston no/ /gsum pa me khrag 'thung gal po'i brtag pa bdun par bshad cing brtag pa bas bzhi par dur khrod rdzas kyi me rta go dor ba 40/—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung tsom/ (2)yang gas/tog dor ba ni/sngar byin pa'i me tog gi 'phreng ba thal mo sbyar ba'i bar du bzung nas rang gi rigs kyi lha la phul bar mos shig ces bsgo la/zla 'di nas dkyil tshang bltas bal shā sa 44tsho sbyor ma gas dbang gas /gam dgu zla gam tsog pa zhes pa 'don dzo ༷ nga yin/pa'i dkyil 'khor du//rig pa'i me tog 'di dor bas//sngon tshe ye shes mkhyen pa'i lha//gang yin de la 'bab par shog/oṃ bra titsā badz+ra sngo/zhes zlo zhing dkyil 'khor la me tog dor du gzhug/de nas gang la phog pa'i lha ni 'di'o zhesaslob dpon gyis ngos gzung ste lung bstan tshul/lha gang la babs pa de yi dam du blang bar bya'o//de yang gtso bo la phog na ni/mchog gi dngos grub 'grub cing bar mtshams dag gis ni 'bring po'i lasahrūb na/ra ba las 'das pa dag ni slar bskyar te lan gsum dor zhing gang zhig dkyil 'khor la ma babs pa dag ni chus shis par byas te slar gtang bar bya'o//zhes byung ngo /bzhi pa me rtag tso nga gal po'i gag po bon par ga sto/'phreng ba'i dbang ni/me tog gi phreng ba de wo slob dpon gyis gtso bo'i dbu nas blangs te/me tog rin 'a phreng ba 'di//gang la babs la rigs kyi lha/khrag 'thung yab yum khyod kyi lha//rtag tu mi 'bral bsgom par bya//kye rdo rje sems dpa' r+ṣa po'i 'phreng ba 'di dang ma bral bar gyis shig/oṃ rat+na mā le a bhi ṇiñtsa tho/zhes mgo la 'ching ngo //lnga pa mig dbye ba ni/khrag 'thung 44na〉la tsho cag pa bdun par bshad/yi ge oṃ las skyes pa'i gser gyi thur mas mtshan ma'i dri ma bsal zhes dbang gzhung las byung yang 'jug pa bde ba rdo rjes mig dbye ba'i stang ka dang bcas/oṃ rdo rje sem dpa' khyod nyid kyis//mig 'byed par ni brtson par mdzad//sgrib g.yogs ling tog kun bsal nas//rdo rje'i mig ni bla na med//chabadz+ra tsa ku dzñā na bra be sha phaṭa/ces brjod la gdong g.yogs bkrol/khyod kyi mi shes pa'i rab rib dag pas ye shes kyi mig thob ste thar pa chen po'i dkyil 'khor mngon sum du mthong bar bsam/zhes bsgo'o//gnyis pa dkyil 'khor bstan pa dngos/0/bu khyod dkyil 'khor legs par ltos//thar pa

sangs rgyas thams cad mnyam par sbyor ba dpal yang dag zla gam dgu pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga hūṃ mdzad zhal lung / nang ma tanachen po'i grong khyer du/ /me tog gang la babs pa ni/ /de nyid khyod kyi rigs kyi lha/ /zhes lta bar bskul nas/ rtogs sla las/ dkyil 'khor ltar bcug ste khyod kyis mthong zhing zhugs pa'i dkyil 'khor 'di ni/ 'di lta bu mthong bar yid la gyis shig /ces bskos la/ srung 'khor nas gdan gyi bar du gzhal yas khang dang gtso bo nas dur khrod kyi bar du lha rnams ji ltar bris shing rang gis bsgoms pa dang mthun par gsal bar bshad do/ /dbang gzhud las/ slob mas/ bdag gig yi du bza' gas la sogs pas lha dang slob dpon mnyes par mdzad/ skal ces pa dkyil 'dor mthong shā dga' ston yin na'ang ding 4 bod du dar sos / ba ji ltar lags pa bstan du gsol/ zhes pa'i lan du/ bu khyod dad pas rab gus bskyed/ /dkyil 'khor bzang po legs par ltos/ /sangs rgyas thams cad mnyam sbyor ba'i/ /yang (44brkog grub pa gcig pu nyid/ /mkha' 'gro sgyu ma'i rigs mchog 'dzin/ /'gro ba phun sum tsho gos kun dang / /dngos rnams thams cad mngon du gyur/ /dam tshig ting 'dzin rjes chags dang / /gsang sngags snying po 'dzin par gyis/ /zhes brjod/rtogs sla las/ de ltar 'jug pa rnam pa gnyis kyi sgo nas khyod kyi dkyil 'khor du zhugs pas rgyud la lam lnga las tshogs lam gyi rtogs pa skye ba'i mthu dang ldan par byas pa yin no/ /zhes brjod/ gnyis pa dbang bskur ba dngos la/ bum dbang / gsang dbang / sher dbang /tshig dbang dang bzhi las/ dang po bum pa'i dbang la sngon 'gro/ dngos gzhi/ dbang don bshad pa dang gsum las/ dang po sngon du 'gro ba ni/ maṇ+ḍal ye shes dbab pa ltar la bum pa'i dbang bskur zhes kha bsgyur/ gsol gdab ni/ dbang gzhung las/ rgyal ba kun gyi gsang ba'i lam/ /'gro ba skyob pa'i gzi brjid can/ /mkha' 'gro ma yi 'khor lo mchog /yon to thams cad 'byung ba'i gnas/ /de ring dbang bskur gnang ba yi/ /dus la bab par mkhyen pa legs/ /dpa' bo chen pos mi ldog pa'i/ /dbang bskur rim pa bdag la stsol/ /rig pa chen po'i las bsgrubs nas/ /dngos po mchog rnamasashis pa dang / /sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir/ /bdag gi rdo rje slob dpon gzung / /zhes lan gsum 403

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()gyis gsol ba gdab/de nyid las/de nas shar phyogs kyi sgo drung du khru do tsam gyis cho de par dbang stegs dkyil 'khor gyi lte ba dang 45nasgo nyam pa brtsigs te pad+ma 'dab brgyad sgo dang bcas pa bris shing seng dang r+sās su ga dang sgo khri rtogs slar mig mu/ge'i khri la pad+mas mtshan pa'i gdan bshams par slob ma bzhag ste/rtogs sla las/steng du gdugs dkar po/g.yas g.yon du rgyal mtshan dang ba dan bsgreng /mdun du mchod pa sna tsho gis pas gang bar bsam/las sngags kyis bsangs/su bhā was sbyangs/stong pa'i ngang las dbang stegs kyi steng du slob ma hūṃ las dpal dbas khung du sa kyi lha dang rtogasaslar mem phog pa'i lha lko༄nga /yang dag zhal gsum phyag drug pa yum kro dhī shwa rī ma dang mnyam par sbyor ba'i gnas gsum oṃ āḥ& gi yi ges mtshago par bsam/badz+ra sa mā dza chis spyan drangs/dzaḥlha baṃ lhos gnyis su med par thim par bsam/rang gi thugs ka'i hūṃ las khro bo dpag tu med pa spros bar du gcod pa'i bgegs rnams bskrad par bsam/'bru brgyad dang hūṃ bzhi'i sngags brjod de yungs kar gyis brab dbang g.yi du yung kar gyi sbyin sreg bya zhes3da/bo//gnyis pa 'di nasang chi dang gi bar tsos smoyo4)sgos chos dang/gsal byed kyi 445sbyor sa da mgams de phyin khrug pa bde ched du rtogs par sla ba sor sgo'i bkod do//dbang dngos la slob ma dang slob dpon gnyis las/dang po thun mong ba slob ma'i dbang la rigs lnga/mna' bsgag cing sdom pa sbyin pa/bdag po'i dbang dang gsum las/dang po rigs lnga'i dbang ni/'dir dkyil chog tu slob ma lhar bskyed pa'i gsal kha ma byung bsam bskyed kyang chog par gsal zhing gzhan 45bskos bskyed pa mang du snang bas bskyed kyang mi 'gal lam snyam zhes rtogs slar gsungs pa 'dir yang rigs 'gre bas/de yang thog mar bum pa g.yin gyi chu rnams rnam rgyal du bsdus la/las sngags kyi bsangs/su bhā was sbyangs/slob ma dang dbang rdzas bum pa mi dmigs te stong pa nyid du bsam/stong pa'i ngang las pad nyi'i steng du hūṃ las rdo rje hūṃ gis mas pa las mi bskyod pa rdor dril 'dzin par bskyed/de'i stol bar oṃ/mgrin par aḥthugs kar hūṃ/thugs ka hūṃ las 'od 4// 'phros pas rang 'dra'i ye shes sems dpa' sa

sang rgyas thams cad mnyam par sbyor bdapal yang dag zla gam dgu pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga hūṃ mdzad zhal lung / nang ma (ka)mā dzaḥs spyan drangs/ dzaḥ& baṃ lhos gnyis su med par thim par bsam/ a ha ra sogs kyis mchode/mi bskyod pa ni ye shes che/ /rdo rje'i thugs ni bla na med/ /skye med spros bral ngo bo nyid/ /mi bskyod pa la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /ces pas bstod de dbang rdzas kyi lha 'od du zhu bas chur gyur par bsam/ de nas bdag gi thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od sa pas dbang bskur gyi lha dpag tu med pa spyan drangs/ de rnams dang dkyil 'khor gyi lha la dbang bskur bar slob mas gsol ba btab pas/ gtso bos gtso mdzad pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis/ mi bskyod pa'i rang bzhin chu'i dbang bskur bar bsams shing / bum pa slob ma'i mgo bor bzhag la/ dbang gzhung las/ til gyi gang bu bzhin gang ba'i tso 'thung gal po'i brtag pa bas par sangs rgyas rnams ni thams cad kyi zhes dang bgragasum par chos dbyings yum gyi bum pa na zhesagos sna brgyal bas bum pa bzung nas ni/ /'di nyid la ni (46na ji bang bskur bas/ /bag chags ma lus dag gyur cig /slobadz+ra a bhi khiñtsa hūṃ/ zhes brjod cing bum chu gtor/ spyan drangs pa'i ye shes kyi dbang lha yab yum gnyis su med par rol pa mdzad pa'i byang chub sems kyi chu rgyun gyis bum pa yongs su bkang bas dbang bskur bar mos te/ dbang gzhung las/ oṃ/ lha yi chu ni rnam dag pas/ /rdo rje gsang gsum gnas las byung / /rig pa'i lha mo tshogs ldan pa'i/ /rang bzhin gcig tu gyur pa yin/ /oṃ badz+ra a bhi khiñtsa mi/ zhes brjod pas dbang bskur ba'i chu rgyun gyis slob ma'i lus thamasacad gang / sdig sgrib dag /chu lhag ma yar lud pa las mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan par bsams la/pu 〉 nas sha rdi'i bar gyis mchode nas/ de ltar me long lta bu'i ye shes kyi rang bzhin bcom ldan 'dasame bskyod he ru ga'i byang chub sems kyi ngo bo chu'i dbang thob par mos pa gyis shig /ces bsgo/ de nas bris pa dang brkos pa la sogs pa'i dbu rgyan swā las byung ba'i rin po che swā sa mtshan pa las/rin 'byung rin po che dang dril bu 'dzin pa bskyed/ gzhan snga ma dang 'dra ba las bstod pa'i skabs su/lta ba ga pa 'joms mdzad pa'i/ /rin cen rgyal po yon tan gtso/ /mnyam nyid ye shes ngo bo nyid/ /rin cen 'byung la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /ces dang / dbang rdzas kyi lha 'od du zhu bas rin po che'i dbu 405

gsum las/dang po slob dpon gyis lung bstan pa ni/slob dpon gyis snam sbyar gyon lag pa g.yon pas chos gos gyi grwa seng ge'i rna ba ltar byas la bzung zhing g.yas mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya slob ma'i mgo bor bzhag la/'di ltar nga yis khyod lung ༷stan//rdo rje dpal ldan gsang ba'i bdag/dngos

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()po mchog tu bsgrub pa'i phyir//srid pa'i ngan 'gro gnas las grol//kye che ge mo chasarba ta thā ga ta sirnyi badz+ra sa ma ya rto sme bhu wa su/zhes brjod/gnyis pa sangs rgyas rnams kyis lung stan pa ni/dus gsum gyi rgyal ba rnams kyis phyogs bcu nas gsung dbyangs mthun pa'i sgra skad kyis lung ston par mdzad de/kye rigs kyi bu khyod kyi srid pa mtha' ma ni 'di yin te gsang ba bla na med pa'i theg pa la zhugs pas phyag rgya chen po dang sngags kyi mthus rigs kyi dkyil 'khor du gnas par 'gyur ro//zhes gsungs par bsam mo//gsum pa slar yang slob dpon gyis gsang bar gdams te lung ston pa ni/52bsgo rgyad kyis chags pa dang mi 'bral bar bya ste de dag ni las la sbyar bar bya'o//'dod chags bral ba lta bu'i sdigakhams gsum na ni gzhan med de//de bas 'dod la chags bral bar/khyod kyis nam yang byab min//ma hā sam ya hūṃ phaṭa/de ring dkyil 'khor slob dpon dang //sngags sogs rgyud rnams 'dzin par 'gyur//sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang //lha rnams kun gyis mthun par gsung //semasacan kun la rjes brtse ba//dkyil 'khor cho ga bzhin du bris//rtsegacig nan to bskyed nas ni//sgrub pa po rnams rgyud la sbyor//zhes brjod/dgu pa dbugs dbyung la phan yon dang gzengs bstod pa gnyis las/dang po dkyil 'khor mthong ba'i phan yon brjod pa ni/mchog tu gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor 'dir//zhugs shing mthong ba sogs pa yis//sdig pa kun las rnam grol zhing /khyed rnams rab tu dge bar gnas/khams gsum pa ni rgyal srid che//rgyal ba'i bdag por dbang bskur zhing //bdud rnams kun las rnam par rgyal//pho brang mchog tu zhugs pa yin//dbang bskur rjes thogs dbugasaphyung bas/ /slob ma yon tan bdag por 'gyur/ /slob dpon blo gros dam tshig ldan/ /brtan g.yo mtha' yas rnam par grol//lam mchog 'jug stobs dbugs phyung ste//ngal ba'i gnas ga kun spangs so//zhes brjod/gnyis pa de don spyad pas phan yon gyi gzengs bstod pa ni/bde chen theg pa 'di la ni//phyi nas 'chi ba 53na yod mod ciX /4/mtshudas med thub par mi 'gyur te/khos kyang

sang rgyas thams cad mnyam par sbyor ba dpal yang dag zla gam dgu pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga hūṃ mdzad zhal lung / nang ma zhanami 'jigs dga' bar gyis/ /srid pa shin tu dag pas na/ khrad pa'i sdug bsngal las 'das so/ /'di yi khyed rnams dus 'di sa /sangs rgyas thob par the tshom med/ /ces brjod/ bcu pa de dag gi dam tshig bshad pa ni/ rdo rje bla ma mi spang zhing / /byang chub smos ni yongs mi spong / /rdo rje zhes bya phyag rgya che/ /gang zhig bskyed pa tsam gyis ni/ /sangs rgyas nyid du the tshom med/ /dam pa'i chos dag mi smad cing / /ma gus spang zhing dor mi bya/ /mi shes snod min rmongs pa la/ /nam yang bstan par mi bya'o/ /rdo rje dril bu mi spang ste/ /slob dpon dag la gus par gyis/ /zhes brjod/bcu gcig pa rnam dag la dkyil 'khor dang lha'i de kho na nyid gnyis las/ dang po dkyil 'khor gyi de kho na nyid ni/ zhugs pa'i dkyil 'khor 'di rnams bsgoms pas rab tu ci zhig mngon du gyur ce na/ dbang gzhung gi de ha cang mangs pas don la khyad med phyin/ he ru ka thugs kyi gal po las/ gzhal yas khang chen ye shes te/ /'khor 'das mnyam pa gru bzhi pa/ /sgo bzhi dran pa nyer gzhag bzhi/ /rnam thar brgyad dang rta babs so/ /rin chen sgo ste thugs rje'i ngang / /yang dag spong bzhi to ra ṇa/ /dran pa nyer gzhag sgo 'byud dang / /rdzu phrul rkang bzhi sgo khyams dang / /'phreng ba byang chub yan lag bdun/ /'phags lam brgyad kyi kha bas mdzes/ /lam gyi ye shes rnga yab dang / /nyon mongs(53na)tsho gos 'joms mu tig 'phreng / /dril bu ba dan rlung bskyod pa/ khres rab chos kyi sgra sgrogasadang / /che ba'i yon tan khrus pa'i rtags/ /bdud bzhi 'joms pa'i rgyal mtshan dang / /thod 'phreng sku gsum thob pa'i rtags/ /gzhal yas khang mchog dam pa'o/ /zhes brjod/ gnyis pa lha'i de kho na nyid ni/ /de lta na'ang nang gi lha rnams ni spang bya dang lam gyi chos gang rnam par dag pa'i 'bras bu yin snyam na he ru ka thugs kyi gal po las/ bcu ldan ye shes dpal la dga' gnyis ldan zag med yum gyi sku/ /kun rma du/rnam shas bas dag mkha' 'gro brgyad/ces byung ba 'di dkrol ba yin no/ /gzhi rnam dag go rī ma/ /yid shes rnam dag tso rī ma/ /nyon yid rnam dag pra mo hā/ /lus shes rnam dag be+et+ta lī/ /mig shes rnam dag puska sī/ /rna ba'i rnam shes ghasma rī/ /sna shes rnam dag sma sha ni/ /lce shes rnam dag tsaṇ+ḍa413—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (25)lī/ /ye shes brgyad kyi ngo bor rdzogs/ /snod bcud 'di man sa rdzo /lha dang gzhal yas khang / /phung po lnga la so gos pa'i chos/ /de ni spang bar bya ba min/ /theg pa gsum ni spang ba min/ //ti li bzhin yongasasu gzung / /zhes pa ltar shes par gyis shig /ces ngo sprad do/ /rtogs sla las de lta na khyod dkyil 'khor bri bsgrub dbang bskur 'phrin las thams cad bsgrub pa la sogs pa slob dpon gyi bya ba thams cad la dbang bas slob dpon gyi dbang thob bo/ /zhes bsgo'o/ /gsum pa dbang don bshad pa ni/ de ltar rdul rdzo gyi dkyil 'khor du bum pa'i dbang bskur ba thob pas bskyed pa'i rim pa bsgom (54na)pa la dbang zhing lam lnga las sbyor lam gyi rtogs pa skye ba'i mthu dang ldan par byas la/ des lus kyi dri ma dag ste/ sprul sku 'grub dbang gci du yon tso las shad pa ni dmu gyis mas mi bar ba'i das du byas par yon/ pa'i rten 'brel 'grig go /zhes brjod do//gnyis pa gsang dbang bskur ba la dbang gzhung las/ da ni nye ba'i bsnyen pa'i gnas su sngon du dbang rdzogs par ma byas pa dang gang zhig rdzogs pa dag gis bstan par 'dod na/ dben pa'i gnas su dris legs par byugs pa'i maṇ+ḍal la me tog sna tshogs bkram zhing bde ba'i stan brtsegs pa la bla ma bzhugs nas shes rab rtsa bar g.yon phyogs gnas nas tshul 4sto du zhe par sgoms du yum khrus bya sbos chu la gos phe dzing da tsod/ zhi khrog pa byed kyi ༅ 'dogs zhes3da/ma mtshan dang ldan pa dag phul te/ mchod pa dang smon lam la sogs pa'i longs spyod kyis dgyes par byas nas/ ras kyi yol ba la sogs pasabar chod pa'i rgyab nas gsol ba gdab par bya'o/ /zhes byung ba ltar gsol gdab dang dbang bskur ba gnyis las/ dang po gsol ba gdab pa ni/ maṇ+ḍal gong bzhin la gsang ba'i dbang bskur zhu ba'i zhes 'don ba bsgyur/ de nyid las/ dpal lngan las ga la yi ga pa bas par ༅༅ldan ni bar po kye/zhes ga byung /ldan mgon po bde ba che/ /bdeb chen po'i gnas la bzhugs/ /sangs rgyas thams cad mnyam sbyor ba/ /mkha' 'gro sgyu ma'i bde mchog mdzad/ /byang chub sems dpa' tshe rnams kyi/ /yang dag don mchog rnam (54ba)dag pa/ /ji ltar de sgo/16

sang rgyas tham cad mnyam par sbyor ba dpal yang dag zla gam dgu pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga hūṃ mdzad zhal lung / nang ma zhananyid bdud rtsi yi/ /mchog gi dbang ni bskur ba bzhin/ /de bzhin bdag sogs 'gro kun gyi/ /sdug bsngal rnams ni sel bar mdzod/ /rnal 'byor bdud rtsi dri med mchog /ma rig rtog pa'i rab rib sel/ /gang gi byang chub bla na med/ /de ring bdag gis thob par mdzod/ /ces lan gsum gyis gsol ba gdab/ slob dpon gyis de nyid las/ bu khyod ji ltar 'dod pa bzhin/ /rgyal ba kun gyi bde wo sbyin/ /ting 'dzin sbyor sngags gsal ba ni/ /rang gi gnas su legs par bstod/ zhes khas blang ngo / /gnyis pa dbang bskur ba la sngon 'gro dngos gzhi/ nga rgyal dbang don dang bzhi las/ dang po sngon du 'gro ba ni/ rtogs sla las/ slob ma'i shes rab ma lang tsho dar la bab cing rgyan gyis brgyan pa bla ma la phul bar mos la/ khyod zhabs pa khro'i bka' drin gyis/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi byang chub sems/ /don chen zab mos nyon mongs 'joms/ /de ring bdag la dbab par mdzod/ /ces pas gsol ba gdab/ gdong 'ching / 'bru gsum brjod/ bdud rtsi gtor bas bsrung ngo / /gnyis pa dngos gzhi ni/ dbang gzhung las/ dam tshig gi lha mo sbyangs nas sngags dang bcasapa'i yungs kar gyis bgegs bskrad cing sbyor ba dang rjes su sbyor bas yab yum gnyis kyi sku bskyed par bya'o/ /yang dbang bskur ba dang byin gyis brlab pa dag rdzogs par byas nas rol mo'i sgras bskul zhing spro ba bskyed de rigs kyi nga rgyal ma nyams pa'i sgo nas gnyis (55na)su med pa'i sbyor bas byang chub kyi sems slob ma'i lce la gzhag par bya'o/ /rtogs la las/ slob dpon dpal yang dag tu gsal ba'i rtsa bar pad+ma gi 'a sa byas nas zhes byung /gsang gnas/ las rdo rje hūṃ gis mtshan pa nor bur oṃ rtse mor phaṭa dang bcas pa/ phyag rgya kro dhī shwa ri mar gsal ba'i mkha' a las pad+ma as mtshan pa/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga ṇa badz+ra su bhā wa āt+pa ko3nya/ yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i dga' ba'i sgras phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad spyan drangs/ zhal du zhugs/ thugs rjes su chags pa'i mes 'od du zhu/ yum 417

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (25)gyi mkhar babs pa mtheb srin kyis bzung nas slob ma'i lce la bzhag par bsams shing dbang gzhung las/ ji ltar rgyal brtag pa stso par ji ltar rgya thang sras bams kyis zhes sogs byung / ba bde gshegs kyis/ /rang gi sras tshogos dbang bskur zhing / /byang chub sems bde dag pa'i chus/ /rnam rtog dri ma dag par bya/ /oṃ ma hā bo dhi tsit+ta sa ma ya a bhi 'i ṣañtsa hūṃ/ zhes brjod cing blud do/ /gsum pa nga rgyal gzung ba ni/ slob mas kyang / a ho ma so mag du/lce rtse nas: rtsa la bskur bar bya dang byes mkha' nas lce len pa bdang bes srin lag gis ra ba bung ba dang me rta go /sdod du ka ra lta bu dang sbyar na sbyin pa dung dang nya nyis kyi tso du dbang bskur bar gsungs/ hā su kha/ rtogs sla las/ da ni sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam/ /bdag ni bsod nams skal ba che/ /yon tan kun gyis bdag brgyan te/ /yang dag sbyor ba'i bdag nyid do/ /zhes brjod la btang des lus gang bas (55ba jig gi nyes pa dag nas gsung rdo rjer gyur par bsam zhing mig dar 'grol/bzhi pa dbang don bshad pa ni/ de nyid las/ yum gyi bha ga nas gsang ba'i dbang thob pas rang byin gyis brlab pa bsgom pa la dbang zhing lam lnga las mthong ba'i lam sa dang po'i rtogs pa skye ba'i mthu dang ldan par byas la/ ngesang ga gi dri ma dag ste longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku 'grub pa'i yon dbul bar bzhad pa ni phyi ma gnyis mi bskur ba la dgongs/ rten 'brel 'grig go /zhes brjod do/ /gsum pa shes rab ye shes kyi dbang bskur ba la dbang gzhung las/ rdzogs pa'i rim pa thob par 'dod pas rdo rje bla ma mchog tu gyur pa la gsol ba gdab par bya ste/ maṇ+ḍal dang mchod pa'i tshogs kyis rdo rje bla ma dang phyag rgya mtshan ldan mnyes par byas nas zhes byung ba ltar/ gsol gdab/sngon 'gro/ dngos gzhi/ dbang don dang bzhi las/ dang po gsol ba gdab pa ni/ maṇ+ḍal gong ltar la shes rab ye shes kyi dbang zhu ba'i zhes 'don pa bsgyur/ dbang gzhung las/ kye kye mgon gag pa bstopar shi ru dra khyod ces sogs byung /po bde nga che/ /rdo rje sbyor las yang dag byung / /phyag rgya mi phyed rab bsgrub pa/ /418—

sangs rgyas thams cad mnyam par sbyor ba dpal yang dag zla gam dgu pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga hūṃ mdzad zhal lung / nang ma tanamangon sum nyams myong bskyed pa'i phyir/ /bdag nyid chen po ji lta bar/ /gtso bos bdag la bka' drin mdzod/ /rtog pa'i dri mas bsgribs pa rnams/ /byang chub chu yis dag par mdzod/ zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba gdab/ gnyis pa dbang gi sngon 'gro ni/ bla mas mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i phyag rgya kro dhī shwa rī mar bskyed pa/ (56na yas ba ma la gtad par dpon slob gnyis gas bsams shing / de nyid las/ dga' ba'i gnas brtag dzogs ra/ dga' 'i gnas ster lha mo ni/ zhes sogs byung / chen lha mo 'di/ /legs par zungs shig blo gros can/ /dga' bde'i mchod pa rab tu gyis/ /thabs ga' na gyis ni 'tshang mi rgya/ /'gro ba thams cad 'di las byung / /de bas khyod kyis 'di nyid dang / /nam yang 'bral bar mi bya ste/ /'di ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /rig ma'i brtul zhugs bla na med/ /blun po gang zhig 'di spong ba/ /de la mchog gi dngos grub med/ /ces brjod/ de nas rig ma de grogs la dga' ba'i 'dzum gyis bltas te/ de nyid las/ khyod kyis nus sam rdo rje can/ khri chen dri chu'i bza' bco dang / /rak+ta ga bur myang ba dang / /bud med rnams la rtag gus dang / /bha gar 'o byed mi rtog par/ /smros shig grogs po bde ba can/ /zhes dris pa'i lan du/ slob mas/ khu khrag la sogs za ba dang / /bud med rnams la rtag gus shing / /bha ga'i pad+ma ra 'o bgyid do/ /zhes brjod/ de nas rig ma de lus gcer bur phyung me rtag gi 'phreng ba mgo la bcings/ bha ga phyag gis bstan nas/ de nyid las/ med byung gsang ba'i pad+ma 'di/ /thams cad bde bar yang dag ldan/ /rtag tu 'di bzhin 'di spyod na/ /de nyid bde wo mi 'bral 'gyur/ /chos dbyings 'di ni rnam par dag /sems can thams cad rnam par grol/ /bde wo rgyal po 'di nyid ni/ /dngos po kun gyi rang byung gnas/ /nang gi rtsa yi 'bor lo la/ /pad+ma la (56ba tshes gas rab tu rgyas/ /bha ga'i mkha' dngas nam mkha'i dbyings/ /'byung ba bzhi po rgyan bzhi bkod/ /lte ba'i ze'u snyu ge sar zlum/ /pad+ma 'dab ma rnam par mdzes/ /de yid bus su gnas pa ni/ /de nyid bdud rtsi bde chen gzugs/ /bhañdza mok+ṣa lho/ zhes brjod/ rtogs sla las/ de nas rig ma'i lag pa g.yon slob ma'i lag pa g.yas par gtad par sgoms shig /ces bsgo la/ shes rab 419

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (25)dam pa 'di yis ni/ khyod kyi ye shes skyed byed pa/ /'di dang khyod gnyis rtag tu yang / /dad pas rtag tu 'grogs par gyis/ /'di la rtag tu rol mo gyis/ /zhes brjod/ de ni shes rab ye shes kyi dbang bskur ba zhes brjod de/ bsgom lam sa bcu'i rtogs pa skye ba'i mas dang ldan par byas pa yin no/ /zhesabasgo'o/ /gsum pa dngos gzhi ni/ dbang gzhung las/ de nas gnas dben par rgyan bzang po bres shig dri zhim po'i chu gtor/ stan bde ba la gnas te khang pa'am yol ba la sogs pa gang yang rung bsabasgribs la/ thabs dang shes rab kyi sbyor ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang sbyor ba bde ba chen po'i ting nge 'dzin de dag rim pa bzhin du bsgom par bya'o/ /zhes byung ba ltar/ mig dar 'ching zhing bsrung rtogs sla las/ slob ma dpal yang dag sbyor bar gsal ba'i gsang gnas hūṃ las rdo rje hūṃ gis mtshan pa nor bur oṃ/ phyag rgya kro lha shwa rī mar gsal ba'i mkha' a las pad+ma as mtshan pa/ yab kyi rdo rje nor bu'i rtsa bar rtsa gsum 'dus(57na)pa'i rtsa g.yas la oṃ dkar po/ rtsa g.yon la āḥdamar po/ dbus su hūṃ mthing kha/ rtse mor phaṭa yig ser po dmigs/ yab yum la 'byud pa dang tsuspa dang / gsang gnas sbyar bas 'dod chags chen po'i mes drod skyes te dngas ma rnams bzhu/ gsang gnas mnyam par sbyar bas khams dngas ma thams cad spyi bo nas rim bzhin 'khor lo bzhir brgyud de rdo rje'i rtsa bar phyin pas dga' ba/ dbus su phyin pas mchogo dga' rtsa gsum 'doms pa'i dbus su byon pas khyad dga'/ nor bu'i rtse mor byon te steng 'og gi rlung kha sbyar bas mi g.yo bar gyur nas bde stong gi ye shes skyes pa lhan skyes de cher 'phel bas byang sems rgyas te lte snying mgrin spyir phyin te brtan pas/ mas brtan gyi dga' ba bzhi skyes par bsams shing ngos 'dzin du gzhug /dbang gzhung las/ de nas 'dod pa'i gtsug rtsa bar/bde mchog sgyu ma'i brngas mtsho ni te zhes par so mas du ༅ gi ra dang lus kyi 3 la sogs pa zhes byung / lag dang mthun pa'i bde ba'i ye shes bskyed cing shis pa dang mi shis pa'i mtshan ma dag yi ge lnga bcu'i gnas gang la —420

sang rgyas thams cad mnyam par sbyor ba dpal yang dag zla gam dgu pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga hūṃ mdzad zhal lung / nang ma zhanababs pa'i sgo nas brtag ste/ma ning gi yi ge dag la bab pa ni bskyar rtsa bar/dul ba'i sgos sus gnasakyang //zhes pa sgoms du kun du nyon mong pa'i dbang du ma song bar shin tu'ang spyod lam dge slong gsar pa'am bag ma gsar pa ltar/zhes byung /bar bya'o//de ltar bde ba chen po'i don byang chub kyi sems babs nas/tshigs su bcad pa 'dis btung 57ba thar bya'o//zhes byung ba ltar/rdo rje snying po mkha' 'dra zhing //rdul bral thar pa zhi ba'i mchog/rang gi rang bzhin de nyid do//zhes brjod/rtogs sla las/gdong g.yogs bgrol/kun rdzob byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor mthong ba yin no//zhes ngo sprad do//bzhi pa dbang don bshad pa ni/de nyid las/de ltar phyag rgya gto de bde stong gi ye shesaskyes pas kun rdzob byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/lam dkyil 'khor 'khor lo sgom pa la dbang /lam lnga las rgyu'i theg pa'i mthar phyin lam kun tu 'od kyi rtogs pa skye ba'i mas dang ldan par byas/des yid kyi dri ma dag ste chos sku 'grub yon das mir shad po ni ༅pomi skur ba'i dang du gto /pa'i rten 'brel 'grig go/zhes brjod do//bzhi pa tshig gi dbang bskur la/dbang gzhung las/dbang bzhi pa dag bla ma dam pa'i gdamasangag las byung ba'i don bzhin du phyag rgya rnam pa gsum gang yang rung ba la brten te rang gis nyams su myong bas me long gi dkyil 'khor bzhin du gnas pa la yun ring du gsal bar brtag go/desazag pa med pa'i ye shes bde ba chen po'i sku skye bar 'gyur ro//zhes byung ba'i don bzhin/gsol gdab/sngon 'gro/dngos gzhi/dbang don dang bzhi las/dang po gsol ba gdab pa ni/maṇ+ḍal gong ltar la tshig dbang rin po che zhu ba'i 58na tshe sa 'don pa bsgyur/rtogs sla las/khyad zhabs pad+mo'i bka' drin brtag pa wu par byung bdang li tsā/gyis//gtso bo dbang bskur rnam gsum thob//de ring rin cen ༷༷pa yang //gtso bos bdag la bka' drin stobs//

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzarnga rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (25)zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba gdab/ sngar bzhin gdong 'ching zhing bsrung / gnyis pa sngon du 'gro ba ni/ dbang gzhud las/ rnal khrag 'thung gal po'i brtag pa bcu par/ zhes pa lusang ga gi yid dang ni zhes so gos rgyasagad snang / 'byor bde ba thams cad kyi/ /dbang bskur bde chen las byung ba/ /rin cen tshogs rnams thams cad kyis/ /rab tu myos par dbang bskur 'gyur/ /'di man rtogs sla las/ ji ltar snang ba thams cad kun/ /skad cig gcig la dmigs med pa/ /brjod pa'i tha snyad kun dang bral/ /rang byung ye shes zhes brjod do/ /zhes pa'i rang byung gi ye shes gsal la mi rtog pa chos thams cad kyi de kho na nyid rtogs pa'i ting nge 'dzin bzhi pa ste de la yun ring du goms pas brtan pa'i nang rtags lus 'gul bskyod/ ngag dbugs 'gyu ba sems la bde sdug gang gis kyang nyon mi mongs shing bde ba chen po'i ye shes las mi 'gyur ba dang / phyi rtags snang ba thams cad sgyu ma ltar shes shing mtshan 'dzin dang bral ba 'byung bas/ de la 'bad de goms par gyis shig /ces brjod/gsum pa dngos gzhi ni/ slob ma lus (58bsgom snang gi chos bdun dang ldan pas sngar gyi bde stong gi ye shes dran du bcug la/ de'i ngang la mnyam par 'jog tu gzhug go /de las mi rtog pa'i ye shes skyes pas na khyod kyis bzhi pa'i ye shes nyams su myong bas don dam byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor mthong ba yin no/ /zhes brjod la/ gdong g.yogs dgrol lo/ /bzhi pa dbang don bshad pa ni/ khyod kyis dbang bzhi pa tshig dbang rin po che thob pas lam rang byung gi ye shes phyag rgya chen po bsgom pa la dbang zhing lam lnga las/ 'bras bu'i theg pa'i mthar phyin lam bcu gsum rdo rje 'dzin pa'i theg pa'i rtogs pa skye ba'i mthu dang ldan par byas la/ des lus ngag yid gsum gyi dri ma bag chags dang bcas pa thams cad dag ste ngo bo nyid kyi sku 'grub pa'i rten 'brel 'grig go /zhes brjod do/ /rtsa ba'i gsum pa rjes kyi cho ga la dam tshig /dngos grub/ sbyin sreg /gter spa/ lhag ma/ sgo dbye/dpang gzu/ bstan skyong / chad mtho/ zor/ bro/ tshe 'gugs/ mchod gtor/ rgyal mtho/ sgo byang /mar me/ gtang rag dang bzod gsol/ dkyil 'khor bsdu ba/ rdul tshon skyel ba/ phur shul bkru ba/422

sangs rgyas thams cad mnyam par sbyor ba dpal yang dag zla gam dgu pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga hūṃ mdzad zhal lung / nang ma (ka)lus bsrung / bzod gsol/ gtang rag /smon lam/ bkra shis te nyer lnga'i dang po dam tshig la khyad par dang spyi gnyis las dang po khyad par gyi dam tshig ni/ dbang gzhung las/ khyod kyis srog chagasagasad par bya/ /ma byin (59na〉 yang blang bar bya/ /'dod pas log par g.yem par bya/ /rdzun gyi tshig kyang smra bar 'gyur/ /rdo rje bla ma byang chub sems/ /srog gi phyir yang mi gtad zhing / /dran pa gsal bas bzung byas nas/ /lhag pa'i lha bzhin rin cen tog /ces brjod do/ /gnyis pa spyi'i dam tshig bsgrag pa ni/ rtogs sla las/ 'ga' zhig tu gsang ba spyi rgyud du 'byung ba'i spyi'i dam tshig nyer brgyad/ khyad par bsrub bya'i dam tshig nyi shu/ gnas bya lhag pa'i dam tshig nyi shu rtsa gnyis bshad/ yang rtsa ba'i dam tshig gsum/ yan lag gi dam tshig bco lnga/ zhes bshad pa la rkang grangs mi snang yang rnam snang la gsum/ mi bskyed pa la bzhi/ rin 'byung la bzhi/ snang mtha' la gsum/ don grub la gcig dang bco lnga/ bslab pa rnam pa gsum la 'dod pa yin nam snyam/ gtso bo ni gsar rnying thams cad du 'byung ba'i rtsa ba dang yan lag gi dam tshig yin pas khyod kyis zab mo'i dkyil 'khor du zhugs dbang bskur ba thob pas rig pa 'dzin pa'i slob dpon du gyur pa'i phyir dam tshig rnams tshul bzhin du bsrung dgos la/ de dag gang zhe na/ gang phyir rdo rje 'dzin pa yis/ /dngosagrub slob dpon rjes 'brangs gsung / /de bas de la brnyas pa ni/ /rtsa ba'i lhung ba dang por bshad/ /bde gshegs bkakhi las 'das pa ni/ /lhung ba gnyis pa yin par bshad/ /rdo rje spun la khros pa ni/ /nyes (59ba)par brjod pa gsum pa yin/ /sems can rnams la byams pa spong / /bzhi pa yin par rgyal bas gsungs/ /chos kyi rtsab byang chub sems/ /de spong ba ni lnga pa yin/ /rang ngam gzhan gyi grub pa'i mtha'/ /chos la smod pa drug pa yin/ /yongs su ma smin sems can la/ /gsang ba sgrog pa bdun pa yin/ /phung po sangs rgyas lnga bdag nyid/ /de la brnyas byed brgyad pa yin/ /rang bzhin dag pa'i chos rnams la/ /som nyi za ba dgu pa yin/ /gdug la rtag tu byams ldan pa/ /byed pa de ni bstobar 'dod/ /ming sogs bral ba'i chos rnams la/ /de rtog pa de bcu gcig pa/ /sems can dad dang ldan 423

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()pa la//sems kun 'byin pa bcu gnyis pa//dam tshig las ni ji bzhin rnyed//mi bsten pa de bcu gsum pa/shes rab rang bzhin bud med la//smod par byed pa brgya bzhi pa//sngags pas de dag spangasan ni//dngos grub myur du 'thob par 'gyur//gas du dam tshig las khos na//nyams pa bdud kyis gzung bar 'gyur//de bas sdug bsngal myong 'gyur te//thur du bltas te dmyal bar 'gro//de bsang rgyal kun bcom ste//bdag nyid ma zhakhrul shes par bya//mnyam par bzhag pa'i bla ma la/sgyu 'byor pa yis mchod par bya//gsum pa skyabs 'gror nas brtsams te//byang chub sems sogs sdom pa ni//gal te bdag 60na 'a phan 'dod na//sngags pas 'bad de gzung bar bya//dam tshig dang ni mi ldan pa'i//rig ma bsten par dga' ba dang //tshogs kyi 'khor lor rtsod pa dang //gsang ba'i chos ni ston pa dang //sems ga dad dang ldan pa la//dam chos gas du ston pa dang //wā thos dag tu rlom byed pa'i//nang du zhag bdun 'das pa dang //sbyor ba nges par ma byas par//skal min gsang ba ston pa dang //gang zhig phyag rgya mi mkhas la//lus kyi phyag rgya ston pa dang //bsnyen sogs dag par ma byas par//dkyil 'khor las la 'jug pa dang //sdom pa gnyis kyi bcas pa la//dgos pa med par 'da' ba rnams/kha na ma tho bcas gyur te//sngags pa de yi dam tshig zad//zad pas 'grub par mi 'gyur zhing //bdud dang sdug bsngal mang du 'phel//nyin dang mas mo dus drug tu//nyin re bzhin yang bzlas par bya/ /gal te nyams gyur rnal 'byor pa/ kha na ma tho sbom por 'gyur/ /zhesagasungs pa rnams so//zhes brjod la dam tshig bsrung ba'i sems kyis/gtso bos ji ltar bka' stsal pa//de dag thams cad bdag gis bgyis//zhes lan gsum gyis khas len du gzhug go/sgrub chen tshad ldan gyi lugs su byed na yon dbul ba 'og tu 'byung yang sa phur dang bstun 'jug bder bya ba zhan byung du maṇ+ḍal gong bzhin la dbang bskur zab mo thob pa'i bka' drin btang rag gi zhes 60ba 'don pa bsgyur/de nyid las/slob mas bla ma'i zhabs/ ༷ga byas la/gser dngul byu ru rin po che//glang

sangs rgya thams cad mnyam par spyor ba dpal yang dag zla gam dgu pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga hūṃ mdzad zhal lung / nang ma zhanachen ma he nor bur bcas//yid la gces pa rnams kyang dbul//zhes pa ltar yon dang lus kyang phul la/deng nas brtsams te bdag bran du/khyod la bdag ni 'bul lags na/khyod kyis slob mar bzung ba dang //bdag gi lus kyang bzhes su gsol//ces brjod/slo dpon gyis kyang //slob ma dam pa dam rdzo che/khyod kyis lor tshogs shin tu bzang //dad mos che bas dngos grub thob//dad mosamed bas mi 'grub bo//zhes bsgo'o//gnyis pa dngos grub len pa ni/rtsa bar/zhag grangs dus ni brtag pa'am//mtshan ma bzang po byung ba na//zhes par so mas du rnal 'byor pa tha ma las dang po pas rab sku mngon du mthong ba'am mngon du gshegs pa/'bring sgra grag pa/tha ma sku gzugs 'gul ba'o//zhes khrung ba'i dus dang bstun/khrag 'thung gal po'i brtag pa bcu drug pa las/khyad par chen po bsgrub pa rgyal ba'i bka'/khyu gnyis rkyen gsum sbyar ba'i bdud rtsi 'di//snang srid snang ba chen por shar ba'i rdzas//rgyal ba zhi khro'i tsho gos la mchod pa 'bul//snang srid rak+ta'i rgya mtsho dbang gi rdzas//ro mchog brgya ldan bdud rtsi wo por gnas//zhes byung ba ltar dngos grub len tshul rgyasapar 'dod na bka' brgyad sogs gzhan du shes par bya'o//gsum 61na ) pa sbyin sreg bya ba dbang gzhung las/'grin las gas brtsams pa las yang na i sreg gi shis po bya bar bshad/ni/gsang ba me dpung thugs kyi rgyud sogs nas rgyas bar gsungs shing mdor bsdu na rtogs par sla ba'i sbyin sreg ṣ+ka kha bsgyur ro//bzhi pa gter sba bya ba ni/puṇ+ḍa ri ga'i le'u bzhi pa dang gsang ba thugs kyi me dpung gi dgu par gyer tshig gsal bar byung zhing lag len bka' gter mang por bshad pas de dag las shesapar bya'o//sa bcad lnga pa nas bcu gnyis pa'i bar las byang ltar bya zhing /khrag 'thung rol pa'i gtor bzlog bya bar spro na rgyud gzhung man ngag gzhan las shes par bya//bcu gsum dbang g.yi las/mgron gyi tshogs rnaXsal gtor ma sbyin zhing dkyil 'khor bsdu zhes༅da/pa mchod

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (25)gtor 'bul ba ni/ phyi rol ba'i dus kyi phyogs skyong la mar gtor 'bul tshul len/ /bcu bzhi pa rgyal mtho 'grol ba ni/ mchod gtor brlabs la/ gtsang zhing gtsang mar sbyar skyesapa'i zhes pa nas bzung rdzu snyul che la stobs po cher zhes pa'i bar sta gon gyi skabs ltar la sgrub pa'i bar chad bsrungs pa yi/ sngar bcol legs pa'i gtang rag tu/ /mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di snomasal zhes pa nas/ dngos grub ma lus stsal du gsol gyi bar brjod/ ma 'byor pa sogs kyis bzod par gsol/ oṃ badz+ra muḥs ye shes pa rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs par bsams shing tsaka li yod na brtan bzhugs bya/ de (61ba tha zhin du rgyal chen gzhan la'ang sbyor/ bco lnga pa sgo byang 'grol ba ni/ mchod gtor brlabs la/ oṃ badz+ra karma ya ma nas bzung / lha srin sdebargyad 'byung po kun zhesapa yan dkyus ltar la/ bdag gi sgrub pa ma thon par/ /bsrungs pa'i 'phrin las mdzad pa la/ /gtang rag mchod pas mnyes par mdzod/ /ces brjod/ nongs pa gsol ba sogs gong bzhin bya/mchod gtor 'bul ba nas/ 'phrin las thog ser bgegs la 'bebs yan gong ltar la/ dngosagrub bar 'ad bsrungs pa yi/ /gtang rag phul bas dgyes bskyed nas/ /slar yang 'phrin las mdzad du gsol/ /ces brjod/ nongs pa gsol ba sogs gong dang 'dra'o/ /bcu drug pa mar me'i smon lam ni/ dbang gzhung du/ de nas dkyil 'khor gyi mtha' la bskor zhing 'di dang phyi mar mi 'bral ba'i smon lam gdab ces pa dang bka' gter gyi gzhung phal cher du mar me'i smon lam mdzad pa mang bas/ slob dpon rnams kyis mar me thogs la dkyil 'khor gyi mtha' bskor te/ khro bo puṇ+ḍa ri kolas/ hūṃ/ dur khrod gsang ba mchog gi dkyil 'khor du/ 'phrul zhal yid bzhin bhan+ta'i rdzas mchog dang / /ma rig mun sel me mar dgu pa dang / /zla gam dgu pa gsang ba'i gnas 'di sa /ngan song 'khor ba rnams kyang bsgral lags la/ /dus gsum rgyal ba rnams kyang mchod lags la/ /dpal chen he ru ka yang bsgrub lags la/ /ma sring rgya mtsho rnams kyang bsgrub lags la/ /dngos grub dbyings mchogo (62na sgoms kyang blangs la gsal/ /mi gnas ye shes —426

sangs rgyas thams cad mnyam par sbyor ba dpal yang dag zla gam dgu pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga hūṃ mdzad zhal lung / nang ma (ka)thugs kyang bsgrub lags kyis/ /dang po gnas dang chos kyi dbyings su gshegs/ /mi gnas ye shesathugs kyi dkyil 'khor du/ /'gyur ba med par lhun gyis grub pa dang / /rab stims rgyal ba'i bka' la dbang thob nas/ /'gro ba yongs kyi dpal du 'gyur bar shog /'di lta bu yi man ngag lung ston pa'i/ /bka' drin che ba'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen dang / /srog gi lu gu rgyud kyis 'brel ba rnams/ /'og min lhun gyis grub pa'i ga rta gnas mchag tu/ /dus gsum 'du 'bral med par 'grogs pa dang / /gsang ba chen po thugs kyi dkyil 'khor du/ /bla med sku gsung thugs su 'grub par shog /ces smon lam gdab/ sa phur lha khra dang phyog mthun par ma byas kyang 'gal ba med dam snyam/ /bcu bdun pa gtang rag dang bzod gsol ni/ las byang gi gtang rag mchod pa dang bstod pa ci rigs bya zhing yig brgya'i mthar ma 'byor ba sogs len/ /bco brgyad pa dkyil 'khor bsdu ba ni/ puṇ+ḍa ri ga'i le'u gsum par/ da ni dkyil 'khor mtha' nas bsdu zhes sogs dang / gsang ba me dpung thugs kyi rgyud nas kyang gsungs pa'i don khyed kyi sems can sogs nas bzung badz+ra muḥ'i bar las byang ltar brjod pas dkyil 'khor gyi ye shes pa gshegs par bsams shing dzaḥ& baṃ lho sa dam tshig pa rang la thim par bsam/ dkyil 'khor la phur cha med na bsdu lugs 'di bzhin dang yod na phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' zhes sogs brjod nas ye shes pa rnams phur pa la brtan bzhugs ma byas na phur pa'i rab gnas kyang 'jig par dogs shing rtogs slar phur cha dang lha mtshan gdam ngar gsungs pa gshegs gsol 'di lha mtshan la dgongs pa 'dra'o/ /sarba sam ya sogs kyis gtor mgron gyi dam can rnams gshegs par bsam/ rang gtso bo'i nga rgyal gyis lha'i mtshan ma dang gdan rnams bsdu/ de nas tshangs thig nas brtsams te lte ba'i bar gyi rdul tshon bsub cing a kā ro bzlas pas dkyil 'khor bsdu'o/ /bcu dgu pa dbang g.yi las/ dngos grub kyi rdzas su la dog gam/chu sto 'dor ba gdamang ra shad/rdul tshon skyel —427

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (25)ba ni/ rtogs sla las/ rdul tshon bum pa la sogs par blug ste mchod rdzas dman ma la sogs pa dang lhan cig tu rgya mtshor 'bab pa'i chu bor dor/ bum pa chus bkang la nang du khyer te dkyil 'khor gyi khang par bzhag go /nyi shu pa phur shul 'khru ba dbang g.yi las/ khro brgyal mgo cing bstod de/phur pa bsdus la cod pan bkyel ṣ+ka sa bya sa gad/ni/ de nyid las/ sngar gyi bum pa'i chu bdud rtsi lnga dang bsres pas dkyil 'khor gyi khang par chag chag gdab/ hūṃ mdzad kyi phyag rgya dang sum+bha sa phur bu thams cad brtan la/ oṃ ru ru spu ru dz+wa la tiṣ+ṭha sirnyi lo tsa ne sarba a the gā dha ni swāhā/ zhes brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas pa'i 'o mas phur bu dang bgegs kyi gzugs brnyan yod na bkru/ bu ga yang bkang la mnyam por bya'o/ /nyer (63na gi cig pa lus bsrung ba ni las byang bzhin byed/ nyer gnyis pa mched lcam nang gi bzod gsol ni byed par spro na bka' brgyad sogs gzhung gzhan nas len/ nyer gsum pa rdo rje slob dpon la gtang rag 'bul zhing bzod par gsol ba ni/ khrag 'thung gal po las/ ston pa rdo rje slob dpon 'di/ /bdag cag rnams kyi pha lags so/ /bdag cag rnams kyi ma lags so/ /bu dang bu mo sring gnyen lags/ /lam stor rnams kyi lam mkhan lags/ /long ba rnams kyi dmigs bu lags/ /chu bo sgrol ba'i gru chen lags/ /rin cen len pa'i rdzings chen lags/ /'dod pa bsgrubs pa'i ded dpon lags/ /ma lus 'gro ba'i lam chen lags/ khun pa sel ba'i sgron me lags/ /gser 'gyur rtsi yi mkhan po lags/ /dug sgyur ma gi ta chen lags/ /sprul pa 'byung ba'i sgyu mkhan lags/ /g.yul ngo bzlog pa'i dpa' bo lags/ /nad gcong 'byin pa'i sman pa lags/ /'dod pa ster ba'i yid bzhin lags/ /lha yi dpag bsam shing chen lags/ /gnod sbyin bum pa bzang po lags/ /nam mkha' lta bur 'byung ba lags/ /rgya mtsho lta bur gnas pa lags/ /ri bo lta bur brtan pa lags/ /nyi zla'i sku dang ldan pa lags/ /'brug sgra chos dang gsung sgra lags/ /'gyur med rdo rje'i thugs can lags/ /yon tan sa gzhi mnga' ba lags/ /'phrin las gar mkhan glog 'dra lags/ /zil gnon 428

sangs rgyas thams cad mnyam par sbyor ba dpal yang dag zla gam dgu pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga hūṃ mdzad zhal lung / nang ma (ka)seng ge 'dra ba lags/ /sgro 'dogs yongs (63ba)su gcod pa lags/ /rang byung ye shes ston pa lags/ /lhan cig skyes pa'i dgongs pa lags/ /cho khri/rnams de nyid ston pa lags/ khams gsum gnas kyi dbang phyug 'dis/ /lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten 'dir/ /rnal 'byor dbang phyug chen po 'di/ /bdag cag rnams kyi ston pa'o/ /zhes ched du brjod nas/ gsang rdzogs las/ /rdo rje slob dpon sku tshe g.yung drung ni/ /'gyur ba med par mchog tu brtan par smon/ /mched lcam dus gsum rtag tu 'grogs pa dang / /pho brang chen po g.yung drung chugs par smon/ /bdud rtsi rnam lnga ro mchog rgyas pa dang / /zhen bral 'dod yon lnga la longs spyod smon/ /zhal zlas bdud rtsi'i ro ldan gser dngul skyogs/ /phyag tu bzhes nas dgyes pa skyong bar smon/ /lha yi na bza' pañtsa li ka 'di/ /sku la bzhes nas 'khor 'dab rgyas par smon/ /zhes brjod/ dbang gzung las/ lha dang slob dpon la ci 'byor pa'i yon gyisamar cing rjes su yi rang dbul bar bya'o/ /zhes dang / tan+t+ra he ru ka las/ rta dang glang po ma he dang / /gser dngul la sogs rin cen g.yu/ /bu dang chung ma nor gyi dbyig /rab tu gces dang yid 'thad dbul/ /zhes dang / rgyal ba'i skul bkres skyems mi mnga' yang / /dga' dang gus pas phul ba'i bsod nams kyis/ /sgrib pa gnyis byang tshogs gnyis rdzogs gyur nas/ /rdor sgos mtshan sogs sa la phyin par 'gyur/ /zhes dang / dgongs(4na〉dus las/ rjes su rig pa yid pa'i yon/ /nor gyi dbyig dang zlas kyi mchog /brtse mchog 'chi med zas mchoge rnams/ /dbul dang gsol bas mnyes par bya/ /zhes pa ltar/ zhal du skyemasadrangs sku la na bza' gsol/ /sgrub pa dag dbang gi yon rgyas par dbul/ /ye shes sku mchog ma brjod nas nongs pa thams cad bla ma la bshags/ /sa bcad 'di mi spro na sngar maṇ+ḍal sogs song zin pa des chog go /nyer bzhi pa bsngo smon dang nyer lnga pa ba po shis dbang g.yi las/sku gar dang ba po shis brjod par gad/ni las byang ltar bya'o/ /ma nub dbang bzhi'i chu bo'i sa bon rnams/ /gro lam skyed rdzogs drod gsher 429

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()gyis smin nas//zung 'jug sku bzhi'i snye ma g.yur za ba//gsang chen bla med theg pa'i dgongs pa yin//mchog gi dngos grub snyigs dus tshe gcig la//ster ba'i yi dam yang dag he ru ga'i/khyud dang rgya gzhung 'phags yul kha spu can//tshad ldan paṇa grub mang zhig gshegs pa'i bshul//bye brag bka' babs lha chen kā ra dang //lam 'dis grub brnyes pad+ma thod 'phreng rtsal//rjes wangs sogazur gnubs 'khon rig sngags 'chang //brtul zhugs spyod pa'i dbang pos ljongs 'di khengs/khyad par 'jam pa'i rdo rje ngur smrig dang //dkar po'i gos kyis gcig las du ma'i gar//sa skya'i bla chen brgyud pa'i thugs gsang gi/dpal ber g.yas 'khyil zab bzhes 'di ko mtshar//'on te gsar ma'i dkyil chog mtshams sbyor gyi/ /bshad 64ba〉los nag 'gros bris la yang dag ces/ /nya phyis srad bur brgyus nas mu thi la'i//'phreng brdzus kha po'i mgul par brgyan min nam//ma smras mi pho'i rdzong du grags pa ltar//sbubs bzang 'gying bag 'gros kyi mthon po'i khrir//kun dga'i mtshan can sngagasa'achang che bzhugs na//sa skya'i bstan zhabs 'dren min mdzes pa tsam//kong yul ma phyin kong bshad mi 'byung bzhin//snga 'gyur sgrub 'phrin smin grol 'chad pa la//bslabs sbyangs goms pa'i zhal 'drisathogs dgos kyis//rna thos dpe shig bsgrubs pas ga la rtogs//mkhas pa'i gral khyur chud pa'i blo dman yang //rdo rje slob dpon mang bsnyen bka' ga sto rgyud//gzhung dang gdams par 'dris pa'i gdengs tsam gyis//bkod 'di zhabrul med lam srol yin nam snyam//dge bsan ma mkha'i mtha' bzhin tshad bzung dang //bral ba'i ma rgan rgyud lnga'i 'gro ba rnams//sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam par sbyor ba yi//dpal chen khrag 'thung go 'phang nyer thob shog/sangs rgyas thams cad dang mnyam par sbyor ba dpal yang dag zla gam dgu pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga hūṃ mdzad zhal lung 'di ni dbus 'gyur gsang r+ṣa rgyud sde bzhi'i chos grwa r+ṣa po gong dkar rdo rje gdan du 'dzugs pa'i sta gon gyi tshe 'dus pa'i tshogs kyis chog sgrigs shig dgos zhes gsung gis bskul ba dang du blangs nas slob dpon wo po hūṃ kā ra'i dbang g.yi nyid gtso bor bzuX /0des mdzad pa'i rtsa ba dang sgo65nasgo pha/khrag

byang gter thugs sgrub 'bring po'i 'phrin las rin cen 'phreng ba/ nang ma rkana'athung gal po sogs yang dag gi rgyud rnams la zhib mor dpyad/ thams cad mkhyen pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa'i phur pa'i dkyil chog rtogs par sla ba dang mthun pa rnams 'jug pa bde ba'i phyir de kho na nyid du sbyar zhing rkang pa skong ba dang tshig sna bsring ba sogs cung zad las phal cher byin rlabs kyi tshan kha che ba'i phyir yig rnying rnams sor bzhag ste/ chos kyi rgyal po pha bong kha pa dpal 'byor lhun grub sogs rdo rje 'chang dang zhal gnyis pa'i yongs 'dzin du ma'i bka' drin las gsang chen rnying ma'i chos la blo mig yangs pa'i za hor gyi sngags btsun ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho 'jigs med go cha thub bstan lang mtsho'i sdes bag yod ces pa chu mo glang gi lo gro bzhin can gyi phyi ma'i phyogs kyi khrag 'thung rnam par rol pa'i tshes la rang byung 'phags pa'i gtsug lag khang du sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni sdom brtson rig pa 'dzin pa 'jam dbyangs grags pas bgyis so/ /sarba maṅga lo// //byang gter thugs sgrub 'bring po'i 'phrin las rin cen 'phreng ba zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /gu ru pad+ma sirnyi hūṃ khyuḥ sto ṭa de she sarba su kha sha me bra la mkhyen brtse nus pa'i 'phrin las mkha' mnyam 'gror/ /chad med 'jug kyang khyad par gangs can 'dir/ /thugs rje'i mthu dpung dusagasum rgyal gzhan gyis/ /sgrun min pad+mā kā ras rtag tu skyongs/ /sis rgya mtshor 'dab stong ke sar ra/ /rdzus skyes mtshan dpe'i gzi 'bar sprul pa'i sku/ /rgya gar paṇa chen tshul gyis 'dzam gling na/ /brtul zhugs che ba'i rig sngags 'chang de rgyal/ /srid gsum dregs pa yongs kyi gshed ma sa /sgrub pa sdebargyad lha yi tshogs rnams kun/ /lus kyi dkyil 'khor la rdzogs drag po rtsal/ /rtsa gsum 'dus pa'i bdag nyid khyod kho na/ /rtsegacig nyams su blangs pas bla ma dang / /yi dam mkha' 'gro chos srung yongasa'agrub pa/ /gsang chen theg mchog man ngag bcud phyung ba/ /pad 'byung dgongs pa'i bzhed phugs gzhan 431—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()du med//de phyir sngon 'gro gnad kyi gzer lnga sogs//lhan 2na ṣ+ṭha bas 'phrin las 'bring por yongs bsdebs pa//rin cen 'phreng ba phyag bzhes 'khrul bral gyi//srad bur brgyus nas skal ldan rgyan du spel//de la 'dir mdzod lnga 'dus pa'i zab gter gyi nang tshan lho gser mdzod ser po nas gter chen chos kyi rgyal po rigs 'dzin rgod kyi ldem phrus spyan drangs pa'i thugs sgrub drag po rtsal gyi 'phrin las tshong po lhan thabs dang sbyar te khrigs chags su bkod pa la/sngon 'gro rin cen gnad kyi gzer lnga ni/na mo/kun bzang thugs la phyag 'tshal lo dang po dad ldan skyes bu rnams 'khor ba'i chosal skyo ba skyes yang dag snying po'i don 'tshol na legs par ngan song sdug bsngal bsam dben pa'i gnas su yo byad bsags bde ba'i stan la 'dug par bya rin cen gnad kyi gzer lnga brtsis dang po skyabs 'gro sems bskyed ni:bdag dang khams gsum sems can kun log pa'i lam las ldog nas kyang : dkon cog gsum la skyabs su 'gro: nyon mongs dbang gyur sdug bsngal 2bsgos thar bar bya phyir sems bskyed do bdag gi spyi bor nam mkha'i khams nyi zla pad+ma'i gdan steng du:bla ma bkrag dang gzi mdangs ldan mdzes pa'i na bza' sku la gsol zhal 'dzum mdangs dang ldan par bsam:shar phyogs mdun gyi nam mkha' la:shākya seng ge la sogs pa'i yi dam lha tshogs thams cad kun kha dog lngar gsal rnam dag bsam lho phyogs bde bar gshegs pa'i gsung :glegs bam yi ge'i rnam pa la dam chos ma lus 'dus par bsam:nub phyogs byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs rigs gsum mgon po byams pa dang :'gro don mdzad pa thams cad bsam:byang phyogasadam chos skyong ba yi chos skyong mkha' 'gro dam can rnams bga' nyan las byed pho nyar bsam:'og tu rigs drug sems can rnams snying rje'i sems kyis kun bsdus nas las la 'gyod pas sems bskyed bsam: :brtag gus pas skyabs 'gro bya:kye ma/ khams gsum 'khor bar 'khyams pa'i sems can kun bla med dkon cog gsum la skyabs su mchi ma rig mun pas bsgribs pa'i lasag sbyangs dag pa ye shes rang gnas bstan du /sol:bdag dang 'gro drug sems can thams cad

byang gter thugs sgrub 'bring po'i 'phrin las rin cen 'phreng ba/ nang ma 6)la byang chub ma thob bar du thugs rjes gzigs yon tan kun 'byung dngos grub mchog gi gnas:bla ma rin po che la skyabs su mchi gang la gang 'dul 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa'i yi dam lha tshogasarnams la snga sangs rgyas gsung las sprul (3na)pa'i yi ger byon: nyon mongs 'joms byed chosalamo thugs rje chen pos 'gro don stobs chen mdzad byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs la mo: gdul bya'i don du drag po'i skur ston pa: chos skyong dam can rnams las yon tan kun 'byung ma nas 'di bar tshar gsum/ bdag gis dus gsum bsags pa'i dge ba yis: 'gro ba ma lus byang chub mchog thob shog rang byung rig pa rang shar chos kyi sku yang dag snying po myur du rtogs par shog bdag ni dus 'di nas bzung tshe rabs su 'gro ba 'dren pa'i ded dpon byed par shog tshar gsum/ dbang po rab 'bring tha ma yis zhag gsum lnga'am bdun gyi bar rim par skyabs 'gro sems bskyed bya:gnyis pa bdag 'dzin bkrol ba ni bsod na mas tshogos gnyis bsag pa'i phyir zas dang longasaspyod ci 'byor pa 'phangs dang snying brtse thams cad kun bde gshegs mchod cing sbyin par btang :dngos 'byor yid kyis rnam sprul pa'i phyi nang gsang ba'i maṇ+ḍal 'bul: zhes gsungs pa ltar/ phyi'i maṇ+ḍal ni/ na mo/ dbang chen gzhal yas dbus kyi lte ba la ri rgyal lhun po brjid cing 'gying bag ldan gser gyi ri bdun rol ba'i mtsho bdun rnams mnyen lcug sra brtan rin cen rtsig par gtams gling bzhi gling phran brgyad kyis phyogs mtshams bskor lha dang mi yi 'dod yon rgyan gyisagang : nyi zla'i 'od kyis 'jig rten mun pa sel: lcags ri mu khyud mtha' nas legs par bskor (3ba)phyi ltar snod kyi 'jig rten snang ba 'di bla med dkon cog gsum la gus pas 'bul bdag gzhan bsod nams ye shes tshogos rdzogs nas yang dag snying po myur du rtogs par shog nang gi maṇ+ḍal ni na mo/ 'jig rten las kyis sa pa'i bar do phu bdag lus shin tu gces par bzung ba yi yul 'khor longs spyod 'dod pa'i ra bar bcas byams pa'i pha ma mdza' ba'i grogs dang ni:bu dang bu mo gces pa'i 'khor gyis bskor: zas nor gos dang longs spyod rgyan dang ldan bkrag 433

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (25)mdangs mdzes pa'i kha dog rang 'od bcas 'dzin pa'i sems kyis gces par bzung ba yi bdag gi 'jig rten 'di yi gces pa kun: gu ru rat+na sprul pa'i sku la 'bul bdag gi nyon mongs 'dzin pa'i yul dag nas dag pa ye shes rang gnas bstan du gsol gsang ba'i maṇ+ḍal ni/ hūṃ/ bdag lus yang bzhi 'dus pa'i pho brang du: sems kyi rten gnasatsit+ta 'bar ba la dbang po sgo lnga'i rten gyis mtha' brten byas rnam shes tshonas brgyad 'khor gyis rab tu brgyan sha khrag rus pa nang 'brol sna tsho gos ldan mig gnyis dngas ma'i 'od kyis mun pa sel bdag lus longs spyod rgyas pa'i sgyu lus 'di nges pa'i don ston bla ma nyid la 'bul bdag gi lam gyi 'khrul snang kun dag nas rang rig ye shes rtogs par mdzad du gsol gsum pa sgrib sbyong bshags pa'i gzer las sgrib pa ma dag par yang dag snying po mi rtogs pas rang gi sgyu lus bem po 'di'i spyi gtsug pad+ma nyi zla'i steng : āḥlas rdo rje sems(4na'i pa' nyid dung mdog zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa rin cen rgyan gyis mdzes par brgyan phyag g.yas rdo rje thugs kar 'dzin g.yon pa dril bu dku la brten zhabs gnyis sems dpa'i skyil krung mdzad de yi thugasagar yi ge āḥ āḥlas 'od 'phros mdangs dang ldan: āḥlas bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun babs bdag gi spyi gtsug rkang mthil bar phyi nang lus bkrus dag par bsam yi ge brgya pa dang / ā+oṃ badz+ra sa twa hūṃ āḥ thun bzhi thun drug gang bde'i bar yang snying gzungs dang bcas pa bzlas dbang po rab 'bring tha ma yis zhag gsum bdun nam nyer gcig gam rim par sgrib sbyong las la 'bad bzhi pa mi rtag bskul 'debs gzer rang gi yul 'khor khang khyim dang : sa rdo ri brag 'jig rten khams:brtsig dang gnas dang 'jig pa dang : dus kyi 'pho 'gyur legs par bsam: bar du rang gi dgra dang gnyen: srog chags kun dang rang gi lus skye dang gson dang 'chi bar bsam: tha ma 'khor ba rigs drug gi sdug bsngal rim par brtag cing bsam thun du bcad la mi rtag bsgom mi rtag bsgoms pas chos la 'jug 434

byang ga kho thugs sgrub 'bring po'i tshon las rin cen 'phreng ba/ nang ma 6)lnga pa bla ma'i rnal 'byor ni dus gsum bde gshegs thams cad kyi thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don mdzad kyang :bdag ni 'khor ba'i gnas su 'khyams da lta nges pa'i don ston pa'i bla ma de ni sangs rgyas kyi sprul pa yin te sku drin chadaper na yid bzhin nor bu 4bti 'byung ba lnga yi bcud yin kyang :'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po la rtsol ba med par grogs su 'byung :rgyal po dgung du gshegs pa'i chas rdo gzhan gyis mi thub par:'byung ba lnga la zang thal du gshegs te rgya mtsho chen po'i nang :rin cen gser gyi sa gzhi la nor so:thugs dam lha la phyag 'tshal lo gsang mtshan thugs sgrub bla ma yi rnal 'byor pad+ma bdag gis bshad:྅/rang lus der 'dzin med pa yi:spyi bor pad+ma nyi zla dang :dar wo ltab khri brtsegs pa'i dra brdzis zhal bgrad mche gtsigs ag tsho mes 'bar:spyan gsum nyi zla lta bur gzigadabu skra'i thor tshugs dar gyis bcings rigs lnga'i sangs rgyas dbu la brgyan rin cen rus rgyan dur khrod chas:thams cad sku la legs par ldan7rgyan zab chen brjid pa'i na bza' gsol gar dgu'i nyams dang ldan pa la 'gying bag rol pa'i stabs su bzhugs zhal nasa3 gi sgra chen sgrog thugs ni drag po'i ngar dang ldan dus gsum sangs rgyas yi dam lha rnam dag brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams bkrag mdangs 'od du mer re re ma hā gu ru'i sku la 'dus kun 'dus bla ma'i ngo bo la rtsegacig dad pas phyag 'tshal lo gnyis med rol pa'i
