rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()de nas brgyud pa'i gsol ba gdab rtswa āḥ//'og min chos kyi dbyings kyi pho brang du kun bzang che mchog he ru ka la gsol ba 'debs:rang byung rnam par dag pa'i gzhal yas su longs sku rgyal ba rigs lnga las lcang lo can gyi snam gnas mchag dam pa phugasang bdag phyag na rdo rje la mo byang chub sems kyi gzhal yas chen po sa smug nag dbang gi mkha' 'gro las gnas chen ri rgyal lhun po'i rtse mo sa sgos pa'i rgyal bo gdong gsum las steng phyogs rnam par rgyal ba'i khang bzang du rigs 'dzin lha dbang brgya byin lar:/ rgya mtsho rol pa'i mtsho gling du rigs 'dzin klu rgyal 'jog po las ri rgyal ma la ya yi rtse mo sa skal ldan rgyal po dzal mo tho lha me yul gyi cho rtaganas ma ga dam ba sa mkhas pa shākya pra bha lar:bal yul yang le shod kyi brag phug sa rigs 'dzin pad+ma 'byung gnas la mo:chu bo chen po gaṅgā'i rtsa ba phu mkhas pa bi mā mi tra la mo 5 bsgo bal nagasakyi ri yi rtsab phub la po shī la mañdzu las lho phyogs mon kha seng ge'i yang rdzong du mkhar chen bza' yi 'tsho rgyal las rong zhes grags pa'i brag dmar ke'u tshang du sna nam rdo rje bdud 'joms las gnas chen ri rgyal bkra bzang shar 'dabs su//gter ston rigs 'dzin yab sras la mo//thugasarje 'gyur med gzhal yas chen po mā/dran mchog rdo rje'i mas can la mo//mkha' spyod dag pa chen po'i gzhal yas su//sngags 'chang rdo rje mgon po las/shrī byang rdzong dpal gyi sgrub khang du//mas ldan byams pa bshes gnyen la mo//gnas chen rdo rje phur ba'i gzhal yas su//mtshan ldan ngag dbang grags pa lar//byang phyogs skya bo kha gdangs gnas ma ga tu//chos rje sangs rgyas dpal bzang la mo//bde grol gsang sngags chos gling pho brang du//thugs sras nam mkha' rgyal mtshan las/sbas yul yol mo gangs kyi ra ba sa/sngags 'chang shākya bzang po la mo//dpal chen chu bo ri yi gnas mchog tu//mnga' ris rigs 'dzin chen po las//gu ru pad+ma'i e waṃ lcog sgar du//chos rgyal dbang po'i gnyid lar//smon thang dpal gyi dben gnas dam pa mā/rigs 'dzin ngag gi dbang po la mo//bde ba'i rdo rje'i mi 'gyur pho brang du/khyaX ༷dag chos dbyings rang grol la mo//gar bzhugs

byang gter thugs sgrub 'bring po'i 'phrin las rin cen 'phreng ba/ nang ma 6)dag pa'i zhing khams sgo son/ /sna tsho gos brgyud pa'i bla ma lar/ /theg mchog chos kyi pho brang chen po na/ /chos rgyal gter bdag gling pa las/ /'bral med snying ga chos kyi pho brang du/ /(6na ji na can rtsa ba'i bla ma lam/ /rang lus rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor chen bo phu rang rig ma hā gu ru las gter mdzod bse sgrom smug bo'i gzhal yas su gsang sngags snying po'i mthar thug las: smug nag gru gsum dbang gi gzhal yas su bka' srung e ka dzā khyi las rtsa dang thig le'i gzhal yas chen po phu ma dang ye shes mkha' 'gro las bka' dang dam tshig chen po'i gzhal yas su bka' srung chos skyong gter bdag lar rang snang dag pa chen po'i gzhal yas su mched lcam rdo rje spun grogs la mo dngos dang brgyud pa'i bla ma khyed rnams la: rab gus rtse gcig gdung bas gsol ba 'debs rang rig ma bcos bla ma'i ngo bo phu da lta wo du rtogs par byin gyis rlobs dpal ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma bka' drin che mchog gi mchog gyur sku gsung thugs kyi dbyig gsol 'debs brgyud 'dzin skal ldan bdag cag la 'bad med lhun gyis grub par mdzad du gsol bla ma 'od du mer gyi zhu bdag gi spyi bor thim pa las tha mal lus 'di 'od du chu bdag gi lusang ga yid gsum po ma hā gu ru'i ngo bor gyur rang rig bla ma'i ngang der ni: dar cig ma yengs slong la bzhag: de nas bla ma'i rnam par ldang : thams cad sku gsum bla mar blta sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya:ā+oṃ āḥsnyi/ ma hā gu ru sarba sirnyi hūṃ/ 'jig rten snang ba sgyu mar go lags kyang / /'phral snang 'di la da dung bdag 'dzin (6bskyis/ /bdag gi nyen mongs bag chags ma stongs bar/ /chags then rtsad nas da par byin gyis rlomes/ /zhom/ snyigs ma'i lasang na mi rtag rang gzugs la/ /ngesa'abyung skyes nas chags yul bor yang / /phyis nas rang bde'i yul 'dod du khas mnar/ /'dod sems rtsad chog nas da par za/ chur/ dug gsum nyen mongs sel ba'i thabs chen po/ /rgyal bas lung bstan mang por gsungs lags kyang / /spong dka'i bag chags dbang du shas cher shor/ /lasang na rtsad nas da par〉/ /lhar/ phyi rkyen nang rkyen de ma thag pa'i rkyen/ /thams cad bskyed pa'i rtsa ba 437

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (25)gnyis 'dzin du/ /da gzod go yang mdud pa'i rtsa ma grol/ /rang sems gcer bur 'char bar〉 tshwa྾/ /gnyis 'dzin sgrog las grol bar byin gyis rlobs/ shes pa bzo med rang lugs lhug pa la/ /mkhas kyang legs pa'i rang bzo ma byas shing / /bying 'thibs g.yeng ba'i bcen rar ma bcings par/ /bkrag mdangs rang 'od 'tsher ba'i rig pa 'di/ /chos nyid yangs pa'i ma dang bu 'phrad nas/ /le lo rkyen gyi grogs phyir ma 'thoms par/ /legs pa'i khang bur gces pa'i gnyer byas te/ /myur du chosanyid ma dang bu 'phrad nas/ /phyin ho 'gro don stobs chen byed par shog /byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa byed par shog /gzhan don dge ba rlabs li 'grub par shog /'khor ba dong nas sprug pa'i mthuthob shog /ces pa 'di ni sprul sku rigs 'dzin wo po rgod kyi ldem phru (7na7na gyis mdzad pa'o/ /thun mong ma yin pa'i sngon 'gro la/ thugs sgrub las byang kha bskang phyir bdag nyid lha yi bsgom thabs la lha yi dkyil 'khor bsgom pa ni stan bde ba la lus tsog pur 'dug lha thamasacad kyi sku'i ngo bo rdo rje slob dpon la 'dus pas/ bdag nyid kyisa3 hūṃ zhes brjod pas skad cig dran rdzogs su ma hā gu ru pad+ma 'byung gnas rdo rje drag po rtsal zhes bya ba/ sku 'jigs pa'i cha lugs su bstan pa gsung rngam pa'i nga ro sgrog pa: thugs drag po'i ngar dang ldan pa: 'gying bag dang rol pa'i stang stabs su bzhugs pa/ phyag g.yas gnam lcags kyi rdo rje rtse dgu pa nam mkha' la 'phyar ba/g.yon pa gser gyi dril bu dku la brten pa/ rus pa'i rgyan drug dang rin po che'i dbu rgyan dang / sprul gyi gdu bus brgyan pa/ khro gtum brjid pa'i gar dgu dang ldan pa/ spyan gsum nyi zla 'khyil ba ltar gzigs pa/ tshems gangs ri gtams pa ltar ba 'ad pa: ag tshoms dus mtha'i me ltar 'bar ba/zhal nas hūṃ gi sgra 'brug ltar sgrog pa za 'og gi ber smug po dang dur khrod kyi chas brgyad kyis brgyan pa/ dbu skra'i thor tshugs rus pas brgyan pa/ zhabs gnyis stang stabs su bgrad de nyi zla pad+ma'i steng du raka srin po pho mo brdzis pa'i gdan la bzhugs pa bskal pa'i me ltar 'bar ba'i klong dkyil na 'gying bag tu brjid pa khams gsum dbang du sdud cing srid gsum zil gyis gnon pa'i bdag —438

byang gter thugs sgrub 'bring po'i 'phrin las rin cen 'phreng ba/ nang ma 9)nyid can du gyur / hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ/ brgya tsam bzla thugs(7ba〉skyub las byang kha bskang phyir/ rgyal chen ge bzhi'i mchod thabs la/ hūṃ/ bdag nyid lha yi thugs ka nas/ dkar ser dmar ljang hūṃ chen bzhi/'phros 'dus 'od du zhu ba las/ ye shes rgyal po bzhi ru gyur/ ā+oṃ dzñā na rā dza sam ya hūṃ dzaḥ lha/ ri rgyal lhun po'i shar phyogs na/ pho brang chen po sposang da ldan/ zab cing rgya che gzigs 'phags po/rgyal po ོ po yul 'khor bsrung / sku mdog dkar po pi waṃ 'dzin/ btsun mo sras dang blon por bcas/ 'khor ni dri za 'bum gyi bskor/ sde'o che la stobs po che/ mchod gtor 'di bzhes shar phyogs kyi/ gdon rnams bzlog cing phyi mtshams srungs/ hūṃ/ ri rgyal lhun po'i lho phyogs na/ pho brang chen po be+e ḍūrla/ zab cing ྾/ rgyal po chen po 'phags skyes po/ sku mdog ser po ral gri 'dzin/bas mor/ 'khor ni grul bumaḥ/ sdebar/ mchod gtor 'di bzhes lho phyogs kyi/ gdon rnams྾/ hūṃ/ ri rgyal lhun po'i nub phyogs na/ pho brang chen po rgya mtsho'i rba/ zab cing ྾/ rgyal bo chen po spyan mi bzang / sku mdog dmar po sbrul zhags 'dzin/ btsun ma'i/ 'khor ni klu dbang ྾/ sde bo che la stobs bo che/ ma rdzo gtor 'di bzhes nub phyogs kyi/ gdon rnams sko/ hūṃ/ ri rgyal lhun po'i byang phyogs na/ pho brang chen po lcang lo can/ zab cing —/ rgyal po chen po rnam thos sras/ sku mdog ljang gu rgyal mtshan 'dzin/ btsun mor/ 'khor ni gnod sbyin mo/ sde bor/ mchod gtor 'di bzhes byang phyogs kyi/ gdon rnams za/ (8྅/ rgyal po chen bo sdebazhi po/ don gyi sangs rgyas yin mod kyang /gsang sngags bstan pa bsrung ba'i phyir/ bar chad 'dul bar mdzad du gsol/ thugs dam lha la phyag 'tshal lo/ bdag 'dra pad ma 'byung gnas sa/ lnga brgya tha ma shar ba'i tshe/ ri bo bkra bzang shar 'dabs su/ las can sbas pa'i rnal 'byor pa/ rgod kyi ldem phru can zhig 'byung / de phyir nga yi thugs sgrub bzhag /tshe sgrub lcags kyi sdong po yin/ nor sgrub rin cen spungs pa yin/ sdebargyad 'dul ba'i gnyen po yin/ sgrub chen bka' brgyad 'dus pa yin/ pad+ma 'byung gnas snying thig yin/ mkha' 'gro rnams kyi snying khrag yin/ kun bzang thugs kyi dgongs pa yin/ las can bu yi dngos grub yin/439

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()nga yi rjes 'jug rnal 'byor pa/ man ngag 'di dang 'phrad pa'i tshe/ brtson tsos drag pos bar chad spongs/nyams len drag pos dngos grub thob/the tshom spongs la sgrub pa mdzod/bu khyod yi dam 'di la mdzod/bdag dang gzhal mjal lung ston nges/e ma ho/'di nyid sgrub pa'i rnal 'byor pas/dben pa'i gnas su maṇ+ḍal bsham/mdun du pad+ma nga yi sku/rab gnas ldan pa bzhugs su gsol/thugs sgrub sems la longs spyod phyir/sgrub rdzas mchod gtor bsham mi 'tshal/spyan 'dren mchod bstod bskul mi dgos/dkyil 'khar gsum gyi sgrub pa bya/de nas bsnyen pa'i rtags rdzogs nas/dngos grub blang ba'i cho ga bya/mchod rdzas spyan gzigs sna tshogs bstag ma/thugs sgrub 'phrin las ting 'dzin ni/hūṃ/dang po rang nyid dben pa'i gnas su 'dug/phyi nang snod bas snang ba thams cad kun/rang rig sems las byung ba'i cho 'phrul te//sems nyid dngos po gzung 'dzin bral ba'i ngang /de ltar rtogs na bgegs rnams rang sar grol/hūṃ/de nyid ngang las skad cig dran rdzogs su/'jigs byed 0 po rdo rje drag po rtsal/bskal pa'i me 'bar rdo rje'i tsha tsha 'phro/'jig rten thamasacad ming nas ldeg cing 'khrug/bdud dang dam sri bgegs gas brlag par byed/bshags pa bya ba ni/hūṃ/dus gsum bde gshegs mkha' 'gro dam can rnams/ting 'dzin rtse gcig dad pas spyan drangs nas/bskal pa dpag med dus nas da lta'i bar/dug lnga'i dbang gyur ngan song gsum gyi las/lusang ga yid gsum sdig sgrib mthol lo bshags/byin dbab pa ni/hūṃ/bdag nyid sdig sgrib dag pa'i phung po la/lha rnams dgyes shing 'od zer stong gsum gang /bdag la thim bas yi dam lhar gyur te/sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub thob pa yi/mchog dang thun mong dngos grub byin chen thob/bdud rtsi byin rlabs ni/hūṃ/bdag las 'od 'phros bhan+ta gzhal yas khang /g.yas g.yon thabs dang shes rab phyag rgya las/rigs lnga yab yum sbyor mdzad byang chub sems/bdud rtsi mu tig dkar po char ltar babs/ snod bcud thams cad bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshos gang / hrī khyo/ mtheb srin sbyar ba rta mgrin yum bzhir bcas/bdud rtsi 'khyil zhing ༷/sa grub ster mdzad lha/bdag la reg pas dam

byang gter thugs sgrub 'bring po'i 'phrin la rin cen 'phreng ba/ nang ma 9)tshig nyams sgrib dag/rdzas la gtor bsam dag skyon rnams sbyangs/bgegs la phog pas bdud dang dam sri bskrad/gtor ma byin rlabs ni/hūṃ/snod kyi 'jig rten dur khrod khog pa sa snying khrag sha rusachu ser nyon mongs lnga/rnam dag ye shes lnga dang 'dod yon drug/bcud kyi 'jig rten lha mo drug gisakhengs/dam rdzas gtore ma mchod par byin gyis brlabs/rak+ta byin rlabs ni/hūṃ/bhan+ta 'bar ba rak+ta dmar gyi snod/khams gsum 'khor ba'i rgyu ni 'dod chags te/rnam shes tshogos brgyad 'i bos pa rtsa chen khrag/rak+ta chos nyid skye ba med pa la/gsang ba yum gyi thig le bde ba'i ngang /phyi mchod byin rlabs ni/hūṃ/a bdug spos me tog mar me dang /dri chab phyi yi mchod ba rnam pa lnga/yid 'ong mdzes pa'i lha mo rnam pa lngas/rnam dag gtsang mar sbyar te bsnams nas kyang /yi dam lha dang mkha' 'gro mchod pa'i rdzas/dngos gzhi la/de bzhin nyid kyi ting 'dzin ni/hūṃ/'di ltar sems kyi rtsal snang ma 'gags pa/sna gos snang ba 'di ni ye shes te/snang ba'i dus na ngo bo stong pa'i ngang /chos kyi dbyings smi spros dang bral bar gnas/dbyer med byang chub sems ni bde ba che/kun tu snang ba'i ting 'dzin ni//hūṃ/de ltar ma rtogs zhakhrul pa'i sems can rnams/snying rje chen po byams pa'i ting 'dzin gyis/rang rig 'od zer kha dog lnga dang ldan/9bskos la 'tsher snang ba ma 'gags dngas pa la/ngo bo brtse ba'i snying rje chen po bsgom/rgyu'i ting 'dzin ni/hūṃ/de las 'od lnga 'dus pa'i yi ge ni/hūṃ chen sngon po 'bar ba nyi zla bzhin/snang stong dbyer med ngang du gsal bar shar/skar chen thang la babs pa'i tshul bzhin du/'bras bu rgyu yi yi ge hūṃ du shar/'byung ba rim brtsegs ni/hūṃ/yi ge hūṃ lasa3 lnga los pa las/hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ/gangs la thig pa bab pa bzhin du chags/de las 'od 'phros khrung ba chen po lnga/'og gzhi dbang chen gzhal yasagasal bar bsgom/ye shes lnga dang yum lnga rnam dag klong /hūṃ/nam mkha' mthing nag gru gsum gdal ba la/rlung nag rdo rje rgya gram rab tu g.yo/me dpung bskal pa dus mtha'i me ltar 'bar/rak+ta'i rba rlabs rgya mtsho'i klong ltar 'khyil/keng rus 'a ༷༷ ri rab lhun sdug brjid/hūṃ/rgyu yi yi ge nyid las

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (25)'od 'phros pas/ snang ba snod kyi 'jig rten thams cad kun/ bdag gi gzugs kyi phung po gzhal yas khang / tsi sto ga'u rin cen pho brang mdzes/ rtsa r+ṣa rtsa phran ka gdung rgyan dang ldan/ bhan+ta'i rtsig pa nang khrol dra bar ldan/ rnam shes tshogs brgyad gzer gyis rab tu gtams/ gsal byed mig gnyis nyi zla'i mthongs khung la/ steng 'og rgyu lam bzhi la sgo bzhi gnas/ byang chub sems las kun 'byung ga6ltar yabs khang /hūṃ/ rgyu yi yi ge 'od 'phros 'dus pa las/ ma chags pad+ma thabs shes nyi zla'i steng / srin po ru dra brdzis pa'i gdan steng du/ ma hā gu ru rdo rje drag po rtsal/ (10na)rang rig rang byung rang shar gsal bar bsgom/ hūṃ/ sku mdog mthing nag 'jigs pa'i cha lugs la/ phyag g.yas gnam lcags rdo rje rtse dgu bsnams/ phyag g.yon gser gyi dril bu dku la brten/ rin cen rus rgyan zab chen ber la sogs/mkha' 'gro dam can dbang sdud rgyan gyis brgyan/ dur khrod chas brgyad brjid pa'i gar dgu ldan/ sku gsung thugs dang yon tan 'phrin las kyis/ lha tsho gos thams cad nyid kyi sku la rdzogs/ bde gshegasakun 'dus rdo rje drag po rtsal/ zhabs gnyis gyad kyi 'gying bag stabs su bzhugs/ spyi bo tshangs pa'i bu ga'i rtsa 'dab steng / mgon po tshe dpag med kyi lha tsho gos rdzogs/ klad pa dung khang rtsa yi 'khor lo la/ 'jam dpal sku yi lha tshogs thams cad rdzogs/ mgrin pa longs spyod 'khor lo'i rtsa 'dab la/pad+ma gsung gi lha tsho gis thams cad rdzogs/ snying ga chos kyi 'khor lo'i rtsa 'dab la/ rdo rje thugs kyi lha tshogs thams cad rdzogs/ lte ba 'khor lo 'i 'dus pa rtsa 'dab la/ bdud rtsi yon tan lha tshogasathams cad rdzogs/ gsang gnas bde skyong 'khor lo'i rtsa 'dab la/ che mchog ma mo'i lha tsho gis thams cad rdzogs/ rtsa chen rtsa phran stong gi 'khor lo la/ mkha' 'gro 'bum phrag mang po'i lha tsho gis rdzogs/dbu la rgyal ba rigs lngas dbang bskur mdzad/ sku ni rdo rje khros pa'i sku gsung thugs/ phyag g.yasaganam lcags rdo rje rtse dgu la/ 'jigs byed khro bcu'i lha tsho gos thams cad rdzogs/ phyag g.yon gser (10ba)gyi dril bu khro mo bcu/ zhabs gnyis brkyang bskum ru dra brdzis pa la/ phyogs skyong sdebargyad 442

byang gter thugs sgrub 'bring po'i 'phrin las rin cen 'phreng ba/ nang ma 9)dregs pa'i srog rtsa 'dus/ de nas rol mo'i sgra dang bcas/ gdung ba'i dbyangs kyis spyan drang ba ni/hūṃ/ sngon gyi bskal pa'i dang po la/ phyon yul gyi nub byang mtshams/ pad+ma ge sar sdong po la/ ya mtshan mchog gi dngos grub brnyes/ pad+ma 'byung gnas zhes su grags/ 'khor du mkha' 'gro mang posabaskor/ khyod kyi rjes su bdag bsgrub kyi/ byin gyis brlab phyir gshegs su gsol/ hūṃ/ dha na ko sha'i mtsho gling du/ drag po'i brtul zhugs mdzad pa'i tshe/ sangs rgyas kun gyis dbang bskur mdzad/ mkha' 'gro dam can dbang du bsdus/ rdo rje phag mo yum dang rol/ lha srin sdo brgyad bran du bkol/ bdud dang log 'dren thams cad bsgral/ gsang mtshan rdo rje drag po rtsal/ rdo rje srin po'i lha tsho gos rnams/gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol/ hūṃ/ ma g.yel ma g.yel rigs 'dzin tshogs/ chos sku longs sku sprul sku yi/ bla ma kun 'dus thod phreng rtsal/ gnas 'dir mo/ hūṃ/ ma g.yel ma g.yel yi dam lha/ sgrub chen bka' brgyad lha tshogs kyi/ yi dam kun 'dus brag po rtsal/ gnas 'dir〉/hūṃ/ ma g.yel ma g.yel dam can tshogs/ mkha' 'gro ging dang bka' nyan rnams/ sngon gyi dam tshig rjes dgongs la/ gnas 'dir〉/ hūṃ/ bzhengs shig pad+ma 'byung gnas mkha' 'gro'i tshogs/dgongs shig phyogs bcu dus gsum bde gshegs rnams/ rje btsun chen po (11na)pad+ma thod 'phreng rtsal/ rigs 'dzin mkha' 'gro'i gnas nas gshegs su gsol/ dbu skra mdzes pa'i thor tshugasashigs se shig /rin chen rgyan cha mang po sil li li/ dur khrod rus pa'i rgyan cha khrol lo lo/ sgra dang rol mo mang po 'ur ru sa yi dam lha tshogs hūṃ sgra dir ri ri/ mkha' 'gro sde lnga'i gar byed shigs se shig /ging chen dpa' bo'i bro rdung khrabs se khrab/ ma mo mkha' 'gro sprin ltar thibs)thib/ phyogasaskyong sdo brgyad las byed khyugs se khyug /zhub can stong gi sgra skad sil li li/ g.yas na pho rgyud thamasacad shar ra ra/ g.yon na mo rgyud thams cad shar ra ra/ bar snang thams cad dar du lhabs lhab/ dri zhim spos kyi ngad pa thul lu lu/ mkha' 'gro gsang ba'i brda skad dir ri ri/ gying chen dpa' bo'i bshug glu kyur ru sa ྅ gi snang glu mang po dir ri ri/ phaṭa kyi brda skad drag po sangs sesang / bdag dang 'gro 443

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()drug sems can thams cad la/ thugs rjes gzigs la gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ gnasa'adir thugs rjes dgongs te gshegs nas kyang /bdag gis byang chub snying po ma thob bar/bgegasadang log 'dren bar chad 'dul ba dang /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsal du gsol/hūṃ/skye 'gag 'gyur med 'phrin las thams cad rdzogs/rang byung thugs rjes 'gro drug sgrol bar mdzad/yid bzhi nor bu'i dngos grub sa ltar 'bebs/rdo rje thod phreng rtsal la phyag la'i bstod/hūṃ/bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro la/lha rdzas phyi mchod 'bul 1ba tha ni/a bdug spos me tog dang /mar me dri chab zhal zas dang /snyan pa'i rol mo mchod par 'bul/hūṃ/bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro la/rang byung nang mar 'bul ba ni/dbang bo lnga yi me tog mchod/gsur r+pā dud pa'i dri yis mchode/tso chen snang gsal mar mes mchode/rdo rje dri chu byug pas mchode/bdud ni dri chen zhal zas mchode/rkang gling thod rnga'i sgra yis mchod/dug gsum sku gsung thugs su mchod/dug lnga ye shes lnga ru mchod/snang srid phyag rgya bzhi ru mchod/mchod bzhes dbang dang dngos grub stsol/hūṃ/bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro la/gnyis med gsang mchod 'bul ba ni/yab yum gnyis med mkha' gsang nas/byang semasadakar dmar bde ba'i mchog/bde ba chen po mchod par 'bul/sku lus rgyas phyir bzhes su gsol/hūṃ/bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro la/drag po'i bsgral mchod 'bul ba ni/che mchog pad+ma thod 'phreng rtsal/phyag g.yas rdo rje rtse dgu gdengs/phyag g.yon phur bus dgra snying gzir/gnod byed thal ba'i rdul du rlog/dgra bgegs sha rus mchod par bzhes/hūṃ/rang byung gdod nas rnam par dag/rtsa ba brgyad la yan lag stong /bdud rtsi sman gyi mchod pa 'di/bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro dang /dam can chos skyong rnams la 'bul/sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub stsol/hūṃ/bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro la/rgyud drug bsgral ba'i rak+ta 'di/'dod chags rtsad nas bcad pa'i phyir/skye med don gyi mchod pa 12nabazhes/hūṃ/bla med mchog gi mchod pa dam par sbyar ba 'di/ye shes lnga yi 'od zer rnam par 'phro/'dod pa'i yon to lnga 'a yas rab bas te/thugaXm bzhi du ci bder bzhes su gsol/las can

byang ga kho thugs sgrub 'bring po'i 'phrin la ren cen 'phreng ba/ nang ma 6)'di dang 'phrad pa rnams/ dkyil 'khor gsum po gsal btab la/ nyin mtshan dus drug thams cad du/ bsnyen pa chu bo'i gzhung bzhin bzlas/ dam rdzas phyi nang gsang ba'i rdzas/ dngos 'byor yid kyisarnam sprul te/ dus dang gza' skar bzang po la/ dbu btsugs/ gi 'phrin las ni/ bla ma mchod phyir rgyun du 'bul/ rtags dang don gyi bstod pa ni/ 'dzab bsnyen 'phrin las skabs su 'bul/ hūṃ/ dur khrod chen po 'jigs pa'i gad brgyangs can/ bskal pa'i me 'bar rdo rje'i tsha tsha 'phro/ ma mo mkha' 'gro sprin ltar 'du ba'i gnas/ sha za srin po brgyal zhing rengs pa'i gnas/ skyon mkha' 'gro'i gling nasazab mo'i bka'/ bsam gyis mi khyab gsung gi snying thig 'di/ drag po'i thugs kyi sgrub pa 'di tsam ste/ gter du sped do nam zhig bstan pa'i mthar/ las can nga yi bu dang 'phrad par shog /rtags bstod 'di ltar du dgongs la rtags kyi bstod pa'o/hūṃ/ dur khrod chen po rab tu 'jigs pa'i tshal/ nyon mongs 'joms mdzad me dpung 'bar ba'i klong / chags med pad+ma thabs shes nyi zla'i gdan/ dregs pa srin po brdzis pa'i gdan steng du/ 'jigasabyed byu po rdo rje drag po rtsal/ sku mdog mthing nag 'bar ba'i gar dgu ldan/ spyan (12ba〉grad mche gtsigs ag tsho mes me ltar 'bar/ rgyad kyi dor stabs long bag stabs su bzhugs/ dbu skra'i thor tshugs nam mkha'i sprin ltar gtibs/ rigs lnga'i sangs rgyas rnams kyis dbu la brgyan/ rin chen 'bar bas dbu dang phyag zhabs spras/ phyag g.yas gnam lcags rdo rje rtse dgu 'phyar/ phyag g.yon gser gyi dril bu dku la brten/ dur khrod mas brgyad sku la legs par brgyan/ zab chen ber smug dbang gi na bza' gsol/ rus pa'i rgyan drug rtags kyis mdzes par brgyan/ bde gshegs thamasacad 'dus pa'i sku gsung thugs/ mkha' 'gro 'bum phrag mang po'i sdod pon mdzad/ rdo rje drag po rtsal la phyag 'tshal bstod/ skabs 'dir sum brgya nyer gcig gi 'dzab bzla/hūṃ/ chos kyi dbyings kyi zhing khams su/ kun bzang che mchog he ru ka /'gro ba'i don du sku bzhengs la/ chos nyid stong pa'i rang sgra sgrog /bdag kyang khyed kyi rjes su 'jug /rigs 'dzin bla ma tshos byin 445

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (25)gyis rlomes mdzod cig /hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ/ rang byung rnam dag gzhal yas su/ ye shes lnga ldan rgyal ba lnga/ lcang lo can gyi gnas mchag tu/ gsang bdag phyag na rdo rje yang / byang chub sems kyi gzhal yas su/ smug nag dbang gi mkha' 'gro yang / 'gro ba'i ri/ chos྾/ bdag ra/ rigs sko/ /ra/ri rgyal lhun po'i rtse mo mā tshangs pa'i rgyal po gdong gsum yang / rnam par rgyal ba'i khang bzang du/rigs 'dzin lha dbang brgya byin yang / sis rgya mtsho'i mtsho gling du/ rigs 'dzin klu rgyal 'jog po yang / 'gro ba'i mo mo mo rki ra/ ma la ya gnam lcags rtse mo sa bsod nams bsags pa'i rgyal po dza/ za hor yul gyi gnas mchag tu/ mkhas pa shākya pra bha yang / yang le shod kyi brag phug tu/ rigasa'adzin pad+ma 'byung gnas kyang / 'gro ba'i za ra〉〉 〉/ chu bo gaṅgā'i rtsab sa mkhas pa bi mā mi tra yang / ma bal nags kyi rtsab sa bal po shī la mañdzu yang / mon kha seng ge yang rdzong du/ mkhar chen bza' yi 'tsho rgyal yang / /'gro ba'i〉 〉 〉 〉〉/ /rong gi brag dmar ke'u tshang du/ /sna nam rdo rje bdud 'joms kyang / /ri bo bkra bzang shar 'dabs su/ gter ston rigs 'dzin yab sras kyang /thugs rje 'gyur med gzhal yas su/ /dran mchog rdo rje'i mtshan can yang / /'gro ba'i〉〉〉〉〉/ /mkha' spyod dag pa'i zhing khams su/ /sngags 'chang rdo rje mgon po yang / s+t+waṃ byang rdzong sgrub khang du/ /mtshan ldan byams pa bshes gnyen yang / /rdo rje phur pa'i gzhal yas su/ /mtshan ldan ngag dbang grags pa yang / /'gro ba'i mo ra 〉mo ra/ /skya bo kha gdangs gnas mchog tu/ /chos rje sangs rgyas dpal bzang yang / /bde grol gsang sngags chos gling du/ /thugs sras nam mkha' rgyal mtshan yang / /yol mo gangs kyi ra ba rtswa /sngags 'chang shākya bzang po yang / /'gro ba'i mor 〉〉skom/ /chu bo ri yi brag phug tu/ /rigs 'dzin bdud 'joms rdo rje yang / /pad+ma'i e waṃ lcog sgar du/ /chos rgyal dbang po'i sde nyid kyang / /thub bstan rdo rje'i brag steng du/ /rigs 'dzin ngag gi dbang po yang / /'gro ba'i〉 〉 〉 sko sko/ /theg (13bsgo chog gsang sngags pho brang du/ /zur chen chos dbyings rang grol yang / /bde chen chos sku'i klong yangs su/ /brgyud pa kun 'dus tshogos rnams kyang / /o rgyan 446

byang gter thug sgrub gong po' skrun la rin cen phreng ba/ nang ma 9)smin grol gling mchog tu//sprul sku gter bdag gling pa yang //'bral med snying ga'i pho brang du//drin wo rtsa ba'i bla ma yang //'gro ba'i skor〉〉〉//rang lus rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor du//rang rig ma hā gu ru yang //gter mdzod bse sgrom smug po sa gsang sngags snying po'i mthar thug kyang //smug nag gru gsum gzhal yas su/bka' srung e ka dzā ṭi yang /'gro ba'i〉〉〉〉〉//rtsa dang theg le'i ga 'kha yas su//ma dang ye shes mkha' 'gro yang ཿbka' dang dam tshig gak+ṣ-i kha yas suḥbaka' srung chos skyong gter bdag kyang ཿdam tshig gtsang ma'i gzhal yas suḥmached lcam rdo rje'i spun grogs kyang ཿ'gro ba'i don dumaḥchos woraḥbadag kyang moḥrigs4na bla ma tshos byin gyisarlobs mdzod cig:྅dze/lus la bde ba byin gyis rlobasaḥngag la nus pa byin gyis rlobasaḥsems la rtogs pa byin gyis rlomes/lusang ga yid gsum la byin gyis rlomes mdzod cig/hūṃ/phyi yi bar chad phyi ru gsolaḥnang gi bar chad nang du solaḥgasang ba'i bar chad dbyings su solaḥphyi nang gsang gsum gyi bar chad sol mdzod cigaḥ/o//mi mthun rkyen dang bar chad solaḥmathun pa'i lam sna chos la drongs:mchog dang a mong gi dngos grub stsol mdzod cigaḥ/ra//'og gi dngos grub kyi 'dzab 'dir blangs te 4na gi sum tsam bzlaḥgasol 'debs 'dzab dang 'brel ba yin zhes gsungs pas skabs 'dir le'u bdun ma 'donaḥdon gyi bstod pa ni/hūṃ/skye 'gag med pa chos nyid dbyings kyi ngang ཿ'du gol med pa bde wo pho brang nasaḥrang byung rang shar thugs rje wo po'i skuḥbade gshegs kun 'dus rdo rje drag po rtsalaḥrang rig lha yi lha la phyag 'tshal loḥgasal 'grib med pa bde ba chen po'i sku rang rig rang gdangs ma 'gags gsal ba laḥrtsol sgrub bral bas bya byed gol sa chodaḥm bcos rang shar 'dzin med spros dang bralaḥrig pa rang gsal ngang la phyag 'tshal la:rig pa'i cho 'phrul cir yang 'char ba laḥrgya chad phyogs lhung med pas 'khrul pa bralaḥcir snang 'dzin med grol bas bde ba chogs la 'tsher dngas pa skyon bral rig pa'i gdangasaḥlongs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku la phyag 'tshal laḥ'abyung ba bzhi la brten ༷/ phung po laḥbacings 'thums rdugs pa med par

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()phyogs bcur 'charaḥgang shar rtag ra bral ba'i zang thal laḥzhabrul snang ngar gsos mi gdab rang sor bzhagaḥrang byung sprul pa'i sku la phyag 'tshal loḥrang rig kha dog ngos 'dzin ma grub baḥsnang stong phyogs lhung ye nas bral ba laḥm 'gags gsal 'tsher dngas pa chos nyid dang ཿrang rig go bo ma bcos thod phreng rtsal:rang rig bla ma'i mchog la phyag 'tshal loḥskabs 'dir bstan srung yongasardzogs sogs gter srung gi gsol mchod rnams mdzad/de ltar 14bstu gi 'phrin las zab mo 'diḥlas can bu dang 'phrad nas bsgrubs pa'i tsheḥgasang sngags zab mo'i tshig dang don du bsdebasaḥdon bstod sngags kyi las byang nang du ltosaḥmatshams gcod bshags pa byin dbab gsum gyi dbyangasaḥnam mkha'i 'brug ltar drag la ngar dang ldanaḥspyan 'dren mchod 'bul bstod ba gsum gyi dbyangasaḥsnyan la gdangs chags dril bu'i sgra ltar brjodaX ting 'dzin rnam gsum la sogs gzhung gi dbyangasaḥnam mkha' dngas pa'i klong ltar gting zab gsalaḥlhag ma la sogs mjug gi cho ga rnamasaḥrgyal po'i bka' ltar gsal la brjid chags paḥthugs sgrub drag po'i sku gsung thugs kyi bcudaḥnam mkha' lta bu'i rdo rje sgrub pa'i sgor las can dam tshig can dang 'phrad par shogaḥrjesal/tshogs bya ba ni/raṃ yaṃ byu tre 〉tshwa āḥs//tshogs kyi yo byad thams cad kunaḥrnam rtog dngosa'adzin bag chags sbyangs rat+na'i snod la bdud rtsi'i bcudaḥ'adod yon lha mo sprin ltar gtibasaḥ/ hūṃ/rje btsun pad+ma thod phreng rtsalaḥgadung ba drag pos bdag dungs shing ཿmkha' 'gro'i tsho gis dang bcas pa la:'dod yon lnga ldan mchod pa 'bulaḥb li rgyan gyis bdud rtsi sman gyisaḥrak+ta dmar gyis zhal ma zas tshogos kyi zaḥting 'dzin rtse gcig mo:sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub stsol/hūṃ/snang ba snod kyi 'jig rten gtor gzhed du:srid pa bcud kyi sems can gtor mar sbyaraḥdapal gyi gtor ma brjid ldan 'gying ba ldan 'daḥri rab lhun po bas kyang dpangs re mthaḥm mo'i gtor ma pad+mas bskor ba 'ad:gling bzhi gling phran bas kyang bkod re legasaḥdakar gyi thig btab dmar gyi gur phub baḥgaser gyi ri bdun baX brjid re cheḥrak+ta dmar gyi arnya sbreng ba 'diḥ

byang gter thug sgrub 'bring po'i 'phrin las rin cen 'phreng ba/ nang ma 6)rgya mtsho'i mching nam bas kyang rgya re cheḥ bdud rtsi sman gyis gtore ma bran pa 'ad: lha yi zhal zasabs kyang ro de bda'aḥ dkar rtsi dmar rtsi sha chen dri chen dang ཿ dri chu byug pa'i rdzas de rnam pa lngaḥ seng ge rta dang glang chen ba lang dang ཿ mchog chen mi la sogs te rnam pa lngaḥ ma hā me sal sogs sha sna stong ཿ ma hā tsit+ta la sogs snying sna stong ཿ dbang po lnga dang go ro tsa na dang ཿ bha su ta dang nang khrol rnamapa lngaḥ shing tog me rtag 'bru sna sman sna dang ཿ zan dang 'khur ba thug pa'i bye brag dang ཿ mar thud phrum dang zho dang 'o mar bcasaḥ tsi dang tsa ru tsi chen go stod dang : sga dang lan tsha sbod kyi bye brag dang ཿri sgog klungs sgog sha mo sna tsho gos dang ཿ bza' dang bca' ba btung ba'i bye brag dang ཿ gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya chos la sogs: 'dod yon lnga yi mchod pa sna tsho gis kunaḥ thogs med blo yis thams cad kun bsdus nas: ting 'dzin dgongs brgyud dag pas byin brlabs teḥ bdud rtsir gyur pa'i gtor ma chen po 'disaḥrdo rje slob dpon thugs dam stongs gyur cigaḥ yi dam lha tshogasaḥ mkha' 'gro sdebazhi'i moḥ dpa 'bo shing bzhi'i moḥ dam can srung ma'i khoḥ mchod par 'os pa'i khoḥ 'dir rtsa (15ba)gsum bskang gsogato me ཿ de nas/ ho/ zhal zlas tshogis kyi mchod pa 'diḥ 'dod yon ma spangs longasaspyod rgyanaḥ dngos grub sna tsho gos 'di las khrung ཿ tsho gos kyi mchod pa rgyan du rolaḥ sirnyi pha la a la la ho:tsho gos la rol rjesaḥ ho/ bdag dang rdo rje slob dpon dang ཿ mched dang lcam dral rnams kyis ma hā me sa gsol bas rdo rje sems dpa'i tshe dang lang tsho la mnga' brnyes par gyur cigaḥ dza gad dpa' bo gsol bas 'gro ba mang po dbang du 'du bar gyur cigaḥzhal zas kyi bye brag mang po gsol bsaḥ sgrub pa po'i mthu dang rdzu tshil dang dngos grub la mnga' brnyes par gyur cig ཿde'i dge ba'i rtsa bas sgrib pa rnam pa gnyis byang tsho gos rnam pa gnyisardzogs te bla na med pa'i byang chub kyi 'bras bu 'thob par gyur cig ches brjod lhag mar rang lha ru gsal ba'i kha chus bran la 'di skad do/ /hūṃ/ sngon tshe khrag 'thung he ru ga'i spyan sngar khas blangs dam bcas shing ཿ bar du pad+ma 'byung 449

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (25)gnas kyi ༷ spyan sngar khas blangs dam bcas paḥ da lta rigs 'dzin bdag cag giḥ bran dang pho nyar khas blangs pa'iḥ sgrub sde brgyad kyi bka' srung dang ཿ gsang sngags theg pa'i bka' srung rnamasaḥbaka' yi pham phabs 'di bzhes laḥ sngon gyi dam tshig dran par gyisaḥ gsang sngags bstan pa rgyasapar spelaḥ bdud dang dam sri rdul du rlogaḥ bcol ba'i 'phrin las sgrub par mdzod: de nas chad mtho bya ba ni/ hūṃ/ sngon gyi bskal pa dang po 'das pa'i dusaḥ 'og (16nas na dga' ldan zhes bya'i gnas mchog snya bcom lda dpal chen khrag 'thung chen po yis/ snang srid ma mo dam la btags pa'i tshe: go ri la sogs gnas kyi khro mo brgyadaḥ sidha la sogs yul gyi phra men brgyad: rta gdong la sogs sgo ma bzhi rnams kyisaḥ so so'i gzugs mchogo dam pa bstan nas kyang ཿ bka' yi gtor ma len par ma chad dmaḥ rnal 'byor tshe srog bsring bar ma chad dmaḥ bcol ba'i 'phrin las sgrub par ma chad dam ༷sngon tshe zhal bzhes dam las ma 'da' b.raḥ dpal chen bka' yi gtor ma 'di long laḥ bdag gisabacol ba'i 'phrin las sgrub par mdzodaḥ bskal pa bar ma gsang sngags dar ba'i dusaḥ bal yul yang le shod kyi brag phug 6 slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas dang ཿ las can bal mo shākya de ba yis rdo rje dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor zhal phye tshaḥ gtsang ris dpal mgon bdun du rtsa lnga yisaḥ soso'i bka' yisaḥ rnal 'byor sngaḥ bcol ba'i moḥ sngon tshe'i slob dpon bka' yi skoḥ bdag gis moḥ de 'og lnga brgya tha ma bod kyi yulaḥ bsam yas mchims phu'i brag dmar ke'u tshang duḥ slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas dang ཿ mnga' bdag rgyal po la sogs grub chen brgyad: sgrub pa bka' brgyad dkyil 'khor zhal phye tsheḥ bka' yi srung ma dregs pa sdo brgyad kyisaḥ so so'i moḥ bka' yis:rnal lor moḥ bcol ba'i maḥ sngon tsheraḥ slob dpon bka' yis bdag gis moḥ de 'og lnga brgya tha ma bod kyi yulaḥ bsam yas mchims phu'i brag dmar ke'u tshang duḥ slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas dang ཿ mnga' bdag rgyal po la sogs grub chen brgyadaḥ sgrub pa bka' brgyad dkyil 'khor zhal phye tsheḥ bka' yi srung ma dregs pa sdebargyad kyisaḥ so so'i skoḥ bkal yi skoḥ rnal 'byor mo:450

byang gter thugs sgrub 'bring po'i 'phrin la rin cen 'phreng ba/ nang ma 9)bcol ba'i moḥsngon tsheraḥdam tshig bka' yisaḥbadag gis mo:de nas bstan ma bskyang ba niḥ//a 16ba〉kyi ra yi brag phug sa skyon pad+ma 'byung gnas kyiḥspyan sngar khas blangs dam bcas pa'iḥbod yul blta ma brgya gnyis dang :phyi gtor dbang bar khas blangs rnamasaḥchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes laḥbadud dpung thul la zhing bcu sgrolaḥdal kha chings la 'bru bcud spelaḥdamag dpung choms la mtshon rtse thulaḥbacol ba'i 'phrin las sgrub par mdzodaḥdangos grub blang ba ni/hūṃ/bstan pa 'di la ngo mtshar ra byung ba'iḥ'ajig rten skyabs gyur pad+ma rgyal po naḥrigasani za hor rgyal po'i sras su 'khrungasaḥskyon yul du sgro 'dogs ma lus bcadaḥbasil ba'i tshal du dngos grub thams cad brnyesaḥkha ba can du bstan pa rgyas par mdzad:lho nub mtshams su srin po'i khaganon mdzad mya ngan mi 'da' 'gro ba'i gnyen gcig puḥsku gsum che mchog badz+ra he ru gaḥmanyam med bla ma mchog de dus 'dir dran 'dir gshegs rgyan gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes laḥbadag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor bcas laḥmachog dang thun mong gi dngos grub zhu ba lags so : chu āḥ& badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sirnyi snro3/shar gyi phyogs nas dngos grub bskul ba'i lhaḥzhi ba'i las mdzad rdo rje thod phreng rtsalaḥzhi ba'i rang bzhin sku mdog dkar la 'tsheraḥn bza' dkar po shin tu mdzesapar gsolaḥphyag mtshan rdo rje lcags kyu ḍā ma sa rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i thugs dam rgyud bskul loḥbadag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor bcas laḥnd gdon sdig sgrib zhi ba'i dngos grub zhu ba lags soḥ6skoḥ&/lho yisaḥrgyas pa'i las mdzad rat+na thod phreng rtsalaḥrgyas pa'i rang bzhin sku mdog ser la 17na〉tsheraḥn bza' ser po shin tu mdzes par gsol:phyag mtshan rin cen zhags pa ḍā ma sa rin cen mkha' 'gro'i thugs dmadzeḥbadag cag moḥtshe dang bsod nams rgyasapa'i dngos grub zhu ba lags so : zhodzeḥ//nub kyisaḥdabang gi las mdzad pad+ma thod phreng rtsalaḥdabang gi rang bzhin sku mdog dmar la 'tsheraḥn bza' dmar po shin tu mdzes par gsolaḥphyag mtshan pad+ma lcags sgrog ḍā ma sa pad+ma mkha' 'a/'imaḥ bdag cag mo: khams gsum dbang

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (25)sdud kyi dngos grub zhu ba lags sa : lharaḥ ྅/ byang gis: drag po'i las mdzad badze thod 'phreng rtsalaḥdrag po'i rang bzhin sku mdog ljang la 'tsher: na bza' ljang gu shin tu mdzes par gsolaḥ phyag mtshan rgya gram dril bu ḍā ma sa las kyi mkha' 'gro'i thugs dam rgyud bskul loḥ bdag cag raḥ dgra bgegs tshar gcod kyi dngos grub zhu ba lags so/ ā+oṃ āḥlha badz+ra mo/ hūṃ/ dbus kyi raḥ sku lnga lhun grub budha thod 'phrong rtsal: lhun grub rang bzhin sku mdog smug la 'tsheraḥ na bza' smug po shin tu mdzes par gsolaḥ phyag mtshan 'khor lo dril bu ḍā ma pu sangs rgyas moḥ dag cag moḥ mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub zhu ba lags so: zho āḥlha badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sirnyi hūṃ hūṃ snro na na kha : sirnyi hūṃ hūṃ snrisarba sirnyi dha rna dhi me dhi hrīḥ ā yuḥsirnyi sam ya sdus sdusaḥ zhes lan gsum brjod/ dngos grub bskul ba'i cho ga'o/ lhag chad kha bskang / de nas dkyil 'khor bsdu ba ni/ hūṃ/ da ni dkyil 'khor gsal btab laḥ phyi nang snod bcud thams cad kunaḥ yig 'bru hūṃ la hril gyi bsdu: ྅ yang mi dmigs 'ja' ltar (17ba〉la: de nas bdag nyid lha ru gsal: rtag chad gnyis kyi mtha' gsal lo: smon lam shis brjod bla ma gsang 'dus ltar byaḥ thugs sgrub hūṃ gi 'phrin las 'diḥ ma 'ongs snyigs ma lnga brgya laḥ las can bu dang 'phrad par shogaḥ tan nyan su lta: thugs sgrub drag po hūṃ gi 'phrin las naḥrgyas par byed na tshig dang don du bsdebasaḥ bsdus par byed na rang gzhung so sor byaḥ sa ma yaḥsku'i rgyaḥ gsung gi rgyaḥ thugs kyi rgyaḥ brag ri dug sprul spungs 'dra'i rked lho gser mdzod ser po nasarigs 'dzin rgod kyi ldem phru can gyis gdan drangs pa'o/ 'di bsgrubs dus gsum rgyal ba yin no cog /cig car 'grub pa rigs 'dzin bla ma yi/ /drag po hūṃ gi 'phrin las nyams bstar ba/ /bskal mang bsod nams bsags pa'i mthu las ci/ /bgrang yas zhi khro snang stong lus dkyil nas/ /hūṃ gi glu dbyangs grag stong sngags kyi sgra/ /ka dag rang rtsal gsal stong chos nyid klong / /stims su klas pasarig stong rang ngo 'phrod/ /kun bzang go 'phang tshe 'dir sgrub zhar la/ /zhi rgyas dbang sogs a mong dngos grub kun/ /'bras dkar lo legs tswa phub 'bad med du/ /'byung 'dis theg dgu'i zab gsang 452

byang gter thugs sgrub 'bring po'i 'phrin las rin cen 'phreng ba/ nang ma (ka)gnad kun rdzogs/ /gser min gser du 'bardzu ba 'a rdzun po'i gter/ / zhig min zhig por rlomasapas nyer spel nas/ /rigs min rigs par 'bad pas bsgrub pa la/ / mkhungs min mtshudas bral snga 'gyur zab mo'i chos/ /'phrin las lhan thabs bsdebs pa'i rin cen 'phreng / /bkod pas skye bar mtsho skyes rdo rje yis/ /rjes bzung gangs (18na〉na bstan 'gro'i phan bde rnams/ /spel la pad+ma thod phreng dang mtshungs shog /thugs sgrub drag po rtsal gyi 'phrin las 'bring po cha lag tshang ba zhig rnam par rgyal ba'i phan bde legs bshad gling pa'i zhal 'don du thog ma nas 'dzugs rtsis yod kyang gzhan rkyen gyis gleng brjod sogs la brten rim 'gyangs su lus pa yi dam 'di nyid kyi sgo nas bod 'bangs bde thabs sogs mang du bstar dgos pas gal che nges su mthong zhing sgrig rtsom kyang stod phyogs nas lhad yod med sna tshogs shig mthong ba mchog gi sprul sku rigs 'dzin mnga' ris pa chen po dang mnyam med nub dgon pa byams pa chos kyi rgyal mtshan sogs tshad thub kyi dam pa du ma'i gsung gi bdud rtsis thugs kyi bum bzang yongs su gtams pa khri srong rnam 'phrul dpal bkra shis stobs rgyal gyi phyag bzhes 'khrul med zur thams cad mkhyen pa chos dbyings rang grol gyis gsung las nye bar thos pa brjed ngas kyi som nyi rnams rigs 'dzin mchog sprul pad+ma 'phrin las la dogs dpyod zhib mor zhus pa'i reg zig gi don ltar la tshogs mchod kyi skabs snang ba snod bcud ma le brgyad ma dang 'dra min cung zad byung ba 'don bde khyed nas gter kha 'og ma sor bzhag dang de phyin bcos bslad med pa'i 'phrin las rin cen 'phreng ba 'di ni don grub ces pa sa mo lug gi lo hor zla bdun pa'i yar tshes lnga la za hor gyi sngags smyon zil gnon bzhad pa rtsal gyis pho brang po ta lar sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dpal grong sngags dmas pa ngag dbang dge legs kyis bgyis pa dge legs 'phel/ /sarba maṅga lo// // 453

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (25)thugs sgrub drag po rtsal gyi las byang dngos grub yongs 'du'i gter mdzod bzhugs/na maḥsarba dza ya sa ma sa pad+mā ka rā ya/ tshe yi g.yung drung lcags srog rtsar 'khyil 'od dpag med pa chos kyi sku/ /'gro la rjes brtse'i snying stobs mchogo mnga' phyag na pad dkar longs spyod rdzogs/ /si rtse'i dngas mtshor pad+ma las 'khrungs rgya gar paṇa chen sprul pa'i sku/ /sku gsum dbyer med rgyal kun 'dus pas byang chub bar du bdag rjes bzung / /brtul zhugs spyod pa'i rnam rol gar dgu'i nyams/ /dpal chen khrag 'thung lus kyi dkyil 'khor du/ /sgrub sdo brgyad rdzogs rdo rje drag po rtsal/ /kun go gcig chod zla med gtan gyi skyabs/ /gang gi 'phrin las tshig nyung don gsal ba/ /rnam dpyod gsher gyis bskyed pa'i zab gter don/ /snying por dril ba'i sa bon dar drag las/ /'dod pa'i re skong yongasa'adu'i ljon 'di bskrun/ /de la 'dir thugs sgrub drag po rtsal gyi 'phrin las 'bring po'i dgongs don la gzhi byas te nyams 'a 'jug pa bde ba'i ched du bkod par sngon 'gro la/ dang po skyabs 'gro sems bskyed kyi gzer ni/ thugs rje'i dbang gis 'gro don mdzad/ /bla ma rnams(2na 'a skyabs su mchi/ /mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la skyabs su mchi/ /sngon nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib bshags/ /'gro don sangs rgyas thob bya'i phyir/ /smon pa byang chub sems bskyed do/ /sems can yongs su smin bya'i phyir/ /gsang sngags spyod pa rlabs chen spyad/ /don dam spros bral byang chub sems/ /rang byung mtha' bral stong gsal bsgom/ /lan gsum brjod/gnyis pa tshogs gsog pa maṇ+ḍal gyi gzer la gsum las dang po phyi'i maṇ+ḍal ni/ nor 'dzin lhun po ri phran nyi zla mtsho/ /gling bzhi gling phran mu khyud lha dang mi'i/ /'dod yon dang bcas dkon cog gsum la 'bul/ /tshogs rdzogs rang byung ye shes myur rtogs shog /nang gi yul mkhar longs spyod —454

thugs sgrub drag po rtsal gyi la byang dngos grub yongs 'du'i gter mdzod/ nang ma 9)byams pa'i mdza' grogs sogs/ /bdag gi 'jig rten 'di yi gces pa kun/ /bla mar 'bul gyi nyon mongs 'dzin pa'i yul/ /dag pa ye shes rang gnas bstan du gsol/ /gsang ba'i/ bdag (2ba)gi rnam shes dbang po tsho gos brgyad dang / /sgyu lus phyi nang drin can bla ma la/ /'bul lo la ma gyi 'khrul snang kun dag nas/ /rang rig ye shes rtogs par mdzad du gsol/ /gsum pa sgrib sbyong bshags pa'i gzer ni/ spyi bor gdan steng a las rdor sems dkar/ /rdo rje dril 'dzin sems pa'i skyil krung mdzad/ /thugs ka'i mdangs ldan a las bdud rtsi'i rgyun/ /babs pas phyi nang lus bkrusadag par gyur/ /yig brgya grangs skabs sbyar brjod/ / bzhi pa mi rtag pa bskul 'debs kyi gzer ni/ snod kyi 'jig rten ma lus mthar 'jig cing / /rigs drug bcud kyi sems can skye rga dang / /na 'chi 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal legs bsams nas/ /mi rtag snang tshul thun du bcad nas bsgom/ /lnga pa byin rlabs 'jug pa bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi gzer ni/ dus gsum sangs rgyas rnamasalas rang nyid la/ /smin grol gdams pa ston pa'i bla ma nyid/ /bka' drin che phyir gsang sngags lam gyi gnad/ /zab mo bla ma'i rnal 'byor bsgom par bya/ /spyi bor sum rtsegs gdan dang dar chen khri/ /brtsegs steng mthing nag gu ru drag po rtsal/ /rdor dril 'dzin zhing dur khrod mas brgyad rdzogs/ /zab chen ber gsol gar dgu'i nyams kyis bzhugs/ /dus gsum rgyal ba yi dam bla ma'i tshogs/ /'od zhu ma hā gu ru'i sku la thim/ /kun 'dus bla mar phyag 'tshal mchod pa 'bul/ /sku gsung thugs kyi dngosagrub stsal du gsol/ /ā+oṃ āḥsnyi/ rgyal ba dgongs brgyud rigs 'dzin brda brgyud dang / /gang zag snyan brgyud rtsa ba'i bla (3na〉pa la/ /snying nas gsol ba 'debs so thugs rjes gzigs/ /thugs dam dbyings nas bskul lo byin gyis rlobs/ /yi dam mkha' 'gro chos dang de'i srung ma/ /mched lcam rdo rje'i spun grogs bcas pa la/ /snying nas kho/ /thugs dmar/ /de ltar dngos dang brgyud pa'i bla ma la/ /'gyur med gdung shugs drag pos gsol 'debs na/ /rang rib/ ma bcos bla ma'i ngo bo —455

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (25)du/ /da lta nyid du rtogs par byin gyis rlobs/ /ā+oṃ āḥ& ma hā gu ru sarba sirnyi hūṃ/ 'di snang sgyu mar go zhing 'khor ba la/ /nges par yid 'byung rgyal ba'i gsung rab thos/ /kun gyi rtsa ba gnyis 'dzin du shes kyang / /nyen mongs bag chags dbang du shas cher shor/ /chags zhen 'dod sred las ga rtsad bcad nas/ /gnyis 'dzin sgrog las grol bar byin gyis sgro bos/ /ā+oṃ āḥ& ma hā gu ru sarba sirnyi hūṃ/ma bcos rang la gdod nas lhun grub pa'i/ /rang byung rig pa gzhug ma lhan cig skyes/ /ma' du gyur nas mar gyur 'gro ba rnams/ /kun bzang sal 'god pa'i mthu ldan shog /lha'i dkyil 'khor sgom pa ni/ bdag nyid kyis hūṃ hūṃ zhes brjod pas skad cig dran rdzogs su ma hā gu ru pad+ma 'byung gnas rdo rje drag po rtsal zhes bya ba/ sku 'jigs pa'i cha lugs su bstan pa/ gsung rngam pa'i nga ro sgrog pa/ thugs drag po'i ngar dang ldan pa/ 'gying bag dang rol pa'i stang stabs su bzhugs pa/ phyag g.yas gnam lcags kyi rdo rje rtse dgu pa nam mkha' la 'phyar ba/ g.yon pa gser gyi dril bu dku la brten pa/ (3ba)rus pa'i rgyan drug dang rin po che'i dbu rgyan dang / sbrul gyi gdu bus brgyan pa/ khro gtum brjid pa'i gar dgu dang ldan pa/ spyan gsum nyi zla 'khyil ba ltar gzigs pa/ tshems gangs ri gtams pa ltar bsad pa/ ag tshom dus mtha'i me ltar 'bar ba/ zhal nasa3 gi sgra 'brug ltar sgrog pa/ za 'og gi ber smug po dang / dur khrod kyi chas brgyad kyis brgyan pa/ dbu skra'i thor tshugs rus pas brgyan pa/zhabs gnyis stang stabs su bgrad de nyi zla pad+ma'i steng du raka srin po pho mo brdzis pa'i gdan la bzhugs pa/ par spel//bdud dang dam sri rdul du rlog/bcol ba'i 'phrin las sgrub par mdzod//ho mtho ni/hūṃ/sngon tshe gas༅sna sus ga kyang rdzo/bskal ba dang po 'og min du//bcom ldan dpal chen he ru ka pa yis//snang srid ma tsho gos dam la btags pa'i tshe/khro mo sidha sgo ma bzhi sogs kyis//so so'i gzugs bstan bka' yi gtor ma len//bcol ba'i las kun bsgrub sogs khas blangs pa//dus 'ar ma g.yel gtor ma 'di bzhes la//zhi rgyas dbang drug 'phrin las thams cad sgrubs//bskal pa bar ma bal yul yang shod du//pad+mā kā ra shākya de wa yis//rdo rje dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor zhal phye nas//bdun cu rtsa lnga'i mgon po dam btags tshe//so so'i gzugs bstan sko /bcol ba'i las kun sko4//rdo 'dir ma g.yel ra /zhi rgyas dbang drags//

thugs sgrub drag po rtsal gyi las byang dngos grub yongs 'du'i gter mdzod/ nang ma yonabaskal pa tha ma bsam yas mchims phu sa/slob dpon chen po rje 'bangs grogs dgu yis//bka' brgyad lha yi dkyil 'khor zhal phye nas//dregs pa sdebargyad dam la btags pa'i tshe//so so'i gzugs bstan bka' yi gtor ma len//bcol ba'i las kun bsgrub sogs khas blangs pa//dus 'dir ma g.yel gtor ma 'di bzhes la//zhi rgyas dbang drag 'phrin las10na ) thams cad sgrubs//de nasabastan ma skyong ba ni/hūṃ/a su ra yi brag phug tu//phyon pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi//spyan sngar khas blangasadam bcas pa'i//bod yul bstan ma bcu gnyis dang /pung thul la zhing bcu sgrol/sa sgrub par mdzod//dngos grub bskul ba ni//phyogs bzhi'i dbus nas dngos grub bskul ba'i lha//rdo rje rat+na pad+ma na dze dang //budha thod 'phreng rtsal lnga rang rtags kyi//sku mdog phyag mtshan na bza' rgyan 'phreng 'tsher//mched lnga'i rgyud bskul bdag cag rgyu sbyor gyi//nad gdon kun zhi tshe dang bsod nams rgyas//mthun rkyen dbang sdus gnod byed dgra bgegs sgrol//thams cad lhun gyis grub pa'i dngos grub zhu//ā+oṃ āḥ& badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sirnyi hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ/na na kha : sirnyi hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ/sarba sirnyi dha rna me dhi hrīḥ.ā yuḥsirnyi sa ma ya sdus sdus/zhes lan gsum brjod/lhag chad kha bkang /dkyil 'khor bsdub ni/snod bcud ma lus yi ge hūṃ du gyur/hūṃ yang 'ja' ltar dmigs med stong pa'i tswa //rang nyid mahā gu ru drag po rtsal//'jigs med rdo rje 'bar ba'i sku ru gyur//smon lam ni/sangs rgyas kun 'dus rdo rje drag po rtsal//'phrin las gzhung bzhin nyams su blangs pa'i mthus//sde10ba〉rgyad 'tshub lhongs mthu byang nad gdon rims//geg sridagra bgegs bar chod zhi bar shog /bskal par 'tshob srog gi rgya mdud thebs//dpal 'byor mnga' thang rnam thos bu la 'gran//chos dang srid kyi legs tshogs ma lus pa//'bad rtsol med par bla nas blar 'phel shog/skye ba kun tu pad+ma thod 'phreng gis//rjes bzung rnga yab dpal ri'i pho brang du//theg mchog chos la spyad nas 'gro ba kun//'dren pa'i ded dpon li por 'gyur bar shog/shis brjod ni/ shes bya'i don la ma rmongaX pa'i/ /bla ma dam pa'i bkra shis shog /gang la

rgya dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()bsams pa de 'grub pa'i//don 'grub mchog gi bkra shis shog/sku gsung thugs kyi bha ga nas//phyag rgya chen po'i bkra shis shog/gzhan yang shis brjod ci rigs bya'o//mchog dang thun mong dngos grub ma lus pa//'bad med stsol ba rigs 'dzin bla ma yi//dkyil 'khor gcig tu zhi khro kun 'dus pa//yid bzhin dbang gi rgyal po gnyis pa bzhin//'phrin las tshig gi spros par ma 'chol zhing //don kun chad pa med par legs tshang ba//dngos grub yongs 'du'i gter mdzod yi ge mā/bkod la mkha' 'gro gter srung bzod par gsol//bsod nams byas 'bras thog med nas bsags pa'i//rnam dkar dge tsho gos rnams dang chabs cig tu//nam mkha'i mtha' bsnyeg ma rgan sems can rnams//rang rig kun bzang rang ngo 'phrod rgyur bsngo//zhes thugs sgrub drag po rtsal gyi las byang sngon 'gro gzer lnga dang bcas cha tshang la 11na〉khyer bde ba dngos grub yongs 'du'i gter mdzod 'di ni lha sras sprul par lung gis zin pa sa skyong grong smad pa sangs rgyas rgya mtshos sprel zla nas bzung yar ngo'i tshes bcu byung ngo cog gi mchod pa'i nyams len du dgos tshul ltar za hor gyi bzhes lcags sprel sag zla ba'i dmar cha'i gral tshes dge bar po ta lar sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni thar rgyas pa blo bzang dbang pho//sarba maṅga lo// 466

thugs sgrub drag po rtsal gyi la byang dngos grub yongs 'du'i gter mdzod/ nang ma zhanathugs sgrub kyi las byang nor bu'i cod pan zhes bya ba bzhugs/na mo gu ru we/ phul byung zag bral bde chen mkha' klong dbyings su rtag rol 'gyur ba med pa chos kyi sku de las/ /zhi dang khro sogs 'khor lo'i mgon po longs spyod rdzogs sku'i gar gyis rnam rol rdo rje drag po rtsal/ /bsil ldan ljongs 'dir bka' drin zla med stsol mdzad ye nas gdod ma'i sangs rgyas pad+ma saṃ bha wa/ /sku gsum dbyer med ngang du rol kyang skal ldan smin mdzad rtsa brgyud bla ma'i zhabs pad spyi bos bsten/ /ngo mtshar gnas su rgya yis legs spras pa'i/ /yid bzhin nor lta'i thugs sgrub zab mo'i lam/ /thog mar sgo 'byed dngos grub rgyal mtshan nas/ /gsang chen chosa'adi'i 'phrin las sgo brgya pa/ /spel mdzad pad+mas byin brlabs rigs 'dzin tshogs/ khyad par gdul bya'i don du kun bzang mgon/ /dka' spyad grub pa mchog brnyes rigs 'dzin rje'i/ /rnam rol drin can bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud/ /gang zhig yi dam chos srung rgya mtsho la/ /mchod bstod sgrub la sngon du med mi rung / /dngos grub kun gyi gter gyur bla ma mchog /nyer bsgrub 'phrin las rta ljang dbang po 'dis/ /gangs ldan phan bde'i pad tshal bshad pa dang / /rdo rje theg pa'i legs bshad rgya mtsho'i gling / /phun tshogs (2na khog 'a ston spel phyir 'dri byed na/ /mthu ldan gter srung dus 'dir gnang ba stsol/ /skyabs 'gro ni/ bdag sogs 'gro kun byang chub ma thob bar/ /mchog gsum kun la skyabasa'agro dus gsum dges/ /rang byung rig pa rang shar chos kyi sku/ /yang dag snying pa myur du rtogs par shog /phyi'i maṇ+ḍal/ nor 'dzin lhun po ri phran nyi zla mtsho/ /gling bzhi gling phran mu khyud lha dang mi'i/ /'dod yon dang bcas dkane cog gsum la 'bul/ /tshogs rdzogs rang byung ye shes myur rdzogs shog /nang gi /yul mkhar longs spyod byams pa'i mdza' grogs so gos/ /bdag gi 'jig rten 'di yi gces pa kun/ /bla mar 'bul gyi nyon mongs 'dzin pa'i yul/ /dag pa ye shes rang gnas bstan du gsol/ /gsang 467

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (25)ba'i/ bdag gi rnam shes dbang po tshogs brgyad dang / /sgyu lus phyi nang drin can bla ma la/ /'bul lo lam gyi 'phrul snang kun dag nas/ /rang rig ye shes rtogs par mdzad du gsol/ / rdor sems sgom bzlas ni/ spyi bor gdan steng āḥlas rdor sems dkar/ /rdo rje dril 'dzin sems dpa'i skyil krung mdzad/ /thugs ga'i mdangs ldan āḥlas bdud rtsi'i rgyun/ /babs pas phyi nang lus bkrus (2ba)dag par gyur/ /yig brgya grangs skabs sbyar brjod/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor ni/ spyi bor sum brtsegs gdan dang dar chen khri/ /brtsegs steng mthing nag gu ru drag po rtsal/ /rdor dril 'dzin cing dur khrod chas brgyad rdzogs/ /thab chen ber gsol gar dgu'i nyams kyis bzhugs/ /dus gsum rgyal ba yi dam bla ma'i tshogs/ /'od zhu ma hā gu ru'i sku la thim/ /kun khrus bla mar phyag 'tshal mchode pa 'bul/ /sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /ā+oṃ āX// rgyal ba dgongs brgyud rigs 'dzin brda' brgyud dang / /gang zag snyan brgyud rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ /snying nas gsol ba 'debs so thugs rjesagazigs/ /thugs dam dbyings nas bskul lo byin gyis rlomes/ /yi dam mkha' 'gro cho ge dang de'i srung mar/ /mched lcam rdo rje'i skrun grogs bcas pa la/ /snying nas ra/ /thugs dam mo/ /de ltar dngosadang brgyud pa'i bla ma la/ /'gyur med gdung shugs drag pos gsol 'debs na/ /rang rig ma bcos bla ma'i ngo bo sa /da lta nyid du rtogs par byin gyis rlobs/ /ā+oṃ āḥ/ ma hā gu ru sarba sirnyi hūṃ/ 'di snang sgyu mar go zhing 'khor ba la/ /nges par yid 'gyur rgyal ba'i gsung rab thos/ /kun gyi rtsa ba gnyis 'dzin du shes kyang / /nyon mongs bag chags dbang du shas cher shor/ /chags zhen 'dod sred las ༅ rtsar bcad nas/ /gnyis 'dzin sgrog las grol bar byin gyis rlomes/ /ā+oṃ āḥ/ ma hā gu ru sarba sirnyi hūṃ/ ma bcos rang la gdod nas lhun grub pa'i/ /rang byung rig pa gnyug ma lhan cig skyes/ /mngon du gyur nas mar gyur 'grob rnams/ /kun bzang sal 'god pa'i mthu ldan shog /rgyal chen mtshamasagacod ni/ hūṃ hūṃ/ pad+ma nyi zla raka srin po yi/ /gdan steng skad cig nga las bdag (3na snyad ni/ /rdo rje drag rtsal khams gsum dbang sdud cing / /srid gsum zil gyis gnon pa nyid du gyur/ /hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ —468

thugs sgrub drag po rtsal gyi las byang dngos grub yongs 'du'i gter mdzod/ nang ma 6)hūṃ hūṃ/ ā+oṃ āḥ/ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sirnyi hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ/ na na ba : sirnyi sarba sirnyi dha rna me dhi hriḥ ā yuḥsirnyi sam ya sdus sdus/ thugs ka las byung dkar ser dmar ljang hūṃ/ /yongs gyur rgyal chen sdo bzhi 'khor bcas rnams/ /gtor ma 'di bzhes phyogs kyi gdon srungs la/ /mthun pa'i rkyen rnams yid bzhin grub par mdzod/ /nang mtshams gcod pa ni/ hūṃ/ phyi nang snod bcud snang ba thams cad kun/ /rang rig sems las byung ba'i cho snyul te/ /sems nyid ngo bo gzhi rtsa bral ba'i ngang / /de ltar rtogs na bgegs rnams rang sar grol/ /gsang mtshams ni/ hūṃ/ de nyid ngang las skad cig drag po rtsal/ /bskal pa'i me 'bar rdo rje'i tsha tsha 'phro/ /'jig rten thams cad rab tu ldeg cing zhabrug /bdud dang dam sri bgegs rigs brlag par byed/ sgrib sbyong bshags dkyil/ ting 'dzin gdung ba'i mos pasamadun gyi mkhar/ /thogs med byon pa'i rtsa gsum spyan snga sa /dug lnga'i dbang gis bsags pa'i sdig sgrib kun/ /zol med snying gi dkyil nas mthol lo bshags/ /byin dbab thugs dkyil/ sdig sgrib rnam dag phung por lha rnams kun/ /dgyes shing stong gsum gang 'od bdag thim pas/ /yi dam lhar gyur thugs gsung sku'i dngos grub/ /rab thob mchog thun dngos grub byin chen phobs/ /mchod gtor byin rlabs/ bdag nyid lhar gsal ngang nas 'od 'phros pas/ /sman rag gtor gsum phyi nang mchod pa yi/ /mi gtsang nyes pa'i skyon kun rab sbyangs nas/ /zag med bdud rtsi'i ro ldan ngo bor gyur/ /hūṃ ā+oṃ swā e hā hril/ ā+oṃ badz+ra ya ka kro ta hūṃ phaṭa/ ā+oṃ āḥlha/ rak+ta maṇ+ḍal hūṃ/ (3btos dhū pu ā ga hūṃ/ de ting / sems kyi sna tsho gis snang 'di ye shes te/ /snang ba'i dus na ngo bo stong pa'i ngang / /chos kyi dbyingasanyid spros dang bral bar gnas/ /dbyer med byang chub sems ni bde ba che/kun ting / ma rtogs zhabrul pa'i 'gro la snying rje che/ /byams pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi rang rig 'od/ kha dog lnga ldan gsal 'tsher dngasapa la/ /ngo bo bde ba'i snying rje wo por gyur/ rgyu'i ting / 'od lnga 'dus pa'i hūṃ sngon rab 'bar ba/ /snang stong dbyer med ngang du gsal bar shar/ /skar chen thang la phebs pa'i tshul bzhin du/ /gos bu rgyu yi yi ge hūṃ du gyur/ /dkyil 'khor dngos/ gangs las thigs pa babs ltar hūṃ yig las/ /hūṃ lnga 469

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()rab 'phros hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ//de las 'od los 'og bzhi'i dkyil 'khor lnga//brtsegs steng rgyu yig wo las lha 'phros pas//snod kyi rten dang bdag phung gzhal yas khang //tsit+ta rin cen pho brang rtsa'i ka gdung //ban+ta'i rtsig pa nang khrol dra bar ldan//tsho gos brgyad gzer bto mig gnyis nyi zla yi//mthongs khung steng 'og rgyu lam bzhi ni sgo//byang chub sems las kun 'byung gzhal yas khang /khyu yi yi ge 'od los bos pa las//pad nyi zla gdan srin po ru dra'i steng //rdo rje drag rtsal mthing nag rab khros pa//g.yas pa gnam lcags rdo rje gser dril g.yon//dkur brten zab chen ber gsol rin wo rgyan/ /dur khrod mas rdzogs brjid pa'i gar dgur ldan/ /sa gnyis gyad kyi 'gying bag stabs bzhugs sku'i//spyi bo sgo brag gi rtsa gnas/klad pa dung khang gi rtsa 'khor/mgrin pos spyod kyi rtsa 'khor/snying ga 76'tsha stse rtsa 'dab/lteb dang ge'i lo khrus༅ rtsa 'dab/gsang gnas la de ོ 'a ci lo/rtsa chen rtsa༅ sto gi we lo/rnams la rim pa bzhin/dmar po 4 rdza tshig44na mi 4na/tshe dpag med sku nag pochatho bas40mdzad/'jam dpal dmar nag pad+ma sa mdzub mdzad/pad+ma gsung /mthing nag rdo rje dung dmar lon/rdo rje thugs yon smug nag rdo rje dril bu lon/bdud rtsi mthing nag rdo rje dung dmar won/tshe mchog dang /mthing nagaphyagaXblo phur bu sto/mkha' 'gro 'bum sde'i lha tsho gis dang bcas rdzogs//sku ni rdo rje khros pa'i sku gsung thugs/ /rigs lngas dbang bskur phyag mtshan khro rdo rje la yab dang dril bu la yum/bcu rdzogs/ /zhabs gnyis brkyang bskum ru dra brdzis pa la//phyogs skyong sdebargyad dregs pa'i srog rtsa 'dus/spyan 'dren ni/hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ/sngon gyi bskal pa'i dang po la/zhes pa nas/byin gyis brlab phyir gshegs su gsol//hūṃ/dha na ko sha'i mtsho gling du//drag po'i brtul zhugs mdzad pa'i tshe//sangs rgyas rnams kyis dbang bskur mdzad//mkha' 'gro thams cad dbang du bsdus//rdo rje phag mo yum dang rol//lha srin sdebargyad bran du 'khol/ /bdud dang log 'dren thams cad bsgral/ /gsang mas rdo rje drag po rtsal/ /rdo rje srin po'i lha tsho gos rnams//gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol//lhun grub bde ba chen po'i pho brang nas//dus gsum sangs rgyas pad+ma thod phreX /la//rigs 'dzin dba' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs

thugs sgrub drag po rtsal gyi las byang dngos grub yongs 'du'i gter mdzod/ nang ma 6)dang bcas/ /thogs med thugs rje'i dbang gis gshegs su gsol/ / hūṃ/ ma g.yel ma g.yelartsagasum dkyil 'khor tshogs/ /bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i lha tshogs rnams/ /kun 'dus bla ma rdo rje drag po rtsal/ /gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs shing bzhugs su gsol/ /bzhengs shig pad+ma 'byung gnas nas/ /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /phyag mchod ni/ rigs(4ba 'dzin grub pa'i dbang phyug pad+ma 'byung / /lnga brgya'i gtsug rgyan dpal ldan mar me mdzad/ /rdo rje 'chang dbang blo bzang grags pa'i dpal/ /sna tsho gos sprul pa'i gar mdzad de la 'dud/ /phyi nang gsang gsum bsgral mchod ni/ /rtsa gsum spyan sngar mchod yon me tog spos/ /mar me dri chab zhal zas rol mo bshams/ /dbang lnga tshil chen zhun chen dri chen chu/ /rkang gling thod pa'i rnga sgra brjid bag ldan/ /dug gsum sku gsum dug lnga ye shes lnga/ /snang srid phyag rgya bzhin mchod yab yum mkha'i/ /byang sems dkar dmar dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i sha /phyi nang gsang ba bsgral ba'i mchod pa ste/ /phyi yi mchod pa sa dang bar snang gang / /nang gi mchod pa zag med bdud rtsi'i mtsho/ /gsang ba bde chen smra bsam brjod las 'das/ /'gro ba'i don phyir dgyes bzhi bzhes su gsol/ / sman mchod ni/ rang byung gdod nas rnam par dag /rtsa ba brgyad dang yan lag stong / /bdud rtsi sman gyi mchod pa 'di/ /bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro dang / /dam can chos skyong rnams la 'bul/ /rak+ta ni/ bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro la/ /zhing bcu rgyud drug bsgral ba'i khrag /gsang ba yum gyi rak+ta 'di/ /'dod chags rtsad nas bcad phyir 'bul/ /skye med don gyi mar pa bzhes gtore ma ni/ bla ma mchog gi mchod par sbyar ba 'di/ /ye shes lnga yi 'od zer rnam par 'phro/ /'dod pa'i yon tan lnga yis rab brgyan te/ /thugs dam bzhin du ci bder bzhes su gsol/ /rtags bstod ni/ dur khrod 'jigs dbus chags med thabs shes gdan/ /dregs srin steng du 'jigasabyed drag po rtsal/ /mthing nag spyan bgrad mche gtsigs dbu skra 'bar/ /sna tshogs rgyan spras rdo rje dril bu 'dzin/ /gar dgu'i nyams ldan ber smug na bza' gsol/ /rus pa'i rgyan dug rtags kyisamadzes par brgyan/ /bde gshegs gsang gsum kun 'dus mkha' (5na 'gro'i gtso/ /rdo rje drag po —47/—

sirnyi hūṃ/zhi khro dbang dang dngos grub blang ba yi//bzla tshul man ngag phyag len ltar bya ste//hūṃ/chos ci/dbyings kyi pho brang /rang byung rnam dag cha khas/lcang lo can rnamasanas//kun bzang he bdun dang bcas pa 'og ma kun la sbyor/ bgrod dka' mtsho gling ma la ya'i rtse mo sogs/ gnas mchog/dam pa so so nas/smug nag dbang gi rā gi tshangs pa'i yo po gdong gtso/lha dang brgya byin/klu yi/'jog po dza/sa po/'gro don bskur bgos mo/bdag kyang ྾//〉〉〉〉〉〉〉〉 za sto yul yang le shod/chu bo gaṅgā'i rtsa ba/maṇ+ḍal sogs rgya gar gnas rnams nas/shākya pra bha rigasa'adzin wo po pad khrung bi mā la mi ldem/rje//'gro don sko//bdag kyang ྾//lhamadze〉〉〉〉mor//rdo rje mgon dang byams pa bshes gnyen dpal//ngag dbang grags pa sangs rgyas dpal bzang zhabs/ /dzer rin ma mkha' rgyal mtshan sngags 'chang shākya bzang / /bdud 'joms rdo rje mkha' 'gro yongs grub rtsal mo sko/ /bstan pa'i rgyal mas rje bas rdo rje 'dzin/ /bka' drin sum ldan zil gnon drag rtsal rje/ /skor mo/ā+o med snying ga 'i pho brang
