thugs sgrub drag po rtsal gyi las byang dngos grub yongs 'du'i gter mdzod/ nang ma 6)dang sa mong dngos grub stsal du gsol//hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ/don bstod ni/hūṃ/skye 'gag med pa chos i dbyings kyi ngang //'du stsol med pa bde r+ṣa pho brang nas//rang byung rang gsal thugs rje wo po'i sku//bde gshegs kun 'dus rdo rje drag po rtsal//rang rig lha yi lha la phyag 'tshal lo//gsal 'grib med pa bde ba chen po'i sku//rang rig rang gdangs ma 'gags gsal ba la//rtsol grub bral bas bya byed gol sa cho de//ma bcos rang shar 'dzin med spros dang bral//rig pa rang gsal ngang la phyag 'tshal lo//rig pa'i cho 'phrul cir yang snang ba la//rgya chad phyogs lhung med pas tshil pa bral/khor snang 'dzin med grol bas bde ba che//gsal 'tsher dngas pa skyon bral rig pa'i gdangs//longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo//'byung ba bzhi la brten pa'i phung po la//bcings thumasardugs pa med par phyogs brgyar 'char//gang shar rtag chad bral bas zangs thal la//'khrul snang rang sos mi bto rang sor bzhag/rang byung sprul pa'i sku la phyag la'i lo//rig pa dngos 'dzin kha dog ma grub pas//snang stong phyogs lhung ye nas bral ba la//ma 'gags gsal 'tsher dngas pa chos nyid dang //rang rig ngo bo ma bcos thod phreng rtsal//rang rig bla ma'i mardzo la 6na ) phyag 'tshal lo//de ltar tshogs dang ga kho srung mchod pa la sogs pa rnams ni/thugs sgrub dang /rdo rje 'chang dpal 'byor lhun grub kyis mdzad pa'i yig cha dang /kha skongs kyi yi ge gzhan dag la gsal bas 'dir ma spros/zil gnon las byang r+ṣa mo dang zung du sbrel te nyams su len pa la 'di tsam 'byer bde zhing /mjug chog kyang shugs las 'byung ba yin no//'di nyid kyang zil gnon las byang ltar bka' rgya dam zhing /gter srung bka' gnyan pas/dbang ma thob pa dang bka' rgya ma khrol pa la ston pa dang nyamasasu len pa ni rang gzhan gnyis ka la bar chad du 'gyur bas gsang zhing sba bar bya'o//smras pa/gang zhig ljongs 'dir bstan la legs zhugs pa//la la g.yin ngo tsam du dul bar ston//'ga' zhig khungasamed dpe hrul phan 0 bsre/ /dregs ldan thos bsam bral ba dam par rlom/ kha cig mthon po'i khri dang rigs tsam bsnyen/ /mang zhig rtog ge'i // pa 'ga' shes pas/ /sngon chad mthong thos med

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (25)la'ang bshad pa byed/ /'brel med rang bzo'i tshig dang 'di mi 'dra/ /'di ni rab stims rgyal ba'i spyi gzugs mchag /mtsho skyes thugs sgrub kun gyi yang snying bcud/ /skal bzang nyams su blangs pasatshe gcig la/ /sku gsum go 'phang thob pa'i lag rjes mang / /de phyir thugs sgrub don kun khrus pa la/ /rnam mang tshig gi skrun pas ma rnyogs pa'i/ /las byang yid bzhin nor bu 'di lta bu/ /gzhan du byed po yod na thal mo sbyor/ /de ltar rnam par dge ba'i wo byed dbang / /zab don chos kyi 'od stong 'bar ba yis/ /bdud rigs nag po'i phyogs rnams rab bcoms nas/ /nges don nyin mo'i snang ba rgyasapar shog /ces thugs sgrub kyi las byang nor bu'i cod pan zhes bya ba 'di yang / rje btsun dam (6ba)pa rgyal ba pu ce su ga ra'i dgongs gzhi sogs dgos pa du ma mthong bas bsgrig pa'i 'dun pa ma rga du gyur pa dang / don gnyer can mang pos nye bar bskul ba la brten nas shākya'i btsun pa zil gnon drag rtsal du 'bod pas rang lo nyer drug pa gro zhun can gyi dpa' bo mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i tshes bzang po la dga' ldan pho brang du sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni ngag dbang dge legs so/ /bka' srung brgyad kyi gtor ma so sor ram mdor bsdus 'byer bde byed pa phyag len ltar skabs thob dang sbyar te bshams la/ hūṃ/ kun bzang thugs sprul sangs rgyas kun gyi yum/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis kha ṭ+wāṃ bhan+ta thogs/ /smug nag sprin dkar 'ja' yi mtha' can gyon/ /e ka dzā ṭi ral gcig gshegs su gsol/ /dur khrod brgyad dbus ma mo ro kha ma/ /nam gru tsa murnyi gsum sko/ /nyi ma byang phyogs gnas nas re ma tī/ /ma gcig dpal ldan gnas 'dir sko/ /dmar nag pad+ma khros pa'i dur khrod nas/ /dbang gi ma mo mched bdun rki/ /ri lung thang dmar zangs mkhar dmar po nas/ /sgrol ging chen po btsan rgod ra/ /steng phyogs nam mkha' 'od kyi gzhal yas nas/ /legs ldan chen po gnas 'dir〉/ /snying nye bga' nyan gter bdag gshog rgod rtsal/ /dam can rdo rje legs par〉/ /dri za'i rgyal po rdo rje 'bar ba rtsal/ /sngon gyi dam tshig dgongs la sko/ kha ba can gyi yul bdag srung ma che/ /bstan ma bcu gnyis 'khor bcas sko/ /ba po bzang ri bo'i gnas nas nye ba'i dpang / /ri de'i —474

thugs sgrub drag po rtsal gyi las byang dngos grub yongs 'du'i gter mdzod/ nang ma 6)phyogs bzhir lha bdud btsan klu yi/ /dge bsnyen khrom pa skyes bzhi mtshams bzhi nas/ /klu sras bu le dkar po rgyal thang dkar/ /klu btsan skrun gsum rno myur nag po sogs/ /gter srung 'khor bcasaganas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ /ā+oṃ badz+ra trag raka e ka dzā smi ma (7na)ma ra smo tra tra tra ga /ma hā ya ka nag mo/ pad+ma ḍā gi ni ya ma shu tri/ ma hā kwa la/ badz+ra swā dhu/ badz+ra thang ka ra/ ma ma/ kha kha/ la la/ le le/ta ta/ te te/ dha rma pā la sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra sa ma ya dzaḥ de nas mchod 'bul ni/ hūṃ/ bka' srung 'khor dang bcas pa'i spyan lam du/ rak+ta gsur chen dud pa tshel chen sgron/ sha rus zhal zas thod rnga rol mo'i sgra/ /dam rdzas gtor ma bdud rtsi a mṛ ta/ /dri za'i rgyal po bsgos dang g.ya' gangs chu/ /sposadakar dud pa rin cen rnam pa lnga/ /dar dang za 'og gos dkar gtsang ma dang / /gsang lug la sogs rang rang mthun pa'i rdzas/ /klu rnams dkar gsum bdud rtsi rin cen lnga/ /klu sman la sogasarang rang dgyes pa yi/ /'dod pa'i longs spyod tshogs rnams rab 'bul gyi/ /dga' bder spyod la mthun pa'i las rnams sgrubs/ /gong gi sngags gsham du sa pa ri wā ra'i mthug tu/ ma hā pañtsa a skṛ ta kha kha/ khā hi khā hi/ ma hā bha li ta kha kha/ 'a hi 'a hi/ bstod pa ni/ bka' srung sde brgyad mched zla bran g.yog rnams/ /rgyal ba'i bstan dang rnal 'byor ma g.yel srung / khyad par gsang sngags zab mo'i chos 'di skyongs/ /log par 'dren pa'i dam nyams dgra bo la/ /bar bskrad rengs rmonges rdzu la sna tshogasaston/ /bod khams ru bzhi nad 'khrug nyer 'tshe las/ /skyobs la gnas chen byin brlabs zab gter srung / /mdor na bcol ba'i las kun sgrub par mdzad/ /ces rdo rje drag po rtsal gyi gter srung rnams la mchod gtor 'bul tshul mdor bsdus 'di yang / med du mi rung ba'i phyir thugs sgrub cha lag tu bkod pa'o/ /rtsa gsum lha la gus btud nas/ /bod yul bstan dang 'gro ba yi/ /phan bde rgyas shing sa spyod kyi/ /cho me srid yun du gnas pa la/ /pad+mas zhal bzhes mi bslu phyir/ /thugs(7ba tshe sgrub mjug gi bya ba kun/ /bri la gter srung gdug can gyis/ /skabs phye snod min rnams la gsongs/ /las byang nor —475

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()bu'i phreng ba'i kha skongs//dus kyi mchod pa'i skabs gzhan du yang rung ba'i gsol 'debs dang tshogasaganyis las/gsol 'debs thun drug tu byed pa ni gzhan du shes la/dkyus gcig tu gtong ba'i dbang du byas na/ā+oṃ āḥlha badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sirnyi hūṃ/gsol ba 'debs pa'i rten bskyed pa ni/rang lus 'dzin med spyi bo yi//pad+ma nyi zla'i gdan steng du//dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi//thugs kyi sprul pa'i rigs 'dzin na//pad+ma 'byung gnas rgyal ba'i sku//sku mdog dkar dmar skyil krung mdzad//gzhen nu lo brgyad lon pa'i tshul//sngags pa'i cha lugs mthing nag gos//rab byung cha lugs chosagos dmar//rgyal po'i cha byad zab ber gsol//phyag g.yas rdo rje thugs kar 'dzin//g.yon pa mnyam gzhag /pā la//dbu la pad+ma'i gnyen zhu gsol//sna tsho gis rin cen rgyan gyis mdzes//bkrag dang gzi mdangs ldan pa la//rtsa brgyud bla ma yi dam lha//mkha' 'gro chos skyong gter bdag tshogos//ma lus 'khor gyis bskor bar bsam//ye shes pa spyan drang ba ni/hūṃ/phyon yul gyi nub byang mtshams//pad+ma ge sar sdong po la//ya mtshan mchoge gi dngos grub brnyes//pad+ma 'byung gnas zhes su grags//'khor du mkha' 'gro mang pos bskor/khyed kyi rjes su bdag sgrub gyis//byin gyis brlab phyir gshegs su gsol//mchod pa 'bul ba ni/hūṃ/me rta ge bdug spos mar me dang //lha bgos dri chab mchod par bshams//bla bre rgyal mtshan na bza' dang //ba dan gdugasadang rol tsho lis//rin po che dang me rta ge dang //gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya dang //chos dang mdangasachen byang chub sems//mchod sprin bsam gyis mi khyab pa//ni thab brgyud pa'i bla ma dang //yi dam zhi khro'i lha tsho gis dang //cho me bdag dpa 'bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs//dam can chos skyong rnams la 'bul//sku gsung thugs kyi dngos lha grub stsol//de nas gsol 'debs le'u bdun pa dkyus bzhin byed//brgyud 'debs ni/bde byu chos sku'i ngo bo 'od dpag med//longs spyod rdzogs sku'i rnam rol pad dkar can//grangs med sprul pa'i zlos gar pad+ma 'byung //nam mkha'i snying po 'tsho rgyal khri srong lde//rdo rje bdud 'joms mu khri btsan po la//gsol ba 'debs so thugs rje'i spyan gyis gzigs//476

thugs sgrub drag po rtsal gyi las byang dngo grub yongs 'du'i gter mdzod/ nang ma 6)tshul 'di'i sgo 'byed gter ston bzang bo grags//bka' babs dngos grub rgyal mas rdo rje dpal// byams pa bshes gnyen burnya shrī'i zhabs//mes ston nam mkha'i mtshan can shākya bzang //bdud sde'i dpung 'joms rdo rje 'dzin pa la//gsol bar//snga 'gyur srog shing che mchog 'dus pa rtsal//rdo rje bdud 'joms sprul pa'i zlos gar can//theg mchog chos kyi rgyal po rig sngags 'chang //kun bzang sgyu phrul dra ba'i rol gar can//'khon ston dpal 'byor lhun grub 'khor lo'i mgon//gsol ba྾//ru lag grom pa rgya dang yon po lung //gting zab sgrom bur mi ma' phyag rgya yi//rgyas bcingasagasang ba zab mo gter gyi chos//dpal ldan lha mo dge bsnyen nor bu bzang //gter gnas srung mar bcas pa tsho gos rnams la//gsol bza//mchog thun dngos grub ma lus 'byung ba'i gnas//tshig don yang zab gsol 'debs tshangs pa'i dbyangs/khres ldan g.yel ba med par nyams len na//thugs rje nus pa'i mthu dpung bskyed du gsol//zhes pa spros bral chos dbyings ma'i skabs su 'osapar bya zhing / /skyon rjes 'jug 'khor ba spong 'dod rnams/ /dad gus mos pas rgyun du gsol ba thob//rtsegacig gdung ba'i dbyangs ni 'di lta ste/khye'u pha mar 'bod wa'i gdungs dbyangs la//pi wang gling bu'i gdangs ltar snyan pa yis//nyin mtshan dus drug rnams su gsol ba thob//ces gsungs sngon gyi thugs dam zhal bzhes bzhin//bskul phyir gdung shugs drag pos gsol 'debs bar//kye ma thugs rjes gzigs shig ma hā gu sa/byin gyis rlomes shig rje btsun thod phreng rtsal//bar chad kun sol bdun bdul drag po rtsal//dngos grub mchog stsol skyon si po che//da lta rtsod dus lnga brgya'i snyigs dus 'dir//'byung pos rgyud dkrugs skye bos log par 'tshe//mtha' yi dam gdapung nad mtshon mu ge sogs/khyur dang ltas gnod pa kun zhi zhing //rgyal ba'i bstan dang khyad par theg dgu'i srol//de 'dzin tshogs rnams dar smin rgyas gyur cig/phun tshogs bsam yas lhun grub pho brang nas//pad+ma 'byung gnas lam bzang mchog ston pa//theg chen rgyal srid rin cen bdun ldan chos//skal ldan las can dag pa rnam lnga'i 'khor//'od dkar rgyal gyiX gang ba'i bkra shis dus//deng 'dir bsam pa lhun

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()grub bkra shis shog/don bstod kyi rjes su tsho gos ni/bdag gi thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od los pas//tshogs kyi gnyis na rnam rtog kun sbyangs nas//rin 'a yangs pa'i snod du bdud rtsi'i tswa//'dod yon lnga yi mar bas tso par gyur//zhes byin sa sa 'di rdo rje slob dpon k+ṣe sa bya/de nas rol modang bcas te/hūm̐/4 stims dag pa'i rang snang gzhal yas nas//mahā gu ru rdo rje drag po rtsal//sgrub chen bka' brgyad lha yi 'khor lo'i tshogs//'gying bag gar gyi rnam 'gyur shigs se shig/'jigs rung gsung gi nga ro ldir ri ri//thugs rje nus mthu'i byin sa thibs rtse thib//gnas 'dir brtser dgongs tshogs kyi mchod pa la/ /9na logs med rdzu phral ldan pas gshegs su gsol/ /'bul ba ni//rtsa ba gsum gyi dkyil 'khor lha tsho gos la//sman raka gtor ma sha sna dbang po lnga//gza' dang bca' ba btung ba'i bye brag sogs//so sor dgyes pa'i ji snyed mchod pa'i tshogs//bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho wo por byin brlabs 'dis//rtsa brgyud bla ma thugs dam stong gyur cig/bka' brgyad lha tshogs thugs dam mo//chos srung gter bdag thugs dmar//bshags pa ni/mchog dang thun mong dngos grub gaṅgā'i rgyun//zhes sogs gnam lcags 'khor lo ltar ro//gdab pa ni/hūṃ las pho nya khro bo'i tsho gos spros pas//thar med 'brub khung lcags mkhar 'bar ba'i nang //dgra dang bgegs kyi dmigs rten liṅga la//skar mda' 'phangs pa bzhin du 'dir khug cig/badz+ra 'gu sha dzabadz+ra pā sha hūṃ/badz+ra spro ṭa baṃ/badz+ra ghaṇ+ḍa sngo/gnam lcags gru gsum 'bar ba'i phur bu yis//snying gar btab pasamar me bsad ltar gyur//dur tri a mo gha tri ga nan myags/ dza mā ra ya rbad/rnam shes phur rtser blangs nas thugs kar bsdu//gnam lcags ral gris sha khrag rab gtubs nas//rdo rje drag rtsal 'khor dang bcas la 'bul//rgyal ba'i bstan pa bsrung phyir bzhes su gsol//ma hā me sa/ma hā rak+ta/ma hā tsit+ta/ma hā bha su ta/ma hā go ro tsa na/ma hā kai ni ri ti khā hi/tsho gos la rol rjes/slob dpon mched dang lcam dral tsho gos rnams kyis//rdo sdu me sa gsol bas rdor sems ltar//sku tshe lang

thugs sgrub drag po rtsal gyi las byang dngos grub yongs 'du'i gter mdzod/ nang ma 6)tsho rgyas pa'i mnga' brnyes shog /dza gad dpa' bos 'gro ba dbang sdud cing / /zhal zas ro brgya'i zas la longs spyad pas/ /zhi dang khro bo'i dbang rnams thob par shog /ces pa yang rdo rje slob dpon tsam gyis byed do/ /lhag ma ni/ hūṃ/ sngon tshe khrag mthung he ru ga'i/ /spyan sngar khas blangs dam bcas dang / /bar (9ba)du pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi/ spyan sngar khas blangs dam bcas dang / /da lta rigs 'dzin bdag nyid kyi/ /bran dang pho nyar khas blangs pa'i/ /sgrub sdebargyad kyi bka' srung dang / /gsang sngags theg pa'i bka' srung rnams/ /bka' yi pham phabs 'di bzhes la/ /sngon gyi dam tshig dran par gyis/ /gsang sngags bstan pa rgyas par mdzod/ /bdud dang dam sri rdul du rlog /chad mtho bstan skyong ni/ sngon tshe bskal pa dang po 'og min du/ /bcom ldan dpal chen he ru ka dpal gyis/ /snang srid ma tshogs dam la btags pa'i tshe/ khro mo bzhi dang sgo ma bzhi sogs kyis/ /so so'i gzugs bstan bka' yi gtor ma blangs/ /bcol ba'i las kun bsgrub sogs khas blangs pa/ /dus 'dir ma g.yel gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /zhi rgyas dbang drag phrin las thams cad sgrubs/ /bskal pa bar ma bal yul yang shod du/ /pad+ma kā ra shākya de wa yis/ /rdo rje dbyings kyi dkyil 'bor zhal phye nas/ /bdun cu rtsa lnga'i mgon po dam btags tshe/ /so so'i gzugs bstan mo/ /bcol ba'i las kun mo/ /dus 'dir ma g.yel mo/ /zhi rgyas dbang drag rki/ /bskal pa tha ma bsam yas mchims phu mā /slob dpon chen po rje 'bangs grogs dgu yis/ /bka' brgyad lha yi dkyil 'khor zhal phye nas/ /dregs pa sdebargyad dam la btags pa'i tshe/ /sgo so'i gzugs bstan mo/ /bcol ba'i las kun mo/ /dus 'dir ma g.yel྾/ /zhi rgyas dbang drag za/ /pad+ma thod 'phreng spyan sngar srog snying kun/ /phul te dam bcas bstan ma bcu gnyis po/ /gtor ma 'di long gnod byed dgra bgegs thul/ /bcol ba'i 'phrin las ma lusabasgrub par mdzod/ /dngos grub bskul ba ni/ phyogs bzhin bus nas dngos grub bskul ba'i lha/ /rdo rje rat+na pad+ma ga me dang / /burnya thod phreng rtsal lnga rang rtags kyi/ /sku (10na〉dog phyag mtshan na bza' rgyan 'phreng 'tsher/ /mched lnga'i rgyud bskul bdag cag rgyu sbyor gyi/ /nad gdon kun zhi tshe dang bsod —479—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo su bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ rtonanams rgyas//mthun rkyen dbang sdus gnod byed dgra bgegs sgrol//thams cad lhun gyis grub pa'i dngos grub zhu//ā+oṃ āḥ& badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sirnyi hūṃ/dkyil 'khor bsdu ba ni/snod bcud ma lus yi ge hūṃ du gyur//hūṃ yang 'ja' ltar dmigs med stong pa'i ngang //rang nyid ma hā gu ru drag po rtsal//'jigasamed rdo rje 'bar ba'i sku ru gyur//smon lam shis brjod gnam lcags 'khor lo ltar ro//de ltar thugs sgrub mjug chog 'di yang sngon du bgyis pa'i las byang cha lag tshang ba'i ched tsam du ma zad dus kyi bskal ba dang bstun pa'i dgos pa'i tshogs du ma mthong ste zil gnon drag rtsal gyis shing sprel spre'u zla ba'i tshes bcur sbyar//sarba maṅga lo////rig 'dzin gdung sgrub kyi 'phrin las klag chog mthong ba don ldan du bkod pa bzhugs//rgyal kun gsang ba rab 'byams ra lo'i mgon//mtsho skyes rdo rje'i thugs rje'i 'od zer gyis//gangs can skye dgu'i bsod nams pad+ma'i tshal//rab rgyas phan bde'i sbrang rtsir spyod gyur cig/zab gter bstan pa rgyas mdzad rgod ldem can//bdud sde'i g.yul las rgyal ba'i mnga' risapa//pad+ma'i rnam sprul bkra shis stobs kyi rgyal//rig 'dzin brgyud pa'i tsho gis kun spyi bor bsten/khyad par kun bzang che mchog he ru ka/bshes gnyen gar gyis rol ba rdo rje 'dzin//bkakha drin mnyam med pad+ma badz+ra zhabs//'bral med snying gi ze'u 'brur rtag tu rol//rig 'dzin rgyal ba ma lus 'dus pa'i gdung //tshul bzhin sgrub pa'i rim pa lha brag gter//mthong ba don dang ldan pa'i las byang 'di//skal bzang sngags 'chang tshogs kyi don du bri//de la 'dir rig 'dzin gdung sgrub kyi 'phrin las rig 'dzin brgyud pa'i phyag bzhes ltar khrigs chags su bkod pa ni/dpal rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo//nang gtor ma la brten te bla ma mchoX ༷'i 'phrin las bya ba niḥganas dben par maṇ+ḍal

rig 'dzin gdung sgrubakyi 'phrin las gla/ chog mthong ba don ldan du bkod pa/ nang ma zhanapad+ma bcu drug dang ldan pa sgo rgyan rdzogs par briḥ gtor snod yangs shing gtsang ba'i nang du gtor ma rin (2na)bo che 'bar ba bca'aḥ dkar gsum gyis brgyan mngar gsum gyi bcud 'dza' gad dpa' ba rak+ta bla re 'phan gdugasaḥ rol mo rnams bsag go ཿdang po skyabs 'gro sems bskyed niḥ bdag dang khams gsum sems can kunaḥ log pa'i lam las bzlog nas kyang ཿ dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gra nyon mongs dbang gyur sdug bsngal lasaḥ thar par bya phyir sems bskyed doḥbadag gi spyi bo nam mkha'i khamasaḥ nyi zla pad+ma'i gdan steng duḥ bla ma bkrag dang gzi mdangs ldan mdzes pa'i na bza' sku la gsolaḥ zhal 'dzum mdangs dang ldan par bsamaḥ shar phyogs mdun gyi nam mkha' laḥ shākya seng ge la sogs pa'aḥ yi dam lha tsho gos thams cad kunaḥ kha dog lngar gsal rnam dag bsamaḥ sto phyogs bde bar gshegs pa'i gsung ཿ glegs bam yi ge'i rnam pa laḥ dam chos ma lus 'dus par bsamaḥ nub phyogs byang chub sems dpa'i tshogasaḥ rigs gsum mgon po byams pa dang ༷ 'gro don mdzad pa thams cad bsamaḥ byang phyogs dam chos skyong ba yiḥ chos skyong mkha' 'gro dam can rnamasaḥ bka' nyan las byed pho nyar bsamaḥ 'og tu rigs drug sems can rnamasaḥ snying rje'i sems kyis kun bsdus nasaḥ las la 'gyod pa'i sems skyed bsamaḥ (2bgyi gcig gus pas skyabs 'gro bya/ kye maḥ khams gsum 'khor bar stims pa'i sems can kunaḥ bla med dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su mchiḥ ma rig mun pas bsgribs pa'i las ngan sbyangs: dag pa ye shes rang gnas bstan du gsolaḥ bdag dang 'gro drug sems can thams cad la: byang chub ma thob bar du thugs rjes gzigasaḥ yon tan kun 'byung dngos grub mchog gi gnasaḥ bla ma rin po che la skyabs su mas gang la gang 'dul 'gro drug don mdzad pa'iḥ yi dam lha tsho gos rnams la skyabs su mchaḥ sangs rgyas gsung las sprul pa'i yi ger byonaḥ nyon mongs 'joms mdzad chos la skyabs su mchiḥthugs rje chen pos 'gro don stobs chen mdzad byang chub sems dpa'i tsho gis la skyabs su mchiḥ gdul bya'i don du drag po'i skur ston paḥ chos skyong dam can rnams la skyabs su mchiḥ bdag gis dus 481—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho/ gsung 'bum/ (25)gsum bsags pa'i dge ba yisaḥ 'gro ba ma lus byang chub thob par shog: rang byung rig pa rang shar chos kyi skuḥ yang dag snying po myur du rtogs par shogaḥ bdag ni dus 'di nas bzung tshe rabs su:'gro ba 'dren pa'i ded dpon byed par shogaḥ phyi'i maṇ+ḍal ni/ na moḥ dbang chen gzhal yas dbus kyi lte ba laḥ ri rgyal lhun po brjid cing 'gying bag ldan: gser gyi ri bdun rol pa'i mtsho bdun rnams:gnyen lhag sra brtan rin chen rtsig par bltams: gling bzhi gling phran brgyad kyis phyogs mtshamasabaskoraḥ lha dang mi yi 'dod yon rgyan gyis gang ཿ nyi zla'i 'od kyis 'jig rten mun pa selaḥ lcags ri mu khyud mtha' nas legs par bskoraḥ phyi ltar snod kyi 'jig rten snang ba 'di bla med dkon mchog gsum la gus pas 'bulaḥ bdag gzhan bsod nams ye shes tsho gos rdzogs(3na skosaḥ yang dag snying po myur du rtogs par shogaḥ nang gi maṇ+ḍal ni/ na moḥ 'jig rten las kyis 'dus pa'i bar do sabadag lus shin tu gces par bzung ba yiḥ yul mkhar longs spyod 'dod pa'i ra bar bcasaḥ byams pa'i pha ma 'dza' ba'i grogs dang niḥ bu dang bu mo gces pa'i 'khor gyis bskoraḥ zas nor gos dang longs spyod rgyan dang ldanaḥ bkrag mdangs mdzes pa'i kha dog rang 'od bcasaḥ 'dzin pa'i semasakyis gces par bzung ba yiḥ bdag gi 'jig rten 'di yi gces pa kunaḥ gu ru rat+na sprul pa'i sku la 'bulaḥ bdag gi nyon mongs 'dzin pa'i yul dag nas: dag pa ye shes rang gnas bstan du gsol:gsang ba'i maṇ+ḍal ni/ hūṃ/ bdag lus khrung bzhi 'dus pa pho brang duḥ sems kyi rten gnas tsit+ta 'bar ba laḥ dbang po sgo lnga'i rten gyis mtha' rten byas: rnam shes tshogos brgyad 'khor sa rab tu brgyan: sha khrag rus pa nang khrol sna tsho gos ldan: mig gnyis dngas pa'i 'od kyis mun pa bselaḥbadag lus longs spyod rgyal po'i sgyu lus 'ad: nges pa'i don ston bla ma nyid la 'bul: bdag gi lam gyi 'khrul snang kun dag nasaḥ rang rig ye shes rtogs par mdzad du gsolaḥ rang gi sgyu lus bem po 'diḥ spyi gtsug pad+ma nyi zla'i steng ཿ āḥlas rdo rje sems dpa' nyidaḥ dung mdog zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa: rin chen rgyan gyis mdzes par brgyan: phyag g.yas rdo rje thugs kar 'dzinaḥ g.yon pa dril bu dku —482

rig 'dzin gdung sgrub kyi 'phrin las klag chog mthong ba don ldan du bkod pa/ nang ma 6)la brtenaḥ zhabs gnyis sems dpa'i skyil krung mdzadaḥ de yi thugs kar yi ge aḥ a las 'od 'phros mdangs dang ldanaḥ a las bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun babasaḥ bdag gi spyi gtsug rkang mthil b.raḥphyi nang (3ba)lus bkrus dag par bsam2 PROB badz+ra satwa sam ya/ ma nu pā la ya/ badz+ra satwa twe no pa — ḍi sgo me bha ba/ su to stso me bha ba/ a nu ra sto me bha ba/ su po stso me bha ba/ sarba sirnyi m+me pra yasmosarba mdze su tsa me/ tsit+ta shrī yaṃ ku ru hūṃ/ ha ha ha ha ho/ bha ga wan/ sarba ta thā ga ta/ badz+ra ma me muñtsabadzi bha wa ma hā sa ma ya sa tu a/ rang gi yul mkhar khang khyim dang ཿ sa rdo ri brag 'jig rten khamasaḥbartsigs dang gnas dang 'jig pa dang ཿ dus kyi 'pho 'gyur legs par bsamaḥ bar du rang gi dgra dang gnyenaḥ srog chags kun dang rang gi lusaḥ skye dang gson dang 'chi ba bsamaḥ tha ma 'khor ba rigs drug shoḥ sdug bsngal rim pa brtag cing bsamaḥ thun du bcad la mi rtag bsgomaḥ mi rtag mthong nas chos la 'jug: dus gsum bde gshegs thams cad kyiḥ thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don mdzad kyang ཿbdag ni 'khor ba'i gnas su 'khyamasaḥ da lta nges pa'i don ston pa'i: bla ma de ni sangs rgyas kyiḥsprul pa yin te bka' drin cheḥ dper na yid bzhin nor bu deḥ 'byung ba lnga yi bcud yin teḥ 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po la: rtsol ba med par grogs su 'byung ཿ rgyal po dgung du gshegs pa'i tsheḥ sardo gzhan gyis mi thub paraḥ 'byung ba lnga la zang thal duḥ gshegs te rgya mtsho chen po'i nang ཿ rin chen gser gyi sa gzhi laḥ nor bu rin chen chags par 'gyuraḥ de bzhin man ngag zab mo'i chosaḥ nges don ston pa'i bla ma deḥ sangs rgyas kun gyi sprul pa yinaḥ bdag la sangs rgyas kun las lhagaḥ las byung gang zag yod pa'i saraḥ rtsol ba med par 'byung bar 'gyuraḥ dad med log lta sdig spyod gnasaḥder ni bzhugs par mi 'gyur teḥ (4na skog pa'i zhing du gshegs par 'gyur/ gsang sngags ngesapa'i don 'dod ni: bla ma'i rnal 'byor bsgom par byaḥ bla ma'i rnal 'byor ni rang lus 'dzin med spyi bo yiḥ pad+ma nyi zla'i gdan steng duḥ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyiḥ thugs las sprul pa'i rig 'dzin niḥ pad+ma 'byung gnas rgyal ba'i skuḥ sku mdog dkar dmar skyil krung bzhugasaḥ gzhen nu lo —483—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()brgyad lon pa'i tshulaḥsngags pa'i cha lugs mthing nag gosaḥrab byung cha lugs chos gos dmar/rgyal po'i cha byad zab ber gsol:phyag g.yas rdo rje thugs gar 'dzinaḥgayon pa mnyam gzhag ka pā laḥdabu la pad+ma'i gnyen zhu gsol:sna tsho gos rin chen rgyan gyis brgyanaḥbakrag dang gzi mdangasaldan pa la:rtsa brgyud bla ma yi dam lhaḥmakha' 'gro dpa' bo dam can dang ཿchos skyong bka' srung gter bdag tshogasaḥm lus 'khor gyis bskor bar bsamaḥye shes pa spyan drang ba ni/hūṃ/u rgyan yul gyi nub byang mtshamasaḥpad+ma ge sar sdong po laḥya mtshan mchog gi dngos grub brnyesaḥpad+ma 'byung gnasazhes su gragasaḥ'akhor du mkha' 'gro mang pos bskoraḥkhyed kyi rjes su bdag bsgrub kyiḥbyin gyisarlob phyir gshegs su gsolaḥmachod pa 'bul ba ni/hūṃ/me tog bdug spos mar me dang ཿlha bskosadri chab mchod par bshamasaḥbla bre rgyal mtshan na bza' dang ཿba dan gdugs dang rol mo'i tshogasaḥrin po che dang me tog dang ཿgzugs sgra dri ro reg bya dang ཿchos dang mdangs chen byang chub semasaḥmachod sprin bsam gyis mi khyab pa:rtsa ba brgyud pa'i bla ma dang ཿyi dam zhi khro'i lha tsho gos dang ཿchosabadag dpa' 4ba〉bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogasaḥdam can chos skyong rnams la 'bulaḥsku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub stsol2zho āḥlha ma hā gu ru sarba sirnyi hūṃ/rang bzhin rnam dag chos kyi dbyings nyid lasaḥthig le nyag gcig chos kyi sku ru sharaḥrang byung ye shes 'od gsal chen po'i ngang ཿchos sku kun du bzang pos byin gyis sgro bosaḥthams cad rig pa byang chub sems kyi 'od:sku lnga gsal 'tsher bkrag dang gzi mdangs ldanaḥye shes rang snang lhun gyis grub pa poḥlongs sku rgyal ba rigs lngas byin gyisarlobs: thugs rje rgyun chad med pas thabs kyis bzhengasaḥ khams gsum sems can kun gyi mgon gyur pa srid gsum 'gro ba kun gyi gnyen gcig puḥgasang bdag sprul pa'i sku yis byin gyis zlo bosaḥXrang byung lhun grub rdzogs pa chen po'i ngang ཿdmigs gtad med par lta ba mkha' ltar dgaḥskye 'gag med pas 'dzin pa rang sar grolaḥdaga' rab rdo rje lta bas byin gyis rlobs:blo bral yangs pas ting 'dzin 'phel 'grib medaḥnyon mongs rlabs daX /la bas mi g.yo baḥdamigs med rang rig ngo bo

rig 'dzin gdung sgrub kyi 'phrin las klag chog mthong ba don ldan du bkod pa/ nang ma yodaye re gnasaḥ shrī sing ha sgom pas byin gyis rlobs: 'dzin chags med pas snang srid thams cad grolaḥthogs thug med pas ci la ya mi nga ཿ blang dor med pas rol pa chen po'i ngang ཿ rgyal po dza yi spyod pas byin gyis rlomesaḥ zag med spros bral thig le nyag gcig laḥ ye shes longs sku mtshan dpes rab brgyan cing ཿ 'khor 'das gnyis med rang rig sems la rdzogasaḥ in+d+ra bhū ti 'bras bus byin gyis rlobs mnyam nyid dgongs pa rnam par dag pa laḥ thams cad rang rig byang chub sems kyi ngang ཿye shes rang gsal 'gag pa med par gsalaḥ pad+ma 'byung gnas thugs (5na)rjes byin gyis rle bres:'khor 'das thams cad rig na sangs rgyas teḥ ma rig 'khrul pa'i rtsol ba bral nas sangasaḥ gser 'gyur rtsi ltar ye shes rang gnas mthong ཿ mkhas pa bi ma mi thos byin gyis rlomesaḥ thugs kyi rig 'dzin rdo rje sems dpa'i sras: nyi zla lta bur ma rig mun pa sel/ stong nyid snying rjes 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa'i slob dpon hūṃ chen snar sa byin mo: sku yi rig 'dzin rnam snang mdzad kyi srasaX ri rgyal lhun po lta bur gzi brjid cheḥ drag shul thabs kyis 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa'iḥ slob dpon 'jam dpal bshes gnyen gyis byinaḥ gsung gi rig 'dzin snang ba mtha' yas srasaḥ ka la ping ka lta bur sgra dbyangs snyanaḥ zhi ba byams pas 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa'i slob dpon nā ga rdzunas byin dzeḥ 'phrin las rig 'dzin rdo rje gzhen nu'i srasaḥ 'ja' tshon lta bu 'phrin las ma 'dres gsal las bzhi lhun gyis grub pas 'gro don mdzad slob dpon pra wa ha tis byin skoḥ dbyings dang rig pa dbyer med bde ba'i sras thabs kyi rang bzhin rtsa rlung rnam par dgaḥ shes rab rang bzhin mtshan ma spros dang bralaḥ dha na sang kṛ ta yis byin za ༷ 'chi med grub pa tshe dpag med kyi srasaḥ sa dang lam la sbyangasanas 'bras bu thobaḥ rang bzhin lhun gyis grub pa'i dgongs pa brnyesaḥ tshe dbang rig 'dzin chen posabyin nus pa thogs med phyag na rdo rje'i srasaḥ rdzu tshil stobs ldan sdebargyad bran du 'kholaḥ kun la dbang sgyur 'khor 'das sa la ler gzigasaḥ rom bu tsho ya tsa spros byin ra: drag sngags mngon gyur stobs ldan nag po'i srasaḥ mthu rtsal chen po gnam lcags thog ltar 'bebasaḥ zhing bcu tshar gcod 485

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (25)sgrol (5ba tshe pam thabs la mkhasaḥ slob dpon shan+ta nga gar+bhas byin gyis moḥ pad+ma 'byung gnas thugasarjes byin brlabs pa'aḥ rdo rje phag mo yum gyi sras mchog ste: rdo rje bdud 'joms sku yi sprul pa poḥsprul sku rig 'dzin chen pos snoḥ rgyal bas lung bstan mtshan dang dpe byad ldanaḥ sku gsung thugs dang yon tan 'phrin las kyisaḥ las can rnams la ye shes mngon sum stonaḥ rig 'dzin rnam rgyal mgon pos byin sko: gu rus lung bstan sbas pa'i tshul du byonaḥ gsang sngags thabs mkhas mjo zhe sum ye shes stonaḥ las can ma lus thar pa'i lam la 'drenaḥ dran mchog sangs rgyas dbon chen gyisaloḥ rgyal ba'i gdung 'dzin snyigs dus 'gro ba'i dpalaḥ las can rnams la gsang sngags snying po'i donaḥ cig car ston mdzad drin can sprul pa'i skuḥ mtshan ldan byams pa bshes gnyen gyis zoḥ dusagasum sangs rgyas 'phrin las gcig bsdus nas: 'gro ba'i don mdzad mngon sum don ston cing ཿkhams gsum sems can thar pa'i lam la 'drenaḥ drin can sangs rgyas dpal bzang gis byin gyis rlobasaḥ thugs rje'i bdag nyid u rgyan pad+ma yiḥ zhal gzigs mchog dang thun mong dngos grub brnyesaḥ'aphrin las drag pos gdul bya smin grol mdzadaḥ sngags 'chang chos rgyal bsod nams kyi moḥ thugs rje'i bdag lhad u rgyan pad+ma yiḥ bstan la rab zhugs nyams dang rtogs pa'i bdag: 'phrin las rnam bzhis 'gro ba'i don mdzad paḥ rig 'dzin sangs rgyas bstan pas moḥ u rgyan lung bstan gsang sngags chos kyi bdag raḥ bka' babs lung bzhin sbas yul gnas sgo phyeraḥ chos blon pad+ma gung btsan sprul pa'i sku: sngags 'chang shākya bzang pos byin gyis rlobasaḥ lung thob bka' babs bla ma'i gsung bzhin duḥ 'gro mang don du gnas phyin dka' spyad mdzadaḥ rgyal dbang pad+ma'i gdung gsob mnga' ris rjeḥ rig 'dzin legs ldan rdo rjes byin gyis rlomesaḥ sgo gsum gus pas bla ma (6na〉lbal med bstenaḥ u rgyan lung bstan gsang sngags chos kyi bdagaḥ bka' babs lung bstan bla ma'i thugs susamachogaḥ chos rgyal ma bla' mtshan gyis moḥ ljang lhar brag gi zab mo'i gter kha las drag sngags grub pa'i dbang por lung bstan cing ཿ rig 'dzin gong ma'i gdung gsob ngag gi dbang ཿ chos rgyal bstan —486

rig 'dzin gdung sgrub kyi 'phrin las klag chog mthong ba don ldan du bkod pa/ nang ma 6)pa'i rgyal mtshan gyis mo: dpal gyi mchims phur ngo mtshar rdzu 'phrul gyis: grub pa'i rtags bstan dzñā na ku mā ra bsams bzhin srid 'dir sprul pa'i zlos gar mkhanaḥ pad+ma dbang gi grong khyer gyis〉ཿbdud 'joms rdo rje chos rgyal dbang po'i rjes: mi lam tshul du zab gter gdams pa'i bka'aḥlegs gtad za hor sngags spyon drag po rtsalaḥ rig 'dzin gang shar ring grol gyis byin gyis rlobasaḥsku gsum brgyud pa'i bla ma dam pa rnamasaḥ chos kyi dbyings nas bdag la brtser dgongs nas: thugs brgyud rang grol mchog gi dngos grub stsolaḥ mi mthun rkyen dang bar chad bsal du gsolaḥ mthun pa'i lam sna cho gel drang du gsolaḥ mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsal du gsol: phyi'i mtshams mtho rgyal chen bzhi ru bskyed la bzhagaḥ dang po hūṃ zhes brjod pas stong nyid kyi ngang la thun gcig bzhagaḥ de nas yi dam lha'i nga rgyal dang ldan pas raṃ yaṃ kho/ ā+oṃ āḥlha zhes pas mchod gtor rnams byin gyis brlabs la 'di skad do/ hūm̐/ bdag nyid lha yi thugs ka nasaḥ dkar ser dmar ljang hūṃ chen bzhi 'phro 'dus 'od du zhu ba lasaḥ ye shes rgyal po bzhi ru gyur: zho dzñā na rā dza sa ma ye swāhā/hūṃ ri rgyal lhun po'i shar phyogs naḥ pho brang chen po spos ngad ldanaḥ zab cing rgya che gzi 'phags paḥrgyal po chen po yul 'khor srung : sku mdog (6ba)dkar po pi wang 'dzin: btsun mo sras dang blon por bcasaḥ 'khor ni dri za 'bum gyis bskoraḥ sdo bo che la stobs po cheḥ mchod gtor 'di bzhes shar phyogs kyiḥ gdon rnams zlog cing phyi mtshams srungasaḥ lha/ ri rgyal lhun po'i lho phyogs naḥ pho brang chen po be+e ḍūr+yaḥ zab cing rgya che gzi 'phags poḥ rgyal po chen po 'phags skyes poḥ sku mdog ser po ral gri 'dzinaḥ btsun mo sras dang blon por bcasaḥ 'khor ni grul bum 'bum gyi bskoraḥ sde bo che la stobs po cheḥ mchod gtor 'di bzhes lho phyogs kyiḥ gdon rnams zlog cing phyi mtshams srungasaḥhūṃ/ ri rgyal lhun po'i nub phyogs naḥ pho brang chen po rgya mtsho'i sna: zab cing rgya che gzi 'phags poḥ rgyal po chen po spyan mi bzang ཿ sku mdog dmar po sprul zhags 'dzinaḥ btsun mo sras dang blon por bcasaḥ'akhor ni klu dbang 'bum gyis bskor 〉 ཿ ste bo che la stobs po cheḥ mchod gtor 'di bzhes nub —487—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()phyogs kyiḥgadon rnams zlog cing phyi mtshams srungasaḥlha/ri rgyal lhun po'i byang phyogs naḥpho brang chen po lcang lo canaḥzab cing rgya che gzi 'phags paḥrgyal po chen po rnamathos sras sku mdog ljang bu rgyal mas 'dzinaḥ bas mo sras dang blon por bcasaḥ 'khor ni gnod sbyin 'bum gyis bskor sdo bo che la stobs po cheḥmachod gtor 'di bzhes byang phyogs kyi gdon rnams zlogacing phyi byusasrungasaḥlha/rgyal po wo po sdebazhi poḥdon gyis sangs rgyas yin mod kyang ཿgsang sngags bstan pa bsrung ba'i phyiraḥbar ho 'dul bar mdzad du gsol:zho lha khyu ༷ ye swā lha be ru ta /ye swā lha be rubhak+ṣa ye swāhā be+e shra ma ṇa ye swā lhanang gi mtshams gcad pa ni/hūṃ/stong gsum stong gi 'jig rten kunaḥsangs rgyas7na ) sprul pa'i sku yis gang ཿrig 'dzin bla ma'i rnal lor pasaḥsngon tshe dgra bgegs btul ba bzhinaḥpho nya mang po bkram nasakyang ཿsteng 'og phyogs mtshams mtsho ni chas gang ཿbdud dang dam sri bsgral bar byaḥgasang ba'i dkyil 'khor gto po 'diraḥbar chad byed pa'i 'byung po rnamasaḥm 'dug rang rang gnas su dengasaḥci ste bka' las 'das gyur na thal ba bzhin du rlag par byed/ā+oṃ badz+ra ma hā kro dha pad+ma kro dha shwa ra badz+ra gī li gī la ya ma hā ya ka ka la ྅ pa ba glu raṃ raṃ dz+wa raṃ hūṃ phaṭa/bshags pa bya ba ni/hūṃ/grub pa'i rig 'dzin thams cad dgongs su gsolaḥm rig 'khrul pa'i las kyi dbang gyur bas:rtsa ba yan lag dam tshig nyams pa dang ཿsgrub pa yun thung yi dam lha mi gsalaḥle lo gnyid rmugs g.yeng ba'i las kyis mnar rig 'dzin gdung gsob rnams kyi brgyud ma zinaḥbaka' las 'das pa'i spyod pa ci byas rnams:bla ma sku gsum brgyud pa'i spyan snga sashin tu gnong zhing 'gyod pas mthol zhing bshagasaḥbyin dbab pa ni/hūṃ/ye shes gzhal yasabaskyed pa rgya che yangasaḥseng ge glang chen khri bshams spangs re mthoḥnyi zla pad+ma'i gdan bshamasabarjid re cheḥye shes lha mchog sgrub pa 'du 'bral med ma mo mkha' 'gro mchod pas dam la 'duḥrdo rje slob dpon bkur bas byin rlabs che:chos skyong dam can bsten pas mas rtsal che ma g.yel ma g.yel rig 'dzin grub pa rnamasaḥdakyil 'khor /༷ 8pa'i rdzas la byin gyis rlobs rnal 'byor bdag

rig 'dzin gdung sgrub kyi 'phrin las klag chog mthong ba don ldan du bkod pa/ nang ma 6)la dbang dang dngos grub stsolaḥ sam ya sirnyi hūṃ lhaḥ de nas mchode pa byin gyis brlab pa ni/ raṃ yaṃ khaṃ ra bi sha bi brdzi badz+ra dzñā na tsakra maṇ+ḍal :: lha ā+oṃ swā e hā / lo me rgya taḥ sam ya sngo (7ba 〉 tham ya stoḥ dzaḥ/ baṃ rnya ṅgā āḥlha ma hā sarba pañtsa a skṛ ha hūṃ gyi tha2 chu ba smra ta te dz+wa ba kla ta bha te snu ya sam ye swāhā rak+ta sam sna man dha lhaḥ lha/ 'bru bcud stong las sbyar ba'i dza gad dang ཿ dam rdzas med du byung ba'i gtor ma dang ཿ r+sā mongs rgyud drug bsgral ba'i rak+ta dang ཿ thabs dang shes rab sbyar ba'i zla gam dang ཿ rtsa brgyad stong las sbyar ba'i bdud rtsi dang ཿ ma rig mun pa sel ba'i sgron me dang ཿrig 'dzin grub pa rnams kyi tshe mchog dang ཿ zhal zas sna tsho gos sbyar ba'i mchod pa rnams: bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro mchod pa dang ཿ dam tshig bskang ba'i rdzas su byin gyis brlabs2 PROB sarba ta thā ga ta pā tsa a ho su ka sam ya a ho de nas ting 'dzin rnam gsum bsgom pa ni/ hūṃ/ gzung 'dzin sprosadang bral ba lasaḥ zhen med shes pa rang sor gnasaḥ ma bcos rang dngas de bzhin nyidaḥ rang lugs bstan na chos kyi sku: zho ma hā shā n+ya tā dzñā na badz+ra swa bhā wa ad+ma ko3〉 lha/ de ltar gnas pa'i gsal gdangs naḥ rang bzhin 'od gsal ye shes lngaḥ so sor ma 'dres sal le mthong ཿ rang gsal longs spyod rdzogs pa'i skuḥ a dharma khyu tu tsak+ṣu maṇ+ḍal a/ hūṃ/ ma rig zhakhrul snang 'khor ba'i rgyuḥgazung 'dzin bltas las snying re rjeḥ 'gro ba rigs drug drang ba'i phyiraḥ thugs rjes sprul pa'i sku ru bzhengasaḥ / bo dhi tsit+ta badz+ra/ཿ lha/ 'jig rten yul snang 'byung ba lngaḥ steng 'og rim par chags pa niḥ e las nam mkha' mtha' dbus medaḥ shā las rlung gi dkyil 'khor g.yos: re las bskal pa'i me chen 'baraḥ lo las chu yi rgya mtsho 'khyilaḥ lha las sa 'bregs sa gzhi chags: lo las rin chen ri rab brjidaḥ e yaṃ raṃ baṃ / le/ hūṃ/ 'og gi 'byung ba lnga yi steng : : las ye shes gzhal (srin)yas khang ཿ rnam dag 'od lnga'i pho brang mdzes: lhun grub rin po che yi dkyil: : bhi sha bi shud+dhi rat+na dzñā na pad+ma maṇ+ḍal du/ hūṃ/ dbus na pad+ma 'dab ma bzhiḥ phyi rim pad+ma 'dab brgyad bskoraḥ ku bzhi sgo bzhi rtsig pa lngaḥ 'dod yon pha gu dra ba dang : dra phyed mda' yab rta babs dang ཿ chos kyi 'khor lo 489

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (25)gdugs dang togaḥ rdo rje ra ba me ris bskoraḥ rin chen pho brang gsal bar bsgomaḥ rat+na maṇ+ḍal :ཿlha bskyed pa ni/ hūṃ/ dkyil 'khor dbus kyi lte ba laḥ pad+ma nyi zla'i gdan steng duḥ dus gsum sangasargyas thams cad kyiḥ thugs kyi sprul pa'i rig 'dzin niḥ pad+ma 'byung gnas rgyal ba'i sku: sku mdog dkar dmar skyil krung mdzadaḥ gzhen nu lo brgyad lon pa'i tshulaḥ sngags pa'i cha lugs mthing nag gosaḥ rab byung cha byad chos gos dmar: rgyal po'i cha byad zab ber gsolaḥ phyag g.yas rdo rje thugasadar 'dzinaḥ g.yon pa mnyam gzhag ka pā laḥ dbu la pad+ma'i gnyen zhu gselaḥ sna tsho gis rin chen rgyan gyis mdzesaḥ bkrag mdangs gzi mdangs ldan par bskyedaḥ rig 'dzin pad+ma 'byung gnas kyiḥspyi gtsug pad+ma 'dab bzhi yiḥ dbus su 'od lnga'i thig le laḥ 'ja' tshon sna lnga'i gur khyim can:dbus su nyi zla'i gdan steng duḥ mgon po 'od mi 'gyur ba'i skuḥ mthing kha mtshan dang dpe byad ldanaḥskyil krung mnyam gzhag phyag rgya can: rin chen sna gas rgyan gyis mdzesaḥ kun bzang yum dang gnyis su medaḥ g.yas su sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang ཿ mthing kha rdo rje dril bu bsnamasaḥ bdag med ma dang gnyis su medaḥ rin chen rgyan mdzes skyil krung bzhugasaḥ g.yon na rnam par snang mdzad mthing ཿ'khor lo rtsibs brgyad dril bu bsnamasaḥ dbyings(8ba'i ga yum dang gnyis su medaḥ shar gyi thig le dkar po'i steng ཿ rdo rje sems dpa' sku mdog dkar: rdo rje rtse lnga dril bu bsnamasaḥ sangs rgyasaspyan dang gnyis su med: lho phyogs thig le ser po'i steng ཿ rin chen 'byung ldan sku mdog seraḥ rin chen 'bar ba dril bu bsnamasaḥ mā ma zhi dang gnyis su medaḥ nub phyogs thig le dmar po'i steng ཿsnang ba mtha' yas sku mdog dmaraḥ pad+ma 'dab brgyad dril bu bsnams: gos dkar yum dang gnyis su medaḥ byang phyogs thig le ljang gu'i steng ཿ don yod grub pa sku mdog ljang ཿ rdo rje rgya gram dril bu bsnamasaḥ sgrol ma yum dang ga lhas su med: thams cad rin chen rgyan dang ldan: skyil krung nyi zla'i gdan la bzhugs de yi phyogs bzhin pad+ma'i steng ཿ nyi zla pad+ma'i gdan steng duḥ shar du dga' rab rdo rje dkar rdo rje dril bu thugs kar bsnams: sprul sku'i na bza' chos gos gsol: rgyal ba —490

rig 'dzin gdung sgrub kyi 'phrin las klag chog mthong ba don ldan du bkod pa/ nang ma 6)rigs lngas dbu la brgyan: zhabs gnyis skyil krung mdzad de bzhugs: lho ru 'phags pa 'jam dpal niḥ dmar ser ral gri yal bsnamasaḥ nub tu 'phags pa spyan ras gzigasaḥ dkar bo pad+ma'i phreng ba bsnamasaḥ byang du phyag na rdo rje ljang ཿrdo rje rtse lnga dril bu bsnams: thams cad rin chen rgyan dang ldan mos shing dad pas bsgom par byaḥ gtso bo'i shar phyogs pad+ma'i steng ཿ nyi ma zla ba'i gdan steng duḥ sprul sku skal ldan rgyal po dzaḥ zab chen ljang dmar sku la gsolaḥ phyag gnyis thugasaskar glegs bam 'dzinaḥ dbu la dar dang rin chen brgyan: sku mdog dkar po skyil krung mdzadaḥ brjid ldan rgyal po'i sku ru bskyed: lho phyogs pad+ma nyi zla'i steng : rgyal sras(9na/mi spro bhū ti na dkar po zab ber sbrags ma gsolaḥ dbu la dar lnga'i thod dang ldanaḥ phyag na bdud rtsi'i bum pa bsnamasaḥzhabs gnyis skyil krung mdzad pa bskyedaḥ nub phyogs pad+ma nyi zla'i steng ཿ rig 'dzin shrī sing ha ni:phyag gnyis mnyam gzhag phyag rgya canaḥ dbu la gnyen zhu mdzes pas brgyanaḥ sku la dbang gi cho sgo gosagasolaḥ thugs rje can gyi sku ru bskyedaḥ byang phyogs pad+ma nyi zla'i steng : mkhas pa bi ma mi tra na: phyag gnyis mnyam gzhag bum pa 'dzinaḥ sku la gnyen zhu chos gos gsolaḥ ā tsarla yi cha byad canaḥ zhabs gnyis skyil krung mdzad pa bskyedaḥ de yi phyi rim 'dab brgyad laḥ pad+ma nyi zla'i gdan steng duḥ sprul pa'i rig 'dzin chen po brgyadaḥ thams cad sku mdog dkar po laḥ sprul sku'i cha byad chos gos gsol:dbu la mdzes pa'i gnyen zhu gsolaḥ zhabs gnyen skyil krung mdzad pa bskyedaḥ shar du rig 'dzin hūṃ ka raḥrdo rje sems dpa' gsang gos naḥ dung mdog phyag rgya'i phu dung can: thugs kar rdo rje dril bu bsnams: lho ru 'jam dpal bshes gnyen ni: gshin rje gshed po gsang ba'i gosaḥ mthing nag phyag rgya'i phu dung can: be con phyar nas sdigs mdzub mdzadaḥ nub tu nā gwa rdzun niḥ pad+ma dbang gi gsang ba'i gos/ dmar smug phyag rgya'i phu dung can/ gseg shang bdud rtsi'i lhung bzed bsnams:byang du pra ba ha ti naḥ 'phrin las phur pa'i gsang gos naḥ ljang nag phyag rgya'i phu dung canaḥ rdo rje rgya gram po ti bsnamasaḥ shar lhor dha na saṃ kṛ taḥ dbyings dang rig pa'i gsang gos na: smug nag phyag —49/—

sogasaḥrig 'dzin thams cad bskyed cing bsgomaḥdakyil 'khor de yi bar khyams laḥdam tshig dbang gi slob dpon dang ཿman ngag lung gi slob dpon dang ཿshes sa rgyud kyi slob dpon dang ཿnyams chags skong ba'i slob dpon dang ཿmkha' 'gro rigs lnga dpa 'bo lngaḥrigs bzhi ging bzhi bskyed par byaḥdakyil 'khor de yi sgo bzhi sa ta spring bzhi dang sgo ma bzhi phyi rba rgyal chen sdebazhi bskyedaḥde nas raḥlongs spyod rdzogs sku'i yi ge lnga rtswa hūṃ / 〉āḥye shes lnga yis dbang bskur roḥsprul sku'i yi ge lnga bcu yisaḥsna tshogs don byed dbang bskur roḥka kha ga gha nga /tsa tsha dza dzha nya/ṭa ṭha laḥlha/sngon gyi bskal pa dang po laḥkun gzhi ma bcos ye sangs rgyasaḥye shes lnga yi 'od dang ldanaḥthog ma'i sangs rgyas 'od mi 'gyuraḥrigs bdag chen po rdo rje 'chang ཿrgyal ba rigs lnga yab yum dang :lhun gyis grub pa'i rig 'dzin rnamasaḥ'og min chos dbyings pho brang nasaḥganasa'adir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsolaḥlha/yul4 ḍi ming ni dga' ldan brtsegasaḥthugs rje'i dbang

rig 'dzin gdung sgrub kyi wen las klag chog mthong ba don ldan du bkod pa/ nang ma 6)gis sku bzhengs pa 'aḥ'aphags pa 'jam dpal spyan ras gzigasaḥgasang ba'i bdag po rdo rje won:rig won wo po rdo rje chosaḥsprul sku dga' rab rdo rje laḥlha dang klu dang gnod sbyin dang ཿmi yi rig 'dzin 'khor dang bcasaḥphyag rgya chen po'i rig 'dzin rnamasaḥganas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsolaḥ lha/ yul gyi ming ni za hor yul: 'dzam gling shar lho'i phyogs mtshams suḥshākya thub pa'i rgyal tshab mchogaḥgasang ba'i bdag pos byin brlabs pa'iḥmatshan ma bdun thob lung bstan mthong ཿ glegs bam po ti'i char pa babasaḥ de phyir skal ldan rgyal po dzaḥ bstan pa mtha' rgyas man sangs rgyasaḥ bdag kyang khyed kyi gdung gsob kyiḥ byin gyis brlab phyir gshegs su gsol lha/sprul sku rgyal po de yi srasaḥ'ajig rten khams la mnga' mdzad pa'iḥmakha' 'gro sde lnga'i dbang bskur bsaḥrgyal bu in+d+ra bhū ti zhes/bstan pa'i mnga' bdag 'gro ba'i mgonaḥrig 'dzin rgyal ba'i zhing dugashegasaḥbadag kyang khyed kyi gdung gsong kyi byin gyi brlab phyir gshegs su gsolaḥhūṃ/10bsgol gyi ming ni rgya gar yulaḥbhu ta'i pho brang dgu rim duḥchos rnams kun gyi snying po'i don ma lus thugs su chud pa yiḥrig 'dzin chen po sprul pa'i skuḥshrī sing ha zhes su gragasaḥskye shi med pa'i dngos grub thobaḥgashegs ni chos kyi dbyings su gshegs:bdag kyang khyed kyi gdung gsob kyi byin gyis brlab phyir gshegs su gsol lha/yul gyi ming ni u rgyan yulaḥsis rgya mtsho'i mtsho gling du dpal chen khrag 'thung thugs kyi srasaḥ yab dang yum med brda yis byonaḥ pad+ma 'byung gnas zhes su gragasaḥ'ajig rten thams cad 'od kyis bkang ཿsprul pa bye ba phrag brgya 'gyedaḥ'achi med tshe yi rig 'dzin mchog ༷bdag kyang khyed kyi gdung gsong kyiḥbyin gyis brlab phyir gshegs su gsolaḥ//yul gyi ming ni rgya gar yulaḥrdo rje gdan gyi pho brang duḥphyi nang theg pa ma lus pa'iḥchosarnams thams cad thugs su chudaḥmakhas pa chen por yongs su gyuraḥbi ma mi tra zhes su gragasaḥ'achi med tshe yi rig 'dzin thobaḥ sangs rgyas stong gi 'phrin las mdzadaḥ bdag kyang khyed kyi gdung gsob kyi byin gyis brlab phyir gshegs su gaXlaḥ//yul gyi ming ni rgya gar yulaḥbasil ba ru

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ () ༅ snying babs/rang byung mar rten bde byed ma mo kyi ri'i gnas/tshal gyi dur khrod du/slob dpon chen po hūṃ ka ras yang dag thugs kyi dngos grub thobaḥbadag kyang khyed kyi gdung gseb kyiḥbyin gyis brlab phyir gshegs su gsolaḥlha/yul gyi ming ni sing ga'i yul:sku la rdzogs pa'i dur khrod su 'a 'gro 'ong la/rgya40gling la bod/mgo rten ri go la byon/mtsho mo pha ri gnas/duḥslob dpon 'jam dpal bshes gnyen gyisaḥgashin rje gshed po'i dngos grub thobaḥbadag kyang khyed kyi gdung 11na gi sob kyi byin gyisabarlab phyir gshegs su gsolaḥlha/yul gyi ming ni bal po'i yul:lhun grub brtsegs pa'i ru sa lag g.ya༄bas/go rten bya ri la shor/yo mo su na rdas/dur khrod duḥslob dpon nā gā rdzun yisaḥpad+ma dbang gi dngos grub thobaḥbadag kyang khyed kyi gdung gsob kyiḥbyin gyis brlab phyir gshegs su gsol lha/yul gyi ming ni za hor yulaḥlang ka brtsegs kyi ru ḍā nang krol babs/mar rten bde byed gzhi nu byon/ma mo sma sha ni gnas/za sto dang rgya mtsho gling nas brgyud nas srin pho yul dang tshol yod/dur khrod duḥslob dpon bra pa ha ti yisaḥ'aphrin las phur pa'i dngos༄/ba thobaḥbadag kyang khyed kyi gdung gsob kyiḥbyin gyis brlab phyir gshegs su gsolaḥlha/yul gyi ming ni sa la'i yulaḥgasang chen rol pa'i ru' lagayo kho pa ba slo/sgri po rgyad kya yul yin/mchod rten sto ma sa dang /ma mo be ta la gnas so/dur khrod duḥslob dpon dha na saṃ kṛ tasaḥsrid pa ma mo'i dngos grub thobaḥ bdag kyang khyed kyi gdung gsob kyiḥ byin gyis brlab phyir gshegs su gsolaḥlha/yul gyi ming ni u rgyan yulaḥpad+ma ru ༅ 4'a ma babs/mchod rten sto tsakra/mo mo ga sma ri gan so/brtsegs pa'i dur khrod duḥslob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas kyisaḥsgrub pa mthar phyin dngos grub thobaḥbadag kyang khyed kyi gdung gsob kyi byin gyis brlab phyir gshegs su gsolaḥ//yul gyi ming ni kha che'i yulaḥhe chen brdal ba'i 'dir ru sa rkang g.ya babs/mchod rten ka ni ka/ma mo phra mo gnas so/dur khrod duḥ slob dpon bhu ya tsan+t+ra yis: dregs pa tshar gcod dngos grub thobaḥ bdag kyang khyed kyi gdung gsob kyi:byin gyis brlab phyir gshegs su gsol:lha/yul gyi 11ba kā ming ni li yi yul lang ka brtsegs pa'i 'dor ru tsho rkang g.yon babs/mar rten // bye shan dang /ma mo tshwa dha li gnas so/dur khrod du slob

rig 'dzin gdung sgrub kya 'phrin las klag chog mthong ba don ldan du bkod pa/ nang ma 9)dpon sharnying ga lha yisaḥbadud dpung 'dul ba'i dngos grub thobaḥbadag kyang khyed kyi gdung gsob ༅byin gyis brlab phyir gshegs su gsolaḥlha//dag lhun grub dgongs pa yisaḥmadzad pa mthar phyin dngos grub thobaḥ tshe la dbang ba'i rig 'dzin rnamasaḥ bdag kyang 〉ཿ byin gyis brlab phyir gshegs su gsolaḥrgyal ba'i bka' bzhin sgrub pa yiḥs dang lam la rab gnas pa'iḥrnam par smin pa'i rig 'dzin rnamasaḥsmon lam dbang gis gshegs su gso lo ཿ ca e spo hi bha ga wa na ma hā kā ru ṇi ga tri shu sngos ma ya sngos ma ya stuḥdzaḥlha rbaḥhoḥs ma ya hūṃ hrī hrī dzaḥdzaḥde nas bzhugs su gsol ba ni/hūṃ/rang bzhi 'od gsal wo po'i pho brang 'diraḥrnam dag pad+ma 'od kyi gdan steng duḥrig 'dzin rnam bzhi'i bla ma brgyud pa rnamasaḥbadag la dgyes bzhin brtan par bzhugs su gsolaḥsam ya a be sha ya tiṣ+ṭha badz+raḥde nas phyag mchod ni/hūm̐/rang byung lhun gyis grub pa'i pho brang nasaḥgazhi nas rang byung rig pa'i don rtogs pa'iḥrang bzhin rnam dag bla ma chos kyi skuḥkun bzang rigs lnga'i tsho gis la phyag 'tshal loḥrgyal ba'i thugs las 'gro don mdzad pa'i phyiraḥsku gsung thugs dang yon tan 'phrin las kyiḥsprul pa 'jig rten 'dul ba'i don du bstanaḥmachog gi sgrub pa lnga la phyag 'tshal loḥthugs rje'i dbang gis 'jig rten 'dir byon nas:gdul bya'i stobs kyis 'phrin las so sor mdzadaḥrig 'dzin rgyal ba'i zhing du gshegs mdzad pa'iḥrnal 'byor dbang phyug rnams la phyag 'tshal loḥsgrub pa'i gnas chen bzhugs gnas so so nasaḥ12na ) rgyal ba'i bka' bzhin sgrub pa'i rnal 'byor pas:'bras bu grub pa'i sa la rab gnas pa'iḥrig 'dzin grub pa rnams la phyag 'tshal loḥ.a ti bu ho/pra ti dzaḥhon ma ya ti/de nas mchod pa 'bul ba ni/hūṃ/lhun gyis grub pa'i rig 'dzin niḥsangs rgyas kun gyi thog ma yinaḥde la mchod pa 'bul ba ni:rig pa rang byung dngas pa laḥye shes lnga yi bkrag mdangs 'tsheraḥ'adzin med mchod pa chen por 'bul/kun bzang mchod sprin sna tshogs kyisaḥcho ge kyi dbyings kyi pho brang naḥbazhugs pa'i sangs rgyas mnyes gyur cigaḥ.ā+oṃ na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yoḥ'i shwa mu ṣe saḥsarba // ṇaḥ.ud ga te lpa ra ṇa hi me ga ga na kho swāhā/hūṃ/

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (25)rang bzhin dag pa'i zhing khams naḥ bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas byang chub sems: 'gro don mdzad pa thams cad laḥ zung 'jug bde chen mchod pa 'bulaḥ ma hā bo dhi tsit+ta pā dza ho de nas gtore ma 'bul ba ni/ hūṃ/ gdod nas dag pa'i dam tshig rdzasaḥ ye shes lnga yi bdud rtsi dang ཿ 'bru bcud dza gad dpa' bo dang ཿ ba kla ta yi gtor ma dang ཿ dmar dngas skyed byed rak+ta dang ཿ dngos grub zhal zas sna tsho gos kyisaḥ bla ma rnams kyi thugs dam bskang ཿ yi dam lha yi thugs dam bskang ཿ mkha' 'gro'i tsho gos kyi thugs dam bskang ཿ dpa' bo rnal 'byor thams cad kyiḥ thugs dam gtor mas bskangasagyur cigaḥ ma hā pañtsa a skṛ ta kha raṃ khā sti ma hā ba kla ta khā sti ma hā rak+ta khā sti ma hā sarba pā dza khā stide nas bdud rtsi'i dngos grub blang ba ni/ hūṃ/ grub pa'i rig 'dzin thams cad kyisaḥ bdag la byin gyis brlab tu gsol: rkyen dang bar gcod phyi la zlogaḥ mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsolaḥ sam ya sirnyi hūṃ lhaḥ lha: sku gsung thugs rdzogs pad+ma 'byung gnas niḥ rgyal ba'i (12bsko dung gsob 'khor ba'i g.yul ngo zlogaḥ thugs rje chen pos 'gro ba 'dren mdzad pa'iḥ sprul sku 'gro ba 'dren la phyag 'tshal loḥ rkod kyi rtse ldem dbu la btsugs pa niḥ sgrub pa mthar phyin ye shes rgyas pa'i rtagasaḥ dpal chen sha ba'i dbyibs zhu gsol ba niḥ theg chen lta ba'i don dang ldan pa'i rtagasaḥ dbu skra thor tshugs rgyan du bcings pa niḥ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i rtagasaḥ spyan gsum drag pos 'gro la gzigs pa ni: thugs rje chen pos 'gro ba 'dren pa'i rtagasaḥ 'dzum pa'i zhal ras mdangs dang ldan pa niḥ byams dang snying rjes 'gro ba 'dren pa'i rtagasaḥ za 'og ber chen sku la gsol ba ni sgrub pa bka' brgyad sku la rdzogs pa'i rtagasaḥ leb brgan dmar po'i chos gos gsol ba niḥ tshul khrimasarnam dag sdom dang ldan pa'i rtagasaḥ brjid pa'i ber chen sku la gsol ba niḥ srid gsum 'gro ba zil gyis gnon pa'i rtagasaḥ phyag g.yas gser gyi rdo rje bsnams pa naḥ ye shes lnga ldan log 'dren 'joms pa'i rtagasaḥ phyag g.yon bdud rtsi'i thod pa bsnams pa niḥ sgrub pa po la dngos grub ster ba'i rtagasaḥ kha ṭaṃ rtse gsum sku la brten pa niḥ thabs dang shes rab 'du 'bral med pa'i rtags: mi 496

sarba sirnyi lhaḥ'o āḥlha badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sirnyi nyu2'o āḥ/ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma thod phreng rtsal/ཿbadz+ra sa ma ya dzaḥsirnyi pha la lhaḥzhes brgya 'am stong bzlaḥdagongs pa zur du blta'oḥde nasargyud 'dzab ni/bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi skabs kyi rang bzhi rnam dag ma len no:skabs 'dir gsol 'debs le'u bdun ma bsams pa lhun grub ma dang bcas pa sngon 'gro rten skyed nas bzung brgyud 'debs sogs chos rgyal ma ba'i mtshan can yab sras kyi phyag len ltar byaḥde nas bstod pa bya ba ni/hūṃ/dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyaḥsku gsung thugs kyi sprul pa steḥmi mjed 'jig rten khamasasu byonaḥmadzad pa mthar phyin mngon 4 sa rgyasaḥsprul pa'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo:lha/rdo rje khrag 'thung thugs kyi srasaḥsku ni rgya mtsho'i klong nas 'khrungasaḥ'aphrin las 'dzam gling khyab par mdzadaḥthugs rjes bod kyi yul du gzigs spyod pa srin po'i yul du mdzadaḥpad+ma 'byung gnas zhes su gragasaḥ'akhor du mkha' 'gro mang pos bskoraḥsprul pa'i sku la phyag 'tshal loḥlha/sing gal yi nags tshal duḥ'ajam dpal sku yi dngos grub thobaḥm ga dh+wa yi brag phug sa pad+ma gsung gi dngos grub thob: 3ba'ang le shod kyi brag phug 6yang dag thugs kyi dngosaX thobaḥ.a su ra yi brag phug sa wen las phur

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dab blo bzang rgya mtsho' gsung 'bum/ rtonapa'i dngos grub thobaḥbasil ba'i tshal gyi dur khrod duḥbadud rtsi yon to dngos grub thob ཿ ma mo rol pa'i dur khrod duḥspod ga kho ma i dngos grub thobaḥdakyil wor drug lamang 'a brnyes pa'iḥdangosagrub rgyal po nyid la bstodaḥlha/dus gsum bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal loḥrig 'dzin rgyal ba rnamasal phyag 'tshal loḥrdo rje thod phreng rtsal la phyag 'tshal loḥrang bzhin rnam dag chos kyi dbyings nyid lasaḥthig le nyag gcig chos kyi sku ru sharaḥrang byung ye shes 'od gsal chen po'i ngang ཿbla ma chosakyi sku la phyag 'tshal bstodaḥthams cad mnyam nyid ngo bo chos kyi sku gnyis med 'od gsal longasaspyod rdzogs pa'i skuḥganyis snang kun khyab rang rig byang chub semasaḥlongs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstodaḥdus gsum sangs rgyas kun gyi sprul pa naḥkhams gsum sems can kun gyi mgon du gyuraḥ'akhor ba thams cad thar pa'i lam la 'drenaḥbla ma sprul pa'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstodaḥrang byung lhun grub rdzogs pa chen po'i ngang ཿmnyam nyid kun khyab phyogs su 'dzin pa medaḥskye 'gag med pas rnam rtog rang sar grolaḥlta ba mthar phyin rdo rje thod phreng rtsal:blo gros la pos kho 'dzin 'phel 'grib med:nyon mongs rlabs dang bral bas mi g.yo baḥdamigs med yengs med rang rig ngo bor gnas:sgom pa mthar phyin rdo rje thod phreng rtsal:'dzin chags med par snang srid thams cad grolaḥthogs brdugs sten pas ci la'ang nyam nga medaḥblang dor med pas rol pa chen po'i ngang :spyod pa mthar phyin rdo rje thod phreng rtsalaḥthams cad ye nas sangs rgyas yin pa laḥm rig rtog 4napa'i dbang gis 'khor bar 'khyamasaḥrig pa rang ngo shes nas 'khrul pa bralaḥgaser 'gyur rtsi ltar ye shes rang snang mthong ཿgos bu mthar phyin rdo rje thod phreng rtsalaḥri rgyal lhun po lta bur gzi brjid che ༷ka la ping ka lta bus sgra dbyangs snyan yid bzhin nor bu lta bur dgos 'dod 'byung ཿthugs rje phyogs ris med par 'gro don mdzadaḥ'aphrin las thogs pa med par sprul pa 'gyed sku lnga lhun grub rdo rje thod phreng rtsalaḥ'adas pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyi thugs kyi srasaḥd lta bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyasasku yi chabaḥm 'ongs sangs rgyas thams cad skul ༷༷ dpalaḥyon tan lhun gyis grub pa'i bla ma mchog:

rig 'dzin gdung sgrub kyi mun las klag chog mthong ba don ldan du bkod pa/ nang ma 9)rdo rje thod phreng rtsal la phyag 'tshal bstod:de nas tshogos kyi yo byad bshams la:zho su bhā wa bi shudhe sarba dharma su bhā wa shu 〉 ྅nyaḥzhes dag par sbyangasaḥre yaṃ — gis stong par sbyangs ཿ 'o āḥlha gis bdud rtsir byin gyis bsasaḥde nas spyan drang ba ni/hūṃ/'og min chos kyi dbyings kyi pho brang nasaḥye shesalnga rdzogs lhun gyis grub pa yiḥsangs rgyas thams cad spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol:phyogs bcu dag pa'i zhing khams so so nasaḥthugs rje chen pos 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa'iḥye shes sprul pa'i tsho gos rnams gshegs su gsolaḥsgrub pa'i sa dang lam la rab gnas pa'iḥrig 'dzin rtsal 'chang thams cad gshegs su gsolaḥyi dam lha dang mkha' 'gro dam tshig canaḥbaka' srung dam can thams cad gshegs su gsolaḥgu ru de wa ḍā gi ni sa ma ya hrī hrī dzaḥde nas tshogs gsum du bcad laḥdang po mchod pa 'bul ba ni/hūṃ/kun du bzang po rdo rje 'chang ཿrgyal ba rigs lnga yab yum la:ye shesalnga yi tshogs mchod 4ba tshe bulaḥsprul sku 'gro don mdzad pa yiḥrig 'dzin bla ma'i tsho gos rnamasal:'dod yon lnga yi mchod pa 'bulaḥm mo mkha' 'gro thams cad laḥbade ba ོ po'i mchod pa 'bulaḥchos skyong bka' srung thams cad laḥtshogs mchode gtor ma'i mchod pa 'bulaḥm hā ba li ta 'a hi/ma hā pañtsa a mṛ ta khā hi/ma hā me sa khā hi/ma hā rak+ta 'a hi/keng ni ri ti khā hi/zhes dbul/bar pa bshags pa bya ba ni/hūṃ/ma bcos spros bral bla ma chos kyi skuḥbade chen longs spyod bla ma chosakyi rje pad sdong las byon bla ma sprul pa'i sku:sku gsum rdo rje 'chang la phyag 'tshal loḥlha/chos sku dri med spros bral ngang nyid las:'gro don bsgrub phyir zhi khro gtso dang 'khoraḥthugs rje'i ngang / ma'i skur bzhengs pa'iḥyi dam lha tshogs rnams la phyag 'tshal loḥlha/thabs shes bde chen gnyisasu med pa laḥm 'gags rang rtsal ye shes las grub tshogasaḥlegs nyes stangs 'dzin dam tshig rjes gcod pa'i dam can mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal bstodaḥlha/dgongs shig bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro dang ཿrdo rje slob dpon rgyal ba zhi khro'i lhaḥdus gsum bde gshegs sgrub pa dam tshig can:sku gsum gdung gso me rdo rje lcam dral mgo/9 pang gyur skyabs mchog ma lus dgongs su gsolaḥ

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()bdag ni ma rig lus dang ngag sems kyis slob dpon mched sogs sku smad ngan smras dang ཿyi dam sngags dang phyag rgya ma gsal ba:rtsa ba'i dam las 'das gyur mthol lo bshagasaḥshes bya lnga dang bcas par bya ba lngaḥmi spang lnga dang bsgrub par bya rgyu lngaḥdang blang la sogs yan lag dam tshig kun:nyams gyur rang mnong 'gyod pas mthol zhing bshagasaḥsngags la the tshom bla med theg pa smadaḥlta spyod 15na / ya bral bsnyen sgrub gzhung ma bsrangasaḥlog spyod dbang song dus kyi mchod pa bcagaḥsdom gsum thun mong dam tshig nyams pa bshagasaḥrig pa'i rtsal chung snying po'i don ma rtogasaḥsgom pa'i sran chung gnas lugs so ma thub:blo yi stobs chung spyod pas bogs ma thonaḥlegs bsams bshad kyang don log thugs 'gal gyuraḥ'abras bu yid smon gyur pa mthol lo bshagasaḥzhes bshags shing 'di rgyun bshags byas na yang shin tu zabaḥlha/sems can ma rig 'khrul pa'i bloḥnyams rtags 'khrul pa'i dbang du shoraḥgasang sngags dkyil 'khor chen po yiḥsgo ru zhugs kyang dam las 'galaḥrtsa ba yan lag dam tshig laḥ nyams chag 'gal 'khrul ci mchis paḥ sku gsum bla ma'i spyan sngar bshags:tsho gos dang gtor ma ma dag paḥmakha' 'gro srung ma'i spyan sngar bshagasaḥzhes brjod de dbul/tha ma gdab pa bya ba ni/zan la dgra bgegs kyi rū pa byas laḥphyag rgya bzhis 'gugasaḥgha ta yas gtugasaḥzhag pa ni/na ma sa man+ta/ka ya wā ka tsit+ta badz+ra na/ā+oṃ gha gha/ghā ta ya/ghā ta ya/sarba dun gnod byed dgra bgegs ma ra ya/gī la ya/sarba pā baṃ/hūṃ hūṃ/hūṃ badz+raki li gī lā ya/badz+ra dha rod ad dzñā pā ya ti/kā ya wa ga tsit+ta badz+ra zhi li gī lā ya hūṃ phaṭa/hūṃ/nyen mongs log pa'i sems can rnams dgra bgegs gzugs su las kyis grubaḥbastan pa'i ru tra bsgral ba'i phyiraḥmyur mgyogs thugs rje'i lcags kyus bkug:rno myur ye shes mtsho ni gyis bsgralaḥyo badz+ra kro dha sarba ni tri sa mu ka ma ra ya rbadaḥlha/sha ni gti mug chen po steḥbasgral bas rig pa'i ye shes 'charaḥkhrag ni 'dod chags rab bzhin teḥbasgral bas bde ba'i mchod par 15ba〉gyuraḥrus pa zhe sdang rang bzhin teḥbasgral bas ye shes rang la gsalaḥdu/ gsum bsgral ba'i mchod pa 'ad:bla ma yi dam

rig 'dzin gdung sgrub kyi 'phrin las klag chog mthong ba don ldan du bkod pa/ nang ma rkanamakha' 'gro dang ཿ dam can srung ma'i zhal du gdab/ ma hā me sa khā sti ma hā ra sta khā sti mahā keng ni ri ti khā hi/ sa te dbul lo: rtsa gsum bskang gso gtong bar 'dod na zur nas 'byung ba bzhin gtang ngo ཿ gter srung brgyad mchod skabs 'di'am don bstod kyi mjug gang 'os la byaḥ rang nyid tsho gos la rolaḥ de nas lhag ma rnams rdo rje slob dpon gyi kha chus bran nasaḥ lha/ sngon tshe khrag 'thung he ru ga'i spyan sngar khas blangs dam bcas dang ཿ bar du pad+ma 'byung gnas kyiḥ spyan sngar khas blangs dam bcas dang ཿ da lta rig 'dzin bdag nyid kyiḥ bran dang pho nyar khas blangs pa'i: sgrub sdebargyad kyi bka' srung ngang ཿ gsang sngags theg pa'i bka' srung rnamasaḥ bka' yi pho phabs 'di ba che sti galaḥsngon gyi dam tshig dran par gyisaḥ gsang sngags bstan pa rgyas par mdzodaḥ bdud dang dam sri rdul du rlogaḥ ces lhag ma btang ste gtor ma shod du phab la rang slob dpon pad+ma ra gsal bas 'di skad do:hūṃ/ rgyal ba shākya thub pa'i bstan pa laḥ rgyal tshab sprul sku mang po byon pa yisaḥ bka' dang dam la btags pa'i srung ma rnamasaḥ dam tshig tshul bzhin mchod kyis gshegs su gsolaḥ sam ya dzaḥdzaḥhūṃ/ grub pa'i rig 'dzin thams cad kyisaḥ dam la btags pa'i srung ma rnamasaḥ bka' yi gtor ma 'di long laḥ khas blangs bzhin du 'phrin las mdzodaḥ slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas kyisaḥ da rol ba'i mtsho gling duḥ nam mkha'i gza' rnams dam la btagasaḥ rgya dang bal po'i so mtshams suḥ bar nas lha srin dam la btagasaḥ bka' yi gtor ma 'di long laḥ khas (16na)blangs bzhin du 'phrin las mdzodaḥ g.ya' ri gong gi brag phug ca bdag nyid chen mo dam la btagasaḥ a su ra yi brag phug 6 shwa na mched bzhi dam la btagasaḥ byang chub ris kyi chu mig snya bse yi lha mo dam la btagasaḥbaka' yi gtor ma 'di long laḥ khas blangs bzhin du 'phrin las mthong : slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas kyisaḥ mang yul byams sprin lha khang duḥ rgyal po dpon g.yog dam la btagasaḥ dpal mo'i lha mtsho srin mtsho sa bstan ma brgya gnyis dam la btagasaḥ byang rgyud byang lam bar pa sa gnod sbyin thang lha dam la btagasaḥ byang stod byang smad so mtshams suḥ pho nya sum brgya drug stodang ཿ 'brog mo thams cad —501—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (25)dam la btagasaḥ gnam gyi shu thog glang thod duḥ pho bdud nyer gcig dam la btagasaḥ mal gro gzi chen mtsho 'gram du klu rigs rnam lnga dam la btagasaḥ has po ri yi rtsa ba sa bod kyi lha srin thamasacad kunaḥ dam la ma btags gag kyang medaḥ bsam yas dbu rtse rigs gsum duḥ rgyal po thamasacad dam la btags spa gro cal gyi brag dmar duḥ kyi mthing g.yu sgron dam la btagasaḥ bka' yi gtor ma 'di long laḥ khas blangs bzhin du 'phrin las mdzodaḥ slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis:rgya gar za hor lang ga'i yulaḥ sing nga sa la u rgyan yulaḥ kha che bal bo li yi yulaḥ dur khrod brgyad kyi lha srin rnamasaḥ dam la ma btags gag kyang med: gong gong chum chum dam la 'duḥ dam tshig gtor ma 'di long laḥ slob dpon pad+ma'i chos rgyud skyongasaḥ gal te bka' las 'das gyur na slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas daḥ khro bo yas me dpal yinaḥ khyed kyi snying khrag brngubs nas kyang ཿ ri rab 'og tu (16bsko non par 'gyuraḥ de bas dam las ma 'da' b.raḥ khas blangs bzhin du 'phrin lasamadzodaḥ a ya ma du ru ca sha la naḥ sa tsa ga phud: ra smo ya klaḥ sa ma ya na ra kha naḥ ba kla ta khā nya rak+ta khā sti ma skṛ ta khā hiḥ zhes bstan ma gtor ma'i bshal chus bskyang ste chad mdo bstan skyod lhan cig tu gtang ཿ dngos grub len pa ni/ hūṃ/ shar gyi phyogs nas dngos grub skul ba'i lhaḥ zhi ba'i lasamadzad rdo rje thod phreng rtsalaḥ zhi ba'i rang bzhin sku mdog dkar la 'tsher ཿ na bza' dkar po shin tu mdzes pa gsolaḥ phyag gnyis rdo rje lcags kyu ḍa ma sa rdo rje'i mkha' 'gro'i thugs dam rgyun bskul nasaḥ bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor bcas laḥ nad gdon bgegs dang bar chad zhi bar mdzod2 PROB āḥlha badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sirnyi lhaḥ lha/ lho yi phyogs nas dngos grub skul ba'i lha: rgyas pa'i las mdzad rin chen thod phreng rtsal: 'i rgyas pa rang bzhin sku mdog ser la 'tsheraḥ na bza' ser po shin tu mdzes pa gsolaḥ phyag gnyis rin chen zhags pa ḍa ma sa rin chen mkha' 'gro'i thugs dam rgyud bskul nasaḥ bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor bcas laḥ tshe dang bsod nams rgyas pa'i 'phrin las mdzod2 PROB āḥlha badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi lhaḥ lha/ nub kyi phyogs nas dngos grub skul ba'i lhaḥ—502

rig 'dzin gdung sgrub kyi 'phrin las klag chog mthong gdon ldan du bkod pa/ nang ma 6)dbang gi las mdzad pad+ma thod phreng rtsalaḥ dbang gi rang bzhin sku mdog dmar la 'tsheraḥ na bza' dmar po shin tu mdzes pa gsolaḥ phyag gnyis pad+ma lcags sgrog ḍa ma sa pad+ma mkha' 'gro'i thugs dam rgyud bskul nasaḥ bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor bcas laḥ khams gsum dbang du bsdu ba'i 'phrin las mdzod: zho āḥlha badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sirnyi lhaḥ lha/ byang gi phyogs nas dngos grub skul ba'i lhaḥ (17na༄ga po'i las mdzad ga me thod phreng rtsalaḥ drag po'i rang bzhin sku mdog ljang la 'tsheraḥn bza' ljang gu shin tu mdzes pa gsolaḥ phyag gnyis rgya gram dril bu ḍa ma sa las kyi mkha' 'gro'i thugs dam rgyud bskul nasaḥ bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor bcas kyiḥ dgra bgegs bar chad thams cad tshar gcod mdzodaḥ zho āḥ/ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sirnyi lhaḥ lha/ dbus kyi phyogs nas dngos grub skul ba'i lhaḥ sku lnga lhun grub burnya thod phreng rtsalaḥ sku lnga'i rang bzhin sku mdog smug la 'tsheraḥn bza' smug po shin tu mdzes pa gsolaḥ phyag mtshan 'khor lo rgya gram ḍa ma sa sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro'i thugs dam rgyud bskul nasaḥ bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor bcas laḥ thams cad lhun gyis grub pa'i dngos grub stsol: zho āḥlha badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sirnyi hūṃ/ mi la tshe yi dngos grub stsolaḥnor la g.yang gi dngos grub stsolaḥ zas la bcud kyi dngos grub stsolaḥ de nas dkyil 'khor bsdu ba ni/ hūṃ/ da ni dkyil 'khor gsal btab la: phyi nang snod bcud thams cad kunaḥ yi ge hūṃ la hril gyi bsduḥ / yang mi 'jigs 'ja' ltar yalaḥ zhes pa ste rtag mtha' gsal ba'o: slar yang de nyid lha ru gsalaḥ zhes chad mtha' gsal ba'oḥ zhes dkyil 'khor bsdu: rgyun gyi ting nge 'dzin la gnas par bya'oḥ smon lam ni/ bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro mchod la sogasaḥ spyad dang bskul dang yi rang las byung ba'i bsod nams dge tsho gos dpag med de dag gisaḥ tshe 'dir bla med byang chub 'bras thob nasaḥsku gsum bde r+ṣa zhing du spyod byed cing ཿ gzugs skus 'gro don mas li spyod par shogaḥ lha/ phyi yi bla ma sna tsho gis sprul pa'i sku nang gi bla ma kun bzang he ru gaḥ gsang ba'i bla (17bsgo rang rig gnyug ma'i gshisaḥ tshe 'dir mngon du mjal bar byin gyis rlobs: rig pa'i ngo bo gsal stong 'dzin —503

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (25)pa medaḥ rjen par mthong ba ye stong ka nas dgaḥ sgron drug lam la brten nas zag bcas kyiḥ phung po 'ja' lus rdo rjer 'grub par shogaḥ skal ba dman na bar do'i gnas skabs dang ཿ skye ba'i srid pa 'dzin tshe pad+ma 'byung : byon nas mngon par mtho dang nges legs kyiḥ yang dag lam du 'khrid par byin gyis rlomesaḥ phan bde'i rtsa lag rgyal ba'i bstan pa dang ཿ mtha' klas skye dgu'i bde skyid ma lus paḥyar ngo'i zla ba lta bur rab rgyas shing ཿ mi mthun nyes pa'i tsho gos kun zhi gyur cigaḥ khyad par gangasakyi ra bas yongs bskor ba'iḥ dbus gtsang ru bzhi'i rgyal khams 'di nyid duḥ nad rims mu ge sad ser than pa dang ཿ 'brug rtsod mtha' dmag gnod pa zhi bar shog: thugs rjes 'gro kun yol med rjes 'dzin kyang : bod 'bangs lhag par skyong ba'i zhal bzhes bka'aḥ khri srong rgyal por stsal ba'i nga po'i donaḥ re ba ji bzhin skong ba'i dus la babaḥ de phyir sdo bzhi'i dpag bsam yongs 'du'i ljonaḥmatsho skyes byin rlabs dpyid kyi ma ma yisaḥ nye bar bskyangs las grub pa'i don gnyis 'brasaḥ longasasu spyod pa'i dga' ston rgyas gyur cigaḥ bkra shis ni/ dus gsum bla ma sku gsum bdag nyid can:dbyer med rang la rtogs pa'i bkra shis shogaḥ thabs shes dbyer med zung 'jug yi dam lhaḥ don dam 'du 'bral med pa'i bkra shis shogaḥ 'khor 'das chos la dbang sgyur mkha' 'gro'i tshogasaḥ phyi nang bar chad zhi ba'i ba po shis shogaḥ e ma ho/ gdod nas ma skyes spros dang bral ba'i sku: srid zhi mnyam nyid 'khor 'das kun gyi dpalaḥ ka dag snying po chos sku'i bkra shis shogaḥ burnya thod phreng sangs (18na)rgyas 'dus pa skuḥ gti mug rnam dag chos dbyings ye shesang nga ཿ thams cad yongs rdzogs grub pa'i bkra shis shogaḥ pad+ma thod phreng sangs rgyas 'dus pa'i gsung ཿ 'dod chags rnam dag kun rtog ye shesang nga ཿ snang srid dbang du bsdu ba'i bkra shis shog: rdo rje thod phreng sangs rgyas 'dus pa'i thugasaḥzhe sdang rnam dag me long ye shes ngang ཿ mi mthun rkyen rnams zhi ba'i bkra shis shogaḥ rat+na thod phreng sangasargyas yon tan bdagaX nga rgyal rnam dag mnyam nyid ye shesang nga ཿ tshe dbang longs spyod rgyas pa'i bkra shis shog ga rma thod phreng sangs rgyas 'phrin las bdagaḥ phrag dog rnam dag bya grub ye shesang nga ཿ—504

rig 'dzin gdung sgrub kyi 'phrin las klag chog mthong ba don ldan du bkod pa/ nang ma (ka)dgra bgegs tshar gcod drag po'i bkra shis shog: rdo rje slob dpon rdo rje rgyas 'debs dang ཿ mched dang lcam dral sngags dang phyag rgya'i mthusaḥ sprul sku 'gro 'dul yongs rdzogs bkra shis shogaḥ rig 'dzin gdung sgrub kyi 'phrin las rdo rje gdan du rig 'dzin rnams gyis bka' bgros nas mdzad pa bod yul du slob dpon pad+mas rgyal po rje 'bangs bdun la gtad pa ma 'ongs pa'i don du byang zang zang lha brag gi rked la sbas soḥ sam ya/ rgya rgya rgya/ brag ri dug sbrul spungs 'dra'i rked nas rig 'dzin rgod kyi ldem 'phru can gyis gter nas bton pa'o/ rig 'dzin gdung sgrub kyi las byang gi khrid rim 'thor ba dang gab pa dang mi gsal ba rnams bsdebs nas brgyud 'debs kyi mjug dang smon lam gyi rim pas kha bkang ste bklags chog mthong bas don ldan 'di ni tshul 'di nyams su len pa'i skal ldan rnams la phan pa'i ched dang / khyad par bod yul gangs can gyi ljongs kyi bstan 'gro'i phan bde'i ched du dbus gtsang stod smad kun gyi tshes bcu'i mchod pa sngar srol yod pa rnams dar rgyas dang / med pa gsar du bskrun pa/ de (18ba)mthun rdzong 'go so sor yang tshes bcu'i mchod pa 'dzin pa zhig grub na legs tshul phyag mdzod sa skyong bsod nams rab brtan la byas skabs tshul de sgrub par bzhed pas yul gru kha yar du rang gang mos kyi gter kha'i tshes bcu gang dar byed dgos pa'i brda brgyag dang mthun rkyen sogs mdzad cing / rdzong gzhis rnams su 'don rgyu bde ba gcig dgos gsungasapar brten 'di'i dbu btsugs grub 'tshams la rat+na gling pa'i gtsang la phan pa'i zhal chems kyi lung bstan thog tu babs pa'i brjod bya sna tsho gos shig byung ba'i 'gal rkyen glo bur ba zhig la brten da cha byed mi bde ba 'dug gsung yang chog bsgrigs 'di nyid slad nas rig 'dzin pad+ma'i thugs rje'i gzi byin gyisabasil ldan gyi yul kun skal ba bzang por 'gyur ba'i dga' ston gyi rten 'brel du lcags stag dbyug gu zla ba'i dpa' bo dga' ston gyi tshes la za hor gyi rigs las sngags spyon gang shar rang grol gyis dga' ldan pho brang du bkod pa'i dge bas spur rgyal bod kyi rgyal khams bde zhing / bde ba'i thabs tshulu sgrub par mdzad pa po rnams kyi thugs kyi bzhed don lhun gyis grub par gyur cig / maṅga lo// //—505

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()drang srong dri med zhi khro'i rig gtad kyi chog sgrigs thugs thigs snying bum g.yas 'khyil ces bya bar bzhugs so//na mo de wa ṛ ṣi bi ma lā ya/gsang 'dzin lag na rdo rjes byang tso bar//'bral med rjesa'adzin thugs rje'i lcags kyo che//'debs byed 'phrul gyi sgo 'byed rig gtad gzhung //gnam skas klu bdud sto ba'i zab mo'i gter//yid srubs las rgyal sra go rno ba'i mtshon//'chi med srog gi rgya mdud bdud rtsi'i bas//dpal 'byor dbang thang rgyas pa'i dpag bsam ljon//phan bde'i sgo brgya 'byed pa'i lde mig yin//de phyir bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro la//'dud pa'i gtsug tor sal nyer bkod de//bdag byin brlabs pa'i thugs kyi thigs pa'i rgyun//rang snying bum pa bzang por g.yasasu 'khyil//de yang bram ze'i sngags rgod drang srong wo po dri med 'od zer zhi khro'i rig pa gto pa'i lag len gyi rim pa nyams su len pa la gnas yid du 'ong bar skyang nul bya/cog tse'i steng du maṇ+ḍal gyi khar 'bras kyi tshom bu gcig bkod/de steng ma sgyu'i khar/dkar gsum gyis sbrus pa'i gtor zlum dkar po pad 'dab bzhi pa mthar 'bru sna mngar gsum shing tog sna tshogs kyis bskor ba drang srong zhi drag gi tsaka li btsugs pa bshams par chu chang sbran/g.yas su thob dang g.yon du ral gri dngos sam tsaka li/mdun nas brtsams te sgor 2na7chod dam thad mchod gang rung la chu gnyis nyer spyod lnga/drag po'i chu gnyis dang nyer spyod lnga/sman raka gtor gsum/gter bsrung dge bsnyen she'u kha ri la zlum gtor/klu bdud mgo dgu dang /ston kha gnyis la zlum gtor gnyis sbrul gyi dkrisapar klu sman btab pa/rgyal po shel ging la 'phyi shos/tsho gos chas/chang bu brgyad/bgegs gtore/gu gul/yungs thun/rol chen/slob dpon gyi cog tse'i steng du rdor dril/las bum/me tog sogs mkho ba'i yo byad rnams mngon par 'du byas/laX /nga gi gzhung bsrangs te bdag mdun gnyis ka

drang srong dri med zhi khro'i rig gtad kyi chog sgrigs thugs thigs snying bum g.yas 'khril/ nang ma (ka)zhe sdang rdo rje spyi bor dri med 'od zer sogs mngon rtogs ji lta ba bsgoms pa'i sgrub mchod bzlas pa tshogs mtha' ma'i bar bya/ las bum du rdo rje sems dpa' dang bdud rtsi 'khyil pa bskyed sgrub byed/ting nge 'dzin tsam gyi sgo nas rig gtad dmigs par len/ slob ma rnams khrus nas dbyung / yon du ral gri sogs khyab kyis mtha' brten pa'i mtshon cha 'bul/ phyag byas te gral la 'khod/ bgegs gtor btang / thun mong sngon du 'gro ba'i chos bshad nas maṇ+ḍal 'bul du (2bgi zhug /steng gos mgo mjug rigs 'dzin dmi gu ru sogs kyi rgyun la bya rog gi zhwa gon yang 'bri gung phyogs su sgrub pa'i skabs ma gtogos par gang mi mdzad pas:dgos/ ldog ste gyon/ lag tu me tog thogs la gsol ba gdab pa ni/ slob dpon bdag ni mu stegs byed dang ni/ /sdebargyad 'gong po'i dbang du song ba la/ /drang srong dmod pas bzlog pa'i thabs/ /ngo mtshar can du ga tri gnang du gsol/ /zhes lan gsum brjod/ de nas yid ches shing khungs btsun pa'i phyir/ lo rgyus ni/ lho phyogs in+da'i yul na rgyal po dharma a shwa ka bya ba zhig yod pas/yul mi rnams kyis rgyal khrims bshig pas rgyal po thugs ma bde nas yul gyi gtso blon rnams la thugs khros te/ sde brgyad gzir cing khyad par du gtad khram byas pas rgyal khrims bshig pa thams cad phung bar byas so/ /de nas rgyal khrims shin tu gnyan par byas so/ /der rgyal po la rang bsrung gi gdams pa med pas/ klu la sogs sde brgyad kyi bsnyags byung nas mdze byung / slo snying mer 'bar kha nas khrag bskyugs/ shin tu nad kyis gdungs pa las/ mo dang bra mang du byas tsa na/ nags tshal dra ba can gyi phug na drang srong dri med 'od zer zhes bya ba dka' thub la gnas pa dmod pa btsan pa zas su shing tog gsol ba zhig bzhugs kyi de spyan drangs nas byin rlabs zhugan phan/ gzhan cis kyang mi phan zer bas de rgyus yod pa'i mi su yod dris pas/ bram ze rgan po zhig na re/ nags tshal dra ba can gyi phug tu stag gzig dom dred kyang mi thar na mi dag lta ci smos/ drang srong dri med 'od zer ni zla ba nya'i nyin par ri bo kun 'dus kyi rtse mor drang srong 'bum phrag du ma la chos ston du yong ba yin no zer —507

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (25)bas/ de'i wo par ri bo kun 'dus(3na7 rtse mor rgyug bzhi bas/ drang srong rgan po lus sa zad rid pa/ mdog sngo ba/ ag tsho mes che ba/ ras dkar po'i smad dkris gsol ba zhig byung ba la zhu ba phul te shing rta la bskyon nas spyan drangs te rgyal po'i pho brang du gdan drangs la bzhugs su gsol nas zhal zas sna tshogs drangs te rgyal pos phyag dang zhe sa byas nas/ bdag gis rgyal khrims shor ba la thug nas/ klu dang sa bdag la sogs sde brgyad la gtad khram byas pas lha 'dre'i bsnyags byung nas 'di lta bu'i nad kyis zin pa la bdag la thugs rjes gzigs nas byin gyis brlab tu gsol zhug pas/ drang srong gi zhal nas/ rgyal po chen bo sdig pa mi dge ba bas spongs/ 'bru dang zan gyi gtor ma rgya chen po shoms shig /drang srong 'bum phrag la gtor ma gtong gsungs nas/ drang srong rnams kyisasmon lam btab bo/ /drang srong chen po nyid kyis dmod pa'i sngags rgod 'di lan cig brjod pas/ de cung zad bde zer/ de bzhin du lan bdun brjod pas snyun mi bde ba med par phan par gyur to/ /de nas drang srong la mchod gnas su bzhugs par zhus kyang ma gnang nas/ nags tshal dra ba can du bzhud do / /de nas rgyal po dharma a shwa gas bram ze legs grub la gnang / des rgya gar pra ha sti la gnang / des shān+ti gar+bha la gnang / des slob dpon pad+ma la gnang / de yang gangs can bod kyi btsad po lha gcig khri srong lde btsan gyis sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che'i srol btsugs pa/ lha srin rnams kyis mdzad du ma ster ba de'i gnyen por 'dzam bu'i gling na che ba'i rig sngags grub pa sangs rgyas gnyis pa o rgyan chen po gdan drangs pa'i dus slob dpon pad+mas/ rgyud/ gzhung / man ngag /mde'u thung / nad gso ba sogs lho brag mkho mthing lha khang du gter du sbas pa mnga' (3ba thad ga nyid kyi skye ba bcu gsum pa nyang nyi ma 'od zer gyis spyan drangs te rigs kyi sras thugs rje chen po'i sprul pa mnga' bdag 'gro mgon la gnang / des bla ma mnga' bdag pa chen po'i yang srid gsung sprul chos kyi dbang phyug la gnang / gdams skor 'di'i las tshogs/ 'phrin las/ rig gtad/ snying 'grel/ snyan brgyud sogs man ngag phal cher gnam skas brag gi klu bdud sto bar gtams shing bcud —508

drang srong dri med zhi khro'i rig gtad kyi chog sgrigs thugs thigs snying bum g.yas 'khril/ nang ma (ka) phur sogs 'ga' zhig pa kor be+e ro tsa nas be+eḍūrla'i shog bu la gser gyis bris nas bse'i sgrom bur bcug ste mkho mthing lha khang du sbas pa'i gter kha gnyis chos dbang rin po ches gdan drangs/ thugasakyi sras pad+ma dbang chen dang ka thog pa rgyal ba bzang po gnyis la gnang / de nas so sor brgyud pa gyes pa mthar chu bo gcig tu bla ma mkha' dbyings rdo rje la 'dres/ des lha sras mu tig btsan po'i skye ba chos rgyal rin cen phun tshogs la gnang / rje zur pas rgyal po mya ngan med du skye ba bzhes pa gsal bar dran zhing yi dam 'di dngos su 'grub pas dharma a shwa ka nas rje gnam lcags me 'bar la nye brgyud du byas kyang chog pa yin/ rje zur pa la zhabrul med kyi gter chen chos kyi rgyal po legs ldan bdud 'joms rdo rjes gsan/ gnyis ka la dpal 'bri gung pa chos rgyal phun tsho gis kyis gsan/des rang gi rigs sras bkra shis phun tshogs la gnang / de la kho bo'i 'dren pa dam pa gnyags dzñā na ku mā ra'i sprul pa'i zlos gar zur khyab bdag chos dbyings rang grol gyis rig gtad gsan/ lung rags rim phyag bzhes dang bcas pa rje zur pa la ras chung rnam sprul snang gsal ba bkra shis rgya mtsho sogs na/ des rigs sras kun dga' che mchog /des zur lhun grub rdo rje/ des yab gnyon nu don grub/ de la sras rtsa ba'i (4na)bla mas gsan cing bdag la stsal ba ltar/ sreg pa me'i las sbyor la brten nas dam sri 'byung po'i tsha ngar bcag pa'i yid ches kyi nges pa rnyed/ yang rig gtad lung dang bcas pa yongs su rdzogs pa rje chos rgyal phun tshogs nas rat+na'i mchog sprul dbur spyon chos kyi grags pa/ des mnga' ris pa sngags 'chang chen po dkon cog lhun grub/ des drin can sprul pa'i sku mchog chos rgyal gter bdag gling pa/ des bdag la stsal zhing man ngag phyag len dmar 'khrid shin tu mtha' chod pa mkhas grub dkon cog lhun grub nyid la kho bos nos shing / gzhan yang lung rgyun 'ga' zhig chos rgyal bkra shis stobs rgyal nas rigs 'dzin yol mo ba chen po las zur thams cad mkhyen pas gsan cing rig gtad dang lung kha yar khyab bdag khra tshang pa chen po la yang bdag gis zhus pa lags pas/ steng nas rigs 'dzin brgyud pa'i byin brlabs kyi chu bo ma nub/ bar du man —50()

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (25)ngag mkha' 'gro'i kha rlangs kyi tsha ngar ma yal/ lha sngags ye shes snang grag rig gsum du gsal ba'i 'char sgo ma 'gags/ 'og tu dam rdzas gtor ma'i ri bo ma nyil zhing sman rag gi rgya mtsho ma skams/brgyud pa dam nyams 'dre khyer bsre bslad kyis mi dbar khyis ma chod pa lags/ de yang mdun gyi nam mkhar rtsa ba gsum gyi lha tsho gos gsal legs par btab pa la/ rgyud dag par bya ba'i slad du skyabs sems kyi rjes zlos las byang bzhin lan gsum bya/ thun mong ma yin pa'i gsol ba gdab pa ni/gsang ba'i bdag po rdo rje 'dzin/ /bdag la thugs rjes dgongs nas kyang / /bar chad rkyen lasargyal ba'i phyir/ /drang srong dri med bshes gnyen gi /sku gsung (4ba)thugs dang yon tan rnams/ /rdzogs par bdag la stsal du gsol/ /lan gsum rjes zlos byed/ de nas las byang gi tshig brjod pa dang mnyam du slob ma rnams drang srong zhi ba dri med 'od zer du bskyed cing brda sprad/ gnas gsum byin gyis brlab/ snying ga'i dhīḥser po las 'od zer 'phros pas rgya gar lho phyogs in+da'i yul nags tshal dra ba can nas/ lha'i bu drang srong dri med ras dkar po'i na bza' mnabs pa/ ral pa sngo skya/ ag tsho mos brang du sleb pa/ phyag gnyis na ril ba spyi blugs dang lung thang phreng ba 'jin pa/ 'khor drang srong 'bum gyi tshogs dang bcas pa byon par bsams nas/ hūṃ/ dad pa dang ni dam tshig gis zhes pa nasabazung ste sems can don la gshegs su gsol gyi bar dang oṃ ha la ha la hi li hi li he he drung drung /dzaḥdzaḥbh+yo bh+yo/ bzlog bzlog ces dang co du nyer gcig brjod la/ nags tshal dra ba can nas drang srong dri med 'od zer la rang 'dra 'bum gyis bskor ba nam mkha' la sprin 'thibs pa bzhin byon nas thim par bsam/ spos rol bya zhing spyi bor rdo rje rgya gram du bzhag ste tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra zhes brjod nas brtan par bya/ de ltar thim pa'i rkyen gyis slob ma drang srong zhi bar gsal ba gnas 'gyur te khro bo zhe sdang rdo rjer las byang gi mngon rtogs ltar tshar gcig brjod de gsal btab/ bsnyen sngags log tri dang drag sngags spu gri ring mo tshar gcig las byang gi che ba'i nga rgyal bskyed pa rnams brjod/ dmod pa tshar gcig dang bcas thal mo brdab/ dbang dngos la mdun gyi gtor ma lhar gsal ba las zhe sdang rdo rje —510

drang srong dri med zhi khro'i rig gtad kyi chog sgrogs thugs thigs snying bum g.yas 'khril/ nang ma (ka)mar me gcig las gnyis mched kyi tshul du slob ma'i spyi bor byon par bsams la/khro bo'i sku gzugs spyi bor bzhag ste/hūṃ/lha yi drang srong dri med 'di//gsang bdag dngos ldan)dang khyad par med//nga yis khyod la gtad pa yin//sde brgyad bka' las ma 'da' zhig/ā+oṃ shing du tri na trang du dzaḥdzaḥ.a bhi ṇiñtsa hūṃ/zhes lha spyi bo nas bstim/bsnyen sngags dang spu gri ring mo gnyis dmod pa dang bcas pa brjod cing thal mo brdab/lag pa g.yon du ral gri gtad la/dbang gas rnams kyi rigs la lha'i phyag mtshan g.yas nasagatod pa'i 'khrul gzha la brten ral grir ngos bzung ste tsaka lir bris pa yong 'dug pa/cung zad mi 'thad pas nged kyi a pha dang a ma'i dus la bod ces lug4sha mi mdzad 0gum bsam chod ral gri khyod la gtad//pha rol log rtog ngan pa rnams//bcad gtub ming yang med pa dang //gtan nas brlag pa'i 'phrin las mdzod//ā+oṃ trang du tri na kha ṅga a bhi khiñtsa hūṃ/bsnyen
