sngags brjod lag g.yas su tho ba gtad de/āḥganam lcags tho chen 'bar ba 'dis/khyod la gdug sems ldan pa kun//spyi bo choms la thal bar thong //rnam shes chos kyi dbyings su spor//oṃ co du tri na tiṣ+ṭha a bhi ṇiñtsa hūṃ/bsnyen sngags brjod/yon to 'phrin lasagator ma'i byin rlabs kyi sngon du/chang rjes brgyad lho rgyud kyi sngags lang rnams slob ma re la 4 rjes brgyad pa re mdzad 'dug rung 'bri gung gi sa la med cing de ltar na slob ma re la bgegs gtor re yang dgos pa'i rig pa dod mtshungs par ma'/phyag len la lar thog mar drang song la mas gtor phul/de rjes bgegs la mas gtor gtong ba'ang dpyad bzod par mi snang ngo //chab kyis sbran/'bru gsum gyis brlab/sam+bha ra'am a kā ro lan gsum gyis sde brgyad la bsngo/lha srin sde brgyad khyed rnams kyis da phyin chad slob ma 'di la gnod pa ma byed par bsrung skyab mdzod cig/ces bka' bsgo/gtor ma gtsang sar dor/de nas5ba ) gtor ma zhe sdang rdo rjer gsal ba'i spyi gtsug tu zhi ba dri med bshes gnyen bzhugs pa'i gtor ma spyi bor bzhag ste/hūṃ/drang srong chen po dri ma med//lha yi drang srong 'bum dang bcas//slob ma byang chub ma thob bar//bsrung ba chen po mdzad du gsol//ā+oṃ to du tri na co du dzaḥdzaḥb lin+ta a bhi khiñtsa hūṃ/drang srong dri med dang gsang bdag don gcig pa yin pas/da phyin chad dregs pa phyi nang sus kyang mi gnod cing bka' las

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzab rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (25)'da' bar mi phod pa yin pas so/ /bsnyen sngags brjod rjes 'di la gnod par byed pa'i mthu byad nad gdon sogs gang dgos pa kha bsgyur te bsrung ba'i bka' bsgo drag tu byed/ spu gri ring mo dang dmod pa tshar gcig gis thal brdab bya/ phyin chad kyang de bzhin du mdzod cig ces bka' gtad/ gtor ma lhar gsal ba 'od du zhu nas bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor bsams te dngos grub tu rol/ bdud rtsi nas kyang ster/ rtsa ba dang yan lag gi dam tshig rnams tshul bzhin du bsrung snyam pa dang bcas/ rdo rje 'dzin pa'i bka' bzhin du/ /bdag ni rtsegacig gus gdung bas/ /ma lus bdag gis bsgrubs lags na/ /brtse bas rjes bzung byin gyis rlabs zhes lan gsum gyi rjes zlos bya/ maṇ+ḍal 'bul/ lhag ma/chad mtho/stan skyong / rta bro/ gtang rag/ lhag chad bkang ba/ nyer bsdu/ smon lam shis brjod sogs gzhung ltar bya'o//khyod zhabs dran pa'i mod la srid dang zhi'i/ /gdung mun pha mthar byed pa'i drang srong che/ /sngon med zla ba gsar pa'i dkyil 'khor nas/ /byin rlabs ga pur gzegs ma chal chil 'dzag /phal cher bdag bskyed med pa'i rig gtad byed/ /la la wal gyis bsgom zhes ga' na snang 'drid/ /'ga' zhig 'tshol pa'i (6na thag len sna tsho gos sbyong / /rigs 'dzin brgyud pa'i ring lugs ming tsam gyur/ /de phyir gangs can lha gcig mu tig btsan/ /gos dkar lcang lo'i tshul 'dzin 'bri gung pa/ /gnam lcags me 'bar bzhed srol ji bzhin du/ /bkod 'dis gzung gnas blo gsal 'dod pa 'jo/ /'bad pa'i legs byas mthulas skye ba mā /zab gter 'di dang de ston yongs 'dzin rnams/ /ā+o la med lha sngagasaye shes rnal 'byor la/ /brten nas yid srubs g.yul las rgyal bar shog /gdod nas sgrib bral rang rig kun bzang zhal/ /mngon sum rjen par mthong min de srid du/ /'chi med drang srong che desarjes bzung nas/ /mchog thun dngos grub char chen 'bebs gyur cig /ces drang srong dri med zhi khro'i rig gtad kyi chog sgrigs thugs thigs snying bum g.yas 'khyil zhes pa 'di ni las byang sgrig rtsom gyi skabs dge slong 'jam dbyangs grags pas rig gtad 'di la chog sgrigs shig byung na zhes 'bad —512

gzhung chen bder gshegs 'dus pa'i snying po'i don kun tshang bar bsdus pa'i thug sgrub thog mda'i tsha dbal/ nang ma 6)pas bskul ba la brten nas za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni bskul ba po nyid kyis bgyis pa'i dge bas 'gro ba rnams bdud bzhi'i 'ching ba las grol ba'i rgyur gyur cig //sarba maṅga lo// //gzhung chen bder gshegs 'dus pa'i snying po'i don kun tshang bar bsdus pa'i thugs sgrub thog mda'i tsha dbal bzhugs/na maḥpad+mā kā ra kro dhe sgru ya/ mthu stobs gnam lcags tsha tsha khol ba'i thog /sdebargyad brag ri phyer 'thag drag rtsal nus/ /dran pas bdud bzhi'i dpung 'joms bla ma dang / /yi dam dbyer med khyod zhabs gtsug na bsten/ /nyang rigs ral pa'i khur ldan mnga' bdag gter/ /zab chos bye ba'i gdams pa stsol ba la/ /bka' drin zla med rje btsun khra tshang pa/ /blo mchog rdo rje kun bzang he ru daḥ/ /drag dmar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor yongs 'bar ba'i/ /byin rlabs bde gshegs 'dus pa'i 'od zer gyis/ /nyes brgya'i smag rum rab sel rgyun 'byer gyi/ /thugs sgrub mkha' 'gro'i zhal gyi drod rlangasa'adri/ /de yang bla ma mnga' bdag chen po nyi ma 'od zer gyi zab gter sangs rgyas gnyis pa pad+ma thod phreng gi thugs sgrub drag dmar rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum thems med dang bcas pa mtha' klas pa'i nang nas gzhung chen bder gshegs 'dus pa'i nyams len rgyas par spro na bla ma'i man ngag gis gung bsgrigs te gter gzhung kha 'thor ba khrigs su bsdebs nas bcos bslad med pa byin rlabs kyi tshan kha che bas de dag gi byed tshul kho bos brtsams pa'i bsnyen yig ma rlung 'khrug pa'i tsha ngar las shes par bya (2na)rigs na'ang ha cang rgyas drags pas bsnyen pa tshugs 'grol gyi thog mtha' gnyis tsam ma gtogs bar gyi thun bzhi tshor 'dzab kyi grangs la gnod cing rgyun 'khyer la 'jug pa bde ba sogs kyi ched du ji ltar 'os pa snying po bsdus te dgod pa la/ skyabs sems ni/ brgyud pa'i rtsab bla ma rje/ /dngos grub khrung ba yi dam lha/ /legs par byin brlab mkha' 'gro'i tshogs/ /rtsa ba gsum la —513

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (25)skyabs su mchi/ /bdag gzhan gnyis med don phyir du/ /drag po khro rgyal kun bsgrubs nas/ /snying po bla med mchos pa dang / /gzhan don byed par sems bskyed do/ /zhes so sor lan gsum sogs ci rigasabarjod/ tsho gos zhing ni/ mdun gyi nam mkhar paṃ pad+ma maṇ+ḍal hūṃ/ a tsan+d+ra maṇ+ḍal hūṃ/ me su rla maṇ+ḍal hūṃ/hūṃ/ dur khrod rin cen 'bar ba'i pho brang nas/ /'jigs byed che mchog badz+ra he ru gaḥ/ /dbang drag pad+ma bka' yi 'khor dang bcas/ /dbang drag las la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol/ /badz+ra sa ma ya dza: rngam brjid dgyes pa'i tshul gyis bzhugs su gsol/ /dbang drag pad+ma'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dbang drag pad+ma'i sku la mchod pa 'bul/ /dbang drag pad+ma'i sku la bzod par gsol/ /dug gsum zhal du gsol la yi rang ngo / /mya ngan (2bas 'dar bdag la thugs rjes gzigs/ /theg chen chosakyi 'khor lo bskor du gsol/ /bdag dang sems can byang chub thob par shog /ces gter gzhung gi tshig rkang tha ma bsdus pa ste sgom don ltar tsho gos bsags/ gzhal yas khang srung 'khor bcas pa ni/ /tshogs zhing 'od zhu spyi gtsug nas thim pas/ tha mal lus kyang 'od zhu rnam shes kyi/ /ngo bo hūṃ yig dmar po zhig tu gyur/ /de las 'od zer dmar pos 'jig rten khyab/ /sems can la phog las dang bag chags sbyangs/ /rnam shes dbang bsdus slar yang bder gshegs mchode/ /sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs bdag la thim/ /dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong thugs rgyud bskul/ /dbang dang dngos grub byin rlabs nus kun bsdus/ /hūṃ yig sngar bas gzi brjid bkrag dang ldan/ /'od dmar tsha rtsub rnam pa mtshon cha'i dbyibs/ /rgyob gsod brlag sgrar bcas pa grangs med 'phros/ /snang srid ltem gang sdobargyad gnod byed la/ /phog pas bya sgro mer bsregs lta bur brlag /tshe dbang mthu nus rdo phrul 'od tshul bsdus/ /sngar gyi gzi byin grogs gyur 'od zer dang / /drag po'i sgra yis stong gsum rab gang ba/ /slar 'dus shin tu gzi 'bar mgar mal gyi/ /tsha tsha lta bur 'phro zhing zhabrug par gyur/ /hūṃ las re chad dmar smug dur khrod me/ /sna tsho gos pad zla dregs steng sa bon babs/ /kai 'phros me ri gdan dang bcas pa rnams/ /'od zhu thod skam zlum po'i gzhal yas khang / /hūṃ las ye yaṃ raṃ ra / ke —514

gas r+sā bder gshegs 'dus pa'i snying po'i don kun tshang bar bsdus pa'i thugs sgrub thog mda'i tsha dbal/ nang ma 6)chad//nam mkha' rlung me khrag mtsho me sa'i gzhin//rus pa'i ri rab steng na gzhal yas khang /khru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs bzhi dang ldan//thod rtsig zhing chen ka ba zhing chung gzhu//tshangs gdung mchog phran 3na po za' skar dral ma bkab/sha chen nag leb nyi zla'i mthongs khung btod//zhing lpags bla bre gsur chen dud pa 'thul//thod skam pha gu pad+ma dra ba phyed//mda' yab pu shu rus chen mchod rten khrigs//zhing lhags rgyal mtshan ba dan rgyan kun spras//ser po'i 'od 'phros phyi rol gser 'khor rtsibs//brgyad pa g.yas 'khor dpal la lcags sdig mtshan//phyir 'od dmar las me 'khor g.yon 'khor ba//nang bstan rtsibs stong dpal las lcags sdig 'phro//de'i phyir rdo rje'i gur khang smug nag mar//me yi khro bo bya khyung dpag med 'tshub//gdan dang lha bskyed pa ni//gzhal yas dbus su po a ma yig las//sna tsho gis pad+ma zla nyi'i gdan steng na//rang sems hūṃ zhu 'od phung 'khyil ba las//bdag nyid drag po pad+ma sku mdog dmar//zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum dmar la zlum//zhal gdangs mtshe gcigs ag tshom tshe ltar 'bar//dbu skra dmar ser phyed brdzes lhag ring 'phyang //phyag g.yas gser gyi rdo rje rtse dgu pa/hūṃ dgu raṃ dgus mtshan las me dpung 'phro//lcags bsregs sdig pa kha dgu mig dgu pa//'jigs rung g.yon pa'i sdigs mdzub rtse nas 'gyed//zhing chen rked dkris la sogs dur khrod chas//rin cen rus rgyan klu rigs bzhi yi sprul//yan lag rab bcings brjed gtum rngams shing khros/khams gsum dbang sdud srid gsum zil gyis gnon//g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang dregs pa pho mo brdzis//ba spu'i bu gar gser rdor nas gos tsam//rwa dbar tsha tsha khol ba'i go khrab gyon//dung khang nang du 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi'i dbus//sku yi ngo bo 3ba 'jam dpal gser mdog can//khro tshul g.yas pa ral gri klad la bskor//g.yon pa thugs dar sdigs mdzub sems skyil bzhugs//rin cen rgyan spras dar gyi na bza' gsol//mgrin par 'dab bzhir khyoḥsgra'i ngo bo las//rta mgrin dmar po spyi gtsug rta skad sgrog/g.yas pa rdo rje dbyug pa g.yon sdis/sa mdzub/khro gtum dur khrod mas rdzogos zhabs dor stabs//thugs kar rgya gram steng na thugs ka snya//

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (25)gser mdog bang rim gsum pa bum bre 'khor/ /gdugs bcas lte bar dran rig ngo bo ni/ /phyag rdor mthing nag gser rdor sdigs mdzub mdzad/ /stag sham sbrul sogs khro mas zhabs dor stabs/ /lte bar chos sting pad+ma baṃ ro'i steng / /phag mo dmar mo gcer bu ga grol ba/ /gri gug thod khrag kha ṭ+wāṃ gru mor brten/ /g.yas pa'i rting pa bha gar bstad pa yi/ /bzhedas pa'i gar stabs rus pa'i rgyan gyis mdzes/ /dkar ser dmar ljang rang 'dra'i rigs bzhis bskor/ /rim bzhin thugs kur 'byu gsum ma yis mtshan/ /spyi bor 'phrin las ngo bo bya khyung rgyal/ /mthing nag me gzhog rdo rje'i mchu sder gyis/ /klu gnyan zhal gsol sbrul dang rin chen brgyan/ /thugs kar khrom mthing 'od 'bar rwa dbar du/ /nyi zla pad steng rigs bdag snang mtha' yas/ /dmar po mnyam gzhag mtshon gang sprul sku'i chas/ /bas bcur hūṃ mdzad la so gos khro brgyan ga /zhal gcig phyag gnyis tho ba lcags kyu 'dzin/ /brkyang bskum zhabs gnyis dregs brdzis rang 'dra ba'i/ /sprul pa 'gyed cing hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa sgras/ /gdug pa kun 'dul me dpung klong na bzhugs/ spyan 'dren ni/ hūṃ las 'od 'phros skyon gnas mchog nas/ /dbang drag pad+ma thod phreng rtsal gshegs shig /dam tshig pa (4na)dang ye shes gnyis med gyur/ /oṃ las 'od ser 'phros pas sku yi lha/ /dpag med byon pa dung khang lha la thim/ /mi shigs rdo rje sku yi dbang thob gyur/ /āḥlas 'od dmar 'phros pas gsung gi lha/ /dpag med byon pa mgrin pa'i lha la thim/ /'gags pa med pa gsung gi dbang thob gyur/ /hūṃ las 'od sngon 'phros pas thugs kyi lha/ /dpag med byon pa thugs ga'i lha la thim/ /skye med don dam thugs kyi dbang thob gyur/ /ma las 'od dmar 'phros pas yon tan lha/ /dpag med byon pa lte ba'i lha la thim/ /ma lus rdzogs pa'i yon tan dbang thob gyur/ khrom las 'od mthing 'phros pas na las lha/ /dpag med byon pa dbu gtsug khyung la thim/ /thogs pa med pa'i 'phrin las dbang thob gyur/ /yig 'bru lnga las 'od zer rnam lnga 'phros/ /snang mtha' la sogs bde gshegs thams cad kun/ /spyan drangs 'od dpag med la thim pa yis/ /sku gsung thugs yon 'phrin las dbang thob gyur/ khro bcu grangs med spyan drangs so sor thim / 5/6

g.yi r+sā bder gshegs 'dus pa' snying po'i don kun sgo bar bsdus pa'i thug sgrub thog mda'i tsha dbal/ nang ma 6)dang sngags phreng ba spu'i bu ga nas//me dbal mthing nag lcags kyi tho ba dang //me yi zhags thogasakhros ma glog lta bur//stigs pa 'jig rten khams khyab gnod byed rnams//bsad bcad gtubs nas thal ba'i rdul bzhin brlag/phyi nang kun gang srung dang bzlog pa'i las//bdag nyid sngar bas che btsan 'gran zla bral//lus dkyil lha yi sku las 'bar ba'i mes//lus gang nad gdon sgrib pa'i dri ma bsregs//lus nang mar me sbar ltar lha rnams gsal//lus ngag yid gsum bde ba'i nyams dang ldan//phyi nang 'khor ba'i rtsibs bar dgra bgegs kyi//ske gtubs brul zhing sha khrag dmar nyog btags//'dzab ni/gzhal 4bges nang du bsrung bya lha'i rnam pa//phyag rdor thugs kar zla nyi'i steng du hūṃ//dmar po'i mtha' nas g.yas su sngags kyis bskor//mgal me'i 'khor lo lta bur 'khor bar gyur//rtsa sngags la sham bu 'dogs lugs man ngag ltar byas te bsnyen//thun mtshamasasu gtor ma 'bul tshul shog dril las nye bar bsdus te/raṃ yaṃ kho/ā+oṃ āḥ& ma hā bha lin+ta/te dz+wa bha lin+ta/bha la bha te/gu ༅ sa ma ye swāhā/lan gsum gyis brlab/mdun gyi nam mkhar paṃ pad+ma maṇ+ḍal nas//dbang drag pad+ma'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo//zhes pa'i bar tshogs zhing ltar/hūṃ//rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa yi//byang chub bsgrub la bar gcod byed pa dang //gzugs can dgra dang gzugs med bgegs la sogs//drag pos bsgral ba'i sha khrag rus pa' tshogs//dbang drag pad+ma'i sku la mchod par 'bul//ā+oṃ āḥ& ma hā me sa khā hi/ma hā rak+ta khā hi/mahā tsit+ta khā hi/ma hā bha su ta khā hi/dbang po lnga khā hi/go ro tsa na khā hi/bstod cing 'phrin las 'chol ba gter gzhung las btusapa ni/hūṃ/khams gsum gnas nas stobs ldan rdzu 'phrul can//nub phyogs bde ba can gyi zhing khams nas/ /snang ba mtha' yas sku gsung thugs las sprul/ /ngo mtshar med byung badz+ra he ru gaḥ//'jigs byed khro rgyal rdo rje thod phreng rtsal//drag po pad+ma'i lha tshogs rnams la bstod//hūṃ/dur khrod 'jigs su rung ba'i pho brang nas//rngam brjid stobs ldan pad+ma thod phreng bskul//bdag ni bla med byang chub bsgrub pa la//lam la bar du gcod pa'i /gra bgegs rnams//dbang drag pad+ma 'khor dang

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (25)bcas pa yis/ /thugs rjes (ldan jig po'i stobs kyis bsgral nas kyang / khu spya gsum mthing nag 'bar ba'i zhal du drongs/ /gsung dbyangs drug cu ldan pa'i mgur du bsgril/ /don dam skye med thugs kyi dkyil du bstim/ /rnal 'byor bdag gi 'dod pa'i don rnams ni/ /dbang drag pad+ma 'khor dang bcas pa yis/ grub par mdzod cig badz+ra sa ma ya/ /ma mgon sdebargyad la gtor ma bsngo ba ni/hūṃ/ nyi ma phyogs phyogs pha gi na/ /sum cu rtsa gsum lha gnas kyi/ /rnam par rgyal ba'i khang bzang gi /byang sar mtshams kyi phyogs dag na/ /rtsub 'gyur tshal gyi dur khrod nas/ /ma hā kā la gshegs su gsol/ /bh+yo/ nyi ma phyogs phyogs pha gi na/ /chos bzang lha yi 'dun sa yi/ /byang shar mtshams kyi 'jig rten na/ /yongs 'du shing gi rtsa ba na/ khu le ding gi nag shed nas/ /dpal ldan lha mos/ shar nas lha yi gtso bo sko/ /lho nas ya ma rā tsam/ /nub nas srid pa'i rgyal mo sko/ /byang nas bskos rje brang dkar〉/ shar lho'i srog zan dmar por/ /lho nub pe dkar rgyal por/ khub byang ka la yaka྾/ /byang shar klu bdud mgo dgu / /dur khrod gzhal yas chosang rtsibs brgyad steng / /pad+ma nyi ma ro yi gdan la bzhugs/ kha khrag bdud rtsi'i gtor ma rgya mtsho'i tshogs/ /'bul gyi 'khor dang bcas pa dgyes par rol/ /oṃ badz+ra ma hā kwa la badz+ra re ma tī/ /a ya ma du ru tsa sha na ma hā bha liṅka khā hi/ mgon po ber nag thod can khram/ /ru mtshon 'dzin cing rta nag bcibs/ khring mo bags rgya zhe ral gri dang / /nad rkyal thogs nas drel rta zhon/ /sdebargyad 'khor dang bcas pa rnams/ /rlung nasamagyogs par myur du rgyug /srod la dgra bo'i bla khug la/ /nam phyed dam nyams(5ba tha rgyal du chug /tho rengs dgra bo'i srog rtsa chod/ /snying khrag dron mo zhal du gsol/ /bstan pa'i ru dra sdig can ni/ /myur du bsgral ba'i dus la bab/ /ces bskul zhing bdud rtsi sbreng / /rak+ta 'phyar/ gtor ma btang /bshags pa bya/ bkra shis brjod/ bsngo ba smon lam bya'o/ /gter kha gong ma'i drag sgrub bde 'dusal/ /rnying mar mkhas 'ga' snga 'gyur lugs spyi 'gebs/ /gsar ma ba dag phyi 'gyur sgrub thabs kyi/ /zhwa dpe lham gyis byed mthong tshig dgod 'chor/ /mdo sngags yongs la sbyangs pa'i yus po che/ /min —518—

'chi bdag bzlog byed kyi gyer gzhung 'chi bdag g.yul las rgyal ba'i ru mtshon/ nang ma tanakyang gter byon so so'i bzhed pa'i srol/ /ma 'dres bla ma'i drin gyis rtogs pa'i tshe/ khun nag mda' 'phen ma dgos blo re bde/ /dge 'dis skye ba kun tu thod phreng rtsal/ /snying gi ze'u 'brur bzhugs la bshes mdzad de/ /rang rig bla ma'i ngo bo yongs grol zhing / /gnas skabs las bzhi'i 'phrin las myur 'grub shog /mnga' bdag khri srong lde'u btsan gyi skye ba bcu gsum pa nyang nyi ma 'od zer gyi zab gter drag po gzhung chen bder gshegs sa pa'i snying po'i don kun tshang bar bsdus pa'i thugs sgrub thog mda'i tsha dbal zhes pa 'di ni rang nyid kyi rgyun khyer dang snod ldan 'ga' la'ang phan par 'gyur ram snyam pa'i lhag bsam gyis yid drangs nas zur thams cad mkhyen pa chos dbyings rang grol dang khyab bdag khra tshang pa blo gros mchog gi rdo rje'i bka' drin las zab lam 'di la thos bsam sgom pa'i blo can za hor gyi sngags spyon rdo rje thogs med rtsal gyis kun dga'i lo mgos nya ba'i dmar cha'i dga' ba dang po la ri bo gru 'dzin gyi gzhal med khang du sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni gnas brtan 'jam dbyangs grags pa'o// // 'chi bdag bzlog byed kyi gyer gzhung 'chi bdag g.yul las rgyal ba'i ru mtshon zhes bya ba bzhugs so/a gra ta sirnyi pra la mkhyen brtse nus pa'i 'od zer 'bum phrag gis/ /'chi bdag mun pa'i smag dras mthar mdzad pa'i/ /tshe dbang rigs 'dzin brnyes pa'i pad+ma 'byung / /lus can kun la 'chi med dngos grub stsol/ /gang gi zab gter a skra'i tshal chen la/ /lha brag gter gyi 'bras bu smin pa'i bcud/ /skal ldan 'gro la ster mkhas rgod ldem can/ /brgyud par bcas pa'i rig sngags 'chang rnams rgyal/ khyad par ga lhags ban dzñā na ku mā ra/ /bshes gnyen zol la brten pa'i rdo rje 'dzin/ /dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i mgon po ā nan+da/ /dus kun rigs kyi bdag por brtan gyur cig /—519

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (25)'khrul med dam pa'i spu gri rnon po yis/ /'chi bdag pho nya'i zhags pa rab bcad de/ /'dzad med tshe la ring du longs spyod pa'i/ /mi 'jigs sbyin pa'i sgo 'phar 'dir phye na/ /'gong po'i gdon gyis zin min gzu bo'i blo/ /ldan rnams 'dir 'dus ci gar longs spyod dang / /bsams pa'i re ba yongs su skong byed pa'i/ /bdud rtsi'i bum bzang lag tu thob par nges/ /de yang 'chi bdag 'joms pa'i cho ga'i rim pa/ /gter kha so sor rnam grangs mang du mchis pa las/ /'dir rigs 'dzin chen po rgod kyi ldem phru can gyis byang zang zang lha brag gi (2na)rked bse sgrom smug po'i lho gser mdzod ser po nas gdan drags pa'i 'chi bdag nag po bzlog byed kyi gyer gzhung gi rim pa khrigs su bsdebs pa ni/ lag len dang cho ga'i cha lag rnams bla ma'i phyag len gyis brgyan te mngon par 'du byas la/ ngag 'don dngos ni/ thugs sgrub kyi las byang gzhung bsrang / bka' srung gi bskang gso/ /tsho gos tham rtsagasum bskang gsodang bcas pa btang rjes/ glud bsngo ba ni/ hūṃ/ stong gsum kun tu dri mchog 'byung gyur pa'i/ /spos dang sman sbyar chu gtsang dag pa'i khrus/ /yid bzhin sprin phung mkha' la char 'bebasapas/ /mi gtsang dri ma'i tsho gos kun dag gyur cig /ā+oṃ shu khye shudhe shodha na ye swāhā/ hūṃ/ pad sdong 'dab drug khri 'phang bzhin/ /nyi ma zla ba'i gdan steng du/ /bdag nyid rdo rje sems dpa'i sku/ /dkar gsal zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ /rdo rje dril bu thugs kar 'dzin/ /dar dang rin chen du mas spras/ /spyi gtsug bla ma kun bzang mthing / /mtshan dpes spras pa yum dang sbyor/ /sku yi gnas su zhi khro'i lha/ /chu nang zla ba lta bur gsal/ /ā+oṃ badz+ra satwa hūṃ/ 'dab drug shar gyi pad 'dab la/ /sbyong ba'i lha ni shāka thub ser/ /phyag gnyis sa gnon lhung (2ba〉zed bsnams/ /mtshan dang dpe byad ldan par bzhugs/ /thal mo khong stong phyag rgya'i nang / /a dkar 'od yodangos 'dzin sbyangs/ /ā+oṃ su bhā wa shuḥsarba dharmā:su bhā wa shurnyo3nya/ sngags 'di lan bdun brjod pa'i mthus/ /snod bas dngos 'dzin dag gyur cig /de yi mtshams kyi pad 'dab la/ /spel ba'i lha ni rnam snang dkar/ /phyag na 'khor lo dril bu bsnams/ /mtshan dang dpe byad sko/ /thal mo tshigs bcag phyag rgya'i nang / khaṃ sngon 'od 'phros snod —520

'chi bdag bzlog byed kyi gyer gzhung 'chi bdag g.yul las rgyal ba'i ru mtshon/ nang ma 6)bcud spel/ /ā+oṃ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bh+yo bi shwa mu khe saḥ sarba tad kho lpa ra ṇa i paṃ ga ga na kho swāhā/sngags 'di lan bdun mo/ /snod bcud legs tshogos spel gyur cig /de yi mtshams kyi pad 'dab la/ /bsgyur lha bdud rtsi 'khyil ba ljang / /phyag mtshan rgya gram dril bu bsnams/ /mtshan dang dpe byad za/ /thal mo kha gyer phyag rgya'i nang / /dza dmar 'od 'phros bdud rtsir bsgyur/ /ā+oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa ha na ha na hūṃ phaṭa/ sngags 'di lan bdun sko/ /snod bcud zag med bdud rtsir gyur/ /de yi mtshamasakyi pa darki/ /thob lha rin 'byung sku mdog ser/ /phyag na rin chen dril bu bsnams/ /mtshan dang dpe byad mo/ /mchog sbyin phyag rgya tre ser las/ /'od 'phros kun gyis 'bad med thob/ /na ma mi rba ta thā ga ta a wa lo gi te oṃ sam+bha ra sam+bha ra hūṃ/ sngags 'di lan bdun ri/ /mgron rnams kun gyis thob gyur cig /de yi mtshams kyi mo/ /tshim lha don yod grub pa ljang / /phyag mtshan ral gri dril bu bsnams/ /mtshan dang dpe byad ldan par bzhugs/ khu tshur mchog sbyin phyag rgya'i nang / /ha ljang 'od 'phros mgron mnyes bsam/ /ā+oṃ dzñā na a wa lo ki te na mas man+ta snya ra (3na)kha ra smi bha wa ma hā ma ṇi du ru du dra: da ya dza la ni swāhā/ sngags 'di lan bdun mo/ mgron kun dgyes shing tshim gyur cig /de yi mtshamasakyir/ /dbang r+ṣa phyag rdor ljang dmar ni/ /phyag mas rdo rje dril bu bsnams/ /mas dang dpe byad ldan par bzhugs/ /sor bsnol phyag rgya dza dmar las/ /'od los mgro ne bzhi'i mthu stobos bsdus/ /na ma sma man+ta bud+dhā nī gra he shwa ri pra bhañdza na mahā sa ma ya hūṃ phaṭa/ sngags 'di lan bdun brjod pa'i mthus/ dbang bsdus 'phrin las kun 'grub shog /ces sngags drug dang phyag rgya drug gis byin gyisabarlabs te/ hūṃ/ 'chi bdag nag po gshin rje'i gtsaḥ bgegs kyi rgyal po chen po dang ཿ steng gdon lha srin dregs pa canaḥ 'og gdon klu srin klu gnyan dang ཿ bar gdon bdud dang rgyal po btsanaḥ srid pa'i pho 'dre mo 'dre dang ཿ mgon po dam sri ma ning gdon: gshin rje pho nya 'bum brag dang : dregs pa sdo brgyad ma lus paḥ dpon dang g.yog 'khor bcas pa laḥ bdag gas gyi go du yin na/ mi las lhag pa'i re/ las lhag pa'i gzugs dang glud: sngags dang phyag rgyas byin rlabs nas: srid pa'i lha srin —521—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (25)kun la 'bulaḥ khyer cig khyer cig gdon gyi tshogasaḥ 'dod sred chags sdang bral bar bgyi mthong dag reg pa'i bsam ga rtulaḥ gzung ba thong la bcings pa slod: 'dzin pa'i zhen pa dang grol cigaḥsngon gyi lan chags sha 'khon dang ཿ bu lon 'phral gyi rkyen rnams kun: thams cad ma lus 'khor bar gyis: bdag gi bsam pa'i stobs dang niḥ de bzhin gshegs pa'i sbyin stobs dang ཿ cho ge kyi dbyingasakyi stobs rnams kyisaḥ gdon bgegs ma lus thams cad kyiḥ bsam pa yid (3ba)bzhin 'grub gyur cigaḥ lan gsum brjod de gzhung bzhin rdzong : rgyas par spro na glud rabs gzhan nas sting ba ltar byas kyang rung bar sems so/ /slob dpon gyis srung sngags bzla zhing srung 'khor bsgom/ /bla ma gshin rje gshed du gsal gdab pa ni/ rang nyid bla ma rdo rje drag rtsal du/ /gsal ba skad cig tsam gyis gnas 'gyur te/ khru gsum mthing nag mkha' steng rlung nag gzug /bskal pa'i me 'bar steng na rgya mtsho che/ /mthing nag rba klong 'khyil ba mkha' la 'phyo/ sru brtan rdo rje'i sa gzhi rnam par bkra /gsal ba de steng du ya rag nan/ /zhes pa'i sngags kyi gshin rje pho mo ni/ /zung lnga bskyel ba'i steng du pad+ma dang / /zla nyi brtsegs steng ya ma me da k+ṣe/ /yi ge kha dog rnam pa lngar 'bor bas/ /'od zer 'phro 'du yongs su gyur ba las/ /dbus kyi mthing nag ya las bdag nyid sku/ /ngo bo rigs 'dzin bla ma rnam pa ni/ /bcom ldan dpal chen 'jam dpal gshin rje gshed/ /sku mdog mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ /sku che rags pa ri rab lhun por bsnyes/ /dbu yis tshangs pa'i 'jig rten thang du slebs/ /sdang mig spyan gzigs zhal gdangs mche ba gtsigs/ /smin ma sma ra ag tshom me ltar 'bar/ kham nag dbu skra gyen du rnam par 'khyil/ /phyag g.yas zhing gi be con mkha' la 'phyar/ /g.yon pa zhags pa dang bcas sdigs mdzub mdzad/ /rigs lnga'i sangs rgyas dbu brgyan dur khrod kyi/ /chas brgyad ma lus sku la yongs su rdzogs/ /zhabs gnyis g.yas brkyang g.yon bskum tshul du bzhugs/ /mdun gyi gdan steng ma yig yongs gyur las/ /ya ma rā dza smug nag g.yas pa na/ /lcags kyi be con g.yon pa 'khor lo 'dzin/ /g.yas kyi gdan steng me yig yongs gyur las/ /myos(4na)byed 'bar —522

'chi bdag bzlog byed kyi gyer gzhung 'chi bdag g.yul las rgyal ba'i ru mtshon/ nang ma 6)ba ser nag g.yas pa na/ /gser gyi be con g.yon pa 'khor lo 'dzin/ /rgyab kyi gdan steng du da yig yongs gyur las/ khro bo ar+ya dmar po g.yas pa na/ /zangs kyi be con g.yon pa 'khor lo 'dzin/ /g.yon gyi gdan steng k+ṣe yig yongs gyur las/ /ral pa tshar dgu ljang nag g.yas pa na/ /g.yu yi be con g.yon pa 'khor lo 'dzin/ /rnam 'gyur rgyan cha gtso bo dang mtshungs gyur/ /ā+oṃ ya mān+ta g.ya ma me da k+ṣe/ rā dza sa ho/ ru na yo ni/ ra ya tsa ni hūṃ phaṭa/ du raṃ hri yang 'dri dbyung ha gzer thong / /gshin rje 'chi bdag nag po'i gnod pa e hur zum dza/ kho shag ro myags mugs ti rbad ya/ zhes gong bsnyen gyi 'dzab ci nus su bzla/ mdun bskyed ni/ /ā+oṃ su bhā wa bi shu sarba dharmā su bhā wa bi shurnyo ྅gi/ chos rnamasami dmigs stong pa nyid du gyur/ /stong pa'i ngang las e raṃ yongs gyur pas/ /'og bzhi lcags mkhar gru gsum nag po la/ /bskal pa 'i dus mtha me dpung 'ur 'ur 'bar/ /de yi nang du srog chags 'bum phrag gi /baṃ ro gsar rnying brtsigs pa'i khri steng du/ /skad cig tsam gyis yi ge ya dag du/ /mthing nag 'od zer 'phro 'du yongs gyur las/ /'jig rten las la grub pa'i 'chi bdag ni/ /srid gsum za ba'i gshin rje ma rungs pa/ /mun pa bye bas byugs pa ltar gnag pa'i/ /mdog can srin po drag tu khrosapa'i gzugs/ khro gnyer g.yo zhing mig gsum sdang mig blta/ /dmar ser ral pa'i thor cog spyi bor bcings/ /smin ma sma ra dus mtha'i me ltar 'bar/ /gnam sa gdangs pa tsam gyi kha nang du/ /rab dkar mche ba gangs ri lta bu gtsigs/ /lte ni glog 'phreng 'khrigs pa bzhin du 'khyug /yan lag rnams(4ba〉) nywa sum re re la/ /rgyang grags gsum gyi tshad dang rnam par ldan/ /yan lag bzhi yi sen mo rno ngar can/ /lcags kyu bkug pa lta bur ra btu 'jigs/ /g.yas pa 'jig rten ma lus 'degs nus pa'i/ /phung bar byed pa'i bdud kyi khram shing dang / /skye 'gro 'ching ba'i zhags pa nag po thogs/ /g.yon pa srog rtsa ma lus gcod byed pa'i/ /ral gri so gcig pa ni 'dzin zhing 'phyar/ /thod skam dbu brgyan rus pa'i rgyan mas dang / /sprul gyi gdu bu pags rlon gos su gyon/ /ro smad stag lpags rlon ba'i sham thabs dkris/ /lto ba rab yangs srid pa'i grong khyer bcas/ /rgya mtsho chen po'i pha mtha' 'gebs—523—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()nus pa'i//'jigs rung ma he nag po'i steng na 'gying //rgyab tu las kyi las ma'i phung po 'khyil//'chi bdag mdun du zhe sdang las grub pa'i//gshin rje nag po kha gdangs mche ba gtsigs//nywa sul rags shing yan lag rnam par bgrad//mthong ba tsam gyis skye 'gro'i srog dbugs 'phrog/g.yon du phrag dog 'khrugs pa las byung bdud//sdig pa nag po rwa dang kha mig gdangs//yan lag bgrad cing mjug ma lcags kyu ltar//bkug cing mthong ba tsam gyis 'jigs par byed//rgyab tu gti mug 'thibs pa las byung bdud/sru mkhregs lcags las rnam par grub pa yi//ru dang gshog pa gdengasapa'i phye ma leb//tshul can skye 'gro'i srog la rnam par rgol//g.yon du 'dod chags zhen pa las byung ba'i/khrog dbugs sha khrag za la rab rngam pa'i//'jigs su drang ba'i dred mo dmar nag gzugs//mche ba gtsigs shing sbar mo rnon po bgrad//gzhan yang kha gdangs mche gtsigs 'jigs su rung //sna tsho gos mtsho ni cha thogs nas bla tshe brku//srid gsum ma lus myul ba'i ldan tshe/den rje yi//grangs med 'khor gyis yongs su bskor bar gyur//ā+oṃ badz+ra tri /ṇa kha thi hūṃ/zhes bzlas shing a sgrub/mi bzad rno ngar ldan pa yis//thun nag brabs pas sa gzhi gas//mtha' yi rgya mtsho cher nag pa//mer mer mngon sum gsal bar gyur//yang sngar gyi sngags dang bcas te a rdeg/dza/rang nyid gshin rje gshed gsal ba'i//thugs ka las 'phros 'od zer ni//lcags kyu rnon po lta bu yis//'chi bdag gshin rje'i tsho gos rnams bkug/ā+oṃ srin dza ma ri hūṃ dza dzaḥ& baṃ sngos ma ya dza dza/zhes phyag rgya dang bcas lan mang du brjod/ā+oṃ badz+ra a khra tas bgegs bsangs/su bhā was sbyangs/stong pa'i ngang las a las byung ba'i thod pa yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du khrag gi a /sha chen gyi dud pa/dbang po'i me tog/zhun chen gyi mar me/mkhris chen gyi dri chab/sha rus kyi zhal zas/rkang gling snyan pa'i rol mor bcas pa/'chi bdag gshin rje'i rgyal po 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi dbang po drug tshim par byed pa'i mchod sprin zad mi shes pa nam mkha' dang mnyam par gyur/ā+oṃ a ha ra a ha ra sarba bi du ra pā da ti hūṃ/sgru be hūṃ/stso ṭaṃ/ā lo ge hri/gharnye gan/kriṣ+ṭha dza ma ri ha bha lin+ta 'a hi/zhes mchode 4

'chi bdag bzlog byed kyi gyer gzhung 'chi bdag g.yul las rgyal ba'i ru mtshon/ nang ma rkanapa dang gtor ma 'bul lo/ /gtor 'bul dngos ni/ su bhā was sbyangs/ na ma mi bo ta thā ga te bh+yo bi shwa mu khe ṣ+ṭhaḥ sarba ta da kham u ṅga te rdza ra ṇa i me ga ga na khaṃ swāhā/ ā+oṃ āḥ// lan gsum brjod byin gyisabarlabs/ ā+oṃ du ti bhi dza hūṃ tha 4 ṣ+ṭha dza ma ri/ ma hā ba kla ta khā hi/ i dan ba kla ta kha kha 'a hi khā hi/ bdun nam gsum gyis phul/ de nas rdo rje dril bu dang rol (5bcu thogs nas 'di skad ces brjod do/ /hūṃ/ ya las grub pa'i stobs po che/ /du las grub pa'i rdo 'phrul can/ khams gsum srid pa'i dbang po che/ /ma rungs dregs pa kun gyi rje/ /'byung ba'i 'khor los thams cad 'joms/ /skye 'gro'i sha khrag dbugs la za/ /srog 'phrog gshin rje nag po ni/ /sku mdog mthing nag mun dras 'khyil/ /spyan gsum khro gnyer glog ltar 'khyug /lcags kyi ral pa mi mgos brgyan/ /ljags 'dril mche ba gtsigs pa yis/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas ma gtogs pa'i/ /tshangs pa'i 'jig rten man chad nas/ /'jag mig srin bu yan chad kyi/ /srog dbugs za ba'i stobs po che/ /srog bdag gshin rje nag po khyod/ /g.yas pa khrag shing mig dgu yis/ /skye 'gro srog dbugs khram la 'debs/ /mun zhags nag po mda' ltar 'phen/ /rlung ltar mgyogs pas 'gro drug 'ching / /g.yon pa gri nag sogacig gis/ /'gro ba'i srog rtsa nyal thag gtsod/ /sen mo lcags kyu'i mtshon cha yis/ /'gro drug ro yi lus kun gtub/ /rngams pa'i stobs kyis phyogs bcur rgyug /'jig rten khams kyi stobs po che/ /kun gyi gzi brjid stobs༄ ba/ /drag shul can la mchod par dbul/ /zhes bstod/ de nas me rta ge 'thor zhing / kye/ 'chi bdag gshin rje 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad dgongs su gsol/ /bdag dang khams gsum gyi sems can thams cad dang / /deng yon gyi bdag po ming 'di zhes bya ba la/ /'chi bdag gi rgyal po 'khor dang bcas pa khyod rnams kyis/ /sngon bskal pa dpag tu med pa'i thog ma nas dus da lta yan ho du/ bu lon dang / lan chags dang / stong khrin dang / nyen mongs pa'i las kyi rkyen ci yod pa (6na)thams cad da lta nyid du 'jal bar bgyi/ /tshe dang srog la bar du gcod pa thamasacad zhi bar gyur cig /lusang ga yid gsum bar du gcod pa'i rkyen du 'gro ba/ 'gal bar byed pa'i —525

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtshogasung 'bum/ ()las gang yang ma byed cig/lan gsum brjod/lan chags 'jal rgya'i yas rnams sngags drug phyag rgya drug gis byin gyis brlabs/'bru sna btung ba'i bye brag rnams//bre lagazhal te 'bul bar gyis//sha mar dar zab rin r+ṣa sogs//srang la bteg nas 'bul bar gyis//grangs rnams rim par 'dren bzhin mang por spel ba'i sngags kyang brjod/de rjes glud rabs tshar gcig bto /lha'i nga rgyal gyis 'di skad do//hūṃ/ri rgyal lhun po'i sa 'og na//rgya mtsho 0 i gto rum na//rma nag 'tshub ma'i steng shed na//bskal pa'i me dang rgya mtsho'i bar//lcags bsregs nag po'i sa gzhi la//lcags kyi khang pa sgo med nang //gshin yul 'jig rten rme nag ces//zin nas thar pa med pa'i gnas//'jigs su rung ba'i gnas de na//'chi bdag chos kyi rgyal po khyod//mdzo shes mas dang rdzu phrul ldan//dge sdig chos bzhi spyod pa'o/khyod la lan chags stong khrin du//'byor ba'i longasaspyod glud 'bul gyi//'jig rten sa steng lha mi'i yul//dge bcu dam chos spyod pa'i sar//deng nasami lo bstogasum du//'chi bdag zhags pas ma 'debs shig/gshin rje'i pho nya ma gtong zhig/'jam dpal ya mān+ta ka yi//bka' dang dam las ma 'da' zhig/ā+oṃ ya mān+ta ka ya ba ti sam ya na ra skan/rtse gsum gyis bdud rtsi lce thog tu bzhag nas mna' chu blud//dam bsgrag pa ni/hūṃ/chosadabyings ka dag gsal stong 6bstadzin med la//'khor ba mya ga 'das par ro gcig pas//gnod bya gnod byed gnod pa'i yul la sogs//rdul phran tsam yang grub pa ga la zhig/'dzin med 'dzin pa zhugs pa'i 'khrul ngo sa/lus srog longs spyod de 'joms dgra bgegs sogs//sgyu ma'i rol pa ji bzhi snang ba kun//rten 'brel thabs kyis mi bzlog gang yang med//'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug las grub pa'i/khyud gsum dregs pa'i tshogs rnams ma lus pa//sngon tshe dpal chen khrag 'thung he ru gas//srog gi snying po ma lus blangs min na mo//bye brag 'chi bdag gshin rje'i tshogasarnams kun//phyag rgya ma lus zil gyis gnon byed pa'i//'jam dpal dpa' bo dus kyi dgra chen pos//srog snying blangs nas dam la ma btags saX/khyad par dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyi dngos //

'chi bdag bzlog byed kyi gyer gzhung waṃ bdag g.yul las rgyal ba'i ru mtshon/ nang ma 9)phyon slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis//ma rungs 'dul phyir lang ga'i lho phyogs kyi//dug sdong nag po'i 'gram du bzhugs pa'i tshe//nam gyi srod yol dus su mtha'i rgya mtsho//mkha' la 'phyo zhing rba klong zhakhrug pa dang //gdug pa'i skad sgrog sa gzhi nags tshal g.yo//lha srin 'bros so gos mi rung ltas dang bcas/khrid zhig tsam na rgya mtsho'i 'gram dag nas//'chi bdag nag po ral pa'i thor cog can//'jigs rung gzugs can rang dang 'dra ba'i 'bor//'bum phrag mang pos bskor te sa steng du//'o pas tshe rigs 'dzin pad+ma thod phreng rtsal//zhe ca gshin rje gshed po'i ting won gyi//'a mi bdag nag po'i srog snying 'phrogs min nam//srid pa'i rtse nas dmyal ba yan chad du//nga yis dbang gyur thams cad brlag nus pas//yal gam chen po nga yi gnas 'di na//ma 'dug ces pa'i khengs tshig 7na sa pa'i lan//khyod ni 'jig rten zhabrul pa'i bdag po ste//nga ni 'khor 'das kun la dbang sgyur bas//gnam lcags 'bar ba'i be con 'di brgyab na/khyed kyang thal ba'i rdul du brlag par 'gyur//'gas med rdo rje'i tshig de thos pa na//zhus bzhin skrag nas slob dpon zhabs la gtugs//rdzas sngags ting 'dzin 'khrul 'khor la brten nas//'chi bdag bzlog pa'i cho ga ma lus phul//nyams su blangs na 'chi bdag lag chud kyang //lo lngar bzlog pa khas len ma byas bsam//de tshe rgyal dbang pad+ma ka ra yis//srin po khrag mig bsgral ba'i sha khrag sogs//mthun rdzas sngags dang phyag rgyas byin rlabs nas//lus can kun gyi don du bsngos pa'i tshe//bcu gsum lo yi bar du 'gro ba la//gnod pa spong ba'i dam bca' byas min nam//de ltar slob dpon chen po nas bzung ste//rigs 'dzin rtsa brgyud bla ma mtha' dag gis//dpal ldan dus dgra'i ting 'dzin la brten nas//gshin rje dam btags 'chi bdag g.yul las rgyal//deng 'dir rig sngags long ba bdag cag rnams//sgrub la mchog gi ded dpon mtsho skyes rje//ring lugs brgyud pa'i bka' srol ma nyams pa//thos bsam bsgom pa'i byin rlabs mtshan kha can//'dzin med spros bral lta ba'i klong yangs su//gsal stong ting 'dzin 'phro 'du 'gog pa med//mthun pa'i rdzas dang zab mo'i gsang sngags bcas//

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()dus min 'chi ba bzlog pa'i thabs bsgrub na//sngon nas khas blangs dam bcas dam tshig dang //rten 'brel rgyu rkyen tsho gos pa'i nus mthu yis//sbyin bdag che ge mo zhes bya ba rnams/khram la btab pa yod na khram kha phyis/kho la btab na rde'u 7brkokar nag spos//bdud kyi zhags pas bcings na mdud pa khrol//byad du bcug na byad thag myur du chod//'di la dus min 'chi ba'i ltas yin na//bcu gsum bar du mi 'chi bgol thob cig/gal srid dus la bab cing tshe zad kyang //lo gsum bar du mi 'chi bshol thob cig/bsgo ba'i bka' la nyan par mi byed na/khas blags dam bca' nyams pa'i bka' go dang //rtsa ba gsum gyi bden pa'i byin chas dang //ting 'dzin sngags dang phyag rgya'i nus pa yis//gdug can khyod kyi mgo bo tshal bar 'gas//de bas mi la glud dga' glud 'di khyer//lan chags bu len 'di yis tshim gyis la/'di ru ma 'dug rang gi yul du song //de nas/'chi bdag gshin rje kha bsgyur te bteg/di a yi/bskal pa dus mtha'i rlung shugs dang //ldan pa'i rnga mo yisabateg nas//'chi bdag glud dang bu lon bcas//lho yi phyogs su 'gro bar gyur//hūṃ/'chi bdag gshin rje nag po'i tshogs/khyod ni las rdzu 'phrul can//'gro ba'i srog bdag chen po khyod//ma rungs gshin rje'i 'khor gyis bskor//bgegs kyi rgyal po 'khor bcas la//mchod sbyin gtor glud bzang po dang //bu lon lan chags bcal zin gyis//glud dang gtor ma 'di long la//nga yi sems bskyed gnas 'di sa/gshin rje'i gnod pa ma btang zhig/bdud kyi khram la btab pa phyis//'chi bdag zhags pas ma 'ching zhig/sngon chad bcings na da lta khros//skye 'gro gsod pa'i las ma byed//dud kyi khram ka slar la brtul/khams gsum sems can thams cad la//gnod cing 'tshe bar ma byed par//lan gas stong khrin yol zin gyis//glud dang gtor ni sgo 'di long la//'di nasalho yi phyogs su bskyod//dpag 3 brgyad khri bzhi stong gi/pha rol rgya mtsho nag po'i gting //nyi ma zla ba med pa'i gnas//mun rum 'khyil ba'i nang shed na//'chi bdag gshin rje'i rang yul yod//skyod cig gshin rje de ru skyod//gshegs shig 'a/ 8 'khor bcas gshegs//bgegs kyi rgyal

'chi bdag bzlog byed kyi gyer gzhung 'chi bdag g.yul las rgyal ba'i ru mtshon/ nang ma 'dapo da skyod cig /lan gsum brjod de/ rol mo'i sgra wo po dang bsag bto / drag sngags mang du bzla zhing / thun gyis brag bzlog sngags ci rigs bzla/ de nas/ ā+oṃ ya ma me da snye/ ra tsa gto/ ru na yo ni/ra ya tsa ni/ sarba tsa tu ra nan/ snying gzer breng shag yi rbad/ tshar ji ltar rigs pa bzlas rjes/dpal ldan gshin rje gshed kyi lha tsho gos kyis/ /nam mkha'i khyon kun ma lus rab bkang ste/ /'od zer mtshon cha sna tsho gos sa pa yis/ /thogs med mas stobos nus pa'i rdzu phrul gyis/ /'chi bdag gshin rje bdud dang bgegs kyi tshogs/ /chom sgra dang bcas rgya mtsho'i klong bskyal te/ dpag tshad brgyad khri bzhi stong 'og rol tu/ khun rum mtha' med gshin rje'i yul song nas/ /bskal pa 'di nyid ma 'das bar dag tu/ /thon pa'i go skabs cung zad med par gyur/ /zhes brjod cing dmigs pa dang bcas chu bo chen po la dor ba bya'o/ / phyir log cing srung sngags brjod/ sgo drung du mtshams gtsod pa ni/ dang por thig le nyag cig rgya/ /gnyis pa thabs dang shes rab rgya/ /gsum pa sku gsung thugs kyi rgya/ /bzhi pa tshad med bzhi yi rgya/ /lnga pa rgyal ba rigs lnga'i rgya/ khrug pa thub pa drug gi rgya/ /bdun pa sangs rgyas rabs bdun rgya/(8ba)/rgya bdun btab pa sa chad du/ /snang srid 'khor 'das dgrar langs kyang / /dgra zhes bya ba'i ming yang med/ /bgegs zhes bya ba'i ming yang med/ /rgya bdun mtshams las ma 'da' zhig /rlu ring gi srung sngags brjod/ me chus rgyas btab bo/ /de nas dkyil 'khor bsdus/ gshin rje'i bshul lam du/ hūṃ/ sra mkhregs rdo rje 'bar ba'i rgya gram gyis/ /go skabs med pa'i sa ga'i na rab gyur nas/ /bskal pa ma stongs bar du gshin rje'i tshogs/ /skad cig tsam yang thar ba med par gyur/ /e nan big nan sto bha ya nan/ /zhes brjod cing bro brdung / bla ma gshin rje gshed du rab gsal ba/ /slar yang gnas 'gyur rdo rje drag po rtsal/ /rten dang brten bar bcas pa'i rnam rol tu/ /lhun grub snang stong ngang du gsal bar gyur/ /tshogs la rol ba nas bzung / bsngo ba smon lam bkra shis kyi bar zhi dkyus ban btang bar bya'o/ /'di'i cha lag dang lag len gyi rim pa rnams ni gter gzhung dang —529

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()zur rgyan sogs las shes par bya'o// smras pa/dpag bsam yongs 'du'i ljon pa dang //yid bzhin dbang gi rgyal po la//gsol ba bton 'dod pa'i don//'grub pa dngos po'i gshis lugs mtshar//rdzas sngags ting 'dzin zhabrul 'khor dag//tshul bzhin nyams su blangs pa yis//lnga pa'i pho nya bzlog nus pa'i//rten cing 'brel bar 'byung 'di lo//'on kyang 'di 'dra'i gnad shes pa/khu dum wā ra dang mtshungs te/khregs ldan rā rlom 'ur brgyangs༅//tso gyi spyod yul ga la yin/kho bos ma' pa'i nga rgyal spangs//bshesaganyen dam pa yun du bsten//dka' ba'i gnad la sgro 'dogs bcad//bsams kyin e ma 9nabaskal pa bzang //dge 'dis bdag gzhan 'gro ba kun//'jig rten gsum gyi mnga' bdag gis//dus kyi go pa las thar te//'chi med rdo rje'i sku thob shog/ces lha brag ga kho byon gyi/waṃ bdag bzlog pa'i gyer gzhung 'chi bdag g.yul las rgyal ba'i ru mtshon zhes pa 'di ni sa'i tshangs pa bstan 'dzin chos kyi rgyal po'i sku rim bsgrub pa la mdzo du phyogs pa'i tshe/theg mchog bstan pa'i srog shing zur gyi gdung las rdo rje 'dzin pa chos dbyings rang grol gyis/'di la chog sgrigs gsal ba zhig byung na legs pa 'dug ces gsungs pas mtshams sbyar te/gter gzhung dngos su mi gsal ba'i 'don cha rnams/gleng gzhi dang lag len sogs khungs dang 'brel ba rnams nas kha bkang ste/rang bzhin rdzogs pa chen po'i gnas lugs la cung zad gzhol ba'i za hor gyi sngags ban bla med rdo rje rtsal du 'bod pas/lcags stag dbo zla'i dmar phyogs kyi dga' ba dang po'i tshes la/dga' ldan pho brang du sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni blo bzang tshe ring ngo /0/sarba maṅga lo////

zhing skyong seng ge'i gdong pa can gyi las byang gnam lcags sgru gri/ nang ma rtog)zhing skyong seng ge'i gdong pa can gyi las byang gnam lcags spu gri bzhugs so/ /rgyal ba kun 'dus pad+ma ka ra dang / /dbyer med rtsa ba'i bla ma'i zhabs btud nas/ /zhing skyong dbang po seng ge'i gdong can gyi/ /las byang rgyun 'byer nyung ngu'i tshul du 'dri/ /mchod gtor rten dang dam rdzas ma lus pa/ /rigs 'dzin brgyud pa'i phyag len ltar bshams nas/ /rang nyid dpal chen lta bu yi dam lha'i/ /ting 'dzin ngang nas 'phrin las rim pa gyer/ /oṃ shu n+ya tā dzñā na badz+ra su bhā wa āt+pa ko ྅ lha/ /chos rnams gsal stong 'dzin med ngang nyid las/ /dmar nag me rlung drag tu zhabrug pa'i dbus/ /paṃ las pad+ma raṃ las nyi ma dang / /dgra bo gan rkyal bsnyel ba'i gdan steng du/ /rang gi thugs ga'i sa bon las chad pa'i/ /hūṃ yig 'phro 'du yongs su gyur pa las/ /bdud mgon seng gdong mthing nag 'jigs pa'i sku/ /dmar zlum spyan bgrad zhal gdangs mche ba gtsigs/ /ljagasa'adril drag po'i gdab rgyangs 'brug ltar sgrog /lcags ral sngon po gnam du 'phyo ba'i gseb/ /seng chang skar ltar 'byug cing glog ltar 'khyug /phyag g.yas dar mdung nag po mkha' la 'phyar/ /(2na)g.yon pa dmar gtor gnam lcags thog ltar 'phen/ /mun pa'i mdog can dar gyi 'jol ber gsal/ /go mtshon spu gri'i 'khor lo rked la mdzed/ /stag ral gzig shugs bcings shing sag lham gyon/ /bdud rta nag po rlung gzhog can la chibs/ /g.yon du tri las bdud mo seng gdong ma/ /mdog dmar 'kha bgrad mche gtsigs spyan gsum ldan/ khrag ral gseb nas seng chung me stag 'phro/ /g.yas pa kha ṭ+wāṃ g.yon pa dgra snying 'dzin/ /dar dmar ber gyon btsan rta dmar po chibs/ /yab yum gnyisakyi mdun du tri yig las/ /las mkhan bam ro pho mo dmar ser mdog /sprel gdong lag gnyis bya ster sal btsugs/ /rkang pas dmar gyi gtor ma dgra la 'phen/ /mi lpags rked dkris me rlung —53/—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ smyona'atshub ma 'khyil//yab yum 'khor du las mkhan gtum po ni//lho phyogs byang shar lho nub shar lho dang //byang phyogs nub byang nub dang shar rnams su//sa bon brgyad las skyes pa'i mi bsrun pa'i//'jigs rung dregs pa'i sdod pon chen po brgyad//ya las gshin rje chos rgyal ljang 2bskog mdog/be con rgyu zhags 'dzin cing chu glang zhen//ma las rdo rje ba lam mdog nag mo//ral gri nad rkyal 'dzin cing drel nag zhon//ra las tshangs pa dkar po rta dkar zhen//spu gri 'dzin cing dar mdung dkar po 'phyar//dza las btsan 'gong yam shud dmar po ni//mdung dmar zhags pa 'dzin cing btsan rta zhen//du las bdud po bye ba dgu ring nag/ral gri bdud zhags 'dzin cing rta nag zhen//tri las na ga sing ha dud ga'i mdog khram shing lcags kyu 'dzin cing bong bu zhen//phu las klu bdud mgo dgu sku mdog nag phyag gnyis sprul zhags 'dzin cing chu srin nyon//tri las rdo rje legs pa mthing nag mdog/tho ba lcags skam 'dzin cing ra skyes zhon//gtso 'khor kun kyang thod skam dbu rgyan dang //khrag 'dzag rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal 'phyang /khrag gi thig le zhag gi tho ris dang //thal chen tshom bu stag sham rus pa sogs//'jigs rung dur khrod chas kyis rnam par brgyan//g.yin yang mkha' 'gro 'byung po 'dus pa las//gtum chen seng ge glang chen smyon pa dang //stag gzig ce spyang dur bya ga sko khra//bya rog 'ug pa phag rgod mi rgod sogs//'jigs rung 'khor rnams la las ri rab 'phen//rgya mtsho hub 'debs nyi zla thang la 'bebs//mtshon cha'i char 'bebs rang sha rang gis za//ha ha hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa sgra chen sgrog/dug mtsho 'khol zhing thog mtshon bu yug 'tshub//bskal pa'i me 'bar rlung nag 'tshub ma 'khrug/dgra bgegs 'dar byed gtso 'khor thams cad kyi//gnas gsum yi shes mtshan dang 3na thad ga nyid kyi//thugs ka las 'phros 'od zer lcags kyu yis//bsil ba'i tshal dang dpal gyi tsā ri nas//zhing skyong 'khor bcas thogs med spyan 'dren gshegs//hūṃ/kun tu bzang po rigs 'dzin pad+ma 'byung //gter ston rin cen tshul rdor la sogs pa//rtsa brgyud bla ma'i bstan srung mthu rtsal can//zhing skyong 'khor bcas gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol//rgyal ba'i

zhing skyong seng ge'i gdong pa can gyi las byang gnam lcags spu gri/ nang ma zhanabastan pa gnyan po bsrung ba'i tshe/ /'phags yul rdo rje gdan nas dze/ /gsang sngags theg pa'i bka' srung mdzad pa'i tshe/ /skyon gsang ba'i gnas nas snga/ /dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i gtso bo mdzad pa'i tshe/ /nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i yul nas snga/ /lha srin ldebargyad dmag sna 'dren pa'i tshe/ /dur khrod bsil ba'i tshal nas ri/ /grangs med sprul pa phyogs bcur 'gyed pa'i tshe/ /te se gangs kyi ri nas mo/ /ma sring bstan ma'i 'khor gyis bskor ba'i tshe/ /la phyi sgrub pa'i gnas nas mo/ /rigs 'dzin dgra lha chen po mdzad pa'i tshe/ /gnas mchog tsā ri tra nas sko/ /dam nyams dgra bo'i srog rtsa gcod pa'i tshe/rngam pa sgra sgrog che nas mo/ /zab mo gter gyi srung ma mdzad pa'i tshe/ /zil chen gsang ba'i phug nas྾/ /tshur spyon tshur spyon seng gdong yab dang yum/ /bam ro pho mo dregs pa sde brgyad sogs/ /grangs med 'khor tshogs rgya mtshor bcas pa rnams/ /dam las ma 'da' thogs med da tshur spyon/ /ā+oṃ mahā kā la sidha mu kha hūṃ phaṭa tre hring dzaḥ ḍā kyi ni chan ra ma hūṃ phaṭa tri hring dzaḥ sa pa ri wā ra e gye hi badz+ra(3ba〉gam ya dzaḥdzaḥ dzaḥ& baṃ ho // 'jigs rung dur khrod chen po'i dbus/ /pad nyi dgra bgegs gdan steng du/ /bdud mgon yab yum 'khor bcas rnams/ /dgyes shing brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ /sam ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan/ hūṃ/ mas stobs rdzu 'phrul bsam mi khyab/ /bdud mgon nag po seng ge'i gdong / /yab yum 'khor dang bcas pa la/ /'phrin las bsgrub phyir phyag 'tshal bstod/ a ti pu ho/ bra ci 〉 srung ma 'khor bcas spyan lam du/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod tshogs kun/ /dngos bshams yid kyis sprul nas 'bul/ /bzhes nas bcol ba'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /(slo mahā kā la sidha mu kha si na ra ma tri tri/ ya ma rā dza du tri phu tri sa pa ri wā ra a lha nas sha rdi'i bar brjod/ dmar chen gtor ma ri ltar spungs/ /sman phud rgya mtsho lta bur bskyil/ /dmar chen khrag gi a: sbreng / /dam can 'khor bcasabazhes su gsol/ /gong gi sngags gsham du/ i rda bha li ta kha kha ji hi ji hi/ mahā me sa go ro tsa na tsit+ta bha su ta 18 ti kha raṃ ji hi/ sarba pañtsa yi ta kha raṃ khā hi/ mahā rak+ta kha raṃ ji hi/ hūṃ/ dngos bshams yid kyis sprul pa yi/ /mthun pa'i dam rdzas tshogos rnams kyis/ /zhing skyong 'khor bcas spyan lam du/ /—333

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang ble bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (25)dgyes pa chen po bskyed gyur cig /dbang po lnga yi me tog dang / kha chen spos sbyar dud pa'i sprin/ /tshil chen las sbar mar me'i 'phreng / khrag zhag dri chab mtsho ltar bskyil/ tan rus 'kha zas ri ltar spungs/ /rkang gling rol mo 'brug ltar ldir/ /kun bzang mchod pa'i sprin/ (4na〉8nga gis/ /bdud mgon 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang / /bdud kyi rta nag rting dkar can/ /btsan rta dmar po glog ltar 'byug /sga srab gong med chas kyis brgyan/ /dmar nag dar gyi 'jol ber dang / /mdud rnon dar nag ba dan g.yo/ /dmar gtor rtse gsum dgra bo'i snying / /dur khrod chas brgyad la sogs pas྾/ /rta nag dom snying ma nyams pa/ zhang byang bcas pa bla rdo dang / /gsang ba srog 'khor dar nag gril/ /'byong g.yag shel gong bya nag khyi/ /sman rag sgrub gtor rgyun gtor spungs/ /dza gad gser skyems bdud rtsi lnga/ /sra ba'i go cha rno ba'i mtshon/ /tshogs dang mdos kyi mchod pa yis mo thar med btson khang 'brub khung nang / kha sbyar thod pa me rlung gi /'jigs su rung ba'i 'khor lo'i bar/ /dam nyams nya'o thun rdzas sogs/ /drag po mthu yi las sbyor gyis/ /dgra bgegs phye mar 'thag nus pa'i/ /bca' bzhi sgrub pa'i las rim gyis/ /za'adod yon lnga dang rgyal srid bdun/ /nyi zla lhun po gling gzhin bcas/ /yab yum gnyis med 'khril sbyor gyis/ /med byung zag med bde chen rgyas/ /dpal ldan kun bzang he ru ka /zhing skyong dbang po'i rnam rol du/ /nges rnyed bla med rten mchog gis/ /hūṃ/ bskal pa dus mtha' me rlung 'khrul pa'i dbus/ /stong gsum skad cig myul ba'i rta mchog steng / /jigs rung gar dgu'i nyams kyis rnam rol ba'i/ /zhing skyong seng ge'i gdong can khyod la bstod/ /mdog dmar mi sdug srin mo khros pa'i gzugs/ /dgra bo'i don snying (4ba〉zung nas khrag rgyun 'thung / /rlung gi shugs ldan btsan rta dmar po chibs/ /ma mo mkha' 'gro'i gtso mo khyod la bstod/ /mthong ba tsam gyis 'jigs shing skyi g.ya' la/ /rbad na dgra bgegs bdun brgyud rtsad nas gcod/ /las kun thogs med bsgrub pa'i mthu rtsal can/ /sde brgyad dregs pa'i 'khor tshogs rnams la bstod/ /chos dbyings bde ba che las ma g.yos kyang / /mi bsrun bshan pa bdud mgon seng ge'i gdong / / 534

zhing skyong seng ge'i gdong pa can gyi las byang gnam lcags spu gri/ nang ma (ka)yab yum gnyis kyi thugs dam dus la bab/ sha khrag rgyan gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /rnal 'byor bdag la sdang ba'i dam nyams dgra /steng 'og phyogs mtshams bar gsum gar 'dug kyang / /tshe srog stobs 'byor mnga' thang kha rje choms/ /lo slar ma 'jog snying khrag zhal du gsol/ /mdog ser dri ngan spyi bo tshugs su 'gro/ /bya sder sar btsugs rkang bas dmar gtor 'phen/ /baṃ chen pho mo'i thugs dam dus la bab/sko sko sko ma dze/'jigs pa'i gzugs can sna tshogs mtshon cha thogs/ /stong gsum myul zhing dgra po'i bla tshe brku/ /'khor tshogs rgya mtsho'i thugs dam dus la phab skodze sko sko ra mtsho skyes rdo rje gter ston las 'brel rtsal/ /kun dga' tshe mchog pad+ma badz+ra sogs/ /rtsa brgyud bla ma'i dam tshig gnyan po rnams/ /nye bar dgongs shig bdud mgon seng ge'i gdong / khyad par gtsug lag 'dzin gyi skye ba'i mtha'/ /za hor rigs 'dzin mthu stobs kun gyi bdag /ngag dbang bsod nams grags pa dpal bzang pos/ /bsnyen sgrub mchod bstod dam (5na/sog ma bsgrags sam/ /de phyir rigs 'dzin sngags 'chang bdag cag la/ /gnod byed dgra bo byung dus mi sgrol na/ /mthu ldan srung ma'i dbang po chen po zhes/ /mchod bstod rbad cing bskul ba'i dgos pa ci/ /gnyer gtad dgra 'di sgrol ba'i mthu med na/ /rgyal ba'i bstan pa gnyan po ji ltar bsrung / /rnal 'byor sgos kyi 'phrin lasami sgrub na/ /pha mes brgyud pa'i srung mas ci zhig byed/ /ma yengs ma yengs zhing skyong seng ge'i gdong / /dka' ba dang du blangs nas khyod bsgrubs so/ /lus srog theng la bor nas khyod bsten no/ /mthun pa'i dam rdzas bsags nas khyod bos so/ /bsam pa ngan zhing sbyor ba rtsub mor ston/ /thabs kyis smod cing legs bsub nyes pa sgrog /dug mtshon dmag dang mnan gtad drag sbyor rtsom/ /mdor na log sgrub byed pa'i dgra bgegs rnams/ /mthu ldan khyod kyi zas su gtad lags na/ /steng nas gnam gyi 'ju thag gnyan po chod/ /'og nas sa yi brten phur myur du phyungs/ /bar du mi nor zas gsum thal bar rlog /'chi bdag gshin rjes tshe yi 'du byed bkums/ /ma mos dal yams sprin ltar 'thib tu chug /tshangs pa chen pos smyo 'bog brgyal nad thong / /btsan gyis gzer nad gnam lcags thog ltar —535

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (25)rgyob/ /bdud kyis zhags pa nag pos yan lag chings/ /srin pos sha khrag rul pa nang khrol zo/ /klu yis mdze nad me ltar 'bar du chug /rdo rje legs pas ltasang na char ltar phob/ /rang rang las kyis shi ba ma yin par/ /slo bur mi 'dod rkyen ngan (5bskrag po yis/ /srog rtsa dmar po rbad kyis bcad nas kyang / /thal ba'i rdul phran bzhin du brlag par mdzod/ /mdor na bdag cag dpon slob 'khor bcas kyi/ /tshe dang bsod nams dpal 'byor legs tsho gos kun/ /yar ngo'i zla ba lta bur rab rgyas nas/ /bsam don lhun gyis grub pa'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /ces sto ri zhing skyong seng ge'i gdong can gyi las byang gnam lcags sbu gri zhes bya ba 'di'ang / pad+ma las 'brel rtsal gyis tsā ri zil chen gsang phug nas gdan drangs pa'i sgrub skor dang / gzhan yang chos rgyal rin cen gling pa'i gter ma sogs gter kha khungs btsun rnams kyi dgongs pa ltar/ za hor gyi sngags ban ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho ming gzhan zil gnon drag rtsal du 'bod pas sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni rgya mtsho'i/ /lha mchog 'bar ba rtsal gyi 'phrin las brgya phrag nyid ngos 'dzin pa'i snang gsal bzhugs so/ /na ma ste kā la bzhi pad+mā ka rā ya/ zhi dang khro bo'i dkyil 'khor ma lus pa'i/ khyab bdag oṃ ṇ+ḍi yā na'i rig sngags 'chang / /'dzam gling che ba'i brtul zhugs grub pa'i dbang / /rgyal mchog pad+ma thod 'phreng bdag byin rlobs/ /mgon khyod bka' rtags phyag rgyas zur phud rtser/ /rjes gsal lce la a mṛ ta blud pas/ /dam ldan lha chen rdo rje 'bar ba stsal/ /bkra shis snying nye mthu stobs rdzul can/ /gang de mchod gsol bskang dang bsnyen cing sgrub/ /las sbyor rtsom la nyer mkho'i gyer sgom gzhung / /lha chen dgyes zhal 'dab stong 'dzum byed pa'i/ /brgya phrag nyi ma'i dngos 'dzin snang gsal spel/ de la 'dir dri za'i rgyal po gnyan chen thang lha rdo rje 'bar ba rtsal gyi 'phrin las kyi rim pa nyams su —336

lha mchog 'bar ba rtsal gyi 'phrin las brgya phrag nyid ngos 'dzin pa'i snang gsal/ nang ma (ka)bstar bar byed pa la sgrub rten mchod gtor spyan gzigs sogs mkho ba'i rdzas dang yo byad thamasacad mthong ba brgyud pa'i phyag len ltar legs par bshams/ sngon du zhi khro gang yang rung ba'i 'phrin las kyi gzhung bsrangs pa legs pas thugs sgrub drag po rtsal gyi las byang don bstod yan rdzogasapar btang / 'di ga'i sgos chos thog mar 'gyur sngags brjod nas gnas yo byin gyis brlab pa ni/ā+oṃ 64byung rang shar:'a 'gro4༄bab/ bha ra (2na〉yi bha ra bi ma na/ sar ma hā dzo wa/ phaṭa/ e yaṃ raṃ / ke raṃ : hūṃ/ zlo bi sha bi shud+dhi bhan+dha dzñā na e tsakra maṇ+ḍal ra/ dra las sa phyogs thams cad ye shes rang snang las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang chen po gru bzhi sgo bzhi pa mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogasapar gyur pa de'i nang du ༷ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du ā+oṃ zhu ba lasabyung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod rdzas bsam gyis mi khyab pa yul sa dang bar snang thams cad yongs su khyab pa dus 'khor ba ji srid ma stongs kyi bar du gnas pa/ chos sku kun tu bzang po'i rnam 'phrul las byung ba'i 'og min ye shes rang snang gi mchod sprin lta bu zad mi shes pas khyab par gyur/ā+oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta mahā shrī he ru ka /mahā kro dha rā dza sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra sa ma ya dzaḥdzaḥ arnya/ pulge hūṃ pe/ ā lo ke /gharnye/ ni li skye/ sha lta āPROBPROB/ na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na mo bha ga wa te badz+ra su ra pra ma rnga yi/ta thā ga tā ya arnya te/ sa mya klo bu dh+wa ya/ ta du thā/ ā+oṃ badz+re badz+re/ ma hā badz+re/ ma hā te dzo badz+re/ ma hā bi sdi badz+re/ ma hā bo dhi tsit+ta badz+re/ ma hā bo dhi maṇ+ḍi pa si kra ma ṇa badz+re/ sarba ga rma/ ā ba ra ṇa bi sho dha na badz+reswāhā/ /skyabs 'gro sems bskyed ni/ rang byung thugs sgrub kyi skyabs sems lhun gyis(2ba〉spyab pa'i sku/ /'od gsal chen po'i dgongs pa can/ /thugs rje'i dbang gis 'gro don mdzad/ /bla ma rnams la skyabasasu mchi/ /rang las ye shes shar ba'i sku/ /mi 'bral rtse gcig dgongs pa can/ /byin gyis brlob cing bar chad sel/ /yi dam lha las/ /dam tshig rnam par dag pa'i sku/ /brtse gdung byams pa'i dgongasapa can/ /legs nyes bstang 'dzin dngos grub ster/ /mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la ri/ /sngon nas bsagasapa'i sdig sgrib bshags/ /'gro don sangs rgyas thob bya'i phyir/ /smon pa'i byang chub sems bskyed de/ /—537—

rgyal ba lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (25)sems can yongs su smin bya'i phyir/ /gsang sngags spyod pa rlabs chen spyad/ /don dam spros bral byang chub sems/ /rang byung mtha' bral stong gsal bsgom/ /zhes lan gsum brjod/ sems can thamasacad bde ba dang zhes sogs tshad med bzhi bsgom/ tsho gos zhing ni/ rang nyid skad cig gis rta mgrin dregs pa zil gnon du gsal ba'i thugs ga'i hrī las 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bla ma 'od dpag med rigs kyi bdag por bzhugs pa'i bcom ldan 'das pad+ma dbang chen la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba mdun gyi nam mkhar badz+ra sa mā dzaḥdzaḥs spyan drangs/ hūṃ/ bla ma ra byung rang shar:'a 'grolas byung ba/yi dam mkha' 'gro gshegs su gsol/ /spyi gtsug nyi zla pad+ma'i gdan la bzhugs/ /lus ngag yid gsum gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /phyi nang gsang gsum ma lus mchod pa 'bul/ /sdig pa mi dge thams cad so sor bshags/ /dus gsum dge ba'i tshogs la rjes yi rang / /chos 'khor rgyun ho med pa bskor du gsol/ /mya ga mi 'da' 'gro ba'i don la bzhugs/ /de sogs dge ba byang chub thob phyir bsngo/ /sku (3na gi sum 'phrin las bdag gis byed par shog /ces brjod/ gong gnon gyi ting nge 'dzin gsal gdab pa ni/ bdag ga khog yi /nyid tha mal snying ga na/ /yi ge sa dmar gnas pa la/ /bdag nyid hrī༅ lus su gyur/ /hrīḥde 'od du zhu ba las/ /bdag nyid dbang chen rgyal po ni/ /dbu ni tshangs pa'i yul rtser slebs/ /zhabs ni rgya mtsho'i gting du brkyang / /g.yas kyi phyag gis gter gzhung / gzugs khams 'degs/ /g.yon gyi phyag gis 'dod khams gnon/ /nyi zla gza' skar rked la 'khor/ /sku mdog bskal pa'i me ltar 'bar/ /sku stegs ri rab steng na 'cha'/ /dbu gtsug rta mgo rta skad 'tsher/ /g.yas kyi rta skad thengs gsum gyis/ /srid pa pho rgyud dbang du sdud/ /g.yon gyi rta skad thengs gsum gyis/ /srid pa mo rgyud dbang du sdud/ /steng du rta skad thengs gsum gyis/ /srid pa'i gza' rnams dbang du sdud/ /'og tu rta skad thengs gsum gyis/ khred pa'i klu rnams dbang du sdud/ /gyi/ phaṭa gsum bsgrags pa yis/ /'brug stong dus gcig ldir ba tsam/ khams gsum dbang du sdud byed cing / /srid gsum zil gyis gnon par bsgom/ /zhes —538

lha mchog 'bar ba rtsal gyi 'phrin las brgya phrag nyid ngos 'dzin pa'i snang gsal/ nang ma (ka)bskyed rim gsal gdab bo/ /hrīs hā kro dha paṅgān+ta kri ta ha yaṃ skyi wa hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ ya ma ra tsa du tri phu ti shrī tsho / phaṭa/ ces skabs sbyar bzla/ bstod pa ni/ khyoḥ& phaṭa/ khyuḥ dbang ga khog yi chen las la rngam mdzad khro bo che/ /sku mdog dmar nag thams cad dbang du sdud/ /dbu ni nam mkha'i dbyings su rta skad 'tsher/ /zhabs ni rgya mtsho'i gting du klu rnams gnon/ /g.yas kyi phyag gis snang srid gzugs khams 'degs/ /g.yon gyi phyag gis (3ba 'dod khams sa gzhi gnon/ /nyi zla gza' skar rked bcings gza' rnams 'dul/ /dur khrod chas brgyad lha srin sdo brgyad 'jigs/ /rta skad 'tsher bas khams gsum dbang du sdud/ /hrīḥyi sgra chen srid gsum 'gul zhing dngangs/ /phaṭa kyis thog 'bebasabadud dpung spyi nas 'joms/ /hūṃ gi nga ros gdug pa bran du bkol/ /phyag mtshan mtshon chas ri rab rdul du 'jig /bskal pa'i me 'bar 'jig rten ma lus bsreg /'jig rten dregs pas khengs pa'i sdobargyad ni/ /drag po gza' dang gdug pa klu la sogs/ /'chi bdag gshin rje nad gtong ma mo dang / /che btsan rgyal po rol pa btsan gyi tshogs/ /nag po bdud dang the'u brang bgegs kyi tshogs/ /snang srid lha srin sde brgyad stobs po che/ /rang dbang med par dbang sdud zil gyis gnon/ /mthu dang rdzu'aphrul stobs dang gzi brjid 'phrog /rang byung thugs rje'i dpal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mdun bskyed kyi sman gtor byin gyis brlab pa ni/ chang la chos sman btab na brlab mi dgos shing de min bka' brgyad ltar byin gyis brlab/ hrīs gsar bris/ hā kro dha pa dhan+ta kri ta ha yaṃ snri wa hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa kyis bsangs/su bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las zlo las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du ā+oṃ 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i gtor ma kha dog dri ro reg bya phun sum tshogs pa'i steng du ā+oṃ āḥ& gis mtshan pa las 'od zer 'phros pas 'khor 'das kyi ro bcud thams cad 'dus te gtor ma la thim/ yi ge gsum yang 'od du zhu nas dbyer med gcig tu 'dres pas ye shes kyi bdud rtsi rgya mtsho chen po zad mi shes pa'i rang bzhin du gyur/ ā+oṃ āḥ〉 ma hā bha lin+ta ti dz+wa bha lin+ta bha la bha te gu spo sam me swāhā/ zhesalan gsum mam bdun gsar bris/ brjod/ rten bskyed pa (4na ji/ hrīs hā kro dhas bsangs/ swa gawas—539

rgyal ga lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (25)sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rang gi mdun du ra las rin po che'i gzhal yas khang shar shel/ lho'i ḍūrla/ nub pad+ma rā ga /byang gser las grub pa gru bzhi sgo bzhi pa logs su dra ba dang dra ba phyed ba 'phyang zhing mda' yab pu shus bskor ba'i steng du rgya phubs rin po che'i tog gis spras pa/ de'i phyi rol tu khor sa rim pa gnyis dang ldan pa'i dbus su man shel gyi khang bzang dzaskru'i gser gyi rgya phubs 'od du 'tsher ba'i rtser yid bzhin gyi nor bu'i tog gis mtshan pa rin po che sna tshogs kyi sgo lcog 'od 'bar ba/ rtsa bar bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho 'phyur ba/ rked par 'ja' 'od na bun gyi gur phub pa/ rtse mor sprin dkar rin po che'i zil char 'bebs pa/ sa gzhi ljang sngon la me tog sna tshogs rgyas pa/ khor yug tu gnam lha brgyad kyi gangs ri shel gyi mchod rten lta bus bskor ba/ de'i dbus su nyi zla pad+ma'i gdan la stobs ldan rta mchog ngang dkar rin po che'i sga srab gong rmed spu len ze long gi khebs sogs rgyan du mas mdzes par spras pa'i steng na ā+oṃ badz+ra thang ka ra mun nying khu sha li swāhā las 'od zer 'phros/ dgra bgegs gdug pa can thams cad tshar bcad tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las ngo bo byang chub sems dpa' nam mkha'i snying po'i rnam par sprul pa rnam pa tshangs ris kyi lha'i gtso bo mtshan drug rdo rje 'bar ba rtsal la/ dam can shel ging dkar po/ lha gnam the dkar po/ gnam lha byang chub sems dpa'/ tshangs pa'i rgyal po dung gi thor tshugs can/ dri za zur phud lnga pa/ khyab 'jug gnam mtsho'i rgyal mo zhes bya ba srung ma chen mo/ lha chen rdo rje 'bar ba rtsal sku mdog shel gyi ri bo la ston mtshan zla bas byugs pa ltar dkar la brjid pa/ zhal 'dzum shing mche ba'i (4bsko/ gu cung zad btsigs pa/ spyan gsum rab tu bkra ba/ dbu skra gnag snum gyi thor tshugs dar dkar pos bcings pa'i rtse mor nor bu 'bar bas spras pa/ phyag g.yas rdo rje rtse lngas mtshan pa'i sba lcag nam mkha' la 'phyar zhing g.yon pa shel dkar gyi 'phreng ba thugs ka'i thad du 'dren pa/ zab chen dkar dmar mthing gsum gyi tse ber dang yug gyon gsol ba/ ber nang ma gnyis la rin po che sna tshogs kyis spud pa'i gser sked bcings shing / rin po che'i gser pad la g.yu'i phra tshom gyis mdzes pa'i dbu rgyan/ snyan —540

lha mchog 'bar brtsal gyi 'phrin las brgya phrag nyid ngos 'dzin pa'i snang gsal/ nang ma (ka)rgyan/ mgul rgyan/ gser ga /rtse mo do/ do shal/ gdu bu sogs rgyan sna tsho gos kyis brgyan pa/ snyan gong ut+pa la'i chun po dang dar dbyangs can/ sku gzhen zhing mdzes pa/ zhabs gnyis nor bu'i mchil lham gyon nas rgyal po rol pa'i 'dug stangs kyis bzhugs pa g.yon du bde ba skyong ba'i dbang mo yid 'ongs mdangs ldan gyi yum gnam mtsho'i rgyal mo rdo rje g.yu sgron ma sku mdog sngo sangs zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma spyan gsum dang ldan pa/ g.yas rgyal mtshan dang g.yon me long 'dzin cing /dbu skra thor tshugs lhag ma'i zar bu thur du 'phyang ba/ sman btsun mdzes ma yid du 'ong ba'i cha byad kyis gtso bo la bdud pa'i rnam pa can g.yu 'brug bcibs ba/ gtso bo'i steng gi nam mkhar ma rungs log 'dren klu gnyan sa bdag 'dul ba'i gnyen por ngo bo ye shes lha'i sprul pa rnam pa khyung nag dbu dgu pa zhas gdangs shing kri sku gi sgra sgrog pa/ phyag gnyis kyis sa bdag klu gnyan sprul gyi rnam pa can bzung nas zhal du gsol ba/ gnam lcags me'i mchu sder dang spu gri 'bar ba'i gshog pa can/dmigs pa'i sa gnyan bkab cing nam mkhar lding ba/ gtso bo'i mtha' skor du mched 'khor sum brgya drug cu/ g.yas(ldan)kyi ru 'dren skyes bu g.yu'i smin ma can/ g.yon gyi ru 'dren khye'u chung g.yu'i zur phud can/ mdun gyi ru 'dren mi dkar g.yu'i thor cog can/ rgyab kyi ru 'dren mi sngon 'jigs pa ste so so brgya phrag dang bcas pas bskor ba/ shar du be+e ḍūrla dkar po las grub pa'i lha'i gzhal med khang rgya phubs can rin po che'i ra ba gru bzhi pas bskor ba'i nang du nad brgya 'joms pa'i sman gyi me tog lo 'bras myu gu grangs med pas yongs su gtams pa'i dbus su pad zla'i steng na zhi mdzad rdo rje 'bar ba rtsal sku mdog dkar po g.yas sman gyi ljon shing thugs ka dang g.yon bdud rtsis gtams pa'i bum pa brla steng na 'dzin cing / zhabs gnyis sems dpa'i skyil krung gis bzhugs par sman lha drang srong gi tshogs kyis bskor ba/ lhor dzo chu bo'i gser sbyangs la rin po che sna tshogs kyis sprasapa'i khang bzang rgya phubs can/ rin po che'i ra ba gru bzhi bas khor yug tu bskor ba'i nang du rgyal srid bdun/ ba po shis rtags brgyad/ rin po che'i ri/ yongs 'du sa brtol/ 'dod 'jo'i ba/ ma rmos pa'i —541—

rgyal ba lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (25)lo tog sogs lha mi'i dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs pas yongs su gang ba'i dbus na pad zla dang ne'u le dmar ser gyi gdan la rgyas byed kyi rdo rje 'bar ba rtsal ser po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/g.yas nor bu 'bar ba thugs ka dang g.yon rin bo che'i sgrom bu pus steng na 'dzin pa/ zhabs sems dpa'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs par gnod sbyin nor lha'i tsho gos kyis bskor ba/ nub tu pad+ma rā ga'i khang bzang rgya phubs can khor yug dang bcas pa'i ra bar 'chi med bdud rtsis gtams pa'i bum bzang / mtsho/ rdzing / lteng ka /lu ma/ chu mig dang bcud (5ba 〉 len snying por gyur pa'i rdzas sman gyis yongs su khyab pa'i dbus na pad zla'i gdan la dbang gi lha rdo rje 'bar ba rtsal sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis mnyam gzhag gi steng na pad+ma rā ga'i tshe bum 'dzin pa/ rin po che'i rgyan rdo rje'i dbyibs can/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs par tshe'i lha dang rigs 'dzin drang srong gitshogs kyis bskor ba/ byang du drag pa gnam lcags 'bar ba'i mkhar steng du rgya phubs dang khor yug ra bas bskor ba'i nang mtshon cha sna tshogs kyi dra bas sbrel ba'i dbus su pad+ma nyi ma dgra bgegs pho mo bsnol ba'i gdan la rkadze las kyi khro bo rdo rje 'bar ba rtsal sku mdog nag la khros pa/ mig rtsa dmar zhing mche ba gtsags pa/ ral pa dmar ser gyen du brjes shing rin po che'i rgyan rnams dang dug sgrul gyis brgyan pa/ tse ber dmar nag brtsegs pa'i nang ma gser sked can g.yas mdung dmar dang g.yon lcags kyi mda' gzhu 'dzin pa rin po che'i hor lham gyon nas rta mchog bra nag rlung shugs can la bcibs shing me rlung 'byug pa'i klong na bzhugs par mnga' bdag dregs pa'i sde dpon rnams kyis bskor ba/ shar lhor rtse mor gangs dang / rked par ne'u gsing / me tog nags tshal 'a rgyas brgyan pa'i dbus su shel dkar gyi khang bzang yid du 'ong bar pad zla'i gdan la lha chen gzhen nu skyes bu bzhin bzang kha dog dkar la dbu skra g.yu'i zur phud can/ dung so khor ma yod pa/ g.yas skyabasasbyin dang g.yon khu tshur dkur brten pa/ dar dkar gyi la'u gsol zhing zhabs gnyis mnyam pa'i stabs kyis bzhengs par rang 'dra'i lha phrug du mas bskor ba/ lho nub tu mtshon cha sna tshogs rtse mo —542

lha mchog 'bar ba rtsal gyi 'phrin las brgya phrag nyid ngos 'dzin pa'i snang gsal/ nang ma (ka)phyir bstan cing me rlung 'tshub mar (6na smo'u la ba las 'phros pa'i 'od zer gyis gnod byed dmigs bya rnams ra ba'i nang du bkug pa'i steng na skye 'gro'i srog gshed spyo 'dre srin po 'dul ba'i gnyen por lha chen gyi ngo bo rnam pa 'phrong g.yag zhal can dkar po 'gying bag dang ldan pa/ rwa gnyis thang shing brgyangs pa tsam la shin tu rno ba/ kha rlangs na bun ltar 'thibs shing ngur sgra 'brug ltar sgrog pa/gnam lcags rmig pa me ltar 'bar bas rgyal 'gong dam sri 'dam ltar brdzis shing rang 'dra'i sprul pa dpag tu med pa 'gyed pa/ nub byang du byu ru'i ba gam lcags ris bskor ba'i ra bar ut+pal dmar pos mchan pa'i me tog dang ljon shing sna tshogs pa'i tshal gyis khor yug tu dkrigs pa'i dbus su pad nyi'i gdan la rlung sems las rung gi lha dpa' bo rdo rje 'bar ba rtsal sku mdog dmar la 'tsher ba pad+ma dmar po'i phreng rgyan can/ g.yas lcags kyus bsgrub bya'i snying nas khrugs shing g.yon zhags pas mgul nas 'ching ba/ zhabs phyed skyil gyis bzhugs par 'gugs byed dbang gi pho lha'i tshogs kyis bskor ba/ byang shar du yid 'ong 'ja' gur 'khrigs pa'i nang du rin po che las grub pa'i 'chi med lha'i khang bzang bkod pa phun sum tshogs pa'i khor yug tu lha'i skyed tshal gyis yongs su bskor ba'i lte bar rin po che'i khri pad+ma nyi zla dgra bgegs pho mo'i gdan la lha mchog srid gsum gyi bdag po sku mdog dmar ser mche ba gtsigs pa ag tshom dang smin ma glog ltar 'khyug pa/ dbu skra li khri'i mdog can thor tshugs kyi rtser skye ba lnga pa'i dung sum tshom gyi steng du nor bu 'bar bas mtshan pa/spyan gsum dang ldan zhing zhi ma khro'i nyams can/ g.yas ye shes kyi ral gri me 'bar ba nam mkhar (6ba)'phyar zhing g.yon pa gser gyi 'khor lo rtsibs stong thur du bskor ba/ stag lpags kyi rked dkris dang sprul gyi do shal gsol ba/ zhabs gnyis mnyam pa'i stabs kyis bzhengs nas me 'od klong na bzhugs par tshangs ris kyi 'khor tshogs grangs med pas bskor ba zhi rgyas dbang 'gugs tshangs pa ste lnga ga'ang dbu skra ral pa'i thor tshugs can brog zhu sogs rin po che'i rgyan snyan gong ut+pal dang dar gyi cod pan 'phyang ba/ nang kha dog sna tshogs dang phyi rang mdog dang mtshungs pa'i tse —543

rgyal ga lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (25)ber nyis brtsegs gsol ba'i nang ma la gser sked bcings pa/ rin po che'i hor lham gsol zhing sku las 'od zer sna tshogs phyogs bcur 'phro ba'o/ /sku'i rnam par 'phrul pa dgur bstan pa de dag gi g.yas phyogs su ngo bo ye shes kyi lha la rnam pa dung khra dkar pos bar snang rlabs kyis spyad de khyer 'dre 'phung sri 'byung po phug ron 'dra ba'i rjes shul bsnyegs te sha khrag rus pa za ba/ rgyab tu lcags sdig nag po lus kyis gzhi khyab cir rwa dang mjug ma nam mkhar gdengs nas 'od zer lcags kyi dra bar sgab 'dre phyir 'brang bcug ste snying khrag 'byin pa/ g.yon du sprul pa'i dung spyang pho mo glog ltar 'khrug pa spu gri'i mche bas dgra bgegs 'bigs shing lcags kyi sder mos sa gzhi 'drad pa/ mjug ma brdabs pas me rlung 'tshub pa/ phyi rol gyi khor sa dang po la lha dang klu gnyan bye ba 'bum sde'i dmag tshogs/ phyi ma la snang srid lha srin sde brgyad kyi dpung tshogs yan lag bzhi pa'i cha lugs su 'jigs shing dpa' ba/ /kun kyang nyi ma 'bum gyi gzi brjid ltar 'bar ba'i gtso 'khor thams cad kyi spyi bor ā+oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs gar hūṃ hrīḥmathar snying pos bskor ba dang bdag nyid kyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas mtho ris lha'i tshal/(7na sko brgyad gangs kyi ra bas bskor ba'i pho brang sogs nas dri za'i rgyal po rdo rje 'bar ba rtsal sku'i rnam 'gyur brgyad dang bcas par grangs med pa'i 'khor tshogs rgya mtshos bskor ba badz+ra sa ma ya dzaḥdzaḥs spyan drangs/ spos sbyor bsreg cing g.yab dar rol mo dbyangs dang bcas te spyan 'dren bzhugasasu gsol ba ni/ hūṃ/ sngon tsheg kho g.yi / ka dag rdo rje'i dbyings/ /nang gsal 'od kyi gzhal yas khang / /'og min 'phrul gyi zhing khams su/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung bya'i phyir/ /byang chub sems dpa' nam mkha'i snying / /sprul pa lha chen 'bar ba rtsal/ /mi mjed kun la dbang bskur ba'i/ /tshangasapa'i rgyal po mthu bo che/ /dregs pa'i sdod pon kun gyi rje/ zhal gyi gnam lha dkar por grags/ /gsang yum rdo rje g.yu sgron ma/ /byang thang gnam mtsho'i rgyal mo ste/ /mched 'khor gtsang ris lha yi tshogs/ /bka' stod dregs ldan du mas bskor/ /lha chen dpal 'bar drag shul can/ /rdzu 'phrul stobs —544

lha mchog 'bar ba rtsal gyi 'phrin las brgya phu ga nyid ngos 'dzin pa'i snang gsal/ nang ma zhan kyis sku bskyod tshe/ /sa gzhi ri brag thams cad kyang / /mtho dma' med par zhongs se zheng / /dpung tshogs char sprin 'thibs pa bzhin/ /dgyes pa'i gad brgyangs dir ri ri/ /spyan 'dren dang ba'i gnas 'dir gshegs/ /nyi zla pad+ma rin chen khrir/ /ye shes gsang ba'i lha mchog khyod/ /bstan srung rgyal bor mnga' gsol tshe/ /sku gsung thugs kyi dkyil 'khor la/ /gzi brjid nyi ma 'bum bzhin rgyas/ /nag phyogs bdud dpung zil gyis gnon/ /dpa' bo stobs ldan snying rje can/ /sdod pon chen po'i spyan snga sa /bdag gis khas blangs dam (7ba ji ca' g.yel/ /dam tshig nyams chags mthol lo bshags/ /mnyes mchode thugs dam bskang ba ni/ /man shel 'od 'phro gsang ba'i rten/ /ting 'dzin gsal bas thugs dam bskang / /dam rdzas gtor ma nang gi rten/ /bsnyen sgrub bzlas pas thugs dam bskang / /sku 'bag rgyan ldan phyi yi rten/ /'dod yon longs spyod thugs dam bskang / /hūṃ/ ye shes ga sto gco / gzhal yas bskyed kyi rgya ma chung / /seng ge glang chen khri bshams dpangs ma dma'/ /nyi zla pad+ma'i gdan bting bkrag ma zhan/ /ye shes lha mchog bsnyen gyi rgyang ma ring / /'jig rten srung ma bsgrubasakyi mthum chung / /'dir gshegs nyi zla'i gdan la bzhugs su gsol/ /rdo rje 'bar ba rtsal sam ya dzaḥdzaḥ ྅/ sku lha'i yab smos pa/ 'o de gung rgyal lags/ /sku lha'i yum smos pa/ /g.yu bya gshog gcig lags/ /sku lha nyid smos pa/ /ya zur gnyan gya lha/ /bzhugs yul mtshan gsol ba/ /'dam shod snar mo lags/ /khri rgod g.yu ljang khril/ /dbyar sngo dgun yang sngo/ /bzhugs yul nyamasare dga' dgyes so lha yi yul/ /mi chos mtshan gsol ba/ /thang lha ya zhur lags/ /lha chos mtshan gsol ba/ /dri za'i rgyal po ni/ /zur phud lnga pa lags/ /gsang ba'i mtshan gsol ba/ /rdo rje 'bar ba rtsal/ /sku la ci gsol gsum kun tu rgyu/ /mdog dkar 'od zer 'bar/ /g.yas pa sba lcag 'phyar/ /ma bdun las la 'gyed/ /yon pa shel 'phreng 'dren/ /thugs(8na sgom dbyings su zlo/ sprul pa ci 'gyed na/ /rta dmag 'bum sde skrud/ /blon g.yog 'khor dang bcas/ /'dir spyon 'phrin lasamadzod/ /dam can kun gyi lha/ /dam med kun gyi gshed/ /man 'jan kun gyi bdud/ /rnal 'byor kun —545

rgyal ba lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (25)gyi dpal/ /sgrub mchog bdag gi grogs/ /'phrin las skal phog pa/ /spyo ba'i 'dre 'dul zhing / /sdang ba'i dgra srog ga khod/ /mgyogs su rta gto kyi/ /i thogs zor ma lci/ /rno ru mar rdor gyi/ /rtse mo dbal ma zhan/ ci dang do sngo na/ do thag chang ta re/ mgyogs dang dkyus mnyam na/ /dkyus thog shor ra re/ /sdang dgras 'khyer ra re/ /byams kyis skyong ta re/ /dus la bab po sa ma ya/ /dam tshig rjes su dran par gyis/ /las la bab po bgegs kyi rgyal/ /bcol ba'i 'phrin las sgrub par mdzod/ /dbusagatsang ru bzhi'i yul lha khyod/ /chos skyong rgyal po lha yi sras/ khri srong lde'u btsan sku lha yin/ /skyon pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis/ /dam la btags pa'i dam tshig can/ /da lta ci bsgo'i las rnams nyone/ /phyi rabs bstan pa'i tha ma la/ /phyon pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi/ /rjes su 'jug pa'i sngags 'chang dang / /chos rgyal khri srong lde'u btsan gyi/ /lha brgyad chags pa'i rje rigs rnams/ /mtho mtho gung la resapa dang / /dma' dma' bu bzhin skyong bar gyis/ /bod khams ru bzhi phyugs bzhin skyongs/ /bsam yas lha khang dkor ba'i na srungs/ /bskal pa tha ma'i sems can la/ khyed kyis srung skyob mi byed na/ /dang po byang lam bar pa mā /gsang (8ba thad ga phyag na rdo rje yis/ /srog snying gzir ba mi dran nam/ /bar du bsam yas has po rir/ /dbang chen pad+ma he ru gas/ /dbang du bsdus pa mi dran nam/ /tha ma ri rgyal bkra bzang gi /rtse mor lha srin kun bsags nas/ /dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu yis/ /dam tshig phog pa mi dran nam/ /nga ni pad+ma 'byung gnas yin/ khyod ni gnyan chen thang lha yin/ /yul ni dbus gtsang ru bzhi yin/ /byin rlabs sprin ltar thibs4thib/ /thugs rje char ltar shar ra ra/ /dam tshig mdangs ldan yal la la/ /thang lha gnyan po gshegs su gsol/ /sku lha gnyan po 'khor bcas la/ /brjid ldan bzang ring bsgos kyis mchode/ /g.ya' chu gangs chu gtsang mas mchod/ /dri zhim spos dkar dung bas mchod/ /gser dngul rin chen sna lngas mchode/ /rngon cha dar dang za 'og mchod/ /gsang lugs 'bras dkar gtsang mas mchod/ /mchod yon nyer spyod rol mo 'bul ba ni/ hūṃ/ dri med g.ya' chu gangs chu gtsang ma'i chu/ /rab dkar yol go'i snod du kun nas bskyil/ /mdangs mdzes dri zhim —546

lha mchog 'bar ba rtsal gyi 'phrin las brgya phrag nyid ngos 'dzin pa'i snang gsal/ nang ma (ka)lte ba rab mtho ba'i/ /me tog dkar pos gser gyis bum bzang mdzes/ yol mo ba gsum pas mdzad/tsan+dan spos dkar rgya shug sbyar ba'i bsangs/ /srid gsum 'jig rten khyab pa'i dud sprin 'thul/ /rtsi bcud gsang ba'i zhun me dngul dkar gyi/ /kong bur nyi ltar 'bar ba'i snang gsal mchog /rin chen brdar shel las grub pad phor nang / /ga phur bsil ba'i chur btab byug pa'i rdzas/ /dmar dang ma 'dres bda' dgur sbyar ba'i zas/ /rin chen byu ru'i (9na gi zheng par ri ltar spungs/ /snyan pa'i sgra dbyangs ma 'dres sna tsho gos pa/ /dga' dang spro dang dad pas gus mchod kyi/ /lha chen gsang mtshan rdo rje 'bar ba rtsal/ /yum gcig mtsho sman sprul 'khor rta dmag 'bum/ /ma bdun bran g.yog 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ /dgyes shing thugs brtser dgongs la bzhes su gsol/ /ā+oṃ badz+ra thang ka ra sapa ri wā ra a lha/ pu 〉 nas shag pra ci swāhā'i bar brjod/ dam tshig rdo rje'i phyag rgya bcas la/ dpal phyag na rdo rje/ skyon chos kyi rgyal po/ paṇa chen bi ma la mi༄/ lo chen be+e ro tsa na/ chos rgyal mnga' bdag yab sras/ jo mo mkhar chen bza'/ gter ston rigs 'dzin yab sras/ sngags gsar bris/ 'chang rdo rje rnam gnyis/ mtshan ldan bla ma rnam gnyis/ drin can sangs rgyas dpal bzang / ldongs ston chos rgyal bsod nams yab sras/ kun mkhyen mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug /'phags mchog byams pa skal bzang /rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan/ khyab bdag mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan/ gzhan yang gter ston yab sras nas/ rdor 'chang bsod nams bzang po/ mkhas grub chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ dpal ldan nam mkha' grags pa/ rje dkon cog blo gros/ mtshungs med blo gros dbang po/ mnyam med shākya dpal bzang / nub dgon pa byams pa chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ gzhan yang gter ston yab sras nas/chos rje sangs rgyas dpal ba/ rje chos dpal 'byor/ mtshungs med rin cen gzhon nu/ sngags 'chang shākya bzang po/ rigs 'dzin legs ldan rdo rje dang nub dgon pa ste rnam gnyis gtsug brten dpal bkra shis stobs rgyal/ rigs 'dzin ngag gi dbang po/ yol mo gter ston bstan 'dzin nor bu/ brgyud pa kun 'dus zur thams cad mkhyen pa chos dbyings rang grol sogs rigs 'dzin rtsa brgyud kyi dpal —547

rgyal ba lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (25)ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' dang dam la btags pa'i dam tshig gnyan po nye ba dgongs la mnga' bdag rgyal po'i sku lha/ ya rabs bsod nams kyi srung ma/ dbus gtsang ru bzhi'i yul lha/ dam tshig nyams pa'i srog bdud/ mna' zan yongs kyi gshed ma/ grib gnon rgyal 'gong dam sri'i gnya' gnon/ sku gcig la rnam 'gyur dgur ston pa/ don tha ṇi ga la mtshan drug tu grags pa/ lha chen rdo rje 'bar ba khyod kyis sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa srungs/ dkon cog gi dbu 'phang bstod/ mchod gnas sde gnyis kyi 'dus sde skyongs/ /bod yul ru bzhi'i rgyal khams 'dir bde skyid spel/ khyad par rigs 'dzin sngags 'chang bdag cag dpon slob rgyu spyor mi nor 'khor dang bcas pa'i tshogs la sdang bar byed pa'i dgra thul/ gnod par byed pa'i bgegs choms/ bye brag grib gnon rgyal bsen dam sri 'byung po rnams kyi mthu stobs nus pa rdul phran bzhin du rlog la bdag sogs yongs kyi nad rims dus min 'chi bas mtshon pa'i mi mthun pa'i phyogs kun zhi ba dang tshe dpal longs spyod mnga' thang sogs chos srid kyi legs tshogs ma lus yar ngo'i zla ba ltar spel ba dang srid gsum zil gyis gnon pa dang khams gsum thams cad dbang du bsdu ba'i 'phrin las thogs pa med par lhun gyis grub par (10na〉padzod cig /badz+ra sa ma ya hūṃ/ zhes dam bsgrags/ pra ston ga khogazhung / par gsol ba ni/ lha chen rdo rje 'bar ba rtsal 'khor dang bcas pa la mnyes mchod rten gtor 'di phul bas bdag gi phyi nang gsang ba'i bar chad mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad zhi ba dang legs nyes kyi mtshan ma dang rtags rnams gsal bar bstan du gsol/ zhes dmod bor zhing brtag lugs g.yin du shes so/ /sman gtor gsar bris/ 'bul ba ni/ hūṃ/ rtsa brgyad stong sbyar bdud rtsi a mṛ ta/ /rtsa brgyud bla ma yi dam dkyil 'khor lha/ /rdo rje 'bar rtsal 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ /bzhes nasadangos grub ma lus stsal sna du gsal/ /mahā sarba pañtsa.a mṛ ta kha raṃ 'a hi/ hūṃ/ dkar gsum dngar gsum bzang sman 'bru dkar zan/ /legs sbyar ye shes bdud rtsir byin brlabs pa/ /ro mchog brgya phrag ldan pa'i bha lin+ta/ /'bul gyis bzhes la dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /rdo rje thal mo kha phye ba'i phyag —548—

lha mchog 'bar ba rtsal gyi 'phrin las brgya phrag nyid ngos 'dzin pa'i snang gsal/ nang ma (ka)rgya dang bcas/ lha chen rdo rje 'bar ba rtsal 'khor dang bcas pa'i ljags hūṃ las skyes pa'i rdo rje rtse gcig pa dmar po 'od kyi sbu gu can gyis gtor ma'i bcud thams cad drangs te gsol bar gyur/ā+oṃ badz+ra thang ka ra sa pa ri wā ra mahā bha lin+ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ gtso bo la lan bdun nam nyer gcig /a kā ros gtso 'khor spyir lan gsum mam bdun gyis 'bul/ bka' srung rgyas mad dang gzhi bdag la gtor ma bsngo/ gter g.yi /'dzab ni/ lha tshogs rnams kyi thugs skar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng āḥdakar po'i mthar/ (10ba)rtswa badz+ra thang skar mun nyid khu sha li swāhā/ zhes pa dung gi phreng ba lta busabaskor ba/ rang dpal rta mgrin du gsal ba'i thugs gar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la khyoḥdamar po rtsa sngags kyis bskor ba/ de'i 'od zer lcags kyu lta bus lha chen gyi nus pa dang gzi byin 'od zer sna tshogs su rang la thim par bsam/ slar gas bris/yang 'od zer 'phros/ dbus dang
