phyogs mtshams su bzhugs pa'i lha tshogs rnams kyi thugs rgyud bskul/ de dag las kyang 'od zer lcags kyu lta bu 'phros/lha mi'i gnas su gzhugs pa'i rdo rje 'bar ba rtsal so so'i sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las kyi byin rlabs las ma dag pa sbyong ba'i khrus char 'bebs/ dri bzang spos kyi ngad pa 'thul/ ā li kā li'i rang sgra bsgrags pas nad gdon bar chad zhi zhing tshe dpal 'dod dgu'i legs tshogs rnams bsdus nas rang la thim/ stong gsum gyi skye rgu kun dbang du 'dus te bran du bkol zhing 'dar yeng yang nas dgra bgegs bdud dpung thams cad tshar bcad/ mdor na ci bsams pa'i don rnams yid bzhin du sgrub par bsam zhing sngags ci nus bzla/ las so sor sgrub tshe skabs thob kyi gtso bo 'pho ba dang dmigs pa'i kha bsgyur gyi gnad zhal las 'dri/ nyams chags kyi ltas che na bag chags stobasa'ajoms kyi sgo nas khrus gsol/ ye shes sku mchog ma dang g.yin yang / hūṃ/ byang gas bris/sems/nam mkha'i snying po 'gro ba'i don/ /las bzhi bsgrub phyir sna tshogs sprul pa'i gar/ /ston mdzad zur phud lnga pa dri za'i rgyal/ /'khor dang bcas pa deng 'dir snyan gson zhig /dngos grub (11na〉khyung gnas rtsa brgyud bla ma la/ /log par lta sogs spyi dang bye brag gi /gsang chen rdo rje theg pa'i dam —549

rgyal ba lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (25)tshig las/ /nyams chags nongs par gyur pa'i tshogs kun bshags/ /tshon brgya nye ba'i man shel ji bzhin du/ /lha khyod bgrang yas sku yi rnam par 'phrul/ /gsal stong bskyed rim tshul ldan me bsgoms pa/ /sku yi dam tshig nyams chags ma lus bshags/ /srog gi snying po gsang ba sngags kyi sgra/ /grag stong rgyun mi chad pa'i 'dzab bzlas kyis/ /thugs dam brgyud bskul bsnyen sgrub g.yel ba sogs/ /gsung gi dam tshig mo/ /ngo bo ye dag rang bzhin 'od gsal bar/ /kun khyab kun la 'jug pa'i thugs rje'i gdangs/ /bde stong zung 'jug ting 'dzin la g.yel ba'i/ /thugs kyi dam tshig nyams chags ma/ /srog dbang lung dang man ngag gnad gsang kun/ /dam med snod min rnams la bstan pa dang / /bsnyen sgrub las sbyor mchod pa'i rdzas ma tshang / /'bags btsog 'cho pa dang nor 'phrul ma dag bshags/ /dam tshig sdom nyams 'khon mdze dme yugs bshan/ /ro bag mi gtsang ka ca rdzasang na sogs/ /rtsing por spyad pas lha dang sgrub ba po/ /nongs pa'i rgyu rkyen bsags pa ma lus bshags/ /lo zla tshes grangs dus kyi gsol bskang mdos/ /rgyun gyi gtor ma bag med g.yeng bas chag /nag phyogs lha rigs 'byung por yid bstad de/ /'bad pas bsten cing mchod pa'i nyes kun bshags/ /dri med rig pa ye nas rang dag kyang / /kun rdzob sems kyi 'khrul (11ba)ngo'i nyes pa rnams/ /sgyu ma'i rta glang ji bzhin don dam dbyings/ /bshags bya bshags byed bral ba'i ngang nas bshags/ /zhes brjod/ phyi nang gsang ba'i bskang rdzas byin rgyas brlab pa ni/ hūṃ/ stong ca bzang sa sag kho gos ga kho kha sna rdzas nasabyung ba/ gsum kun tu dri mchog 'byung 'gyur ba'i/ /spos dang sman sbyar chu gtsang dag pa'i khrus/ /yid bzhin sprin phung mkha' la char 'bebs pa/ /mi gtsang dri ma'i tshogs kun dag gyur cig /ā+oṃ shud+dhi shud+dhi shodha na ye swāhā/ hūṃ/ bde sdong 'dab drug khri 'phang bzhin/ /nyi ma zla ba'i gdan steng du/ /bdag nyid rdo rje sems dpa'i sku/ /dkar gsal zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ /rdo rje dril bu thugs gar 'dzin/ /dar dang rin chen du mas spras/ /spyi gtsug bla ma kun bzang mthing / /mtshan dpes spras pa yum dang sbyor/ /sku yi gnas su zhi khro'i lha/ /chu nang zla ba lta bur gsal/ /ā+oṃ badz+ra satwa hūṃ/ 'dab drug shar gyi ca5()

lha mchog 'bar ba rtsal gyi 'phrin las brgya phrag nyid ngos 'dzin pa'i snang gsal/ nang ma (ka)pad 'dab la/ /sbyong ba'i lha ni shāka thub ser/ /phyag gnyis sa gnon lhung bzed bsnams/ /mtshan dang dpe byad ldan par bzhugs/ /thal mo khong stong phyag rgya'i nang / /a dkar 'od 'phros dngos 'dzin sbyangs/ ā+oṃ swa bhā wa shuḥsarba dharmāḥsu bhā wa bi shu khro3lha/ sngags 'di lan bdun brjod pa'i mthus/ /snod bcud dngos 'dzin dag gyur cig /de yi mtshams kyi pad 'dab la/ /spel ba'i lha ni rnam snang dkar/ /phyag na 'khor lo dril bu bsnams/ /mtshan dang dpe byed ldan snga/ /thal mo tshigs bcag phyag rgya'i nang / — sngon 'od 'phros snod bcud spel/ /na maḥ(12nasgo rba ta thā ga te bh+yo bi shwa mu khe saḥsarba thā khi ud ga te lpa ra ṇa i mo ga ga na khaṃ/ sngags 'di lan bdun brjod pa'i ya/ /snod bcud legs tshogos spel gyur cig /de yi mtshams kyi pad 'dab la/ /bsgyur lha bdud rtsi 'khyil pa ljang / /phyag mtshan rgya gram dril bu bsnams/ /mtshan dang dpe byad ldan par bzhugs/ /thal mo kha gyer phyag rgya'i nang / /dzaḥdamar 'od 'phros bdud rtsir bsgyur/ /ā+oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍali ha na ha na hūṃ phaṭa/ sngags 'di lan bdun za/ /snod bcud zag med bdud rtsir gyur/ /de yi mtshams kyi pad 'dab la/ /thob lha rin 'byung sku mdog ser/ /phyag na rin chen dril bu bsnams/ /mtshan dang dpe byad ldan ri/ /mchog sbyin phyag rgya'i khri ser las/ /'od 'phros kun gyis 'bad med thob/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta a wa lo gi te oṃ saṃ bha ra 6bha ra hūṃ/ sngags 'di lan bdun mo/ /mgron rnams kun gyis thob gyur cig /de yi mtshamasakyi pad 'dab la/ /chim lha don yod grub pa ljang / /rgyas mtshan ral gri dril bu bsnams/ /mtshan dang dpe byad ldan par〉/ khu tshur mchog sbyin phyag rgya'i nang / /ha ljang 'od los mgron mnyes bsam/ /ā+oṃ dzñā na a wa lo ki te na maḥs man+ta skyo ra ṇa ra smi saṃ bha wa sa ma ya mahā ma ṇi du ru du ruX da la dza ya ni swāhā/ sngags 'di lan bdun kho/ /mgron kun dgyes shing tshim gyur cig /de yi mtshams kyi pad 'dab la/ /dbang chen phyag rdor ljang dmar ni/ /phyag mtshan rdo rje dril bu rnams/ /mtshan dang dpe byad ldan (12ba)par bzhugs/ /sor bsnol phyag rgya'i dza dmar las/ /'od 'phros mgron bzhi'i mthu stobs sdus/ /na mas man+ta bud+dhā ni gra he shwa ri brabha ñtsa dza ti ma hā sa ma ya hūṃ phaṭa/ sngags 'di lan bdun —551—

rgyal ba lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (25)brjod pa'i mthus/ /dbang sdud 'phrin las kun 'grub shog zhes byin gyis brlab/ phyi'i bskang ba ni/rab yol mo ga gsum pas mdzad/ dwangs zhi ba'i rlabs ldan gtsang ma'i chab/ /lhung lhung snyan pa'i sgrar bcas rgyun 'bab klung / /g.ya' chu gangs chu lu mar skye sogs kyi/ /mchod yon mdzes par sbrengs pas khyod mchod do/ /puṇ+ḍa ri ga'i tshal rgyas āt+pal nags/ /gzhan yang chu dang thang skyes me tog tshogs/ /dpyid kyi dpal mos rab spel 'phreng mdzes pa/ /lha mchog dbu la 'ching ba'i thod du 'bul/ /tsan dan spos dkar lha shug sogs sbyar ba'i/ /dud sprin srid pa gsum gyi blar 'phungs pas/ /ma dag nyesapa'i dri ma kun sel ba/ shangs kyi dbang po tshim phyir bdag 'bul lo/ /rab sbyangs nor bu'i sgron me sna tshogs dang / /rtsi bcud til gyi mar me gsal 'bar bas/ /bskal pa'i gshe mun mthar byed ā lo kai /ma bsgribs gsal bar spyan gyi gzigs mor 'bul/ /ga pur dog pas rab bsil gur kum gyi/ /ge sar rdul tshogs rgyas pas rab mdzes pa/ /yid 'ong khrus kyi rdzing bu 'di dag ni/ /brjid pa'i sku la byug pa'i rdzas su sbyar/ /'bras dkar phung po 'bru bcud bzang po dang / /gnyis su med sbyar rgyan ldan gtsang ma'i bskos/ /dkar gsum mngar gsum shing rtag 'bru sna yis/ /(13na skogasakyi dbang po kun nas tshim gyur cig /rnga wo dung dang sil snyan gling bu'i sgras/ /rab drangs dri ba'i dbyangasasu rab 'tsher ba'i/ /spyan 'dren mchod bstod bskul ba'i gyer mang po/ /thogs pa med gsan lha yi snyan la 'bul/ /skad cig gcig la stong gsum 'jig rten kun/ /bgrod byed rgya phrul shugs ldan mdzes pa'i chibs/ /gser dngul dar zab rgyan ldan lha rta dkar/ /gsang chen bka' yi bya ra mdzad phyir 'bul/ /sprin dkar dag pa'i phung po cher phungs lta'i/ /zhol dkar rdo rje'i rwa ldan ri ltar 'gying / /sna tsho gos dar gyi phon pos ltar mi mngon/ /phyi rten lha g.yag mdzes pas thugs dam bskang / /thogasamed cir yang rgyu ba skar mda'i spun/ /mdzes pa'i dung khra 'phur lding gzan la bcu mu/ shel dum ltar dkar gtsang lug mang po yis/ /lha mchog thugs kyi dgyes pa skong gyur cig /'dod gzugs 'jig rten kun na zla bral zhing / /zla ba'i gdugs dkar g.yas su 'khor ba'i tog /yid bzhin nor bus—552

lha mchog 'bar ba rtsal gyi 'phrin las brgya phrag nyid ngos 'dzin pa'i snang gsal/ nang ma (ka)mtshan pa bsil ba 'bod/ /rgyal mtshan dar 'phan rnga yab dkar pos bskang / /mchog dman rin chen mang spungs gter gyi ri/ /dar zab lda ldir rab dpyangs tshon ris kyis/ /phyogs la dbang po'i tshon dgod spyan gzigs kyis/ /lha gnyan 'khor bcas thugs dam skongs gyur cig /gsar bris/sra brtan khrab chen za 'og sham bu can/ /rgyal mtshan dar lcog rgod spur mas ldan glog /rnga ma'i 'ja' risazhol btags lcags gzhibs sogs/ /rang srung rdo rje'i go chas thugs dam bskang / /ral gri (13ba)spu gri dgra sta dpag chen mda'/ /gri gug rtse gsum dung rnon 'phrul sgrogs sogs/ /pha rol dgra dpung phye mar 'thag nus nga/'i/ /sna tshogs mtshon cha'i rigs kun khyod la 'bul/ kha dog rab bkra tse ber lhab lhub gos/ /lha mi'i rin chen rgyan cha ska rags lham/ /pad 'phreng snyan gong ༄ la dar lce g.yo/ /stag sham sprul gyi chun pos khyod mchod do/ /sba lcag shel 'phreng gser gyi 'khor lo bri/ /sman ljon bcud bum nor bu rin chen sgrom/ /mdung zhabs lcags kyi mda' gzhu mchil pa dang / /rgyal mtshan me long phyag mtshan tshogs rnams 'bul/ /rta nag ne'u le g.yu 'brug seng stag dom/ sha rkyang rma bya ba tso thang dkar sogs/ /gnam la 'phur dgu sa la 'jul dgu dang / /ri dwags 'phyo dgu'i tshogasakyis thugs dam bskang / /bzang drug tsan dan ga pur la sogs sman/ /bkra shis rtags brgyad rgyal srid sna bdun dang / /ri rab gling bzhi:nga phran nyi zla sogs/ /lha klu gnod sbyin me yi 'byor tshogs 'bul/ /phyi'i rten ni/ yol mo ba'i gsung la sa thod bsnan pa/ maṇ+ḍal gru bzhi smyug rgod dar snas brgyan/ /bris 'bur zhal brnyan ye shes sems dpa' 'khyil/ /dar dkar gzhi dmar legs bris snying po'i phreng / /lha chen chags pa'i phyi sgrub rten du 'bul/ /nang gi bskang ba ni/ gser skyems/ raṃ yol mo ba gsum pas mdzad/yaṃ kho ā+oṃ āḥ& gis byin gyis brlab/ hūṃ/ 'bru bzhi stong la sbyar ba'i dza gad dang / /dkar dang rgya ja gtsang ma'i gser phye sbar/ /'chi med bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen po 'dis/ /lha chen 'khor bcas thugs dam skong gyur cig /(14na༄sa brjod/ logs su gser skyems bshams pa las kyi rdo rjes bteg la/ho/ dri za'i gsar bris/ rgyal po rdo rje 'bar ba rtsal 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyis gser gyi mchod pa —553

rgyal ba lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (25)rgya chen po 'di bzhes la bdag cag dpon slob rgyu sbyor kun la gnod par byed pa'i ban bon sngags pa'i mthu byad/ snang srid lha 'dre'i za kha zug pa/ nad gdon bar chad/ chags che nyam nga / khyad par steng 'og bar gsum gyi gdon gnod thams cad bzlog tu gsol/ bye brag che ge mo sogs dngos nyams rmi lam du cho 'phrul ngan pa ston pa po rnams sprul pa'i lha g.yag dkar pos 'dam ltar rdzis/ dung khra dkar pos mchus thal phyung du phug /lcags kyi sdig pa nag pos srog rtsa chod la rdul du rlog cig /mdor na 'phrin las rnam bzhi lhun gyis grub par mdzad du gsol/ zhes brjod cing gtsang sar gtor/ tshogs mchod ni/ ā+oṃ dro be+e tā lī kro dha ni sarba dra bye /sho dha ni hūṃ gti bcog4 smosalas/ phaṭa swāhā/ rdo rje lta bu'i ye shes kyis/ /chos kun thams cad sgyu mar rig /rig pa'i ye shes re kho/ /tshogs kyi dngos po bsregs sbyangs bkru/ /ā+oṃ āḥshā gis byin gyis brlab/ zhi rdzas dang drag rdzas kyi tsho gis phud ma 'dres par bshams/ dang po mchod pa ni/ gdod yol mo bag4pas mdzad nas yongs dag dam tshig chen po'i rdzas/ /ye shes bdud rtsi'i bza' bca' gas ba'i dngos/ /lha chen yum gcig 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ /bzhes nas dam tshig bka' yi bya ra mdzod/ /rdo rje 'bar ba rtsal sa pa ri wa ra ga ṇa tsakra pā dza khā hi/ (14ba thar pa ni/ sgrub rdzas ma tshogs mna' dang dam las 'gal/ /mi gtsang grib phog dam med mi dang 'dres/ /nag phyogs lha rigs bsten sogs nyes spyad tshogs/ /rang gnong 'gyod pas bshags so byang bar mdzod/ /tham la nya bo dang phyag mtshan rnams bsham/ /hūṃ/ gsar bris/ e las thar med gnam lcags 'brub khung nang / /: dang tri las dam nyams dgra bgegs tshogs/ /skra gzings rid cing yan lag lcags sgrog bsdams/ /nyam thag mya ngan 'dug stangs can du gyur/ /dgra bgegs bla tshe rnam shes 'gugs pa'i ched/ /rang nyid dri za'i rgyal por gsal ba yi/ /phyag g.yas sba lcag 'phyar bsam mo bdun/ /skar mda' 'phangs pa bzhin du thogs med song / /na ma rbad bh+yo lan bdun brjod/ hūṃ zhes brjod pas skad cig gnas gyur te/ /dpa' bo rdo rje 'bar rtsal phyag gnyis kyis/ /lcags kyus snying bzung zhags pas ske bcings tshe/ /ma mo bdun gyi nga ro bcas te —554

lha mchog 'bar ba rtsal gyi 'phrin las brgya phrag nyid ngos 'dzin pa'i snang gsal/ nang ma (ka)bkug /rtsi tri dzaḥdzaḥlan bdun brjod/ pho nya bskul la/ na maḥrtsa gsum lha tshogs bden pa dang / /chos nyid ye nas tsor ba med pa la/ /chos can rgyu 'bras slu med bden pa dang / khyad par zhi ba byang semasanam mkha'i snying / khro bo rdo rje 'bar rtsal 'khor bcas kyi/ /mthu stobs nus pa pahrūl bden pa dang / /che mnyam bsod nams 'brel ba'i bden pa dang / /'go lha ru bzhi'i yul lha'i bden pa dang / /mna' dang dam la gnas pa'i sgrub pa po'i/ /ting 'dzin sngags dang phyag rgya'i byin rlabs dang / khyod gsol mchod sgrub brtson pa'i bden pa dang / /(15na tha den pa chen po'i mthu dang byin rlabs kyis/ /sangs rgyas bstan 'jig 'gro ba'i bde skyid 'phrog /yang gsang bka' gter snying po'i bstan pa snub/khyad par sngags 'chang dpon slob rgyu sbyor la/ /byad ma dug mtshon g.yul 'khrug ngan gros mkhan/ /bsam ngan sbyor ba rtsub pa'i gzugs can dgra/ /tshe la rku zhing srog la rnam par 'jab/ /lus la na tsha sems la sdug bsngal gtong / /bsam par bar du gcod pa'i gzugs med bgegs/ /spyo 'dre rgyal bsan 'gong po dam sri'i tshogs/ /rbad 'dre lha srin 'byung po ma rungs kun/ khu gcig badz+ra a dru sha ya dza/ /ske nas chings shig badz+ra pā sha hūṃ/ /yan lag sdoms shig badz+ra sgro ṭa baṃ/ /myos par gyis shig badz+ra ghaṇ+ḍi lho tre phye zhig badz+ra pra be sha ya phaṭa/ dbyer med bstim zhig a be sha ya āḥ zhes lan gsum mam bdun so gos dgug gzhug bya/ /de nas bsgral ba ni/ hūṃ rang nyid dmi rdo rje 'bar ba rtsal thabs shes lcags kyi mda' gzhur bar dang nas/ /gnam lcags 'bar ba'i mde'u dgra bgegs kyi/ /snying la 'phangs te sod cig sha re ṇa/ /dar lce rlung gis bskyod pa'i ba dan can/ /rno ngar dbal dang ldan pa rnon po'i mdung / /gzugs can dgra dang gzugs med bgegs tshogs kyi/ /lte bar bsnun no phug cig ku rnye na/ /rang nyid lha chen tshangs par gnas 'gyur ba'i/ /mi bzad rno ngar ldan pa'i ral gri yis/ /gnod byed dgra dang bgegs kyi yan lag rnams/ /tshal pa dum bur yams shig kha zhen/ /rtsibs (15bsko lhong gser gyi 'khor lo thogs med du/ khugs drag rab 'khor rno dpal 'bar ba yis/ /sdang byed dgra dang gnod byed bgegs rnams kyis/ /mgo la bskor bas 'gems so tsakra ṇa/ /dgra bgegs —555

rgyal ba lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (25)spyo 'dre dam sri 'byung po'i srog la mā ra ya phaṭa/ rtsi tri mā ra ya sod/ ces dum bur gtubs/ /ling ror bdud rtsi bran la/ yol mo ba gsum pas mdzad/gdug byed dgra bo mi bsrun dam nyams kyi/ /gzugs phung sha khrag rus pa klad tshil snying / /glo ba rgyu ma nang khrol rkang mar dang / /dngas ma chu ba dbang po rnam lnga'i tshogs/ /bhan+dha yangs pa'i snod du yongs bskyil nas/ /rlung me 'bar ba'i sbyor bas skol byasashing / /'bru gsum zhu ba'i bdud rtsi chen po 'di/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung phyir gus pas 'bul /rab thos lha chen rdo rje 'bar ba rtsal/ /rdo rje g.yu sgron bdud mor khros pa'i gzugs/ /'jigs pa'i mi bdun las byed bshan pa'i tshogs/ /sprul 'khor sde brgyad dregs pa'i tsho gos kyis bzhes/ /ma hā mo sa rat+na go ro tsa na ba su ha bo dhi tsit+ta ke ma : ti in+d+ra pañtsa khā hi/ zhes 'bul/ lhag ma la bdud rtsi bran/ yol mo ba gsum pas mdzad/ ā+oṃ āḥ/ gis byin gyis brlabs la/ rang lha chen po'i ting nge 'dzin gyis/ /lhag la dbang ba bran dang pho lha'i tshogs/ /mchod sbyin bka' yi pham phab 'di long las /gtso bo'i bka' bzhin bcol ba'i 'phrin las rnams/ /ma thogs myur du sgrub pa'i las mdzod cig /ma hā ba lin+ta ji hi/ nang rten ni/ yol mo ba'i gsung la sa da bsnan pa/ dkar gsum gtsang phye sman (16na)phud yongs sbyar bar/ /sna tshogs rgyan gyi khyad par bkod legs pa/ zhal mkhar rin chen sgo lcog 'bar ba'i dbyibs/ /dam rdzas gtor ma nang gi rten du 'bul/ /zhes brjod/ gsang ba'i bskang ba ni rab yol mo ba gsum pa mdzad/mdzes gsang ba'i yum chen g.yu sgron ma/ /'dzum sgeg zur gyis lta ba'i mi g.yangs/ ma/ /nu 'bur rab mtho rked skabs rab phra ma/ /brgyad gnyis lon 'dra'i gzugs bzang bde sbyin ma/ khyug khyug smin legs ri mor bris 'dra zhing / /sil sil dbu skra'i lan bu rgyan tu grol/khrol khrol gser gyi gdu bu rab 'khrol zhing / /lhang lhang snyan pa'i glu sgra len pas brel/ /sngo bsangs lang tsho ldan pa'i lus kyi mkha'/ /mu tig rgyu skar bye bas rnam bkra zhing / /dar zab rnam lnga'i 'ja' tshon spel legs kyi/ /smad dkris sham bus mdzes pa deng 'dir dran/ /ma mchu'i sbrang rtsi ci yang ster byed cing / /mnyen lhug dam por 'byud pa'i phyagazung ldan/ /zag med dga' bzhi'i 'dod 'byung ༄ 556

lha mchog 'bar ba rtsal gyi 'phrin las brgya phrag nyid ngos 'dzin pa'i snang gsal/ nang ma (ka)la'i//dri ldan mkha' dbyings gsar pas rnam par mtshan//lha mo khyod ni lha chen dgyes mdzad de//gnyis med gsang ba'i mchod pa 'di 'bul gyi//zung 'jug ye shes chen po'i dgongs pa yi bde chen dga' bzhi'i rol pas bzhes su gsol//mahā mu dra pā tsa heḥgu spo byu dza sa ma ya hoḥgasang ba'i rten ni/yol mo ge gsum pas mdzad pa/ting 'dzin gsal ba'i don mtshon man shel dkar//dri med 'od rgyun zad mi shes pa'i rten//rnam par mi rtog thugs kyi dam rdzas mchoge/gsang 16brten yid bzhin nor bus thugs dam bskang //de kho na nyid kyi bskang ba ni/hūṃ/gdod gsar bris/nas dri bral ngo bon ma mkha'i snying //rang bzhin lhun grub 'gag pa med pa'i gdangs//kun khyab lha chen ngang du nges rnyed pa'i/ /don dam mchog gi mchod pas thugs dam bskang / /yol mo spugasum pas mdzad/bde gsal mi rtog dbyings rig dbyer med pa/ /dus gsum rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i bgrod gcig lam/ /lha chen thugs kyi dgongs pa zab zhi'i ngang //ji bzhin mnyam par bzhag pas thugs dam bskang //rtsa gsum bskang gso btang nas tshogs la rol/ bstod pa ni/ hūṃ/ dpal gter g.yi / ldan lha yi lha mchog khyed//'dzam gling byang phyogs kha ba can/kha ba can gyi byang ljongs su//sa gzhi ljang sngon rtsi bcud rgyas/ /me tog pad+ma 'od du 'phro/ /gangs dkar shel gyi 'phreng bas bskor/ /yid 'ong mtsho chen mdangs dang ldan/ zhal mkhar rin chen sgo lcog 'bar/ /rtsa ba yid bzhin rgya mtshos bsten/ /rked par 'ja' 'od na bun thabs//rtse mor dkar gsal dgos 'dod kyi//rin chen char 'bebs ga sgra sgrog/gzhal yas de yi nang shed na//nyi zla pad+ma rta mchog steng //dam can rdo rje 'bar ba rtsal/sku mdog dkar la khro 'dzum 'gying //phyag g.yas rdo rje'i spa lcag 'phyar//g.yon pa zla ba'i shes 'phreng 'dren//dar dkar thod bcings dbu skra'i rtser//yid bzhin nor bu 'bar bas brgyan//sku la ber chen phrug gsum gso le//gzhon mdzes yid 'phrog rgyal po'i chas//'od zer sna tsho gis phyogs17nabacur 'phro//mched 'khor sum brgya drug cu dang //dmag dpung bye ba 'bum sdes bskor//kun kyang khro gtum brjid pa'i gzugs//dar tshon rol moXnam mkha' gang //bde gshegs stong gi bstan

rgyal ba lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (25)pa bsrung / /pad+ma 'byung gnas bka' bzhin bsgrub/ /chos rgyal mnga' ris bu bzhin skyong / /dbus gtsang ru bzhi'i yul lha mdzad/ /rje dpon yongs kyi dgra lhar gyur/ /rdo rje 'bar ba rtsal la bstod/ /lha chen yongs kyi rje bor bstod/ /dri za'i rgyal po khyod la bstod/ /deng nas rigs 'dzin mchog thob par/ /snyan pa nam mkha'i 'brug ltar sgrogs/ /grags pa gza' skar 'od ltar khye/ /dbu 'phang ri rgyal rtse ltar bstod/ /rigs brgyud chu bo'i rgyun ltar spel/ /dgos 'dod dpag bsam shing ltar stsol/ /sde brgyad dregs pa bran ltar bkol/ /spyo 'dre rgyal po rdul bzhin thul/ /dam med mna' zan bgegs bzhin sgrol/ /bdag gi lus dang grib ma bzhin/ /'grogs nas dngos grub rnam gnyis stsole/ /gsar bris/ chos kyi dbyings las nam yang g.yo med dang / /brlang por spyod pa'i yid srubs sde dpung rnams/ /'dul phyir nam mkha'i snying po lha chen skur/ /ston mdzad rdo rje 'bar ba rtsal la bstod/ /lha brgyad gangs ri'i 'phrong bas bskor ba'i ljongs/ /rin chen rgyan gyis mdzes pa'i pho brang dbus/ /pad+ma nyi zla'i steng na gar dgu yis/ /rnam rol dri za'i rgyal po khyod la bstod/ zhal dkar zhun ma'i lhun po zla zer gyis/ /'khyud 'dra'i gzugs skus lha yi khengs pa 'phrog /gnam (17ba tshe sngon khu bas byugs pa'i thor tshugs rtser/ /yid bzhin dbang gi rgyal pos mtshan la bstod/ /'ja' ltar rnam par bkra ba'i spyan dkyus ring / /smin legs g.yu yi 'khri shing mngon par 'gyug cung zad khro nyams zhi chagasamachu sgros 'dab/ /'dzum dbus tshems dkar ze'u 'byu rgod la bstod/ /phyag g.yas rdo rjes mtshan pa'i sba dkar lcag /lha lam ngos lkor ma bdun las la 'gyed/ /g.yon pa legs nyes rtsis su 'dren pa yi/ /man shel brgya rtsa'i 'phreng ba 'dzin la bstod/ /dmar mthing tse gos rin chen gser sked bcings/ /gos dkar ber chen lding stabs tshul du gsol/ /brog zhu snyen mgul gdu bu se mo do/ /do shal gser ga'i rgyan gyis spud la bstod/ /nor bu'i sga srab gong rmed za 'og gi /spu len ze long khebs mdzes ngang dkar bcibs/ /gom 'gros lhod por rgyu steng phyed skyil zhabs/ /rin chen las grub mchil lham gsol la bstod/ /bde ster gsang yum g.yu sgron nam mkha'i mdog /rgyal mtshan —558—

lha mchog 'bar ba rtsal gyi 'phrin las brgya phrag ted ros 'dzin pa'i snang gsal/ nang ma (ka)me long 'dzin cing lhab lhub gos/ /mdzes pa'i rgyan 'brol g.yu 'byug steng bzhugs pa/ /yid 'phrog sman btsun gnam mtsho'i rgyal mor bstod/ /gnam lcags spu gri'i rwa dang mchu sder can/ /stang zil mdog bzhin gnag 'tsher dbu dgu pa/ /krim krim sgra yis sa bdag klu gnyan klad/ /'gems byed gtsug lding khyung chen dbang por bstod/ /cho rigs mtshungs pa'i mched po lha yi bu/ /ston zla'i mdzesapa 'phrog pa'i bzhin ras can/ /las sgrub pho nyar 'khor gyi sgyu ma'i 'phrul/ /ston mdzad sum brgya drug cu'i tshogs la bstod/ /g.yu smin thor tsugs lha gnyan khye'u dang / /mi dkar g.yas g.yon mdun gyi dpung sna 'dren/ /'jigs rung lcags kyi mi sngon rgyab kyi rtswa /drangs nas g.yul las rnam par rgyal la bstod/ /rtsi sman ljon shing dri ngad 'thul ba dang / /lhan cig ka la sha yi bdud rtsi'i chus/ /bkrus tshe bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi las gyur pa'i/ /nad kyi zug rngu drung nas 'byin la bstod/ /rab 'bar nor bu rin wo sgrom bu las/ /lha klu gnod sbyin mi yi longs spyod kyi/ /'dzad med mchod sbyin char gyis bkres skom sogs/ /dbul ba'i duḥkha pha mthar mdzad la bstod/ /pad+ma rā ga'i bum bzang 'khor 'das kyi/ /srog gi zungs gyur bcud kun 'khyil ba'i rgyun/ /sbyin pa'i mod la 'chi ba med pa'i tshe/ /grub pa'i rigs 'dzin sa la sbyor der bstod/ /mdud rnon mtshon gyis dgra snying tshal pa sa /btang bas ma tshim thog chen 'bar ba'i mda'/ /gnam lcags gzhu mor bkang tshe srid pa gsum/ /'dar byed drag shul brtul zhugs 'chang la bstod/ /skabs gsum bdag po'i lang tsho 'phrog nus pa'i/ /bzhin bzang skyes bu gzhen nu'i rnam 'gyur gyis/ /che mnyam tshangs pa lha yi me tog gi /srung ma'i gtso bor zhal gyis 'ches la bstod/ /sngo bsangs rwa rtse srid pa'i rtse mor gdengs/ /rmig pas spyo 'dre la sogs 'byung po brdzi/ kha rlangs na bun bzhin 'thul 'brug sgra ltar/ /ngur ba'i 'byong g.yag zhol chen dkar por bstod/ /btab pa tsam gyis yid dbang 'phrog nus pa'i/ /rab dmar lcags (18ba)kyu zhags pa'i 'phrul chen pos/ khab len rdo dang lcags bzhin brtan g.yo'i dngos/ /'bad med dbang du bsdu bar mdzad la bstod/ /sis wā ra'i mdangs kyis 'jig rten gsum/ /zil gnon bran 'khol —559

rgyal ba lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (25)ral gri gser 'khor gyi/ /rag pa'i rtsa lag 'thag pa'i mthu rtsal ldan/ /tshangs pa dung gi thor tshugs can la bstod/ /mi rabs phyugs dang longs spyod 'phung ba'i sri/ /'dre ngan 'byung po bya dkar gzugasasprul ba/ /gnam lcags mchu dang sder mos thal phyung du/ /'bugs mdzad sprul pa'i rgya khra dkar por bstod/ /smyo 'bog ṣi rma rgyal gzer dmu chu dang / /'byug slong gtong ba'i lha si gdon gyi snying / /rnon po'i mche ba btab nas khrag 'jib pa'i/ /'jigs rung lcags kyi sdig pa nag por bstod/ /spu gri'i mche gtsigs sder mos sa gzhi 'drad/ /mjug ma brdabs pas me rlung 'tshub ma g.yo/ /glog ltar 'khyug pas stong gsum skad cig ma/ /myul mdzad sprul pa'i dung spyang pho mor bstod/ /mdog dbyibs cha lugs phyag mtshan sna tsho gos pa/ /zhi rgyas chags pa nyams kyi rnam 'gyur dang / /mi sdug gtum po phyi nang bar gsum du/ /'khod pa'i 'khor tsho gos dam can rgya mtshor bstod/ /'phrin las 'chol ba ni/ yol mo ba gsum pas mdzad/ pad+ma thod 'phreng rgyal ba'i spyan snga mā /dam bcas zhal bzhes thugs dam rjes dgongs la/ /rnal 'byor bdag gis ji ltar bcol ba'i las/ /ma lus yid bzhin 'grub pa'i las mdzod cig /skyo ba'i 'dre rgod rgyal po kun 'dul zhing / /rnam thos bu yi bdog pas yang dag 'byor/ /sngags (19na jis mu dra dbang du 'du ba dang / /phas rgol g.yul las rgyal ba'i las mdzod cig /'chi med bdud rtsi'i btung bas yun du 'tsho/ /byad ma ban bon gdug pa'i mthus mi brdzi/ /bstan 'dzin rigs brgyud chu bo'i rgyun lta bu/ /rang gzhan don kun 'grub pa'i las mdzod cig /gnod byed dgra sder thog ser char ltar 'bebs/ /gtad khram las kyi sde dpon sum cu'i tshogs/ /bran bkol mdze phol gzer thabs smyo 'bog dang / /nad rims du mas bstan dgra phung du chug /lha yi lha mchog khyod 'khor lha chen brgyad/ /sde dpon sum cu sde brgyad bstan mar bcas/ /las la bkol nas srid gsum zil gnon cing / /grags 'bar las bzhi 'grub pa'i nus ldan mdzod/ /mtshan ldan thod pa shel phor ci rigs pa/ /'bras dkar dza gad bzang pos yongs bkang ba'i/ /rten 'brel thabs kyis legs nyes kun gsal zhing / /gza' rgod gnod pa zhi ba'i las mdzod cig /khyad par rgyal bas—560

lha mchog 'bar ba rtsal gyi 'phrin las brgya phrag nyid ngos 'dzin pa'i snang gsal/ nang ma (ka)gnyer gtad yongs 'du'i brgyud/ /dgung la reg dang bu bzhin skyong ba sa /dam bcas zhal bzhes dus las mi g.yel bar/ /srung skyob yongs su sba ba'i las mdzod cig /slob dpon smod rtsod skur 'debs zhe snang ba'i/ /dam nyams slob bu mna' zan skye bo'i tshogs/ /log 'dren dgra bgegs ma lus tshar bcad nas/ /bka' gsung bstan pa rgyas pa'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /gter g.yi / nga ni dbang drag pad+ma'i sras/ /nyid ni lha chen 'bar ba rtsal/ /sngon gyi zhal bzhes thugs dam dgongs/ /mthu (19brkong rdzu 'phrul stobs bskyed la/ /nad gdon bar chad mi mthun phyogs/ /ma lus zhi ba'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /tshe dang bsod nams phan bde'i tshogs/ /cir yang rgyas pa'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /snod bca 'khor dang longs spyod tshogs/ khams gsum dbang sdud 'phrin las mdzod/ /log lta gnod byed dgra bgegasarnams/ /tshar gcod drag po'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /snyan par bsngags dang grags pa'i tshogs/ /phyogs bcur rgyas pa'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /'gro kun smin grol legs lam ston/ /don gnyis mthar phyin 'phrin las mdzod/ /bskul ba ni/ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ/ ga kho gas /bzhugs yul 'dam shod snar mo nas/ /ya zhur gnyan po sku bzhengs shig /bla mtsho 'khyil ba'i nang shed nas/ /gnyan chen thang lha sku bzhengs shig /brag dkar gnyan po'i rtse mo nas/ /dri za'i rgyal po sku bzhengs shig /gangs dkar mthon po'i rtse mo nas/ khul lha chen po sku bzhegs shig /sprin dang na bun gseb shed nas/ /zur phud lnga pa sku bzhengs shing / /sdang ba'i dgra 'dul sku bzhengs shig /gnod pa'i bgegs 'dul sku bzhengs shig /spyo ba'i 'dre 'dul sku bzhengs shig /sprul pa'i tshul du sku bzhegs shig /sprul pa 'jigs pa'i lus po de/ /lha g.yag dkar po zhig /dung ru gnam du dbyug /dung ru dkar po zhig /gnam gyi bdud la bsgyur/ /nang gi god kha bsgyur/ /rmig bzhis la 'khrab/ /dung rmig dkar po yis/ /lha srin nyal thag chod/ /rnga ma dal khar dbyug /rnga dkar sprugs pa yis (20na sko btsan bran du 'khol/ /ngar skad thengs gsum ngar/ khams gsum dbang du sdud/ /ru gsigs lan gsum sprugs/ /srid gsum dbang du sdud/ /mtho mtho gong gsum nas/ /dung khra mel tshe bzhin/ /dung khra dkar po zhig /la nye khril li —561—

rgyal ba lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (25)li/ /rong dang 'phrang sgo nas/ /dung spyang dkar po zhig /dgra bo'i bla la rgyug /drag tu bskul ba'i tshe/ /sdang ba'i dgra bo gsad/ /gnod pa'i bgegs rnams thul/ ā+oṃ badz+ra kro ta na shi li mi li du bgegs mā ra ya phaṭa/ hūṃ/ yang gcig nag po ti pa ra tsa khyod/ /byang phyogs rgyud du che ba'i skur ston pa/ /gnyan chen thang lha zhes su mtshan yang gsol/ /dam rdzas rgyan pa'i gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /bdag cag rigs 'dzin 'khor dang bcas pa yi/ /chos rgyal rat+na gling pa'i drag dmar chos sde la byung ba/mi mthun rkyen sol mthun rkyen bsam pa sgrubs/ /skyid shod klung du che ba'i skur ston pa/ /gnyan chen mkhar nag ces su mtshan yang gso le/ /dam rdzas rgyan gyi gtore ma 'di bzhes la/ /bdag cag rigs 'dzin 'khor dang bcas pa yi/ /mi mthun rkyen sol mthun rkyen bsam pa sgrubs/ /pho mo rdzing ring phyogs su che ba'i skur ston pa/ /klu bdud mgo dgu zhes su mtshan yang gsol/ /dam rdzas rgyan gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /bdag cag rigs 'dzin 'khor dang bcas pa yi/ /mi mthun rkyen sol mthun rkyen bsam pa sgrubs/ /lho stod dbu ru'i phyogs su che ba'i skur ston pa/ /sku la mkha' ri zhes su mtshan yang gsol/ /dam rdzas rgyan gyi mo/ /(20ba thad ga cag rigs 'dzin za/ /mi mthun rkyen sol྾/ /sgo chu lha rgyab phyogs su che ba'i skur ston pa/ /bdud po zla ba'i gdong can zhes su mtshan yang gsol/ /dam rdzas rgyan gyi྾ / /bdag cag rigs 'dzin sa / /mi mthun rkyen sol sa / /mon kha ring mo'i phyogs su che ba'i skur ston pa/ /bdud po bkrag med ces su mtshan yang gsol/ /dam rdzas rgyan gyi sko/ /bdag cag rigs 'dzin rki/ /mi mthun rkyen sol ri/ /seng ge rdzong gsum phyogs su che ba'i skur ston pa/ /zur ra zur skyes zhes su mtshan yang gsol/ /dam rdzas ri/ /bdag cags/ /mi mthun ri/ /lho brag mkhar chu'i phyogs su che ba'i skur ston pa/ /dge bsnyen ston kha zhes su mtshan yang gsol/ /dam rdzas rgyan gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /bdag cag rigs 'dzin 'khor dag bcas pa yi/ /mi mthun rkyen sol mthun rkyen bsam pa sgrubs/ /nag po ti bar tsa nā ga raka kro ta pa tsa la dgra bgegs kyi sha khrag rus pa la rbad rbad/ ces ga bdun brjod/ thun gtor la chab spran la/ hūṃ/ ga khog yig yas ru ri rgyal —562

lha mchog 'bar ba rtsal gyi 'phrin la brgya phrag nyid ngos 'dzin pa'i snang gsal/ nang ma (ka)bkra bzang rtser/ /rigs 'dzin rdo rje drag po rtsal/ /bka' nyan lha srin kun 'dus che/ khri srong lde'u btsan sku lha khyed/ /lha brag thugs gter bdag por bsngags/ /rdzogs pa chen po'i rnal 'byor skyong / /snyigs dus rgyal 'gong dam sri yi/ /gnyen po srog gi gshed mar bskos/ /rgyal ba'i bstan pa gus mchod cing / /dkar phyogs skyong ba'i las la brtson/ /gus pas bsten la snying nye zhing / /mgon skyabs dpung gnyen mi (21na tshe khral bsrung / /mdor na bdag sogs 'khor bcas kyi/ /byang chub sgrub la gegs med cing / /bsam dgu chos bzhin 'grub pa dang / /'dod dgu yid bzhin 'byung ba yi/ /mchog thun dngos grub ma lus rnams/ /'bad med lhun grub 'phrin las mdzod/ /yang thog tu mchod gtor spyan gzigs dang gzhan yang rten 'dogs rnams gzhung bzhin ma/ mchod rdzas rnams dkyus ltar byin gyis brlab/ ye shes gzhal yas bskyed kyi rgya ma chung / zhes pa nas/ sam ya dzaḥdzaḥs spyan drangs/ swo/ bod yul phyogs bzhi dbus dang lnga/ /'dzam gling sa yi dbus phyogs na/ /lha ri chags pa gangs dkar ri/ /gangs dkar shel 'od 'bar ba'i gnas/ /rtse la na bun thibs se thib/ /logs la 'dab chags stongs rtse stong / ga kho ston gyis mdzad pa/ /zur la gcan gzan khral la la/ /rtsa bar g.yu mtsho khyil li li/ /'dzam gling shar nas bltas tsa na/ khel gyi maṇ+ḍal brtsegs pa 'dra/ /'dzam gling lho nas bltas tsa na/ /za 'og yol chen 'then pa 'dra/ /'dzam gling nub nas bltas tsa na/ /dung gi gur dkar phub pa 'dra/ /'dzam gling byang nas bltas tsa na/ /dung seng gnam du mchong ba 'dra/ /rtse lnga nam mkha'i mthongs su gsal/ khrel 'dra gur khang rtser re re/ /rmang gzhi dog mo'i dkyil na gnas/ /'byung po'i tshogs rnams skyil li li/ /rked pa g.yung drung gling dgur gnas/ /sdebargyad srog 'khor sgor ro ro/ /de 'dra'i gzhal (21badzes dam pa na/ /su bzhugs de ni su mi bzhugs/ /de na rje yi sku lha gnyan po bzhugs/ /zur phud lnga pa 'khor bcas bzhugs/ /de na jo bo gnyan chen thang lha bzhugs/ /mi dkar g.yu yi smin ma can/ /dar dkar ber chen sku la gsol/ /rin chen rgyan cha du mas brgyan/ /stag ral g.yas la gzig shubs g.yon/ /sku yi mas ni mdzes sdug 'od du 'bar/ /—563

rgyal ba lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (25)thog rgod gtum pos khams gsum zil gyis gnon/ /las kyi shog mdas dgra bgegs srog dbugs 'dral/ /lcags kyi ral gris dgra bgegs mgo lus gcod/ /bar snang khams nas gar btagags thogs pa med/ /thang lha gnyan sras sku la bstod pa 'bul/ /mdzes pa'i zur phud lnga pos sku la brgyan/ /gser gyi sba lcag g.yu yi lcag 'bras can/ /lan gsum klad dbyugs chib bas par drag tu brgyab/ /thang lha gnyan sras sku la bstod pa 'bul/ /ngang dkar zhur pos gar bsams yud kyis phyin/ /'jigs pa'i bya khyung dbu yi gtsug na lding / /sa bdag klu gnyan las kyi pho lhar 'gyed/ /klu rgyal thod dkar sku la bstod pa 'bul/ /rnal 'byor bdag gis bstod cing mchod phul bas/ /stag seng dom dred rngam 'jigs dgra la ston/ /bstod cing bskul bas g.yel ba ma mdzad cig /tshur gshegs bdag gis bcol ba'i 'phrin las mdzod/ gtor ma dkar gsum dngar gsum gyi steng du/ /'bru gsum oṃ āḥ& 'od du zhu ba las grub pa/ 'dod dgu khrung ba'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur pa 'di/ /lha chen rdorje 'bar ba rtsal 'khor (22na skong bcas pa'i zhal du ā+oṃ badz+ra thang ka ra sa pa ri wa ra mahā bha kla ta kha kha/ ji hi khā hi/ oṃ āḥlha/ zhes pa bdun rgyas phul bas dgyes pa'i tshul du bsgom/ de nas yang 'khor tshogs la gtor ma zur gsum mtho gang pa brgyad dam bcu gnyis/ bcu drug gi rtse la rgyan gyis brgyan pa/gsur dud bsangs dud shin tu che ba/ 4 phud/ 'o phud/ zho phud dang bcas te 'di skad do/ /swo/ sku lha g.yas kyi ru 'dren pa/ /lha gnyan g.yu yi smin ma can/ /sku lha g.yon gyi ru 'dren pa/ khye'u chung g.yu yi zur phud can/ /sku lnga mdun gyi ru 'dren pa/ /mi dkar g.yu yi thor cog can/ /sku lha rgyab kyi ru 'dren pa/ /lcags kyi mi sngon 'jigs pa brgya/ /'dir spyon phud dang gtor ma bzhes/ /bcol ba'i 'phrin las grub par mdzod/ khab ni gnam mtsho phyug mo ste/ /sman mo g.yu yi thul pa can/ /gser g.yu spel ma'i zur phud can/ /sku la dar dkar thul pa gsol/ /phyag na dngul dkar me long bsnams/ /chibs su chu rta sngon po bcibs/ /sras ni thang sras mchor ba ste/ /mi dkar g.yu yi smin ma can/ /sku la dar dkar la'u gsol/ /lcam ni 'bri rje gang bzang ma/ /dkar mo g.yu yi thul pa can/ /nang blon phyi blon sgo bar —564

lha mchog 'bar ba rtsal gyi 'phrin las brgya phrag nyid ngos 'dzin pa'i snang gsal/ nang ma (ka)bcas/ /phyag brnyan 'khor dang bcas rnams bsgrub/ /bskul lo 'khor bcas ma g.yel zhig /bskul cing rbad na gnyan sras mthu ma chung / /thang lha gnyan sras 'khor bcas la/ phyi yi mchod pa 'bru yi g.yag lug dang / /(22bskong gi mchod pa gser tha khu chang dang sbyar/ /zhal zas rten du 'bru yi g.yag po 'bul/ /thang lha gnyan sras 'khor bcas rnams/ /rin chen gser gyis thugs dam bskang / /sgra dbyangs rol mos thugs dam bskang / /rten rdzas tshang mas thugs dam bskang / /lha g.yag dkar pos thugs dam bskang / /dmar rtsa lug gis thugs dam bskang / /rngon cha tshang mas thugs dam bskang / /rgyan gyi gtore mas thugs dam bskang / /bdud rtsi sman gyis thugs dam bskang / /dzag da phud kyi thugs dam bskang / /gdung ba'i dbyangs kyis thugs dam bskang / khyed kyi thugs dam bdag gis bskang / /bdag gis bcol ba'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /de ltar mchod cing bskang ba yis/ /bdag sogs dgon gnas rgyu sbyor gyi/ /mgon skyabs dpung gnyen khyed kyis mdzod/ /bcol ba'i 'phrin las bsgrub pa dang / /bsgrubs shing bstan pa bsrung sna du gsal/ /sto/ lha rgyal lo/ /g.yag lug phul ba'i yon tan gyis/ /nor la god kha med pa dang / /gling stod rta ra'i bdag po mdzod/ /gling smad lug ra'i bdag po mdzod/ /g.yag dang mdzo yi bdag po mdzod/ /nor la 'phel ba khyed kyis mthong / /ci bsams 'grub pa'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /sto/ lha rgyal lo/ /rten 'dogs ni/ yol mo ba gsum pas mdzad/ hūṃ/ cang shes rta mchog gser sgo dngul srab can/ /sna tshogs dar zab bzang pos rab mdzes pa/ /g.yang ldan gsang lug gangs ri lta bur 'tsher/ /bag phebs dal khur rgyu dang 'gro ba'i stabs/ /zla shel zhun (23na sgos byugs ltar rab dkar ba'i/ /mkha' lding 'dab chags snyan pa'i skad gsang can/ /sprin dkar phung po lta bu'i lha g.yag cha/ /rdo rje'i ra dang rnga yab dkar po can/ /kun kyang dar zab dril bu g.yer kha dang / khu tig bzang po'i 'phreng bas rab mdzes pa/ /phyi rten mdzes pa'i 'gro tsho gos 'di dag gis/ /lha chen 'khor bcas thugs dam skong gyur cig /g.yas ru nga rgyal bkra bzang rtser/ /zhes sogs bya/ mang 'gasol ni/ yol ma ba gsum pas mdzad/ lha dbang klu bdag laṅka'i rgyal ba sogs/ /srid gsum dbang phyug kun gyis —565

rgyal 0lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (25)mdun bdar nas/ /mchod sprin rgya mtshos sri zhur bcas mchode pa'i/ /lha chen rdo rje 'bar ba rtsal la bstod/ /rnam par rgyal ba'i khang brtsegs las rgyal ba'i/ /rin chen shel gyi sku mkhar zla ba'i phyir/ /ba gam nor bu'i 'od tshogs rab rgyas pas/ /zhing khams rgya mtsho'i go skabs yang dag grags/ /rtsa ba yid bzhin 'byung gnas yid bzhin gyis/ /bar med rab rdzogs rked skabs mtshon lngas mdzes/ /dzam+bha nā da'i rgya phubs ches 'bar ba'i/ /rtse mo rin chen char 'bebs chu 'dzin dkrigs/ /dus gsum rgyal ba'i cho 'phrul dag las bzhin/ /rgya che bkod pa'i khyad par rgya che ba'i/ /pho brang srid rtse'i gung na mngon mtho'i rtse/ /yid bzhin rgyal mtshan gsar pas mnga' gsol lo/ /dpag yas zhing gi rdul snyed rab stims zhing / /skad cig myul ba'i 'gros ldan lha rta dkar/ khyu skar bdag po'i dregs 'jomasargyan ldan pa/ /lha chen chibs kyi dam par mnga' (23ba)gsol lo/ /gtsa lin+da'i ber chen sum brtsegasapas/ /mdzes 'dzu pa rlabs kyi gzugs brnyan bgo 'os pa/ /'jam mnyen reg bya'i khyad par med byung ba'i/ /rab mdzes lha yi na bza' mnga' gsol lo/ /nor bu'i mchil lha ma gser gyi ska rags 'bar/ /ga bur do shal rin chen se mo do/ /mu rtag 'bras chags nor bu'i snyan cha gsol/ /mdzes byed rgyan gyi dam pas mnga' gsol lo/ /gser pad g.yu yi yal 'dab mdzes pa'i khongs/ /rnam mang 'od kyi ge sar rab rgyas pa/ /spel legs 'phreng ba bstar pa'i cod pan 'di/ /skra mtshams mdzes pa'i rgyan du mnga' gsol lo/ /brgya byin thogs pa'i nor bu las lhag nor/ /bkra shis dam pa kun gyisabakra shis par/ /rgyal bas rab bsngags g.yas su 'khyil ba'i dung / /thor tshugs mdzes pa'i rgyan du mnga' gsol lo/ /rtse mor zur phud lnga bcings ral pa'i khyon/ /bung ba stang zil mig sman ltar snum pa'i/ /rtsa chings bkra shis ri mos rnam bkra ba'i/ /dar dkar dri med lwa bas mnga' gsol lo/ /myur mgyogs rdzu phrul shugs ldan bā la har/ /skul byed phyag cha'i khyad par mi 'tshal yang / /ma bdun lasal bskul ba'i 'phrul chen po/ /sba lcag rdo rjes mtshani pas mnga' gsol lo/ /cha shas rab rdzogs zla ba'i spun zla zhes/ /bdud rtsis bran pa'i thigs ma dngos grub ltar/ /zad mi shes 'bab nor bu'i —566

lha mchog 'bar ba rtsal gyi 'phrin las brgya phrag nyid ngos 'dzin pa'i snang gsal/ nang ma (ka)shel 'phreng 'di/ /thugs dam dbyings su lo phyir mnga' gsol lo/ /dar zab spyan gzigs mang pos sa bla'i khongs/ /brgya byin gzhu yi dra bas mdzes byas shing / /snyan brjid dpa' ba'i (24na)nyams ldan 'bod pa'i dbyangs/ /sna tsho gos rol mor bcas pas mnga' gsol lo/ /gtsang ma'i zhal zas la sogs 'dod yon lnga/ /lha klu mi dang gnod sbyin thams cad kyi/ /dkon nor ma tshang med spungs nor 'dzin ma'i/ /phang ba rab rdzogs 'dod dgus mnga' gsol lo/ /dkon mchog skyabs kyi dam par skyabs song mgron/ /dkar phyogs lha dang gdengs can 'byung po'i tshogs/ /bstan la rab dga' mthu rtsal med byung ba/ /kun gyi rje bor deng bdag gzengs bstod do/ khyad par dpal gyi sprul pa pad+ma'i lung / /ji bzhin mnos pa'i bka' las mi 'da' bar/ /gter bdag gnas bdag dkor bdag thamasacad kyi/ /tsho gos bdag tshogs kyi rje bor gzengs bstod do/ /rnal 'byor bdag gi mgon skyabs 'ches pa'i lha/ /bsten gsol mchod bsgrub lha srung gnyan rnams dang / khri srong lha brgyud sku lha gnyan rnamasakyi/ /rje btsun lha yi lha mchog gzengs bstod do/ /rgyal dbang pad+ma'i ring lugs 'dzin rnams kyi/ /dbu 'phang ri rgyal rtse mor gzengs bstod de/ /sngags 'chang bdag gis mnga' gsol gzengs bstod na/ /lha yi lha mchog lha zhal mtho bar mdzod/ /ces pa bya/ nang du log nas/ yig brgya brjod/ma 'byor ba dang nyams pa dang / /sogs/ lhag pa dang ni chad pa dang / sogs/ ser sna'i dbang gyur ma 'byor zhing / /mchod pa ༅ zhing bsham nyes pa/ /sbyor ba gtsang sbras ma thon pa/ /de yang bzod par mdzad du gsol/ /rten yod na/ 'dir ni gzugs(24bskong lhan cig tu/ /zhes pa nas/ su bra tiṣ+ṭha badz+re swāhās brtan bzhugs bya/ rten med pa'i skabs yin na/ khyed kyis sems can sogs/ /badz+ramuḥs ye shes pa gshegs/ /dam tshig pa rang nyid la thim par bsam/ shis brjod ni/ hūṃ/ gtso bris/gar dbang 'od mtha' yas pa chos kyi sku/ /gdug pa 'dul mdzad rta mgrin longs spyod rdzogs /mtsho las skyes pa'i rdo rje sprul pa'i sku/ /dbyer med ye shes sum ldan bkra shis shog /sa brgyad brnyesakyang bstan dang 'gro ba'i don/ /dregs pa'i sdod pon tshul 'dzin gnyan gyi rigs/ /dri za'i rgyal po rdo —567

rgyal ba lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()rje 'bar ba rtsal//rnam 'gyur cir yang ston pa'i bkra shis shog/zhi rgyas dbang drag las kun sgrub mdzad pa'i//gsang yum mched blon sprul pa yang sprul dang //sdo brgyad dregs pa'i dmag gi dpung tsho gos sogs//grangs med 'khor tsho gos rgya mtsho'i bkra shis shog/bdud dang rgyal 'gong dam sri 'byung po'i rigs//dngos dang yid la brlams pa'i skye wa'i mtshon//nag po'i rtsa lag ba dan rab bsnyil te//dkar phyogs rgyal ma' bsgred pa'i bkra shis shog/bod skyong lha rigs dngos dang dngos 'dra ba//chen nyam bsod nams ldan pa ya rabs kyi//sku lha gnyan po mdzad nas gangs ljongs 'dir//bde skyid dga' ston dpal 'bar bkra shis shog/gzhan yang bkra shis kyi tshigs bcad ci rigs pa brjod cing me tog sil ma phyogs kun tu dgram par bya'o//pad 'byung rig sngags 'chang ba'i brtul zhugs kyis//sa btul bsam yas gtsug lag 'byongs min gong //g.yung drung bon gyis bsten 25na tha'i lha chen po//lugs de'i gyer sgom gsol mchod ci yang dar//skyon sangs rgyas gnyisapas zangs mdzod kyi//srung mar bka' bsgos sgrub yig bdud rtsi'i bcud/khog ser ma bu'i za ma tog 'khyil bas//tshim pa'i rnying rgan nyin mo'i skar ma tsam//brgyud pa'i gsung sgros phyag len mthong thosabral//gab dkrugs 'thor bsdebs mi shes phyogs re'i gzhung //klog cing rol mo brdung ba lhur len pa//bon dkar lha gsol mkhan po'i cho ga bzhin//de phyir shog ser dri ngad chal chil du//g.yo ba'i dgongs don rigs sgon zhal gyi lung //bklags pas don kun 'grub pa gaṅgā'i rgyun/kho bo'i rnam dpyod ma dros mtsho las babs//'bad pas nyer bsgrubs rlung gi shing rta yis//drangs pa'i bde da brgya phrag nyi ma'i dngos//legs byas dgung la 'char nub rab spangs nas//rtag tu snang ba'i dga' ston dar bar shog/de'ang lha chen 'di nyid kyi mchod bskang gi rim pa chos rgyal mthi'i mtshan can yan chad du gsung rgyun ma gtogs khrigs chags kyi yig rigs mi snang zhing zhang sna nam pa'i sprul pa'i sku mchog rigs 'dzin ngag gi dbang bo chos rgyal bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan gyis gter gzhung dang grangs gter ston gsum pa'i gzhung 'khrugs bsdebs su ༷dzad pa khungs thub tu 'dug kyang phyag len rnams

lha mchog 'bar ba rtsal gyi 'phrin las brgya phrag nyid ngos 'dzin pa'i snang gsal/ nang ma (ka)dkyus su bkod pa sogs cung zad rtogs dka' ba nas rang nyid srung ma chen po 'dir mos pa'i dang bas yid drangs te mchod sprin tshangs pa lha'i shel gyi rnga bo che'i go rim phal cher gtso bor bzung gzhan ma gter gzhud / /bla ma bor ma dag gis mdzad (25ba)pa/ gsar bris rnams so sor khungs smos shing / gcig po nyid las du ma'i gar yin na'ang gangs can 'dir 'brel chags kyi rnam 'gyur gtso bor bzung / mdor na cung zad mi gsal zhing ma tshang ba rnams tshang na snyam pa'i lhag bsam gyis kun nas blangs te/ lha mchog rdo rje 'bar ba rtsal gyi 'phrin las brgya phra nyid ngos 'dzin pa'i snang gsal 'di ni za hor gyi sngags btsun zil gnon bzhad pa rtsal gyis kun dga' zhes pa shing stag hor zla bdun pa'i dkar cha'i dga' ba dang po rgyal phur gyi thog la dbu btsugs zla ba de ga'i tshes lnga zla ba gro bzhin 'dzom pa'i 'phrod dge bar gnam bskos kyi pho brang chen po dmar po rir grub par sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni rigs 'dzin gyi btsun pa 'jam dbyangs grags pas bgyis pa dpal ldan lha chen tshangs pas nyin mtshan dus drug tu bsrung zhing skyob pa'i rgyur gyur cig /sarba maṅga lo/ /—569

rgyal ba lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (25)lha chen rdo rje 'bar ba rtsal gyi sgog gtad kyi rjes gnang mu thi la'i 'phreng ba bzhugs so/ /yid bzhin dbang gi rgyal po ltar/ /dngos grub ma lus stsole mdzad pa/ /lha mchog dri za'i rgyal po yi/ /srog gtad rjes gnang rim pa 'di/ /de yang stegs bur ras dkar po dri ma med pa sogasagayogs pa'i steng du ma sgyu'i khar sgrub gtor sku rten tsakli/ gtor gdugs dkar po can bsham/chu gsum/ chu gcig sngon du 'gro ba'i nyer spyod sbreng tshar/ sman phud/ 'bul gtor zur gsum lug mgos brgyan pa/ gser skyems/ bgegs gtor/ rol mo/ yungs gar/ a ra skya/ spos dkar sogs nye bar mkho ba'i rdzas dang yo byad rnams mngon par 'du byas/ gnas yo byin rlabs nas bzung rta mgrin gyi bstod pa'i bar dkyus bzhin la bzlas pa mang nyung long skabs dang bstun nas bya/chos sman ma btab pa'i nang mchod gsar pa yin na sman gtor gzhung bzhin brlab/ khyuḥmahā kro dhas bsangs/ /su bhā was mdun bskyed kyi gtor ma sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las man shel gyi khang bzang zhes pa nas rgyab kyi ru 'dren lcags kyi mi sngon 'jigs pa ste so sor brgya phrag dang bcas pas bskor ba'i bar dang de dag gi g.yas phyogs su (2na)ngo bo ye shes zhes pa nas mjug ma brdabs pas me rlung 'tshub pa'i bar dkyus bzhin la/ de dag gi phyi rol tu lha klu gnod sbyin 'khor tshogs bye ba 'bum sdes bskor ba'i gtso 'khor thams cad kyi spyi bor oṃ zhes pa nas bzung ste gtor bsngos kyi bar bya/'dzab mang du bzlas te nus ldan du byed/ bstod pa lha yi lha mchog mas bstod/ de nas slob ma rnams kyi lus gangs chu gtsang mas khrus nas 'don/ spos dang gu gul dkar pos bdug /phyag dang yon dbul/ bgegs gtor btang / thun mong ba'i sngon 'gro spyi dang bye brag snga 'gyur theg pa'i chos kyi che ba sogs phan yon bshad/ khyad par du slob dpon chen po'i bka'i srung ma rnams kyi nang nas gtso —570

lha chen rdo rje 'bar ba rtsal gyi srog gtad kyi rjes gnang mu thi la'i 'phreng ba/ nang ma (ka)bor gyur pa lha chen rdo rje 'bar ba rtsal 'di nyid ngo bo sa brgyad non pa byang chub sems dpa' nam mkha'i snying po yin pa la rgyal bsen sogs lha srin ma rungs pa rnams kyi gnyen por dam can shel ging dkar po/ lhag gnam the dkar po/ gnam lha byang chub sems dpa'/ tshangs pa'i rgyal po dung gi thor tshugs can/ dri za zur phud lnga pa/ khyab 'jug gnam mtsho'i rgyal po ste sku gcig la mtshan drug tu grags pa (2bsko chen rdo rje 'bar ba rtsal 'di nyid gnas skabs 'jig rten dregs pa'i tshul bzung ba'i rgyu mtshan/ thang yig las/ de nas sku gnyan thang lhas nyams ga phyir/ /mgo bo gru gu'i yul du slebs pa la/ /mjug ma khams kyi sag chu g.yer thang brkyang / /sbrul dkar zhig gis lam 'phrang bcad pa la/ /slob dpon sprul gyi rked par phyag 'khar btsugs/ /klu yi rgyal po na le thod dkar khyod/ /dri za'i rgyal po zur phud lnga pa zhes/ khyod rang phar song tshogs 'khor gshoms dang gsungs/ /thang lhasagangs la bros pas gangs zhu nas/ /rtse ma nag zang g.ya' sngon nyil gyis byung / /ma bzod zhal zasasna tsho gos tshogs 'khor drangs/ /byis pa g.yu yi zur phud can du gyur/ /dar dkar ral gu zhig gyon phyag skor byas/ /srog snying phul nas dam btags gter rgya gtad/ /gsang mtshan rdo rje mchog rab rtsal du gsol/ /zhes pa ltar slob dpon chen po la mtho 'tshams pa'i tshe bka' rtags phyag rgya chen pos zil gyis mnan te dam la btags nas srung mar bskos/ slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis byang lam bar ba nas bsam yas has po ri'i mdun du byon pa'i dus su gnyan chen thang lha de g.yag dkar po rwa nam mkha'i mthongs na yer re ba/ rmig bzhis sa mdud non pa zhig byas nas slob dpon gyi drung na tshur byung / chos skyong ba'i rgyal po khri srong lde'u btsan mthong ba dang g.yag dkar por brdzusapa'i rdzu phrul bshig nas skyes bu bzhin bzang dkar po dung gi mdog can g.yu'i zur phud lnga yis brgyan pa zhig tu byas te rgyal po la zhe sa dang phyag phul lo/ /de'i tshe slob dpon gyis 'di skad ces gsungs so/ /gnyan chen po thang lha khyod lha srin (3na)yal gam can zhig 'dug ste rgyal po khri srong lde'u btsan la 'go zhing grogs byed pa ci'i phyir yin gsung ngo / /thang lhas zhus pa/ bdag gnyis la —57/—

rgyal ba lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (25)'brel ba bzhi mchis so/ /bdag dbus gtsang ru bci'i yul lha lags pas rgyal po khri srong lde'u btsan bod kyi rgyal po lags te che mnyam dpung gis 'brel lo/ /bdag dam tshig can gyi srung ma lags pas rgyal po dam tshig gtsang ste dam tshig gis 'brel lo/ /bdag skye bo ngo tsha can gyi pho lha lags pas rgyal po gsang khrims che bas las dang spyod pas 'brel lo/ /bdag sde pa bsod nams can gyi grogs la dga' bas che mnyam bsod nams kyis 'brel ba lags so/ /zhes zhus so/ /yang zhus pa/ kye slob dpon chen po lags/ da nang gung gi snga dro bdag khro zhing gtum pa'i gzugs su byas te 'ong ba ni/ bdag dam tshig nyams pa'i srog bdud/ dam tshig nyams pa'i gshed ma/ grib gnon ma rabs kyi gnya' gnon/ spyo 'dre rgyal 'gong gi gnyen po lags pas/ de rnams mthong ba dang rang bzhin gyis bdag la zhe sdang skyes te gtum zhing khro ba lags so/ /zhes zhus so/ /yang slob dpon gyis gsungs pa/ 'o na gnyan chen thang lha khyod rgyal po khri srong lde'u btsan la rang bzhin gyi 'go bar 'dug pas/ rgyal po nyid nas 'od gsal lha'i gdung brgyud tha ma dgung du ma gshegs kyi bar du sku lha gyis shig /rgyal pos mchod cig /ces lha brag gter byon gyi lo rgyus las byung ba ltar chos skyong rgyal po'i sku lha khyad par can 'phral byin rlabs myur zhing phugs bkra shis pa'i lha chen 'di nyid/ nub zangs mdzod kyi srung mar bka' bsgos/ chos skor rnams zang zang lha brag (3bsku gter du sbas pa snying thig gnad kyi man ngag don bdun las/ byang phyogs tho yor nag pa'i sa phyogs su/ /ri bo bkra bzang zhes pa'i shar 'dabs su/ /chu khams glang lo sme ba'i mtshan rtags can/ /pad+ma nga yis byin rgyas brlabs pa'i rtags/ /spyi bor rgod kyi ldem phru yang yang 'byung / /zhes lung gis zin pa'i gter chen chos kyi rgyal po rgod kyi ldem phru can gyis spyan drangs pa'i rjes gnang dang man ngag gi skor gnyis las/ srog dbang 'di nyid gter ston nas rtsa ba'i bla ma zur thams cad mkhyen pa'i bar du chad med du bzhugs pa'i srog gtad zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba zhu/ zhes maṇ+ḍal 'bul du gzhug /de nasargyud dag par bya ba'i slad du mdun gyi nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i rtsa ba gsum gyi lha tshogs rnams kyi —572

lha chen rdo rje 'bar ba rtsal gyi srog gtad kyi rjes gnang mu thi la'i 'phreng ba/ nang ma (ka)spyan sngar skyabs sems sdom pa bzung ba'i ched du thugs rje'i dbang gis 'gro don mdzad/ ces pa nas/ rang byung mtha' bral stong gsal bsgom/ zhes pa'i bar lan gsum gyi rjes zlos byed du gzhug /sku'i rjes gnang gi don du slob dpon dpal rta mgrin du gsal ba'i spyan sngar rjes zlos 'di bzhin du mdzod ces brda sprad/ dbang chen rgyal po he ru ka /rnam 'phrul dpa' bo pad+ma 'byung / /bdag la rdo rje 'bar ba rtsal/ /sku yi byin rlabs gzi byin phob/ /ces lan gsum gyis gsol ba gdab/ slob dpon dbang chen rgyal por gsal ba'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pa mdun du sgrub gtor lha chen 'bar ba rtsal du gsal ba'i sku la phog /de'i rkyen gyis lha chen gyi sku las 'od zer dkar po dpag tu med pa zla ba shar ba lta bu bsam gyis mi khyab pa byung ba sbyo/ba ma'i lus la thim pas lus kyi sdig sgrib nad (4na)gdon bar gcod thams cad sbyangs pa las 'od kyi phung por dkar lam gyis song / de'i ngang nas slob ma skad cig gis pad+ma nyi zla'i gdan gyi steng du slob ma'i rnam par shes pa a dkar po yongs su gyur pa las gtso bo'i mngon rtogs dkyus su yod pa brjod de bsgom du bcug pa'i spyi bor gtor ma bzhag ste/ hūṃ/ rta mgrin rgyal po dbang gi lha/ /rnam sprul dpa' bo pad+ma 'byung / /skal ldan slob ma'i sgo gsum la/ /dam can rdo rje 'bar ba rtsal/ /sku yi byin rlabs gzi byin phob/ /shrī tshobadz+rathang ka ra mun nying khu sha li dzaḥ/ baṃ lho zhes brjod/ sku'i byin rlabs 'od zer dkar po'i rnam pa spyi bo nas sib kyis thim pas lha chen gyi sku dang slob ma'i lus ngo bo dbyer med du byas/ sku'i byin rlabs dang dngos grub thob par bsam/ mchod pa dngos su bsham pa'am med na kha gsos te chu dang nyer spyod rol mo rnams spro na gdangs dang bcas nas tshigs bcad dam mi spro na sngags tsam gyis slob mas gtor ma lhar gsal ba la mchod pa'i tshul bya/ gsung gi rjes gnang gi don du gsol 'debasatitshig rkang gsum po gong ltar la gsung gi byin rlabs gzi byin phob/ ces lan gsum gyis gsol ba gdab/ slob dpon rta mgrin du gsal ba'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ lha chen gyi mgrin par phog pa'i rkyen gyis lha chen gyi gsung gi byin rlabs dang nus pa thams cad 'od zer dmar po'i rnam —573

rgyal ba lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (25)par thon te slob ma'i mgrin pa dang lce la thim pas ngag gi sdig sgrib nad gdon bar gcod thams cad sbyangs pas lus 'od kyi phung por dmar lam gyis song bar bsams la gtor ma mgrin par bzhag ste/ bskur tshig gong bzhin la gsung gi byin (4ba)rlabs gzi byin phob/ hrī mi dz+ra thang ka ra sogs brjod/ de nas lha chen gyi thugs kur zla gdan la a yig gi mthar sngags 'phreng gis bskor ba las sngags phreng gnyis pa chig 'kho5 nas thon slob ma'i zhal du zhugs/ thugs ga'i a yig gi mthar 'khod par bsams la dpon slob gnyis gas phreng ba la 'jus te ā+oṃ badz+ra thang ka ra mun nying khu sha li swāhā/ zhes lan gsum gyi rjes zlos byed du gzhug /phreng ba mgrin par bzhag ste dzaḥ& baṃ hoḥs byin gyis rlabs/ lha chen gyi gsung dang slob ma'i ngag ngo bo dbyer med du byas/ gsung gi byin rlabs dang dngos grub thob par bsam/ gong bzhin mchod/ thugs kyi rjes gnang gi don du tshig rkang tha ma thugs kyi byin rlabs gzi byin phob/ ces lan gsum gyis gsol ba gdab/ slob dpon rta mgrin du gsal ba'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ lha chen gyi thugs skar phog pa'i rkyen gyis thugs brtse ba chen pos slob ma rjes su bzung ba'i byin rlabs dang nus mthu thams cad 'od zer sngon po'i rnam par thon te slob ma'i snying gar thim pas yid kyi sdig sgrib nad gdon bar gcod thams cad sbyangs pas lus 'od sngon po'i phung por mer gyis song bar bsams la gtor ma snying gar bzhag ste/ bskur tshig bsgyur kha thugs kyi byin rlabs gzi byin phob/ hrīḥbadz+ra sogs brjod/ thugs kyi byin rlabs 'od zer sngon po'i rnam pa snying gar sib kyis thim pas lha chen gyi thugs dang slob ma'i yid ngo bo dbyer med du byas/ thugs kyi byin rlabs dang dngos grub thob par bsam/ sngar bzhin mchod/ yon tan dang 'phrin las kyi rjes gnang gi don du dngos gzhi gong ltar la/ yon (ldan〉tha byin rlabs gzi byin phob/ 'phrin las byan rlabs gzi byin phob/ ces ga gsum gyis gsol ba gdab/ slob dpon rta mgrin du gsal ba'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ lha chen gyi thugs gar phog pa'i rkyen gyis lha chen 'khor dang bcas pa'i sku las nor bu dbang gi rgyal po sogs lha mi'i rin po che'i char chen po —574

lha chen rdo rje 'bar ba rtsal gyi sreg gtad kyi rjes gnang mu thi la'i 'phreng ba/ nang ma (ka)dang 'od zer kha dog sna lnga 'phros pa lus la thim pas slob ma lhar gsal ba'i lus kyi nang ltem gyis gang / sgo gsum gyi sdig sgrib nad gdon bar gcod thams cad sbyangs bas lus kha dog lnga ldan du song bar bsams la gtor ma lte ba'i thad du bzhag ste/ bskur tshig dngos gzhi 'dra ba la/ yon tan byin rlabs gzi byin phob/ 'phrin las byin rlabs gzi byin phob/ khyiḥbadz+ra sogs brjod/ yon tan gyi byin rlabs 'od zer ser po dang 'phrin las kyi 'od zer ljang gu lte gsang du sib kyis thim pas yon tan 'phrin las kyi dngos grub ma lus pa thob par bsam/ sngar ltar mchod/ dam bsre ba ni/dam chu a skṛ ta slob mar sbyin zhing gtor mar 'thor/ gtor ma sngar bzhin spyi bor bzhag ste/ dpal phyag na rdo rje/ rgyal mchog pad+ma thod 'phreng / paṇa chen dri med bshes gnyen/ lo chen be+e ro tsa na/ chosargyal khri srong lde'u btsan/ lha sras mu khri btsan po/ mkha' 'gro ye shes 'tsho rgyal/ gter ston rigs 'dzin rgod ldem/ sras mchog rnam rgyal mgon po/ sngags 'chang rdo rje dpal/ sngags 'chang rdo rje mgon po/ mtshan ldan byams pa bshes gnyen/ mtshan ldan ngag dbang grags pa/ drin can sangs rgyas dpal bzang / ldongs kyi sngags 'chang chos rgyal bsod nams/ (5bti sras chos skyong bsod namasabakra shis/ thams cad mkhyen pa mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug /ga 'phags ma chag byams pa skal bzang / rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan/ khyab bdag mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan/ rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje 'chang chos dbyings rang grol sogs rtsa brgyud kyi dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' dang dam tshig gnyen po dran par mdzod la lha chen rdo rje 'bar ba rtsal 'khor dang bcas pa khyed rnams kyis rdo rje slob ma 'di'i nyin gsum gyi bya ra mdzod/ mtshan gsum gyi mel tshe mdzod la bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi'i nad/ stong phrag brgyad cu'i bgegs/ khyad par steng 'og bar gsum gdon bgegs rgyal bsen dam sri 'byung po ban bon sngags pa'i mthu byad dug mtshon g.yul gshoms sogs gzugs can sdang ba'i dgra/ gzugs med gnod pa'i bgegs rnams kyis btang ba'i bar gcod mi mthun phyogs thams cad las bsrung zhing skyob pa'i 'phrin las mdzod/ tshe dang bsod nams dpal 'byor mnga' thang thos—575

rgyal ba lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (25)bsam sgom gsum sogs chos dang srid kyi legs tshogs thams cad 'phel zhid rgyas par mdzad du gsol/ zhes bka' bsgo rgyas par brjod rjes sngags mthar dzaḥlha baṃ hoḥs lha tshogs thams cad 'od du zhu nas sib kyis thim par bsam/ de nas dam tshig bsdus te khas blang ba ni/ rdo rje 'dzin pa'i bka' bzhin du/ bdag ni rtse gcig gus gdung bas/ /ma lus bdag gis kha bsgrub lag bas na/ /brtse bas rjes bzung byin gyis rlomes/ /zhes ni gsum gyi rjes zlos bya/ gtang rag gi maṇ+ḍal phul/ bkushis rgyas par byed/ slar yang mchod gtor kha gso/ (6na7gli sogs rten lhar bskyed pa rnams la 'bul nyid bstod/ yig brgya brjod cing lhag chad kha bkang / nongs pa bzod par gsol/ brtan bzhugs dang shis brjod bya'o/ /e ma rigs 'dzin brgyud pa yi/ /'brul med phyag bzhes mu thi la/ /rnam dpyod srad bur brgyusapa yis/ /lha mchog rtag tu grogs mdzad shog /ces lha chen rdo rje 'bar ba rtsal gyi srog gtad kyi rjes gnang mu thi la'i 'phreng ba 'di ni dge slong 'jam dbyangs grags pas bskul bas mtshams sbyar rig sngags 'chang ba mang por phan 'dod kyis yid drangs nas gter gzhung du mi gsal ba rnams bla ma dam pa'i phyag len gyis brgyan te za hor gyi ban+de rdo rje thogs med rtsal gyis gro zhun zla ba'i dkar cha'i rgyal ba gsum pa la pho brang po ta lar sbyar ba'i yi ge pa'ang bskul ba po nyid do/ /sarba maṅga lo//rdo rje 'bar ba rtsal gyi bsnyen sgrub bkang mdos kyi lag len dran pa'i gsal 'debs bzhugs/snying nye bkra shis dam ldan pa/ /lha chen rdo rje 'bar ba rtsal/ /bsnyen sgrub bskang mdos la mkho ba'i/ /lag len reg zig cung zad 'dri/ /de yang gangs ri mthon po'i mdun nam ri mthon po gangs mtho ba'i sa rab/ de min gnas khang gtsang zhing gya nom pa mtshan nyid dang ldan par byi dor legs par bya/—576

rdo rje 'bar ba rtsal gyi bsnyen sgrub bkang mdos las ler dran pa'i gsol 'debs/ nang ma (ka)spos dkar dang ljon shing sna tshogs kyi bsangs kyis bdug /sa rgyan gnam rgyan yol ba sogs bkod pas mdzes par byas pa'i nang du dkon mchog spyi dang bye brag bla ma zhi drag rta mgrin phyag rdor phur ba sogs kyi rten dgram/ mdun du cog tse mtho bar gtor ma zangs mdog dpal ri ma'am las bzhi lhun grub gang rung / sman raka /rtsa gsum/ bka' srung brgyad mchod/ gzhi bgegs kyi gtor ma/ phyi nang gi nyer spyod rnams bshams/ de'i mdun lta bur gong gnon las dma' bar stegs bu'am cog tse gang rung gi steng du rab dri ma med pa'i g.yang shun nam ma 'byor na ras dkar po bting bar dri bzang gis chag chag gdab/ de'i steng du nas dkar la gro 'bras rin chen sna lnga cung zad bsres pa'i mchod gzhi rtse sor gang tsam khod snyoms par dgram/ mthar gong gsal gyi 'bru gsum po gang rung gis lcags (2na)ri'i tshul du zlum por bskor ba'i phyogs mtshams brgyad du tshom bu'i dbyibs can mtho bar bya/ stan dkar gyi mtha' non tsam du smyug rgod rtse rgyas la dar tshon sna lnga/ za 'og sna lnga'i 'phan chung / rgyal mtshan gos le brgan la gser dngul g.yu mu tig mu men byu ru sbur len sogs rin chen sna tshogs spel legs su bkod pa'i mdun ngos gdugs chung phub pa'i 'og tu rin po che'am sman 'dam gyi 'bur ram dar ras la tsag li rab gnas dang ldan pa sku'i rten/ dar dkar dri med la gser dngul bsres pa'i snying po mtshal gyis bris pa dang rdo rjes mtshan pa'i sba lcag gsung rten/ shel 'phreng dang 'ja' shel thugs rten/ maṇ+ḍal gyi dbus su ma zhi'i khar gser dngul zangs gzhong sogs kyi snod gtsang mar gtor ma gru bzhi shel mkhar rgya phubs nor bu 'bar bas spras pa/ rtsa bar pad+ma 'dab brgyad kyis bskor ba rat+na sum tshom gyis mdzes pa/ dpangs rab khru gang / 'bring rkang gang /tha ma'ang mtho gang la skabs su 'os pa'i rgyan spros sna tshogs kyis spras pa gtor gdugs dkar po phub pa/ de'i g.yas g.yon rgyab gsum du shel lam dngul la sogs pa'i rin po che'i snod du g.ya' chu/ gangs chu/ lu ma chu mig rgyun 'bab lta bu'i skye (2ba〉spya rnams ni yon tan gyi rten/ mdun du dgyes skong mchod gtor zur gsum sor bcu gnyis pa mtheb skyus bskor ba/ logs bstan par gsang lug —577—

rgyal ba lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (25)dkar po'i mgos brgyan pa rtsi dkar/ de'i g.yon du g.yu sgron ma'i gtor ma dkar zlum/ shar dang shar lhor zlum gtor dkar po/ lho dang byang shar du ser po gru bzhi/ nub tu zlum gtor dmar po/ byang dang lho nub tu gru gsum nag po/ nub byang du zla gam dmar po'i gtor ma so so'i skabs thob dang mtshungs pa'i rgyan ldan rnams 'phrin las kyi rten/ de'i phyogs bzhi mtshams bzhir zlum gtor sor brgyad pa 'khor gnyis re rgyan ldan/ de'i phyi rol du snod 'byor na bskor cing ma 'byor na dngul gzhong lta bur gtor chung sum brgya brgyad cu lhag bcas bon rgyan dmar thig btab pa/ snod cig tu bskang gtor kha gso la dmigs pa'i mtheb skyu bzhi brgya lhag bcas/ zur du thun gtor zur gsum lug mgos brgyan pa/ gtor ma rnams kyi rgyu 'bru dkar mo gsum gyi rjen btags la dkar gsum/dngar gsum/ bzang drug /tsan+dan/ ga pur sogs klu sman gyi rigs/ bdud rtsis skṛ ta rnams bsre/mdun du shel phor du chang bzang po la 'o ma/ ci tas bzang po'i phye ma/ gser gtso bor gyur ba'i rin chen lnga brdar ba bsres pa'i dza gad/ zhi ba'i mchod pa g.ya' gangs lu gsum gyi mchod yon la bzang sman dang 'o ma sogs kyis kha bsgyur ba/ dug dang dri nga ba med pa'i thang skyes dang chu skyes kyi me tog dkar po'i rigs dang dgun bcos ma'am 'bru dkar gyi me tog /dug gla rtsi gu gul nag po dri nga ba min pa'i tsan+dan spos dkar shug pa la gzhi byas/ bzang sman sna tshogs sbyar ba'i gdug spos/ me shel sogs nor bu 'od (3na)'phro dang mar dkar/ til mar bsres pa'i 'bru mar gyi mar me/ ga pur sogs bzang sman sbyar ba'i dri chab/ 'bru dkar mo gsum la dkar gsum dngar gsum sbyar ba dang ga 'a na yang 'bras bu can sogs bza' ba dang bca' ba'i rigs kyi lha nga lhas/ rgyas pa dang dbang 'ganyas la mdog so sor bsgyur ba min pa dbyibs gong dang mtshungs/ lha thams cad la 'jam po gsum po'i mchod pa gtso bor shis shing drag po'i mchod pa ni tshogs tha ma'i tshe/ khrag gi arnya dang dbang po'i me tog sogs dgra bgegs bsgral ba las byung ba'i nyer spyod don gyis tshang ba dmi rdo rje 'bar rtsal la stob pas go bcad pa'o/ /—578—

rdo rje 'bar ba rtsal gyi bsnyen sgrub bkang mdos las len dran pa'i gsol 'debs/ nang ma (ka)sbug sil/ rnga chen/ dung chen/ rgya gling / dung dkar sogs rol mo sna tshogs/ mar gyi rta/mdzo/ khra/ lug /spyang ki rnams re/ zan gyi g.yag gcig /sman khrog sna tshogs/ rin po che du ma'i spyan gzigs/ tsho gis chas/ gdab las kyi chas sba lcag /lcags kyu/ zhags pa/ mda' gzhu/ mdung /ral gri /'khor lo/ g.yas g.yon gyis ci bder zhal brnyan/ tse ber/ mdun du gser ga zhal dkar dmar sogs rin po che'i rgyan/ gzhan yang gos dar/ gser dngul/ ja ras sogs spyan gzigs mkho dgu rnams bsham/ dkar mo lag g.yas/ lug sha mgo 'byar/ stag lpags sder bzhi tshang ba/ dar tshon sna lnga/ mda' bo cher btags pa/ ru dar/ gser skyems kyi chang dang phud phor/ dar sna tshogs kyi lda ldi/ go khrab/ gri dong / stag ral gzig shubs/ phye mar/ bsangs shing / yang thog tu stegs kyi (3bakhir dgyes skong mchod gtor zur gsum khru gang pa/ mtheb skyu brgya rtsas bskor ba/lug mgo sogs rgyan ldan/ mdun du chu gsum/ chu dang nyer spyod tshar gcig /sman phud/ gser skyems/'thor nas/ 'phyar dar/ phye mar/ dngos su rta/ zhol g.yag /khra/ lug dkar rnams gsum re/ bum chus khrus bya/ rna mgos bzang po/ rnga phod/ dril chung / g.yer ga /sog dar sogs kyis brgyan pa/ rta la gser dngul gyi sga srab kyis spras pa rnams bsham/ gyer gyi skabs bskang gso tshar lnga re'i thog gtor ma bsngo zhing kha bsos nas brlab/ gtor chung rnams mtheb skyu sum brgya drug cus go chod pas gso mi dgos/ bla ma'i las byang la mi rkang gi gling bu btang chog /spyan 'dren dang tsho gos thengs de'i thog mar phye mar btab pa'i bsangs kha gsum re gtong / sgrub zhag tu byed na nyin snga ma rnams su thun gtor phul rjes mnga' gsol/ phan bde 'byung gnas ma dang 'dis mtshon 'dod gsol bshags pa'i rigs la me tog 'thor/ lhag ma bsdun du 'dzin/ bsam pa lhun grub ma sogs dkyus bzhin bya/zhag re bzhin mchod pa rnam pa brje/ grol nyin bstod bskul song mtshams su thun gtor ming dgosapas yang thog tu rten 'dogs grub rjes g.yas ru ri rgyal bkra bzang sogs kyis gtor ma 'dam shod snar mo phyogs su zhal bsgyur/ mnga' gsol grub nas gnas khang du mjug chog dkyus ltar bya'o/ /—579

rgyal ba lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (25)mdos kyi bca' ni/ rten mdos la/ mdos stan ras dkar gtsang ma sgrom khri dang mnyam pa'i steng du an gdar la gling bzhi gling phran lcags ri mu khyud sogs chu tshod gyis bris/ dbus su rin po che sna lnga bsres pa'i (4na)sa sbyin po la ri rab bang rim bzhi pa phyogs mdog can rtse mor dbus dang phyogs mtshams kyi lcog brgyad kyi nang du 'bur sku 'grub na rab/ de min sku so so'i shing byang bzhugs/gtso bo'i g.yas g.yon du sngags/ sba lcag ti shel 'phreng / man shel sogs rten rnams 'jog /bang rim gnyis pa dung khra sogs sprul pa lha klu sde brgyad 'khor tshogs kyi shing byang / bang rim gsum pa'i mdun ngos su gtso bo dang gnam mtsho rgyal mo/ shar gyi gtor ma/ gzhan rnams so so'i thad kyi phyogs mtshams/ bang rim bzhi pa dang bzhi pa'i rtsa bar mched 'khor sogs kyi gtor ma sum brgya drug cus mtshon gang shong / de'i phyir ngar mi bcu gsum/ de'i phyi mdos khri'i nang gi bar khyams la rin po che/sman/ ja/ zas sna/ shing tog /'bru sna/ tshwa/ dkar gsum/ dngar gsum/ bcod/ zhun/ rams/ rgya tshos/ mtshal sogs mdor na lho rdzas/ byang rdzas/ la rdzas/ klungs rdzas kyi rigs/ zan bar gyi yas rnams dang / mtheb skyu/ chang bu/ ril bu gsum/ brgya rtsa rnams 'god/ zhag grangs su byed na dngul lta bu'i gzheng par bzhos bu bzhi brgya tsam dang zan par sogs kyang bsham/ mdos khri'i bang rim dang por nam mkha' dang rgyang bu spel ma/ gnyis par chu nyer spyod nas bzung rta khal gyi bar rnams shing byang la bris pas bskor/ gsum par mda' khra dang 'phang khra/ zhabs dkris gto me / steng dug dugs/khyung tshang / zla nyi nor bu'i tog can gyi rtser rma bya'i sgro/ gang bzang / bal tshon lnga/ dar tshon lnga/ de bo dkar po'i sgro sogs kyis (4ba〉brgyan pa/ srog shing 'bras bu can nam shug pa lcang ma sogs shing bzang po'i rigs dang smyug ma rtse rgyas/ khyung tshang nang du yi dam gyi sku/ gdugs sogs ya stags rnams kyi dkyil dkar por byed/ dar zab ci rigs snyan shal gyi tshul dang / gos dar ras/ bkasarigs go mtshon sogs/ mtha' skor du lding stabs kyi tshul/ mdun du/ rten gtor/ mchod gtor/ chu gsum/ sman phud/ chu nyer spyod/ gser skyems/ tshogs chas rnams bsham/ gong gnon zhi khro gang —58()

rdo rje 'bar ba rtsal gyi bsnyen sgrub bkang mdos las len dran pa'i gsol 'debs/ nang ma (ka)rung gi mchod gtor stegs mtho bar gang 'gab par bsgrig go /bskang mdos su byed na mdos kyi gong ngam rgyab gang rung dus yul 'os par las byang dus kyi rten/ spyan gzigs/ mchod pa rnams rgyas bsdus ci rigs pa dgram/ mdos kyi bca' gzhi khongs 'dra ba la gsung rten sogs mi dgos/ mdos gdan g.yang shun/ rtse mor nor bu'i tshab nam mkha' che ba zhig gis byas kyang rung / gos dar/ snam ras/ pags rigs sogs gang bder bsham mo/ /bskang mdos bsdus pa byed na g.yang shun gyi steng du 'bru dkar gyi gling bzhi gling phran mu khyud bkod/bang rim dang por gtso bo yab yum gyi gtor ma/ gnyis par rnam 'phrul brgyad kyi gtor ma/ gsum pa dang bzhi par 'khor gyi gtor ma bsham/ lcags ri'i nang khong gi khyams la yas rnams dkyus bzhin 'god/ lcags ri la nam mkha' rgyang bu/ mda' 'phang / pho gdong / mo gdong sogs kyis bskor/shing byang la bris pa'i spyan gzigs rnams zan par gyi go gcod do/ /bzlog mdos su byed na bcas dngos gzhi rten mdos ltar la ri (5na〉rdob kyi rtser gtso bo yab yum/ tshangs pa/ dung g.yag /dpa' bo rdo rje 'bar rtsal/ rma rdo rje 'bar rtsal rnams las gzhan rnams mi dgos shing gtor ma'ang 'gre/bang rim bzhi pa'i rtsa bar dmar gtor zur gsum mtsho yungs kyis brgyan pa/ lcags ri la rtsang dmar srin mo 'gros su 'dzugs/ zhung tshang gi rtser ral gri lta bu'i phyag mtshan bsdam/ 'chong gi dgongs pa bzhin yas thams cad zor du bsgyur dgos kyang kong zor/ rnga zor/ mda' zor/ khrag zor/ gtor zor rnams kyang bsham/ glud che bar glud rdzas/ na ma rgyang / pho gdong / mo gdong / khram ris sogasatshang ba dgod do/ /de yang rten mdos kyi tshe gtso bo dang rnam 'phrul rnams kyi shing byang la rang sngags kyi mthar che ge mo rten 'di la brtan par bzhugs nas/ mdos glud las kyi mchod pa dam pa 'di bzhes la/ dgon grong yon bdag sogs gang yin de ga'i mi nor phyugs sogs gnyer gtad bsrung skyob sba ba dang dgon gnas lta bur bstan 'gro'i bde skyid/ bla ma'i sku tshe/ dge 'dun gyi sdodang bshad sgrub longs spyod sogs 'phel ba/ 'jig rten pa la mi nor longs spyod rigs brgyud mnga' thang —581—

rgyal ba lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (25)'khor 'bangs sogs 'phel ba dang gnod byed bar chad zhi ba/ gdon lta bu dmigs bsal yod na 'byung po che ge mo 'di'i gnod pa zhi ba sogs skabs thob sbyar nas 'dri yas kyi shing byang la rdo rje 'bar rtsal 'khor bcas la mchod pa che ge 'di 'bul ba yin pas mdos 'di la brtan par bzhugs nas zhi rgyas dbang drag gi las mchod rdzas gang yin dang bstun te 'chol lugs rigs pas dpyod do/ /bskang mdos la sngags gsham du (5ba ji ge khyed la phyi nang gsang ba'i dam rdzas mdos glud las kyi mchod pa dngos bshams yid kyis sprul te 'bul bas bzhes la zhes 'phrin las gong bzhin 'chol/yas kyi skabs mchod rdzas 'di rnams bzhes la gsol tshig gong bzhin sbyar ro/ /bzlog pa'i dus sngags bsham du che ge 'khor bcas la mdos glud yas kyi mchod pa 'di 'bul bas mthu byad rbad 'dre rbod gtong sde brgyad kyi gnod pa sogs dgra bgegs kyi steng du bsgyur ba'i 'phrin las mdzod cig sogs spyir btang dmigs bsal gyi spel tshig /yas la dper na sal 'dzul dgur/ che ge 'khor bcas kyis gcan gzan gyi spyan gzigs 'di bzhes la mche ba can gyi zor dgra bo'i steng du bsgyur nas bar gcod thams cad phyir bzlog pa'i 'phrin las mdzod cig /dmigs bsal med pa rnams la yas kyi mchod pa 'di bzhes la dkor nor 'di dag drag po'i zor du bsgyur te zhes sogs rigs pas dpyod dgos so/ /smras pa/ snyan grags dbyar rnga ltar sgrog ban sngags 'gas/ /rten mdos byang bur bzlog pa'i gsol tshig 'dri/ /so so'i lag len bsre bslad 'chol par spyod/ /mdos khri ma mthong yas kun thog lding byed/ /stobs nor ldan phal blun po gtsug na bsten/ shes rab can mang zog po'i zol gyis 'drid/ /smras tshad gtam du 'gro ba'i dus ngan 'dir/ /gser dang ra gan dbye ba ga la phyed/ /'on te gzur gnas du mar phan pa'i phyir/ /lag len dran pa'i gsal 'debs 'di tsam gyis/ /rnam dpyod ldan rnams mdos rigs gzhan la yang / /dpag par nus pa'i gcig shes kun grol yin/ /chos dang brgyud pa gsangs te rang che (6na tshe sun/ /la la ma bslabs par yang shes so skad/ /'ga' zhig —582

rdo rje 'bar ba rtsal gyi rten mdos bkang mdos zlog mdos kyi rim pa rgya 'bag mig gi rnam 'phrul/ nang ma (ka)gzhan nas byung zhes rdzun khungs 'tshol/ kha gcad mkhan la spir gyi lag bzhin sdoms/ /regazig 'dis kyang lha chen 'bar ba rtsal/ /dgyes pa'i 'dzum zhal lhag par legs bstan nas/ /ji ltar bsams pa'i don rnams ma lus pa/ /lhun gyis grub pa'i bkra shis dga' ston stsol/ /zhes bsnyen sgrub bkang mdos kyi lag len dran pa'i gsal 'debs 'di'ang rdo rje thogs med rtsal gyis bkod pa'i yi ge pa ni mañdzu sto ṣa kirti 'o// /sarba maṅga lo//rdo rje 'bar ba rtsal gyi rten mdos bkang mdos zlog mdos kyi rim pa rgya 'bag mig gi rnam 'phrul bzhugs so/ /si rtse'i chu gter pad+ma'i ze'u 'bru'i dbus/ /snang ba mtha' yas sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i gar/ /rab bsgyur srid gsum zil gnon thod 'phreng rtsal/ /zhabs rdul byang chub bar du gtsug na mdzes/ khyod las gas min rigs rnams kun gyi bdag /zur chen chos dbyings rang grol zhal lung bcud/ /btung pas smra ba'i spobs pa gzengs mtho'i drin/ /bgrang yas lus su sprul kyang gzhal nus ci/ /de phyir rang rig don gyi bla ma sa /nges rnyed rnal 'byor mchog la gzhol bzhi du/ /lha wo rten bskang bzlog pa'i mdos kyi gzhung / /rgya 'bag mig gi rnam par 'phrul 'di'o/ /de yang gsang sngags rnying ma bka' gter gyi gzhung rnams su ma mgon dregs pa sde brgyad so sor spyi sgos kyi mdos gzhung rna ma grangs ches mang zhing de dag kyang spyi mdos sgos su bsdeb/ sgos mdos spyir bsngo ba/ pho sna mo yisadrang ba/ mo sna pho yis drang ba'i lag len kha bsgyur mtha' klas shing snying po rten mdos/ bskang mdos/bzlog mdos sogs rgya che na'ang dri za'i rgyal po 'di nyid la lha brag (2na gi ter byon du mdos skor mi gsal zhing shes bya mtha' ma bkag pas gter kha gzhan dag na med pa'i nges pa mi 'dug rung thos tshod kyi gags pa dang mngon sum du spyod yul du ma gyur la/ 'jig rten dregs pa rnams ni mdos —583—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (25)kyis bskong ba phan yon mchog tu che zhing dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i khyab bdag zur thams cad mkhyen pa chos dbyings rang grol gyi zhal snga nas bshad khungs gzhan nas blangs te rung mthun sbyar ba 'thad ces gsung gis gnang ba stsal zhing tshul de la lha chen gyis kyang dgyes pa'i mtshan ma mthong bas rten mdos/ bskang mdos/ bzlog mdos gsum gyi bcas kyi rim pa reg zig dang mthong ba brgyud pa'i phyag len gyis rtogs pa'i dbang du byas nas dang po rdzas gsog pa dang gnyis pa bsham pa rnams btang snyoms su bgyis/ de yang bskang mdos rgyug che bas chu babs su bkod/ gzhan gnyis de la 'byin 'jug gis go nus pa'i dbang du byas te/ bka' brgyad phur pa zil gnon sogs zhi khro gang rung gis gzhud bsrang ba 'dzab bzlas kyi bar bya/ gnas dang yo byad brlabs nas/ dpal ldan lha mchog mas bstod (2ba)pa yan 'phrin las brgya phrag nyid ngos 'dzin pa'i snang gsal bzhin gtong /gsum pa mdos byin rlabs la shes pa rnam pa bzhi las/ dang po ri rab gzhal yas khang du shes pa ni/ phyi ma hā kro dhas bsangs/ su bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las nam mkha'/ rlung / chu/ sa ste 'byung ba bzhi'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du ri rab lhun po shar shel/ lho in+d+ra ni la/ nub pad+ma rā ga /byang gser las grub pa bang rim bzhi pa/ phyi rol gyi rmang du gser gyi ri bdun/ rol pa'i mtsho bdun/ gling bzhi gling phran/ mtha' lcags ri mu khyud kyis bskor ba'i nang lha mi'i 'dod yon bsam gyis mi khyab bas gang bar gyur pa'i ri rab kyi steng gi dbus su zlo las man shel gyi khang bzang ri gser gyi rgya phubs 'od du 'tsher ba'i rtser yid bzhin gyi nor bu'i tog gis mtshan pa/ rin po che sna tshogs kyi sgo lcog 'od 'bar pa/ rtsa bar bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho 'phyur ba/ rked par 'ja' 'od na bun gyi gur phub pa/rtse mor sprin dkar rin po che'i zil char 'bebs pa/ sa gzhi ljang sngon la me tog sna tshogs rgyas pa/khor yug tu gnam lha brgyad kyi gangs ri shel gyi mchod rten lta bus bskor ba/ shar gyi lcog be+e ḍūrla dkar po las grub pa'i lha'i gzhal med khang rgya phubs can/ rin po che'i ra ba gru bzhi pas bskor ba'i nang du rtsi sman gyi ljon shing sogs nad brgya 'joms pa'i sman gyi me tog lo 'bras myu gu grangs —5mi —

rdo rje 'bar ba rtsal gyi rten mdos bkang mdos zlog mdos kyi rim pa rgya 'bag mig gi rnam 'phrul/ nang ma (ka)med pas yongs su gtams pa/ lhor dzasbu chu bo'i gser sbyangs la rin po che sna tshogs kyis spras pa'i khang bzang rgya phubs can/ (3na)rin po che'i ra ba gru bzhi pas khor yug tu bskor ba'i nang du rgyal srid sna bdun/ bkra shis rtags brgyad/ rin bo che'i ri/ yongs 'du sa brtol/ 'dod 'jo'i ba ma rmos pa'i lo tog sogs/ lha mi'i dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs pas yongs su gang ba/ nub tu pad+ma rā ga'i khang bzang rgya phubs can/ khor yug dang bcas pa'i ra bar 'chi med bdud rtsis gtams pa'i bum bzang / mtsho/ rdzing / lteng ka /lu ma/ chu mig dang bcud len snying por gyur pa'i rdzas sman gyis yongasasu khyab pa/ byang du drag po gnam lcags 'bar ba'i mkhar steng du rgya phubs dang khor yug tu ra bas bskor ba'i nang mtshon cha sna tshogs kyi dra bas sbrel ba/ shar lhor shel dkar gyi khang bzang rgya phubasacan ra bas bskor ba'i nang du me tog nags tshal gyis gang ba/ lho nub tu drag po gnam lcags kyi gzhal med khang rgya phubs can ra bas bskor ba'i phyi rol tu mtshon cha'i bu yug dang nang du me rlung 'tshub ma 'khyil ba/ nub byang du byu ru'i ba gam rgya phubs can lcags ris bskor ba'i ra bar ut+pa la dmar pos mtshon pa'i me tog dang ljon shing sna tshogs pa'i tshal gyis khor yug tu dkrigs pa/ byang shar du yid 'ong 'ja' gur 'khrigs pa'i nang du rin po che las grub pa'i 'chi med lha'i khang bzang bkod pa phun sum tshogs pa'i khor yug tu lha'i skyed tshal gyis yongs su bskor ba'o/ /gnyis pa dregs pa'i gzugs brnyan gtso 'khor pho nyar shes pa ni/ dbus ma'i pho brang gi lte bar nyi zla pad+ma'i gdan la stobs ldan (3bsko mchog ngang dkar rin po che'i sga srab gong rmed spu len/ze long gi khebs sogs rgyan du mas mdzes par spras pa'i steng na ā+oṃ badz+ra thang ka ra mun nyid khu sha li swāhā las 'od zer 'phros/ dgra bgegs gdug pa can thams cad tshar bcad tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las ngo bo byang chub sems dpa' nam mkha'i snying po'i rnam par sprul pa rnam pa tshangs ris kyi lha'i gtso bo mtshan drug rdo rje 'bar ba rtsal la dam can shel ging dkar po/ lha gnam the dkar po/gnam lha byang chub sems dpa'/ tshangs pa'i rgyal po dung gi thor tshugs can/ dri za zur phud lnga pa/—585

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (25)khyab 'jug gnam mtsho'i rgyal po zhes bya ba srung ma chen po lha chen rdo rje 'bar ba rtsal sku mdog shel gyi ri bo la ston mtshan zla bas byugs pa ltar dkar la brjid pa/ zhal 'dzum zhing mche ba'i myu gu cung zad gtsigs pa/ spyan gsum ra btu bkra ba/ dbu skra gnag sna mo gyi thor tshugs dar dkar pos bcings pa'i rtse mor nor bu 'bar bas spras pa/ phyag g.yas rdo rje rtse lngas mtshan pa'i sba lcag nam mkha' la 'phyar zhing g.yon pa shel dkar gyi phreng ba thugs ga'i thad du 'dren pa/ zab chen dkar dmar mthing gsum gyi tse ber dang yug gyon gsol ba/ ber nang ma gnyis la rin po che rnam mang gis spud pa'i gser sked bcings shing rin po che'i gser pad la g.yu'i khra tshom gyis mdzes pa'i dbu rgyan/ snyan rgyan/ mgul rgyan/ gser ga /se mo do/ do shal/ gdu bu sogs rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa/ snyan gong ut+pa la'i chun po dang dar dbyangs(4na7na/ sku gzhen zhing mdzes pa/ zhabs gnyis nor bu'i mchil lham gyon nas rgyal po rol pa'i 'dug stangs kyis bzhugs pa/ g.yon du bde ba skyong ba'i dbang mo yid 'ong mdangs ldan gyi yum gnam mtsho'i rgyal mo rdo rje g.yu sgron ma sku mdog sngo bsangs zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma spyan gnyis dang ldan pa/ g.yas rgyal mtshan dang g.yon me long 'dzin cing dbu skra thor tshugs lhag ma'i zar bu thur du 'phyang pa/ sman btsun mdzes ma yid du 'ong ba'i cha byad kyis gtso bo la 'dud pa'i rnam pa can g.yu 'brug la bcibs pa/ gtso bo'i steng gi nam mkhar ma rungasalog 'dren glu gnyan sa bdag 'dul ba'i gnyen por ngo bo ye shes lha'i sprul pa rnam pa khyung nag dbu dgu pa zhal gdangs shing krim krim gi sgra sgrog pa/ phyag gnyis kyis sa bdag klu gnyan sbrul gyi rnam pa can bzung nas zhal du gsol ba/ gnam lcags me'i chu sder dang spu gri 'bar ba'i gshog pa can/dmigs pa'i sa gnyan bkab cing nam mkhar lding ba/ gtso bo'i mtha' skor du mched 'khor sum brgya drug cu/ g.yas kyi ru 'dre skyes bu g.yu'i smin ma can/ g.yon gyi ru 'dre khye'u chung g.yu'i zur phud can/mdun gyi ru 'dren mi dkar g.yu'i thor cog can/ rgyab kyi ru 'dren lcags kyi mi sngon 'jigs pa ste so so brgya phrag dang bcas pas bskor ba/ shar gyi gzhal med khang gi nang du pad zla'i steng na zhi mdzad —586

rdo rje 'bar ba rtsal gyi rten mdos bkang mdos zlog mdos kyi rim pa rgya snye ri bag mig gi rnam 'phrul/ nang ma (kanardo rje 'bar ba rtsal sku mdog dkar po g.yas sman gyi ljon shing thugs ka dang g.yon bdud rtsis gtams pa'i (4ba)bum pa 'dzin cing 'khas gnyis sems dpa'i skyil krung gis bzhugs par sman lha drang srong gi tsho gos kyis bskor ba/ lho'i khang bzang gi dbus su pad zla dang ne'u le dmar ser gyi gdan la rgyas byed kyi rdo rje 'bar ba rtsal ser po zha kha gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas nor bu 'bar ba thugs ka dang g.yon rin po che'i sgrom bu pus steng na 'dzin pa/ zhabs sems dpa'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs par gnod sbyin nor lha'i tshogs kyis bskor ba/ nub kyi ba gam gyi nang du pad zla'i gdan la dbang gi lha rdo rje 'bar ba rtsal sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis mnyam gzhag gi steng na pad+ma rā ga'i tshe bum 'dzin pa/ rin po che'i rgyan rdo rje'i dbyibs can/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs par tshe lha rigs 'dzin drang srong gi tshogs kyis bskor ba/ byang gi lcags mkhar 'bar ba'i dbus su pad+ma nyi ma dgra bgegs pho mo bsnol ba'i gdan la rkarma las kya khro mo rdo rje 'bar ba rtsal sku mdog nag la khros pa/ mig rtsa dmar zhing mche ba gtsigs pa/ ral pa
