dmar ser gyen du brdzes shing rin po che'i rgyan rnams dang dug sprul gyis brgyan pa/ tse ber dmar nag brtsegs pa'i nang ma gser sked can/g.yas mdung dmar dang g.yon lcags kyi mda' gzhu 'dzin pa/ rin po che'i hor lham gyon nas rta mchog bra nag rlung shugs can la bcibs shing me rlung 'khrugs pa'i slong na bzhugs par mnga' bdag dregs pa'i sde dpon tshogs kyis bskor ba/ shar lho'i khang bzang gi nang du pad zla'i gdan la lha chen gzhon nu skyes bu bzhin bzang kha dog dkar ba dbu (ldan skyo g.yu'i zur phud can/ dung so khor mar yod pa/ g.yas skyabs sbyin dang g.yon khu tshur dkur brten pa/ dar dkar gyi la'u gsol zhing zhabs gnyis mnyam pa'i stabs kyis bzhengs par rang 'dra'i lha phrug du mas bskor ba/ lho nub kyi gzhalu med khang gi dbus su gnod byed dmigs bya rnams kyi steng na skye 'gro'i srog gshed spyo 'dre srin po 'dul ba'i gnyen por lha chen gyi ngo bo rnam pa 'brong g.yag zhol can dkar po 'gying bag dang ldan pa/rwa gnyis thang shing brgyangs pa tsam la shin tu rno ba/ kha rlangs na bun ltar 'thibs shing ngur sgra 'brug —587

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (25)ltar sgrog pa/ gnam lcags kyi rmig pa me ltar 'bar bas rgyal 'gong dam sri 'dam ltar brdzis shing rang 'dra'i sprul pa dpag med 'gyed pa/ nub byang gi byu ru'i ba gam gyi nang du pad nyi'i gdan la rlung sems las rung gi lha dpa' bo rdo rje 'bar ba rtsal sku mdog dmar la 'tsher ba/ pad+ma dmar po'i phreng rgyan can/ g.yas lcags kyus bsgrub bya'i snying nas 'gugs shing g.yon zhags pas mgul nas 'ching ba/ 'khas phyed skyil gyis bzhugs par 'gugs byed dbang gi pho lha'i tshogs kyis bskor ba/byang shar gyi 'chi med lha'i khang bzang gi dbus su rin po che'i khri/ pad+ma zla nyi dgra bgegs pho mo'i gdan la lha mchog srid gsum gyi bdag po sku mdog dmar ser mche ba gtsigs shing ag tshom dang smin ma glog stong ltar 'byug pa/ dbu skra li khri'i mdog can thor tshugs kyi rtser skye ba lnga pa'i dung sum tshom gyi steng du nor bu 'bar bas mtshan pa/ g.yas ye shes kyi ral (5ba)gri me 'bar ba nam mkhar 'phyar zhing g.yon pa gser gyi 'khor lo rtsibs stong thur du bskor ba stag lpags kyi rked dkris dang sbrul gyi do shal gsol ba/ zhabs gnyis mnyam pa'i stabs kyis bzhengs nas me 'od klong na bzhugs par tshangs ris lha'i 'khor tshogs grangs med pas bskor ba/ zhi rgyas dbang 'gugs tshangs pa ste lnga ga'ang spyan gsum dang ldan zhing zhi ma khro'i nyams can dbu skra ral pa'i thor tshugs dang brog zhu sogs rin po che'i rgyan/ snyan gong ༄ la dang dar gyi cod pan 'phyang ba/ nang kha dog sna tshogs dang phyi rang mdog dang mtshungs pa'i tse ber nyis brtsegs gsol ba'i nang ma la gser sked bcings pa/ rin po che'i hor lham gsol zhing sku las 'od zer sna tsho gos phyogs bcur 'phro ba'o/ /sku'i rnam par sprul pa dgur bstan pa de dag gi g.yas phyogs su ngo bo ye shes kyi lha la rnam pa dung khra dkar pos bar snang rlabs kyis bcad de khyer 'dre 'byung po phug ron 'dra ba'i rjes bshul bsnyegs te sha khrag rus pa za ba/ rgyab tu lcags sdig nag po lus kyis sa gzhi khyab cing rwa dang mjug ma nam mkhar gdengs nas 'od zer lcags kyi dra bar sgab 'dre phyir 'brang bcug ste snying khrag 'byin pa/ g.yon du sprul pa'i dur sbyang pho mo glog ltar 'khyug cing spu gri'i mche bas dgra bgegs 'bigs shing lcags kyi sder mos sa gzhi 'drad —588

rdo rje 'bar ba rtsal gyi rten mdos bkang mdos zlog mdos kyi rim pa rgya 'bag mig gi rnam 'phrul/ nang ma (kanapa/ mjug ma brdabs pas me rlung 'tshub pa'o/ /bang rim gnyis par lha dang klu gnyan bye ba 'bum sde'i dmag tshogs/ snang srid lha srin sde brgyad kyi dpung tshogs yan lag bzhi pa'i cha lugs su 'jigasashing dpa' ba/ kun kyang nyi ma 'bum gyi gzi brjid dang ldan par gyur/ gsum pa thun rdzas ya stagasaglud dang skongs su shes pa ni/ raṃ las ye shes kyi mes dngos po'i skyon rnams bsregs/ yaṃ las cho me nyid kyi rlung gis dngos po'i skyon rnams sbyangs/ kho las mtshan med kyi chus dngos po'i skyon rnams bkrus/ ā+oṃ gyis phun sum tshogs pa'i longs spyod rnams dang ldan par byas/ āḥs sa gzhi bar snang nam mkha'i khyon rnams yongs su bkang ste 'dzad pa med pa nam mkha'i mdzod du spel/ hūṃ gis med du byung ba'i bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ swā sa gzugs brnyan thams cad mtshan dang dpe byad phung khams skye mched dang ldan/ hās dri za'i rgyal po rdo rje 'bar ba rtsal 'khor dang bcas pa'i sku gsung thugs dang gnyis su med pa'i byin rlabs kyis thugs dam gnyan po yongs su skong ba'i nus mthu dang ldan par gyur/ ā+oṃ āḥ& tri spe paṃ tre rat+na ste lo kya phaṭa/ bzhi pa thun rdzas mtshon char shes pa ni/ mda' mdung ral gri gser 'khor sogs phyag mtshan gyi rdzas rnams gnam lcags 'bar ba'i thog ltar gyur nas gnod byed dgra bgegs thams cad rdul du brlag ste tshar gcod pa'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur/sngags drug dang phyag rgya drug gis 'phrin las ltar phyin gyis brlab/ bzhi pa spyan drang zhing bzhugs su gsol ba ni/ /spos sbyor rol mo g.yab dar dang bcas/ /ye shes gzhal yas ma nas/ /sa ma ya dzaḥdzaḥ'i bar brjod/ hūṃ/ dus gsum sangs rgyas pad+ma sam+bha wa/ /gter chen chos kyi rgyal po rgod ldem sogs/ /rtsa brgyud (6ba)bla ma'i spyan sngar bstan skyong bar/ /zhal bzhes lha mchog chen po spyan 'dren no/ /phun tsho gos 'chi med bdag po'i pho brang dang / /lha brgyad gangs kyis bskor ba'i gzhal med khang / /ngo mtshar bkod legs zhing khams grangs med nas/ /sna tshogs 'phrin las bsgrub phyir spyan 'dren no/ /dam can shel ging dkar po spyan 'dren no/ /lha chen gnam the dkar po spyan 'dren no/ /gnam lha byang chub —589

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho' gsung 'bum/ (25)sems dpa' spyan 'dren no/ /tshangs pa dung gi thor tshugs spyan 'dren no/ /dri za zur phud lnga pa spyan 'dren no/ khyab 'jug gnam mtsho'i rgyal po spyan 'dren no/ /gsang yum rdo rje g.yu sgron spyan 'dren no/ /mched 'khor sum brgya drug cu spyan 'dren no/ /rnam 'gyur sprul pa'i tsho gos rnams spyan 'dren no/ /dbu dgu mkha' lding dbang po spyan 'dren no/ /yang sprul dung khra dkar po spyan 'dren no/ /rab 'jigs lcags sdig nag po spyan 'dren no/ /glog ltar 'byug pa'i dung spyang spyan 'dren no/ /lha klu gnod sbyin dregs pa sde brgyad kyi/ /dmag tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa spyan 'dren no/ /spyan 'dren mchod pa'i gnas 'dir da tshur spyon/ /sku gcig mtshan drug rnam 'gyur brgyad ston pa/ /dri za'i rgyal po rdo rje 'bar ba rtsal /sngon gyi dam dgongs gnas 'dir gshegs nas kyang / /dgyes pa'i stan la gnyis su med par bzhugs/ /oṃ badz+ra thang dar sa pa ri wā ra dzaḥlha baṃ hoḥ pad+ma ka ma lwa ya rto/ lnga pa bka' bsgo ba ni/ nga ni dbang chen he ru ka /sangs rgyas kun dang (7na)mnyam sbyor ba'i/ /ji snyed sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /de bzhin bsgrub pa'i rnal lhor pa'i/ /dad pa dang ni dam tshig gis/ /ming sring bzhin du dam bsres pa'i/ /dam tshig chen po'i dus la bab/ /rdo rje dri chu bdud rtsi mchog /pañtsa a skṛ ta sbyar te/ /tshangs pa dri za'i rgyal po che/ /rdo rje g.yu sgron sprul 'khor la/ khro bo rdo rje gnod sbyin gyis/ /lce la bdud rtsi bzhag nas ni/ /sngon tshe ji srid mna' bor bzhin/ /nga yang dam las mi 'da'o/ khyed rnams dam las ma 'da' zhig /gal te dam las khyod 'das na/ khro bo rdo rje gnod sbyin gyis/ /snying khrag bzhes te 'thung bar byed/ /de bas dam las ma 'da' bar/ /bcol ba'i 'phrin las sgrub par mdzod/ /badz+ra ya ka hūṃ hūṃ/drug pa mchod gtor 'bul ba ni/ hūṃ/ g.ya' gangs rgyun 'bab a lha'i yon chab sbreng / /thang dang chu skyes me tog phang phung g.yo/ /dri zhim ngad ldang bdug spos lang long 'khrigs/ /snod bcud kun gsal sgron ma tshar du dngar/ /ga pur tsan dan chus sbran byug pa'i rdzas/ /ro mda' lha yi zhal zas phyur bur spungs/ /pi waṃ rdzarnga sil snyan gling bu'i sgra/ /gdugs dkar rgyal mtshan ba dan lda ldi sogs/ /yid 'phrog lta na sdug pa'i mchod pa'i sprin/ /'dzad med nam mkha' mdzod kyi sgo phye nas/ /bod skyong —590

rdo rje 'bar ba rtsal gyi rten mdos bkang mdos zlog mdos kyi rim pa rgya 'bag mig gi rnam 'phrul/ nang ma (ka)mnga' bdag rgyal po'i sku yi lha/ /dri za'i rgyal po 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ /oṃ badz+ra thang ka ra sapa ri wā ra a / pu 〉 sogs kyis(7bsgo chod/ sman mchod dang gtor ma 'phrin las ltar bsngo/ bdun pa dbang du bsdu ba ni/ rang nyid khro bo'i bskyed rim gsal che ba'i nga rgyal bskyed la/ hūṃ/ nga ni che mchog he ru ka /nga ni pad+ma dbang chen yin/ /sku ni ri rab bas kyang che/ /gsung gi hūṃ sgra 'brug ltar sgrog shangasanas bskal pa'i 'thor rlung 'tshub/ /mig nas tshe yi phung po 'bar/ /smin ma khro gnyer rba rlabs zhabrug /ral pa kham nag srid rtser 'bar/ /phyag mtshan mtshon cha skar ltar zhabrug /dus gsum bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyasang / khro rgyal thams cad sku la rdzogs/ /gzi brjid phyogs bcur me ltar 'bar/ /bskal pa'i me yi klong dkyil na/ /dregs pa ma lus las la 'khol/ khams gsum srid gsum dbang du sdud/ /'jig rten khams kun g.yo 'gul byed/ /dam las 'da' ba'i snying khrag 'thung / /bdud dang log 'dren zhabs kyis gnon/ /dam can ma lus srog nas gzir/ /dbang gi rgyal po las 'chol gyi/ /nga yi bka' las gang 'da' ba/ /lus sems rdul du brlag par byed/ /de bas dam can ma lus pa/ /gong gong chum chum dam la 'du/ /ā+oṃ āḥ& swāhā/ badz+ra kro dha mahā shrī he ru ka ya mān+ta ka pad+ma kro twe shwa ri/ badz+ragī li ki lwa ya tsaṇ+ḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa/ kā la rū pa/ badz+ra ya ka kro dha pad+ma ge mu ka ā na〉 ya/ ā po〉 ya/ban+ta ya/ bsgo ya/ to sha ya/ to sha ya/ mo ha ya/ mo ha ya/ shrī mahā kā la sarba rū pa/ badz+ra sarba dus sarba ḍā gi niX da ya/ ha ha nyi hi/ e a ra li hūṃ (8na)dzaḥzhes brgya rtsa sogs ci rigs pa bzla/ brgyad pa mdos glud kyi rabs dang yas kyi cho 'brang 'don pa ni ra ka'i gter byon gyi stod 'chod len/ dgu pa mdos bsngo zhing 'phrin las 'chol ba ni/ hūṃ/ 'byung ba rim brtsegs nor 'dzin dkyil 'khor steng / /shar phyogs man shel in+d+ra ni la lho/ /nub ngos pad+ma rā ga byang gser las/ /legs grub bang rim bzhi ldan ri rab steng / /sna tsho gos rin cen khang bzang lcog brgyad mdzes/ /rgya phubs nor bu'i tog can dra ba dang / /dra phyed dril sil dar dpyangs rin cen brgyan/ /yongs 'du sa brtol srog shing brtan pa'i rtser/ /dbang gzhu ltar ba po gdugs dang khyud tshang brtsegs/ /rked la nyi zla rtsa bar gser gyi ri/ /—59/—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (25)rol mtsho bdun dang gling bzhi gling phran mthar/ /lcags ris legs bskor bzhugs gnas pho brang che/ /rdo rje 'bar rtsal rnam phral gsang ba'i yum/ /mched sprul pho nya 'khor tsho gis rgya mtshor 'bul/ /thugs dam gnyan po dbyings su skongs gyur nas/ /zhi rgyas dbang drag 'phrin las ma lus mdzod/ /nam mkha' khra bo bya dkar sgro phod can/ /sgro yungs ba la tshon gyis spras rgyang bu spel/ /yul mkhar pho gdong mo gdong sde brgyad kyi/ /byang rbod gnod byed ma lus bzlog pa'i khram/ /thabs shes zung 'jug mda' khra 'thang khra bsnol/ /yid tshe srog dbugs phung khams skye mched dbang / /gos rgyan ldan pa mi las dga' ba'i (8ba'i da/ /bgos chang ril bu mtheb skyus bskor ba 'di/ /rdo rje 'bar rtsal rnam 'phrul gsang ba'i yum/ /mched sprul pho nya 'khor tsho gos rgya mtshor 'bul/ /thugs dam gnyan po dbyings su stongasagyur nas/ /zhi rgyas dbang drag 'phrin las ma lus mdzod/ /mchod yon g.ya' gangs skye chu shel snod bskyil/ /lha mi'i me tog 'dab rgyas ze'u 'bru rgod/ mang sman bsangs dud na bun bzhin du 'khrigs/ /nyi zla rtsi 'bru'i mar mes phyogs kun gsal/ /ga pur gur kum 'dag chal byug pa'i dri/ /dkar gsum dngar gsum zlan sbyar ro brgya'i bskos/ /dgar dung dung wo gling bu rnga bo che/ /sbug sil dril bu g.yer kha rol mo'i sgra/ /rdo rje 'bar rtsal ྾/ /mched sprul pho nya ྾/ /thugs dam gnyan po ྾/ /zhi rgyas dbang drag ྾/ /'dod yon lnga ldan rked phra zlos gar bsgyur/ /thogs med gser 'khor nor bu bsam dgu 'grub/ /bde ster btsun mo gru 'dzin khyim gyi bdag /stobs ldan bal glang cang shes rlung gshog rta/ /dgra 'joms dmag dpon nor bu'i tog mdzes gdugs/ /gser nya gter gyi bum bzang pad+ma dkar/ /g.yas 'khyil dung dkar 'khor lo dpal be lnga /rgyal mtshan ba dan rnga yab lda ldi 'phan/ /rdo rje 'bar rtsal ྾/ /mched sprul ྾/ /thugs dam ྾/ /zhi rgyas ྾/ /thor tshugs g.yas 'khyil sum steng nor bus spud/ /dar chings cod pan ut+pal chun po ldem/ /rin cen phrog zhu snyan cha mgul rgyan dang / /gdu bu do (9na skol gser ga se mo do/ /gser sked kha dog sna tshogs tse ber gos/ /yug gyon hor lham pad phreng stag sham sprul/ /chas mdzesang nga dkar rta mchog g.yu 'byug dang / /ne'u le rta nag —592

rdo rje 'bar ba rtsal gyi rten mdos bkang mdos zlog mdos kyi rim pa rgya 'bag mig gi rnam 'phrul/ nang ma (ka)pad+ma nyi zla'i gdan/ /rdo rje 'bar rtsal ྾/ /mched sprul ྾/ /thugs dam ྾/ /zhi rgyas ྾/ /rdo rjesamatshan pa'i sba lcag shel dkar phreng / /chu srin rgyal mtshan me long srid gsum gsal/ /sman gyi ljon pa bum pa bdud rtsis gtams/ /rab 'bar nor bu rin cen gyis gang sgrom/ /mchi med tshe bum gnam lcags mda' dang gzhu/ /mdung rnon ut+pal las mtshan lcags kyu dang / /zhags pa rno ngar ral gri gser sbyangs/ /'khor lo rtsibs stong 'bar ba'i phyag 'tshal sogs/ /rdo rje 'bar rtsal mo/ /mched sprul za/ /thugs dam mo/ /zhi rgyas mo/ /sga chas rab spras rta mchog ngang pa dkar/ /'brong dkar dbang sngon rwa gdengs dar snas brgyan/ /be+e ḍūrla 'dra'i rwa 'khyil lug dkar mdzes/ khyung ltar lding ba'i rgya khra 'phur zhing rgyug /'dzad med 'o ma'i rgyun spel zhol mo dang / /bsams pa'i re skong 'dod pa 'jo ba'i ba/ /mi bzad khur chen 'degs pa'i gnyis 'thung pa/ /ra dkar ma he 'dab chags rgyal po khyung / /rdo rje 'bar rtsal ྾/ /mched sprul ྾/ /thugs dam ྾/ /zhi rgyas mo/ khrung khrung go bo bya nag skyung ka rgod/ /rma bya ne'u tso pu shud 'ug pa glag /khyim bya 'ol ba gong mo ngang ngur dang / /seng (9ba) stag gzig gung dom dred wa spyang gsa'/ /ce spyang 'phar ba spra sprel byi la khyi/ ga ba dgo ba gnyan bcod gla ba rgya/ /ri bong gna' la ru ru brtse ru thung / /sar 'dzul gnam 'phur ri dwags 'phyo dgu'i tshogs/ /rdo rje 'bar rtsal ྾/ /mched sprul ྾/ /thugs dam ྾/ /zhi rgyas ྾/ /sbal sprul nya lcong rta bla sdom sdig sogs/ /klu gnyan sa bdag chags pa'i srog ldan rigs/ /rta dang dre'u bong bu rnga mo g.yag /mi bzad dkor nor khur gyis rab tu lci/ /rten gter rgyun gtor bskang gtor a mṛ ta/ /phrum thud phye mar 'khur ba shing tog tshwa/ /'byu sna ja chang dkar gsum dngar gsum tshogs/ /lug sha mgo 'byar dkar mo lag g.yas rten/ /rdo rje 'bar rtsal ྾/ /mched sprul ma/ /thugs dam ྾/ /zhi rgyas ྾/ /khrab chen gos gsham mgo chas brjid pa'i rmog /sbir phub zhol btags lcags gzhibs btsan po'i go /mda' mdung rtse gsum dgra sta gri gug gri/ khri skyogs dpag chen la sogs rdo rje'i mtshon/ /tsan dan ga pur se 'bru a ka sa /bzang drug sman sna bcod zhun rams skag mtshal/ /za 'og dar ras —593

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (25)snam phrug pags pa'i rigs/ /lha dang mi yi rin cen sna tsho gis pa/ /rdo rje 'bar rtsal ྾/ /mched sprul ྾/ /thugs dam ྾/ /zhi rgyas ྾/ /'phrin las 'tshol ba ni/ hūṃ/ lha khyod sprul dkar gzugs kyis mtho 'tshams tshe/ /pad 'byung gzi byin ma bzod khye'u'i gzugs/ /bstan nas srog gi snying po phul ba na/ /(10na skosang mtshan rdo rje mchog rab rtsal du btags/ /hal po ri'i mdun g.yu yi zur phud can/ /rnam par bstan tshe bod skyong rgyal po'i gdung / /rdzogs min sku la gnyan po byed do zhes/ /slob dpon spyan sngar dam bca' mdzad min nam/ /gter ston chen po dngos grub rgyal mtshan nas/ /rdo rje 'chang dngos chos dbyings rang grol bar/ /rtsa brgyud bla ma rim par byon rnams la/ /zhal 'ches dam tshig gnyan po ma g.yel dgongs/ /'gro la phan bde 'byung gnas thub pa'i bstan/ /mdo rgyud lung dang mngon par rtogs pa la/ /'chad nyan de don bsam sgom sde rnams kun/ /yar ngo'i zla ltar 'phel ba'i 'phrin las mdzod/ khri srong lde'u btsan rjes su brtse ba'i yul/ /bod 'bangs ngo tsha khrel ldan bzang spyod kyis/ /legs skyong sa dbang rgyal po'i mnga' thang dang / /sku tshe mtshan jus chab srid 'phel bar mdzod/ /gangs kyi ra bas bskor ba'i sman ljongs 'dir/ /nad yams skya pham mu gog yul zhabrug sogs/ /mi mthun nyes pa'i dri ma ma lus pa/ /byin rlabs mtho ris chu bos dag par mdzod/ /tshe yang ring gnas mi phyugs rigs brgyud dar/ /sman rnams nus 'phel bzlas brjod mthu che zhing / /brlang spyod med par phan tshun mnyes gshin pa/ /rdzogs ldan gsar pa'i dga' ston rgyas par mdzod/ /'byung bzhi 'khod snyoms lo tog dus su smin/ /mtha' bzhi las sgo ma lus yongs su 'du/ /tshong dang khe spogasadon grub (10ba)'byor pa la/ /ci bder sbyor pa'i dga' ston la sbyor mdzod/ khyad par log smon mthu btsan sa bon tshogs/ /lha min phung sri'i gsher gyis bskyed pa'i 'bras/ /byur chags smra mchu 'thibs po dpung pa'i smag /drag shul nyi ma'i 'od kyis sangs par mdzod/ /stod smad mtha' dmag sdang ba'i sems ldan pas/ /drag shul brtsom pa'i rje blon mngag gzhug sde/ /sgo gsum spa bkong mnga' thang tshe srog rnams/ /rdul phran lta bur rlog pa'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /yang sgos bdag cag dpon slob rgyu sbyor —594

rdo rje 'bar ba rtsal gyi rten mdos bkang mdos zlog mdos kyi rim pa rgya 'bag mig gi rnam 'phrul/ nang ma (ka)la/ /gnod byed phyi rol mu stegs sbyor ༅ mda'/ /bar pa drang srong bram ze dmod pa'i mtshon/ /nang pa sangs rgyas bden mthu phyir zlog mdzod/ /sngon bsags 'phral gyi spyod lam ma dag pas/ /'phog dang las kyi dbang gi rang bzhin gyis/ /lha srin sde brgyad za kha zag pa yi/ /nyer 'tshe'i bar gcod ma lus zhi bar mdzod/ /stong phrag brgyad cu rtsa bzhi'i bgegs kyi rigs/ /sum brgya drug cu'i ma rungasagadug pa'i gdon/ /mtshan dang ltasang na brgyad cu rtsa gcig dang / /sum brgya drug cu'i ye 'brog bzlog par mdzod/ /byis pa'i gdon chen bco lngas rnam 'tshe ba/ /bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi'i nad kyi zug rngu dang / /dus min rkyen gyis 'chi ba rnam pa brgyad/ /gshis ngan 'gums pa bco lnga zhi bar mdzod/ /lo zla zhag dus sheg dang sri ngan sogs/ /dngos nyams rmi ltas mo pra ngan babs pa/ /dug mtshon bsgom pa'i mi dang (11na〉sku min gyi/ /bsam sbyor ngan pa thams cad zhi bar mdzod/ khyad par rgyal bsen 'gong po skrun dgu'i rigs/ /chos byed las mtha' log pas dam sri sa /skyes nas 'gro mang 'phung ba'i bya ba la/ /zhugs pa'i ma rungs mtha' dag rdul du rlog /khyod nyid lhag pa'i ltar bsten gnyer gtad pa/ /dmigs yul bsrung byar gyur pa'i tshogs rnams kyis/ /lus la nad dang rims kyis mi 'tshe zhing / /lcags srog rdo rje'i srad bus bsdam par mdzod/ /lo brgyar 'tsho ba'i tshe yi dngos grub dang / /rnam thosabur 'gran bsod nams mnga' thang rgyas/ /ci bsams 'grub pa'i rlung rta'i dar po che/ /srid pa'i rtse mo'i bar du 'phyar bar mdzod/ khams gsum gnas so cog gi gtsug tor ngos/ /rkang sen zla ba tshesapas nyer brgyan te/ /'bangs su bkol nas ji ltar bsgo ba'i las/ /thogs pa med pa lhun gyis grub par mdzod/ /gtan mdun dkar po dam pa'i chos bsgrub par/ /yid srubs mda' yis 'tshe bar mi nus shing / /mthun rkyen kun tshang lung rtogs yon tan gyis/ /rang gzhan don rnams hrūb pa'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /mdor na deng nas byang chen ma thob par/ /lha mchog rdo rje 'bar ba rtsal khyod kyis/ /nyin mtshan dus drug mel tshe rab mdzad de/ /bsams pa'i don kun thogs med sgrub par mdzod/ /gzhan yang / pad+ma thod 'phreng rgyal ba'i spyan snga mā /zhes sogs bya/—595

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (25)bcu pa bstod pa chos dbyings ma dang bskul (11ba 'a 'dam shod snang mo dang gnas brgyad ma gtong / bcu gcig pa 'bul ba ni/ thog tu mdos bteg ste gso sbran byin gyis brlab/ ye shes gzhal yas mas spyan drang zhing mchod gtor 'bul/ g.yas ru ri rgyal bkra bzang rtser/ zhes sogs kyis mdos zhal phyir bsgyur zhing gtong / mnga' gsol byed/ nang du log nas/ bcu gnyis pa mjug mchog dkyus bzhin no/ /zhag sbrel du byed na tso gtor gyi rjes su mnga' gsol/ bsam pa lhun grub ma sogasasmon lam ci rigs pa bya/ bskang mdos bsdus pa byed na sku rten sogs dor ba'i lag len bcas bder shams te 'phrin las kyi bstod pa lha yi lha mchog ma song mtshams byin rlabs shes pa bzhi'i gnyis pa dor/ sngags drug dang phyag rgya drug gis byin gyis brlab/ mdos bsngo ba dang 'phrin bcol gyi rjes su bstod pa chos dbyings ma nas yang thog tu mdos bte gi pa sogs mjug chog rnams sngar ltar ro/ /rten mdos su byed na 'phrin las kyi sman gtor byin rlabs yan dkyus ltar la mdos brlab pa nas bka' bsgo'i rjes su 'phrin las kyi dam bsgrags nas/ ji bzhin mnyam par gzhag pas thugs dam bskang / yan bya/ de nas mdos gzhung gi che ba'i nga rgyal bskyed pa nas mdos 'bul ba'i bar gtong /de yang bldab rgyu'i blo ka gcig po'i tshab/ rdo rje 'bar rtsal rnam 'phrul gsang ba'i yum/ /mched sprul pho nya bka' sdod rgya mtsho rnams/ /rten 'dir brtan bzhugs mchod pa'i tshogs bzhes la/ bcol ba'i 'phrin las ma lus sgrub (12na)par mdzod/ /ces bsgyur/ 'phrin las 'chol ba nas bskul gyi bar bskang mdos ltar dang sa gtor mnga' gsol mjug chog par 'dra/ zhag grangs su byed kyang 'phrib snon med/ bzlog mdos su byed na thog mar sngags pa bdag nyid ber thod kha g.yu kha gser so gos kyi chas su gzhug /'bru sna bre bcu gsum gyi steng du bsangs phye la mda' dar rin cen btags pa btsugs/ rgya phor dang dngul skyogs gser skyems kyis bkang / sngags drug phyag rgya drug gis byin gyis brlabs nas/ mgron rnam pa bzhi la mchod pa phud skong gtong zhing zhi khro gang rung gis gzhung bsrang ba nas khor yug gnam lha brgyad kyi gangs ri shel gyi mchod rten lta bus bskor ba yan mdos gzhud ltar la/ shar —596

rdo rje 'bar ba rtsal gyi rten mdos bkang mdos zlog mdos kyi rim pa rgya 'bag mig gi rnam 'phrul/ nang ma (ka)du yid 'ong 'ja' gur 'khrigs pa'i nang du rin po che las grub pa'i 'chi med lha'i khang
